hindi: अनुभवोत्तर — जो ज्ञान इंद्रिय-अनुभव के बाद और उसी के आधार पर मिलता है
definition: describes knowledge that can only be justified by experience, such as observation, testing or the evidence of the senses
example: Whether the fridge still holds any milk is strictly a posteriori, Ananya said, so stop theorising and open the door.

hindi: प्रागनुभविक विधि — अनुभव की जाँच के बिना केवल तर्क-सुविधा से विश्वास तय करना
definition: Peirce's name for settling belief by accepting whatever seems agreeable to reason or taste, without testing it against experience
example: Deciding by pure elegance that the metro must run every five minutes, Isha followed the a priori method and missed her train.

hindi: क-श्रेणी — घटनाओं का भूत, वर्तमान और भविष्य के अनुसार क्रम
definition: McTaggart's term for the ordering of events as past, present or future, which keeps changing as time passes
example: On the A-series, Friday's party shifted from future to present to past, while Priya's hangover followed the same route a little later.

hindi: क-कालसिद्धांत — भूत, वर्तमान, भविष्य के भेद को वस्तुगत और समय को सचमुच बहता मानने का मत
definition: the view that the difference between past, present and future is objective, and that time genuinely flows as moments become present then past
example: Riya defended the A-theory of time on the bus, insisting that the present moment really is special because it is the only one she can feel.

hindi: व्याख्यात्मक अनुमान — किसी चौंकाने वाले तथ्य की सबसे संभावित व्याख्या तक पहुँचने की तर्क-विधि
definition: reasoning that begins from a surprising observation and moves to the hypothesis that would best explain it, if that hypothesis were true
example: Seeing flour on the cat and an open cupboard, Rahul used abduction to reach the only sensible theory about the midnight kitchen raid.

hindi: अभाव — किसी वस्तु का न होना, जिसे स्वतंत्र पदार्थ माना गया
definition: in Vaisheshika and Nyaya, absence or nonexistence treated as a real category, such as the absence of a teapot on an empty table
example: Opening the biscuit tin to find only crumbs, Sunil stared at a very solid case of abhava.

hindi: अभिधर्म — मन और अनुभव के घटकों का बौद्ध विश्लेषण
definition: the Buddhist tradition of systematic analysis that breaks mind and experience into lists of basic momentary elements and studies how they combine
example: Colour-coding every emotion in her journal, Tanvi realised she had built a small Abhidharma of her own.

hindi: अभ्यास — मन को स्थिर करने का निरंतर, लंबा प्रयास
definition: in Yoga philosophy, steady and repeated practice, sustained over long periods, which together with dispassion gradually quiets the fluctuations of mind
example: After the fortieth morning of scales, Tara told her piano teacher that abhyasa was the only philosophy she had time for.

hindi: उन्मूलनवाद — दासप्रथा को पूरी तरह समाप्त करने का आंदोलन और मत
definition: the movement and moral view that slavery must be ended completely, and more broadly that deeply unjust institutions should be abolished
example: In history class, the students traced how abolitionism grew from pamphlets and kitchen-table meetings into a force that changed laws.

hindi: विषयपरकता — किसी विचार या चिह्न का किसी चीज़ के विषय में होना
definition: the plain-language name for intentionality: the capacity of thoughts, words and pictures to be about, refer to or stand for something else
example: Staring at a meme nobody understood, Karan realised its aboutness depended entirely on a group chat joke from 2019.

hindi: निरपेक्ष अहं — स्वयं को और जगत को स्थापित करने वाली मूल चेतना
definition: Fichte's idea of a basic, self-positing activity of consciousness, a pure self that sets up both the individual mind and the world it opposes
example: When her brother claimed the entire family revolved around him, Divya dryly asked whether he had confused himself with the absolute ego.

hindi: निरपेक्ष प्रत्ययवाद — समस्त वास्तविकता को एक सर्वव्यापी चेतना की अभिव्यक्ति मानने का मत
definition: the view, associated with Hegel, that all reality is the expression of a single, all-embracing mind or spirit gradually coming to know itself
example: After a long seminar on absolute idealism, Mihir wondered whether the universe was really getting to know itself through his exhausted brain.

hindi: परम शून्यता — सभी सत्ताओं को धारण करने वाली अंतिम, निराकार आधारभूमि
definition: the Kyoto School idea of an ultimate ground beyond both being and its absence, an openness in which all things and selves appear and relate
example: Staring at the empty fridge at midnight, Yash declared that he was finally contemplating absolute nothingness.

hindi: परम विरोधाभास — कीर्केगार्द के अनुसार अनंत ईश्वर का सीमित मनुष्य बनना, जिसे तर्क नहीं समझ सकता
definition: Kierkegaard's term for the belief that the eternal deity became a finite human, a claim reason cannot grasp and faith must accept
example: During the late-night hostel debate, Irfan said the absolute paradox showed where logic hands the baton to faith.

hindi: निरपेक्ष दिक् — वस्तुओं से स्वतंत्र, स्थिर और सर्वत्र एकरूप दिक् की धारणा
definition: Newton's idea of space as a fixed, unchanging container that exists independently of objects and provides a true standard of rest and motion
example: Parked at the traffic light, Divya felt the train beside her move and wished absolute space would settle which vehicle was really going anywhere.

hindi: निरपेक्ष चैतन्य — कला, धर्म और दर्शन में स्वयं को जानती चेतना
definition: Hegel's term for spirit at its highest stage, when mind fully knows itself through artworks, religion and, most completely, philosophy
example: After the concert, Om insisted he had glimpsed absolute spirit in the violin solo, though his friends suspected the late-night biryani.

hindi: निरपेक्ष काल — वस्तुओं और घटनाओं से स्वतंत्र, एकसमान बहने वाले काल की धारणा
definition: Newton's idea of time as flowing uniformly by itself, independent of any clocks, events or observers
example: When every clock in the flat showed a different hour, Aditi longed for absolute time to decide who was actually late.

hindi: निरंकुशतावाद — शासक की सत्ता को असीमित और किसी नियम से न बंधी मानने का सिद्धांत
definition: the political doctrine that a ruler should hold complete, unlimited power, not checked by laws, courts, parliaments or the people
example: The group project's absolutism began when Karan made himself leader, editor and the only person allowed to touch the slides.

hindi: अमूर्त प्रत्यय — विशेष गुणों से रहित सामान्य विचार, जिन्हें बर्कले ने असंभव माना
definition: general ideas supposedly formed by stripping away particular details, such as a triangle lacking any specific size, which Berkeley argued nobody actually forms
example: In maths class, Kabir insisted he could picture a triangle with no particular shape, and the teacher suggested he had just invented abstract ideas.

hindi: अमूर्तन सिद्धांत — किसी समतुल्यता संबंध के सहारे नई अमूर्त वस्तु परिभाषित करने वाला सिद्धांत
definition: a principle introducing abstract objects by saying two items share the same abstract object exactly when they stand in some matching relation, as parallel lines share a direction
example: Declaring that flatmates share the same chore only when they complain about it equally, Sid proposed an abstraction principle nobody else signed.

hindi: असंगत नायक — अर्थहीनता जानते हुए भी पूरी चेतना से जीवन जीने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: Camus's figure of a person who fully sees that life has no final meaning yet keeps living with clear awareness, defiance and even happiness
example: Pushing the stalled scooter uphill every morning with a grin, Farhan considered himself the absurd hero of his colony.

hindi: असंगतिवाद — अर्थ की मानवीय खोज और मौन जगत के टकराव को स्वीकारने का मत
definition: the view, linked with Camus, that humans endlessly search for meaning in a universe that offers none, and that we should face this clash honestly rather than escape it
example: Refilling the office printer for the fourth time that morning, Dev decided absurdism was the only philosophy that fit his job.

hindi: अकादमिक संशयवाद — प्लेटो की अकादमी में विकसित संशयवाद
definition: the sceptical tradition of Plato's later Academy, which argued that certain knowledge is unattainable and that people should follow what seems most persuasive
example: Tired of confident travel blogs, Nisha adopted Academic scepticism and simply picked whichever hotel seemed most plausible.

hindi: अग्राह्यता — वस्तुओं को निश्चित रूप से न जान पाने का मत
definition: the ancient sceptical doctrine that nothing can be grasped with complete certainty, so firm understanding of anything remains beyond human reach
example: After reading three contradictory manuals for the washing machine, Gautam declared acatalepsy and pressed every button.

hindi: अभिगम्य चेतना — वह जानकारी जो तर्क, वाणी और कार्य के लिए मन में उपलब्ध हो
definition: information in the mind that is available for reasoning, speaking and guiding action, as distinct from how that information feels
example: Rushing through the quiz, Omkar's access consciousness supplied the answer instantly, even though he felt nothing but panic.

hindi: अभिगम आंतरिकतावाद — औचित्य के आधार तक चिंतन द्वारा पहुँच को आवश्यक मानने का मत
definition: the form of internalism holding that you must be able to become aware of your justifying reasons simply by reflecting on them
example: Asked why she trusted the recipe, Nidhi listed three reasons on the spot, a tidy display of access internalism.

hindi: सुगम्यता संबंध — यह तय करने वाला संबंध कि कौन-सा संभव लोक किससे 'दिखता' है
definition: in possible-world semantics, the relation saying which possible worlds count as alternatives to a given world, so that necessity means truth in every accessible world
example: Priya's physics teacher said a world where homework grades itself is simply outside the accessibility relation from this classroom.

hindi: आगन्तुक गुण — किसी वस्तु का ऐसा गुण जो बदल जाए तो भी वस्तु वही बनी रहे
definition: a quality that a thing happens to have but could lose without ceasing to be that thing, such as colour, location or size
example: When Dev dyed his hair blue, his mother calmly said it was merely an accident, since underneath the colour he was still the same troublesome son.

hindi: आगंतुक परिवर्तन — वस्तु के बने रहते हुए उसके किसी गौण गुण का बदलना
definition: Aristotelian term for change in which a thing keeps existing while losing or gaining some inessential quality, such as colour, size or place
example: Repainting the bedroom walls was only accidental change, Mohit assured his landlord, so it was still very much the same room.

hindi: आकस्मिक सामान्यीकरण — ऐसा सार्वभौम कथन जो सत्य तो है पर प्रकृति का नियम नहीं
definition: a universal statement that happens to be true without being among the laws of nature, such as every coin in someone's pocket being silver, which predicts nothing about coins added later
example: Everyone in the office wearing blue on Monday was an accidental generalization, not a dress code, Kavya reassured the new intern.

hindi: आगंतुक गुण — वह गुण जो वस्तु में है पर उसके बिना भी वस्तु वही रहती
definition: a property that a thing actually has but could lose or have lacked while remaining the very same thing, as opposed to an essential property
example: Rohan argued that his messy hair was merely an accidental property, while his love of cricket was part of his essence.

hindi: समायोजन — श्रोता द्वारा अनकही पूर्वमान्यता को चुपचाप स्वीकार कर लेना
definition: the process by which listeners quietly accept an unstated background assumption they had not known about, adding it to shared knowledge so the conversation can continue
example: "Sorry I'm late, my cat was sick" worked by accommodation: nobody at the office had known Sana owned a cat.

hindi: अकिलीज़ और कछुआ — ज़ेनो का तर्क कि तेज़ धावक पीछे से धीमे को कभी नहीं पकड़ सकता
definition: Zeno's argument that a fast runner can never overtake a slower one with a head start, because he must first reach every point the slower one has left
example: Chasing her little brother round the park, Pallavi blamed Achilles and the tortoise for never catching him, though snacks were more likely the cause.

hindi: अचिन्त्य भेदाभेद — चैतन्य का मत कि जीव और ईश्वर का भेद-अभेद बुद्धि से परे है
definition: Chaitanya's school of Vedanta holding that the individual self and the deity Krishna are both different and not different in a manner that human reasoning cannot fully grasp
example: Kabir gave up explaining how his cat was both his and totally independent, and simply called it achintya bhedabheda.

hindi: अजगतवाद — केवल ईश्वर को सत्य और जगत को असत्य मानने का मत
definition: the view that only the divine or absolute is truly real, while the everyday world of separate things lacks genuine reality
example: Dreading Monday's meeting, Rehan tried acosmism, insisting the office was unreal, but the calendar invitation disagreed.

hindi: क्रिया और शक्यता — वस्तु की वर्तमान वास्तविकता और उसकी संभावित क्षमता का भेद
definition: the scholastic distinction between what a thing actually is at present and what it has the capacity to become, used to explain every kind of change
example: Looking at a bag of flour, Meera explained act and potency to her nephew: pancakes in potency now, pancakes in act after twenty minutes at the stove.

hindi: कर्म-परिणामवाद — हर एक कर्म को उसके अपने परिणामों से सीधे आँकने का मत
definition: the form of consequentialism holding that each single action should be judged directly by its own consequences, choosing whichever action produces the best outcome in that situation
example: Rahul's act consequentialism meant he recalculated every red light on his cycle commute, which made him late and thoughtful in equal measure.

hindi: कर्म-उपयोगितावाद — वह कर्म चुनने का मत जो उस स्थिति में सबसे अधिक कुल सुख उत्पन्न करे
definition: the form of utilitarianism holding that each single action is right when it produces more total happiness or wellbeing than any other action available in that situation
example: Following act utilitarianism, Vikram gave his concert ticket to his cousin, who would clearly enjoy the band ten times more than he would.

hindi: क्रियात्मक अंतर्बोध — करने और देखने के एक साथ घटित होने का विचार
definition: Nishida's idea that seeing and doing arise together, so that we perceive the world by shaping it and shape it by perceiving
example: Watching her father season the curry without measuring, Avni recognised acting intuition: he tasted, adjusted and understood in a single movement.

hindi: क्रिया-मीमांसा — मानवीय क्रिया के स्वरूप और कारणों का दार्शनिक अध्ययन
definition: the branch of philosophy that studies what makes something a genuine action rather than a mere happening, and how intentions produce behaviour
example: The action theory seminar spent an hour asking whether sneezing during the lecture counted as doing something.

hindi: सक्रिय इच्छामृत्यु — किसी प्रत्यक्ष कदम, जैसे घातक औषधि, से मृत्यु देना
definition: euthanasia in which death is directly caused by a deliberate action, such as administering a lethal injection of medicine
example: Arjun's flowchart separated active euthanasia from everything else with a single thick arrow labelled 'someone does something'.

hindi: सक्रिय बुद्धि — वह बौद्धिक शक्ति जो संभावित ज्ञान को वास्तविक समझ में बदलती है
definition: in Aristotle's account of the mind, the thinking power that makes understanding actual, turning mere potential knowledge into real grasp of ideas
example: The maths problem had sat unsolved for an hour until, somewhere between the bus stop and the office, Farhan's active intellect finally switched on.

hindi: सक्रिय शून्यवाद — खोखले मूल्यों को तोड़कर नए मूल्यों के लिए जगह बनाने वाली मनोदशा
definition: Nietzsche's term for a strong response to meaninglessness that deliberately destroys hollow values to clear space for creating fresh ones
example: Throwing out every self-help book on her shelf, Aditi called it active nihilism and ordered new ones the same evening.

hindi: कर्म-अकर्म सिद्धांत — किसी हानि को करना, उसे न रोकने से अधिक दोषपूर्ण है
definition: the view that performing a harmful action is morally worse than failing to prevent a harm with equally serious results
example: Not warning his flatmate about the expired milk felt different from serving it, and Mohit called the acts and omissions doctrine as witness.

hindi: वास्तविक अनंत — अनंत को एक पूर्ण, संपन्न समग्र के रूप में मानने की धारणा
definition: infinity understood as a completed whole, such as the entire collection of natural numbers existing together at once, rather than an unfinished process
example: Vikram's claim that every possible playlist already existed as an actual infinity did not help him choose a song for the drive.

hindi: वास्तविकतावाद — यह मत कि केवल वास्तविक रूप से विद्यमान वस्तुएँ ही होती हैं, संभव-मात्र वस्तुएँ नहीं
definition: the view that everything that exists is actual, so that merely possible objects and possible worlds must be explained using things found within the actual world
example: When Arjun kept listing his imaginary startup's future employees, his friend's actualism kicked in: 'Those people do not exist, so stop giving them salaries.'

hindi: वास्तविकता — किसी क्षमता का पूर्ण रूप से साकार या सक्रिय होना
definition: Aristotle's term for the state in which a capacity is fully realised or active, like the grown tree that the acorn was capable of becoming
example: After six months of talking about a startup, Dev finally filed the paperwork, and his friends toasted the move from potential to actuality.

hindi: शुद्ध क्रिया — ऐसी पूर्ण सत्ता जिसमें कोई अधूरी संभावना नहीं, ईश्वर का वर्णन
definition: the scholastic description of the deity as pure actuality, fully realised being with no unrealised potential left to develop or change
example: The coach joked that the team's star striker was actus purus on match day and pure potential at training.

hindi: तदर्थ परिकल्पना — केवल किसी विफल सिद्धांत को बचाने के लिए गढ़ी गई धारणा
definition: an assumption added to a theory purely to rescue it from contrary evidence, which explains nothing else and cannot be tested independently
example: Rahul's ad hoc hypothesis that the diet only works on weekdays did not impress his gym friends.

hindi: ऐडम्स का सिद्धांत — 'यदि क तो ख' की संभाव्यता क के होने पर ख की सशर्त संभाव्यता है
definition: the view that the probability of an 'if A then B' statement equals the conditional probability of B given that A is true
example: Applying Adams' thesis, Pooja estimated how likely 'if it rains, the match is cancelled' was by checking past rainy match days.

hindi: अनुकूलनवाद — जीवों के अधिकांश लक्षणों को प्राकृतिक चयन का परिणाम मानने का मत
definition: the view that most traits of living organisms are best explained as adaptations shaped by natural selection for some useful purpose
example: Rohan's adaptationism went too far when he claimed his uncle's snoring evolved to scare away nighttime predators.

hindi: अनुकूलित वरीयताएँ — अभाव के कारण सीमित अवसरों से समझौता कर बनी इच्छाएँ
definition: preferences that people form by adjusting their desires to limited or unjust circumstances, raising doubts about whether satisfying them reflects genuine wellbeing
example: When his sister insisted she never wanted to study further anyway, Rahul wondered whether adaptive preferences were speaking.

hindi: पर्याप्त प्रत्यय — स्पिनोज़ा के अनुसार वे विचार जो अपने विषय को पूर्णतः समझाते हैं
definition: in Spinoza's philosophy, ideas that fully grasp their object and its causes, as opposed to confused, partial ideas received through the senses
example: Only after reading the whole thread did Pooja have adequate ideas about why the group chat had exploded.

hindi: अधर्मास्तिकाय — स्थिति या ठहराव में सहायक, लोक-व्यापी जैन द्रव्य
definition: in Jain philosophy, an invisible substance filling the universe that makes rest possible, the way shade allows a tired traveller to stop without forcing them
example: Sinking into the sofa after a double shift, Nisha thanked adharmastikaya for making rest possible at last.

hindi: अध्यास — एक वस्तु के गुणों को भूल से दूसरी पर आरोपित करना
definition: superimposition, the mistaken projection of the qualities of one thing onto another, such as treating the body and its limits as the true self
example: Mistaking her roommate's jacket for her own on the rack, Pooja committed a small but classic adhyasa.

hindi: उदासीन विषय — जो न शुभ हैं न अशुभ, सद्गुण से असंबद्ध
definition: things that are neither good nor evil in Stoic ethics because they do not affect virtue, such as wealth, sickness, fame or poverty
example: Pallavi argued that the colour of the new office carpet belonged among the adiaphora, but the design team strongly disagreed.

hindi: अद्ल — इस्लामी चिंतन में न्याय, संतुलन और हर वस्तु को उसके उचित स्थान पर रखना
definition: the Islamic concept of justice as balance, treating everyone fairly and placing each thing in its rightful position, a central attribute of divine and human action
example: Farah's grandfather spoke of adl when he divided the orchard so each grandchild received trees of equal yield, not just equal number.

hindi: छायांकन — किसी वस्तु का हर बार केवल एक पक्ष से ही प्रकट होना
definition: in Husserl's phenomenology, the partial profile or side through which a physical object always appears, never showing every side at once
example: Walking around the parked car, Dev collected adumbrations until he finally found the dent his brother had not mentioned.

hindi: अद्वैत — आत्मा और ब्रह्म को एक ही मानने वाला वेदांत का मत
definition: the school of Vedanta holding that the individual self and Brahman, the single ultimate reality, are not two but completely identical, so all difference is only appearance
example: When the twins fought over whose turn it was to wash dishes, their grandmother invoked advaita and said the sink belonged to one self anyway.

hindi: अग्रिम निर्देश — अक्षमता की स्थिति के लिए पहले से दिए गए उपचार संबंधी निर्देश
definition: a written or spoken statement made in advance setting out a person's medical treatment wishes, or naming someone to decide, should they lose capacity
example: Her advance directive named her sister as decision-maker, mainly because her brother still cannot choose a pizza topping.

hindi: क्रियाविशेषणी सिद्धांत — अनुभव को वस्तु नहीं, अनुभव करने का ढंग मानने का मत
definition: the view that perceptual experiences are ways of sensing rather than relations to special mental objects, so seeing scarlet means sensing scarletly rather than perceiving some scarlet inner object
example: Squinting at the traffic signal, Rohit used the adverbial theory to say he was not seeing a green thing but simply sensing greenly.

hindi: सौंदर्यदृष्टि — सुंदरता के बारे में कोई विशेष सिद्धांत या रुचि
definition: a particular theory or sense of what is beautiful or artistically pleasing, as held by a person, movement or style; also spelled esthetic
example: Her room follows a strict minimalist aesthetic, which mostly means her clothes live in a pile inside the wardrobe.

hindi: सौंदर्य-दृष्टि — वस्तु को उपयोग से हटकर केवल उसके रूप और अनुभव के लिए देखने की मनोवृत्ति
definition: the view that a special detached, disinterested manner of attending to something, apart from practical goals, is what makes experiencing it aesthetic
example: Waiting for the delayed train, Rahul adopted the aesthetic attitude toward the platform's peeling paint and found it strangely lovely.

hindi: सौंदर्य-ज्ञानवाद — कलाकृतियाँ ज्ञान और समझ देती हैं और यही उनके मूल्य का अंग है, यह मत
definition: the view that artworks can give people genuine knowledge or understanding, about life, emotions or morality, and that this forms part of their value
example: Citing aesthetic cognitivism, Manav claimed the family drama series taught him more about siblings than any psychology lecture.

hindi: सौंदर्य-अवधारणा — सुरुचिपूर्ण, संतुलित, विषादपूर्ण जैसी अवधारणाएँ जिन्हें लागू करने के लिए रुचि चाहिए
definition: a concept such as graceful, delicate or gaudy whose correct application needs taste and sensitivity, and cannot follow from any rule about colours or shapes
example: No checklist could tell Aisha whether her presentation slides were elegant, since elegant is an aesthetic concept, not a font setting.

hindi: सौंदर्यानुभूति — रूप, रंग या ध्वनि पर एकाग्र होकर मिलने वाला विशिष्ट आनंद-अनुभव
definition: a special kind of absorbed, detached experience in which attention rests on the look, sound or form of something for its own sake, rather than on its usefulness
example: Ishaan swore the first sip of cutting chai at the office canteen was a genuine aesthetic experience, complete with closed eyes.

hindi: सौंदर्य-सुखवाद — सौंदर्य-मूल्य को उससे मिलने वाले आनंद पर आधारित मानने का मत
definition: the view that the aesthetic value of something consists in the pleasure people take in experiencing it for its own sake
example: Justifying a third playlist replay on the commute, Inaya cited aesthetic hedonism: the song's value was simply how much delight it gave.

hindi: सौंदर्य-यथार्थवाद — सौंदर्य जैसे गुणों को वस्तु में सचमुच विद्यमान मानने का मत
definition: the view that aesthetic qualities such as beauty or elegance are genuine features of objects, existing independently of whether anyone finds them pleasing
example: Arguing aesthetic realism, Gaurav said the mountain view was beautiful whether or not his grumpy roommate bothered to look up.

hindi: सौंदर्य-साक्ष्य — दूसरों के कहने पर किसी वस्तु की सुंदरता जानने की संभावना का प्रश्न
definition: the question of whether someone can truly know that a painting or song is beautiful simply by trusting what another person reports, without experiencing it
example: Sid refused to call the café beautiful on aesthetic testimony from his friends, insisting he must first taste the coffee himself.

hindi: सौंदर्यवाद — कला को नैतिक या सामाजिक प्रयोजन से मुक्त, केवल सौंदर्य के लिए मानने की प्रवृत्ति
definition: the nineteenth-century movement and view that beauty is the highest value of artworks, which need serve no moral, political or practical purpose
example: Pooja's aestheticism reached new heights when she chose the office mug with the prettiest glaze, despite its leaky handle.

hindi: सौंदर्यशास्त्र — सौंदर्य, रुचि और कला के मूल्यांकन का दर्शन
definition: the branch of philosophy that studies beauty, taste and artistic value, asking what makes something beautiful and how we judge artworks; also spelled esthetics
example: The canteen debate over whether a banana taped to a wall counts as art was aesthetics, whether anyone called it that or not.

hindi: भाव-दोष — कृति को पाठक पर पड़े भावनात्मक प्रभाव से आँकने की भूल
definition: the supposed mistake of judging a poem or artwork by the emotions it stirs in readers, rather than by the structure and meaning of the work itself
example: Diya admitted that ranking films by how much she cried was probably the affective fallacy, but her tissue count was very consistent.

hindi: अफ़्रीकी समुदायवाद — व्यक्ति का अस्तित्व और मूल्य समुदाय के संबंधों से ही अर्थ पाता है, यह परंपरा
definition: the family of African views holding that a person's identity, worth and duties are shaped through relationships within the community rather than in isolation
example: Sharing one pot of rice among twelve cousins, Ngozi called it African communitarianism in action, and nobody argued with a full plate.

hindi: आगामी कर्म — वर्तमान कर्मों से भविष्य के लिए बनने वाला कर्म
definition: the fresh karma created by present actions, which will bear results in the future, in this life or a later one
example: Helping a stranger carry groceries upstairs, Yash joked that he was investing in agami karma.

hindi: निःस्वार्थ प्रेम — बिना शर्त, बिना योग्यता देखे सब पर समान रूप से बरसने वाला प्रेम
definition: selfless love that gives freely without asking whether the loved person deserves it, which Christian thought treats as the love shown by the deity toward everyone
example: Washing her flatmate's dishes for the third week running without complaint, Meera called it agape and her flatmate called it a miracle.

hindi: प्रेमवाद — प्रेम को ब्रह्मांड और विचारों के विकास की मूल शक्ति मानने का पर्स का मत
definition: Peirce's doctrine that creative, sympathetic love is a real force guiding the evolution of the cosmos and of ideas
example: Ritu cited agapism when explaining why the neighbourhood garden flourished only after everyone started sharing tools.

hindi: कर्ता-कारणता — यह मत कि कोई व्यक्ति स्वयं, न कि केवल उसकी मानसिक घटनाएँ, किसी क्रिया का कारण होता है
definition: the view that a person, as a lasting agent, can directly cause an action, rather than every action being caused by earlier events such as beliefs and desires
example: Choosing the salad over the samosa, Nisha claimed agent causation: no craving made that decision, she did.

hindi: सक्रिय बुद्धि — वह बौद्धिक शक्ति जो अनुभव से सामान्य धारणाएँ निकालती है
definition: the active power of the mind that draws general concepts out of sense experience, lighting up images so the understanding can grasp them
example: After seeing a dozen different chairs, Tanvi's agent intellect finally produced the concept of chair, just in time for the furniture sale.

hindi: कर्ता-केंद्रित सद्गुण नीति — कर्म के मूल्य को कर्ता के प्रेरणा-भाव से निकालने वाला मत
definition: a form of virtue ethics, defended by Michael Slote, holding that an action's rightness comes entirely from the good motives and character of the person performing it
example: Under agent-based virtue ethics, Mira argued, her burnt birthday cake still counted as a good deed because her motives were lovely.

hindi: कर्ता-केंद्रित प्रतिबंध — ऐसा निषेध जो हर व्यक्ति को स्वयं कुछ कर्म करने से रोकता है, भले ही उससे कुल हानि घटे
definition: a moral limit forbidding each person from performing certain actions, such as killing, even when doing so would prevent others performing more of them
example: Even to stop three coworkers gossiping, Rhea wouldn't spread gossip herself, an agent-centred restriction in office form.

hindi: कर्ता-निरपेक्षता — नैतिक कारणों का हर व्यक्ति पर समान रूप से लागू होना, चाहे कर्ता कोई भी हो
definition: the feature of moral reasons that apply equally to everyone, giving each person the same goals, without special weight for their own family, friends or projects
example: Agent-neutrality made Aryan's dilemma awkward: his little brother's school fundraiser counted no more than any stranger's.

hindi: कर्ता-पश्चाताप — बिना दोष के भी अपने कर्म के बुरे परिणाम पर होने वाला विशेष खेद
definition: the special regret felt by the person whose action caused harm, even when they were blameless, which differs from the sorrow of a mere spectator
example: The driver who clipped the cyclist through no fault of his own still felt agent-regret that no amount of reassurance from bystanders could erase.

hindi: समाहार — अनेक व्यक्तियों के सुख-दुःख को जोड़कर एक कुल मूल्य बनाने की प्रक्रिया
definition: the practice of adding together the benefits and harms of many different people into one total, so that small gains to many people can outweigh large losses to a handful
example: The class debated aggregation after realising that thirty mild yawns might, on paper, outweigh one student's genuinely brilliant presentation.

hindi: संशयी अनीश्वरवाद — ईश्वर में विश्वास न करना, साथ ही यह मानना कि इस विषय में निश्चित ज्ञान संभव नहीं
definition: the position of lacking belief in any deity while also holding that nobody can know for certain whether a deity exists
example: Neel summed up his agnostic atheism on the commute: he did not believe in any deity, but admitted he could not prove the matter either way.

hindi: संशयी ईश्वरवाद — ईश्वर में विश्वास रखना, पर यह मानना कि उसका निश्चित ज्ञान संभव नहीं
definition: the position of believing that a deity exists while also holding that such existence cannot be known for certain
example: Ria explained her agnostic theism to her classmates: she believed in a deity, the way she believed her train would arrive, without claiming certain knowledge.

hindi: अज्ञेयवाद — ईश्वर के अस्तित्व को अज्ञात या अज्ञेय मानने का मत
definition: the view that nobody knows, or perhaps can know, whether a deity exists
example: Asked in the group chat whether the rumoured holiday was real, Sid replied with agnosticism: he had no evidence either way.

hindi: अहं ब्रह्मास्मि — 'मैं ब्रह्म हूँ', आत्म-ब्रह्म एकता का महावाक्य
definition: the great saying of the Brihadaranyaka Upanishad, meaning I am Brahman, which expresses the individual self realising its identity with ultimate reality
example: After finally fixing the printer, Siddharth whispered aham brahmasmi, though his colleagues felt that was slightly overstating the achievement.

hindi: अहंकार — 'मैं' का भाव उत्पन्न करने वाला तत्त्व
definition: in Samkhya and Yoga, the principle of selfhood, the part of nature that produces the feeling of 'myself' and 'mine' and wrongly claims ownership of thoughts and actions
example: When Varun took credit for the team's slides, his manager gently suggested his ahamkara was presenting, not him.

hindi: अहिंसा — किसी भी जीव को मन, वचन या कर्म से हानि न पहुँचाने का व्रत
definition: the Indian ethical principle of nonviolence, especially central to Jainism, which forbids causing harm to any living being through deeds, words or even thoughts
example: Out of ahimsa, Riya carried the spider from the bathroom to the balcony in a mug while her flatmate cheered from a safe distance.

hindi: कृत्रिम बुद्धि संरेखण — कृत्रिम बुद्धि प्रणालियों के लक्ष्यों को मानवीय मूल्यों के अनुरूप बनाने की समस्या
definition: the problem of designing artificial intelligence systems whose goals and behaviour reliably match human values and intentions, even when those systems become very capable
example: After the office chatbot booked twelve meeting rooms to be helpful, the team had a sudden appreciation for AI alignment.

hindi: अंतर्संबंध — मनुष्य को संबंधों के बीच स्थित प्राणी मानने का विचार
definition: Watsuji Tetsuro's idea of betweenness, the view that persons exist fundamentally in their relationships rather than as isolated individuals
example: During the family argument, Aryan invoked aidagara, pointing out that nobody could be blamed alone when everyone had shaped the mess together.

hindi: अजातिवाद — गौड़पाद का मत कि वास्तव में कुछ भी कभी उत्पन्न नहीं हुआ
definition: Gaudapada's doctrine holding that nothing is ever truly born or created, since the only reality is unchanging Brahman
example: Accused of starting the group-chat argument, Nikhil appealed to ajativada: nothing was ever truly started, least of all by him.

hindi: अजीव — चेतना-रहित द्रव्य, जैसे पुद्गल, आकाश और काल
definition: in Jain philosophy, everything that lacks consciousness, including physical matter, space, time and the media that allow motion and rest
example: Cleaning out the garage, Dev sorted everything into two piles: the cat, who was jiva, and the rest of the junk, which was firmly ajiva.

hindi: आजीविक — नियति को सर्वोपरि मानने वाला प्राचीन भारतीय संप्रदाय
definition: an ancient Indian ascetic school holding that fate fixes everything that happens, so human effort cannot change the course of anyone's lives
example: Tired of planning his week, Siddharth claimed to be an Ajivika, since fate had already written the calendar anyway.

hindi: अज्ञानवाद — प्राचीन भारतीय संशयवादी संप्रदाय
definition: an ancient Indian sceptical school that held metaphysical knowledge to be impossible and refused to affirm or deny claims about such questions
example: Asked about life after exams, weary Vinay adopted Ajnana and declined to affirm or deny that such a thing existed.

hindi: अकान व्यक्तित्व-दर्शन — घाना की अकान परंपरा में मनुष्य को आत्मा, रक्त-वंश और चरित्र से बना मानने की धारणा
definition: the West African Akan view that a human person is made of several parts, a divine life soul, a personality spirit, maternal blood and a body, and becomes fully a person through moral character
example: In the sociology seminar, Ama used the Akan concept of a person to argue that a person is built through family and good conduct, not merely born.

hindi: आकाश — भारतीय दर्शन में सर्वव्यापी तत्त्व, जिसे शब्द का आधार माना गया
definition: in Indian philosophy, the all-pervading element often translated as space or ether, which several schools treat as the medium of sound
example: When the neighbour's music filled the whole flat, Gauri decided that akasha was carrying far more sound than anyone needed.

hindi: भोगासक्ति — इन्द्रिय-सुख में अति करने की स्थायी दुष्प्रवृत्ति, बिना किसी पछतावे के
definition: the Greek term for self-indulgence, the settled vice of chasing bodily pleasures to excess without even feeling that anything is wrong
example: Ordering a third dessert without a flicker of guilt, Sameer moved from akrasia to full akolasia, his friends noted.

hindi: असंयम — यह जानते हुए भी कि क्या उचित है, उसके विपरीत आचरण कर बैठना
definition: weakness of will, the puzzling state of knowingly acting against your own better judgement, such as choosing what you believe is worse for you
example: Scrolling his phone at midnight while knowing his exam started at nine, Kabir called it akrasia, which sounded better than laziness.

hindi: पापी-प्रधानता — बुद्ध की करुणा का मुख्य पात्र अपराधी ही है, यह मत
definition: Shinran's teaching that wrongdoers who know their failings are the primary object of Amida Buddha's compassion, even more than the self-consciously good
example: Citing akunin shoki, Nikhil argued that the teacher should help him first, since he had clearly failed the worst.

hindi: आलयविज्ञान — संस्कारों के बीजों को संजोने वाली मूल चेतना
definition: in Yogacara Buddhism, the storehouse consciousness, a deep layer of mind that holds the seeds of past actions and habits until they ripen into fresh experience
example: Hearing an old song brought back an entire summer, and Leela blamed her alayavijnana for storing everything.

hindi: ऐल्डर का उस्तरा — जिसे प्रयोग से परखा न जा सके, वह बहस योग्य नहीं
definition: the principle that any claim which cannot be settled by experiment or observation is not worth arguing about
example: The group chat's debate about which colour the number seven feels like ended when Ishaan invoked Alder's razor.

hindi: अनावरण — सत्य को छिपे हुए के प्रकट होने के रूप में समझना
definition: the Greek term for truth, which Heidegger interpreted as unconcealment, meaning things coming out of hiddenness and showing themselves
example: When the lost remote finally emerged from the sofa cushions, Gaurav hailed it as a moment of aletheia.

hindi: सत्यता-प्रकार — किसी कथन के अनिवार्य, संभव या असंभव रूप से सत्य होने का ढंग
definition: the kind of modality concerned with truth itself, sorting statements into those that are necessarily true, possibly true, contingently true or impossible
example: Arjun explained alethic modality over chai: that two plus two equals four is necessary, while the canteen having samosas is sadly only possible.

hindi: कलनविधिक पक्षपात — स्वचालित निर्णय-प्रणालियों द्वारा कुछ समूहों के साथ व्यवस्थित अन्याय
definition: systematic unfairness in automated decision systems, often learned from skewed data, that treats some groups of people worse than others
example: The class project exposed algorithmic bias when the photo app kept recognising the teacher but never the students in the back row.

hindi: अलगाव — श्रमिक का अपने श्रम, उत्पाद, साथियों और स्वयं से कट जाना
definition: the Marxist idea that under capitalism workers become estranged from their labour, from what they produce, from fellow workers and from their own human nature
example: Packing the same boxes for eight hours, Neha said the alienation was so complete she no longer knew what the boxes contained or why she cared.

hindi: गुफा का रूपक — छायाओं को सत्य मानने वाले बंदियों की प्लेटो की कथा
definition: Plato's story of prisoners chained in a cave who mistake shadows on the wall for reality, used to show how education leads the mind from appearances towards truth
example: After quitting social media, Shreya compared it to the allegory of the cave: she had been staring at shadows of other people's holidays.

hindi: परहस्ताक्षरी — जिस कला की हर सही प्रस्तुति मूल कृति ही मानी जाए, वैसी
definition: describing artworks such as novels or music scores, where every correct copy or performance counts as a genuine instance, so forgery makes no sense
example: Since novels are allographic, Chirag argued his dog-eared paperback held the real novel just as much as the author's first manuscript.

hindi: अन्यता — दूसरे व्यक्ति की वह भिन्नता जिसे पूरी तरह समझा नहीं जा सकता
definition: the radical otherness of another person, which phenomenologists such as Levinas held can never be fully grasped or reduced to your own understanding
example: Despite ten years of marriage, Sunil still confronted his wife's alterity every time she enjoyed pineapple on pizza.

hindi: वैकल्पिक संभावनाएँ — किसी कर्म के समय दूसरा रास्ता चुन पाने की खुली गुंजाइश
definition: the genuinely open options a person has when acting, which many views treat as required before anyone can deserve blame for a choice
example: Rohan pleaded alternate possibilities for his lateness, since the metro strike had left him exactly one way to reach the office.

hindi: ईश्वर के प्रति बौद्धिक प्रेम — स्पिनोज़ा के अनुसार ज्ञान से उपजा परम आनंद
definition: Spinoza's Latin phrase meaning 'intellectual love of deity', the calm delight that comes from understanding things as necessary parts of nature, which he treated as the highest happiness
example: Finally understanding why the tides follow the moon, Ira felt something close to amor dei intellectualis on the Marine Drive promenade.

hindi: भाग्य-प्रेम — जो कुछ हुआ और होगा, उसे पूरे मन से स्वीकारना और प्रेम करना
definition: Latin for love of fate: Nietzsche's attitude of fully embracing everything that happens, including suffering, rather than merely enduring or regretting it
example: When the rain soaked her only interview shirt, Anjali practised amor fati and wore it as proof of her commitment.

hindi: नीतिनिरपेक्षतावाद — सही-गलत के नैतिक भेदों को ही अमान्य मानने का मत
definition: the view that moral distinctions between right and wrong have no real authority, so moral rules need not guide anyone's choices
example: Rahul claimed amoralism when he grabbed the last parking spot, yet he glared at the driver who did the same to him an hour later.

hindi: विस्तारक अनुमान — ऐसा अनुमान जिसका निष्कर्ष आधार-वाक्यों से अधिक जानकारी देता है
definition: any reasoning whose conclusion says more than its premises contain, such as induction or abduction, and which can therefore turn false even when every premise holds
example: Seeing wet umbrellas in the office lobby, Meera made the ampliative inference that it was raining, which the umbrellas alone never actually said.

hindi: निर्लज्जता — सामाजिक शर्म को जान-बूझकर ठुकराने की सिनिक मुद्रा
definition: the Cynic practice of deliberate shamelessness, openly breaking social customs to show that convention has no real authority over virtue
example: Eating his lunch cross-legged on the office reception sofa, Tushar claimed anaideia; HR claimed a policy violation.

hindi: सत् का सादृश्य — विभिन्न वस्तुओं में 'होने' का समान पर भिन्न अर्थ
definition: the analogy of being, the medieval Christian view that being applies to the divine and to creatures in related but not identical senses
example: Leela used analogia entis to explain that her grandmother and her houseplant both lived, just in rather different ways.

hindi: सादृश्य-युक्ति — दो वस्तुओं की समानताओं के आधार पर एक अन्य समानता का अनुमान
definition: an argument concluding that because two things are similar in several known respects, they are probably similar in some further respect as well
example: Jay's analogical argument ran that since the new phone looked just like the old one, it would also survive being dropped in the sink.

hindi: आरोपण-सादृश्य — एक मुख्य अर्थ से जुड़कर शब्द का दूसरे पर लागू होना
definition: a form of analogy in which a word applies first to one thing and to others through their relation to it, as healthy applies to people and then to food
example: The gym poster called its smoothies healthy, which Dev explained was an analogy of attribution, since smoothies themselves never jog.

hindi: सत्-सादृश्य — 'है' शब्द ईश्वर और सृष्टि पर न एकार्थ न भिन्नार्थ, बल्कि समानुपात से लागू होता है, यह मत
definition: the scholastic view that words like being or goodness apply to the deity and to creatures neither in exactly the same sense nor in unrelated senses, but in related, proportional senses
example: When Tara said both her grandmother and her phone were 'wise', her philosophy teacher smiled and mentioned the analogy of being.

hindi: अनुपात-सादृश्य — दो संबंधों की समानता के आधार पर शब्द का प्रयोग
definition: a form of analogy in which a word applies to two things because each relates to something in a similar proportion, as seeing is to the mind what sight is to the body
example: Saying 'I see' about the maths homework, Aisha realised she was using an analogy of proportionality.

hindi: सूर्य उपमा — शुभ के प्रत्यय की तुलना प्रकाश देने वाले सूर्य से
definition: Plato's comparison between sunlight, which lets eyes perceive objects, and the Form of the Good, which lets the mind understand the Forms
example: Mr Iyer used the analogy of the sun when the classroom lights failed: without light, even brilliant diagrams became invisible.

hindi: विश्लेष्य — वह अवधारणा या कथन जिसका विश्लेषण किया जा रहा है
definition: in philosophical analysis, the concept or statement that is being analysed, the thing whose meaning the analysis sets out to clarify
example: In the ethics essay, 'being a good friend' was the analysandum, and three pages later it still resisted every definition.

hindi: विश्लेषक — वह अभिव्यक्ति जो विश्लेषण में दी गई अवधारणा को स्पष्ट करती है
definition: in philosophical analysis, the expression that does the analysing, offered as spelling out the meaning of the concept or statement under examination
example: Kavya's analysans for 'adulting', 'doing chores nobody thanks you for', won unanimous approval in the group chat.

hindi: विश्लेषणात्मक — जिसका सत्य केवल शब्दों या प्रत्ययों के अर्थ से तय हो जाए
definition: describes a statement whose truth follows from the meanings of its words alone, like 'every triangle has three sides'
example: Kabir won the group-chat argument by pointing out that 'all widows were once married' is analytic, so nobody needed to google it.

hindi: विश्लेषणात्मक निर्णय — जिसमें विधेय पहले से उद्देश्य में निहित हो
definition: Kant's term for a statement that is true simply because the predicate, the thing said about the subject, is already contained in the subject's meaning, like saying bachelors are unmarried
example: When Varun proudly declared that all triangles have three sides, his sister told him an analytic judgment was not a personal discovery.

hindi: विश्लेषणात्मक दर्शन — स्पष्ट तर्क, सटीक भाषा और तार्किक विश्लेषण पर बल देने वाली दार्शनिक परंपरा
definition: the philosophical tradition, dominant in English-speaking universities since the early twentieth century, that stresses clear argument, precise language and logical analysis
example: Aarav's analytic philosophy seminar spent a full hour defining 'knowledge', which his sister said was the most analytic philosophy thing she had ever heard.

hindi: विश्लेषणात्मक-संश्लेषणात्मक भेद — अर्थ से सत्य और तथ्य से सत्य कथनों का विभाजन
definition: the division of true statements into those true purely because of the meanings of their words and those true because of facts about the world
example: In the staff room, the philosophy teacher used the analytic-synthetic distinction to separate 'lunch is a meal' from 'lunch is cold again'.

hindi: विश्लेषणात्मक मार्क्सवाद — विश्लेषणात्मक दर्शन की पद्धतियों से मार्क्सवाद को पुनर्गठित करने वाली धारा
definition: a school of thought that restates Marxist claims using the precise methods of analytic philosophy, economics and game theory, discarding what cannot be clearly defended
example: Kabir's analytical Marxism turned every canteen argument into a payoff table with suspiciously precise numbers.

hindi: विश्लेषणात्मकता — किसी कथन का केवल अर्थ के बल पर सत्य होने का गुण
definition: the property a statement has when its truth follows entirely from the meanings of its words, needing no check against the world
example: Meera argued about the analyticity of 'a sandwich has bread' until someone served her a lettuce wrap.

hindi: पुनःस्मरण — प्लेटो का मत कि सीखना आत्मा के पूर्वज्ञान को फिर याद करना है
definition: Plato's doctrine that learning is really remembering: the soul already knew certain truths before birth and recalls them when prompted
example: Failing to find his keys, Harsh claimed that anamnesis would bring them back if only someone asked the right questions.

hindi: अराजकतावाद — राज्य और बलपूर्वक सत्ता को अनावश्यक और हानिकारक मानने वाली विचारधारा
definition: the political view that government and every form of coercive authority are unnecessary and harmful, and that people can organise through voluntary cooperation
example: The study group's anarchism worked fine without a leader, right until someone had to book the library room.

hindi: अराजक-पूँजीवाद — राज्य को हटाकर सभी सेवाएँ निजी बाज़ार को सौंपने का मत
definition: the view that government should be abolished entirely, with courts, policing and every other service supplied by private companies competing in a free market
example: After his internet provider failed again, Mohit joked that anarcho-capitalism would mean choosing a police company with equally terrible customer service.

hindi: अनासक्ति — कर्म करते हुए भी फल और वस्तुओं से अलगाव
definition: freedom from attachment: acting fully in the world while staying inwardly free from craving for results, possessions or praise, a theme Gandhi stressed
example: Watching her post get only four likes, Tanvi practised anasakti and went back to her tea.

hindi: अनात्म — कोई स्थायी, अपरिवर्तनीय आत्मा न होने का बौद्ध सिद्धांत
definition: the Buddhist teaching denying any permanent, unchanging self or soul, holding that a person is only a changing stream of bodily and mental processes
example: When Arjun said he was a completely different person before his morning coffee, his sister called it anatta in a mug.

hindi: धर्मशास्त्र की दासी — दर्शन को धर्मशास्त्र की सहायक विद्या मानने का मध्ययुगीन सूत्र
definition: the medieval description of philosophy as the handmaid of theology, meaning a helper discipline whose reasoning serves religious understanding
example: In the staff room, the maths teacher grumbled that statistics had become ancilla theologiae to the marketing department.

hindi: साहस — भय के सामने उचित कारण के लिए डटे रहने का सद्गुण
definition: the Greek virtue of courage, the settled readiness to face fear and danger for a worthy reason, neither reckless nor cowardly
example: Speaking up in the meeting about the unfair deadline took a quiet kind of andreia that Ritu had not known she possessed.

hindi: पुरुषकेंद्रिकता — पुरुष अनुभव को मानव अनुभव का मानक मानने की प्रवृत्ति
definition: the practice of treating male experience, interests and bodies as the normal standard for all humans, while women's experience is treated as a deviation
example: Shivering in the office, Pooja blamed androcentrism: the thermostat standard was apparently designed around a suited male body.

hindi: किस्सा-आधारित दोष — व्यक्तिगत अनुभव को व्यापक प्रमाण से ऊपर रखना
definition: the fallacy of using a single personal story or isolated example as evidence that outweighs broader, more reliable evidence
example: My neighbour smoked daily and lived to ninety, said Uncle, repeating the anecdotal fallacy over his third cigarette.

hindi: अनेकान्तवाद — सत्य को अनेक दृष्टियों से देखने का जैन सिद्धांत
definition: the Jain doctrine of many-sidedness: the view that reality is complex, so every single viewpoint grasps only part of the truth about anything
example: When the family argued over whether the new sofa was grey or blue, Tara invoked anekantavada and declared both sides partly right, depending on the lamp.

hindi: गहन व्याकुलता — अपनी पूर्ण स्वतंत्रता और उत्तरदायित्व के बोध से उपजी बेचैनी
definition: a deep, unfocused anxiety that arises when a person realises their total freedom and responsibility, with nothing outside themselves to guarantee their choices
example: Staring at a blank college application essay, Riya felt a wave of angst: she could write anything, which was exactly the problem.

hindi: संत्रास — अपनी पूर्ण स्वतंत्रता और उत्तरदायित्व के बोध से उपजी पीड़ा
definition: in existentialism, the painful anxiety felt when a person realises they alone are responsible for their choices, with no outside rule to lean on
example: Standing before the vending machine, Tara felt existential anguish, knowing no one else could choose her snack.

hindi: अनित्य — सब कुछ के क्षणिक और परिवर्तनशील होने का सिद्धांत
definition: the Buddhist teaching that everything is impermanent, that all things and experiences arise, change and pass away without lasting
example: When the office coffee machine broke the week after being replaced, Deepak shrugged and said anicca.

hindi: पशु-अधिकार — पशुओं के भी कुछ ऐसे अधिकार होने का मत जिन्हें मानव लाभ के लिए तोड़ा नहीं जा सकता
definition: the view that animals hold moral rights, such as a right not to be killed, confined or used as property, which human benefit cannot override
example: In the school debate on zoos, Arjun built his whole case on animal rights and refused to discuss ticket prices at all.

hindi: पशु-कल्याण — पशुओं के प्रति क्रूरता घटाने और उनके कष्ट को कम करने पर बल देने का मत
definition: the view that humans may keep animals and employ them provided their suffering is kept as small as possible and their living conditions are humane
example: The café switched to cage-free eggs for animal welfare reasons, though the regulars mainly noticed the price going up.

hindi: पशुवाद — मनुष्य को मूलतः पशु ही मानने का मत
definition: the view that human beings are purely animals by nature, with no separate spiritual side, so that each person simply is a living organism
example: After three hours without lunch, his snarling at the printer made a strong case for animalism.

hindi: जीववाद — प्रकृति की वस्तुओं में आत्मा मानने का विश्वास
definition: the belief that natural things such as rivers, trees, animals and mountains possess a soul or spirit of their own
example: When Grandma thanks the neem tree each morning, she is practising a quiet animism her village has kept for generations.

hindi: अनिर्वचनीय — जिसे न सत् कहा जा सके न असत्, माया का स्वरूप
definition: the Advaita claim that maya and the world it produces are indescribable, since they can be called neither fully real nor wholly unreal
example: Asked whether the office party was fun, Leena called it anirvachaniya: neither good nor bad, just indescribable.

hindi: विसंगत एकतत्ववाद — मानसिक घटनाएँ भौतिक हैं पर उन्हें जोड़ने वाले कठोर मनोभौतिक नियम नहीं, ऐसा मत
definition: Davidson's view that every mental event is a physical event, yet there are no strict laws linking mental descriptions to physical ones
example: Anomalous monism, Shreya argued, explained why no algorithm could predict which dessert her physically ordinary brain would crave next.

hindi: जवाबदेयता — अपने कर्म के कारण बताने के लिए उत्तरदायी होना
definition: the sense of responsibility in which a person can fairly be asked to give their reasons for an action and to defend or explain it
example: The manager's answerability for the missed deadline meant a meeting where she had to explain every choice on the timeline.

hindi: अन्तर्यामी — सबके भीतर रहकर उन्हें संचालित करने वाला ईश्वर
definition: the inner controller, the supreme self dwelling inside every being and thing, guiding them from within without their knowing it
example: Whenever his hand reached for a third samosa, Varun blamed the antaryamin, though his mother suspected ordinary greed.

hindi: पूर्ववर्ती संरचनावाद — संरचनाओं को अपने उदाहरणों से स्वतंत्र, अमूर्त रूप में विद्यमान मानने का मत
definition: the version of mathematical structuralism holding that mathematical structures exist as abstract things in their own right, prior to and independent of any systems that follow their pattern
example: Hearing that the pattern of a chessboard would survive even if every board burned, Riya realised her cousin believed in ante rem structuralism.

hindi: पूर्ववर्ती — 'यदि क तो ख' कथन का 'यदि' वाला पहला भाग
definition: the first part of a conditional statement, the clause that follows 'if' and states the condition being supposed
example: In 'if you finish your homework you can play', Ayaan argued the antecedent never specified which homework.

hindi: मानवकेंद्रवाद — केवल मनुष्य को ही मूल्य का केंद्र और मापदंड मानने का मत
definition: the view that human beings are the central or only holders of moral value, so nature matters only because of its usefulness to humans
example: The town council's anthropocentrism showed when it valued the wetland entirely by how many joggers used the path beside it.

hindi: सार-विरोधवाद — यह मत कि वस्तुओं के कोई स्थायी अनिवार्य गुण नहीं होते
definition: the view that things have no essential properties in themselves, so that which properties count as essential depends on how we describe or classify them
example: When Shreya called her cold coffee 'still coffee', her friend's anti-essentialism replied that it depended entirely on who was describing it.

hindi: आशय-निरपेक्षवाद — कृति के अर्थ को रचनाकार के आशय से स्वतंत्र मानने का मत
definition: the view that the meaning of a poem or artwork depends on the work itself and public conventions of language, not on what its maker privately intended
example: Defending anti-intentionalism in the book club, Zoya insisted the novel's ending was hopeful no matter what the author said in interviews.

hindi: न्यूनीकरणवाद-विरोध — दूसरों की बात को बिना अलग प्रमाण के मानने को उचित ठहराने वाला मत
definition: the view about testimony, meaning what other people tell us, that we are entitled to believe it by default, without first needing independent reasons to trust the speaker
example: Asking a stranger for directions and simply following them, Mohit was living by anti-reductionism before he had heard the word.

hindi: व्यवस्था-विरोधवाद — स्थापित सत्ता और संस्थाओं के विरोध का मत
definition: the stance of opposing the existing social and political establishment and distrusting those who hold power; the opposite of establishmentism
example: His antiestablishmentism extends even to the school canteen, where he refuses the official menu on principle.

hindi: जन्म-निषेधवाद — नए प्राणियों को जन्म देना नैतिक रूप से अनुचित है, यह मत
definition: the view that bringing people into existence is morally wrong, or at least harmful to them, because every life contains suffering the person never consented to
example: Priya's antinatalism softened noticeably once her sister handed her a sleeping newborn at the hospital.

hindi: विप्रतिषेध — दो परस्पर विरोधी पर समान रूप से सिद्ध होने वाले निष्कर्ष
definition: in Kant's philosophy, a pair of opposite conclusions that reason can prove equally well, such as the world having a beginning and having none, showing reason overreaching itself
example: Their debate about whether the universe had a beginning ended in an antinomy, with both friends proving their side and neither willing to pay for chai.

hindi: ईश्वरवाद-विरोध — यह मान्यता कि ईश्वर में विश्वास हानिकारक है और उसका विरोध होना चाहिए
definition: active opposition to belief in any deity, holding that such belief or its institutions cause harm and should be challenged
example: Vikram's antitheism made the family dinner tense, until his aunt calmly asked whether he opposed the belief itself or only the temple committee that kept raising the fees.

hindi: अनुमान — पहले से ज्ञात संबंध के आधार पर किसी बात को जानना
definition: in Indian philosophy, inference, the source of valid knowledge that moves from a perceived sign to an unseen fact, as from smoke on a hill to fire
example: Seeing wet umbrellas stacked by the office door, Sneha used anumana to conclude it was raining without looking outside.

hindi: अनुपलब्धि — किसी वस्तु के न मिलने से उसके अभाव का ज्ञान
definition: in Mimamsa and Vedanta, knowing through the absence of perception, the source of valid knowledge by which you know something is missing because it would be seen if present
example: Checking every pocket and finding nothing, Arnav knew by anupalabdhi that his keys were not in his jacket.

hindi: अणुव्रत — गृहस्थ द्वारा लिए जाने वाले छोटे या सीमित जैन व्रत
definition: in Jainism, the lesser, limited vows taken by householders and other ordinary followers, which apply the principles of nonviolence, truthfulness and restraint within everyday family life
example: Vikram's anuvrata about honesty lasted until his aunt asked whether he liked her homemade fruitcake.

hindi: अन्यथाख्याति — भ्रम में वास्तविक वस्तु का अन्य रूप में ग्रहण होने का न्याय मत
definition: the theory of perceptual error from Nyaya, the classical Indian school of logic, holding that in an illusion a real object is perceived as having qualities that really belong to some other object elsewhere
example: Under anyathakhyati, Kunal explained, the grey hoodie on the chair was real; he had simply perceived it with the features of an intruder.

hindi: आपद्धर्म — संकट के समय लागू होने वाले विशेष कर्तव्य
definition: the special rules of conduct permitted in times of emergency or disaster, when ordinary duties cannot be followed
example: Eating instant noodles for dinner during exam week, Neha insisted it was apaddharma and her mother should not judge.

hindi: अपरिग्रह — आवश्यकता से अधिक वस्तुओं और आसक्ति का त्याग
definition: the Jain principle of non-possessiveness, which asks people to limit their belongings and loosen their attachment to things, since clinging binds the soul
example: After decluttering her wardrobe down to twelve outfits, Sneha announced that aparigraha was cheaper than any shopping app.

hindi: वीतरागता — विनाशकारी भावावेगों से मुक्त मन की स्टोइक अवस्था
definition: the Stoic ideal of a mind freed from destructive passions such as rage, fear and craving, leaving calm judgement rather than cold indifference
example: When the printer jammed during the deadline, Nisha's apatheia held: she simply sighed, cleared the paper and carried on.

hindi: ईश्वर-उदासीनता — यह रवैया कि ईश्वर है या नहीं, यह प्रश्न जीवन के लिए महत्त्वहीन है
definition: the attitude that whether any deity exists does not matter, being irrelevant to daily life and not worth settling
example: When the debate about deities flared up again in the office, Anika's apatheism showed: she shrugged and asked who had taken her lunch.

hindi: अपौरुषेय — किसी मनुष्य द्वारा न रचा गया, विशेषकर वेद
definition: in Indian philosophy, describing scripture, especially the Vedas, as not composed by any human author and therefore free from human error
example: At the family dinner, Grandfather explained that his tradition holds the Vedas apaurusheya, and cousin Aman, who writes songs, admitted he could not imagine words without an author.

hindi: अनंत मूलतत्त्व — असीम, अनिश्चित वस्तु जिससे सब कुछ जन्म लेता है
definition: Anaximander's name for the boundless, unlimited and undefined stuff from which every thing in the world arises and into which everything returns
example: Staring at the fridge's leftover containers, Nikhil decided the shapeless mystery curry was his household apeiron: every dinner came from it and returned to it.

hindi: निश्चयात्मक — जो अनिवार्यतः और निर्विवाद रूप से सत्य हो
definition: describing a statement that is necessarily true and beyond any doubt, as certain as a proof in geometry; also spelled apodictic
example: The teacher called the claim that a square has four equal sides apodeictic, and the class moved on without argument.

hindi: निश्चयात्मक — जो तर्क से अनिवार्यतः सत्य सिद्ध हो
definition: describing a statement that is necessarily true and can be shown with complete certainty, like 'every triangle has three sides'; also spelled apodeictic
example: That seven plus five makes twelve is apodictic, which did not stop my little brother from demanding a recount.

hindi: अपोह — शब्द का अर्थ अन्य वस्तुओं के निषेध से समझने का बौद्ध सिद्धांत
definition: the Buddhist theory of meaning, developed by Dignaga and Dharmakirti, that a word picks out things by excluding everything they are not, rather than naming a real shared essence
example: Defining a sandwich as anything that isn't soup, salad or cake, Neel stumbled into apoha.

hindi: संयत-सौम्य — नीत्शे के अनुसार व्यवस्था, संयम, स्पष्ट रूप और विवेक से जुड़ा
definition: in Nietzsche's early thought, relating to order, restraint, clear form, reason and calm beauty, one of two opposing forces within Greek tragedy
example: Her colour-coded study timetable was so Apollonian that even the highlighters seemed to follow rules.

hindi: अपीड़ा — शरीर का दुःख और कष्ट से मुक्त होना
definition: the Epicurean state of bodily freedom from pain, which together with calm of mind makes up the highest pleasure
example: Once the dentist's numbing injection kicked in, Ravi enjoyed a brief Epicurean aponia before remembering the bill.

hindi: निषेधात्मक धर्ममीमांसा — ईश्वर को 'यह नहीं, यह नहीं' कहकर समझने की पद्धति; नेति नेति
definition: an approach that describes the divine only by saying what it is not, because any positive description would limit something beyond human understanding
example: Asked to describe her ideal flatmate, Sana practised apophatic theology: not messy, not loud, not a drummer.

hindi: अनिर्णय की उलझन — ऐसी स्थिति जिसमें तर्क किसी निष्कर्ष तक न पहुँचे
definition: a state of puzzlement or deadlock in which an argument reaches no answer, often where Socratic dialogues deliberately leave the reader
example: Two hours of debating what counts as a sandwich left the flatmates in total aporia.

hindi: प्रामाण्य-दोष — अनुचित या असंबद्ध विशेषज्ञ के कहने भर को प्रमाण मान लेना
definition: the fallacy of accepting a claim merely because some respected figure endorses it, especially when that person has no expertise on the matter
example: A famous actor recommends this toothpaste for fixing your posture, read the advert, a spectacular appeal to authority.

hindi: परिणाम-आश्रित दोष — परिणाम सुखद या दुखद होने से दावे को सत्य या असत्य मानना
definition: the fallacy of judging a claim true or false according to whether its consequences would be pleasant or unpleasant, rather than by evidence
example: The exam cannot be tomorrow because that would ruin the weekend, said Zoya, in a hopeful appeal to consequences.

hindi: भावना-आश्रित दोष — प्रमाण के बजाय भावनाएँ भड़काकर सहमति पाना
definition: the fallacy of trying to win agreement by stirring feelings such as pity, fear or pride instead of giving relevant reasons
example: Think of the puppy's sad eyes, pleaded the advert, an appeal to emotion aimed squarely at the sofa-buying public.

hindi: भय-आश्रित दोष — डर पैदा करके किसी दावे को मनवाना
definition: the fallacy of winning agreement by frightening listeners with threatening outcomes, rather than showing good evidence that those outcomes are likely
example: Share this message or your phone will explode, warned the forward in the family group chat, a crude appeal to fear.

hindi: अज्ञान-आश्रित दोष — खंडन न होने से दावे को सत्य मान लेना
definition: the fallacy of concluding that a claim is true because nobody has proved it false, or false because nobody has proved it true
example: Nobody has proved the office fridge ghost does not exist, said Imran, and the whole floor groaned at the appeal to ignorance.

hindi: प्राकृतिकता-आश्रित दोष — प्राकृतिक होने से ही किसी चीज़ को अच्छा मान लेना
definition: the fallacy of arguing that something is good or safe because it is natural, or harmful because it is artificial
example: Poison ivy is natural too, Mom reminded Sneha, whose appeal to nature was selling her aunt's herbal hair oil.

hindi: नवीनता-आश्रित दोष — नया होने से ही किसी चीज़ को बेहतर मान लेना
definition: the fallacy of claiming that something is better or correct simply because it is newer or more modern than the alternatives
example: Rahul upgraded to the latest phone for its brand new features, then admitted his appeal to novelty mostly bought a different camera bump.

hindi: करुणा-याचना दोष — दया जगाकर दावे को स्वीकार करवाने की कोशिश
definition: the fallacy of trying to win agreement by making listeners feel sorry for someone, instead of offering relevant reasons for the claim
example: Please give me full marks, I stayed awake all night, wrote Aarav under his wrong answers, an appeal to pity.

hindi: परंपरा-आश्रित दोष — पुराना चलन होने से ही किसी बात को सही मानना
definition: the fallacy of claiming that something is correct or better simply because people have always believed or practised it that way
example: We have always held the meeting on Monday at eight, said the manager, and the team sighed at another appeal to tradition.

hindi: आत्म-प्रत्यक्ष — अपने ही अनुभवों के प्रति सजग चेतना
definition: a term introduced by Leibniz for conscious, reflective awareness of your perceptions, as distinct from mere perception, which can happen without awareness
example: Halfway through his commute, Siddharth reached apperception and realised he had been humming the same jingle for twenty minutes.

hindi: प्रयोज्यता समस्या — अमूर्त गणित के भौतिक जगत पर इतने सटीक लागू होने की पहेली
definition: the puzzle of explaining why abstract mathematics, often developed without concern for nature, applies so successfully to the physical world and scientific prediction
example: Watching a formula predict exactly when the kettle would boil, Omar was struck by the applicability problem and let his chai go cold.

hindi: मूल्यांकन-सिद्धांत — भाव इस पर निर्भर है कि व्यक्ति स्थिति को अपने लिए कैसा आँकता है
definition: the view that emotions arise from how someone evaluates a situation's meaning for their goals, so different appraisals of one event produce different emotions
example: One colleague was furious and another relieved about the cancelled meeting, which appraisal theory explains without needing more coffee.

hindi: सहप्रस्तुति — जो प्रत्यक्ष नहीं दिखता उसे दिखने वाले के साथ अनुभव करना
definition: Husserl's term for experiencing something not directly given alongside what is given, such as sensing another person's inner feelings through their visible face
example: Seeing her flatmate's slammed door, Nisha grasped through appresentation a whole inner storm she could never directly perceive.

hindi: प्रागनुभववाद — यह मत कि कुछ महत्त्वपूर्ण ज्ञान अनुभव से पहले, केवल बुद्धि से मिलता है
definition: the view that important knowledge can be gained by reasoning alone, before or independent of any evidence from experience
example: Her economics teacher warned that pure apriorism would let the class prove anything about prices without once checking a shop.

hindi: प्रागनुभविकता — किसी ज्ञान का अनुभव से स्वतंत्र होकर सिद्ध हो सकने का गुण
definition: the property a piece of knowledge has when it can be justified by thinking alone, without needing evidence gathered from experience
example: Dev insisted the apriority of 'every bachelor is unmarried' meant he could skip the survey his manager wanted.

hindi: अपूर्व — कर्म से उत्पन्न अदृश्य शक्ति जो आगे फल देती है
definition: in Mimamsa, the unseen potency created by a ritual action that persists after the action ends and later brings about its promised result
example: Watering the seedlings every morning with nothing to show, Heena trusted some apurva was quietly building toward tomatoes.

hindi: चिह्न की यादृच्छिकता — शब्द और अर्थ के बीच कोई स्वाभाविक संबंध न होना
definition: Saussure's principle that nothing natural links a word's sound to its meaning, since the connection is fixed only by social convention
example: The arbitrariness of the sign came alive when Leo learned that 'gift' means poison in German.

hindi: ज्ञान का पुरातत्व — ज्ञान की छिपी परतों और नियमों की खोज
definition: Foucault's method of digging into the hidden rules and assumptions that shaped what could count as knowledge in past periods, much like studying buried layers
example: Doing an archaeology of knowledge on old school textbooks, Diya found whole chapters built on assumptions nobody questioned.

hindi: मूलतत्त्व — वह आदि सिद्धांत जिससे समस्त जगत उत्पन्न हुआ माना गया
definition: in early Greek philosophy, the first principle or basic source from which everything in the world comes and of which everything is ultimately made
example: Arguing over whether biryani or chai was the arche of every good family gathering, the cousins finally agreed it was gossip.

hindi: आर्किमिडीज़ बिंदु — संपूर्ण ज्ञान का अडिग आधार-बिंदु
definition: a single certain and unshakable truth from which the rest of knowledge could be securely built, as Descartes sought through doubt
example: Rebuilding her messy budget, Esha chose her fixed rent as the Archimedean point and worked outward from there.

hindi: सद्गुण-सम्बन्धी — चरित्र की श्रेष्ठता या दोष से जुड़ा हुआ
definition: relating to virtue and excellence of character, used for judgements like brave, kind or selfish rather than words like right, wrong or required
example: Their ethics teacher pointed out that calling the lunch thief petty was an aretaic judgement, whereas calling the theft wrong was not.

hindi: श्रेष्ठता — किसी वस्तु या व्यक्ति की उत्कृष्टता, विशेषकर चरित्र की उत्तमता
definition: the Greek word for excellence, meaning whatever makes a thing or person perform its proper function well, and especially excellence of human character
example: Watching the chef calmly rescue a burnt curry, Nikhil said that was pure arete, the knife-skills version of moral excellence.

hindi: युक्ति — आधार-वाक्यों और उनसे समर्थित निष्कर्ष का समूह
definition: in logic, a series of statements in which some, called premises, are offered as reasons for accepting another statement, called the conclusion
example: Their shouting match about the thermostat was loud, but the philosophy teacher noted that it contained no single argument with a stated premise.

hindi: युक्ति-रूप — किसी तर्क का वह ढाँचा जो उसके विषय से स्वतंत्र हो
definition: the abstract pattern or structure of an argument, shown by replacing its particular statements with letters, which settles whether the argument is valid
example: Kiran noticed that her sister's excuse and her own shared an argument form, which made it awkward to reject only one of them.

hindi: आकस्मिकता युक्ति — आश्रित वस्तुओं के आधार के रूप में अनिवार्य सत्ता का तर्क
definition: a version of the cosmological argument claiming that things which might not have existed need an explanation, ultimately found in a necessary being whose existence depends on nothing else
example: Rohan's argument from contingency was simple: his phone depends on the charger, the charger on the socket, so something in this flat must depend on nothing.

hindi: रचना युक्ति — जगत की सुघड़ रचना से किसी रचयिता का अनुमान
definition: another name for the teleological argument: the claim that the intricate, purposeful design of living things and nature points to an intelligent designer
example: Opening his new laptop, Aryan said nobody would believe it assembled itself, and his sister groaned that he had rediscovered the argument from design.

hindi: मतभेद तर्क — नैतिक मतभेदों की व्यापकता से वस्तुनिष्ठ नैतिक सत्य पर संदेह करने का तर्क
definition: the argument that deep, lasting moral disagreement across people and cultures is better explained by differing customs and attitudes than by objective moral facts
example: After two hours of family debate about arranged marriage, Pooja reached for the argument from disagreement and suggested nobody had privileged access to moral facts.

hindi: कृतज्ञता तर्क — राज्य से मिले लाभों के बदले उसके कानून मानने का कर्तव्य
definition: the argument that citizens should obey the state's laws out of gratitude for the benefits, such as safety and schooling, that the state has given them
example: Dad deployed the argument from gratitude: eighteen years of free meals, he said, surely earned him one tidy bedroom.

hindi: विभ्रम-तर्क — विभ्रम और वास्तविक प्रत्यक्ष के समान अनुभव से परोक्ष प्रत्यक्ष का तर्क
definition: the argument that since a vivid hallucination can feel exactly like genuine perception, and a hallucination has no physical object, even ordinary perception must directly present only mental images or private sensory appearances
example: After dreaming his phone buzzed, Aman ran the argument from hallucination on his whole inbox and decided none of his emails were really there.

hindi: भ्रम-तर्क — भ्रम के आधार पर इंद्रिय-प्रदत्तों के अस्तित्व का तर्क
definition: the argument that because objects sometimes appear different from how they really are, such as a straight stick looking bent in water, what we directly perceive must be sense data, private sensory appearances, rather than the objects themselves
example: Holding a spoon in his glass of water, Tanmay used the argument from illusion to explain why he could no longer trust anything at lunch.

hindi: अविश्वास-आधारित दोष — समझ में न आने से किसी बात को झूठा मान लेना
definition: the fallacy of concluding that a claim must be false because the speaker finds it hard to imagine or understand
example: I cannot see how a tiny chip holds my whole music library, so it must be cloud magic, said Grandma, in a sweet argument from incredulity.

hindi: सीमांत उदाहरणों का तर्क — जो कसौटी पशुओं को बाहर करे वह कुछ मनुष्यों को भी बाहर कर देगी, यह तर्क
definition: the argument that any trait used to deny animals moral status, such as reason or language, is also missing in some humans whom everyone agrees deserve protection
example: In ethics class, the argument from marginal cases made the room go quiet, because nobody wanted to defend the rule that followed from their answer.

hindi: विचित्रता तर्क — वस्तुनिष्ठ नैतिक गुणों को अत्यधिक विचित्र बताकर उनके अस्तित्व पर मैकी का आक्षेप
definition: Mackie's argument that objective moral facts would be utterly strange entities, able to motivate anyone who knew them, so there probably are none
example: Mohit used the argument from queerness at lunch: a fact that forces everyone to share their fries would be the strangest object in the universe.

hindi: दंड-भय तर्कदोष — धमकी या बल के सहारे बात मनवाना
definition: the fallacy of appealing to force or threats of punishment to make someone accept a claim, instead of giving reasons that support it
example: Agree the plan is brilliant or you are cleaning the fridge, said the flatmate, in a cheerful argumentum ad baculum.

hindi: अज्ञान-आधारित तर्कदोष — प्रमाण के अभाव को ही प्रमाण मान लेना
definition: the Latin name for the appeal to ignorance, treating the absence of proof against a claim as though it were proof for the claim
example: No one saw me eat the last samosa, so I did not, argued Varun, in a crumb-covered argumentum ad ignorantiam.

hindi: करुणा-आधारित तर्कदोष — दया भाव को प्रमाण के स्थान पर रखना
definition: the Latin name for the appeal to pity, using sympathy for someone's suffering in place of relevant evidence for a claim
example: The intern's argumentum ad misericordiam about his dying laptop did not change the fact that the report was missing.

hindi: जनमत-आश्रित तर्कदोष — बहुत लोग मानते हैं, इसलिए सत्य है मान लेना
definition: the fallacy of concluding that a claim is true simply because many people believe it or approve of it
example: A million followers cannot be wrong about this detox tea, said the influencer, in a sparkling argumentum ad populum.

hindi: आदर-आधारित तर्कदोष — किसी प्रतिष्ठित व्यक्ति के कहने भर से दावे को सत्य मान लेना
definition: the Latin name for the appeal to authority, resting a claim on a respected person's word rather than on evidence relevant to the claim
