example: My uncle is a doctor, so this stock will double, said Riya, not noticing her argumentum ad verecundiam.

hindi: अर्हत् — जिसने स्वयं निर्वाण प्राप्त कर लिया हो
definition: in early and Theravada Buddhism, a person who has fully ended craving and ignorance and reached nirvana, the highest goal of that path
example: Unbothered by the noisy flat upstairs, Grandpa sat so calmly that his grandchildren called him an arhat.

hindi: अरस्तूवाद — अरस्तू के दर्शन और उस पर आधारित परंपरा का मत
definition: the philosophical tradition following Aristotle's teachings on logic, nature, ethics and metaphysics, influential across Islamic, Jewish and Christian medieval thought
example: Their philosophy teacher's habit of classifying every lunch into genus and species convinced the class that Aristotelianism was contagious.

hindi: स्थानसंख्या — किसी संबंध या फलन में भरे जाने वाले खाली स्थानों की गिनती
definition: in logic and mathematics, the number of inputs, or empty slots, that a function or relation needs; 'gives' has three slots, as in 'Asha gives Ravi a book'
example: The relation 'sits between' has an arity of three, which is why the seating chart for the family wedding needed a spreadsheet.

hindi: आरामकुर्सी दर्शन — बिना प्रयोग, केवल सोच-विचार से दार्शनिक प्रश्न सुलझाना
definition: philosophy done by careful thinking alone, without experiments or fieldwork, sometimes used as praise and sometimes as mild criticism
example: Proving the office needed a better coffee machine through armchair philosophy, Rajat never once left his swivel chair.

hindi: काल-बाण — समय की भूत से भविष्य की ओर दिशा
definition: the apparent single direction of time from past to future, seen in eggs breaking but never unbreaking and in memories reaching only backward
example: Watching milk spread through his coffee, Samar blamed the arrow of time for the fact that he could never stir it back out.

hindi: बाण विरोधाभास — ज़ेनो का तर्क कि उड़ता तीर हर क्षण स्थिर होने से कभी चलता ही नहीं
definition: Zeno's argument that a flying arrow is motionless at every single instant, so if time is made of instants, motion never happens
example: Frozen mid-bite in a group photo, Kiran said the picture proved the arrow paradox: at that instant nobody at dinner was moving.

hindi: ऐरो का असंभवता प्रमेय — कोई भी मतदान-विधि सभी न्यायोचित शर्तें एक साथ पूरी नहीं कर सकती
definition: the theorem that no voting method for ranking three or more options can satisfy a small list of seemingly reasonable fairness conditions all together
example: When the flatmates' vote on a holiday spot looped forever, Anika blamed Arrow's impossibility theorem and booked the beach herself.

hindi: कला कला के लिए — कला का मूल्य उसके भीतर ही है, किसी बाहरी उद्देश्य में नहीं, यह सूत्र
definition: the slogan that artworks have value in themselves and should not be judged by whether they teach morals, serve politics or bring profit
example: Asked why his comic had no message, Varun shrugged and said art for art's sake, which also explained why nobody bought it.

hindi: अर्थ — धन, आजीविका और भौतिक सुरक्षा का जीवन-लक्ष्य
definition: in Hindu thought, the human goal of wealth, livelihood and material security, considered legitimate when pursued within the bounds of dharma
example: Asking for a raise, Priya reminded herself that artha is one of life's proper aims, not something to feel guilty about.

hindi: अर्थापत्ति — किसी तथ्य को समझाने के लिए आवश्यक बात की कल्पना
definition: in Mimamsa and Vedanta, postulation, the source of valid knowledge that supposes an unseen fact needed to explain a puzzle, as a fasting person who stays plump must be eating at night
example: Her flatmate never cooked yet the fridge kept emptying, so by arthapatti Zoya concluded the midnight snacking was real.

hindi: कृत्रिम नैतिक कर्ता — ऐसी मशीन जो नैतिक निर्णय ले सके और शायद उनके लिए उत्तरदायी भी हो
definition: a machine or software system able to make moral decisions, and possibly to bear responsibility for them, much as a human agent does
example: When the smart fridge refused to open after midnight, Ravi wondered if he now lived with an artificial moral agent.

hindi: कलाजगत — कलाकारों, दीर्घाओं, समीक्षकों और कला-सिद्धांतों का वह परिवेश जो कलाकृति को अर्थ देता है
definition: the network of artists, galleries, critics, collectors and theories that surrounds artworks and, on some views, decides which objects count as artworks
example: Tanvi joked that her doodle became serious the moment the artworld found it, which in practice meant her aunt posting it online.

hindi: असबिय्या — इब्न ख़ल्दून की सामूहिक एकजुटता, जो राज्यों को उठाती और गिराती है
definition: Ibn Khaldun's idea of group solidarity or shared loyalty, which he held lets a community found a state and weakens as rulers grow comfortable
example: The startup's asabiyyah was fierce in the garage years, then faded once everyone had a private office and a parking spot.

hindi: असत् — अनस्तित्व या अवास्तविक, सत् का विलोम
definition: the Sanskrit term for nonbeing or unreality, the opposite of being, raised in Vedic hymns asking whether existence first came from nonexistence
example: Tidying the empty storeroom, Lakshmi joked that it held nothing but asat and three broken chairs.

hindi: असत्कार्यवाद — न्याय-वैशेषिक मत कि कार्य उत्पत्ति से पहले अपने कारण में विद्यमान नहीं होता
definition: the Nyaya-Vaisheshika doctrine that an effect does not exist inside its cause beforehand but is a genuinely fresh creation, as a clay water vessel is something beyond mere clay
example: At pottery class, Shreya argued asatkaryavada: the mug she threw on the wheel had never existed before, whatever the clay thought.

hindi: तपस्वी आदर्श — इंद्रियों और जीवन-सुख को नकारने को ही ऊँचा मानने वाला मूल्य
definition: Nietzsche's term for the value placed on self-denial, chastity and poverty, which he read as life turning against its own desires
example: Refusing every cookie at the office party, Leela embodied the ascetic ideal until someone found her secret chocolate drawer.

hindi: वैराग्यवाद — सांसारिक सुख त्यागकर आत्मिक उन्नति पाने का मार्ग
definition: the view and practice of giving up worldly pleasures and comforts in order to reach a higher spiritual or mental state
example: His month of phone-free asceticism lasted until the cricket final, when he suddenly remembered where he had hidden the phone.

hindi: स्वयंभूता — स्वयं से, बिना किसी कारण के, अस्तित्व रखने का गुण
definition: the property of existing from oneself alone, depending on nothing else for existence, which scholastic writers ascribed only to the deity
example: Rohan claimed his sourdough starter had aseity until his mother pointed out she had been feeding it every morning.

hindi: अशअरी मत — ईश्वर की सर्वशक्ति और शास्त्र की प्रधानता मानने वाला कलाम संप्रदाय
definition: the school of Islamic theology holding that the deity directly creates every event, that moral rightness comes from divine command, and that reason must serve revelation
example: Nadia's roommate claimed the kettle boils only because the deity makes it boil each time, which Nadia recognised as a kitchen version of Asharism.

hindi: आश्रम — जीवन की चार अवस्थाओं में से एक
definition: one of the four ideal stages of life in Hindu thought: student, householder, forest dweller and renunciant, each carrying its own duties
example: Dad announced he was entering a new ashrama, which turned out to mean he had bought gardening gloves.

hindi: अष्टांग योग — पतंजलि का आठ अंगों वाला योग मार्ग
definition: the eight-limbed path of classical Yoga philosophy described by Patanjali, moving from ethical restraints and posture through breath control and concentration to meditative absorption
example: In the staff room, Mr Iyer explained that ashtanga yoga involves far more than stretching, which disappointed the PE teacher.

hindi: अभ्यास-तप — सद्गुण के लिए कठोर आत्म-प्रशिक्षण
definition: the Cynic and Stoic practice of deliberate training through hardship, such as cold, hunger or discomfort, to strengthen character and independence
example: Taking cold showers all winter, Manav called it askesis, though his flatmates called it an unpaid water bill.

hindi: आस्रव — आत्मा में कर्म-पुद्गलों के प्रवाहित होने की प्रक्रिया
definition: in Jain philosophy, the inflow of karmic matter into the soul, caused by actions, words and thoughts driven by passion
example: Every time Sameer doomscrolled until two in the morning, his sister warned him that the asrava of bad karma was flooding in with the notifications.

hindi: अभिकथन — किसी बात को सत्य बताकर प्रस्तुत करने की वाक्-क्रिया
definition: the kind of utterance that presents something as true, which commits the speaker to its truth and invites the listener to believe it
example: Kunal's assertion that he "never snacks at night" survived until the kitchen camera footage appeared.

hindi: सहायित मृत्यु — असाध्य रोगी को अपनी मृत्यु चुनने में दी गई चिकित्सकीय सहायता
definition: the medical practice of helping a competent adult with a terminal illness to bring about their own death, usually through prescribed lethal medication
example: The newspaper's group chat split instantly over whether the headline should say assisted dying or assisted suicide.

hindi: प्रत्यय-साहचर्य — सादृश्य, समीपता या कारणता से विचारों का आपस में जुड़ना
definition: the principle that ideas become linked in the mind through resemblance, closeness in space or time, or cause and effect, so each summons another
example: Every time the office microwave beeped, Rahul craved popcorn, a textbook case of the association of ideas.

hindi: सहचारी दायित्व — किसी समुदाय का सदस्य होने मात्र से उपजा कर्तव्य
definition: a duty that arises simply from belonging to a group, such as a family or nation, rather than from any promise or consent given
example: Nobody asked Isha to defend her cousin at the wedding, but she felt the associative obligation that comes with sharing a surname.

hindi: अस्तेय — दूसरे की वस्तु न लेने का संयम
definition: the ethical restraint against stealing, never taking what belongs to others, including their time, credit or ideas
example: Returning the stapler he had borrowed three months ago, Manav felt his asteya had been restored.

hindi: अस्तिकाय — जैन दर्शन में विस्तार वाले पाँच मूल द्रव्य
definition: in Jain philosophy, a substance that has extension in space, a group including souls, matter, space and the media that allow motion and rest
example: Trying to fit the new bookshelf into her tiny flat, Kavita decided that space was the most demanding astikaya of all.

hindi: खगोलीय अपव्यय — मानव सभ्यता के फैलाव में देरी से असंख्य संभावित जीवनों के खो जाने का तर्क
definition: the argument that every year of delay in humanity's expansion, and above all its extinction, wastes an enormous number of possible future happy lives
example: Stuck in traffic, Kunal called the forty-minute commute his own personal astronomical waste.

hindi: असममित निर्भरता — फोडर का वह सिद्धांत जिसमें गलत कारणों का संबंध सही कारणों पर निर्भर है
definition: Jerry Fodor's theory of content holding that a symbol means what causes it in the basic case, because mistaken triggers produce the symbol only in ways that depend on that basic link
example: Asymmetric dependence explained why Ravi's word for crows still meant crows, even though a dark plastic bag on the roof sometimes triggered it.

hindi: अक्षोभ — मन की पूर्ण शांति और व्याकुलता से मुक्ति की अवस्था
definition: a lasting calm of mind, free from worry and inner disturbance, which Epicurean and sceptical thinkers treated as the goal of living well
example: Having finally muted the family group chat, Arjun reached a state of ataraxia that no meditation app had ever given him.

hindi: अनीश्वरवाद — ईश्वर के अस्तित्व को न मानने का मत
definition: the absence of belief in any deity, or the stronger view that no deity or divine being exists at all
example: At the dinner table, Nikhil explained his atheism calmly while his aunt kept passing him extra helpings of kheer anyway.

hindi: आत्मा — मनुष्य का सच्चा, अविनाशी और चेतन स्वरूप
definition: the true, unchanging self at the core of every person, pure consciousness beneath body and mind, which Vedanta relates to Brahman
example: After losing his phone, Rehan reminded himself that his atman was not stored in the cloud.

hindi: परमाणु तथ्य — संसार का सबसे सरल, अविभाज्य तथ्य
definition: in logical atomism, the simplest kind of fact, which cannot be broken down into smaller facts and is independent of every other simple fact
example: 'The kettle is on' was the only atomic fact anyone in the half-awake office could confirm before nine.

hindi: परमाणु प्रतिज्ञप्ति — ऐसा सरलतम कथन जिसमें कोई अन्य कथन न छिपा हो
definition: the simplest kind of statement, containing no smaller statements joined by words like 'and', 'not' or 'if', which in logical atomism pictures a single atomic fact
example: Their logic teacher broke 'Sam is tired and hungry' into two atomic propositions, which Sam confirmed were both true.

hindi: परमाणु वाक्य — ऐसा सरलतम कथन जिसमें कोई तार्किक संयोजक न हो
definition: the simplest kind of statement in a formal language, containing no connectives or quantifiers, from which every compound statement is built
example: Their teacher broke the rambling excuse into atomic sentences, and 'the dog ate my homework' turned out to be the only claim in there.

hindi: परमाणुवाद — जगत को अविभाज्य कणों और रिक्त स्थान से बना मानने का मत
definition: the theory of Leucippus and Democritus that everything consists of tiny, uncuttable particles moving through empty space, and that all change is their rearrangement
example: Sweeping up glitter from the craft project, Neha became a firm believer in atomism: the particles were everywhere and would never be destroyed.

hindi: आरोपणीयता — किसी कर्म का व्यक्ति के वास्तविक स्वरूप को प्रकट करना
definition: the sense of responsibility in which an action truly expresses who a person is, their values and character, so that it can fairly be credited to them
example: His rude comment under stress was a slip, but the pattern of sneering emails showed real attributability to his character.

hindi: गुणधर्म — किसी द्रव्य का मूल स्वभाव, जिससे बुद्धि उसे समझती है
definition: in Descartes and Spinoza, the basic nature of a substance through which the intellect grasps it, such as thought or physical extension in space
example: Reading Spinoza on the train, Aditya realised that thought and extension were each an attribute, and that his packed carriage had rather too much extension.

hindi: गुणारोपक प्रयोग — वर्णन से वह जो भी हो, उसकी बात करना
definition: Donnellan's term for employing a definite description to talk about whoever or whatever matches it, without having any particular individual already in mind
example: When Jai fumed that 'whoever designed this form' must hate people, it was a purely attributive use, since he had no idea who that was.

hindi: उत्कर्षण — किसी चीज़ को एक साथ मिटाना, बचाना और ऊपर उठाना
definition: Hegel's term, often translated sublation, for the process in which a stage of thought is cancelled, preserved and lifted into a higher, richer stage
example: Merging two rival school clubs into one, the principal achieved a small Aufhebung: both traditions ended, survived and improved.

hindi: ऑगस्टीन का ईश्वर-न्याय — अशुभ को सृष्टि के पतन और स्वतंत्र चयन का परिणाम मानने वाला समाधान
definition: a theodicy claiming that a deity created a good world and that evil entered through the free, wrongful choices of angels and humans
example: Aunt Leela's Augustinian theodicy for the ruined kitchen was clear: it was perfect until the twins decided to bake.

hindi: ऑगस्टिनवाद — ऑगस्टीन के विचारों पर आधारित धर्म-दर्शन की परंपरा
definition: the tradition following Augustine, stressing divine grace, the inner search for truth, the weakness of the human will and knowledge through divine illumination
example: The debating club's Augustinianism showed when every speech about procrastination ended with a confession of weakness.

hindi: आत्मनिर्भरता — बाहरी वस्तुओं से स्वतंत्र, स्वयं में पूर्ण रहने का आदर्श
definition: the ideal of complete self-sufficiency, needing nothing outside yourself for happiness, prized especially by Cynic and Stoic thinkers
example: When the delivery apps went down, Rhea discovered her autarkeia extended exactly as far as instant noodles.

hindi: प्रामाणिकता — अपनी स्वतंत्रता को स्वीकारकर स्वयं चुने मूल्यों के अनुसार जीना
definition: the existentialist ideal of living by values you have freely chosen and openly owned, rather than hiding behind roles, habits or the expectations of others
example: Quitting the family business to teach dance, Neha called it authenticity, while her uncle called it a very expensive hobby.

hindi: लेखक-प्रकार्य — लेखक के नाम द्वारा पाठों को वर्गीकृत और नियंत्रित करने की भूमिका
definition: Foucault's term for the social role that an author's name plays in grouping, valuing and controlling texts, rather than simply naming the actual writer
example: The same poem was ignored online until someone attached a famous name, showing the author function doing its quiet work.

hindi: सत्तावाद — नागरिक स्वतंत्रता की कीमत पर कठोर केंद्रीय सत्ता का शासन
definition: a form of government that concentrates power in a single leader or party, demands obedience and suppresses opposition and civil liberties
example: The group admin who deleted every message he disliked was accused of authoritarianism, and promptly removed the accuser.

hindi: स्वहस्ताक्षरी — जिस कला में मूल कृति और उसकी नकल का भेद अर्थपूर्ण हो, वैसी
definition: describing artworks such as paintings, where even a perfect copy counts as a forgery, because the history of how the object was made matters
example: When Ravi printed a flawless poster of the famous painting, his sister reminded him painting is autographic, so the dorm wall held no masterpiece.

hindi: स्वायत्ततावाद — कलाकृति के नैतिक दोषों को उसके कलात्मक मूल्य से अलग मानने का मत
definition: the view that the moral flaws or virtues of an artwork have no bearing on its value as artwork, which must be judged separately from ethics
example: Defending autonomism at dinner, Aditi argued the villain-loving film was brilliant filmmaking even if its message was dreadful.

hindi: नीति की स्वायत्तता — नैतिक निष्कर्षों को केवल तथ्यों से न निकाल पाने का सिद्धांत
definition: the thesis that moral conclusions cannot be derived from purely factual premises alone, so ethical reasoning always needs some moral starting point
example: During the debate club practice, Rohan leaned on the autonomy of ethics: statistics about screen time alone could never show that phones ought to be banned.

hindi: संकल्प-स्वायत्तता — विवेक द्वारा स्वयं को नैतिक नियम देने की क्षमता
definition: in Kant, the capacity of a rational will to give itself the moral rule through reason alone, independent of desires or outside pressure
example: Refusing to copy homework even when the whole class did, Aarav called it autonomy of the will; his friends called it stubbornness.

hindi: सहायक परिकल्पना — मुख्य परिकल्पना के साथ परीक्षण में मानी गई पूरक धारणा
definition: a background assumption, such as that instruments work properly, that must be combined with a main hypothesis before any testable prediction can be deduced
example: When the cake sank, Divya blamed an auxiliary hypothesis about the oven thermometer rather than her treasured recipe.

hindi: सत्तातीतता — वस्तु का अस्तित्व और अनस्तित्व दोनों से परे होना
definition: Meinong's term for the status of pure objects standing beyond both being and nonbeing, before any question of their existence arises
example: The office's promised four-day week, Maya said, floated in Außersein, neither existing nor quite dismissed.

hindi: अवच्छेदवाद — जीव को उपाधि से सीमित ब्रह्म मानने का मत
definition: the Advaita theory that the individual self is Brahman limited by conditions, just as open space appears divided by the walls of separate rooms
example: Partitioning the open office into cubicles, the facilities team accidentally gave everyone a lesson in avacchedavada.

hindi: अवस्थात्रय — जाग्रत, स्वप्न और सुषुप्ति, चेतना की तीन अवस्थाएँ
definition: the Vedantic analysis of the three states of consciousness, waking, dreaming and deep sleep, used to show that the true self witnesses all three
example: Rushing through the morning, Mira passed through avastha traya in record time: asleep, half dreaming, then wide awake at the alarm.

hindi: औसत-उपयोगितावाद — प्रति व्यक्ति औसत कल्याण को अधिकतम करने का मत
definition: the form of utilitarianism holding that the best outcome has the highest average wellbeing for each person, rather than the largest total wellbeing added across everyone
example: Sameer invoked average utilitarianism to keep the birthday dinner small, since two grumpy extra guests would drag down everyone's mood.

hindi: इब्न रुश्दवाद — इब्न रुश्द की अरस्तू-व्याख्या पर आधारित लैटिन विचार-परंपरा
definition: the movement among Latin thinkers following Averroes's commentaries on Aristotle, known for defending philosophical reasoning independently of theology and for claiming all humans share a single intellect
example: In the college canteen, Omar's Averroism surfaced whenever he insisted reason should follow its argument wherever it led, even past dessert.

hindi: इब्न सीनावाद — अस्तित्व और सार के भेद पर आधारित इब्न सीना का दर्शन
definition: the philosophy of Avicenna and his followers, known for separating a thing's essence, what it is, from its existence, the fact that it is
example: Reading about Avicennism, Omar realised his unicorn sketch had a perfectly clear essence and absolutely no existence.

hindi: अविद्या — आत्मा के सच्चे स्वरूप का अज्ञान
definition: spiritual ignorance, the basic failure to know the true self, which causes the illusion of separateness and keeps beings bound to rebirth
example: Kiran blamed avidya for forgetting his own password, though his manager blamed the sticky note he lost.

hindi: मूल्यमीमांसा — मूल्यों और मूल्य-निर्णयों का दार्शनिक अध्ययन
definition: the branch of philosophy that studies value, asking what makes things good, worthwhile or beautiful, and how we judge them
example: Arguing over whether the pricier phone was actually 'worth it', the roommates had stumbled into axiology without realising.

hindi: स्वयंसिद्ध — बिना उपपत्ति के स्वीकार किया गया वह मूल कथन जिससे अन्य कथन सिद्ध होते हैं
definition: a basic statement accepted without proof as a starting point, from which other statements in a system are proved by valid deduction
example: In their flat, 'whoever cooks does not wash up' functioned as an axiom, never proved and never questioned.

hindi: चयन अभिगृहीत — अनेक समुच्चयों में से हर एक से एक सदस्य चुन पाने की मान्यता
definition: the principle that from any collection of nonempty sets it is possible to pick a single member from each, even when no rule for choosing exists
example: Faced with forty identical pairs of socks and no sorting rule, Imran simply invoked the axiom of choice and grabbed a sock from each pair.

hindi: ख-श्रेणी — घटनाओं का पहले और बाद के स्थायी संबंधों के अनुसार क्रम
definition: McTaggart's term for the ordering of events by fixed earlier and later relations, which never change however much time passes
example: In the B-series, lunch always comes after the standup meeting, which Dev pointed out was the only permanent thing about his office.

hindi: ख-कालसिद्धांत — समय को केवल पहले, बाद और साथ के संबंधों से समझने का मत
definition: the view that time consists only of events standing in earlier, later and simultaneous relations, with no objective present and no real flowing
example: Kunal used the B-theory of time to argue that his birthday is not approaching at all; it just sits later than breakfast.

hindi: पश्चगामी कारणता — यह धारणा कि कार्य अपने कारण से पहले घटित हो सकता है
definition: the idea that an effect might happen earlier in time than its cause, so later events could influence earlier ones, discussed in physics and time travel puzzles
example: Sahil claimed backward causation when his exam went well, since he planned to revise properly next week.

hindi: कुसंगति आपत्ति — यह आपत्ति कि कुछ अमूर्तन सिद्धांतों के असंगत निकलने से पूरी पद्धति संदिग्ध हो जाती है
definition: the objection to neo-logicism that some abstraction principles shaped just like acceptable ones lead to contradiction, so the method cannot tell sound principles from harmful ones
example: When Arjun's friends pointed out that his logic for skipping the gym also justified skipping work, he met the bad company objection in real life.

hindi: अपराध-बोधी अंतःकरण — भीतर मोड़ी गई प्रवृत्तियों से जन्मा अपराध-भाव, नीत्शे के अनुसार
definition: Nietzsche's account of guilt as aggressive instincts that society forbids turning outward, so they turn inward and torment the self instead
example: Eating his flatmate's leftover biryani gave Farhan a bad conscience that lasted exactly until dessert.

hindi: आत्मप्रवंचना — अपनी स्वतंत्रता से मुँह मोड़कर स्वयं को धोखा देना
definition: Sartre's term for deceiving yourself about your freedom, pretending that your choices are fixed by your role, your past or other people when they are really yours
example: Saying he had no choice but to reply to office emails at midnight, Arjun was accused by his flatmate of pure bad faith.

hindi: गंजे व्यक्ति का विरोधाभास — एक बाल घटने से गंजापन कब आता है, यह उलझन
definition: a version of the sorites puzzle, the puzzle about vague words changing through tiny steps, where losing one strand of hair never makes someone bald, yet losing enough strands clearly does
example: Checking the bathroom mirror, Uncle Ravi comforted himself with the bald man paradox: no single strand could ever make him bald.

hindi: बंध — आत्मा का कर्म-पुद्गलों से बँध जाना
definition: in Jain philosophy, the bondage of the soul, when inflowing karmic matter sticks to it through passions like anger, greed and pride
example: Gaurav explained bandha to his little brother as karma sticking to the soul the way syrup sticks to the kitchen counter.

hindi: भेड़चाल दोष — सब कर रहे हैं, इसलिए सही है मान लेना
definition: the fallacy of accepting a belief or choice because many people are adopting it, treating popularity as evidence of truth
example: Everyone in class bought the neon water bottle, so Diya did too, the bandwagon fallacy rattling in her school bag.

hindi: ज्ञान-निक्षेप शिक्षा — शिक्षक द्वारा विद्यार्थी में तथ्य जमा करने वाली पद्धति
definition: Freire's name for teaching that treats students as empty accounts into which the teacher deposits facts to be stored, memorised and repeated back without questioning
example: Copying all forty slides word for word before the exam, Kabir admitted the banking model of education had turned him into a very nervous savings account.

hindi: बंटू दर्शन — बंटू भाषी लोगों की विश्वदृष्टि को एक दर्शन के रूप में प्रस्तुत करने का प्रयास
definition: Placide Tempels' influential and much-debated account of the worldview of Bantu-speaking peoples, often cited as the founding text of ethnophilosophy
example: In seminar, Chidi argued that Bantu philosophy said more about its missionary author than about any actual Bantu speaker.

hindi: नाई विरोधाभास — स्वयं दाढ़ी न बनाने वालों की ही दाढ़ी बनाने वाले नाई का उलझाव
definition: a popular illustration of Russell's paradox about a village barber who shaves exactly those villagers who do not shave themselves, leaving his own shaving impossible
example: At the salon, Neha asked who cuts the barber's hair, and the stylist groaned that he had heard the barber paradox before.

hindi: बार्कन सूत्र — संभावना और अस्तित्व के क्रम को जोड़ने वाला प्रकारमूलक सूत्र
definition: a disputed principle of modal logic that uses 'every' and 'some', stating that if possibly something has a property, then something exists that possibly has that property, which seems to populate reality with merely possible beings
example: When Rohit said he could possibly have a younger brother, his cousin cited the Barcan formula and asked where this brother was hiding.

hindi: निर्गुण विशेष — गुणों से अलग वह शुद्ध आधार जो वस्तु को उसकी व्यक्तिगत पहचान देता है
definition: a thing considered apart from all its properties, proposed as the plain featureless core that owns those properties and makes an object this individual
example: Staring at a completely blank sticky note, Rahul joked that it was the closest the office would ever come to a bare particular.

hindi: बार्हस्पत्य — बृहस्पति के नाम से जुड़ा चार्वाक या लोकायत दर्शन
definition: another name for the ancient Indian materialist school, traditionally traced to the sage Brihaspati, which accepts only perception and denies any afterlife
example: In the philosophy quiz, Tushar remembered that Barhaspatya, Charvaka and lokayata all name the same stubbornly materialist school.

hindi: आधार और अधिरचना — आर्थिक आधार द्वारा कानून, राजनीति और संस्कृति के आकार लिए जाने का मार्क्सवादी प्रतिरूप
definition: the Marxist model in which the economic base, meaning the forces and relations of production, shapes the superstructure of legal systems, politics, religion and culture
example: Explaining why the canteen menu changed after the new catering contract, Ishaan drew base and superstructure on a napkin.

hindi: स्थान-तर्क — वह आधारभूमि जिसमें सब वस्तुएँ और संबंध प्रकट होते हैं
definition: Nishida's logic of place, the view that things and judgments exist within ever deeper fields of context, ending in absolute nothingness
example: Explaining office politics, Neel used basho: every quarrel only made sense inside the wider place of the team, the company and the city.

hindi: मूल क्रिया — किसी अन्य क्रिया के माध्यम से न की जाने वाली सरलतम क्रिया
definition: an action done directly, not by doing something else first, such as raising a finger, from which more complex actions are built
example: Turning on the light required a basic action, moving her finger, which Divya pointed out when accused of doing nothing.

hindi: मूल विश्वास — बिना अन्य विश्वासों के सहारे स्वतः उचित माना जाने वाला विश्वास
definition: in foundationalism, a belief that is justified without resting on other beliefs, often drawn from direct experience, and that supports further beliefs
example: Staring at the empty milk carton, Ishaan treated 'there is no milk' as a basic belief needing zero further argument.

hindi: मूल पात्रता — केवल कर्म के आधार पर प्रशंसा या दंड का अधिकारी होना
definition: the idea that a person can deserve praise or blame purely because of what they chose and performed, apart from any useful effects that praising or punishing them might bring
example: Sara's teacher claimed the detention served basic desert, while Sara insisted it served only the teacher's lunch break.

hindi: मूल भाव — सब मनुष्यों में जन्मजात और सार्वभौम माने जाने वाले कुछ प्राथमिक भाव
definition: a small group of emotions, such as fear, anger, disgust and surprise, held to be inborn, universal across cultures and building blocks for others
example: The teacher listed the basic emotions on the board, and the class agreed Monday mornings triggered at least three of them.

hindi: मूल नियम पाँच — फ्रेगे का वह नियम जो आगे चलकर रसेल के विरोधाभास से असंगत सिद्ध हुआ
definition: Frege's axiom stating that concepts have identical extensions, meaning collections of things falling under them, exactly when they apply to the very same things, later shown inconsistent
example: Pointing at the collapsed group project, Vivaan compared its central assumption to Basic Law V: elegant, confident and quietly contradictory.

hindi: मूल ढाँचा — समाज की प्रमुख संस्थाएँ जो अधिकारों, कर्तव्यों और लाभों का बँटवारा तय करती हैं
definition: Rawls's term for a society's major institutions, such as its constitution, economy and family, which together shape everyone's rights, duties and prospects
example: Priya argued that one generous employer changes little if the basic structure of the industry still rewards unpaid internships.

hindi: आधार-संबंध — विश्वास और उसके कारण के बीच का वास्तविक टिकाव-संबंध
definition: the connection between a belief and the reason it actually rests upon, which decides whether good evidence really supports that belief
example: Nisha's correct forecast rested on her horoscope, not the radar map, so the basing relation spoiled her smugness.

hindi: बेज़ प्रमेय — प्रमाण मिलने पर परिकल्पना की प्रायिकता निकालने का गणितीय सूत्र
definition: a mathematical formula for working out how probable a hypothesis is given some evidence, from its prior probability and how likely the evidence would be if it were true
example: Reviewing the smoke alarm's false alarms, Isha used Bayes' theorem to decide that burnt toast was likelier than fire.

hindi: बेज़ीय पुष्टि — प्रमाण से परिकल्पना की प्रायिकता बढ़ने को पुष्टि मानने का सिद्धांत
definition: the account on which evidence confirms a hypothesis exactly when learning that evidence raises the hypothesis's probability, calculated using Bayes' theorem
example: Every muddy pawprint on the sofa was Bayesian confirmation of Riya's growing suspicion about the neighbour's dog.

hindi: बेज़वाद — विश्वास को प्रायिकता की मात्रा मानकर उसे प्रमाण से अद्यतन करने का मत
definition: the view that beliefs come in degrees measurable as probabilities, and that rational thinkers update those degrees on evidence using Bayes' theorem
example: Madhav's Bayesianism about the late food delivery meant nudging his confidence downward with every ignored message.

hindi: परमानंद दर्शन — ईश्वर का प्रत्यक्ष, आनंदमय साक्षात्कार
definition: the direct vision of the divine, believed in some traditions to be the final happiness of blessed souls, knowing the divine face to face
example: Seeing the holiday roster finally approved, Farhan described the moment as a beatific vision, though mostly of beaches.

hindi: भव — निरंतर बदलते और बनते रहने की अवस्था
definition: the process of change and coming into existence, often contrasted with stable, unchanging being in debates since Heraclitus
example: Watching the dough rise, Ananya declared that bread is not a being but a becoming, at least until someone eats it.

hindi: डिब्बे में भृंग — निजी अनुभवों और सार्वजनिक भाषा के संबंध पर विट्गेन्श्टाइन का दृष्टांत
definition: Wittgenstein's thought experiment in which everyone owns a small container holding something called a beetle that nobody else can inspect, used to question whether words can name private inner feelings
example: When everyone in the group chat described their headache differently, Omar said it was a beetle in a box situation and nobody could check anyone else's.

hindi: आत्माश्रय दोष — जो सिद्ध करना है उसे पहले से ही मान लेने की भूल
definition: the fallacy of arguing for a conclusion by quietly assuming that same conclusion inside the premises, the starting claims of the argument
example: Saying the office coffee is the best because nothing beats it is begging the question, Priya pointed out over her lukewarm cup.

hindi: सत् — अस्तित्व का मूल तथ्य या जो कुछ भी है
definition: the most general feature shared by everything that exists, or the fact of existing itself, studied as the central topic of ontology
example: Stuck in traffic, Kabir mused that being was the only thing every honking driver had in common.

hindi: सत् के रूप में सत् — किसी भी वस्तु को केवल अस्तित्ववान होने की दृष्टि से देखना
definition: Aristotle's phrase for studying things purely insofar as they exist, rather than as numbers, living bodies or other special kinds
example: Asked why he stared at his coffee mug, Arjun said he was considering it as being qua being, not as a mug that needed washing.

hindi: स्वयं-हेतु सत्ता — सार्त्र के अनुसार सचेत, स्वतंत्र और सदा अधूरी मानवीय चेतना
definition: Sartre's term for conscious human existence, which is always free, never complete, and constantly moving beyond what it currently is toward what it might become
example: Aditi explained that her houseplant was simply there, while she, as being-for-itself, kept worrying about who she might become.

hindi: पर-हेतु सत्ता — दूसरों की दृष्टि में वस्तु बनकर स्वयं को अनुभव करना
definition: Sartre's term for the side of a person's existence that appears when others look at them, turning them into an object judged from outside
example: Tripping in the school corridor, Nikhil felt his being-for-others arrive all at once in thirty watching faces.

hindi: स्वयं में सत्ता — सार्त्र के अनुसार जड़, पूर्ण और चेतनाहीन वस्तुओं का अस्तित्व
definition: Sartre's term for the existence of ordinary things like rocks and tables, which are simply and completely what they are, without consciousness, freedom or possibility
example: Envying the sofa's calm being-in-itself, Varun wished he too could exist without deadlines.

hindi: जगत-में-होना — मनुष्य का संसार के साथ अविभाज्य रूप से जुड़ा अस्तित्व
definition: Heidegger's term for human existence as always already involved in a meaningful world of tasks, tools and people, never a detached mind looking outward
example: Juggling a laptop, a lunchbox and a crying toddler, Seema needed no lecture on being-in-the-world.

hindi: मृत्यु-उन्मुख अस्तित्व — अपनी मृत्यु की निश्चितता को स्वीकार कर जीना
definition: Heidegger's term for facing your own death as your certain, personal possibility, which he held can make everyday living more deliberate and genuine
example: After a frightening hospital visit, Manav adopted being-towards-death and finally cancelled the gym membership he never used.

hindi: विश्वास-इच्छा प्रतिमान — कर्म को विश्वास और इच्छा के मेल से समझाने का ढाँचा
definition: the model explaining every action as produced by a desire for some goal combined with a belief about how to reach that goal, a picture often traced back to Hume
example: By the belief-desire model, Rohan's midnight fridge raid needed only a craving for mango pickle and a belief it sat behind the curd.

hindi: बेल का प्रमेय — स्थानीय छिपे चरों से क्वांटम भविष्यवाणियाँ न निकल पाने का प्रमाण
definition: the proof that no theory where distant particles carry only local hidden instructions can reproduce every prediction of quantum physics about their correlated measurements
example: Ananya used Bell's theorem to explain why she and her twin finishing sentences simultaneously needed more than shared pre-planned answers.

hindi: सबका सबके विरुद्ध युद्ध — राज्यहीन दशा में हर व्यक्ति के दूसरे से संघर्ष की हॉब्स की धारणा
definition: Latin for 'the struggle of all against all', Hobbes's description of life without government as constant warfare, where everyone competes with everyone and nobody is safe
example: The office fridge on Friday afternoon, with no labels and no rules, was a small bellum omnium contra omnes over yoghurt.

hindi: प्रिय समुदाय — प्रेम और निष्ठा से जुड़ा आदर्श मानव समाज
definition: Josiah Royce's ideal of a community bound by shared loyalty and love, later taken up by Martin Luther King Jr. as the goal of justice and reconciliation
example: After the neighbours repaired the park together, the residents' newsletter half-jokingly declared the arrival of the beloved community.

hindi: बेनासेराफ़ की दुविधा — गणितीय सत्य और उसके ज्ञान, दोनों को एक साथ समझा पाने की कठिनाई
definition: the challenge that mathematical platonism, the view that numbers exist as abstract objects, explains mathematical truth well but leaves unclear how humans could know about objects that never physically affect them
example: Staring at a prime number that had never once touched her, Isha felt Benacerraf's dilemma and wondered how she knew anything about it at all.

hindi: बेनाटार की विषमता — दुःख का अभाव अच्छा है, पर सुख का अभाव बुरा नहीं, यह तर्क
definition: David Benatar's claim that the absence of pain is good even when nobody enjoys that absence, while the absence of pleasure is harmless unless someone is deprived, used to support antinatalism
example: When Kunal explained Benatar's asymmetry in class, his friends decided that the absence of Monday tests was good even for students who never enrolled.

hindi: परोपकारिता — रोगी की भलाई के लिए सक्रिय रूप से कार्य करने का कर्तव्य
definition: the ethical duty, central in medicine, to actively promote the wellbeing of others, especially patients, by doing them good and preventing harm
example: The school nurse's beneficence extended to hiding extra biscuits in the first-aid cupboard for anyone who fainted during assembly.

hindi: करुणामय शासन — जनता के कल्याण पर केंद्रित शासन
definition: the Mencian doctrine that rulers must govern with humaneness, lowering taxes, easing punishments and providing for people's basic needs
example: When the principal added free breakfast before exams, the students hailed a new era of benevolent government.

hindi: बर्लिन मंडल — बर्लिन के दार्शनिकों का समूह जो वियना मंडल के समान वैज्ञानिक दर्शन अपनाता था
definition: the group of philosophers and scientists in Berlin, headed by Hans Reichenbach, that worked alongside the Vienna Circle to build a scientific philosophy based on logic and experience
example: In the seminar, Meera explained that the Berlin Circle was the Vienna Circle's sibling group, sharing its love of logic but living in a different city.

hindi: बेरी विरोधाभास — 'बीस से कम शब्दों में अवर्णनीय सबसे छोटी संख्या' का स्वयं-खंडन
definition: the puzzle of 'the smallest number that cannot be described in fewer than twenty words', a phrase that itself describes that number in fewer than twenty words
example: Trying to name the dullest number in his maths notebook, Yash stumbled straight into the Berry paradox.

hindi: बर्ट्रांड विरोधाभास — 'यादृच्छिक' चयन की विधि बदलने से संभावना बदल जाना
definition: the probability puzzle showing that picking a random chord, meaning a straight line joining two points on a circle, gives different answers depending on how 'random' is defined
example: Arguing over how to randomly choose a restaurant, Sanya warned the group about Bertrand's paradox.

hindi: विश्वेच्छा — एक साथ विश्वास और इच्छा दोनों का काम करने वाली कल्पित मानसिक अवस्था
definition: a proposed mental state that works both as a belief and as a desire at once, introduced by critics of the belief-desire model to explain moral motivation
example: Aditi insisted her conviction that recycling matters was a besire, since believing it somehow made her want to rinse every yoghurt pot.

hindi: सर्वोत्तम हित मानक — असमर्थ रोगी के लिए वही चुनना जो उसके लिए सर्वश्रेष्ठ हो
definition: the standard for proxy decisions requiring a substitute decider to choose whatever would most benefit an incapacitated patient, when their own wishes are unknown
example: Nobody knew the toddler's views on vaccines, so the paediatrician simply applied the best interests standard and handed over a sticker.

hindi: सर्वश्रेष्ठ संभव जगत — लाइबनिज़ का मत कि ईश्वर ने संभव जगतों में से सबसे उत्तम को रचा
definition: Leibniz's view that a perfectly good and wise creator must have chosen, from every world that could exist, the best overall one, which is therefore ours
example: Stuck in traffic with a flat phone, Kunal asked whether this was truly the best of all possible worlds or just the cheapest.

hindi: सर्वोत्तम तंत्र सिद्धांत — प्रकृति के नियमों को जगत के सबसे सरल और व्यापक वर्णन के सूत्र मानने का मत
definition: the view, from Mill, Ramsey and Lewis, that laws of nature are the statements in whichever summary of all worldly facts best balances simplicity with informative strength
example: Rhea applied the best system account to her messy flat: the house rules were just the shortest summary of how everyone actually behaved.

hindi: प्रदान-मत — प्रेम प्रिय में मूल्य खोजता नहीं, बल्कि उसे मूल्य प्रदान करता है
definition: the view that love does not respond to value already present in the beloved but instead gives value to that person through the loving itself
example: Nobody else sees the charm of Dev's battered old scooter, and his aunt says the bestowal view explains every family heirloom too.

hindi: भेदाभेद — जीव और ब्रह्म को एक साथ भिन्न और अभिन्न मानने का मत
definition: a family of Vedanta schools holding that the individual self and Brahman are both different and not different at the same time, like waves and the ocean
example: Asked whether her playlist was hers or the band's, Nisha answered with bhedabheda: both, and also neither, depending on the chorus.

hindi: बीएचके व्याख्या — तार्किक चिह्नों का अर्थ प्रमाण-निर्माण के रूप में देने की पद्धति
definition: the explanation of intuitionistic logic that defines each logical connective, words like 'and', 'or' and 'if', by what counts as a proof, so that proving 'this or that' means proving at least one side
example: Nikhil used the BHK interpretation on his roommate: saying 'I either paid rent or will pay it' counts only with a receipt for one of them.

hindi: द्विसोपाधिक — 'क तभी और केवल तभी जब ख' वाला कथन
definition: a compound statement asserting that each part holds exactly when the other holds, which is true precisely when both parts share the same truth value
example: The group chat agreed on a biconditional: pizza gets ordered if and only if Arjun finally pays back last week's share.

hindi: आत्म-संस्कार — शिक्षा और संस्कृति द्वारा व्यक्ति का समग्र आत्म-निर्माण
definition: the German ideal of education as lifelong self-formation, in which a person cultivates reason, taste and character through culture until becoming fully and freely themselves
example: Rohan called his evenings of novels, museums and long walks his Bildung, though his flatmates called it avoiding the dishes.

hindi: द्वि-आधारी विरोध — अर्थ बनाने वाले परस्पर विपरीत जोड़े
definition: a pair of opposed concepts, such as male and female or nature and culture, that structuralists think organise meaning and that critics argue usually favour one side
example: The debate club noticed every speech leaned on the binary opposition of 'tradition versus progress', with nobody allowed to stand in between.

hindi: जीवकेंद्रवाद — हर जीवित प्राणी, पौधे समेत, को अपने आप में मूल्यवान मानने का मत
definition: the view that every living thing, including plants and microbes, has value in itself and deserves moral respect simply because it is alive
example: Ananya's biocentrism made mowing the lawn a surprisingly long negotiation with her conscience.

hindi: जैवनीतिशास्त्र — चिकित्सा और जीवविज्ञान से उठे नैतिक प्रश्नों का अध्ययन
definition: the branch of ethics that studies moral questions raised by medicine and biology, such as organ donation, gene editing and caring for dying patients
example: The group chat turned into a bioethics seminar when someone asked whether parents should be allowed to edit their baby's genes.

hindi: जैविक प्रकृतिवाद — चेतना को मस्तिष्क की जैविक प्रक्रियाओं की उपज मानने का मत
definition: John Searle's view that consciousness and understanding are real biological features caused by specific brain processes, so that running a program alone cannot produce them
example: Defending biological naturalism in the staff room, Anand said the software could simulate digestion all day without ever needing an antacid.

hindi: जैविक प्रजाति अवधारणा — परस्पर प्रजनन करने वाले समूह को प्रजाति मानने का मत
definition: the definition of a species as a group of organisms that can interbreed with each other and produce fertile offspring, but not with other groups
example: By the biological species concept, Amit's biology teacher explained, lions and tigers stay separate species despite the famous zoo hybrids.

hindi: जैव-राजनीति — जनसंख्या के जीवन और स्वास्थ्य का राजनीतिक प्रबंधन
definition: Foucault's term for politics that treats the biological life of populations, including birth, health, disease and lifespan, as something governments must measure and manage
example: Watching the council debate vaccination drives and birth-rate figures, Kunal called it biopolitics in a municipal hall.

hindi: जैव-सत्ता — जनसंख्या के जीवन, स्वास्थ्य और शरीरों पर शासन की शक्ति
definition: Foucault's term for modern state power that manages the life, health, birth rates and bodies of whole populations through statistics, medicine and regulation
example: Neha's step-count challenge at the office, complete with health-insurance discounts, felt like biopower wearing a friendly lanyard.

hindi: निंदनीयता — किसी कर्म के कारण दोष के योग्य होने का गुण
definition: the property of deserving blame for an action, which depends on whether the person acted with enough control, knowledge and poor regard for others
example: The flatmates debated the blameworthiness of whoever left the milk out, until the cat was spotted on the counter.

hindi: कोरी पटिया — यह मत कि मन जन्म के समय खाली होता है और सब कुछ अनुभव से लिखा जाता है
definition: the view that the mind begins empty at birth, with all its ideas and knowledge written onto it later by experience
example: The new intern treated his brain as a blank slate, cheerfully admitting he learned the coffee machine by trial and error.

hindi: अंधगज न्याय — आंशिक अनुभव से पूर्ण सत्य न जानने पर जैन अनेकांतवाद का दृष्टांत
definition: the parable, central to Jain teaching on many-sidedness, of several blind people each touching a different part of an elephant and each describing the whole animal differently
example: After four managers described the same project in four different ways, the new hire understood the blind men and an elephant.

hindi: अंधे और हाथी — आंशिक अनुभव को पूरा सत्य समझ लेने की प्राचीन दृष्टांत-कथा
definition: the ancient Indian parable in which several blind people each touch one part of an elephant and wrongly describe the whole animal, used to illustrate that partial viewpoints grasp only part of the truth
example: After each department described the product launch differently, the intern whispered that the meeting was just the blind men and the elephant with slides.

hindi: अंध-दृष्टि — सचेत रूप से न देखते हुए भी वस्तुओं पर सही प्रतिक्रिया देने की क्षमता
definition: a condition in which people with damage to the visual brain report seeing nothing, yet still respond accurately to objects placed in their blind field
example: Dodging a paper ball he swore he never saw, Vikram claimed blindsight, though the class suspected he had simply been pretending to sleep.

hindi: खंड-ब्रह्मांड — समस्त देश-काल को एक स्थिर चार-आयामी खंड मानने की धारणा
definition: the picture of reality as one unchanging four-dimensional block of spacetime, where every past, present and future event exists permanently
example: Explaining the block universe to her study group, Pooja said their exam results already exist somewhere further along the block, which nobody found reassuring.

hindi: बोधि — जागरण, सत्य का प्रत्यक्ष बोध
definition: the Buddhist term for awakening or enlightenment, the direct understanding of reality that frees a person from ignorance and suffering
example: Solving the crossword's final clue on the train, Sunil felt what he generously called a small bodhi.

hindi: बोधिचित्त — सब प्राणियों के कल्याण हेतु जागरण की अभिलाषा
definition: in Mahayana Buddhism, the mind devoted to awakening for the benefit of all beings, the motivation that makes someone a bodhisattva
example: Their meditation teacher said bodhicitta starts small, like actually refilling the office water jug.

hindi: बोधिसत्व — सबके उद्धार हेतु निर्वाण को टालने वाला साधक
definition: in Mahayana Buddhism, a being who seeks awakening for the sake of all others, often vowing to delay final release until everyone is freed from suffering
example: Staying late to help every classmate finish the project, Sahil earned the nickname office bodhisattva.

hindi: दैहिक कसौटी — एक ही जीवित शरीर के बने रहने को व्यक्ति के बने रहने की शर्त मानने का मत
definition: the view that a person stays the same over time by keeping the same living human body, whatever happens to their memories or personality
example: Grandpa backed the bodily criterion when he said he was still the same man who married Grandma, even if he'd forgotten every anniversary since.

hindi: राजनीतिक समष्टि — संगठित राज्य को एक जीवित शरीर जैसा समूचा मानने की धारणा
definition: a people organised under one government, pictured as a single living body whose members depend on each other like parts of an organism
example: When half the office caught flu, the manager lamented that the whole body politic of the sales team was bedridden.

hindi: शरीर-रूपरेखा — शरीर की अपनी स्थिति और गतिविधि की अचेतन समझ
definition: the body's unreflective, practical sense of its own posture, reach and movement, which guides action without needing conscious attention or careful thought
example: Thanks to his body schema, Farhan squeezed through the crowded metro door without once thinking about his elbows.

hindi: देह-विनिमय — दो व्यक्तियों के मन का आपस में शरीर बदल लेने का विचार-प्रयोग
definition: a thought experiment in which a pair of people's memories and personalities trade bodies, used to test whether a person travels with their mind or remains with their original body
example: After a week of night shifts, Priya said a body swap with her well-rested cat would be the most generous gift imaginable.

hindi: अंगहीन शरीर — स्थिर संगठन से मुक्त शुद्ध संभावनाओं की अवस्था
definition: deleuze and Guattari's term for a state of pure potential that resists fixed organisation, where desires and forces flow freely before being structured into roles
example: After finishing exams, Rhea lay on the sofa with no plans or purpose, declaring herself a body without organs until dinner.

hindi: बोल्ट्ज़मान मस्तिष्क — संयोग से बने झूठी स्मृतियों वाले मस्तिष्क की कल्पना
definition: a hypothetical conscious brain that forms by random chance in space, complete with false memories, raising doubts about whether our own memories are trustworthy
example: Forgetting his own password twice, Akash wondered whether he was a Boltzmann brain that had only just flickered into existence.

hindi: वाह-धिक् सिद्धांत — नैतिक कथनों को प्रशंसा या धिक्कार की भावनात्मक पुकार मानने वाला भावनावाद
definition: a nickname for emotivism, the view that calling something wrong amounts to booing it and calling something right amounts to cheering it
example: Watching the group chat erupt over pineapple pizza, Farah decided the boo-hurrah theory explained every moral argument her friends ever had.

hindi: स्वयंभू विरोधाभास — समय-यात्रा में किसी वस्तु या सूचना का बिना उद्गम के चक्र में घूमना
definition: the time travel puzzle in which an object or piece of information is sent into the past and becomes its own cause, with no original source
example: When Vikram's notes circulated back to him from his juniors, he called it a bootstrap paradox: nobody could say who first wrote them.

hindi: स्वावलंबन समस्या — किसी स्रोत की विश्वसनीयता को उसी स्रोत से सिद्ध करने की कठिनाई
definition: the worry that some theories let you prove a source reliable simply by checking its readings against beliefs formed from those very readings, which seems suspiciously easy
example: Checking the kitchen clock against the kitchen clock, Varun cheerfully demonstrated the bootstrapping problem to his confused sister.

hindi: सीमांत उदाहरण — ऐसी स्थिति जहाँ किसी शब्द का लागू होना न स्पष्ट हाँ हो, न स्पष्ट ना
definition: an example where a vague word neither clearly applies nor clearly fails to apply, such as whether someone of middling height counts as tall
example: The kitchen argument over whether a hot dog counts as a sandwich raged until Shreya ruled it a borderline case and made everyone lunch.

hindi: बोथो — सेत्स्वाना भाषा में सामुदायिक मनुष्यता और परस्पर आदर का आदर्श
definition: the Setswana word for the southern African ideal of humanity through community, stressing respect, compassion and shared responsibility among people
example: Neo's neighbours in Gaborone took turns cooking for her after the surgery, a quiet lesson in botho.

hindi: बद्ध चर — ऐसा चर जो किसी परिमाणक के दायरे में आकर उससे बँध जाता है
definition: a variable in a formula that falls within the reach of a quantifier, a phrase such as 'for every' or 'there exists', and so is governed by it
example: Omar rewrote 'everyone who orders pays' as 'for every x, if x orders then x pays', noting that x was a bound variable so nobody at the table could wriggle out.

hindi: पूँजीपति वर्ग — उत्पादन के साधनों का स्वामी वर्ग
definition: in Marxist theory, the capitalist class that owns the means of production and profits from employing the labour of others
example: The bourgeoisie of the college canteen, Megha joked, was the single uncle who owned the only coffee machine.

hindi: कोष्ठकीकरण — किसी अनुभव के बारे में अपनी मान्यताओं को कोष्ठक में रखकर अलग कर देना
definition: the phenomenological practice of setting aside your belief that the outside world exists, putting those assumptions in brackets so experience itself can be described
example: During the group project, Arjun tried bracketing his belief that the printer hated him and simply described what it actually did.

hindi: ब्रैडले की अनवस्था — वस्तु और गुण को जोड़ने वाले संबंध के लिए अनन्त नए संबंध माँगने वाला तर्क
definition: an argument, named after the philosopher Bradley, that if a relation is needed to connect a thing to its quality, a further relation is needed to connect that relation, and so on endlessly
example: Needing a manager to supervise the supervisor of the supervisors, Shreya decided the office org chart was Bradley's regress in a lanyard.

hindi: ब्रह्मचर्य — अध्ययन और संयम की विद्यार्थी अवस्था
definition: the first stage of life in Hindu thought, devoted to study, discipline and self-restraint under a teacher, and also the virtue of sexual restraint
example: During board exams, Karan put his phone in a drawer and called the month his brahmacharya.

hindi: ब्रह्म — समस्त जगत का परम, अनंत और एकमात्र आधार
definition: in the Upanishads and Vedanta, the single, infinite ultimate reality underlying everything that exists, often described as pure being, consciousness and bliss
example: Staring at the night sky from the rooftop, Kavya wondered aloud whether Brahman ever felt as small as she did.

hindi: मस्तिष्क-कसौटी — उसी कार्यशील मस्तिष्क के बने रहने को व्यक्ति के बने रहने का आधार मानने का मत
definition: the view that a person goes wherever their functioning brain goes, so that keeping the same brain matters more for survival than keeping the rest of the body
example: In biology class, Sana cited the brain criterion to argue that her brain, not her sleepy body, deserved credit for finishing the homework.

hindi: मस्तिष्क मृत्यु — पूरे मस्तिष्क की क्रियाओं का स्थायी रूप से बंद हो जाना
definition: the irreversible ending of all brain function, including the brainstem, which many medical and legal systems treat as the death of the person
example: In biology class, Sameer asked how a ventilator could keep a chest rising after brain death, and the teacher put the textbook down to answer properly.

hindi: पात्र में मस्तिष्क — कृत्रिम अनुभव से भ्रमित मस्तिष्क की विचार-कल्पना
definition: a thought experiment imagining that your brain floats in a laboratory container, wired to a computer that feeds it every experience, so the whole world you perceive could be simulated
example: Stuck in a meeting that looped the same slide for an hour, Dev wondered aloud whether he was a brain in a vat running a very boring program.

hindi: मस्तिष्क-प्रत्यारोपण — एक व्यक्ति का मस्तिष्क दूसरे शरीर में रखने का विचार-प्रयोग
definition: a thought experiment in which someone's brain is moved into another body, used to test whether a person follows their brain and memories or stays with their original body
example: Debating a brain transplant over chai, Varun asked whether the new body would also inherit his overdue library fines.

hindi: शाखा-रेखा प्रसंग — पारफ़िट का प्रसंग जिसमें प्रतिलिपि बनने के बाद भी मूल व्यक्ति कुछ समय जीवित रहता है
definition: Parfit's thought experiment in which a teleporter builds a duplicate on Mars while the original person on Earth survives briefly, testing whether the duplicate's continuity makes the original's coming death matter less
example: When the office cloned his desktop onto a new machine but kept the old one running, Nikhil worried he had become a branch-line case.

hindi: शाखित काल — भविष्य को अनेक संभावित शाखाओं में बँटा मानने की धारणा
definition: the model in which the past is fixed but the future splits into many possible branches, only one of which will actually happen
example: Choosing between chai and coffee at the canteen, Akash described branching time as a menu where every option is a future version of himself.

hindi: वीर अधिकारी आपत्ति — स्मृति-कसौटी के विरुद्ध रीड का तर्क जिससे व्यक्ति अपने ही बचपन से अलग ठहरता है
definition: Reid's objection to the memory criterion: an elderly general remembers his brave young officer days, and the officer remembered his boyhood, yet the general forgets the boyhood, so memory alone makes identity break its own logical chain
example: Meera raised the brave officer objection in class: she remembered last summer, and last summer she could still remember kindergarten, yet today kindergarten was a total blank.

hindi: ब्रेंटानो का सिद्धांत — विषयोन्मुखता को मानसिक का विशिष्ट लक्षण मानने का मत
definition: the thesis, drawn from Franz Brentano, that intentionality is the defining mark of the mental: all and only mental phenomena are directed at some object
example: Leela used Brentano's thesis to win the argument: her phone's reminder was not thinking about the meeting, even though she clearly was.

hindi: सेतु नियम — ऊँचे स्तर के विज्ञान के शब्दों को भौतिकी के शब्दों से जोड़ने वाला सूत्र
definition: a principle linking the terms of a higher-level science, such as biology or chemistry, to terms of physics, so that higher theories can be derived from lower ones
example: Priya's chemistry teacher called temperature-equals-molecular-motion a bridge law, and the class immediately asked for one linking homework to happiness.

hindi: ब्रिटिश अनुभववाद — लॉक, बर्कले और ह्यूम की परंपरा कि ज्ञान अनुभव से आता है
definition: the tradition of Locke, Berkeley and Hume holding that all knowledge and ideas ultimately come from experience rather than inborn reason
example: Swati's flatmate practised British empiricism at the fridge, trusting no expiry date until he had smelled the milk.

hindi: अंधा भाग्य — वह सौभाग्य या दुर्भाग्य जो किसी सोचे-समझे जोखिम का परिणाम नहीं
definition: Dworkin's term for fortune or misfortune that strikes a person without their having chosen or gambled on it, such as a sudden illness
example: Getting hit by a stray cricket ball on the walk home was pure brute luck, and Aman demanded sympathy accordingly.

hindi: कारणाश्रित मूल्य-मत — मूल्य को उन गुणों से परिभाषित करना जो अनुकूल प्रतिक्रिया के कारण देते हैं
definition: the view that being valuable is nothing more than having other features that give reasons to respond favourably, such as admiring or desiring the thing
example: Asked why the sunset was good, Zoya took the buck-passing account and simply listed the colours that gave everyone reason to stop and stare.

hindi: बुद्ध-स्वभाव — सभी प्राणियों में जागरण की अंतर्निहित क्षमता
definition: the Mahayana Buddhist teaching that all living beings already possess the inner potential for awakening, hidden beneath ignorance and harmful habits
example: Even after the intern deleted the shared folder, the manager reminded everyone about Buddha-nature.

hindi: गुण-पुंज सिद्धांत — वस्तु को केवल गुणों का समूह मानने और किसी अलग आधार को नकारने का मत
definition: the view that an object is nothing more than a bundle or collection of its qualities held together, with no hidden underlying thing that owns them
example: Peeling an onion layer after layer for dinner, Ishaan announced that bundle theory was right: there was no onion underneath, only layers of onion qualities.

hindi: बुराली-फ़ोर्टी विरोधाभास — सभी क्रमसूचक संख्याओं के समुच्चय से उपजा विरोधाभास
definition: the puzzle that the collection of all ordinal numbers, meaning numbers that measure positions in an ordering, would need an ordinal larger than every ordinal
example: When the gaming leaderboard tried to rank every possible rank, Nikhil warned that they were flirting with the Burali-Forti paradox.

hindi: ब्यूरिडन का गधा — दो समान विकल्पों के बीच निर्णय न कर पाने की पहेली
definition: the thought experiment of a hungry donkey standing exactly between two identical piles of food that starves because it has no reason to prefer either, used to explore choice and free will
example: Stuck between two identical phone plans for forty minutes, Rhea became the Buridan's ass of the mobile store.

hindi: योद्धा-धर्म — सामुराई से जोड़ी जाने वाली निष्ठा, सम्मान और आत्मसंयम की आचार-संहिता
definition: the ethical code associated with Japanese samurai, stressing loyalty, courage, honour and self-discipline, largely systematized and idealized in modern times
example: Coach treated the Monday training schedule like bushido, where showing up late brought dishonour on your whole family.

hindi: तितली स्वप्न — च्वांगत्सू का स्वप्न और जागरण के भेद पर दृष्टांत
definition: Zhuangzi's story, from the Chinese Daoist tradition, of dreaming himself a butterfly and then waking unsure whether he was a person who dreamt of a butterfly or a butterfly dreaming of being a person
example: After a nap on the sofa, Omkar recounted his butterfly dream moment, briefly unsure whether he was a student or an unfinished assignment.

hindi: पशु-यंत्र — पशुओं को चेतनाहीन यांत्रिक ढाँचे मानने का कार्तीय मत
definition: the Cartesian doctrine that animals are complex machines without thought or feeling, whose behaviour is explained entirely by mechanical processes in the body
example: Watching her cat sulk after a missed dinner, Sara declared the bête-machine theory dead on arrival in her kitchen.

hindi: ग-श्रेणी — दिशाहीन क्रम जिसमें घटनाएँ बिना पहले-बाद के केवल एक पंक्ति में स्थित हों
definition: McTaggart's term for a mere ordering of events in a line, without any direction from earlier to later and without past, present or future
example: Shuffling his playlist, Arnav joked that his songs formed a C-series: they had an order, but nothing about which came first.

hindi: तर्क-गणक — विवादों को गणना द्वारा सुलझाने की लाइबनिज़ की परिकल्पना
definition: Leibniz's imagined system of logical calculation that would settle disagreements by computing answers, so that disputing parties could simply declare 'let us calculate'
example: When the flatmates argued over the electricity bill, Nisha opened a spreadsheet and called it her calculus ratiocinator.

hindi: कैम्ब्रिज परिवर्तन — वस्तु में वास्तविक बदलाव के बिना, केवल संबंध बदलने से आया परिवर्तन
definition: a merely apparent change, where something acquires a different description only because something else changed, while nothing within it actually altered
example: When his younger sister grew taller than him, Neel underwent a Cambridge change and became 'the shorter sibling' without shrinking at all.

hindi: निरस्तता — निहितार्थ को बिना विरोधाभास के वापस ले सकने का गुण
definition: the feature of a hinted, unstated meaning in conversation that a speaker can take it back without contradiction, as in "some guests left; in fact, all of them did"
example: Cancellability rescued Ira when she added "and actually I liked all your songs" after praising "some" of them.

hindi: कैंटर का स्वर्ग — अनंत समुच्चयों का वह समृद्ध गणित जिसे छोड़ने से उसके समर्थक इनकार करते हैं
definition: the rich mathematics of infinite sets and their differing sizes developed by Georg Cantor, which defenders insist mathematicians should never abandon despite objections from finitists, who accept only finite collections
example: When the tutor suggested dropping infinite sets from the syllabus, Meher protested that nobody would expel her from Cantor's paradise before the exam.

hindi: कैंटर विरोधाभास — सभी समुच्चयों के समुच्चय के आकार से उपजा विरोधाभास
definition: the puzzle that a collection containing every collection would have to be larger than itself, since the collection of all its smaller groupings is always strictly bigger
example: Riya's plan for a folder containing every folder on her laptop ended in Cantor's paradox and a crashed file manager.

hindi: क्षमता दृष्टिकोण — अमर्त्य सेन का मत कि न्याय को लोगों की वास्तविक करने और होने की क्षमताओं से आँका जाए
definition: Amartya Sen's approach that judges justice and wellbeing by what people are actually able to do and become, rather than by income alone
example: Using the capability approach, Neha argued the new library helped more than a cash handout, because the village children finally had somewhere to study.

hindi: पत्ता विरोधाभास — दो ओर के वाक्यों का एक-दूसरे को सत्य-असत्य बताना
definition: a liar-style puzzle about a card whose one side says the other side is true while the other side says the first side is false
example: Kabir wrote the card paradox on a coaster at the café, and his date flipped it back and forth until the coffee went cold.

hindi: प्रधान सद्गुण — विवेक, साहस, संयम और न्याय, जिन पर अन्य सद्गुण टिके हैं
definition: the four main virtues of classical Greek and later Christian thought, namely prudence, courage, temperance and justice, on which other virtues were thought to depend
example: Their debate coach listed the cardinal virtues and added a fifth: never interrupting the opposing speaker.

hindi: कार्तीय चक्र — ईश्वर-प्रमाण और स्पष्ट प्रत्ययों का चक्रीय तर्क
definition: the objection that Descartes argued in a circle, using clear and distinct perceptions to prove a trustworthy deity, then using that deity to guarantee those perceptions
example: Jatin trusted the review because the brand vouched for the reviewer, and the reviewer vouched for the brand, a perfect Cartesian circle in his cart.

hindi: कार्तीय संदेह — हर संदिग्ध विश्वास को अस्थायी रूप से त्यागने की विधि
definition: Descartes's method of systematically doubting every belief that could possibly be false, in order to find whatever remains absolutely certain
example: Applying Cartesian doubt to the office fridge, Nikhil refused to trust any label and sniffed every container himself.

hindi: कार्तीय द्वैतवाद — मन और शरीर को दो बिलकुल भिन्न द्रव्य मानने का मत
definition: Descartes's view that the thinking mind and the physical body, which fills space, are entirely separate kinds of substance, a substance being something that exists independently of anything else
example: When her legs refused to leave the sofa though her brain wanted the gym, Tara blamed Cartesian dualism for the poor communication between departments.

hindi: कार्तीय अहं — शरीर से भिन्न एक सरल, स्थायी चिंतनशील आत्मा
definition: the self understood as Descartes pictured it, a single, simple thinking subject distinct from the body and certain of its existence through thought
example: Stuck in a boring meeting, Harsh insisted only his Cartesian ego was present; his body was merely attending.

hindi: कार्तीय रंगमंच — मस्तिष्क में एक केंद्रीय मंच की धारणा जहाँ सारा अनुभव एक दर्शक के सामने आता है
definition: Dennett's critical name for the picture of a central place in the brain where all experience comes together and is displayed to an inner viewer
example: Describing her dream as a movie playing for herself, Suhana was teased by her roommate for booking tickets to the Cartesian theater.

hindi: कार्तीयवाद — देकार्त के दर्शन और पद्धति पर आधारित विचारधारा
definition: the philosophical school following Descartes, marked by methodical doubt, reliance on reason over the senses, and a sharp division between mind and matter
example: Aisha's Cartesianism showed at the market: she trusted the weighing scale's reasoning over the vendor's cheerful assurances.

hindi: नकद मूल्य — किसी विचार का अनुभव में ठोस व्यावहारिक अंतर
definition: William James's phrase for the concrete, practical difference a belief or concept makes in actual experience and conduct
example: Asked the cash value of her manager's talk about synergy, Priya admitted it meant only that two teams would share one kitchen.

hindi: ग्राही प्रतीति — स्वयं अपनी सच्चाई प्रमाणित करने वाला बोध
definition: the idea, from the ancient Greek Stoic school, of a perception so clear and vivid that it guarantees its own truth, serving as a secure foundation for knowledge
example: Seeing the smoke alarm blinking above the burnt toast, Neha felt she had a cataleptic impression of exactly who ruined breakfast.

hindi: सकारात्मक धर्ममीमांसा — ईश्वर का वर्णन सकारात्मक गुणों से करने की पद्धति
definition: an approach that describes the divine through positive statements, such as calling the divine good, wise or loving, rather than through denials
example: Where her sister listed only what the divine is not, Riya preferred cataphatic theology and wrote a whole page of positive qualities.

hindi: स्वतंत्रार्थक — जो पद अकेले ही वाक्य का उद्देश्य या विधेय बन सके
definition: in logic, describing a word that carries meaning by itself and can stand as the subject of a statement or as what is said about that subject, unlike 'every' or 'and'
example: In 'every student passed', the word 'student' is categorematic, while 'every' only works when propped up by another word.

hindi: कोटिगत अंतर्दृष्टि — संबंधों और ढाँचों को सीधे अनुभव में पकड़ना
definition: Husserl's idea that people directly perceive structures such as 'and', 'being' or 'more than', not merely coloured shapes and sounds
example: Seeing two slices on his plate and one on hers, Yash had an instant categorial intuition that the sharing was unfair.

hindi: निरपेक्ष इच्छाएँ — वे इच्छाएँ जो जीवित रहने का कारण बनती हैं, जीवित रहने पर निर्भर नहीं
definition: Bernard Williams's term for desires that give a person a reason to keep living, rather than merely depending on their staying alive, such as a deep commitment to finishing a life project
example: Finishing his novel was one of Sameer's categorical desires, whereas wanting a samosa at four o'clock merely assumed he would still be around.

hindi: निरपेक्ष आदेश — बिना किसी शर्त के हर विवेकी प्राणी पर लागू होने वाला कांट का सर्वोच्च नैतिक नियम
definition: Kant's supreme moral principle, a command of reason that binds every rational person unconditionally, whatever that person happens to want or desire
example: Tempted to skip the office recycling, Dev remembered the categorical imperative and realised the rule didn't come with an exception for tired Fridays.

hindi: स्वरूपगत गुण — वस्तु का वह वास्तविक गुण जो किसी संभावित व्यवहार पर नहीं, उसकी वर्तमान बनावट पर टिका है
definition: a property that concerns what a thing actually is at present, such as its shape or molecular structure, rather than how it would tend to behave in some situation
example: The glass had not broken yet, Maya noted, so its only categorical property worth mentioning was that it was already on the edge of the table.

hindi: निरपेक्ष न्यायवाक्य — 'सभी', 'कोई नहीं' या 'कुछ' वाले कथनों से बना न्यायवाक्य
definition: a syllogism whose premises and conclusion are categorical statements, each claiming that all, some or none of one group belong to another group
example: Nisha turned the hostel rules into a categorical syllogism: all prefects wear badges, no juniors wear badges, so no juniors are prefects.

hindi: निरपेक्ष गुणवाद — यह मत कि मूल गुण स्वयं में निष्क्रिय होते हैं और उनकी शक्तियाँ बाहरी नियमों से आती हैं
definition: the view that the basic properties of things are categorical, meaning simply how things are in themselves, with their powers to behave supplied by external laws of nature
example: Defending categoricalism over lunch, Ria said her phone battery is just a certain arrangement, and physics decides what it does.

hindi: पदार्थ-वर्ग — अरस्तू द्वारा बताए गए अस्तित्व के मूल प्रकार, जैसे द्रव्य, गुण, परिमाण और संबंध
definition: Aristotle's list of the most basic kinds of things that can be said to exist, including substance, quality, quantity, relation, place and time
example: Sorting the laundry, Ishaan joked that he was applying Aristotle's categories: quantity said too many socks, quality said none of them matched.

hindi: बोध की श्रेणियाँ — अनुभव को व्यवस्थित करने वाली मन की मूल धारणाएँ
definition: Kant's twelve basic concepts, such as cause, substance and unity, which the mind applies to everything it experiences in order to think about objects at all
example: Watching toast pop up, Riya joked that her categories of understanding were already at work, since she instantly blamed the toaster as the cause.

hindi: कोटि-दोष — किसी वस्तु को ऐसी श्रेणी में रखना जिसमें वह हो ही नहीं सकती
definition: the error of treating something as belonging to a type or category it cannot belong to, like asking what colour the number seven is
example: Asking where exactly the 'company culture' was kept in the office building struck the intern as a category mistake.

hindi: चतुष्कोटि — चार विकल्पों वाली भारतीय तर्क-पद्धति
definition: the four-cornered logic of Indian and Buddhist debate, which considers that a claim may be true, false, both, or neither
example: Asked if the meeting was useful, Ankit ran the catuskoti and settled on neither.

hindi: स्वयंभू — जो अपना कारण स्वयं हो
definition: a Latin phrase meaning 'cause of itself', describing something whose existence depends on nothing outside itself, as Spinoza held of the single infinite substance
example: Karan claimed his startup idea was causa sui, conveniently forgetting the podcast he had copied it from.

hindi: कारण-शृंखला — घटनाओं का ऐसा क्रम जिसमें प्रत्येक घटना अगली का कारण बनती है
definition: a sequence of events in which each event causes the next, linking a distant starting cause to a final effect through many intermediate steps
example: Divya traced the causal chain from one forgotten phone charger to a missed alarm, a missed bus and a very tense meeting.

hindi: कारणात्मक बंदता — हर भौतिक घटना का पूरा भौतिक कारण होता है, यह सिद्धांत
definition: the principle that every physical event that has a cause has a complete physical cause, leaving no room for non-physical minds to push matter around
example: Their physics teacher invoked causal closure to deny that Jaya's wishful thinking had any role in the cricket ball clearing the boundary.

hindi: कारणगत संयोग — पूर्ववर्ती कारणों से निर्धारित कर्मों से जुड़ा नैतिक भाग्य
definition: the kind of moral luck arising because every choice follows from earlier causes that the person never chose, raising doubts about deserving praise or blame at all
example: Arguing over dinner, Ishaan blamed causal luck for his third dessert, claiming his genes and the menu had decided it long ago.

hindi: कारण-संबंध जाल — घटनाओं को जोड़ने वाले कारण और कार्य के संबंधों का ताना-बाना
definition: the connecting network of cause and effect relations that links events together, or the particular link that binds one cause to its effect
example: Somewhere in the causal nexus of family group chats lay the reason everyone suddenly believed turmeric cured everything.

hindi: कारणता बहुलवाद — यह मत कि कारणता की एक नहीं, अनेक भिन्न अवधारणाएँ हैं
definition: the view that there is no single relation of causation but several different kinds, such as production, dependence and regularity, each fitting different cases
example: Asked why the project slipped, the team lead adopted causal pluralism: the bug, the holiday and the vague brief all counted, differently.

hindi: कारण-शक्ति — किसी वस्तु की कुछ विशेष प्रभाव उत्पन्न करने की अंतर्निहित क्षमता
definition: a capacity built into a thing that enables it to produce certain effects, such as the power of salt to dissolve in water or of fire to burn paper
example: Anjali credited her mother's glare with real causal power, since it could stop a whole family argument mid-sentence.

hindi: कारण-यथार्थवाद — यह मत कि कारणता संसार में वस्तुतः विद्यमान एक वास्तविक संबंध है
definition: the view that causation is a real feature of the world, a genuine productive link between events, rather than just a pattern that our minds notice or impose
example: Sipping the scalding chai too fast, Mohit became a firm believer in causal realism: that burn was no mere pattern.

hindi: कारणिक भूमिका प्रकार्य — किसी अंश का पूरी प्रणाली की क्षमता में योगदान
