definition: the account on which a part's function is simply whatever contribution it makes to some capacity of the larger system containing it, regardless of evolutionary history
example: Judged by causal role function, the office printer's main contribution to the system was generating complaints.

hindi: क्रिया का कारणवादी सिद्धांत — इरादों द्वारा उत्पन्न व्यवहार को ही क्रिया मानने का मत
definition: the theory that a movement counts as an action when it is caused, through the proper route, by the person's beliefs, desires or intentions
example: By the causal theory of action, Kiran's wave counted as greeting, while his arm twitch during the meeting did not.

hindi: विषयवस्तु का कारणात्मक सिद्धांत — विचार को उसके कारणों से अर्थ मिलने का मत
definition: the view that a mental symbol means whatever reliably causes it to occur, so that a thought represents cows because cows are what typically trigger it
example: The causal theory of content hit trouble when Gauri's alarm for burglars kept being triggered by the neighbour's cat.

hindi: ज्ञान का कारणात्मक सिद्धांत — विश्वास का तथ्य से कारण-संबंध होना ज्ञान की शर्त मानने वाला मत
definition: the theory that you know a fact only when that fact itself properly causes your belief in it, through perception, memory or testimony
example: Smelling burnt toast from the hallway, Leela had a textbook instance of the causal theory of knowledge at work.

hindi: कारणात्मक प्रत्यक्ष-सिद्धांत — वस्तु द्वारा अनुभव उत्पन्न होने पर ही प्रत्यक्ष होने का मत
definition: the view that you perceive an object only if that object plays the right causal role in producing your sensory experience of it, so perceiving means being affected by the thing
example: Half dreaming, Karan invoked the causal theory of perception and argued he had truly heard his alarm only if its actual ringing, not his anxious dream, produced the sound in his head.

hindi: निर्देश का कारणात्मक सिद्धांत — यह मत कि नाम अपने प्रयोग की ऐतिहासिक कड़ी से वस्तु से जुड़ता है
definition: the view that a name refers to its object because of a historical chain of communication linking each speaker's usage back to an original naming of that object
example: None of the new hires had ever met the founder, but the causal theory of reference assured them that their office gossip still named the right man.

hindi: कारणात्मक कालसिद्धांत — कालिक क्रम को कारण-कार्य संबंधों से समझाने का मत
definition: the view that the order of events in time is fixed by causal relations, so that earlier simply means able to cause, and later means able to be caused
example: Sneha applied the causal theory of time to the office printer jam: whatever caused it must have come first, which meant her colleague.

hindi: कारण-यांत्रिक व्याख्या — घटना तक पहुँचाने वाली कारण-प्रक्रियाओं को दिखाकर व्याख्या
definition: an account of explanation, defended by Salmon, on which explaining an event means tracing the causal processes and interactions that actually produced it
example: Nisha's causal-mechanical explanation of the flooded bathroom traced every step from the forgotten tap to the downstairs ceiling.

hindi: कार्य-कारण भाव — एक घटना द्वारा दूसरी घटना को उत्पन्न करने का संबंध
definition: the relation between a pair of events in which the first brings about, produces or makes happen the second, which philosophers analyse through regularity, dependence or power
example: When the smoke alarm shrieked, the flatmates argued about causation: was it the burnt toast, or whoever mounted the alarm right above the toaster?

hindi: कारण-प्राथमिकीकरण — सीमित संसाधनों से सबसे अधिक भला करने हेतु समस्याओं की तुलना कर प्राथमिकता तय करना
definition: the practice of comparing world problems by their scale, neglect and solvability in order to decide where limited time and money will do the most good
example: The club's cause prioritization meeting lasted two hours and ended with everyone agreeing to fund the samosas first.

hindi: केंद्रीय-अवस्था भौतिकवाद — मानसिक अवस्थाओं को केंद्रीय तंत्रिका तंत्र की अवस्थाएँ मानने का मत
definition: the materialist view, associated with Australian philosophy, that mental states are identical with physical states of the central nervous system, especially the brain
example: During biology class, Tara summed up central-state materialism by tapping her forehead and announcing that her crush lived somewhere behind her eyebrows.

hindi: निश्चितता — संदेह की कोई गुंजाइश न होने की अवस्था
definition: the state of a belief that cannot possibly be mistaken, or of a person holding a belief with no room for doubt
example: Rehan announced with total certainty that the meeting was on Tuesday, then quietly deleted his message on Wednesday.

hindi: अन्य-स्थिरता नियम — ऐसा नियम जो केवल तब लागू होता है जब अन्य परिस्थितियाँ समान रहें
definition: a natural rule that holds only when other things are equal, meaning when no interfering factors are present, as with most laws in economics, biology and psychology
example: Raising prices lowers demand was a ceteris paribus law, Nikhil conceded, right up until the café sold the last croissant in town.

hindi: चरित्र और विषय — कापलान का भेद: सूचक शब्द का स्थिर नियम और प्रसंग में बनने वाला अर्थ
definition: Kaplan's distinction between the fixed rule an indexical carries, its character, and the particular object or proposition that rule yields in a given context, its content
example: Both brothers shouted 'I called shotgun', words with one character but two different contents, and the argument lasted the whole drive.

hindi: चरित्र-शिक्षा — विद्यार्थियों में ईमानदारी, साहस जैसे सद्गुणों को अभ्यास से विकसित करना
definition: an approach to moral education that aims to build virtues such as honesty, courage, kindness and self-control in children through habit, example and reflection
example: The school's character education week featured a kindness chart, a courage poster and one very tired teacher counting gold stars.

hindi: चरित्र-संदेहवाद — स्थायी सद्गुणों वाले चरित्र के अस्तित्व पर संदेह करने वाला मत
definition: the view that stable, broad character traits such as honesty or kindness are rare or absent, so ethics built around virtues rests on shaky psychology
example: Watching his honest friend fib about liking the haircut, Sid wondered whether character skepticism had a point.

hindi: सार्वभौमिक प्रतीक-भाषा — सभी विचारों को व्यक्त करने वाली लाइबनिज़ की परिकल्पित भाषा
definition: Leibniz's proposed universal symbolic language in which every concept would have a precise sign, so that reasoning could be written like mathematics
example: Watching his family communicate entirely in emojis, Yusuf wondered whether they had finally invented a characteristica universalis.

hindi: करिश्माई सत्ता — नेता के असाधारण व्यक्तित्व के प्रति आस्था पर टिकी सत्ता
definition: Weber's type of legitimate authority that rests on followers' devotion to a leader's exceptional personal qualities, rather than on rules or tradition
example: The drama club had no constitution, only Zoya's charismatic authority, and everyone happily rehearsed until midnight.

hindi: चार्वाक — केवल प्रत्यक्ष को प्रमाण मानने वाला भारतीय भौतिकवादी दर्शन
definition: the ancient Indian materialist school holding that only perception gives knowledge, that the self ends with the body, and that there is no afterlife or rebirth
example: After the tarot reading at the party, Nikhil took the Charvaka line and said he would believe in the future once he could see it as plainly as the snacks on the table.

hindi: शैटन का प्रति-उस्तरा — जहाँ सरल व्याख्या अपर्याप्त हो वहाँ और तत्व जोड़ने का नियम
definition: the principle that when a simpler explanation fails to account for the facts, you should bring in further entities or assumptions until it does
example: Faced with a leak that no single pipe explained, the plumber followed Chatton's anti-razor and checked the roof as well.

hindi: चतुर्वर्ग — धर्म, अर्थ, काम और मोक्ष, जीवन के चार लक्ष्य
definition: the four aims of human life in Hindu thought, adding moksha (liberation) to the three worldly aims of dharma, artha and kama
example: In ethics class the teacher drew the chaturvarga as four boxes, and someone asked which one covered sleeping until noon.

hindi: व्यत्यास — स्पर्श करने वाले और स्पर्शित होने वाले शरीर का परस्पर गुँथना
definition: Merleau-Ponty's term for the crossing and intertwining of perceiver and perceived, as when your hand touching your other hand is both touching and touched
example: Clasping her cold hands on the bus stop, Riya felt the chiasm: each hand both warming and being warmed.

hindi: कुएँ के पास बालक — मनुष्य की सहज करुणा पर मेंग्ज़ी का दृष्टांत
definition: Mencius's thought experiment of anyone suddenly seeing a toddler about to fall into a well, used to argue that every human being has an inborn feeling of compassion
example: Watching strangers sprint to catch a toddler's runaway balloon, Meera told her friend the child at the well was alive and well in the park.

hindi: बाल-केंद्रित शिक्षा — बच्चे की रुचि, गति और स्वभाव को शिक्षा का केंद्र मानना
definition: an approach that builds teaching around the child's interests, pace and natural development, rather than around a fixed syllabus imposed from outside
example: Child-centred education let Aarav spend the morning on dinosaurs, which somehow taught him fractions, maps and the spelling of Cretaceous.

hindi: चीनी मस्तिष्क — पूरे राष्ट्र द्वारा मस्तिष्क की नकल करने वाला विचार-प्रयोग
definition: Ned Block's thought experiment imagining the population of China each acting as one neuron to simulate a brain, meant to question whether such a system would have experiences
example: The school assembly, with each student passing notes to three others, looked to Nisha like a small, noisy China brain that still had no opinion on lunch.

hindi: चीनी कक्ष — नियम-पालन से समझ न पैदा होने को दिखाने वाला विचार-प्रयोग
definition: John Searle's thought experiment in which a person who cannot understand Chinese follows a rulebook to produce fluent Chinese replies, meant to show that running a program is not enough for real understanding
example: After copying her friend's chemistry answers without following a word, Ishita admitted she had basically been a Chinese room with a pencil.

hindi: चिज़ोम विरोधाभास — कर्तव्य टूटने पर लागू होने वाले दायित्वों की पहेली
definition: a puzzle in deontic logic about contrary-to-duty obligations, the duties that apply only once another obligation has already been broken, which standard systems cannot express consistently
example: Chisholm's paradox came up at dinner: Nisha ought to visit her aunt, and ought to phone ahead if visiting, yet ought not phone if she skips the visit.

hindi: चित्त — मन, बुद्धि और अहंकार से बना समग्र अंतःकरण
definition: in Yoga philosophy, the whole field of mind, including thought, memory and feeling, whose restless fluctuations Yoga seeks to calm and still
example: During the silent exam hall, Kabir's chitta was busy replaying an awkward conversation from three years ago.

hindi: चयन-अनुक्रम — ब्राउवर की धारणा में स्वतंत्र चुनावों से क़दम-दर-क़दम बढ़ता अपूर्ण अनुक्रम
definition: Brouwer's idea of an endless sequence of numbers generated step by step through free choices, never completed and never fixed in advance by any rule, central to his intuitionist mathematics
example: Deciding at each station whether to stay on the train, Kunal treated his commute as a choice sequence with no timetable at all.

hindi: ईसाई अस्तित्ववाद — आस्था और व्यक्तिगत अस्तित्व को जोड़ने वाला अस्तित्ववाद
definition: a strand of existentialism, rooted in Kierkegaard, holding that the individual's anxious, free existence finds meaning through personal faith in the Christian understanding of the divine
example: In the class debate, Joseph argued that Christian existentialism takes both freedom and faith seriously, then lost the vote to the snack break.

hindi: चर्च-ट्यूरिंग सिद्धांत — जो भी यांत्रिक रूप से गणनीय है, उसे ट्यूरिंग मशीन गिन सकती है
definition: the thesis that any calculation which can be carried out by following a mechanical step-by-step procedure can also be performed by a Turing machine
example: In computing class, Diya used the Church–Turing thesis to argue her ancient laptop could, in principle, run anything, given enough patience.

hindi: चक्रक दोष — निष्कर्ष को ही अपने प्रमाण के रूप में घुमा देने वाला तर्क
definition: reasoning that treats its own conclusion as one of its premises, the starting claims, so the argument travels in a circle and never gives independent support
example: The group chat collapsed into circular reasoning: the show was popular because everyone watched it, and everyone watched it because it was popular.

hindi: अन्योन्याश्रय दोष — दो दावों का एक-दूसरे को ही प्रमाण बनाना
definition: a circular proof in which two or more claims support each other in turn, so the whole chain assumes the conclusion it claims to prove
example: The landlord's circulus in probando was neat: the rent is fair because the flat is premium, and the flat is premium because the rent is high.

hindi: न्याय की परिस्थितियाँ — सीमित संसाधन और परस्पर भिन्न स्वार्थ, जिनके कारण न्याय की आवश्यकता पड़ती है
definition: the background conditions, chiefly moderate scarcity and conflicting interests, that make questions of justice arise at all, as described by Hume and Rawls
example: One bathroom, five flatmates and a nine o'clock start: the circumstances of justice were painfully present every weekday morning.

hindi: परिस्थितिजन्य व्यक्तिदोष — वक्ता के स्वार्थ या हालात के कारण उसका तर्क ठुकराना
definition: the fallacy of dismissing an argument because of the speaker's personal circumstances or interests, rather than examining whether the reasoning itself is sound
example: You only want a longer lunch break because you are hungry, said the supervisor, missing that circumstantial ad hominem never answers the actual proposal.

hindi: परिस्थितिगत संयोग — जिन परिस्थितियों में कोई फँसता है, उनसे जुड़ा नैतिक भाग्य
definition: the kind of moral luck in which chance decides which situations and temptations a person happens to face, and therefore which moral tests they pass or fail
example: Nisha never cheated on an exam, though she admits circumstantial luck helped: no teacher ever left the answer sheet on her desk.

hindi: चित्तमात्र — सब कुछ केवल चित्त होने का मत
definition: the Buddhist doctrine of mind-only, the view linked with Yogacara that experienced objects exist only as appearances within consciousness, not as independent outer things
example: Lost in a video game for hours, Yash decided cittamatra was simply accurate.

hindi: नागरिक शिक्षा — लोकतांत्रिक जीवन के लिए आवश्यक ज्ञान, गुण और कौशल सिखाना
definition: the teaching of the knowledge, skills and virtues citizens need to take part in democratic life, such as debate, tolerance and understanding of rights
example: The mock council over the broken playground swing gave the whole class more civic education than a term of textbook chapters.

hindi: नागरिक मानववाद — सक्रिय नागरिक जीवन को मानवीय श्रेष्ठता का मार्ग मानने वाली परंपरा
definition: the Renaissance tradition holding that people flourish best through active participation in public life and service to their city or republic
example: Sarthak's civic humanism made him the only student who read the municipal notices and then showed up to argue about them.

hindi: नागरिक सद्गुण — सार्वजनिक हित के लिए सक्रिय, ईमानदार भागीदारी की नागरिक भावना
definition: the qualities of a good citizen, such as honesty, public spirit and active participation, that a free community needs to survive
example: Picking up litter after the neighbourhood cricket match, Aditya declared it an exercise in civic virtue, then demanded applause.

hindi: सविनय अवज्ञा — अन्यायपूर्ण कानून का खुले, अहिंसक ढंग से जानबूझकर उल्लंघन
definition: the deliberate, public and nonviolent breaking of a legal rule seen as unjust, done openly and with acceptance of punishment in order to change that unjust rule
example: The students' civil disobedience against the uniform rule consisted of wearing odd socks and politely accepting their warnings.

hindi: नागरिक समाज — राज्य और परिवार के बीच लोगों के स्वैच्छिक संगठन और संबंध
definition: the sphere of voluntary groups, clubs, charities and associations that people form outside both the family and the state's direct control
example: The neighbourhood cleanup, the chess club and the temple kitchen together showed how much civil society happens without a government memo.

hindi: दावा-अधिकार — वह अधिकार जिसके सामने किसी दूसरे पर तदनुरूप कर्तव्य होता है
definition: Hohfeld's term for a right that places a matching duty on someone else, as when a lender's right to repayment binds the borrower to repay
example: Having lent Zara five hundred rupees, Om held a clear claim right, and reminded her of it in the group chat every morning.

hindi: वर्ग चेतना — किसी वर्ग का अपने साझा हितों और ऐतिहासिक भूमिका के प्रति जागरूक होना
definition: the awareness among members of a social class, especially workers, that they share common interests and a common position against another class
example: Class consciousness arrived in the delivery riders' group chat the moment everyone compared their per-order rates and found them all cut.

hindi: वर्ग-संघर्ष — विरोधी हितों वाले सामाजिक वर्गों के बीच निरंतर टकराव
definition: the Marxist view that history is shaped by ongoing conflict between social classes with opposed economic interests, such as owners and workers
example: The class struggle in their building flared up whenever the landlord raised maintenance charges and the tenants raised their voices.

hindi: शास्त्रीय आधारवाद — मूल विश्वासों को पूर्णतः निश्चित और अचूक मानने वाला आधारवाद
definition: the strict form of foundationalism holding that basic beliefs must be completely certain, such as beliefs about your present experience or obvious truths of reason
example: Kavya's classical foundationalism stalled her grocery list, since she could only be certain she seemed to want mangoes.

hindi: शास्त्रीय उदारवाद — मुक्त बाज़ार और सीमित शासन पर बल देने वाला पुराना उदारवाद
definition: the older form of liberalism that defends individual liberty, private property, free markets and a strictly limited government
example: Nikhil's classical liberalism showed at the canteen: he wanted the school to stop setting samosa prices and let the market decide.

hindi: शास्त्रीय ईश्वरवाद — ईश्वर को सर्वशक्तिमान, सर्वज्ञ, निरवयव और अपरिवर्तनीय मानने वाली परंपरा
definition: the traditional view that one deity exists who is all-powerful, all-knowing, perfectly good, timeless, unchanging and simple, meaning without parts
example: Kabir's philosophy study group spent the whole commute arguing whether the deity of classical theism could ever change its mind, unlike the train timetable.

hindi: शास्त्रीय उपयोगितावाद — सबके सुख के कुल योग को अधिकतम करने वाला बेंथम-मिल का मूल मत
definition: the original utilitarianism of Bentham, Mill and Sidgwick, holding that right actions maximize the total pleasure minus pain of everyone affected, with each person counting equally
example: Dad's classical utilitarianism decided the holiday: everyone's pleasure counted equally, so the beach beat his museum by a landslide.

hindi: स्पष्ट और सुभिन्न बोध — देकार्त का मानदंड कि जो ऐसा समझा जाए वह सत्य है
definition: Descartes' standard for knowledge: whatever the mind grasps so plainly and sharply that doubt becomes impossible must be true
example: Juhi said her clear and distinct perception confirmed the parcel had arrived, mostly because the doorbell was still ringing.

hindi: क्लिफ़र्ड का सिद्धांत — अपर्याप्त प्रमाण पर विश्वास करना सदा अनुचित होने का मत
definition: the view that it is always morally wrong for anyone to believe anything on insufficient evidence, making belief itself a matter of ethics
example: Quoting Clifford's principle, Neha refused to forward the miracle-cure message until someone showed her an actual study.

hindi: जलवायु-नीतिशास्त्र — जलवायु परिवर्तन से जुड़े दायित्व, दोष और न्याय के प्रश्नों का अध्ययन
definition: the study of the moral questions raised by climate change, such as who is responsible for emissions, who should bear the costs and what is owed to vulnerable nations
example: The climate ethics lecture got personal when the professor asked how many students had flown home for the long weekend.

hindi: विचलन — परमाणुओं का अकारण हल्का-सा मुड़ना
definition: the Latin name for the tiny, unpredictable sideways swerve of falling atoms in Epicurean physics, used to explain collisions and free choice
example: When her usually punctual colleague arrived late for no reason, Tara blamed a clinamen in his morning routine.

hindi: चिकित्सकीय संतुलन — जब विशेषज्ञ यह तय न कर सकें कि कौन-सा उपचार श्रेष्ठ है
definition: the condition, required before ethically running a clinical trial, of genuine uncertainty among medical experts about which treatment being compared is better
example: The two chemistry teachers reached clinical equipoise over whether ginger tea or honey cures a sore throat, so they planned a trial.

hindi: संकीर्णचित्तता — विरोधी विचारों पर विचार करने से इनकार का दोष
definition: the intellectual vice of refusing to consider views that conflict with your own, dismissing contrary evidence without examining it fairly
example: His closed-mindedness was so complete that he muted the group chat the moment anyone mentioned a different route to the stadium.

hindi: निकटता समस्या — इरादे और पूर्वानुमित परिणाम में भेद करने की कठिनाई, जब दोनों बहुत पास हों
definition: the difficulty, for the doctrine of double effect, of separating an intended harm from a merely foreseen harm when both are very closely linked
example: Claiming he intended only to borrow the cake, not eat it, Samar ran into the closeness problem with his sister.

hindi: निकटतम उत्तरवर्ती सिद्धांत — भविष्य के उस व्यक्ति को मूल मानने का मत जो मूल से सबसे अधिक मेल खाता हो
definition: Nozick's view that a later person is the same as an earlier person when they are the closest continuer, meaning they continue the original more closely than any rival candidate does
example: When three branches of the old tea stall claimed the original name, Kavya applied the closest continuer theory and picked the one with the same grumpy owner.

hindi: संवरण सिद्धांत — ज्ञात बात से निकलने वाला निष्कर्ष भी ज्ञात
definition: the principle that if you know something, and know it logically implies another claim, then you also know that other claim, a premise sceptical arguments exploit
example: Ritwik used the closure principle to reason that if he knew he was sitting in class, he must also know he was not a dreaming brain in a vat, and that second part kept him awake.

hindi: अज्ञान-समस्या — यह आपत्ति कि कर्मों के दूरगामी परिणाम इतने अज्ञात हैं कि परिणामवाद निर्णय नहीं दे सकता
definition: the worry that the long-term consequences of our actions are so unpredictable that consequentialism cannot actually tell anyone which action is best
example: Trying to decide whether to take the bus or the train, Manav slid into cluelessness about how either choice might change history.

hindi: गुच्छ कला-सिद्धांत — कई लक्षणों में से पर्याप्त लक्षण होने पर किसी वस्तु को कलाकृति मानने का मत
definition: the view that no single feature defines artworks, and that something counts as one when it shares enough features from a list such as beauty, skill, expression and originality
example: Under the cluster theory of art, Leela's latte decoration ticked skill, beauty and expression, which she felt was plenty for a Tuesday.

hindi: गुच्छ-सिद्धांत — यह मत कि नाम का निर्देश वर्णनों के एक समूह से तय होता है
definition: the view that a proper name refers to whatever object satisfies enough of a loose bundle of descriptions that speakers associate with that name
example: By the cluster theory of names, 'Uncle Ravi' picks out whoever tells long stories, burns toast and forgets birthdays, which narrows it down considerably.

hindi: प्रबलता — आगमनात्मक तर्क का वह गुण जिसमें वह मज़बूत हो और आधार सत्य हों
definition: the property of an inductive argument that is strong, meaning its premises make the conclusion probable, and whose premises are also actually true
example: The class praised the cogency of Aman's case that the canteen samosas would sell out, backed by a month of empty trays.

hindi: मैं सोचता हूँ, अतः मैं हूँ — संदेह करने वाले के अस्तित्व की निश्चितता
definition: Descartes's conclusion that the very activity of thinking, even doubting, proves with certainty that the thinker exists
example: Groggy before her first coffee, Mansi muttered cogito ergo sum just to reassure herself that she was technically present.

hindi: संज्ञानात्मक भेद्यता — विश्वासों और अपेक्षाओं द्वारा प्रत्यक्ष के प्रभावित होने की संभावना
definition: the possibility that your beliefs, expectations or desires can change what you actually perceive, rather than only changing how you interpret perception afterwards
example: Convinced the new manager disliked her, Sneha worried about cognitive penetrability when every neutral email started looking visibly frosty.

hindi: संज्ञानात्मक अनुभूति-स्वरूप — विचारने और समझने का भी अपना अलग अनुभव-गुण होता है, यह मत
definition: the view that thinking, understanding and believing have their distinctive felt character, just as seeing colours or hearing sounds does
example: When the maths problem finally clicked on the train home, Zoya said the sudden feeling of understanding was cognitive phenomenology at its best.

hindi: संज्ञानात्मक सार्थकता — किसी कथन का सत्य या असत्य हो सकने योग्य अर्थ
definition: the property logical positivists sought to define: having genuine factual meaning that could be true or false, as opposed to merely expressing feelings or attitudes
example: Kabir's sister asked whether 'Mondays are evil' had any cognitive significance or simply expressed how everyone in the office felt about Mondays.

hindi: संज्ञानात्मक भाव-सिद्धांत — भावों को मूलतः निर्णय या मूल्यांकन मानने वाला मत
definition: the view that emotions are chiefly judgements or evaluative beliefs, so that fearing something largely means judging it dangerous
example: Priya's faith in the cognitive theory of emotion wobbled when she stayed terrified of a spider she fully believed was harmless.

hindi: संज्ञानवाद — नैतिक कथनों को सत्य या असत्य हो सकने वाली मान्यताएँ मानने का मत
definition: in ethics, the view that moral statements express beliefs that describe the world and can therefore be true or false
example: Anil's cognitivism showed when he treated 'littering is wrong' exactly like 'the train is late': a claim that could be checked and found true.

hindi: संगतिवाद — विश्वास का औचित्य अन्य विश्वासों से उसकी संगति में मानने का मत
definition: the view that a belief is justified when it fits together consistently with the whole network of your other beliefs, rather than resting on any single base
example: Defending her alibi to her flatmates, Riya relied on coherentism: every detail of her story supported every other detail.

hindi: विलय आपत्ति — यह आपत्ति कि नियम-उपयोगितावाद अपवाद जोड़ते-जोड़ते कर्म-उपयोगितावाद बन जाता है
definition: the objection that rule utilitarianism, once it adds exceptions whenever breaking a rule produces more happiness, becomes identical to act utilitarianism
example: The club's 'no phones' policy grew so many exceptions that Rhea declared the collapse objection proven by the second meeting.

hindi: सामूहिक अभिप्रायता — अनेक लोगों का मिलकर एक साझा इरादा रखना
definition: the capacity of several people to share an intention or belief together, such as planning a party jointly, rather than merely holding matching private plans
example: Four flatmates silently deciding to ignore the dishes showed impressive collective intentionality, Lakshmi thought.

hindi: समष्टिवाद — समूह के हितों और लक्ष्यों को व्यक्ति से ऊपर रखने की प्रवृत्ति
definition: the outlook that gives the goals and interests of the group, nation or community priority over those of any single individual
example: The group project turned into collectivism overnight when the team decided everyone's weekend belonged to the presentation.

hindi: कॉलिंगरिज दुविधा — नई तकनीक को आरंभ में नियंत्रित करना आसान पर प्रभाव अज्ञात, बाद में प्रभाव ज्ञात पर नियंत्रण कठिन
definition: the dilemma that an emerging technology is easy to regulate early, when its effects are unknown, but hard to regulate later, once its effects are clear and entrenched
example: The school realised its phone policy faced the Collingridge dilemma the moment every student already owned one.

hindi: जीवन-जगत का उपनिवेशन — बाज़ार और नौकरशाही तर्क का रोज़मर्रा के संबंधों पर हावी होना
definition: Habermas's thesis that the logic of money and bureaucracy increasingly invades everyday life, replacing shared understanding with calculation and rules
example: When her friends started splitting birthday gifts by spreadsheet with late fees, Anjali saw the colonization of the lifeworld.

hindi: रंग-निरपेक्षता — नस्ल की अनदेखी को ही समानता मानने का मत
definition: the view that justice is achieved by ignoring race entirely, criticized by some thinkers for overlooking persistent racial inequality
example: When the principal claimed 'we don't notice race here', the parents' group chat erupted over whether colorblindness solved anything.

hindi: संयोजन समस्या — छोटे-छोटे चेतन अंश मिलकर एक एकीकृत मन कैसे बनाते हैं, यह प्रश्न
definition: the challenge for panpsychism, the view that all matter has some tiny spark of experience, of explaining how countless such sparks could combine into one unified mind
example: Watching five friends fail to agree on a restaurant, Zoya said the combination problem was clearly real for group chats too.

hindi: संयुक्त क्रम-श्रेणी — पारफ़िट का विचार-प्रयोग जिसमें शरीर और मन धीरे-धीरे किसी और के बनते जाते हैं
definition: Parfit's thought experiment imagining a long series of cases in which ever larger portions of someone's brain cells and memories are replaced by another person's, showing there may be no sharp line where identity ends
example: Renovating the flat one room at a time, Sameer feared he was living through a combined spectrum and would end up in his landlord's apartment.

hindi: आदेश-सिद्धांत — क़ानून संप्रभु का दंड की धमकी से समर्थित आदेश है
definition: the view, associated with Bentham and Austin, that laws are general commands issued by a sovereign ruler whom people habitually obey and backed by threats of punishment
example: Aarav's younger brother held a crude command theory of law: a household rule was real only if Mum had threatened to confiscate the console over it.

hindi: प्रतिबद्धक कथन — वक्ता को भविष्य के किसी कार्य से बाँधने वाली वाक्-क्रिया
definition: in speech act theory, an utterance that commits the speaker to some future action, such as promising, vowing, offering or threatening
example: Saying "I'll handle the slides" in the meeting was a commissive, and now Nikhil owns forty slides.

hindi: पण्यीकरण — किसी सेवा, संबंध या गुण को बाज़ार में बिकने वाला माल बना देना
definition: the process of turning something not originally meant for sale, such as care, friendship or attention, into a commodity that is bought and sold on a market
example: When the fitness app began charging for walking reminders, Aarav declared the final commodification of simply going outside.

hindi: पण्य-वस्तु पूजा — वस्तुओं के मूल्य को उनमें निहित गुण मानकर उनके पीछे के मानवीय श्रम को भूल जाना
definition: the Marxist idea that in a market economy people treat the value of goods as a natural property of things, forgetting the human labour and social relations behind them
example: Staring at the new phone launch, Dev admitted his commodity fetishism: he worshipped the shiny glass and never once thought about the factory workers.

hindi: सामान्य-बुद्धि यथार्थवाद — रीड का मत कि सहज विश्वास बाहरी जगत का सीधा ज्ञान देते हैं
definition: the view, developed by Thomas Reid, that everyday beliefs about the external world and other minds are trustworthy starting points needing proof from nobody
example: Asked whether the chair really existed, Gauri simply sat on it, which her tutor accepted as a working demonstration of common sense realism.

hindi: साधारण संवेद्य — अनेक इंद्रियों द्वारा ग्रहण होने वाले गुण, जैसे आकार और गति
definition: in Aristotle's theory, qualities such as shape, size, motion and number that can be perceived by more than one sense, both sight and touch for example
example: Blindfolded in the party game, Sana identified the dice by feel alone, proving that shape really is one of the common sensibles.

hindi: संवादात्मक क्रिया — परस्पर समझ और तर्कसंगत सहमति की ओर उन्मुख मानवीय व्यवहार
definition: Habermas's term for action aimed at reaching mutual understanding and agreement through reasoned discussion, rather than at manipulating others for success
example: The flatmates' calm negotiation over the thermostat was communicative action, until someone quietly changed the setting at midnight.

hindi: साम्यवाद — निजी संपत्ति और वर्गों से रहित समाज का सिद्धांत और आंदोलन
definition: the political doctrine aiming at a classless society in which all property is owned in common and goods are shared according to need
example: Varun joked that the family Netflix password was pure communism: collective ownership, and the account holder had lost all control.

hindi: समुदायवाद — व्यक्ति की पहचान और मूल्यों को समुदाय से बना मानने वाला मत
definition: the view that people are shaped by the communities they belong to, so shared traditions and the common good matter as much as individual rights
example: Meenal's communitarianism surfaced when she argued the colony festival should outrank anyone's private plans for the weekend.

hindi: अन्वेषक समुदाय — मिलकर जाँच और सुधार करने वाला समूह
definition: the idea, from Peirce and Dewey, that knowledge grows through a group of investigators who share evidence, criticise each other and correct mistakes together over time
example: Their study group became a real community of inquiry once everyone started checking each other's physics answers instead of copying.

hindi: विनिमयात्मक न्याय — लेन-देन और आदान-प्रदान में बराबरी और ईमानदारी
definition: the justice that governs exchanges between individuals, requiring that what each party gives and receives in a trade be of equal value
example: Swapping a rare cricket card for a half-eaten sandwich, Aarav learned the hard way what commutative justice forbids.

hindi: सहदोषी तर्क — नैतिक तथ्यों पर आपत्तियाँ अन्य स्वीकृत तथ्यों पर भी लागू होने से उन्हें दुर्बल बताने का तर्क
definition: the realist reply that objections against moral facts would equally rule out other accepted facts about what people should do or believe, such as reasons to trust evidence
example: Using the companions in guilt argument, Irfan told his skeptical classmate that if moral reasons were too strange to exist, so was his reason to trust the evidence.

hindi: संगतिवाद — स्वतंत्र इच्छा और नियतिवाद को एक-दूसरे से मेल खाने वाला मानने का मत
definition: the view that free will and determinism can both be true, because choosing freely means acting from your desires without outside force, even if those desires were caused
example: When her brother said his cravings were caused by chemistry, Neha argued compatibilism: he still chose the third biryani, and he still washes the plate.

hindi: मिश्र प्रत्यय — सरल प्रत्ययों को जोड़कर मन द्वारा बनाए गए विचार
definition: in Locke's theory, ideas the mind builds by combining, comparing or abstracting simple ideas, such as unicorn, justice or university
example: Vikram's plan for a 'productive weekend' was one of those complex ideas assembled from coffee, lists and pure optimism.

hindi: संघटनात्मकता — यह सिद्धांत कि पूरे वाक्य का अर्थ उसके अंशों के अर्थ और उनकी रचना से बनता है
definition: the principle that the meaning of a complex phrase or sentence is fixed by the meanings of its parts together with the grammatical structure combining them
example: Compositionality explains why Ishaan understood 'the purple giraffe ate my homework' instantly, even though nobody had ever produced that sentence before.

hindi: सहसंभाव्यता — कई संभावनाओं का एक ही जगत में साथ-साथ हो सकना
definition: Leibniz's term for the ability of several possible things or events to exist together in one and the same world without contradicting each other
example: Planning her Saturday, Mahi discovered that sleeping till noon and a morning yoga class lacked compossibility.

hindi: सह-उपस्थिति — गुण-पुंज सिद्धांत में गुणों को एक वस्तु के रूप में बाँधने वाला संबंध
definition: in bundle theory, the relation of being together at the same place and time, which binds separate qualities into one single object
example: Ravi claimed his sandwich was held together by compresence, because the bread, cheese and pickle had nowhere else to be.

hindi: मन का संगणनात्मक सिद्धांत — सोच को प्रतीकों पर नियमबद्ध गणन मानने का मत
definition: the view that thinking is a kind of computation, in which the mind manipulates internal symbols according to rules, much as a computer processes code
example: Solving the Sudoku on the train, Zoya felt the computational theory of mind was vindicated: her brain was plainly running a slow, buggy algorithm.

hindi: स्वसंरक्षण-प्रयास — प्रत्येक वस्तु की अपने अस्तित्व में बने रहने की भीतरी चेष्टा
definition: in Spinoza's philosophy, the inner striving by which every thing tries to continue existing and to increase its power of acting
example: The houseplant everyone forgot kept pushing out leaves toward the window, a quiet lesson in conatus on the office shelf.

hindi: कल्पनीयता तर्क — जो कल्पनीय है उसे संभव मानकर निष्कर्ष निकालने वाला तर्क
definition: any argument reasoning from the premise that a situation can be coherently imagined to the conclusion that the situation is genuinely possible
example: Mira ran a conceivability argument over dinner: she could picture the dishes washing themselves, so surely it was possible nobody had to do them.

hindi: प्रत्यय-अंतर्निहितता — विधेय का प्रत्यय पहले से उद्देश्य के प्रत्यय में निहित होना
definition: Kant's test for analytic judgments, those true by meaning alone: the idea expressed by the predicate is already contained inside the idea expressed by the subject
example: By concept containment, Tara explained, 'a pilot flies aircraft' tells you nothing the word pilot had not already packed.

hindi: प्रत्यय-अनुभववाद — सारी अवधारणाएँ अनुभव से ही उपजती हैं, यह मत
definition: the view that every concept the mind possesses is derived from sensory experience, denying that any inborn ideas are present from birth
example: Watching his toddler learn 'hot' only after touching the kettle, Farhan decided concept empiricism was at least true in his kitchen.

hindi: अवधारणात्मक विश्लेषण — किसी अवधारणा को उसके आवश्यक और पर्याप्त अंगों में तोड़कर स्पष्ट करना
definition: the method of clarifying a concept by breaking it down into the conditions something must meet to fall under it, such as asking exactly what makes a belief count as knowledge
example: A bout of conceptual analysis in the office kitchen tried to settle what makes a lunch a 'working lunch', and ended with everyone just eating.

hindi: वैचारिक विउपनिवेशीकरण — औपनिवेशिक भाषाओं से आई अवधारणाओं की अपनी भाषा में आलोचनात्मक जाँच
definition: Kwasi Wiredu's programme of critically examining philosophical concepts inherited through colonial languages, testing whether they still make sense when translated into an African language
example: Finding no Akan word for his essay's key term, Yaw realised conceptual decolonization was not optional homework after all.

hindi: प्रत्ययात्मक भूमिका अर्थविज्ञान — किसी धारणा का अर्थ उसकी अनुमान-भूमिका से तय करने का मत
definition: the view that the meaning of a concept or word is fixed by its role in thinking and reasoning, meaning which conclusions it lets a person draw and how it connects with other concepts
example: Arguing about the word salad, Harsh used conceptual role semantics: if you can infer lettuce from it, fruit salad is a fraud.

hindi: संकल्पनावाद — सामान्य शब्दों को मन की संकल्पनाओं से जुड़ा मानने का मत
definition: the view that a general word like 'chair' fits many different objects because the mind forms a concept linking them, rather than because some shared 'chairness' exists outside minds
example: Debating whether a beanbag counts as a chair, the class drifted into conceptualism: maybe 'chair' just lives in our heads.

hindi: सामंजस्यवाद — समकक्ष से असहमति पर अपना विश्वास ढीला करने का मत
definition: the view that when you discover that an epistemic peer, someone equally informed and equally capable, disagrees with you, you should reduce your confidence and move your belief closer toward theirs
example: Practising conciliationism, the two friends each lowered their confidence about the film's release date and finally checked the website.

hindi: निष्कर्ष — वह कथन जिसे तर्क अपने आधार-वाक्यों के बल पर स्थापित करना चाहता है
definition: the statement that an argument tries to establish, which is claimed to follow from or be supported by the premises offered for it
example: Ananya asked her group to state the conclusion first, because nobody could judge the premises without knowing where the argument was heading.

hindi: सहचारी परिवर्तन — दो चीज़ों के साथ-साथ बदलने से कारण-संबंध का अनुमान लगाने की मिल की विधि
definition: Mill's method of inferring a causal link when one thing changes in step with another, rising or falling whenever the other does
example: Noticing his mood dropped every time the phone battery did, Anil suspected concomitant variation, not coincidence.

hindi: सहकारितावाद — यह मत कि प्रत्येक प्राकृतिक प्रभाव ईश्वर और सृष्ट वस्तुएँ मिलकर उत्पन्न करते हैं
definition: the view, held by Aquinas and many medieval thinkers, that every natural effect is produced jointly by created things and by the deity working together with them
example: Grandma's concurrentism covered the garden perfectly: the tomatoes grew by sunshine, compost and blessings, all working together.

hindi: स्वतंत्र होने को अभिशप्त — मनुष्य चुनाव से बच नहीं सकता, न चुनना भी एक चुनाव है
definition: the existentialist claim that humans cannot escape freedom, because even refusing to choose is itself a choice for which they remain responsible
example: Unable to pick a movie for an hour, the friends learned they were condemned to be free, and also to watch nothing.

hindi: सोपाधिक उपपत्ति — किसी शर्त को अस्थायी रूप से मानकर 'यदि-तो' कथन सिद्ध करने की विधि
definition: a method of proving a conditional, or if-then, statement by temporarily assuming its condition and then deriving its result from that assumption through valid steps
example: Using conditional proof, Siddharth assumed the exam was on Monday and showed he would need the whole weekend to study.

hindi: सशर्त अद्यतन — नया प्रमाण मिलने पर विश्वासों को बेज़ नियम के अनुसार बदलना
definition: the Bayesian rule for updating beliefs: after learning some evidence, your fresh degree of belief in a hypothesis should equal your earlier probability for it given that evidence
example: Hearing thunder, Varun applied conditionalization and raised his confidence that the cricket match would be cancelled.

hindi: कॉन्डोर्से विरोधाभास — व्यक्तिगत रूप से सुसंगत पसंदों से सामूहिक चक्रीय पसंद उत्पन्न होना
definition: the situation in which a group's majority preferences form a cycle, preferring A over B, B over C, and C over A, though each voter is consistent
example: The family's pizza, burgers and noodles vote produced a perfect Condorcet paradox, so dinner was cereal.

hindi: पुष्टि-समग्रतावाद — यह मत कि प्रमाण पूरे सिद्धांत-तंत्र की पुष्टि करता है, अलग कथनों की नहीं
definition: the view that evidence confirms or disconfirms whole networks of beliefs together, rather than individual statements taken separately
example: Confronted with a failed batch of cookies, Om embraced confirmation holism and refused to blame any single ingredient.

hindi: पुष्टि-सिद्धांत — प्रमाण और परिकल्पना के समर्थन-संबंध का व्यवस्थित अध्ययन
definition: the branch of philosophy of science that studies when and how strongly evidence supports a hypothesis, including Hempel's, Carnap's and Bayesian approaches
example: Aditya's confirmation theory homework asked whether his lucky socks were really supported by three straight exam passes.

hindi: कन्फ्यूशियसवाद — सद्गुण, संस्कार और पारिवारिक कर्तव्य पर आधारित चीनी दर्शन
definition: the Chinese tradition of ethical and social thought that stresses humaneness, ritual propriety, family duty, learning and virtuous government
example: Her grandmother's rule of greeting every elder first, Leela realised, was household Confucianism.

hindi: अनुमानित इतिहास — अभिलेखों के अभाव में मानव-समाज के विकास की तर्कसंगत पुनर्रचना
definition: a method of the Scottish Enlightenment reconstructing how societies probably developed, using reasoning about human nature where written records are missing
example: Unable to recall how the office coffee fund began, Maya offered a conjectural history involving a broken kettle and one generous intern.

hindi: संयोजन — दो कथनों को 'और' से जोड़ने वाला कथन, जो तभी सत्य है जब दोनों सत्य हों
definition: a compound statement formed by linking a pair of statements with the word 'and', which counts as true only when both linked parts are true
example: The job ad demanded the conjunction 'five years of experience and under twenty-five', which Neha pointed out no living candidate could satisfy.

hindi: संयोजक सामान्य रूप — ऐसा सूत्र जो वियोजनों का संयोजन हो
definition: a standard format for writing a formula as a conjunction ('and'-joined list) of clauses, where each clause is a disjunction ('or'-joined list) of simple statements or their denials
example: Rewritten in conjunctive normal form, the office dress code became a list of 'this or that' clauses, every single one of which Karan somehow violated.

hindi: संयोजनवाद — मन को सरल इकाइयों के परस्पर जुड़े जाल से समझाने का मत
definition: the approach that models the mind as a network of many simple interconnected units whose connection strengths change with experience, rather than as rules applied to symbols
example: Connectionism, Riya explained, is why her playlist app learned her taste without anyone writing a rule that says she loves sad songs on rainy Tuesdays.

hindi: संयोजी विश्लेषण — अवधारणाओं को तोड़ने के बजाय उनके परस्पर संबंधों का मानचित्र बनाना
definition: Strawson's approach to analysis, which maps how basic concepts connect with and depend on one another instead of breaking them down into simpler parts
example: Rather than defining 'trust' outright, the team's workshop did a kind of connective analysis, tracing how it linked to honesty, reliability and shared deadlines.

hindi: अंतरात्मा — सही-गलत का बोध कराने वाली भीतरी आवाज़
definition: the inner sense of right and wrong that judges your own actions and motives, often felt as guilt or unease when you go against it
example: Her conscience kicked in halfway through copying the homework, so she closed the laptop and asked her friend to explain the sums instead.

hindi: अंतःचेतनावाद — अफ़्रीकी परंपरा, इस्लाम और पश्चिमी प्रभाव को जोड़ने का न्क्रूमा का दर्शन
definition: Kwame Nkrumah's philosophy for postcolonial Africa, aiming to blend traditional African values with Islamic and Western influences into one coherent social vision
example: Mixing his grandmother's recipes with a French oven technique, Kwame called the dinner consciencism on a plate.

hindi: चेतना-जागरण — अपनी सामाजिक स्थिति को समझकर उसे बदलने की जागरूकता
definition: Freire's term for the process by which learners come to understand the social and political forces behind their situation and gain the will to change them
example: After mapping who owned every shop on their street, the evening-class students felt a slow conscientization turning complaints into a residents' petition.

hindi: चेतना-जागरण — साझा अनुभवों द्वारा उत्पीड़न की सामूहिक पहचान
definition: a practice in which people share personal experiences in small groups to discover that their private troubles reflect shared, political patterns of oppression
example: The hostel's late-night chat about curfews for girls only became accidental consciousness-raising by two in the morning.

hindi: शासितों की सहमति — शासन का अधिकार प्रजा की स्वीकृति से आने का सिद्धांत
definition: the principle that a government's right to rule comes from the agreement or approval of the people it governs, rather than from force or birth
example: The office manager tried to impose standing meetings, until the team reminded him that rules work better with the consent of the governed.

hindi: सहमति सिद्धांत — राजनीतिक दायित्व को नागरिकों की सहमति पर आधारित मानने का मत
definition: the view that citizens have a duty to obey a government only because, and only when, they have agreed or consented to its authority
example: Kabir used consent theory to argue that since he never agreed to the family curfew, it simply did not apply to him.

hindi: परिणाम तर्क — अतीत और नियमों के अनियंत्रित होने से स्वतंत्रता को नकारने वाला तर्क
definition: the argument that if determinism is true, our choices are consequences of the distant past and natural laws, neither of which we control, so we control nothing
example: After hearing the consequence argument in class, Zoya wondered aloud whether her homework was really due to the Big Bang.

hindi: अनुवर्ती — 'यदि क तो ख' कथन का 'तो' वाला दूसरा भाग
definition: the second part of a conditional statement, the clause that follows 'then' and states what holds whenever the condition holds
example: Ayaan's father pointed out that the consequent was 'you can play', not 'you can play until midnight'.

hindi: परिणामवाद — कर्म के सही या गलत होने को केवल उसके परिणामों से आँकने का मत
definition: the view that whether an action is right or wrong depends only on its consequences, so the best action is the one that brings about the best overall outcome
example: Priya defended eating the last samosa with pure consequentialism: everyone else was full, so her happiness was the only outcome on the table.

hindi: रूढ़िवाद — परंपरा, स्थिर संस्थाओं और क्रमिक परिवर्तन को महत्त्व देने वाली विचारधारा
definition: the political outlook that values tradition, established institutions and gradual change, warning that sweeping reforms often destroy more than they build
example: Dadi's conservatism about the kitchen was firm: the pickle jars had lived on that shelf for forty years and would not be reorganised.

hindi: संरक्षी विस्तार — ऐसा विस्तार जो मूल सिद्धांत की भाषा में कोई नया निष्कर्ष नहीं जोड़ता
definition: a larger theory that adds extra axioms, meaning starting assumptions, yet proves nothing new that could already be stated in the smaller original theory, a property some anti-realists claim mathematics has relative to physical science
example: The office's upgraded spreadsheet macro was a conservative extension of the old system: faster formulas, but not a single figure the accountants could not already reach.

hindi: संरक्षित राशि सिद्धांत — कारणता को ऊर्जा या संवेग जैसी संरक्षित राशियों के आदान-प्रदान के रूप में समझना
definition: Salmon and Dowe's view that causation is the exchange of a conserved physical quantity, such as energy, momentum or electric charge, between real physical processes
example: On the carrom board, Varun explained the conserved quantity theory as the striker handing its momentum to the queen.

hindi: आगमनों का संगम — अलग-अलग प्रमाण-क्षेत्रों का एक ही सिद्धांत पर मिल जाना
definition: Whewell's term for the agreement of separate lines of evidence from different kinds of phenomena on a single theory, taken as strong support for it
example: The consilience of inductions was complete: the receipt, the crumbs and the grin all pointed to Dhruv eating the last pastry.

hindi: नित्य सहचार — दो प्रकार की घटनाओं का सदा एक के बाद एक साथ घटित होना
definition: Hume's name for the repeated pattern in which events of one kind are always followed by events of another kind, which he held is all we ever observe of causation
example: After forty mornings of the kettle clicking off just as the neighbour's door slammed, Arjun admitted it was constant conjunction, not telepathy.

hindi: वर्णनात्मक कथन — ऐसा कथन जो किसी तथ्य का वर्णन करे और सत्य या असत्य हो
definition: a sentence that describes how things are and can therefore be true or false, contrasted by Austin with performative utterances that perform actions
example: "The printer is jammed" is a constative utterance, and in this office it is also permanently true.

hindi: संघटन मत — वस्तु अपने पदार्थ से बनी होती है, फिर भी उससे अभिन्न नहीं होती, यह मत
definition: the view that a thing can be made up of matter without being identical to that matter, so a statue is constituted by, yet distinct from, its clay
example: Defending the constitution view, Ishaan argued his sandcastle was more than sand, though his little brother's kick proved otherwise.

hindi: संविधानवाद — शासन की शक्ति को मूल कानून द्वारा सीमित रखने का सिद्धांत
definition: the doctrine that government power must be limited and controlled by a fundamental written or settled legal framework, which rulers themselves cannot simply change
example: The book club's constitutionalism was strict: even the founder could not change the reading list without a two-thirds vote.

hindi: स्वभावगत संयोग — जन्मजात स्वभाव और चरित्र से जुड़ा नैतिक भाग्य
definition: the kind of moral luck in which chance shapes the character, temperament and inclinations a person simply finds themselves with, and which later guide their choices
example: Karan's calm temper made him the office peacemaker, though he conceded constitutive luck deserved half the credit.

hindi: रचनात्मक उभयतःपाश — दो 'यदि-तो' कथनों और उनकी शर्तों के विकल्प से परिणामों का विकल्प निकालने वाला तर्क
definition: a valid argument form that starts from two conditional claims and the premise that at least one of their conditions holds, then concludes that at least one of their results follows
example: Neel's constructive dilemma was grim: studying meant missing the party, partying meant failing the test, and since he would do one or the other, he would lose something either way.

hindi: रचनात्मक अनुभववाद — विज्ञान का लक्ष्य केवल अनुभवजन्य पर्याप्तता मानने का वान फ्रासेन का मत
definition: van Fraassen's view that science aims only at theories that correctly describe observable things, and accepting a theory requires believing no more
example: Neha applied constructive empiricism to her fitness tracker, trusting the step count she could check but not the claimed stress levels.

hindi: रचनात्मक प्रमाण — अस्तित्व सिद्ध करने के लिए वस्तु वास्तव में प्रस्तुत करने वाला प्रमाण
definition: a proof that shows something exists by actually building or finding an example of it, rather than merely showing that its nonexistence would lead to contradiction
example: Rahul demanded a constructive proof that a free parking spot existed near the office, preferably one with coordinates.

hindi: परिपूर्ण अनुभव — वह अनुभव जो अपने आप में पूर्ण और संतोषजनक हो
definition: Dewey's term for an experience that feels complete and satisfying in itself, rounding off a course of activity, which he regarded as the root of artistic enjoyment
example: Finishing the jigsaw after three weeks gave the whole family a consummatory experience, plus a sore back.

hindi: चिंतनशील जीवन — दार्शनिक मनन और सत्य-चिंतन को समर्पित सर्वोच्च जीवन
definition: the life devoted to study and reflection on the deepest truths, which Aristotle ranked as the highest and most self-sufficient form of human happiness
example: On holiday with a stack of books and no wifi, Aisha briefly tried the contemplative life until the beach volleyball started.

hindi: विषयवस्तु बाह्यवाद — विचारों का अर्थ आंशिक रूप से बाहरी जगत से तय होने का मत
definition: the view that the content of a person's thoughts depends partly on things outside their head, such as their physical surroundings and the language community they belong to
example: Content externalism, Jaya argued, explained why her grandmother's word for chutney meant something slightly different in Kolkata than in Chennai.

hindi: अन्वेषण संदर्भ — किसी सिद्धांत के वास्तव में सूझने की मनोवैज्ञानिक और ऐतिहासिक परिस्थिति
definition: the actual psychological and historical circumstances in which a scientist first arrives at an idea, separated from how the idea is justified
example: The context of discovery for Rohan's business plan was a shower, which he wisely left out of the investor deck.

hindi: औचित्य संदर्भ — किसी सिद्धांत की तार्किक और प्रमाणिक परख
definition: the logical and evidential assessment of whether a theory deserves acceptance, regardless of how its discoverer first thought of it
example: In the context of justification, nobody cared that Neha's idea came from a dream, only whether her spreadsheet held up.

hindi: प्रसंग-सिद्धांत — फ्रेगे का नियम कि शब्द का अर्थ केवल वाक्य के भीतर पूछा जाए
definition: Frege's principle that philosophers should only seek the meaning of a word within the setting of a whole sentence, never for the word taken on its own
example: Trying to decode her boss's single-word reply 'fine', Tanvi wished the context principle came with a full sentence attached.

hindi: प्रासंगिक अखंडता — सूचना उसी संदर्भ के नियमों के अनुसार बहे जिसमें वह पहले साझा हुई थी
definition: Helen Nissenbaum's account of privacy, holding that personal information flows properly only when it respects the unwritten rules of the setting where it was first shared
example: Telling the doctor about the rash was fine, Neha fumed, but the pharmacy texting her office manager broke contextual integrity.

hindi: संदर्भवाद — अर्थ और सत्य को संदर्भ पर निर्भर मानने का मत
definition: the view that the meaning or truth of a statement, especially a claim to know something, depends on the situation in which it is made
example: 'I know where my keys are' sounds fine at home but shaky at the airport, which is contextualism in a nutshell.

hindi: महाद्वीपीय बुद्धिवाद — देकार्त, स्पिनोज़ा और लाइबनिज़ की बुद्धि-प्रधान परंपरा
definition: the tradition of Descartes, Spinoza and Leibniz holding that reason, rather than sensory experience, is the main source of certain knowledge
example: Continental rationalism would have planned the road trip from first principles; the family simply followed the map app.

hindi: आकस्मिकता — जो है पर अन्यथा भी हो सकता था, उसका गुण
definition: the property of a statement or state of affairs that happens to be true but could have been false, holding in some possible worlds and failing in others
example: Rahul pointed out that his team losing the office quiz was pure contingency, not a necessary truth about his intelligence.

hindi: प्रागनुभविक आकस्मिक सत्य — ऐसा आकस्मिक सत्य जिसे अनुभव के बिना जाना जा सके
definition: a truth that could have been false yet can be known without experience, often because of the manner in which a name or measuring standard was introduced
example: When Nisha decided that 'Tallboy' would name whichever office plant grew tallest, she knew without looking the contingent a priori truth that Tallboy was the tallest plant.

hindi: आकस्मिक सत्य — वह कथन जो सत्य है पर असत्य भी हो सकता था
definition: a statement that is actually true but could have been false, holding in some possible worlds and failing in others
example: That the office coffee machine works today, Dev reminded everyone, is a contingent truth and should not be relied upon.

hindi: निरंतर सृष्टि — ईश्वर द्वारा प्रत्येक क्षण जगत को पुनः अस्तित्व में बनाए रखने का मत
definition: the doctrine, held by Descartes and others, that the deity must keep recreating the world at every moment, because nothing created could continue existing by itself
example: The office coffee machine needed so much constant attention that Jaya said it survived only through continuous creation.

hindi: सातत्य दोष — स्पष्ट सीमा न होने से भेद को ही नकार देना
definition: the fallacy of rejecting a real distinction because there is no sharp boundary between its extremes, as though gradual change erased every difference
example: One more episode never turns a short break into a wasted evening, argued Sanya, and the continuum fallacy carried her to two in the morning.

hindi: सातत्य परिकल्पना — प्राकृत और वास्तविक संख्याओं के बीच किसी मध्यवर्ती अनंत के न होने का अनुमान
definition: Cantor's conjecture that there is nothing in between: every infinite collection larger than the natural numbers is at least as large as the real numbers, a claim standard axioms can neither prove nor refute
example: Asked whether pineapple belongs on pizza, Jaya said it was like the continuum hypothesis: the usual axioms simply cannot settle it.

hindi: अनुबंधवाद — नैतिक और राजनीतिक नियमों को स्वार्थी व्यक्तियों के आपसी समझौते से उपजा मानने का मत
definition: the view, following Hobbes, that moral and political rules are justified because self-interested people would agree to them for mutual benefit
example: The roommates' contractarianism was simple: nobody likes washing dishes, but everybody likes clean plates, so everybody washes.

hindi: अनुबंधपरक नैतिकता — वे नियम उचित हैं जिन्हें कोई भी तर्कसंगत रूप से अस्वीकार न कर सके, यह मत
definition: the view, following Kant and Scanlon, that moral rules are justified when nobody could reasonably reject them, so rightness depends on what we can justify to each other
example: Asha's contractualism settled the playlist fight: no song goes on that anyone in the car could reasonably reject.

hindi: व्याघात — ऐसा कथन जो अपने रूप के कारण हर स्थिति में असत्य हो
definition: a statement that is false in every possible case because of its logical form, such as 'the kettle is boiling and the kettle is not boiling'
example: When Yash insisted the meeting was 'definitely on and definitely not on', his manager pointed out that a contradiction stays false however the calendar turns out.

hindi: संकल्पना में विरोधाभास — ऐसा नियम जिसे सार्वभौम बनाने की कल्पना ही स्वयं को खंडित कर दे
definition: in Kant's test, the failure of a personal rule that could not even be coherently imagined as a universal rule, such as making false promises
example: Vikram showed a contradiction in conception: if everyone made fake promises to repay loans, the word 'promise' in the group chat would mean nothing.

hindi: संकल्प में विरोधाभास — ऐसा नियम जिसकी कल्पना संभव हो पर कोई विवेकी उसे सार्वभौम चाहे नहीं
definition: in Kant's test, the failure of a personal rule that could exist universally but that no rational person could consistently want, such as never helping others
example: Neha pointed out the contradiction in will in Rohit's 'never help anyone' rule, since he had just begged three people to carry his fridge.

hindi: विरोधमूलक व्याख्या — यह समझाना कि कोई बात दूसरी के बजाय क्यों हुई
definition: an explanation that answers why one thing happened rather than some particular alternative, so that the chosen contrast shapes which causes matter
example: Asked why she chose biryani rather than pizza, Leela offered a contrastive explanation citing the pizza shop's broken oven.

hindi: योगदान-अन्याय — किसी समूह की अपनी अवधारणाओं को सुनने से जानबूझकर इनकार
definition: a wrong done to people as knowers, where a marginalised group already has concepts for its experience, but listeners refuse to learn or accept those concepts
example: When the students explained their term for the teacher's pattern of snubs and the principal waved it away as jargon, that refusal was a contributory injustice.

hindi: नियंत्रण समस्या — अपने से अधिक सक्षम कृत्रिम बुद्धि को मानव-नियंत्रण में रखने की चुनौती
definition: the challenge of keeping an artificial intelligence more capable than its creators under human control, so that its goals and behaviour stay safe and aligned
example: Watching the robot vacuum ignore every command and head for the stairs, Asha said the control problem was no longer theoretical.

hindi: तार्स्की की कसौटी — सत्य की हर पर्याप्त परिभाषा को 'स सत्य है यदि और केवल यदि स' प्रमाणित करना चाहिए
definition: Tarski's condition that any adequate definition of truth must yield every sentence of the form 'snow is white' is true if and only if snow is white
example: Checking the essay against Convention T, the tutor noted that 'the kettle is boiling' is true exactly when the kettle is boiling.

hindi: रूढ़ निहितार्थ — शब्दों के अर्थ से ही जुड़ा हुआ अनकहा संकेत
definition: a meaning carried by particular words themselves, such as "but" or "even", rather than inferred from the conversation, and which cannot easily be withdrawn
example: "She's rich but kind" carries a conventional implicature that Anjali found rather rude to rich people.

hindi: संवृति सत्य — व्यवहार के स्तर पर मान्य सत्य
definition: in Buddhist philosophy, truth at the everyday level, where talk of persons, chairs and cities is accepted and useful, even though such things lack fixed essences
example: Farhan admitted that 'my car' was only a conventional truth, but still wanted it back from his brother.

hindi: परिपाटीवाद — यह मत कि कुछ सत्य हमारी भाषा के नियमों या स्वीकृत परिपाटियों से सत्य होते हैं
definition: the view that certain truths, especially of logic and mathematics, hold because of agreed rules and conventions of language rather than facts about the world
example: Conventionalism, Nidhi explained, is why 'a dozen is twelve' never needs a fact-check: we simply agreed on it.

hindi: अभिसारी यथार्थवाद — क्रमिक सिद्धांतों को सत्य की ओर निकटतर जाता मानने का मत
definition: the view that successive scientific theories converge on the truth, with later theories preserving and refining what earlier ones got right
example: Meera's convergent realism about phone maps was simple: each update drew her street a little more accurately than the previous one.

hindi: वार्तालापी निहितार्थ — बातचीत के सामान्य नियमों से निकाला गया अनकहा अर्थ
definition: a meaning a listener infers from what a speaker says, together with the assumption that speakers cooperate and follow the unwritten rules of conversation
example: Asked about the new intern, the manager said "he's always punctual", a conversational implicature nobody missed.

hindi: वार्तालाप-अंकपट्ट — बातचीत में क्रमशः बनती साझा मान्यताओं का लेखा
definition: David Lewis's idea that a conversation keeps a running record, like a sports score, of what has been assumed, permitted and referred to earlier in the exchange
example: Once Isha mentioned "the incident", it went on the conversational score, and every later joke referred to it.

hindi: सहयोग सिद्धांत — बातचीत में उचित और उद्देश्यपूर्ण योगदान देने का ग्राइस का नियम
definition: Grice's principle that people in conversation assume each other to be making contributions suited to the shared purpose and stage of the talk
example: Answering "where are my keys?" with "somewhere in the universe" flouts the cooperative principle, however accurate.

hindi: कोपेनहेगन व्याख्या — क्वांटम मापन पर निश्चित परिणाम और अवलोकन को केंद्र मानने वाला मत
definition: the classic reading of quantum physics on which a measured system has no definite properties until measurement, when its spread of possibilities suddenly settles into one result
example: Under the Copenhagen interpretation of office life, Meenal said, nobody's project status is definite until the manager actually asks.

hindi: कोपर्निकसीय क्रांति — ज्ञान में वस्तु के बजाय मन को केंद्र में रखने वाला कांट का मोड़
definition: Kant's reversal in the theory of knowledge, proposing that objects must conform to the structure of the mind, rather than the mind simply copying objects
example: Tired of rearranging her desk to fit her habits, Sana staged a Copernican revolution and rearranged her habits to fit the desk.

hindi: प्रतिलिपि सिद्धांत — ह्यूम का मत कि हर विचार किसी पूर्व संवेदन की धुंधली प्रतिलिपि है
definition: Hume's principle that every simple idea is a fainter copy of some earlier impression, meaning a vivid experience from the senses
example: By the copy principle, Leela said, her brother's idea of a tidy room must come from some impression he has hidden well.

hindi: सह-निर्देश — दो शब्दों या पदों का एक ही वस्तु की ओर संकेत करना
definition: the relation between two words or phrases that pick out exactly the same object, such as a name and a description that both refer to one person
example: The coreference of 'my flatmate' and 'the person eating my yoghurt' was confirmed by a spoon left in the fridge.

hindi: कॉर्नेल यथार्थवाद — नैतिक गुणों को वास्तविक प्राकृतिक गुण मानने वाला, पर उन्हें अन्य शब्दों में परिभाषित न करने वाला मत
definition: a version of moral naturalism holding that moral properties are real natural properties that explain events, even though moral words cannot be defined in scientific terms
example: Rahul invoked Cornell realism to argue that the manager's cruelty genuinely explained why half the team quit, just like any other cause.

hindi: कणिकावाद — जगत को सूक्ष्म कणों की गति और आकार से समझाने का मत
definition: the view, held by Boyle and Locke, that matter consists of tiny particles called corpuscles whose size, shape and motion explain every observable property
example: Baking bread, Aman explained the rising dough through corpuscularianism, picturing countless tiny particles jostling inside the bowl.

hindi: सुधारात्मक न्याय — एक व्यक्ति द्वारा दूसरे को पहुँचाई गई अनुचित हानि की भरपाई
definition: Aristotle's idea of justice that restores the balance between the parties to a dealing after one has wrongfully gained at the other's expense
example: Corrective justice arrived when Neel's roommate finally returned the charger he had borrowed in March, plus a packet of biscuits as interest.

hindi: सुधार-योग्यता — कृत्रिम बुद्धि का मनुष्यों द्वारा सुधारे, बदले या बंद किए जाने को स्वीकार करना
definition: the property of an artificial intelligence that accepts being corrected, modified or shut down by humans rather than resisting such interference
example: Mum praised her teenager's rare corrigibility after he actually closed the game when asked the first time.

hindi: संपुष्टि — कठोर परीक्षणों में टिके रहने से सिद्धांत को मिली साख
definition: Popper's term for the standing a theory earns by surviving serious attempts to refute it, which records past performance without claiming the theory is probably true
example: After surviving every critique in the team meeting, Nikhil's budget plan earned corroboration, though nobody dared call it correct.

hindi: सृष्टिमूलक युक्ति — जगत के अस्तित्व का कारण खोजकर ईश्वर को सिद्ध करने का तर्क
definition: the argument that the universe needs a first cause or explanation for existing, and that this first cause is best understood as a deity
example: Stuck on a delayed train, Kabir traced the chain of blame back through signals and staff until he declared he had built a cosmological argument for the timetable's first cause.

hindi: ब्रह्मांडमीमांसा — ब्रह्मांड की उत्पत्ति और स्वरूप का दार्शनिक अध्ययन
definition: the part of philosophy that asks about the origin, structure and nature of the universe as a whole, such as whether it had a beginning
example: Lying on the terrace at midnight, the cousins drifted into cosmology: did the universe begin, or has it always been here?

hindi: विश्वनागरिकतावाद — सभी मनुष्यों को एक ही वैश्विक समुदाय का सदस्य मानने का मत
definition: the view that every human being belongs to a single world community, so moral concern should reach beyond national borders
example: Maya's cosmopolitanism meant she donated to flood relief abroad just as readily as to the drive in her own city.

hindi: विश्वचित्तवाद — संपूर्ण ब्रह्मांड एक चेतन सत्ता है और व्यक्तिगत मन उसके अंश हैं, ऐसा मत
definition: the view that the whole universe is a single conscious subject, and that individual minds are fragments or aspects derived from that cosmic consciousness
example: Lying on the terrace under the stars, Mitali said cosmopsychism felt plausible, until the mosquitoes reminded her of more local minds.

hindi: प्रति-उदाहरण — वह उदाहरण जो किसी सामान्य कथन या तर्क-रूप को असत्य या अवैध सिद्ध करे
definition: a particular case showing that a general claim is false, or that an argument form is invalid because its premises are true while its conclusion is false
example: When her uncle said all teenagers hate reading, Sneha offered herself, holding a novel, as a living counterexample.

hindi: प्रतितथ्य विश्लेषण — 'यदि कारण न होता तो कार्य भी न होता' के आधार पर कारणता को समझने की विधि
definition: the theory that one event caused another when, had the first event not happened, the second event would not have happened either; associated with David Lewis
example: Priya ran a quick counterfactual analysis of her missed train: without that second coffee, she would have reached the platform on time.

hindi: प्रतिरूप सिद्धांत — यह मत कि व्यक्ति दूसरे जगतों में नहीं, केवल उसके सदृश प्रतिरूप रहते हैं
definition: David Lewis's theory that an individual exists in only one possible world, and that claims about what that individual could have done concern similar counterparts living in other worlds
example: According to counterpart theory, Tanvi explained to the group chat, it was not she who aced the exam but a very similar counterpart who actually studied.

hindi: होने का साहस — चिंता और अर्थहीनता के बावजूद स्वयं को स्वीकारने का साहस
definition: Tillich's term for the courage to affirm your own existence despite anxiety, doubt and the threat of meaninglessness
example: Walking into her first stand-up open mic, Parul discovered the courage to be, along with sweaty palms.

hindi: आवरक-नियम प्रतिरूप — किसी घटना को सामान्य नियम के अंतर्गत दिखाकर समझाने का मत
definition: the view, associated with Hempel, that explaining an event means showing it falls under general laws, whether deductive or statistical
example: According to the covering law model, Mehul's soggy toast was explained once gravity and the butter-side rule were stated.

hindi: सृष्टिवाद — ब्रह्मांड और जीवों को किसी दैवी सृष्टिकर्ता की रचना मानने का मत
definition: the belief that the universe and living beings were made by a divine creator, often as described in scripture such as the Book of Genesis, rather than through evolution alone
example: A biology lesson on evolution became a respectful discussion of creationism when a student asked how the two views compare.

hindi: रचनात्मक लोकतंत्र — लोकतंत्र को दैनिक सहयोग का जीवन-मार्ग मानना
definition: Dewey's view that democracy is less a government structure than a personal habit of everyday cooperation, open discussion and shared problem-solving
example: The housing society meeting became creative democracy when residents stopped complaining and started drafting the parking plan together.

hindi: विश्वसनीयता-न्यूनता — वक्ता को उचित से कम विश्वसनीय मानना
definition: the situation where a speaker is given less credibility than the evidence supports, often because of stereotypes about the group they belong to
example: The teenager's accurate warning about the burning smell met a credibility deficit until his father sniffed the kitchen himself.

hindi: विश्वसनीयता-अतिरेक — वक्ता को उचित से अधिक विश्वसनीय मानना
definition: the situation where a speaker is given more credibility than the evidence supports, often because of flattering stereotypes about confidence, status or accent
example: The loud manager enjoyed a credibility excess, so his wildly wrong sales forecast sailed through the meeting unchallenged.

hindi: मूलमंत्र — किसी व्यक्ति या समूह के आधारभूत सिद्धांत
definition: a short, clear statement of the core beliefs or principles that guide how a person or group thinks and behaves
example: The startup's credo, printed on every mug, is 'ship small, ship often', though the coffee machine has not shipped anything in weeks.

hindi: मैं समझने हेतु विश्वास करता हूँ — आस्था को समझ की पूर्वशर्त मानने का सूत्र
definition: Anselm's motto meaning I believe in order to understand, holding that faith must come first and makes deeper understanding possible
example: Before her first coding bootcamp, Ira adopted credo ut intelligam and simply trusted the instructor that the semicolons mattered.

hindi: आस्था-सूत्र — जीवन को दिशा देने वाले मूल सिद्धांतों का समूह
definition: any system of beliefs or principles that guides how a person or group thinks and lives, whether religious, political or personal
example: Our running club's creed is simple: nobody gets left behind, and nobody brags about their marathon time at breakfast.

hindi: रेंगता न्यूनतावाद — 'सत्य' और 'तथ्य' के हल्के अर्थ से यथार्थवाद व अभिव्यक्तिवाद का अंतर धुँधला पड़ने की समस्या
definition: the worry that if words like 'true' and 'fact' are given lightweight meanings, quasi-realism and realism become impossible to tell apart
example: The seminar stalled on creeping minimalism when every student, realist or expressivist, agreed that cheating was 'really, truly wrong'.

hindi: आलोचनात्मक सामान्य-बोधवाद — सामान्य विश्वासों को स्वीकारते हुए उनकी निरंतर परीक्षा करने का मत
definition: Peirce's view that we should begin from the everyday beliefs we cannot seriously doubt, while still examining and correcting them whenever genuine evidence demands
example: Rahul's critical common-sensism meant trusting that the train would come, while still checking the platform board twice.

hindi: आलोचनात्मक शिक्षाशास्त्र — शिक्षा को सत्ता और अन्याय पर प्रश्न उठाने का साधन मानने वाला चिंतन
definition: the view that teaching and learning should help students question power, injustice and the social forces shaping their lives, rather than simply accept them
example: Meera brought critical pedagogy to her history class by asking whose voices were missing from the textbook chapter on the city's founding.

hindi: समीक्षावाद — बुद्धि की सीमाओं की जाँच करने वाला कांट का दर्शन
definition: Kant's project of examining reason itself, testing what human thinking can and cannot know before making claims about deity, freedom or the soul
example: Before arguing about the afterlife at dinner, Rohan insisted on some critical philosophy: first work out what anyone at the table could possibly know.

hindi: आलोचनात्मक नस्ल सिद्धांत — कानून और संस्थाओं में नस्लवाद की पड़ताल करने वाला चिंतन
definition: an intellectual movement, begun in American legal scholarship, holding that racism is embedded in statutes, institutions and social structures, rather than existing only in individual prejudice
example: The debate club spent an entire evening arguing over what critical race theory actually claims before anyone judged it.

hindi: आलोचनात्मक बुद्धिवाद — ज्ञान को कठोर आलोचना से परखे गए अनुमानों की शृंखला मानने का पॉपर का दर्शन
definition: Popper's philosophy that knowledge grows through bold guesses exposed to relentless criticism and testing, never through proof or certainty
example: The startup's critical rationalism meant every product idea got a meeting devoted solely to attacking it.

hindi: आलोचनात्मक यथार्थवाद — बाहरी वस्तुएँ हैं पर उनका ज्ञान मानसिक सामग्री के माध्यम से होता है, यह मत
definition: an early twentieth-century view that physical objects exist independently, but perception reaches them only through mental contents or data, rejecting both naive realism and idealism
example: Neha adopted critical realism about her commute: the train was real, but the arrival time on the platform screen was only a hopeful representation of it.

hindi: आलोचनात्मक सिद्धांत — समाज की छिपी सत्ता-संरचनाओं को उजागर कर मुक्ति की ओर ले जाने वाला चिंतन
definition: a style of social philosophy that examines society in order to expose hidden structures of power and domination, aiming not only to describe people's lives but to help free them
example: When the office announced a mandatory fun day, Tanvi applied some critical theory and asked who exactly was being made to have fun, and for whose profit.

hindi: राजनीतिक अर्थशास्त्र की आलोचना — पूँजीवादी अर्थव्यवस्था की मान्यताओं का मार्क्सवादी विश्लेषण
definition: Marx's project of examining the assumptions of classical economics to show that its supposedly natural laws reflect a particular, changeable form of society
