example: Priya's economics essay turned into a critique of political economy the moment she asked why supply and demand never needed a vacation.

hindi: मगरमच्छ दुविधा — बच्चा लौटाने की शर्त से उपजा आत्मविरोधी वादा
definition: an ancient puzzle in which a crocodile promises to return a stolen child if the parent correctly predicts the crocodile's decision, and the parent predicts the child will never be returned
example: When the landlord promised to refund the deposit if Riddhi guessed his decision, she recognised the crocodile dilemma.

hindi: क्रॉमवेल का नियम — किसी संभावित कथन को पूर्णतः निश्चित या असंभव न मानने का सिद्धांत
definition: the principle that you should never treat any claim that could conceivably turn out true or false as either completely certain or completely impossible
example: Following Cromwell's rule, the weather app never promised a zero chance of rain, which saved Dhruv from leaving his jacket behind.

hindi: दोषपूर्ण अज्ञान — ऐसा अज्ञान जिसके लिए व्यक्ति स्वयं उत्तरदायी हो
definition: ignorance that a person is blameworthy for, because they could and should have found out the relevant facts before acting
example: Claiming he never read the group-project brief, Dev discovered that culpable ignorance earns zero sympathy and zero marks.

hindi: सांस्कृतिक प्रभुत्व — शासक वर्ग द्वारा अपने मूल्यों को सबका 'सामान्य बोध' बना देना
definition: Gramsci's idea that a ruling class keeps power less by force than by making its own values and outlook seem like everyone's common sense
example: Nobody questioned why the office celebrated every quarter's profits but no one's birthday, which Farhan called cultural hegemony at work.

hindi: संस्कृति उद्योग — मनोरंजन का मानकीकृत उत्पादन जो लोगों को निष्क्रिय उपभोक्ता बनाता है
definition: Adorno and Horkheimer's term for the mass production of standardized entertainment, which they argued turns audiences into passive consumers and supports the existing order
example: When the fifth superhero sequel hit theatres, Ishita blamed the culture industry and bought popcorn anyway.

hindi: सहघटना-कारण दोष — साथ-साथ घटने से एक को दूसरे का कारण मान लेना
definition: the fallacy of assuming that because two things happen together or rise together, one of them must cause the other
example: Sales of umbrellas and chai both rose that week, and Karan's cum hoc ergo propter hoc blamed the chai for the rain.

hindi: बुद्धि की चतुराई — व्यक्तियों के स्वार्थ से इतिहास का बड़ा उद्देश्य पूरा होना
definition: Hegel's idea that reason uses people's selfish passions and ambitions to achieve historical progress that none of those people actually intended
example: Each café owner only wanted profit, yet the street became a lively neighbourhood hub, which their professor credited to the cunning of reason.

hindi: करी विरोधाभास — 'यदि यह वाक्य सत्य है तो कुछ भी सत्य है' से कोई भी निष्कर्ष सिद्ध हो जाना
definition: a puzzle in which a sentence saying 'if this sentence is true, then some claim follows' seems to prove any claim whatsoever, using only ordinary rules for 'if'
example: Using Curry's paradox, Varun jokingly proved to his mother that he had already finished his homework.

hindi: वक्र-आसंजन समस्या — एक ही आँकड़ों से मेल खाते अनेक वक्रों में चुनाव की समस्या
definition: the difficulty that countless different curves pass through any finite collection of data points, so choosing among them requires something beyond fitting the data
example: Plotting her monthly phone bills, Kiran met the curve-fitting problem when three different graphs predicted three different futures.

hindi: श्वानवाद — प्रकृति के अनुसार सादा, निर्लज्ज और स्वावलंबी जीवन जीने का यूनानी दर्शन
definition: the ancient Greek school teaching that virtue means living simply and according to nature, openly rejecting wealth, status and social convention
example: Kunal's Cynicism lasted exactly one week of sleeping on a yoga mat before he quietly reordered his memory-foam pillow.

hindi: सूत्र-नाम जप — कमल सूत्र के शीर्षक का श्रद्धापूर्ण उच्चारण
definition: the chanting of the title of the Lotus Sutra, practised in Nichiren Buddhism as containing the whole teaching and awakening each person's inner potential for enlightenment
example: Before the job interview, Shruti chanted her daimoku, while her flatmate relied on the equally ancient ritual of strong coffee.

hindi: दान — बिना बदले की अपेक्षा के देने का गुण
definition: the virtue of generous giving, offering money, food, knowledge or help without expecting anything back
example: Leaving her spare umbrella at the bus stop for strangers, Maya felt it was a small but genuine dana.

hindi: दंड — शासन द्वारा व्यवस्था बनाए रखने के लिए दी जाने वाली सज़ा
definition: in Indian political thought, the ruler's power to punish, seen as necessary to keep order and protect the weak from the strong
example: The group chat admin muted the spammer for a day, explaining that without danda the chat would descend into chaos.

hindi: दण्डनीति — दण्ड और शासन-कला का प्राचीन भारतीय शास्त्र
definition: the ancient Indian science of government and punishment, discussed in the Arthashastra, which holds that ordered society depends on the ruler's rightful use of penalties
example: After the third missed deadline, the team lead switched from gentle reminders to dandaniti and started docking snack privileges.

hindi: मार्ग — वह मूल पथ जिससे सारी सृष्टि उपजती और चलती है
definition: in Chinese philosophy, the path or course that all things follow; for Daoists, the nameless source and pattern behind the whole natural world
example: When Tanvi stopped forcing her essay and let the ideas flow, her roommate said she had finally stepped onto the dao of deadlines.

hindi: ताओवाद — प्रकृति के मार्ग के साथ सहज जीवन का चीनी दर्शन
definition: the Chinese tradition that teaches living in harmony with the dao, the natural path of things, through simplicity, spontaneity and effortless action
example: When the train was cancelled, Omar shrugged, found a bench and practised a little commuter Daoism.

hindi: दर्शन — सत्य को देखने की एक व्यवस्थित दृष्टि, भारतीय दर्शन का एक संप्रदाय
definition: any of the classical Indian schools of philosophy, each offering a systematic vision of reality, knowledge and liberation; literally a 'viewing' or 'seeing'
example: When the study group split over whether the world is real, Tanvi said they had accidentally founded two rival darshanas before lunch.

hindi: मानवीय अस्तित्व — हाइडेगर के अनुसार वह सत्ता जो अपने ही होने पर प्रश्न करती है
definition: Heidegger's German term for human existence, understood as the kind of being that is always involved in the world and questions its own being
example: Staring into the fridge at midnight, Rehan decided his Dasein was, above all, a being that asks what snacks mean.

hindi: महा-एकता — सार्वजनिक हित पर आधारित आदर्श समाज
definition: the Confucian vision of the Great Unity, an ideal society where the whole world is shared, the elderly and orphans are cared for, and nobody hoards
example: When the housing society set up a free community fridge, Uncle Mathur called it a small step toward datong.

hindi: दया — दूसरों के दुख के प्रति करुणा
definition: compassion, feeling the suffering of others and wishing to relieve it, praised as a central virtue across Indian traditions
example: Seeing the new intern eating lunch alone, Farhan showed daya and pulled up a chair.

hindi: सद्गुण-शक्ति — सद्गुण से उपजा स्वाभाविक प्रभाव
definition: in Chinese thought, virtue understood as an inner power: the quiet influence a good person or ruler has over others without needing force
example: The class monitor never shouted, yet everyone went quiet when she stood up, which their teacher called de at work.

hindi: कथनगत — किसी पूरे कथन या वाक्य के बारे में किया गया प्रकारता-कथन
definition: 'about the saying': describes a claim of necessity or possibility made about a whole statement or proposition, rather than about any particular object it mentions
example: The office manager insisted that 'whoever wins the raffle gets the prize' is necessary de dicto, which comforted nobody who had actually lost.

hindi: डी मॉर्गन के नियम — संयोजन और वियोजन के निषेध को आपस में बदलने वाले दो समतुल्यता-नियम
definition: the pair of equivalences stating that denying a conjunction equals the disjunction of the denials, and denying a disjunction equals the conjunction of the denials
example: Thanks to De Morgan's laws, 'not both tea and coffee' left Aditi free to order either one, just never the pair.

hindi: वस्तुगत — किसी वस्तु के बारे में उसके अपने स्वरूप से किया गया प्रकारता-कथन
definition: 'about the thing': describes a claim of necessity or possibility made about a particular object itself, whatever words are used to describe that object
example: Sanya noted that saying her specific laptop could have been blue is a de re claim about that machine, whatever the shop receipt calls it.

hindi: आत्म-विषयक — ऐसा विश्वास या ज्ञान जो व्यक्ति अपने बारे में 'मैं' के रूप में रखता है
definition: Latin for 'about oneself', describing beliefs and desires that a person holds about themselves in the first-person manner, such as realising that the person running late is oneself
example: Sunita knew someone in the office had left the kettle on, but her de se belief arrived only when she saw her own mug beside it.

hindi: मृत दाता नियम — अंग केवल मृत घोषित व्यक्ति से ही लेने का नियम
definition: the ethical rule that vital organs may be taken for transplant only from donors already declared dead, and that retrieval must never cause death
example: Their debate on organ donation stalled when Leela asked exactly when the dead donor rule starts the clock.

hindi: ईश्वर की मृत्यु — नीत्शे का कथन कि ईश्वर-विश्वास अब पश्चिमी मूल्यों का आधार नहीं रहा
definition: Nietzsche's claim that belief in a deity no longer grounds Western values, leaving culture to face the loss of its traditional moral foundation
example: In philosophy class, Zoya argued the death of God explained why her generation argues about ethics in comment sections.

hindi: लेखक की मृत्यु — पाठ के अर्थ को लेखक के इरादे से मुक्त मानने का मत
definition: Barthes's claim that a text's meaning should not be fixed by what its writer intended, because meaning is produced by readers and by language itself
example: When the novelist tweeted what her ending really meant, the book club invoked the death of the author and kept arguing anyway.

hindi: कर्ता की मृत्यु — स्वतंत्र, स्थिर आत्म की धारणा का खंडन
definition: the poststructuralist claim that the self is not a free, stable source of thought but a product of language, culture and power
example: When Karan blamed the algorithm for his playlist, his sister joked that he had fully embraced the death of the subject.

hindi: निर्णय-क्षमता — उपचार संबंधी जानकारी समझकर तर्कसंगत निर्णय लेने की योग्यता
definition: a patient's ability to understand medical information, weigh the options and communicate a choice, which is required before their consent counts
example: At two in the morning, Rahul admitted he lacked the decision-making capacity to choose between cereal and noodles.

hindi: घोषणा — ऐसी वाक्-क्रिया जो कहते ही जगत में परिवर्तन कर दे
definition: in speech act theory, an utterance that changes the world simply by being made with proper authority, such as naming a ship or declaring a meeting open
example: The umpire's "out" was a declaration, so no amount of arguing on the balcony could undo it.

hindi: विसंबद्धता — परिवेश के संपर्क से क्वांटम व्यवहार का लुप्त हो जाना
definition: the physical process by which a quantum system's interaction with its surroundings makes its strange quantum behaviour effectively disappear, so outcomes look ordinary and definite
example: Decoherence, the physics teacher said, explains why your coffee mug never appears in two places, however sleepy you feel.

hindi: विखंडन — पाठ को खोलकर उसके छिपे अंतर्विरोध दिखाने की पद्धति
definition: a method of close reading that pulls apart a text to reveal the contradictions and assumptions hidden beneath its surface meaning
example: Her deconstruction of the wedding invitation revealed that 'casual dress' secretly meant 'dress to impress the aunties'.

hindi: विखंडनवाद — पाठ में छिपे अंतर्विरोध खोजने वाली आलोचना-परंपरा
definition: the school of criticism, begun by Jacques Derrida, holding that every text hides contradictions and that its meaning is never fully fixed
example: Two weeks into deconstructionism, Tara could no longer read a cereal box without finding a hidden war between 'natural' and 'flavoured'.

hindi: निगमन करना — दिए गए आधार-वाक्यों से निष्कर्ष तर्कपूर्वक निकालना
definition: to reach a conclusion that must be true if the starting statements are true, by reasoning step by step from general rules
example: All the dosa stalls close at ten and it was half past ten, so Mira deduced that dinner would be instant noodles.

hindi: निगमन — सामान्य आधार-वाक्यों से अनिवार्य निष्कर्ष निकालने की तर्क-विधि
definition: reasoning in which the conclusion follows necessarily from the premises, so that accepting the premises while rejecting the conclusion would be a contradiction
example: By pure deduction Arjun concluded that if every biscuit had been in the jar and the jar was now empty, every biscuit had been taken out.

hindi: निगमन-नियम प्रतिरूप — व्याख्या को सामान्य नियमों से निगमन द्वारा घटना निकालना मानने वाला मत
definition: Hempel's account of scientific explanation, in which an event is explained by deducing its occurrence from general laws of nature together with particular conditions
example: Using the deductive-nomological model, Farhan explained the burst water bottle from freezing laws and a forgotten night in the freezer.

hindi: गहन मतभेद — बुनियादी मान्यताओं पर ऐसी असहमति जिसे तर्क नहीं सुलझा पाता
definition: disagreement so fundamental that the opposing sides share no common principles or accepted evidence from which an argument could settle the matter
example: When one colleague trusted only spreadsheets and the other trusted only gut instinct, their budget debate became a deep disagreement.

hindi: गहन पारिस्थितिकी — प्रकृति को मानव उपयोग से स्वतंत्र मूल्यवान मानकर जीवन-शैली में मूलभूत परिवर्तन की माँग करने वाला मत
definition: the environmental philosophy holding that all living beings and ecosystems have value independent of human usefulness, and calling for deep changes in how humans live
example: After reading about deep ecology, Ishaan cancelled his weekend flight and then spent Saturday complaining about the train timetable.

hindi: निरसनीयता सिद्धांत — ज्ञान को ऐसा सप्रमाण विश्वास मानने का मत जिसे कोई सत्य तथ्य न काटे
definition: the theory that knowledge is justified true belief which no further truth, if discovered, would defeat or undermine
example: Under defeasibility theory, Karan's knowledge that his keys were in his pocket survived only because nobody mentioned the hole.

hindi: निरसनीय — नए प्रमाण से खंडित हो सकने वाला
definition: describing a belief or reason that is justified for the moment but could be overturned when fresh evidence or information appears
example: Karan's belief that the party started at eight proved defeasible the moment he arrived to empty chairs and a cleaner.

hindi: निरसक — किसी विश्वास के औचित्य को हटा देने वाला नया साक्ष्य या कारण
definition: a piece of evidence or reason that removes or weakens the justification a belief previously enjoyed
example: Tara's belief that the meeting was cancelled met its defeater when the calendar reminder chimed.

hindi: निश्चित वर्णन — 'वह' से शुरू होने वाला पद जो एक ही वस्तु को चुनने का दावा करता है
definition: a phrase of the form 'the such-and-such', like 'the tallest student', that aims to pick out exactly one individual by describing a feature only that individual has
example: 'The person who left fish in the microwave' was a definite description the whole office could fill in without a single name.

hindi: ह्रासमान समस्या-परिवर्तन — संशोधनों का केवल विफलताओं को ढकना, नई भविष्यवाणी न करना
definition: Lakatos's term for changes within a research programme that merely patch failures after the fact without predicting anything novel
example: Every excuse Arjun invented for missing the gym was a degenerating problemshift: plenty of patches, zero fresh predictions.

hindi: पुष्टि-मात्रा — प्रमाण द्वारा परिकल्पना को दिए गए समर्थन की मात्रा
definition: Carnap's measure of how strongly a body of evidence supports a hypothesis, expressed as a number between zero and one
example: The degree of confirmation for 'the printer hates Shreya' rose sharply after its fifth paper jam that morning.

hindi: सत्यांश — किसी कथन के आंशिक रूप से सत्य होने की मात्रा
definition: the idea, central to fuzzy logic, that a statement can be partly true, measured on a scale from completely false to completely true
example: When his coach called him fast, Ravi estimated the degree of truth at roughly 0.4 and kept the compliment anyway.

hindi: सत् की श्रेणियाँ — कुछ वस्तुओं के दूसरों से अधिक वास्तविक होने का मत
definition: the view, found in Plato and his later followers, that some things are more fully real than others, forming ranked levels of existence
example: Sameer ranked his meals by degrees of being, with his mother's biryani the most real and airport sandwiches barely there.

hindi: देहात्मवाद — शरीर को ही आत्मा मानने वाला चार्वाक मत
definition: the Charvaka view that the self is nothing more than the living body, so consciousness ends completely when the body dies
example: Sore after leg day at the gym, Aarav said his whole philosophy had shrunk to dehatmavada: the self is the body, and the body hurts.

hindi: तटस्थेश्वरवाद — यह मान्यता कि ईश्वर ने संसार रचा पर अब उसमें हस्तक्षेप नहीं करता
definition: the view that a creator deity made the world and its natural laws but does not intervene afterwards, known through reason rather than revelation, meaning messages sent directly from the deity
example: Siddharth's deism amused his flatmates: a creator who built the whole building, handed over the keys, and never once answered the maintenance group chat.

hindi: निर्देशवाचकता — ऐसे शब्द जिनका अर्थ बोलने के संदर्भ पर निर्भर हो, जैसे मैं, यहाँ, अब
definition: the way certain words, such as "I", "here", "now" and "that", pick out different things depending entirely on who is speaking, where and when
example: The sticky note saying "back in five minutes" was a lesson in deixis, since nobody knew when it was written.

hindi: अति-माँग आपत्ति — यह आपत्ति कि परिणामवाद मनुष्य से असहनीय मात्रा में त्याग की माँग करता है
definition: the objection that consequentialism asks far too much of people, since almost every purchase, hobby or rest could instead produce more good for strangers
example: Buying a fancy coffee right after the charity lecture, Jaya muttered that the demandingness objection had never felt so personal.

hindi: सीमांकन कसौटी — किसी दावे को वैज्ञानिक ठहराने वाली निर्णायक शर्त
definition: a proposed rule for deciding whether a theory counts as genuine science, such as Popper's requirement that it be falsifiable, meaning some possible observation could prove it wrong
example: Meera's demarcation criterion for her flatmates' theories was simple: if it cannot be tested before dinner, it is not science.

hindi: सीमांकन-समस्या — विज्ञान और गैर-विज्ञान के बीच रेखा खींचने की समस्या
definition: the question of how to distinguish genuine science from pseudoscience and other non-scientific claims, with falsifiability being one famous proposed answer
example: In biology class, the demarcation problem flared up when Yash asked why palmistry was excluded from the syllabus.

hindi: सृष्टिकर्ता शिल्पी — आदर्श रूपों के अनुसार जगत को गढ़ने वाला दिव्य कारीगर
definition: in Plato's Timaeus, the divine craftsman who shapes the physical world by copying the eternal Forms onto already existing, disordered matter
example: Arranging the whole wedding hall to match a Pinterest board, the decorator worked like a demiurge copying a perfect pattern.

hindi: लोकतांत्रिक समाजवाद — चुनावी लोकतंत्र के माध्यम से समाजवादी व्यवस्था लाने की विचारधारा
definition: the outlook that seeks collective ownership and economic equality through elections and democratic institutions rather than revolution
example: In the debate club, Neel defended democratic socialism by proposing the canteen become a cooperative, then asked for a vote.

hindi: प्रमाणन — स्वीकृत आधारों से किसी सत्य को निर्णायक रूप से स्थापित करने वाला तर्क
definition: in logic and classical philosophy, a proof that establishes a conclusion with certainty by valid deduction from premises known to be true
example: Aryan's demonstration that the fridge was empty required only opening the door, which he admitted was not exactly Euclid.

hindi: संकेतवाचक — यह, वह जैसे शब्द जो इशारे या प्रसंग से किसी वस्तु को चुनते हैं
definition: a word such as 'this' or 'that' that picks out an object with the help of pointing, gesture or context, making it a special kind of indexical expression
example: In the crowded kitchen, Nisha's demand for 'that one' was a demonstrative with at least nine possible targets.

term: denial of the will to live
hindi: जीवनेच्छा का निषेध — इच्छाओं को त्यागकर दुःख से मुक्ति पाने का शोपेनहावर का मार्ग
definition: Schopenhauer's ideal of escaping suffering by quieting desire itself, through compassion, self-denial and calm detachment from craving, as saints and hermits who renounce pleasure do
example: When Dev deleted every shopping app from his phone, his flatmate called it a denial of the will to live, sale-season edition.

hindi: अभिधान — किसी शब्द द्वारा सीधे इंगित वस्तु या वस्तुओं का समूह
definition: the object or group of objects that a word or phrase directly picks out in the world, as distinct from the ideas, feelings or descriptive content the word carries
example: The denotation of 'my charger' was clear to Aman, even if his sister insisted every white cable in the house belonged to her.

hindi: निर्देशक पदबंध — 'कोई', 'हर', 'वह' जैसे शब्दों से बना पद जो वस्तुओं की ओर संकेत करता है
definition: Russell's term for a phrase such as 'a student', 'every student' or 'the student' that points toward things by describing them rather than by naming them
example: 'Somebody from accounts' was the denoting phrase everyone used when blaming the broken coffee machine.

hindi: कर्तव्य-संबंधी — बाध्यता, अनुमति और निषेध से जुड़ा
definition: relating to duty and obligation, especially to whether actions are required, permitted or forbidden
example: The classroom argument about phones turned deontic fast: were they forbidden, merely permitted, or secretly required for survival?

hindi: कर्तव्य-तर्कशास्त्र — दायित्व, अनुमति और निषेध के कथनों का तर्क
definition: the logic of obligation, permission and prohibition, which studies how statements about what someone ought to perform, may perform or must never perform follow from one another
example: Aditi applied deontic logic to the office rules and concluded that if leaving early was forbidden, staying late was not, alas, obligatory.

hindi: कर्तव्य-मर्यादा — ऐसा नैतिक बंधन जो अच्छे परिणाम के लिए भी कुछ कर्म वर्जित करता है
definition: a moral limit forbidding certain actions, such as killing or lying, even when breaking it would produce better overall outcomes
example: Nikhil wanted to fake data to rescue the project, but his manager cited a deontological constraint and a very long policy document.

hindi: कर्तव्यवाद — कर्म के परिणाम नहीं, कर्तव्य और नियम के पालन को नैतिकता की कसौटी मानने वाला मत
definition: the ethical view that actions are right or wrong because of the duties and moral rules they keep or break, rather than because of their outcomes
example: Ananya's deontology surfaced in the group chat when she refused to share the leaked exam paper, even though everyone swore it would help the class average.

hindi: आश्रित सौंदर्य — वस्तु के प्रयोजन की अवधारणा पर टिका हुआ सौंदर्य
definition: Kant's term for beauty judged against a concept of what a thing is meant to be, so that a building or a horse is beautiful as the kind of thing it is
example: Judging the new office chair, Ritu insisted on dependent beauty: it could look lovely, but a chair that pinches is not a beautiful chair.

hindi: वंचना-पक्ष — मृत्यु इसलिए हानिकारक है कि वह जीवन के आगे के सुखों से वंचित कर देती है
definition: the view that death harms the person who dies because it takes away all the good experiences and goods their life would otherwise have contained
example: On the deprivation account, Kabir argued over chai, dying young is worse than dying old simply because more future birthdays get cancelled.

hindi: व्युत्पन्न करना — स्वीकृत आधारों से तर्क द्वारा कोई निष्कर्ष निकालना
definition: in logic, to obtain a conclusion from starting statements by applying accepted rules of reasoning, step by step
example: From the rule that phones stay off at dinner and the sight of Dad scrolling, Riya derived a clear case of hypocrisy.

hindi: व्युत्पन्न विषयोन्मुखता — मनुष्यों के प्रयोग से चिह्नों को मिलने वाली उधार की विषयोन्मुखता
definition: intentionality that words, signs, maps and computer symbols have only because minds employ and interpret them, borrowing their meaning from human thinkers
example: The office joke was that the traffic-light emoji on the status board had only derived intentionality, since nobody remembered what yellow meant.

hindi: विद्यालय-मुक्ति — संस्थागत विद्यालयों के बजाय मुक्त सीखने के जाल का विचार
definition: Illich's proposal that society should replace compulsory school institutions with open networks where people freely learn from each other, tools and everyday life
example: Watching his cousin learn guitar, Japanese and plumbing from strangers online, Dev wondered whether deschooling had quietly already happened.

hindi: वर्णनात्मक तत्त्वमीमांसा — हमारी वास्तविक सोच की मूल अवधारणात्मक संरचना का वर्णन
definition: Strawson's term for metaphysics that describes the basic structure of concepts we actually employ to think about the world, rather than proposing a better one
example: Mapping how the team actually talked about 'priority' and 'deadline', Nandini said she was doing descriptive metaphysics for project management.

hindi: वर्णनवाद — नैतिक कथनों को सच या झूठ हो सकने वाले तथ्य-कथन मानने का मत
definition: in ethics, the view that moral statements describe facts and so can be true or false, just like ordinary factual claims
example: Riya's descriptivism showed when she said 'cheating on the quiz is wrong' is as much a fact as 'the quiz is on Friday'.

hindi: इच्छा-पूर्ति सिद्धांत — किसी का कल्याण उसकी इच्छाओं के पूरे होने में है
definition: the theory of wellbeing holding that a person's life goes well for them to the extent that their desires, or the desires they would have when fully informed, are satisfied
example: According to the desire-satisfaction theory, Rhea's life improved the moment the delivery app finally brought her exactly the biryani she wanted.

hindi: विनाशक उभयतःपाश — दो परिणामों में से एक के निषेध से शर्तों में से एक का निषेध निकालने वाला तर्क
definition: a valid argument form that starts from two conditional claims and the premise that at least one of their results fails, then concludes that at least one of their conditions fails as well
example: Divya's destructive dilemma cornered her roommate: cooking leaves a mess, ordering leaves a receipt, at least one of those was missing, so one of his stories had to be false.

hindi: निश्चित निषेध — विशिष्ट खंडन से नया सकारात्मक परिणाम
definition: Hegel's idea that refuting a particular idea never leaves mere emptiness, since the specific failure points toward a definite fresh position that improves upon it
example: When the first design failed because users could not find the button, the team treated it as determinate negation and knew exactly what to fix.

hindi: नियतिवाद — हर घटना को पूर्व कारणों से अनिवार्यतः तय मानने का मत
definition: the view that every event, including human choices, is fixed in advance by earlier causes, which many think leaves no room for free will
example: Blaming determinism for eating the last samosa did not impress his sister, who had causes of her own for being angry.

hindi: निवारण सिद्धांत — दंड इसलिए उचित है क्योंकि वह भविष्य के अपराधों को रोकता है
definition: the view that punishment is justified because the threat and example of penalties discourages offenders and others from committing future crimes
example: The office followed deterrence theory when it posted the name of whoever left fish in the shared microwave, and the kitchen smelled better within a week.

hindi: विक्षेत्रीकरण — स्थापित सीमाओं और पहचानों से मुक्त होना
definition: deleuze and Guattari's term for the process by which habits, identities or social structures are uprooted from their settled place and released toward unfamiliar directions
example: Once the office went fully remote, the team's rituals underwent deterritorialization, and the Friday samosas moved into a video call.

hindi: गुप्त ईश्वर — स्वयं को छिपाए रखने वाला ईश्वर
definition: a Latin phrase meaning 'the hidden deity', naming the idea that the divine remains concealed and cannot be fully known by human reason
example: Hunting for the TV remote all evening, Dev muttered that it had become a Deus absconditus, present somewhere yet entirely hidden.

hindi: ईश्वर अर्थात प्रकृति — स्पिनोज़ा का सूत्र कि ईश्वर और प्रकृति एक ही हैं
definition: Spinoza's Latin phrase meaning 'deity, or nature', expressing his view that the divine and the whole of nature are one and the same reality
example: Gazing at the monsoon clouds from the bus window, Farhan whispered deus sive natura, then missed his stop.

hindi: विचलित कारण-श्रृंखला — इरादे से अप्रत्याशित ढंग से उत्पन्न परिणाम
definition: a case where an intention causes the intended result through a strange, unplanned route, raising doubt that it counts as intentional action
example: Planning to knock over the vase dramatically, Tarun got nervous, stumbled and knocked it anyway, a textbook deviant causal chain.

hindi: विचलित तर्कशास्त्र — शास्त्रीय तर्क के मूल नियम बदलने वाला प्रतिद्वंद्वी तर्क
definition: a logic that rivals classical logic by rejecting some of its basic principles, such as bivalence or excluded middle, rather than merely extending it
example: When Sanya's debate partner denied that every claim was true or false, she accused him of smuggling in a deviant logic.

hindi: उपकरण प्रतिमान — सुविधा देना पर उसके पीछे का श्रम और कौशल छिपा देना
definition: Borgmann's term for the pattern in which modern technology delivers goods conveniently while hiding the machinery, skill and effort that once produced them
example: The microwave dinner arrived steaming in three minutes, and thanks to the device paradigm nobody at the table knew what was inside it.

hindi: धारणा — चित्त को एक स्थान या विषय पर टिकाना
definition: in Yoga philosophy, the sixth limb of the eight-limbed path, meditative concentration that holds attention fixed on a single object or point
example: Staring at one spreadsheet cell until it made sense, Pooja said she had finally mastered dharana, or at least cell C14.

hindi: धर्म — कर्तव्य, नैतिक व्यवस्था और सही आचरण का समग्र सिद्धांत
definition: in Indian thought, the moral order that holds life together, and the right duties and conduct each person is expected to follow within it
example: When nobody offered to wash the dishes after the party, Ananya declared that dharma had clearly left the flat along with the guests.

hindi: धर्मशास्त्र — धर्म, कर्तव्य और विधि पर प्राचीन ग्रंथ
definition: the body of classical Sanskrit texts setting out rules of duty, conduct, ritual and legal procedure for Hindu society
example: Reading the flat's house rules taped to the fridge, Siddharth called it their very own dharmashastra.

hindi: धर्मास्तिकाय — गति में सहायक, लोक-व्यापी अदृश्य जैन द्रव्य
definition: in Jain philosophy, an invisible substance filling the universe that makes motion possible, the way water allows fish to swim without pushing them
example: Stuck in traffic, Harsh complained that the city seemed to have run out of dharmastikaya somewhere near the flyover.

hindi: धर्मयुद्ध — नैतिक नियमों के भीतर लड़ा गया न्यायपूर्ण युद्ध
definition: a righteous battle fought for a just cause and according to strict moral rules, such as sparing unarmed and fleeing fighters
example: The office pillow fight remained a dharmayuddha, since everyone agreed nobody could target the person holding coffee.

hindi: ध्वनि — काव्य में शब्द के सीधे अर्थ से परे व्यंजित होने वाला सूक्ष्म अर्थ
definition: the Indian aesthetic theory that the soul of poetry lies in suggestion, a meaning hinted beyond the literal words that stirs feeling in the reader
example: The single word 'fine' in Arnav's reply carried such dhvani that the whole group chat knew he was furious.

hindi: ध्यान — एक ही विषय पर अविच्छिन्न रूप से बहती एकाग्रता
definition: in Yoga philosophy, the seventh limb of the eight-limbed path, meditative concentration that flows unbroken toward its object like a steady stream
example: Lost in debugging for two hours, Aman looked up surprised, as if dhyana had quietly happened to him between commits.

hindi: कालानुक्रमिक अभिन्नता — समय बीतने पर भी किसी वस्तु या व्यक्ति के वही बने रहने का प्रश्न
definition: identity across time, asking what makes something at an earlier moment the very same thing as something at a later moment
example: Scrolling through her school photos, Meera wondered about diachronic identity, since the girl with that haircut surely could not be her.

hindi: कालानुगामी आत्म — स्वयं को दूर अतीत और भविष्य तक फैला हुआ एक ही व्यक्ति अनुभव करना
definition: a manner of experiencing oneself as the same self stretching across a whole life, so that events from the distant past and future feel like they happen to oneself
example: Still cringing at his fifth-grade speech, Aman was clearly a diachronic self who felt every old embarrassment personally.

hindi: विकर्ण तर्क — यह सिद्ध करने की विधि कि कुछ अनंत दूसरों से बड़े होते हैं
definition: Cantor's proof technique showing some infinite collections are larger than others, by building an item that differs from every entry on any proposed complete list
example: Raghav used a diagonal argument on the office lunch list, inventing a sandwich that differed from every order and proving the menu incomplete.

hindi: द्वंद्वात्मक पद्धति — विरोधी तर्कों के टकराव से सत्य तक पहुँचने की विधि
definition: a method of seeking truth through reasoned dialogue, in which opposing arguments are tested against each other until a better view emerges
example: The roommates' nightly dialectic about who should do the dishes has so far produced a rota, a truce and three new arguments.

hindi: प्रबोधन का द्वंद्व — तर्क और प्रगति का स्वयं नए प्रकार के प्रभुत्व में बदल जाना
definition: Adorno and Horkheimer's thesis that the Enlightenment's reason, meant to free people from myth and domination, can turn into fresh forms of control and myth
example: The productivity app built to free his time now scheduled every minute of it, a small dialectic of enlightenment on Varun's phone.

hindi: द्वंद्वात्मक भौतिकवाद — भौतिक जगत को विरोधों के संघर्ष से विकसित होता मानने का मार्क्सवादी दर्शन
definition: the Marxist philosophy that the material world develops through the conflict of opposing forces, which build tension until they produce something qualitatively different
example: After the housing society meeting erupted and then produced a sensible parking rule, Kavya called it dialectical materialism in action.

hindi: उभयसत्यवाद — कुछ विरोधाभासी कथनों के सचमुच सत्य होने का मत
definition: the view that some contradictions are actually true, meaning a statement and its negation can both be true, as some claim for the liar paradox
example: Accused of being both early and late to the meeting, Kiran defended himself with dialetheism, which did not impress his manager.

hindi: अन्योन्याश्रय दोष — दो बातों का एक-दूसरे को सिद्ध करने का चक्र
definition: the ancient sceptical name for circular reasoning, where a claim supports a standard of proof that itself depends on that same claim
example: Riya trusted the clock because it matched her phone and trusted her phone because it matched the clock, a diallelus ticking on the kitchen wall.

hindi: विमर्शात्मक — अंतर्ज्ञान के बजाय क्रमबद्ध तर्क से निष्कर्ष तक पहुँचने वाला
definition: describing thinking that reaches a conclusion through step-by-step reasoning and argument rather than through direct intuition
example: Her dianoetic approach to choosing a phone involved a spreadsheet, three columns of pros and cons and zero gut feeling.

hindi: नियंत्रण-द्वैत — अपने वश और पराये वश की बातों का स्टोइक विभाजन
definition: the Stoic teaching that some things, like your judgements and choices, depend on you, while others, like weather or reputation, do not, so only the first deserve your worry
example: Stuck behind a tractor on the highway, Dev reminded himself of the dichotomy of control and switched from honking to his favourite podcast.

hindi: द्विभाजन विरोधाभास — आधी-आधी दूरी की अनंत श्रृंखला से गति असंभव बताने वाला तर्क
definition: Zeno's paradox arguing that motion is impossible because, before reaching any destination, you must first cover half the distance, then half of the remainder, endlessly
example: Walking to the fridge at midnight, Varun joked that the dichotomy paradox explained why he never reached the ice cream.

hindi: भिन्नता नारीवाद — स्त्रियों के विशिष्ट मूल्यों और अनुभवों को महत्त्व देने का मत
definition: the form of feminism that emphasizes real or cultural differences between women and males, and argues that women's distinctive values deserve equal esteem
example: Arguing that caring skills deserved higher salaries, Kiran took a difference feminism approach rather than asking women to act like executives.

hindi: अंतर का सिद्धांत — असमानता तभी उचित है जब उससे सबसे वंचित लोगों का भला हो
definition: Rawls's principle that social and economic inequalities are acceptable only when they work to the greatest benefit of the least advantaged members of society
example: Meera defended the bigger bonus for the night shift under the difference principle, since it kept the café open for the students who needed it most.

hindi: विवाद-गतिरोध — ऐसा विवाद जिसे किसी साझा नियम से सुलझाया न जा सके
definition: Lyotard's term for a conflict between parties that cannot be fairly settled because no shared rule or language exists that does justice to both sides
example: The argument between the landlord's contract and the tenant's memories of a spoken promise was a true differend.

hindi: विभेदक गुण — वह विशेषता जो किसी उपजाति को उसी जाति के बाकी सदस्यों से अलग करती है
definition: in Aristotelian definition, the distinguishing feature that separates one species from the others within the same broader class, such as rational separating humans from other animals
example: Every snack at the party was fried, so the differentia of the samosa, Mohit decided, was its triangular shape.

hindi: विलंबित भेद — अर्थ का अंतर से बनना और सदा आगे टलते रहना
definition: Derrida's term for the idea that words gain meaning only through their difference from other words, so meaning is always deferred and never fully present
example: Every dictionary definition sent Tanvi to three more words, which she decided was différance working overtime on her homework.

hindi: दिगम्बर — निर्वस्त्र मुनि-परंपरा वाला जैन संप्रदाय
definition: one of the two main branches of Jainism, whose monks renounce all possessions including clothing and which holds that liberation requires this complete renunciation
example: In the comparative religion class, Rhea explained that Digambara means sky-clad, because the monks keep nothing, not even clothes.

hindi: अंकीय द्वैतवाद — यह मत कि जाल-जगत का जीवन और प्रत्यक्ष जीवन दो अलग लोक हैं
definition: the view that online life and offline life are separate, opposing worlds, with the digital realm treated as less real than physical, face-to-face existence
example: Insisting that a friendship formed in a group chat could not count as real, Uncle Suresh displayed textbook digital dualism.

hindi: न्यायशीलता — दूसरों को उनका उचित भाग देने की स्थायी वृत्ति
definition: the Greek virtue of justice, the settled character trait of treating others fairly and giving each person what they are rightly owed
example: Splitting the pizza bill according to who ate what, Aman called his spreadsheet an exercise in dikaiosyne.

hindi: ह्रासमान सीमांत उपयोगिता — हर अतिरिक्त इकाई से मिलने वाले सुख के घटते जाने का सिद्धांत
definition: the principle that each extra unit of money or goods adds less wellbeing than the previous unit, which utilitarians employ to argue for helping poorer people
example: By the fourth slice of pizza, Yash understood diminishing marginal utility better than any economics lecture had managed.

hindi: उन्मत्त-उल्लासमय — नीत्शे के अनुसार उन्माद, आवेग, उल्लास और सीमाओं के टूटने से जुड़ा
definition: in Nietzsche's early thought, relating to frenzy, passion, intoxication and the dissolving of boundaries, the force opposing Apollonian order and restraint
example: The wedding sangeet turned fully Dionysian once the uncles took over the dance floor.

hindi: प्रत्यक्ष उपपत्ति — आधारों से सीधे क्रमबद्ध चरणों द्वारा निष्कर्ष तक पहुँचने वाली उपपत्ति
definition: a proof that moves straight from accepted premises or axioms to the conclusion through valid steps, without assuming the opposite of what is proved
example: Rather than argue in circles, Farah gave a direct proof: the receipt, the date and the bank alert settled who paid for dinner.

hindi: प्रत्यक्ष यथार्थवाद — प्रत्यक्ष में बाहरी वस्तुओं के सीधे ज्ञान का मत
definition: the view that in ordinary perception we are directly aware of physical objects themselves, rather than first perceiving some mental image or sense data that stands between us and them
example: Defending direct realism over breakfast, Rahul tapped the toast and said he was perceiving bread, not some private picture of bread.

hindi: प्रत्यक्ष निर्देश सिद्धांत — यह मत कि नाम बिना वर्णनात्मक अर्थ के सीधे वस्तु से जुड़ते हैं
definition: the view that certain words, especially proper names and indexicals, refer straight to their objects without passing through any descriptive meaning or sense
example: Defending direct reference theory in class, Isha argued that 'Bruno' names her dog without meaning 'the animal that chews every shoe'.

hindi: अनुरूपता की दिशा — मानसिक अवस्था का संसार से मेल खाने या संसार को उससे मिलाने का भेद
definition: the contrast between states like beliefs, which should change to match the world, and states like desires, which seek to change the world to match them
example: Staring at her shopping list, Hina grasped direction of fit: the list told the trolley what to hold, while her receipt had to match the trolley.

hindi: निर्देशक कथन — श्रोता से कुछ करवाने का प्रयास करने वाली वाक्-क्रिया
definition: in speech act theory, an utterance whose purpose is getting the listener to do something, including orders, requests, advice and invitations
example: "Someone should really take the bins out" is a directive dressed up as an observation about the universe.

hindi: अनुशासनिक आधारसमूह — किसी वैज्ञानिक समुदाय के साझा सिद्धांत, विधियाँ और मूल्य
definition: Kuhn's later term for the shared theories, methods, values and model problems that bind a scientific community together
example: Joining the lab, Meera absorbed its disciplinary matrix within weeks: which journals count, which methods impress, which jokes land.

hindi: अनुशासनात्मक सत्ता — प्रशिक्षण और निगरानी से व्यक्तियों को ढालने वाली शक्ति
definition: Foucault's term for power that shapes individual bodies and habits through training, timetables, surveillance, examinations and ranking in schools, armies, factories and prisons
example: The school bell, the seating chart and the weekly test together made disciplinary power feel like ordinary Tuesday.

hindi: तर्कमूलक — अंतर्ज्ञान से नहीं, क्रमबद्ध तर्क से निष्कर्ष तक पहुँचने वाला
definition: reaching a conclusion step by step through reasoning and argument, rather than grasping it all at once by intuition
example: Geometry proofs are discursive: you cannot just feel that the angles add up, you have to walk there line by line.

hindi: विमर्श-रचना — किसी विषय पर बोलने के नियमों की व्यवस्था
definition: Foucault's term for a system of rules that governs what can be said, who may speak and which statements count as serious about a given subject
example: Once the office adopted 'synergy' and 'bandwidth', a whole discursive formation decided which complaints sounded professional.

hindi: निष्काम आनंद — बिना स्वार्थ या इच्छा के सौंदर्य से मिलने वाला सुख
definition: Kant's term for the enjoyment of beauty that involves no desire to own, consume or profit from the object, only delight in contemplating its form
example: Admiring a sunset from the bus window, Shreya felt pure disinterested pleasure, at least until she started planning an Instagram post.

hindi: निष्कामता — किसी वस्तु को उपयोग या स्वार्थ की इच्छा के बिना केवल देखने-सराहने का भाव
definition: the attitude of enjoying something purely for how it looks or sounds, without any personal desire to possess, consume or profit from it
example: Staring at the bakery window, Kavya claimed pure disinterestedness about the chocolate cake, which fooled nobody once she asked the price.

hindi: वियोजन — दो कथनों को 'या' से जोड़ने वाला कथन, जो कम से कम एक के सत्य होने पर सत्य है
definition: a compound statement formed by linking a pair of statements with the word 'or', which counts as true whenever either linked part, or both, is true
example: When the waiter offered 'rice or naan', Dev insisted the disjunction was true if he ordered both, and the waiter was not amused.

hindi: वियोजन समस्या — भ्रामक कारणों से अर्थ के ‘यह या वह’ बन जाने की समस्या
definition: the problem for causal theories of content that if both horses and cattle glimpsed at dusk trigger a thought, the theory seems to claim it means horse-or-cattle and so can never be mistaken
example: When Ananya's phone kept tagging her brother's face as her father's, she joked that its disjunction problem had merged the whole family into one person.

hindi: विकल्पवाद — सच्चे प्रत्यक्ष और विभ्रम को मूलतः भिन्न अनुभव मानने का मत
definition: the view that genuine perception and a matching hallucination are fundamentally different kinds of experience, sharing no common inner core, even though the person having them cannot tell them apart
example: When Zoya mistook a coat on the chair for her flatmate, she cited disjunctivism: that experience was a different kind of thing from actually seeing her flatmate.

hindi: उपकरण-तंत्र — सत्ता चलाने वाले संस्थानों, नियमों और प्रथाओं का जाल
definition: Foucault's term for the network of institutions, laws, buildings, practices and statements that together work to manage and shape people
example: Airport security, with its queues, signs, scanners and polite warnings, was a dispositif built for shoeless compliance.

hindi: प्रवृत्तिगत सारवाद — यह मत कि गुणों का सार ही उनकी क्षमताएँ हैं, इसलिए प्रकृति के नियम अनिवार्य हैं
definition: the view that natural properties have their powers essentially, so the laws of nature flow from what those properties are and could not have been otherwise
example: In physics class, Isha used dispositional essentialism to argue that charge without attraction would simply not be charge at all.

hindi: स्वभावगत सहजज्ञानवाद — यह मत कि मन में जन्म से ज्ञान नहीं, पर उसे बनाने की प्रवृत्ति होती है
definition: the view that the mind is born holding not finished ideas but built-in tendencies that reliably produce certain ideas once experience triggers them
example: Reena called her dispositional innatism a compromise: nobody is born knowing chess, but everyone seems born ready to argue about rules.

hindi: प्रवृत्तिगत गुण — किसी स्थिति में विशेष ढंग से व्यवहार करने की वस्तु की क्षमता
definition: a property that consists in a tendency or power to behave in a certain manner under certain conditions, such as fragility, solubility or magnetism
example: Sugar's solubility, Arjun lectured while stirring his tea, is a dispositional property, which is why the spoon deserved no special credit.

hindi: प्रवृत्तिवाद — गुणों को मूलतः किसी विशेष ढंग से व्यवहार करने की क्षमताओं के रूप में देखने का मत
definition: the view that the basic properties of things are dispositions, meaning readinesses to behave in certain ways under certain conditions, like fragility being readiness to shatter
example: Holding the wobbly flat-pack shelf, Farhan's dispositionalism was clear: its deepest property was a readiness to collapse.

hindi: दूरीकरण — लिखित पाठ का अपने लेखक और मूल संदर्भ से स्वतंत्र हो जाना
definition: Ricoeur's term for the process by which a written text becomes independent of its author and original setting, opening itself to fresh interpretations
example: Thanks to distanciation, Amit's old holiday post now meant something entirely different to everyone reading it years later.

hindi: वितरित संज्ञान — यह मत कि चिंतन अनेक लोगों, साधनों और परिवेश में बँटा रहता है
definition: the view that cognition, meaning thinking and problem solving, is spread across several people, devices and surroundings working together, rather than sitting inside one brain
example: The quiz team's answer came from Anu's memory, Farhan's phone and the scribbles on a napkin, a small triumph of distributed cognition nobody could claim alone.

hindi: वितरणात्मक न्याय — समाज में संसाधनों, अवसरों और बोझ के उचित बँटवारे का विचार
definition: the branch of justice concerned with how a society should fairly share out wealth, income, opportunities and burdens among its members
example: When the office pizza arrived with only six slices for nine people, the break room turned into a heated seminar on distributive justice.

hindi: द्विदेववाद — यह मान्यता कि दो समान शक्ति वाले ईश्वर हैं, प्रायः एक शुभ और एक अशुभ
definition: the view that exactly a pair of deities exist, often equally powerful and opposed, one standing for good and the other for evil
example: After the landlord fixed the heating but broke the lift, Kunal suggested the building ran on ditheism, with two rival powers taking turns.

hindi: विभक्त रेखा — ज्ञान और मत के स्तरों को दर्शाने वाली प्लेटो की रेखा
definition: Plato's image of a line divided into unequal sections that rank levels of awareness, from believing mere images through to understanding the Forms
example: Sorting her notes into rumours, textbook facts and actual understanding, Diya had drawn her own divided line.

hindi: दैवी आदेश सिद्धांत — ईश्वर की आज्ञा को ही नैतिकता का आधार मानने का मत
definition: the view that an action is morally right or wrong simply because a deity commands or forbids it
example: Aditya's divine command theory of the office was that whatever the CEO emailed became the right thing to do by Monday.

hindi: ईश्वरीय अप्रकटता — प्रेममय ईश्वर के स्पष्ट रूप से प्रकट न होने की समस्या
definition: the problem of why a loving deity would stay hidden, leaving sincere seekers without clear evidence of its existence
example: Waiting for a reply from the landlord, Imran joked about divine hiddenness: the rules came from somewhere, but nobody ever saw him.

hindi: दैवी प्रकाश — मनुष्य को सत्य का ज्ञान ईश्वरीय प्रकाश से मिलता है, यह मत
definition: Augustine's view that the human mind can grasp certain, unchanging truths only because the deity shines a kind of inner light upon it
example: After solving the crossword clue in the shower, Leena credited divine illumination rather than the hot water.

hindi: राजाओं का दैवी अधिकार — राजा की सत्ता सीधे ईश्वर से मिलने और प्रजा के प्रति उत्तरदायी न होने का मत
definition: the doctrine that a monarch's authority comes directly from the deity, so the ruler answers only to heaven and subjects may never rightfully resist
example: Claiming the remote by the divine right of kings, Grandpa insisted that the oldest person in the room answers to nobody.

hindi: ईश्वरीय अखंडता — ईश्वर में कोई अंश, भाग या अलग-अलग गुण नहीं, यह मत
definition: the doctrine that the deity has no parts, divisions or separate qualities, so that its goodness, knowledge, power and existence are all one and the same thing
example: Juggling three deadlines, Sana envied divine simplicity: being entirely one thing sounded wonderfully restful.

hindi: भाषिक श्रम-विभाजन — कुछ शब्दों का सटीक अर्थ विशेषज्ञों पर निर्भर होने का विचार
definition: Putnam's idea that ordinary speakers rely on experts to settle the exact meaning of certain words, such as 'elm' or 'gold', which the speakers themselves cannot reliably identify
example: Relying on the division of linguistic labor, Arjun happily talked about 'blockchain' and left its actual meaning to the engineers.

hindi: स्वतंत्रता का चक्कर — अनंत संभावनाओं के सामने होने वाली घबराहट, कीर्केगार्द के अनुसार
definition: Kierkegaard's image of anxiety as the dizzy, spinning feeling of looking down into your own freedom and the endless possibilities it opens
example: A menu with ninety pizza toppings gave Aman the full dizziness of freedom.

hindi: सिद्धांत — किसी समूह या परंपरा द्वारा मान्य और सिखाया गया मत
definition: a belief or set of beliefs taught and accepted as authoritative by a school of thought, religion or political group
example: In their house, the doctrine that whoever cooks does not wash up has never once been challenged.

hindi: करने और होने देने का सिद्धांत — हानि पहुँचाना, हानि होने देने से अधिक गंभीर है
definition: the principle that actively causing harm is morally worse than allowing a similar harm to happen when you could prevent it
example: Explaining why pushing his brother mattered more than not catching him, Ravi leaned on the doctrine of doing and allowing.

hindi: द्वि-परिणाम सिद्धांत — अच्छे उद्देश्य वाले कर्म का पूर्वानुमित पर अनचाहा बुरा परिणाम कुछ शर्तों पर स्वीकार्य है
definition: the principle that causing serious harm as a foreseen side effect of pursuing a good goal may be permitted, while intending that same harm is forbidden
example: Justifying the fire drill that ruined everyone's lunch, the principal invoked the doctrine of double effect: safety intended, soggy sandwiches merely foreseen.

hindi: मध्यम मार्ग का सिद्धांत — सद्गुण को अतिशय और न्यूनता के बीच की स्थिति मानने का मत
definition: Aristotle's teaching that virtue is a settled balance between excess and deficiency in feeling and action, found by practical judgement rather than arithmetic
example: Explaining the doctrine of the mean, the teacher said too little chilli is bland, too much is a crime, and the virtuous cook knows the difference.

hindi: रूढ़ सिद्धांत — बिना प्रमाण के अटल सत्य मान लिया गया मत
definition: a belief or doctrine laid down by an authority as certainly true and not open to question or proof
example: In our office, 'never deploy on Friday' has hardened from sensible advice into dogma.

hindi: विमर्श-क्षेत्र — वह वस्तु-समूह जिसके बारे में परिमाणक 'सभी' या 'कोई' कहते हैं
definition: the collection of objects that the quantifiers in a statement range over, which fixes what 'everything' and 'something' refer to
example: When Rahul announced 'everybody hates Mondays', his colleague asked whether the domain of discourse included the barista who loves double shifts.

hindi: द्वैत चेतना — स्वयं को अपनी और प्रभुत्वशाली समूह की, दोनों आँखों से देखने का अनुभव
definition: Du Bois's term for the divided self-awareness of oppressed people, who constantly view themselves both through their own eyes and through the contemptuous eyes of a dominant group
example: Before every job interview, Samuel described a kind of double consciousness, rehearsing answers while also imagining how the panel would stereotype him.

hindi: दोहरा व्याख्याशास्त्र — ऐसे लोगों की व्याख्या करना जो स्वयं अपनी दुनिया की व्याख्या करते हैं
definition: the idea, from Anthony Giddens, that social science interprets people who already interpret their own world, and its findings then change those interpretations
example: After the survey on office morale was shared, the double hermeneutic kicked in and everyone started performing enthusiasm.

hindi: द्वि-निषेध — किसी कथन के निषेध का निषेध, जो मूल कथन के समतुल्य माना जाता है
definition: the principle that denying the denial of a statement gives back the original statement, so a doubly denied claim says exactly what the plain claim says
example: When Kavya said she was 'not unhappy' with the haircut, her friend invoked double negation and declared her thrilled.

hindi: द्वि-निषेध निरसन — 'असत्य नहीं' से 'सत्य' निकालने का नियम
definition: the rule of classical logic that from 'it is false that the statement is false' you may conclude the statement itself, a rule that intuitionistic logic rejects
example: When Maya said she was not unhappy with the haircut, her stylist applied double negation elimination and wrongly booked her next appointment.

hindi: द्विसत्य सिद्धांत — एक बात दर्शन में सत्य और धर्म में असत्य हो सकती है, यह आरोपित मत
definition: the doctrine, attributed by critics to Latin Averroists, that something could be true in philosophy while its opposite is true in theology
example: Claiming the diet had worked in theory but the scale disagreed, Pooja defended a double truth about her weekend.

hindi: अधोमुखी कारणता — ऊँचे स्तर के संपूर्ण द्वारा अपने ही अंशों पर प्रभाव डालना
definition: the idea that a whole system, such as a mind or society, can causally influence the behaviour of its own smaller parts, rather than causation only flowing upward
example: When the whole office went quiet and each person started whispering, Rhea pointed to downward causation from the room's mood.

hindi: मत — इंद्रियजगत पर आधारित अस्थिर विश्वास, जो सच्चा ज्ञान नहीं
definition: the Greek word for opinion or belief about the changing world of appearances, which Plato and Parmenides contrasted with true, stable knowledge
example: Most of the office's confident predictions about the new boss were pure doxa, based on one handshake.

hindi: विश्वासगत औचित्य — किसी व्यक्ति के विश्वास का सही कारणों पर वास्तव में टिका होना
definition: the justification a person's actual belief has when it is held for the good reasons available, not merely alongside them
example: Kunal had solid evidence his flatmate ate the biscuits but blamed the ghost, so he lacked doxastic justification.

hindi: विश्वास-तर्कशास्त्र — 'मानना' या आस्था से जुड़े कथनों का प्रकारमूलक तर्क
definition: a modal logic of belief that adds an operator for 'the agent believes that', studying how beliefs combine even when, unlike knowledge, they turn out false
example: Doxastic logic helped Manav describe his uncle, who believed the cricket match was fixed and also believed his team would surely win it.

hindi: विश्वास-स्वेच्छावाद — विश्वास को इच्छा से चुना जा सकने वाला मानने का मत
definition: the view that people can choose what they believe by an effort of will, much like choosing an action
example: Trying to believe the Monday meeting would be short, Esha tested doxastic voluntarism and failed within minutes.

hindi: द्रव्य — वैशेषिक और जैन दर्शन में गुण और कर्म का आधार भूत पदार्थ
definition: in Vaisheshika and Jain philosophy, a substance, meaning the basic kind of being in which qualities and motions reside, such as earth, water, time or soul
example: Listing the nine dravya of Vaisheshika for her exam, Ira wondered where her phone charger fitted, and settled on earth with a cable attached.

hindi: स्वप्न तर्क — जाग्रत और स्वप्न में भेद न कर पाने का तर्क
definition: the sceptical argument that since dreams can feel completely real, we cannot be certain that our present waking experience is not a dream
example: Waking up convinced he had already submitted the report, Yash learned the hard lesson of the dream argument.

hindi: दृष्टि-सृष्टि वाद — मत कि जगत देखने के साथ ही रचा जाता है
definition: the Advaita doctrine that the world is created by perception and exists only while perceived, rather than standing independently waiting to be seen
example: Refusing to open his inbox, Omkar cited drishti-srishti-vada: unread emails simply did not exist yet.

hindi: डूबता बालक तर्क — दूर के पीड़ितों की सहायता के नैतिक दायित्व पर तर्क
definition: Peter Singer's argument that, since you would ruin expensive shoes to rescue a child drowning in a shallow pond, distance alone cannot excuse you from helping people dying of poverty far away
example: After the drowning child argument came up at lunch, Priya looked at her third iced latte of the week and set up a monthly donation.

hindi: द्विपक्षीय एकतत्ववाद — एक ही मूल सत्ता के मानसिक और भौतिक, दो पहलू हैं, ऐसा मत
definition: the view that there is one underlying reality which shows itself in two aspects, the mental seen from within and the physical seen from outside
example: Flipping a coin during the debate, Ira explained dual-aspect monism: one coin, two faces, and never a second coin hiding underneath.

hindi: दोहरे उपयोग की दुविधा — एक ही शोध या तकनीक के भले और हानिकारक दोनों कामों में प्रयुक्त हो सकने की समस्या
definition: the dilemma that the same research or technology can serve both helpful and harmful purposes, such as medicine and weapons, making openness risky
example: The chemistry club's dual-use dilemma came down to whether the recipe for stink bombs belonged in the newsletter.

hindi: द्वैतवाद — यथार्थ को दो मूल तत्त्वों, जैसे मन और पदार्थ, से बना मानने का मत
definition: the view that reality is made of a pair of fundamentally different kinds of thing, usually mind and matter, or sometimes good and evil
example: Insisting that his exhausted body went to the gym while his mind stayed in bed, Nikhil gave a sleepy defence of dualism.

hindi: दुहेम-क्वाइन सिद्धांत — यह मत कि परिकल्पना अकेले नहीं, सहायक धारणाओं के साथ ही परखी जाती है
definition: the thesis that no hypothesis can be tested alone, since predictions follow only from whole bundles of assumptions, so failed predictions never pinpoint which assumption failed
example: When the group project flopped, Ananya invoked the Duhem-Quine thesis to argue nobody could prove it was her slides.

hindi: दुःख — जीवन में व्याप्त असंतोष और पीड़ा
definition: the Buddhist teaching that ordinary life is marked by suffering, unease and dissatisfaction, because everything people cling to changes and slips away
example: Stuck in traffic with a melting ice cream in the back seat, Kabir decided he finally understood dukkha.

hindi: शक्ति — अरस्तू के यहाँ बनने या करने की अंतर्निहित क्षमता
definition: the Greek word Aristotle uses for capacity or potential, the power within a thing to change, become something else or perform an activity
example: The coach said the new striker had plenty of dunamis, which the team translated as talent that still refused to turn up on match day.

hindi: आत्म-कर्तव्य — अपने प्रति नैतिक कर्तव्य, जैसे अपनी प्रतिभा विकसित करना और आत्म-सम्मान बनाए रखना
definition: moral duties owed to your own person, such as developing your talents and keeping self-respect, which Kant considered as binding as duties toward others
example: Skipping sleep for a fourth night of gaming, Ayesha was reminded by her roommate that duties to oneself include eight hours.

hindi: कर्तव्य — वह कर्म जिसे नैतिक नियम के कारण करना अनिवार्य है
definition: an action that morality requires of someone, whatever their wishes, and which in deontology matters more than the good outcomes it brings
example: Siddharth didn't want to tell his boss about the billing mistake, but duty, and the audit next week, won the argument.

hindi: कर्तव्य-नीति — नैतिक मूल्यांकन को कर्तव्यों और नियमों के पालन पर आधारित करने वाला नीतिशास्त्र
definition: another name for deontology: ethical theory that judges actions by whether they keep the duties and moral rules binding every person, rather than by outcomes
example: Karan's duty ethics meant he returned the extra change to the café cashier, which his friends called noble and slightly slow.

hindi: परोपकार का कर्तव्य — दूसरों का भला करने और उनकी स्थिति सुधारने का कर्तव्य
definition: the duty to help other people and improve their wellbeing, counted by Ross as prima facie and by Kant as an imperfect duty
example: Helping the new student find the chemistry lab was Mira's duty of beneficence, plus a chance to skip the queue.

hindi: निष्ठा का कर्तव्य — वचन निभाने और सच बोलने का प्रथमदृष्ट्या कर्तव्य
definition: in Ross's list of duties, the prima facie duty to keep your promises and to avoid lying or deceiving others
example: Having promised to proofread the report, Harsh felt the duty of fidelity keep him at his desk past seven.

hindi: कृतज्ञता का कर्तव्य — उपकार करने वालों के प्रति आभार और प्रत्युपकार का प्रथमदृष्ट्या कर्तव्य
definition: in Ross's list of duties, the prima facie duty to return kindness and show thanks toward people who have helped you
example: Remembering who covered his shift last month, Yash felt the duty of gratitude and volunteered for her Saturday.

hindi: क्षतिपूर्ति का कर्तव्य — अपने द्वारा पहुँचाई हानि की भरपाई करने का प्रथमदृष्ट्या कर्तव्य
definition: in Ross's list of duties, the prima facie duty to make amends for harm or wrong you have previously caused another person
example: After spilling coffee on his colleague's notes, Imran accepted his duty of reparation and bought her a fresh notebook and a latte.

hindi: द्वैत — मध्व का मत कि ईश्वर और जीव सदा भिन्न हैं
definition: Madhva's school of Vedanta holding that the individual self and Brahman, understood as the deity Vishnu, are eternally separate and never merge, even after liberation
example: Arjun defended dvaita at dinner, insisting he and the chef would remain eternally distinct no matter how much biryani he ate.

hindi: द्वैताद्वैत — निम्बार्क का मत कि जीव ब्रह्म से भिन्न भी है और अभिन्न भी
definition: Nimbarka's school of Vedanta holding that the individual self and Brahman are naturally both different and not different, the self depending wholly on Brahman
example: In the group chat, Tanvi called her relationship with her phone dvaitadvaita: separate devices, yet somehow never apart.

hindi: गतिशील उदात्त — प्रचंड प्राकृतिक शक्ति को सुरक्षित दूरी से देखकर उपजा विस्मय-भाव
definition: Kant's name for the overwhelming wonder people feel when watching an immense natural power, such as a volcano or a storm, from a place of safety where it cannot actually harm them
example: Watching the cyclone footage from her cosy sofa, Priya said this was the dynamical sublime: terrifying power, plus snacks.

hindi: गतिवाद — जगत को भीतर सक्रिय शक्ति या ऊर्जा से समझाने का मत
definition: any theory that explains the natural world through forces or energy active inside things, rather than through passive, lifeless matter
example: Watching the pressure cooker rattle on the stove, Kabir declared himself a convert to dynamism: clearly the dal had energy of its own.

hindi: दुष्ट-ईश्वरवाद — यह मान्यता कि ईश्वर है पर वह पूर्णतः शुभ नहीं, बल्कि कठोर या दुष्ट भी हो सकता है
definition: the view that a deity exists but is not wholly good, and may be cruel, indifferent or even evil towards creatures
example: After his third rejected visa application, Farhan half-seriously flirted with dystheism, suspecting the deity in charge of paperwork was simply unkind.

hindi: दान हेतु कमाई — अधिक कमाने वाला पेशा चुनकर आय का बड़ा हिस्सा दान करने की रणनीति
definition: the strategy of choosing a highly paid career deliberately so that a large share of the income can be donated to the most effective charities
example: Anika justified her banking job as earning to give, which her flatmates accepted once she paid for the pizza.

hindi: चेतना की सरल समस्याएँ — ध्यान, स्मृति, प्रतिक्रिया जैसी मानसिक क्षमताओं की कार्यप्रणाली समझाने के प्रश्न
definition: the questions about how the brain performs functions like attention, memory, reporting and reacting, which science can study directly even though they are far from simple
example: Her neuroscience lecturer admitted that the easy problems of consciousness had kept his entire lab busy for twenty years.

hindi: प्रतिध्वनि-कक्ष — ऐसा समुदाय जो बाहरी स्रोतों पर जानबूझकर अविश्वास सिखाता है
definition: a social community whose members are taught to actively distrust every outside source, so contrary voices are heard but systematically discredited
example: The forum had become an echo chamber: any member quoting an outside expert was instantly branded a paid shill.

hindi: समन्वयवाद — अनेक दर्शनों से उत्तम विचार चुनकर जोड़ने की पद्धति
definition: the ancient practice, associated with Cicero, of selecting what seems best from several philosophical schools rather than following a single system
example: Juhi's diet showed pure eclecticism: keto breakfast, vegan lunch and whatever her grandmother cooked for dinner.

hindi: पारिस्थितिकीकेंद्रवाद — जीवों के बजाय पूरे पारिस्थितिक तंत्रों, प्रजातियों और भू-दृश्यों को मूल्यवान मानने का मत
definition: the view that whole ecosystems, species and landscapes, rather than individual creatures, are the main holders of value that moral thinking should protect
example: During the river cleanup, Dev argued from ecocentrism that the whole watershed mattered more than any single stranded fish.

hindi: पर्यावरणीय नारीवाद — स्त्री और प्रकृति के शोषण को जुड़ा हुआ मानने का मत
definition: the view that the domination of women and the exploitation of nature are connected, both arising from similar patterns of patriarchal thinking
example: At the tree-planting drive, the organizer's speech about forests and village women's labour turned into an impromptu lesson in ecofeminism.

hindi: पर्यावरण-दर्शन — प्रकृति के साथ सामंजस्य पर आधारित व्यक्तिगत पारिस्थितिक जीवन-दृष्टि
definition: a personal philosophy of ecological harmony and balance, worked out by each person, that guides how they live within nature
example: Nikhil's ecosophy, as far as his flatmates could tell, consisted mostly of a compost bin and very strong opinions about it.

hindi: उन्नायक दर्शन — अंतिम सत्य नहीं, बल्कि संवाद जारी रखने वाला दर्शन
definition: Rorty's term for philosophy that aims to keep conversation going and unsettle fixed ideas, rather than build a permanent system that settles every question
example: Their late-night debate club practised edifying philosophy: nobody won, but everyone left thinking differently.

hindi: अमराविक्षेप — किसी प्रश्न पर निश्चित उत्तर देने से फिसलकर बचना
definition: the name early Buddhist texts gave to certain sceptics' evasive refusal to commit to any answer, wriggling slipperily away from every question
example: Asked whether she had started the assignment, Payal answered with pure eel-wriggling: it neither was nor was not begun.

hindi: प्रभावी परोपकारवाद — प्रमाण और तर्क से यह खोजकर कि किस तरह सबसे अधिक भला हो, वैसा ही परोपकार करने का आंदोलन
definition: the movement and philosophy of using evidence and careful reasoning to find the ways of helping others that do the most good for each rupee or hour spent
example: Mehul's effective altruism spreadsheet ranked every charity by lives saved, then quietly left out his cousin's marathon fundraiser.

hindi: प्रभावी इतिहास — किसी कृति की व्याख्याओं का इतिहास जो हमारी समझ को आकार देता है
definition: Gadamer's term for the history of a work's influence and interpretations, which inevitably shapes how later readers understand that work
example: Reading the famous novel for class, Jiya realised effective history had already spoiled the ending through a hundred memes.

hindi: निमित्त कारण — वह कारक जो किसी वस्तु को उत्पन्न या परिवर्तित करता है
definition: in Aristotle's scheme of four causes, the agent or source of change that produces a thing, such as the carpenter who builds a table
example: The broken printer's efficient cause, the whole office agreed, was whoever jammed forty pages of glossy card into it.

hindi: समतावाद — सभी मनुष्यों को समान मानने और समान अधिकार देने का मत
definition: the view that all people are equal in worth and should have equal political, economic and social rights and chances; also called equalitarianism
example: The flat's egalitarianism is written on the fridge: everyone takes out the rubbish, landlord's nephew included.

hindi: अहं-सिद्धांत — अनुभवों के पीछे एक स्थायी, अलग स्वामी या आत्मा के होने का मत
definition: Parfit's label for the view that behind a person's thoughts and experiences stands a separate permanent subject that owns them and explains the unity of a whole life
example: Arguing against his flatmate's bundle theory, Kunal defended ego theory by pointing out that someone clearly owned all those dirty dishes.

hindi: स्वार्थवाद — अपने हित को ही नैतिकता की कसौटी मानने का मत
definition: the ethical view that each person should pursue their own welfare, treating self-interest as the proper basis of morality
example: Arguing that he only returned the lost wallet to feel good about himself, Kabir defended egoism all the way to the metro station.

hindi: सारगत अपचयन — किसी वस्तु के आवश्यक सार तक पहुँचने की विधि
definition: Husserl's method of imagining many variations of something until you discover which features it cannot lose, revealing its essential nature or essence
example: Testing chairs in the furniture store, Kabir ran an eidetic reduction and concluded that a chair without legs is still a chair, just a disappointing one.

hindi: प्रतिमाएँ — वस्तुओं से निकलकर इंद्रियों तक आने वाली सूक्ष्म परतों का प्राचीन यूनानी मत
definition: in the theory of the ancient Greek atomists, who held that everything is made of tiny particles, thin films or images constantly shed from the surfaces of objects, which travel through space and enter the senses to produce perception
example: Trying to spot her friend across the crowded mall, Mehek wished the eidola would hurry up and deliver a clearer image.

hindi: रूप — किसी वस्तु का शाश्वत आदर्श आकार या सार
definition: the Greek word Plato used for a Form, the perfect, eternal pattern or essence that makes a thing the kind of thing it is
example: Every sketch Arnav drew of a chair fell short, as if he was chasing the eidos of chair and landing on a wobbly stool.

hindi: एन सोफ़ — कब्बाला में अनंत, अज्ञेय ईश्वरीय सत्ता
definition: in Kabbalah, the infinite and unknowable divine reality, beyond every name, description and attribute the human mind can form
example: Trying to describe the size of the internet, Maya gave up and called it the Ein Sof of cat videos.

hindi: समानुभूति — दूसरे व्यक्ति के अनुभव को भीतर से महसूस करना
definition: the German term, central for Husserl and Edith Stein, for empathy: directly experiencing another person as a feeling, perceiving subject like yourself
example: When Rahul winced at his friend's stubbed toe, his Einfühlung was so vivid he checked his own foot.

hindi: आइंस्टाइन का उस्तरा — व्याख्या को सरल रखो, पर आवश्यकता से अधिक सरल नहीं
definition: the principle that a theory should be made as simple as possible while never becoming simpler than the facts it must explain
example: Priya used Einstein's razor on her group's slideshow, trimming the fluff but keeping the chart that actually proved their point.

hindi: महाप्रलय-अग्नि — ब्रह्मांड का आवधिक अग्नि में विलय और पुनर्जन्म
definition: the Stoic doctrine that the whole universe periodically dissolves into fire and is then reborn, repeating the same cycle endlessly
example: After the toast caught fire for the third time that week, Varun declared the kitchen was undergoing its own ekpyrosis.

hindi: एलियावाद — परिवर्तन और बहुलता को भ्रम मानकर सत् को एक और अचल मानने का मत
definition: the doctrine of Parmenides and his followers in Elea that reality is single, unchanging and motionless, and that change and plurality are illusions of the senses
example: Stuck in a traffic jam that had not moved for forty minutes, Rohit announced that Eleaticism had been right all along: motion was an illusion.

hindi: खंडन-विधि — प्रश्नों द्वारा किसी मत का आंतरिक विरोध दिखाना
definition: Socrates's style of questioning someone about their belief until the answers reveal that the belief contradicts itself
example: By the fourth question about why pineapple belonged on pizza, Aditya realised Meera's elenchus had quietly dismantled his whole position.

hindi: निरसनात्मक भौतिकवाद — विश्वास और इच्छा जैसी धारणाओं को भ्रामक मानकर त्यागने का मत
definition: the view that everyday concepts like belief and desire belong to a mistaken theory of the mind, and that a mature brain science will abandon them rather than explain them
example: Rohan claimed eliminative materialism excused him from his promise, since strictly speaking he had never believed he would wash the dishes.

hindi: निरसनवादी संरचनावाद — संरचनाओं को अलग वस्तु न मानकर केवल ठोस व्यवस्थाओं के बारे में सामान्य कथन मानने का मत
definition: the version of mathematical structuralism holding that mathematical structures are nothing over and above actual systems, so statements about numbers are really general claims about every system sharing that pattern
example: Neha's eliminative structuralism meant that 'three' was just a pattern shared by triplets, tricycles and her three unanswered emails.

hindi: निरसनवाद — किसी संदिग्ध श्रेणी को सुधारने के बजाय पूरी तरह हटा देने का मत
definition: the general view that some familiar category, most often beliefs, desires or other everyday mental states, does not really exist and should be dropped from serious theory rather than explained
example: Asked how she felt about the team offsite, Meera pleaded eliminativism: feelings were an outdated theory, and she simply had elevated cortisol.

hindi: उद्गमवाद — सारी सृष्टि को एक परम स्रोत से क्रमिक प्रवाह मानने का मत
definition: the view that everything flows outward in stages from a single perfect source, as light spreads outward from a flame, rather than being made from nothing
example: Watching one leaked rumour spread from the manager's cabin to every desk, Kiran called it office emanationism.

hindi: देहगत संबंध — जब साधन शरीर का अंग बनकर अनुभव का माध्यम हो जाता है
definition: Ihde's term for a relation in which a device becomes part of bodily experience, as glasses or a walking stick do, so people perceive through it rather than noticing it
example: After a week with new hearing aids, Kiran forgot he was wearing them at all, a classic embodiment relation in the middle of a noisy office.

hindi: उद्भव — संपूर्ण में ऐसे गुण प्रकट होना जो उसके अंशों में नहीं होते
definition: the idea that a whole system can show genuinely novel properties, such as life or consciousness, which none of its separate parts possess on their own
example: Watching twenty strangers in the office group chat suddenly agree on pizza, Neha called it a textbook case of emergence.

hindi: उद्भववाद — जटिल भौतिक व्यवस्थाओं से मन जैसे नए गुण उभरते हैं जो अंशों में नहीं होते, ऐसा मत
definition: the view that consciousness and other mental properties arise from complex physical systems as genuinely new features not present in their separate parts
example: Watching the office chatter become a single roar of laughter, Pooja cited emergentism to explain why the whole felt more than its people.

hindi: प्राण — योरूबा परंपरा में सृष्टिकर्ता द्वारा दी गई जीवन-श्वास, जो शरीर को जीवित रखती है
definition: in Yoruba thought, the vital breath or life force given by the creator deity that animates the body and keeps a person alive
example: Gasping after climbing to the fifth floor, Bisi joked that her emi was filing a formal complaint about the broken lift.

hindi: भावनावाद — नैतिक कथनों को वक्ता की भावनाओं की अभिव्यक्ति मानने का मत
definition: the view that moral statements express the speaker's emotions of approval or disapproval rather than stating facts, much like cheering or booing
example: A fan of emotivism, Kabir claimed his mother's 'skipping breakfast is wrong' really meant a loud, loving groan of disapproval.

hindi: समानुभूति-परहित परिकल्पना — समानुभूति से वास्तविक परहित-प्रेरणा उपजने की परिकल्पना
definition: the psychological hypothesis that feeling empathy for someone in need produces a genuine desire to help them for their own sake
