example: The empathy-altruism hypothesis seemed confirmed when the whole class chipped in for the janitor after hearing about his flooded home.

hindi: आनुभविक — अनुभव, निरीक्षण या प्रयोग पर आधारित
definition: describes knowledge, claims or methods based on observation, experiment or experience, rather than on reasoning or theory alone
example: The debate over which queue moves fastest finally became empirical when Anjali started a stopwatch.

hindi: अनुभवजन्य पर्याप्तता — सिद्धांत का सभी प्रेक्षणीय तथ्यों से मेल खाना
definition: the property of a theory whose claims about observable things are all correct, whatever it says about unobservable things
example: The weather model had empirical adequacy for Tanya's commute: whatever it believed about clouds, it predicted her soaked umbrella perfectly.

hindi: प्रायोगिक तुल्यता — दो सिद्धांतों का सभी संभव प्रेक्षणों पर एक-सा अनुमान देना
definition: the relation between two rival theories that make exactly the same observable predictions, so that no possible observation could favour either one
example: Two teachers' explanations of the missing marks reached empirical equivalence, predicting identical report cards from rival stories.

hindi: अनुभवमूलक यथार्थवाद — अनुभव की वस्तुओं को पूर्णतः वास्तविक मानने का मत
definition: Kant's view that the objects of everyday experience, such as tables and planets, are fully real and knowable, even though they are only appearances shaped by the mind
example: Meera's empirical realism came out when her brother doubted the stubbed toe: appearance or not, the coffee table was real enough to hurt.

hindi: अनुभववाद — ज्ञान का स्रोत इंद्रियों के अनुभव को मानने का मत
definition: the view that knowledge comes mainly from experience gathered through the senses, rather than from reason or ideas we are born with
example: Her empiricism is simple: she will believe the new café makes good coffee once she has tasted it herself.

hindi: रिक्त नाम — ऐसा नाम जिसका कोई वास्तविक धारक नहीं
definition: a proper name, such as 'Sherlock Holmes' or 'Vulcan', that appears to name something but has no actual bearer, raising puzzles about how sentences containing it can have meaning
example: 'Steve from IT', whom everyone cited but nobody had met, was beginning to look like an empty name.

hindi: क्रियारूप संज्ञानवाद — अनुभव और ज्ञान शरीर की क्रियाओं और परिवेश से संपर्क द्वारा रचे जाते हैं, यह मत
definition: the view that perception and thought are not inner pictures but skilful bodily activity, created as a living creature actively explores its surroundings
example: Watching the toddler learn about the fridge by opening and shutting its door forty times, Sanjay declared enactivism proven beyond doubt.

hindi: अन्वेषण का अंत — वह आदर्श बिंदु जहाँ सभी जाँचकर्ता अंततः एक ही मत पर पहुँचेंगे
definition: Peirce's ideal limit of research, the final opinion that every careful investigator would eventually reach if inquiry continued long enough, which he identified with truth
example: The quiz team joked that the correct pronunciation of 'GIF' would be known only at the end of inquiry, and possibly not even then.

hindi: कल्याणवाद — सच्चे मानवीय कल्याण को नैतिक कर्म की कसौटी मानने का मत
definition: the ethical view that actions should be judged by whether they lead to a flourishing life, a deep well-being gained by living according to reason; a variant spelling of eudemonism
example: His endaemonism made him quit a well-paid job he hated for a smaller one where he actually looked forward to Mondays.

hindi: स्थायित्ववाद — वस्तु हर क्षण पूरी की पूरी उपस्थित रहकर समय में बनी रहती है, यह मत
definition: the view that objects persist through time by being wholly present, entire and complete, at every moment of their existence, rather than being spread across time as separate slices
example: Defending endurantism at dinner, Ravi insisted that all of him had arrived at the restaurant, not merely his Tuesday evening slice.

hindi: सक्रियता — अरस्तू के यहाँ किसी क्षमता का सक्रिय रूप से साकार होना
definition: the Greek word Aristotle uses for actuality or activity, the state of a capacity being fully at work rather than merely possible
example: Everyone knew Sana could sing, but her karaoke performance at the office party was pure energeia.

hindi: संरचन — आधुनिक तकनीक द्वारा सब कुछ उपयोगी संसाधन के रूप में देखना
definition: Heidegger's term for the modern technological outlook that reveals everything, including rivers, forests and people, merely as resources stored for efficient exploitation
example: When the manager called the team 'bandwidth', Shruti whispered that enframing had officially reached their office.

hindi: प्रतिबद्ध — समाज और राजनीति में सक्रिय रूप से जुड़ा हुआ
definition: describing a writer, artist or thinker who is actively committed to social and political causes, reflecting Sartre's belief that freedom demands involvement in the world
example: After three petitions and a protest poster, the once apolitical book club had become thoroughly engagé.

hindi: आत्मसंयम — ग़लत इच्छा को महसूस करते हुए भी उस पर विजय पा लेना
definition: the Greek term for self-control or continence, the state of feeling strong desires against your better judgement but still managing to resist them
example: Walking past the bakery without stopping, jaw clenched, Neel was a living example of enkrateia rather than serene virtue.

hindi: प्रबुद्ध निरंकुशता — जनहित के लिए तर्क से शासन करने वाले असीमित शासक का आदर्श
definition: the idea of a ruler who holds absolute, unchecked power but uses it according to reason to improve the lives of subjects
example: The hostel cook ruled the menu by enlightened despotism: no votes allowed, but somehow the food kept getting better.

hindi: आत्म-प्रवेश — गर्भ में भ्रूण को आत्मा प्राप्त होने का क्षण
definition: the moment at which a developing human embryo or foetus is believed to receive a soul, a question debated in several religious traditions
example: Their comparative religion class spent a whole period on ensoulment, and even the back bench stayed awake.

hindi: आपादन — वह संबंध जिसमें एक कथन की सत्यता दूसरे की सत्यता को अनिवार्य बना दे
definition: the relation between statements where the truth of some guarantees the truth of another, so the second follows necessarily from the first
example: Tara explained the entailment to her flatmate: if the milk is finished, then there is certainly no milk left for his cereal.

hindi: पूर्णसिद्धि — किसी वस्तु की संभावना का पूरी तरह साकार हो जाना
definition: in Aristotle's philosophy, the state of a thing that has fully become what it had the potential to be, like a seed grown into a towering tree
example: Watching her former intern lead the whole product launch, Sunita felt she was witnessing entelechy in a lanyard.

hindi: लुप्तपद न्याय — ऐसा न्यायवाक्य जिसमें कोई आधार-वाक्य या निष्कर्ष अव्यक्त छोड़ दिया गया हो
definition: an argument, often a syllogism, in which one premise or the conclusion is left unstated because the speaker assumes the listener will supply it
example: 'He is a cricket fan, so he will be late tomorrow' was an enthymeme everyone in the office completed without needing the fixture list.

hindi: हक़दारी सिद्धांत — नोज़िक का मत कि न्यायपूर्ण वितरण वही है जो उचित अर्जन और उचित हस्तांतरण से बना हो
definition: Nozick's theory that holdings are just whenever they were acquired fairly or transferred voluntarily, whatever overall pattern of wealth results
example: Citing entitlement theory, Riya refused to share the chips she had bought with her own pocket money, fair and square.

hindi: सत्ता — कोई भी वस्तु जिसका अपना अस्तित्व हो
definition: anything that exists as a distinct thing, whether physical like a table or abstract like a number
example: The debate about whether the company culture was a real entity ended when HR tried to invite it to lunch.

hindi: सत्ता यथार्थवाद — जिन अदृश्य वस्तुओं का प्रयोग में सफल उपयोग हो, उन्हें वास्तविक मानने का मत
definition: the view that unseen entities like electrons are real whenever scientists can reliably manipulate them to produce effects, whatever theories say about them
example: The lab technician's entity realism was practical: if she could spray electrons at a sample, electrons were real enough for her.

hindi: गणनात्मक आगमन — अनेक समान उदाहरण गिनकर सामान्य नियम तक पहुँचना
definition: the simplest form of induction: counting many observed cases that share a feature and concluding that every case of that kind shares it
example: Having counted forty sweet mangoes from the same vendor, Dev trusted enumerative induction and bought a whole crate without tasting one.

hindi: पर्यावरण-नीतिशास्त्र — मनुष्य और प्राकृतिक जगत के नैतिक संबंध का अध्ययन
definition: the branch of ethics that studies the moral relationship between humans and the natural world, including animals, plants, ecosystems and the climate
example: The environmental ethics unit began with a simple question, whether a mountain can be wronged, and ended forty minutes later with no agreement.

hindi: परिवेशवाद — बौद्धिक विकास में आनुवंशिकता से अधिक परिवेश को निर्णायक मानने का मत
definition: the view that surroundings and upbringing matter more than inherited traits in shaping a person's intelligence and character; the opposite of hereditarianism
example: Pointing out that he only learned to cook after moving in with chefs, Rohan made an easy case for environmentalism.

hindi: आगमन — विशेष उदाहरणों से सामान्य सिद्धांत तक पहुँचने की विधि
definition: the Greek term Aristotle uses for induction, reasoning from particular examples toward a general principle
example: After three late buses in a week, Kunal reached a general principle by epagoge: the 8:15 simply does not exist.

hindi: एपिक्यूरसीय तर्क — जहाँ मृत्यु है वहाँ हम नहीं, इसलिए मृत्यु हमारे लिए कुछ भी नहीं
definition: Epicurus's reasoning that death cannot harm anyone, because while we exist death is absent, and once death arrives there is no person left to suffer harm
example: Meera used the Epicurean argument to calm her brother's midnight panic, though he pointed out that it did nothing for his fear of the dentist.

hindi: एपिक्यूरी परमाणुवाद — जगत को शून्य में गतिशील अविभाज्य कणों से बना मानने का मत
definition: the Epicurean theory that everything, including the soul, consists of tiny indivisible particles moving through empty space, with no divine design behind them
example: Sweeping up spilled sugar, Aryan muttered that Epicurean atomism explained everything except why it always reached the far corner.

hindi: एपिक्यूरस का विरोधाभास — ईश्वर की शक्ति, इच्छा और अशुभ के अस्तित्व पर प्रश्न-श्रृंखला
definition: an ancient statement of the problem of evil asking whether a deity is unwilling or unable to prevent evil, since either answer seems to undermine a perfectly good, all-powerful deity
example: When the class hamster died over the holidays, Jaya laid out the Epicurean paradox on the whiteboard: either the universe couldn't save it, or wouldn't, and neither answer cheered anyone up.

hindi: संयमित सुखवाद — भय-मुक्त, सादे आनंद को जीवन का ध्येय मानने वाला यूनानी दर्शन
definition: the philosophy of Epicurus, holding that the goal of life is calm, simple pleasure found in friendship and freedom from fear and pain
example: His epicureanism is modest: good friends, a plate of hot pakoras, and no work emails after seven.

hindi: एपिमेनिडीज़ विरोधाभास — क्रीटवासी का कहना कि सभी क्रीटवासी सदा झूठ बोलते हैं
definition: an ancient version of the liar paradox in which a Cretan speaker claims that all Cretans are always liars, so his own statement seems to undermine itself
example: When Dev announced in the group chat that everyone in the group exaggerates, Priya replied that he had just reinvented the Epimenides paradox.

hindi: उपघटनावाद — मानसिक अवस्थाएँ शारीरिक घटनाओं का परिणाम हैं पर स्वयं कुछ नहीं करतीं, ऐसा मत
definition: the view that mental states are caused by physical events in the brain but themselves cause nothing, like smoke rising from a working engine
example: Ishaan defended his lateness with epiphenomenalism: his intention to leave early existed, it just had no power to move his legs.

hindi: खंडकालिक आत्म — स्वयं को केवल वर्तमान तक सीमित अनुभव करना, दूर अतीत को किसी और का मानना
definition: a manner of experiencing oneself as a self that barely extends beyond the present, so that events from the distant past feel like they happened to someone else
example: Shown her teenage diary, Pallavi shrugged like a true episodic self and said that dramatic girl was nobody she knew.

hindi: ज्ञान — तर्कसिद्ध, स्थिर और निश्चित जानकारी
definition: the Greek word for genuine, well-grounded knowledge that can be explained and justified, which Plato contrasted with mere opinion
example: Rahul's claim that the exam was easy was doxa until he checked the answer key, which turned it into episteme.

hindi: ज्ञानमीमांसीय प्राधिकार — किसी विषय में विश्वसनीय ज्ञाता का दर्जा
definition: the standing of a person or institution whose judgement on some subject gives others good reason to believe their claims about it
example: On anything involving the office coffee machine, the night-shift guard held undisputed epistemic authority.

hindi: ज्ञानमीमांसीय स्वायत्तता — अपने विवेक से विश्वास बनाने की क्षमता
definition: the capacity and right to form your own beliefs through your own reasoning and judgement, rather than simply adopting what others tell you
example: Wanting epistemic autonomy, Riya worked through the maths proof herself instead of copying her friend's finished homework.

hindi: ज्ञानमीमांसीय बुलबुला — ऐसा सूचना-घेरा जिसमें विरोधी स्वर पहुँचते ही नहीं
definition: an information network in which contrary voices are simply missing, usually by accident of who you follow, so that relevant views and evidence never reach you
example: Everyone in her feed loved the same candidate, and Zoya only discovered her epistemic bubble when the election results came in.

hindi: ज्ञानमीमांसीय निश्चितता — प्रमाण द्वारा संदेह का पूर्ण निवारण
definition: the certainty a belief has when the evidence supporting it rules out every possibility of error, regardless of how confident anyone feels
example: Siddharth felt sure the train would come, but he only had epistemic certainty once its doors slid open in front of him.

hindi: ज्ञानमीमांसीय चक्रकता — किसी स्रोत की विश्वसनीयता सिद्ध करने में उसी स्रोत पर निर्भर होना
definition: the situation where you support the reliability of a belief source, such as memory or perception, only by relying on that same source
example: Insisting her memory was reliable because she remembered it being reliable, Shreya walked straight into epistemic circularity.

hindi: ज्ञानमीमांसीय अनुसरण — किसी विषय पर विशेषज्ञ के मत को अपने मत से ऊपर रखना
definition: the practice of adopting someone else's judgement on a question in place of your own, because you have reason to think they know better
example: On the question of the rash, Kunal practised epistemic deference and followed the dermatologist rather than a stranger's forum post.

hindi: ज्ञानमीमांसीय कर्तव्यवाद — औचित्य को विश्वास संबंधी कर्तव्य-पालन के रूप में समझने का मत
definition: the view that justification is a matter of meeting intellectual duties, so a justified belief is one held without breaking any rule of responsible believing
example: Epistemic deontologism kept Rhea checking the recipe twice: believing the oven temperature blindly felt like shirking homework.

hindi: ज्ञानमीमांसीय निर्भरता — अपने ज्ञान के लिए दूसरों पर आश्रित रहना
definition: the condition of relying on other people, especially experts, for much of what you know, because no single person can check everything alone
example: Planning the renovation, Sunita accepted her epistemic dependence on the electrician, since she could not rewire a house from first principles.

hindi: ज्ञानमीमांसीय अहंवाद — केवल अपने प्रमाण को ही विश्वास का उचित आधार मानने का मत
definition: the view that the mere fact that someone else believes something never gives you a reason to believe it, so you must rely only on your own evidence
example: Nidhi's epistemic egoism meant she refused to believe the café was closed until she had walked there and tugged the locked door herself.

hindi: ज्ञानमीमांसीय विनम्रता — अपने ज्ञान की सीमाओं को स्वीकार करने की प्रवृत्ति
definition: the attitude of recognising the limits of your own knowledge and reasoning, and holding beliefs with the confidence the evidence actually supports
example: With real epistemic humility, the uncle admitted in the family group chat that he had forwarded the miracle cure without checking it.

hindi: ज्ञानमीमांसीय अन्याय — किसी को ज्ञाता के रूप में ठेस पहुँचाने वाला अन्याय
definition: the wrong done to someone specifically in their capacity as a knower, when prejudice leads others to discount their word or leaves them without concepts to understand their experience
example: When the new intern's correct answer was ignored until a senior colleague repeated it, the meeting became a quiet lesson in epistemic injustice.

hindi: ज्ञानमीमांसीय औचित्य — किसी विश्वास को सत्य की दृष्टि से उचित बनाने वाला आधार
definition: the property a belief has when it is reasonable from the standpoint of seeking truth, supported by evidence or reliable methods rather than hope
example: Pranav's certainty that his team would win had loyalty behind it but little epistemic justification.

hindi: ज्ञानमीमांसीय तर्कशास्त्र — 'जानना' से जुड़े कथनों का प्रकारमूलक तर्क
definition: a modal logic of knowledge that adds an operator for 'the agent knows that', studying rules such as whether knowing something means knowing that you know it
example: Using epistemic logic, Shreya proved that her friend knew she knew about the surprise party, which rather ruined the surprise.

hindi: ज्ञानमीमांसीय संयोग — सत्य विश्वास तक केवल भाग्यवश पहुँचना
definition: the kind of good fortune by which a belief turns out true through coincidence rather than through reliable reasoning, often thought incompatible with knowledge
example: Guessing the right answer on the quiz after reading the wrong chapter was pure epistemic luck, and Harsh knew it.

hindi: ज्ञानमीमांसीय संयम — अपने निर्णय पर अति-विश्वास न करने की नीति
definition: the policy of giving your own judgement no special priority over the judgement of equally informed others, and holding opinions with measured confidence
example: Out of epistemic modesty, Rahul stopped arguing about the train timetable once three fellow commuters told him the same different time.

hindi: ज्ञानमीमांसीय दमन — किसी समूह को ज्ञान-निर्माण से लगातार बाहर रखना
definition: persistent, structural exclusion of certain groups from producing, sharing and shaping knowledge, which damages their standing as knowers across a whole society
example: Kiran argued that a history syllabus written entirely by outsiders was a small, everyday form of epistemic oppression.

hindi: ज्ञानमीमांसीय अभिभावकवाद — किसी के भले के नाम पर उसकी सूचना-पहुँच पर रोक लगाना
definition: the practice of interfering with what information people can access or consider, without their consent, on the grounds that it will help them reach truer beliefs
example: The judge's ruling that jurors could not hear the defendant's past convictions was a clear example of epistemic paternalism.

hindi: ज्ञानमीमांसीय समकक्ष — किसी विषय पर समान साक्ष्य और क्षमता वाला व्यक्ति
definition: someone who has roughly the same evidence and the same reasoning ability as you on a particular question, so their judgement deserves equal weight to yours
example: On cricket statistics, Farhan admitted his cousin was an epistemic peer, which made losing the argument far more annoying.

hindi: ज्ञानमीमांसीय अनुमतिवाद — एक ही साक्ष्य से भिन्न उचित निष्कर्षों की अनुमति का मत
definition: the view that the same body of evidence can sometimes rationally permit several different attitudes, so people sharing evidence may reasonably disagree
example: Their teacher's epistemic permissivism let both debaters keep their opposite readings of the poem, since each reading fitted the text.

hindi: ज्ञानमीमांसीय संभावना — जो हमारे वर्तमान ज्ञान से असंगत न हो
definition: a kind of possibility tied to knowledge: something is epistemically possible when it is consistent with everything a person currently knows
example: Until the results page loaded, passing the exam remained an epistemic possibility for the whole anxious classroom.

hindi: ज्ञानमीमांसीय आत्मविश्वास — अपनी संज्ञानात्मक क्षमताओं पर मूल भरोसा
definition: the basic reliance a person places on their own faculties, such as perception, memory and reasoning, which all further inquiry seems to require
example: Without some epistemic self-trust, Omar could never have believed his own memory that he had locked the front door.

hindi: ज्ञानमीमांसीय अतिक्रमण — अपनी विशेषज्ञता से बाहर के विषय पर अधिकार से बोलना
definition: the practice of an expert in their own field making confident pronouncements in another field where they lack the relevant knowledge and training
example: The famous surgeon's podcast rant about interest rates was pure epistemic trespassing, delivered with operating-theatre confidence.

hindi: ज्ञानमीमांसीय विश्वास — दूसरों को ज्ञान के स्रोत के रूप में स्वीकार करना
definition: the attitude of relying on another person as a source of knowledge, accepting their word without checking every claim for yourself
example: Every patient who swallows a prescribed tablet without reading the chemistry is exercising epistemic trust in the doctor.

hindi: ज्ञानमीमांसीय दोष — ज्ञान-प्राप्ति में बाधा डालने वाला मन या चरित्र का दोष
definition: a trait of mind or character, such as gullibility, closed-mindedness or intellectual laziness, that obstructs a person's efforts to reach true beliefs and knowledge
example: Believing every headline that confirmed his hunches was Dev's favourite epistemic vice, and his group chat paid the price.

hindi: ज्ञानमीमांसीय सतर्कता — गलत या भ्रामक सूचना से बचने की मानसिक चौकसी
definition: the collection of mental habits by which people check the reliability of speakers and the plausibility of messages, guarding against being misled
example: A little epistemic vigilance made Bina suspicious of the text claiming her parcel needed an urgent fee.

hindi: ज्ञानात्मक हिंसा — हाशिये के समूहों की आवाज़ और ज्ञान को मिटाना
definition: the harm of silencing marginalized people by dismissing, erasing or speaking over their knowledge, voices and ways of understanding the world
example: Reading a history textbook that described her village only through colonial officers' reports, Asha called it epistemic violence.

hindi: ज्ञानमीमांसीय सद्गुण — सच्चे विश्वास और ज्ञान तक पहुँचाने वाला गुण
definition: a trait of mind or character, such as curiosity, carefulness or open-mindedness, that helps a person reach true beliefs and knowledge
example: Patiently reading the whole article before sharing it was a small epistemic virtue that saved Ishaan from a very public correction.

hindi: ज्ञानसीमावाद — अस्पष्ट शब्दों की निश्चित सीमा होती है, बस हम उसे जान नहीं सकते, यह मत
definition: the view that vague words really have sharp boundaries, such as an exact number of hairs for baldness, but that we cannot possibly know where those boundaries fall
example: Neha defended epistemicism over dinner, insisting there was an exact minute when she became late for work even though she could never know which one.

hindi: ज्ञानमीमांसीय अराजकतावाद — विज्ञान पर कोई एक सार्वभौम पद्धति थोपने का विरोध
definition: Feyerabend's view that science has no single universal method, and that insisting on fixed methodological rules would have blocked many great discoveries
example: Meera cited epistemological anarchism to justify solving her maths homework backwards, which her teacher found only partly convincing.

hindi: ज्ञानमीमांसा — ज्ञान के स्वरूप, स्रोत और सीमाओं का अध्ययन
definition: the branch of philosophy that studies knowledge itself: what it is, where it comes from and how we can tell it apart from mere belief
example: A forwarded message about a miracle cure sparked some family-chat epistemology when Aunt Meena asked how anyone actually knew it worked.

hindi: अज्ञान की ज्ञानमीमांसा — सत्ता द्वारा पोषित और टिकाई गई अनभिज्ञता का अध्ययन
definition: the study of the ways ignorance is actively produced and maintained, especially the ways privileged groups avoid knowing uncomfortable facts about injustice
example: In seminar, Dev offered his favourite epistemology of ignorance example: the landlord who somehow never received a single complaint email.

hindi: निर्णय-स्थगन — किसी पक्ष को स्वीकार या अस्वीकार न करना
definition: the sceptical practice of suspending judgement, refusing either to affirm or to deny a claim when arguments on both sides seem equally strong
example: Faced with two group chats giving opposite exam dates, Aditya declared an epoché and emailed the teacher.

hindi: ईपीआर विरोधाभास — क्वांटम सिद्धांत को अधूरा दिखाने हेतु प्रस्तावित विचार-प्रयोग
definition: the thought experiment arguing that quantum theory must be incomplete, since particles linked together, or entangled, seem to have definite properties before measurement that the theory leaves undescribed
example: Priya's physics essay on the EPR paradox was about entangled particles, though her teacher thought the real paradox was her deadline extension.

hindi: समभार-मत — अपने और समकक्ष के मत को बराबर महत्त्व देने का सिद्धांत
definition: the view that when someone equally informed and equally capable disagrees with you, their opinion deserves exactly the same weight as yours, usually meaning you settle midway between the opinions
example: Following the equal weight view, the two roommates who guessed thirty and forty minutes for the commute agreed to leave thirty-five minutes early.

hindi: समतावाद — सबको बराबर हक और अवसर मिलने का मत
definition: the view that all people are of equal worth and deserve the same political, economic and social rights; a less common name for egalitarianism
example: In a burst of equalitarianism, the cricket team decided the captain would carry the kit bag like everyone else.

hindi: अवसर की समानता — सबको प्रतिस्पर्धा के लिए समान प्रारंभिक अवसर मिलने का सिद्धांत
definition: the principle that everyone should have a fair and equal chance to compete for jobs, schooling and positions, whatever their background
example: Equality of opportunity came up at the job fair when Aman noticed half the internships were only posted inside one college's group chat.

hindi: परिणाम की समानता — लोगों की अंतिम स्थिति, जैसे आय या संपत्ति, को समान करने का लक्ष्य
definition: the goal that people should finish with equal wealth, income or living conditions, rather than merely equal chances at the start
example: Splitting the restaurant bill evenly, whoever ate the most, was Kiran's idea of equality of outcome.

hindi: तुल्यबलता — विरोधी तर्कों का समान वज़न होना
definition: the sceptical claim that opposing arguments on a question carry equal weight, so neither side deserves belief and judgement should be suspended
example: Split between cheaper rent and a shorter commute, Farhan reached perfect equipollence and stayed in his current flat.

hindi: समतुल्यता-शर्त — यह नियम कि जो प्रमाण एक कथन की पुष्टि करे वह उसके तार्किक समतुल्य की भी करे
definition: the principle that whatever evidence confirms a hypothesis also confirms any logically equivalent hypothesis; combined with Nicod's criterion, it produces the raven paradox
example: In the group chat, Vikram used the equivalence condition to argue that his untouched homework confirmed that finished homework gets submitted.

hindi: वाक्छल — एक ही शब्द को तर्क में भिन्न अर्थों में प्रयोग करने का दोष
definition: the fallacy of using one word in two different meanings within the same argument, so the conclusion seems to follow when it does not
example: The sign said fine for parking here, so Dhruv parked, and his equivocation cost him five hundred rupees.

hindi: स्वकर्म — किसी वस्तु या प्राणी का विशिष्ट कार्य या प्रयोजन
definition: the Greek word for the characteristic function or work of a thing, which Aristotle used to explain what makes something, including a human being, good
example: A knife's ergon is cutting, the teacher said, which is why Jay's butter knife attempt on the pumpkin was philosophically doomed.

hindi: काम — सौंदर्य और मिलन की ओर खींचने वाली आसक्तिपूर्ण प्रीति
definition: passionate love that longs for union with a beloved found beautiful, which Plato described as rising from bodily desire toward love of beauty itself
example: Rohan insists his feelings for the new barista are pure eros, though the free cookie refills may also be doing some work.

hindi: भ्रम सिद्धांत — सभी सकारात्मक नैतिक कथनों को असत्य मानने का मत, क्योंकि वस्तुनिष्ठ नैतिक तथ्य होते ही नहीं
definition: the view that moral statements attempt to describe objective moral facts, but since no such facts exist, every positive moral claim is false
example: Kiran's error theory gave her no excuse at the family dinner; her aunt still expected the dishes done, false moral claims or not.

hindi: प्रतिनिधि जगतवाद — संभाव्य जगतों को अमूर्त प्रतिनिधि मानने का मत
definition: the view that possible worlds are abstract substitutes built from actual things, such as sets of sentences or propositions, rather than concrete universes
example: Lavanya's ersatzism meant her 'other possible careers' were just neat lists of sentences in a notebook, not parallel versions of herself.

hindi: अंतिम सत्यापन — मृत्यु के बाद के अनुभव से धार्मिक कथनों की जाँच संभव मानने का मत
definition: the argument that religious statements are meaningful because they could be confirmed or disproved by experiences after death
example: Tired of arguing with his roommate, Varun appealed to eschatological verification: they would settle it in the afterlife.

hindi: सत्ता ही प्रतीति है — बर्कले का मत कि वस्तु का होना उसका अनुभव किया जाना है
definition: Berkeley's principle that for ordinary objects, to exist simply means to be perceived by some mind, so nothing exists wholly outside perception
example: When the office printer vanished behind a stack of boxes, Tanvi muttered esse est percipi and declared it officially gone until somebody found it.

hindi: सार — वह मूल गुण जिसके बिना कोई वस्तु वह वस्तु नहीं रहती
definition: the core nature of a thing, the features it must have to be the kind of thing it is at all
example: Dev insisted that the essence of chai is ginger, and that anything without it is merely warm milk with ambitions.

hindi: सार-अस्तित्व भेद — किसी वस्तु के 'क्या है' और 'है' को अलग मानना
definition: the view, developed by Avicenna and Aquinas, that what a thing is differs from the fact that it exists, except perhaps in the divine
example: Knowing exactly what a unicorn is but never seeing one, Hina found the essence-existence distinction very persuasive.

hindi: अनिवार्य सूचक — ऐसा 'मैं' या 'अब' जिसे किसी वर्णन से बदला नहीं जा सकता
definition: Perry's term for an indexical, such as 'I' or 'now', that cannot be replaced by any description without losing its power to explain a person's beliefs and actions
example: Rahul followed the trail of spilt sugar around the shop until the essential indexical struck: the leaking packet was in his own basket.

hindi: सारभूत गुण — वह गुण जिसके बिना वस्तु वही वस्तु न रह सके
definition: a property a thing must have in order to exist at all, which it keeps in every possible world where it exists, as opposed to an accidental property
example: Pooja claimed that being spicy is an essential property of biryani, and a bland version is simply rice with ambitions.

hindi: सारतत्त्ववाद — यह मत कि वस्तुओं के कुछ गुण उनके अस्तित्व के लिए अनिवार्य हैं
definition: the view that things have some essential properties they could never lose while still existing, as distinct from accidental properties they merely happen to have
example: Debating whether a sandwich without bread is still a sandwich, Neha took a hard line of essentialism and refused to call the lettuce wrap anything else.

hindi: व्यवस्थावाद — स्थापित सत्ता और संस्थाओं के समर्थन का मत
definition: the stance of supporting the existing social and political establishment, its institutions and those who hold power; the opposite of antiestablishmentism
example: Dev's establishmentism surfaces every time he defends the housing society committee, even after it banned balcony plants.

hindi: सौंदर्यदृष्टि — क्या सुंदर है, इस पर टिकी विचार-शैली या रुचि
definition: a particular set of ideas or principles about what is beautiful or artistically good, guiding someone's taste and choices; American spelling of aesthetic
example: His apartment follows a strict esthetic: white walls, one plant, and absolutely nowhere to put your bag.

hindi: सौंदर्यशास्त्र — सौंदर्य, रुचि और कलात्मक मूल्य का अध्ययन
definition: the branch of philosophy that studies beauty, taste and artistic value, asking what makes something worth admiring; American spelling of aesthetics
example: Two flatmates arguing over whether the neon cactus lamp is ugly or brilliant are, whether they know it or not, doing esthetics.

hindi: शाश्वत पुनरावृत्ति — नीत्शे का विचार कि जीवन हूबहू अनंत बार दोहराया जाएगा
definition: Nietzsche's thought experiment asking whether you could welcome living your exact life, every moment of it, over and over for all eternity
example: Stuck in the same traffic jam for the fourth morning, Sana felt eternal recurrence was less a thought experiment than a commute.

hindi: शाश्वतकालवाद — भूत, वर्तमान और भविष्य तीनों को समान रूप से वास्तविक मानने का मत
definition: the view that past, present and future moments all exist equally, so that dinosaurs and future cities are just as real as today
example: When Tanvi missed the concert, her brother offered eternalism as comfort: the show still exists, just at a different spot in time.

hindi: नैतिक अप्राकृतवाद — नैतिक गुणों को वास्तविक पर प्राकृतिक गुणों से भिन्न मानने का मत
definition: the view that moral properties like goodness are real but are not natural properties, so they cannot be discovered or defined by science
example: Sneha's ethical non-naturalism meant no fitness tracker, however clever, could ever measure how good her volunteering actually was.

hindi: नीतिवाद — नैतिक विचारों को सार्थक और सर्वोपरि मानने का मत
definition: the view that ethics and moral ideas are valid and important, often showing up as a strong habit of judging things morally
example: His ethicism turned a simple choice of breakfast cereal into a ten-minute talk on fair wages for farmers.

hindi: नीतिशास्त्र — सही-गलत और अच्छे आचरण का दार्शनिक अध्ययन
definition: the branch of philosophy that studies right and wrong, asking how people should live and treat each other
example: A kitchen debate over whether to eat a flatmate's leftovers without asking turned into a full hour of ethics.

hindi: अस्पष्टता का नीतिशास्त्र — बिना निश्चित नियमों के स्वतंत्र चुनावों पर आधारित नैतिकता
definition: Beauvoir's existentialist ethics, holding that since humans are both free and limited, moral life means choosing freely while respecting the freedom of others
example: Split on whether to report a colleague, Sana found no rulebook, only the ethics of ambiguity.

hindi: देखभाल का नीतिशास्त्र — संबंधों और देखभाल को नैतिकता का केंद्र मानने वाला मत
definition: an ethical theory holding that moral life centres on relationships, responsiveness and caring for particular people, rather than on abstract rules or calculations
example: Choosing to drive her neighbour to the hospital over attending a lecture on duty, Nisha said the ethics of care had won the argument.

hindi: जातीय दर्शन — किसी समुदाय की सामूहिक मान्यताओं को उसका दर्शन मानने की पद्धति
definition: the approach that treats the shared beliefs, proverbs and customs of an African people as their collective philosophy, a method critics say ignores individual thinkers
example: When Kofi's essay summed up his whole village's worldview from three proverbs, his lecturer warned him about the pitfalls of ethnophilosophy.

hindi: उत्पत्तिमूलक प्रकार्य — किसी अंग का वह कार्य जिसके लिए प्राकृतिक चयन ने उसे चुना
definition: the account on which a biological trait's function is whatever effect caused its ancestors to be favoured by natural selection, as hearts were selected for pumping blood
example: Asked about the etiological function of eyebrows, the class agreed it probably was not expressing disapproval of homework.

hindi: सुमंत्रणा — उचित लक्ष्य तक पहुँचने के सही साधन सोच पाने की कुशलता
definition: the Greek term for good deliberation, the ability to reason well about how best to reach a worthy goal, which forms part of practical wisdom
example: Planning the surprise party around three work shifts and a moody cat required serious euboulia from the whole flat.

hindi: परम कल्याण — सद्गुण और विवेक से जिया गया सम्पूर्ण, सार्थक और सुखी जीवन
definition: the Greek idea of human flourishing, a whole life lived well through virtue and reason, rather than a passing feeling of pleasure or cheerfulness
example: Arjun decided that binge-watching was pleasant but not eudaimonia, and reluctantly signed up for the community garden instead.

hindi: कल्याणवाद — विवेकपूर्ण जीवन से मिलने वाले सच्चे कल्याण को नैतिकता की कसौटी मानने का मत
definition: the ethical view that actions are right when they lead to a flourishing life, a lasting well-being reached by living according to reason; also spelled endaemonism
example: Tara's eudemonism made skipping the party easy, since an evening mastering a new guitar song felt like the deeper kind of happiness.

hindi: सुजननिकी — चयनित प्रजनन द्वारा मानव वंश को सुधारने का विवादित आंदोलन
definition: the widely condemned movement and practice of trying to improve the human population by controlling who may reproduce, often through coercion
example: The history teacher's lesson on eugenics made the whole class rethink the phrase 'good genes' in dating apps.

hindi: विवेकजन्य भाव — विवेक से उपजी स्वस्थ, संतुलित भावनाएँ
definition: in Stoic thought, a healthy emotion grounded in correct reasoning, such as rational gladness, caution or goodwill, which the wise person still feels
example: Seeing her team finally ship the product, Anjali felt pure eupatheia: gladness without a single worry about the next sprint.

hindi: इच्छामृत्यु — असाध्य पीड़ा से मुक्ति हेतु जानबूझकर मृत्यु देना
definition: the deliberate ending of a person's life, usually by a doctor, in order to relieve suffering from an incurable illness or unbearable pain
example: A news story about a patient choosing her own death turned the family dinner into a long, careful argument about euthanasia.

hindi: सुमनस्कता — मन की स्थिर प्रसन्नता और संतुलन
definition: a settled cheerfulness and steadiness of mind, praised by Democritus and Seneca as freedom from anxiety and inner disturbance
example: Sipping filter coffee on the balcony before anyone else woke, Leela felt a rare euthymia that lasted until the doorbell rang.

hindi: यूथिफ्रो दुविधा — शुभ ईश्वर की आज्ञा से है या आज्ञा शुभ होने से, यह प्रश्न
definition: the puzzle from Plato's dialogue asking whether something is good because a deity commands it, or whether a deity commands it because it is already good
example: When Mum said homework mattered because she said so, Riya hit back with the Euthyphro dilemma: did she say so because homework mattered?

hindi: घटना-कारणता — यह मत कि कारण और कार्य दोनों सदा घटनाएँ ही होते हैं
definition: the view that causes and effects are always events, meaning happenings at particular times and places, rather than persons, objects or substances
example: Under event causation, Rohit argued, the traffic jam was caused not by the lorry but by the lorry breaking down at nine.

hindi: दैनिक सौंदर्यशास्त्र — रोज़मर्रा की वस्तुओं और क्रियाओं में सौंदर्य-अनुभव का अध्ययन
definition: the branch of philosophy that studies aesthetic experience in ordinary life, such as cooking, cleaning, clothing and tidy desks, rather than only in galleries
example: Folding laundry into perfect squares, Mira called it everyday aesthetics, while her brother called it avoiding homework.

hindi: अशुभ की साक्ष्य-आधारित समस्या — अत्यधिक दुःख को ईश्वर के विरुद्ध प्रमाण मानने का तर्क
definition: the version of the problem of evil claiming that the sheer amount of pointless suffering makes an all-powerful, perfectly good deity unlikely, even if not impossible
example: Dev said the evidential problem of evil didn't prove anything outright; it just made the odds look bad, like his team's league table.

hindi: साक्ष्यवाद — विश्वास को केवल उपलब्ध साक्ष्य के अनुपात में उचित मानने का मत
definition: the view that a belief is justified only when, and only as strongly as, it is supported by the evidence the believer actually possesses
example: Citing evidentialism, Farhan refused to believe the office rumour about free pizza until he smelled cheese.

hindi: प्रमाणवादी आपत्ति — पर्याप्त प्रमाण के बिना ईश्वर-विश्वास को अनुचित ठहराने वाली आपत्ति
definition: the argument that believing in a deity is irrational unless the believer holds enough evidence or argument to support that belief
example: In the group chat, Tanvi raised the evidentialist objection against her brother's faith, then admitted she believes in her horoscope without evidence.

hindi: दुष्ट छलिया — सब अनुभवों को झूठा बनाने वाले छली की कल्पना
definition: Descartes's thought experiment imagining a powerful deceiver who feeds your mind false experiences of an external world, so that everything you perceive might be illusion
example: After her phone autocorrected every message into nonsense, Ishita blamed an evil demon who clearly wanted her friends to think she was unwell.

hindi: विकासवादी खंडन तर्क — नैतिक विश्वासों के विकासवादी मूल के आधार पर उनकी विश्वसनीयता पर संदेह
definition: the argument that since evolution shaped moral beliefs to help survival rather than to track truth, those beliefs cannot reliably detect objective moral facts
example: Naina offered an evolutionary debunking of her brother's fury over shared chocolate: ancestors who guarded snacks simply left more descendants.

hindi: असत् से सत् नहीं — शून्य से कुछ उत्पन्न नहीं होता
definition: the ancient principle that nothing comes from nothing, meaning every existing thing needs some prior thing from which it arises
example: When the budget spreadsheet showed profit without revenue, the accountant sighed ex nihilo nihil fit and went hunting for the error.

hindi: विनिमय-मूल्य — बाज़ार में किसी वस्तु के बदले मिलने वाली अन्य वस्तुओं या धन की मात्रा
definition: the quantity of other goods or money that a commodity can be traded for on a market, as distinct from its practical usefulness
example: His grandmother's pickle recipe had enormous family meaning but, Tara noted, almost no exchange value on any resale website.

hindi: अपवर्जन समस्या — भौतिक कारण पर्याप्त हों तो मानसिक कारण के लिए स्थान न बचने की समस्या
definition: the worry that if every physical event already has a complete physical cause, then mental states seem to have no causal work left to do
example: Varsha raised the exclusion problem at dinner: if her neurons already ordered dessert, what exactly had her craving contributed?

hindi: अनन्य वियोजन — 'या' का वह अर्थ जिसमें ठीक एक विकल्प ही सत्य हो
definition: a compound 'either-or' statement that is true when exactly a single part is true, and false when both parts or neither part are true
example: 'Dessert or a movie' was meant as an exclusive disjunction, but Anika's little brother quietly treated it as permission for both.

hindi: अपवर्जी विधिक प्रत्यक्षवाद — वैधता केवल सामाजिक स्रोतों से, नैतिक तर्क से कभी नहीं
definition: the stricter version of legal positivism, the view that validity rests on social facts, holding that legal validity always depends purely on social sources, so moral reasoning can never itself decide what the laws are
example: When the office handbook said 'be reasonable', Tara took the exclusive legal positivism line that the phrase handed managers discretion rather than made morality part of the rules.

hindi: क्षणावस्थावाद — वस्तु क्षणिक अवस्थाओं के रूप में ही बनी रहती है, यह मत
definition: another name for stage theory, the view that objects are momentary stages that persist only through their links of similarity and causation to earlier and later stages
example: Whenever his mother asked who left the lights on, Aditya pleaded exdurantism and blamed an earlier counterpart stage of himself.

hindi: आदर्शवादी नीति — नैतिक अवधारणाओं को अनुकरणीय व्यक्तियों के आधार पर परिभाषित करने का मत
definition: the view, developed by Linda Zagzebski, that moral concepts like virtue and goodness are best defined by pointing to admirable people we recognise and wish to imitate
example: Asked to define kindness, Tanvi used exemplarism and simply showed a photograph of the school nurse.

hindi: निदर्शन — किसी वस्तु का किसी गुण या प्रकार का उदाहरण बनकर उसे धारण करना
definition: the relation by which a particular thing has or displays a property, often used by metaphysicians as another name for instantiation
example: Holding up the burnt toast, Kunal called it a perfect exemplification of blackness, and his flatmate called it a fire hazard.

hindi: अस्तित्व — किसी वस्तु का वास्तव में होना
definition: the state of actually being there in reality, as opposed to being merely imagined, possible or described
example: The office debate about whether the promised new printer had any existence ended when facilities admitted it was only on a slide.

hindi: अस्तित्व कोई विधेय नहीं — होना किसी वस्तु का गुण नहीं है
definition: Kant's claim that saying something exists adds no feature to our concept of it, so existence is not a property among other properties
example: A hundred imaginary rupees and a hundred real ones match exactly, Kabir said, which is why existence is not a predicate but still matters at checkout.

hindi: अस्तित्व सार से पहले — मनुष्य पहले होता है, फिर अपने चुनावों से स्वयं को गढ़ता है
definition: the existentialist view that humans first exist without any fixed nature or purpose, and only later define themselves through their choices and actions
example: When her parents asked what she was born to be, Tanvi replied that existence precedes essence, so she would decide after lunch.

hindi: अस्तित्व-शर्त — किसी को हानि या लाभ तभी हो सकता है जब वह विद्यमान हो
definition: the principle that something can harm or benefit a person only while that person exists, which, if accepted, makes death and posthumous events harmless
example: Rohan invoked the existence requirement to argue that his unborn future cousins could not possibly mind the family arguing about property.

hindi: सत्तावान — जो वस्तु अस्तित्व रखती है
definition: something that exists, a thing or entity considered simply as having existence
example: Surveying the cluttered drawer, Ayesha counted every existent, including four chargers for phones she no longer owned.

hindi: अस्तित्वगत विश्लेषिकी — मानवीय अस्तित्व की मूल संरचनाओं का विश्लेषण
definition: Heidegger's systematic analysis of the basic structures of human existence, such as care, moods and mortality, carried out in his work Being and Time
example: Rohit's existential analytic of Monday mornings identified three structures: dread, coffee and pretending to read emails.

hindi: अस्तित्वगत चिंता — मृत्यु, स्वतंत्रता और अर्थहीनता के बोध से उपजी बेचैनी
definition: Tillich's term for the deep anxiety that arises from awareness of death, guilt and possible meaninglessness, rather than from any particular threat in daily life
example: Existential anxiety struck Ruhi during a boring meeting, when she wondered whether spreadsheets were her life's purpose.

hindi: अस्तित्व-संकट — जीवन के अर्थ और उद्देश्य पर गहरा संदेह करने की अवस्था
definition: a period in which a person seriously doubts whether their life has meaning, purpose or value, often triggered by loss, change or reflection
example: Turning twenty-five and still unsure how taxes work, Ayesha declared a full existential crisis in the group chat.

hindi: अस्तित्वपरक सामान्यीकरण — किसी विशेष वस्तु के बारे में सत्य से 'कोई तो है' निकालना
definition: the inference rule that from a claim about a particular object you may conclude that something with that property exists somewhere in the range discussed
example: Priyanka finished the crossword, so by existential generalization someone in the office could finish the crossword, which stunned everyone.

hindi: अस्तित्वगत अपराधबोध — अपनी संभावनाओं को न जी पाने का गहरा अपराध-भाव
definition: a deep sense of guilt that comes from failing to fulfil your own possibilities, rather than from breaking any particular rule
example: Seeing his old guitar gathering dust, Neel felt existential guilt about the musician he never became.

hindi: अस्तित्वपरक दृष्टांतीकरण — 'कोई है' से उस अज्ञात वस्तु को एक नया नाम देकर तर्क आगे बढ़ाना
definition: the inference rule that from 'there exists some object with a property' you may introduce a fresh name for such an object and reason about it
example: Someone ate the last samosa, so by existential instantiation Ritika called the culprit 'Suspect S' until the crumbs gave him away.

hindi: अस्तित्वपरक परिमाणक — 'कम से कम एक' या 'कोई है' का तर्कशास्त्रीय चिह्न
definition: the logical symbol, usually written as a backwards capital letter, that claims at least a single object in the range being discussed has some given property
example: Tara only needed the existential quantifier to win the office debate: she had to find just one printer on the floor that actually worked.

hindi: अस्तित्व-संकट — ऐसा खतरा जो मानव जाति को मिटा दे या उसकी संभावनाओं को स्थायी रूप से नष्ट कर दे
definition: a danger that could cause human extinction or permanently destroy humanity's long-term potential, such as a pandemic, nuclear warfare or uncontrolled technology
example: In the group chat, Varun ranked existential risk alongside his exams, then admitted the exams felt more urgent.

hindi: अस्तित्वगत शून्य — जीवन में अर्थ और उद्देश्य के अभाव से उपजा खालीपन
definition: Frankl's term for the inner emptiness and boredom a person feels when life seems to lack meaning or purpose
example: Every Sunday evening, after the weekend fun ended, Lavanya felt a small existential vacuum open up.

hindi: अस्तित्ववाद — मनुष्य को पूर्णतः स्वतंत्र और अपने जीवन-अर्थ का रचयिता मानने वाला दर्शन
definition: a twentieth-century movement holding that people are completely free, with no fixed nature, and so fully responsible for creating meaning through their choices
example: Arnav's existentialism phase began the night he realised no aptitude test could choose his career for him.

hindi: विस्तृत होता नैतिक वृत्त — समय के साथ नैतिक चिंता का परिवार से आगे अजनबियों और पशुओं तक फैलने का विचार
definition: the idea that moral concern has gradually widened over history, from family and tribe to strangers, other nations and possibly animals
example: Grandma said her expanding circle now included the neighbours' cat, though still not the neighbours themselves.

hindi: प्रत्याशित उपयोगिता — हर संभावित परिणाम के मूल्य को उसकी संभावना से गुणा करके जोड़ा गया योग
definition: the value of an uncertain option, found by multiplying the value of each possible outcome by its probability, then adding those results together
example: Neha worked out the expected utility of carrying an umbrella: small bother every morning, versus a soaked laptop on one rainy commute.

hindi: अनुभव-यंत्र — सुख ही सब कुछ है या नहीं, इसे परखने वाली नोज़िक की परिकल्पना
definition: Robert Nozick's thought experiment offering a machine that would feed you blissful simulated experiences for life, used to question whether pleasure is all that matters
example: Scrolling reels at two in the morning, Kabir admitted he had basically plugged himself into a cheap experience machine.

hindi: प्रयोगवाद — ज्ञान और विचारों को प्रयोग द्वारा परखने का आग्रह
definition: the view that ideas and beliefs should be tested through experiment and experience, closely linked to pragmatism in education and science
example: In a fit of experimentalism, the flatmates timed three different ways of boiling pasta instead of arguing about it.

hindi: जीवन-प्रयोग — मिल का मत कि लोगों को जीने के नए ढंग आज़माने की स्वतंत्रता हो
definition: Mill's phrase for people trying out unusual ways of living, which he believed society should permit because everyone learns from the results
example: Moving into a van to work remotely was, Leena told her parents, one of Mill's experiments in living.

hindi: निर्णायक प्रयोग — दो प्रतिद्वंद्वी सिद्धांतों में से एक को निर्णायक रूप से चुनने वाला प्रयोग
definition: a crucial experiment designed so that its outcome decides between two rival hypotheses, a possibility Duhem argued is never quite achievable
example: Tasting both dal pots blindfolded became the family's experimentum crucis for whose recipe deserved the festival.

hindi: व्याख्येय — वह तथ्य या घटना जिसकी व्याख्या की जानी है
definition: in logic and science, the fact, event or statement that needs explaining, as opposed to the explanans, which does the explaining
example: The explanandum at breakfast was simple: why was the milk carton in the cupboard, and who was going to confess?

hindi: व्याख्याकारक — वे कथन जिनसे किसी बात की व्याख्या की जाती है
definition: in logic and science, the group of statements or premises that supply an explanation, as opposed to the explanandum, the fact being explained
example: When the cake sank, 'the oven door was opened too early' became the explanans and the flat sponge the explanandum.

hindi: व्याख्यात्मक खाई — भौतिक तथ्यों और अनुभूति के बीच की वह दूरी जिसे व्याख्या पार नहीं कर पाती
definition: the apparent failure of any physical explanation of the brain to show why particular processes should feel the particular way they feel from the inside
example: Reading a textbook chapter on taste receptors, Farah complained about the explanatory gap: nothing there explained why mango tastes like summer.

hindi: व्याख्यात्मक सामर्थ्य — किसी सिद्धांत की अनेक तथ्यों को समझा पाने की क्षमता
definition: the capacity of a hypothesis to account for many different facts, often treated as a reason for preferring it over rival hypotheses
example: The theory that Uncle had borrowed the car had impressive explanatory power: the empty tank, the sweet wrappers and the jazz station.

hindi: व्याख्यात्मक एकीकरण — अनेक घटनाओं को थोड़े से पैटर्नों के अधीन लाना
definition: the view, developed by Friedman and Kitcher, that science explains by showing many different phenomena to follow from a small number of shared patterns
example: Arnav achieved explanatory unification when one theory, his toddler's teething, accounted for the chewed remote, sleepless nights and drool.

hindi: व्याख्येय — जिस तथ्य या कथन की व्याख्या करनी हो
definition: the thing, fact or expression that needs explaining, as opposed to the explanation that is offered for it
example: The explicandum was simple, a missing phone charger, but the family's explanations ranged from the dog to a conspiracy.

hindi: स्पष्टीकरण — किसी धुँधली रोज़मर्रा अवधारणा को अधिक सटीक अवधारणा से बदलना
definition: Carnap's method of replacing a vague everyday concept with a more precise one that serves the same purpose, such as swapping 'warm' for a temperature measured in degrees
example: Rohan's explication of 'a quick call' as 'under fifteen minutes' was the most useful thing anyone said in the meeting.

hindi: स्पष्टार्थ — संदर्भ से पूर्ण किया गया कथन का स्पष्ट रूप से संप्रेषित अर्थ
definition: in relevance theory, the fully spelled-out content a speaker directly communicates, built by filling gaps in the sentence using the context
example: "I haven't eaten" has the explicature "I haven't eaten lunch today", not "I have never eaten in my life".

hindi: स्पष्ट सहमति — शब्दों या औपचारिक वचन द्वारा दी गई खुली स्वीकृति
definition: agreement to a government's authority that is given openly and deliberately, through words, a signature or a formal oath, rather than silently through conduct
example: At the citizenship ceremony, Farhan realised he was giving express consent while everyone born here had only ever given the silent kind.

hindi: अभिव्यक्ति कला-सिद्धांत — भावों की अभिव्यक्ति को कलाकृति का सार मानने का मत
definition: the view that the essence of artworks is the expression of emotion, so that a painting or song matters because it conveys feeling to its audience
example: Defending the expression theory of art, Bhavna said her angry office doodles were masterpieces of pure Monday feeling.

hindi: अभिव्यक्तिवाद — नैतिक कथनों को तथ्य-वर्णन नहीं, वक्ता की अभिवृत्तियों की अभिव्यक्ति मानने का मत
definition: the view that moral statements express the speaker's attitudes, such as approval, disapproval or commitment to plans, rather than describing moral facts
example: Under expressivism, Nisha's 'you should call your grandmother' told her brother less about the world and more about her firm disapproval of his silence.

hindi: विस्तारित संज्ञान — यह मत कि चिंतन की प्रक्रिया मस्तिष्क से बाहर के साधनों तक फैल सकती है
definition: the view that cognition, meaning thinking and knowing, can extend beyond the brain and body into external devices such as notebooks, calculators or phones
example: Priya planned the month's budget with sticky notes across the wall, calling it extended cognition when her flatmate asked why everything was yellow.

hindi: विस्तारित मन — यह मत कि मन खोपड़ी तक सीमित नहीं, बाहरी साधन भी उसका अंग बन सकते हैं
definition: the thesis that the mind can reach beyond the skull, so that notebooks, phones and other external devices can literally form part of thinking and memory
example: When Arjun's phone died mid-commute he lost every address he knew, which his sister called a vivid case for the extended mind.

hindi: विस्तारित लक्षणरूप — जीन के प्रभाव जो जीव के शरीर से बाहर संसार तक फैलते हैं
definition: the idea that genes shape not only an organism's body but also effects beyond it, such as beaver dams, spider webs or bird nests
example: Watching his son rebuild the same elaborate blanket fort every weekend, Aditya joked that the fort was really the boy's extended phenotype.

hindi: व्याप्ति — वे सभी वस्तुएँ जिन पर कोई पद वास्तव में लागू होता है
definition: the actual collection of things a term applies to, so the extension of 'planet' is simply the group of every real planet, whatever the term's meaning
example: The extension of 'people who washed their mugs' turned out, after an office audit, to contain exactly one intern.

hindi: विस्तारपरक — शब्द का अर्थ उसके दायरे में आने वाली चीज़ें गिनाकर बताने वाला
definition: describing a definition or meaning given by listing the actual things a word applies to, rather than stating the features they share
example: Asked what 'sibling' means, my nephew gave an extensional answer by simply pointing at his three sisters.

hindi: बाह्यतावाद — औचित्य को व्यक्ति की चेतना से बाहर के तथ्यों पर निर्भर मानने का मत
definition: the view that a belief can be justified by factors outside the believer's awareness, such as whether the process producing that belief reliably tracks truth
example: Rahul's grandmother knows rain is coming from her aching knee, which he calls externalism in action since she cannot explain why.

hindi: कारण-बाह्यतावाद — इच्छाओं से स्वतंत्र कर्म-कारणों को मानने का मत
definition: the view that a person can have a reason for action even when it connects to none of their desires or motivations, however carefully they reason
example: Invoking externalism about reasons, the coach told the sleepy team they had reasons to train whether or not any of them wanted to.

hindi: नेत्र-रश्मि सिद्धांत — आँखों से निकली किरणों द्वारा देखे जाने का प्राचीन मत
definition: the ancient theory of vision holding that sight works by rays or fire streaming outward from the eyes and reaching the object perceived
example: Glaring at the colleague who took his stapler, Deepak half believed in extramission, hoping his stare would physically reach across the office.

hindi: असाधारण साधन — ऐसा भारी उपचार जिसे रोगी नैतिक रूप से अस्वीकार कर सकता है
definition: in Catholic moral theology, medical treatments so burdensome or unlikely to help that a patient may rightly refuse them, unlike obligatory ordinary treatments
example: Mehul said a tetanus shot was ordinary treatment but a fourth dentist visit this month was clearly extraordinary means.

hindi: असाधारण विज्ञान — संकट काल में मूल मान्यताओं पर प्रश्न उठाने वाला अनुसंधान
definition: Kuhn's term for research during a crisis, when stubborn results that clash with expectations pile up and push scientists to question basic assumptions
example: The office entered extraordinary science mode when the coffee machine's failures piled up and someone finally questioned the machine itself.

hindi: बाह्य औचित्य — किसी अभिगृहीत को उसके फलदायी परिणामों के कारण स्वीकारना
definition: support for accepting a mathematical axiom because its consequences prove fruitful, elegant or useful, rather than because it seems obvious in itself
example: Samir defended his bizarre study timetable by extrinsic justification: it looked absurd, but his grades had never been better.

hindi: बाह्य गुण — वह गुण जो वस्तु के दूसरी वस्तुओं से संबंध पर निर्भर करता है
definition: a property a thing has only because of its relations to other things, such as being famous, being owned or being the tallest student
example: Winning the office quiz made Jay the smartest person in the room, an extrinsic property that vanished the moment the finance team walked in.

hindi: विधि — सार्वजनिक, स्पष्ट और समान रूप से लागू नियम
definition: the Legalist idea of standards or statutes: clear, public rules applied equally to everyone, which a ruler uses in place of personal judgement
example: The new attendance policy applied to managers too, so Zoya praised it as proper fa.

hindi: बुद्धि का तथ्य — नैतिक नियम के प्रति हमारी प्रत्यक्ष चेतना, जिसे कांट किसी अन्य प्रमाण से सिद्ध नहीं करते
definition: Kant's claim that our direct awareness of the moral rule binding us is a basic given of reason, not something proved from other premises
example: Asked why cheating felt wrong, Leela shrugged that it was a fact of reason, which ended the debate and the free period.

hindi: तथ्यता — जीवन की वे दी हुई परिस्थितियाँ जिन्हें व्यक्ति ने चुना नहीं
definition: the given facts of a person's situation that they never chose, such as their body, birthplace, history and past actions, which limit but never fully decide their freedom
example: Kabir admitted his height was facticity, but insisted that joining the basketball team anyway was pure freedom.

hindi: अवसर की निष्पक्ष समानता — समान प्रतिभा वालों को, पृष्ठभूमि की परवाह किए बिना, समान अवसर
definition: Rawls's principle that people with similar talents and effort should have similar chances of success, whatever family or class they were born into
example: The coaching centre's free seats for bright students from poorer families were a small step toward fair equality of opportunity.

hindi: उचित पारी तर्क — सीमित संसाधनों में उन्हें प्राथमिकता जिन्होंने कम जीवन जिया
definition: the argument that scarce healthcare should favour younger people, since everyone deserves a reasonable lifespan and older patients have already lived theirs
example: Nana-ji, a cricket fan, happily accepted the fair innings argument and said he was well past his half-century.

hindi: नकली खलिहान उदाहरण — धोखे भरे परिवेश में संयोगवश सत्य विश्वास का विचार-प्रयोग
definition: the thought experiment where a driver correctly spots a real barn among many convincing fakes, suggesting that lucky true belief falls short of knowledge
example: Picking the one genuine designer handbag at a market full of copies, Sneha joked she was shopping in fake barn country.

hindi: दोष-आधारित खंडन दोष — तर्क में भूल होने से निष्कर्ष को ही असत्य मान लेना
definition: the fallacy of concluding that a claim must be false because someone defended that claim with a faulty argument
example: Your reasoning about the rain is sloppy, so it will stay sunny, said Ved, committing the fallacy fallacy minutes before the downpour.

hindi: संघटन दोष — अंशों के गुण को पूरे समूह का गुण मान लेना
definition: the fallacy of assuming that what is true of each part must also be true of the whole made from those parts
example: Every ingredient in the smoothie tasted great alone, but the fallacy of composition met its match in that brown sludge.

hindi: विभाजन दोष — पूरे समूह के गुण को उसके हर अंश का गुण मान लेना
definition: the fallacy of assuming that what is true of a whole group must also be true of each individual part or member
example: The school has a brilliant chess team, so Mohit must be a chess genius, reasoned his aunt, in a proud fallacy of division.

hindi: पतितता — भीड़ और रोज़मर्रा की बातों में खोकर अपने प्रामाणिक स्व से दूर होना
definition: Heidegger's term for the everyday tendency of people to lose themselves in chatter, trends and what everyone else thinks, drifting from their genuine possibilities
example: Scrolling for two hours through other people's holiday photos, Divya recognised her fallenness and reluctantly closed the phone.

hindi: भ्रांतिसंभववाद — भूल की संभावना रहते हुए भी ज्ञान संभव मानने का मत
definition: the view that we can have knowledge even when our justification leaves some possibility of being mistaken
example: Embracing fallibilism, Anjali said she knew her parcel was coming Tuesday, while keeping the tracking page open.

hindi: फ़लसफ़ा — इस्लामी जगत में यूनानी परंपरा पर आधारित तर्कप्रधान दर्शन
definition: the tradition of rational philosophy in the Islamic world that built on Greek thinkers such as Aristotle and Plato, using reason and demonstration rather than scripture alone
example: When the study group started quoting Aristotle to settle a debate about fasting, Zoya said they had officially drifted from theology into falsafa.

hindi: मिथ्या कारण दोष — जो कारण नहीं है उसे कारण मान लेने की भूल
definition: the general fallacy of treating something as the cause of an event without good evidence, often because the two merely happened close together
example: Blaming the new printer for the office's bad mood was a false cause; the real culprit was the broken coffee machine.

hindi: मिथ्या चेतना — शोषित वर्ग द्वारा अपने ही शोषण को उचित मान लेने वाली भ्रांत समझ
definition: the Marxist idea that members of an exploited class come to hold beliefs that serve the interests of the ruling class and hide their own exploitation from them
example: Kabir called it false consciousness when his flatmate defended unpaid overtime as a privilege of being part of the company family.

hindi: मिथ्या द्विभाजन — स्थिति को ज़बरदस्ती दो विरोधी खानों में बाँटने की भूल
definition: the fallacy of splitting a situation into two opposed options as though no other choices or middle positions were possible
example: Neha rejected the false dichotomy of pizza or nothing and quietly ordered the dosa.

hindi: मिथ्या द्विविकल्प — केवल दो विकल्प दिखाकर बाकी संभावनाएँ छिपा देने की भूल
definition: the fallacy of presenting only two choices as though they were the only possible options, while ignoring other reasonable alternatives
example: Either you reply to every work message within five minutes or you do not care about the team, declared the manager, serving up a textbook false dilemma.

hindi: मिथ्या समतुल्यता — बहुत भिन्न बातों को समान मान लेने की भूल
definition: the fallacy of treating two things as equally serious or equally valid because they share some feature, while ignoring large differences between them
example: Comparing forgetting to water a plant with burning down the kitchen was a false equivalence, Meera told her dramatic brother.

hindi: मिथ्यावत विरोधाभास — भ्रामक तर्क से निकला असत्य निष्कर्ष
definition: a paradox whose surprising conclusion is actually false, because the reasoning hides a mistake that careful checking exposes
example: When Leo's algebra proved that one equals two, his teacher found the hidden division by zero behind the falsidical paradox.

hindi: मिथ्यापनीयता — किसी सिद्धांत का ऐसा होना कि कोई संभव प्रेक्षण उसे झूठा सिद्ध कर सके
definition: the property of a theory that some possible observation could show it false; Popper proposed this as the mark that separates scientific claims from others
example: When Aman insisted his horoscope was right whatever happened, his sister pointed out that its falsifiability was precisely zero.

hindi: मिथ्याकरणवाद — विज्ञान को परिकल्पनाओं के खंडन-प्रयासों से आगे बढ़ता मानने का मत
definition: Popper's view that science advances by proposing bold conjectures and trying hard to refute them, rather than by accumulating confirming instances
example: A convert to falsificationism, Zoya spent the whole science fair trying to break her own volcano model instead of admiring it.

hindi: पारिवारिक साम्य — बिना किसी साझा सार के आपस में जुड़े लक्षणों का जाल
definition: Wittgenstein's idea that things called by one word, such as games, need share no single common feature, only overlapping similarities like relatives in a family
example: Cricket, chess and hide-and-seek share no one feature, so Jaya called "game" a clear case of family resemblance.

hindi: फ़ना — सूफ़ी मार्ग में अहंकार का ईश्वर में विलीन हो जाना
definition: in Sufi thought, the passing away or dissolving of the individual self and its selfish pride in the divine, a stage on the mystical path
example: Lost in the qawwali at the wedding, Sara described a moment close to fana, forgetting herself entirely until someone stepped on her foot.

hindi: फ़ासीवाद — उग्र राष्ट्रवाद, एक नेता की पूजा और विरोध-दमन पर आधारित विचारधारा
definition: the twentieth-century political ideology combining extreme nationalism, worship of a single leader, a powerful state and violent suppression of opponents
example: In history class, Aryan traced how fascism spread through rallies, uniforms and slogans long before anyone voted it into power.

hindi: मनोपवास — मन को विचारों और इच्छाओं से रिक्त करना
definition: the Daoist practice of emptying the mind of fixed ideas, desires and busy thinking, so that you can respond openly to whatever comes
example: Switching off every notification for an hour, Divya called it a fasting of the mind with snacks allowed.

hindi: भाग्यवाद — सब कुछ पहले से तय होने से प्रयास को व्यर्थ मानने का मत
definition: the view that whatever will happen is already settled, so that effort or choice cannot change the outcome
example: Kunal's fatalism about exams lasted until the results arrived, when he suddenly believed in studying harder.

hindi: फ़ैलसूफ़ — इस्लामी जगत में यूनानी ढंग का दर्शन करने वाला चिंतक
definition: a thinker in the Islamic world who practised falsafa, following Greek philosophy and trusting careful reasoning to reach truths about nature, mind and the divine
example: Imran brought a whiteboard to the family dinner and argued from first principles, so his cousins crowned him the house faylasuf.

hindi: अनुभूति-मत — भावों को मूलतः शरीर में होने वाली संवेदनाओं का अनुभव मानना
definition: the view that emotions are chiefly felt sensations, especially the awareness of bodily changes such as racing hearts or tight stomachs
example: Before his presentation, Aman's sweating palms convinced him the feeling theory of emotion was correct.

hindi: सुख-गणना — किसी कर्म से होने वाले सुख और दुःख को मापने और जोड़ने की विधि
definition: another name for Bentham's method of measuring the pleasure and pain an action will cause, weighing intensity, duration, certainty and extent, then adding the totals
example: Deciding between the late movie and an early night, Farhan attempted a felicific calculus and concluded that sleep had better duration.

hindi: सफलता की शर्तें — किसी कार्यकारी कथन के वैध रूप से सफल होने की शर्तें
definition: the conditions that must hold for a sentence that performs an action, such as a promise or a verdict, to succeed, including proper authority, the right setting and sincere intentions
example: A toddler announcing "meeting adjourned" fails the felicity conditions, although the adults did quietly leave the room.

hindi: नारीवाद — स्त्रियों के समान अधिकारों और अवसरों का समर्थन करने वाला मत
definition: the movement and body of ideas holding that women deserve equal rights and opportunities, and questioning how gender shapes power in society
example: Feminism came up at the family dinner when Riya asked why only the women were clearing the plates.

hindi: कल्पनावाद — गणित को उपयोगी किंतु शब्दशः असत्य कथा मानने का मत
definition: the view that mathematical objects do not really exist, so statements about numbers are strictly false, though useful like statements made within a story
example: Asked to split the restaurant bill, Tara cited fictionalism and said numbers were only a story, but the waiter still wanted real money.

hindi: आस्थावाद — धार्मिक सत्य को तर्क नहीं, केवल श्रद्धा से स्वीकारने का मत
definition: the view that religious faith does not need, and may even resist, support from reason or evidence, so belief rests on trust alone
example: When Kabir asked for proof that the new cafe's filter coffee was the best in town, his aunt replied with pure fideism: you simply have to believe.

hindi: समझ खोजती आस्था — विश्वास जो तर्क द्वारा अपनी समझ गहरी करना चाहता है
definition: Anselm's motto describing theology as faith seeking understanding, meaning belief that uses reason to grasp more deeply what it already holds
example: Trusting the recipe but still asking why baking soda works, Maya called her kitchen method fides quaerens intellectum.

hindi: प्रयोजन कारण — वह लक्ष्य या उद्देश्य जिसके लिए कोई वस्तु अस्तित्व में होती है
definition: in Aristotle's scheme of four causes, the purpose or goal for the sake of which a thing exists or happens, such as a table existing for dining
example: Staring at the unused treadmill, Gaurav wondered whether its final cause was exercise or holding laundry.

hindi: अंतिम शब्दावली — वे मूल शब्द जिनसे व्यक्ति अपने जीवन और मूल्यों को सही ठहराता है
definition: Rorty's term for the words someone uses to justify their deepest beliefs and actions, beyond which they can offer only circular argument or force
example: When pushed on why kindness mattered, Irfan reached his final vocabulary and could only say it simply did.

hindi: सूक्ष्म-समायोजन युक्ति — जीवन-योग्य भौतिक नियतांकों से रचयिता का अनुमान
definition: a modern teleological argument claiming that the physical constants of the universe seem precisely adjusted to allow life, which points to an intelligent designer
example: After perfecting the office thermostat to exactly 22 degrees, Sana announced a fine-tuning argument for her own genius.

hindi: सान्तवाद — केवल सीमित गणितीय वस्तुओं और प्रक्रियाओं को स्वीकारने का मत
definition: the view that mathematics should accept only finite objects and procedures, rejecting completed infinite collections as illegitimate or meaningless
example: When his little sister claimed infinity plus one, Varun invoked finitism and refused to count past the biscuits actually in the jar.

hindi: आदि-कारण युक्ति — प्रत्येक कारण-श्रृंखला के प्रथम कारण के रूप में ईश्वर को मानने का तर्क
definition: a version of the cosmological argument claiming that every event has a cause, the chain of causes cannot stretch back forever, so there must be a first cause of the universe
example: Asked who started the family group chat's endless meme chain, Grandma offered a first cause argument and named Uncle Vikram.

hindi: आद्य दर्शन — अस्तित्व और उसके मूल सिद्धांतों का अध्ययन, जिसे बाद में तत्त्वमीमांसा कहा गया
definition: Aristotle's name for the most basic inquiry, the study of being itself and its first principles, later called metaphysics
example: When Arjun asked why anything exists at all, his sister said that was first philosophy and far too heavy before breakfast.

hindi: प्रथम-क्रम तर्कशास्त्र — ऐसा विधेय तर्कशास्त्र जिसके परिमाणक केवल वस्तुओं पर लागू हों
definition: the standard form of predicate logic, the logic of objects and their properties, in which quantifiers range only over individual objects, never over properties or relations
example: First-order logic let Kiran say 'some colleague reads every email', but not the bolder claim about every quality his manager admires.

hindi: उत्तम पुरुष दृष्टि — अपने आप को 'मैं' के रूप में भीतर से जानने की क्षमता
definition: the capacity to think of oneself as oneself, from the inside, as the subject who has these experiences, which some philosophers treat as essential to being a person
example: The toddler kept calling herself by name until one morning she said 'I want toast', and her parents cheered her new first-person perspective.

hindi: प्रथमता — किसी गुण की शुद्ध, स्वतंत्र संभावना, पर्स की प्रथम श्रेणी
definition: Peirce's first category of reality: pure quality or feeling considered alone, such as redness itself, apart from any relation to other things
example: Staring at the sunset colour before naming it, Diya said she was enjoying pure firstness.

hindi: विखंडन समस्या — एक व्यक्ति के दो समान उत्तराधिकारियों में बँट जाने पर पहचान की पहेली
definition: the puzzle raised when a single person splits into a pair of future people who each have equal psychological continuity with the original, since the original cannot be identical to both duplicates
example: When the group chat split into two rival chats with the same members, Rhea declared it a perfect fission problem.

hindi: फ़ितरत — इस्लामी चिंतन में मनुष्य का जन्मजात, शुद्ध और सत्य की ओर झुका स्वभाव
definition: in Islamic thought, the original inborn nature of every human being, often held to include a natural awareness of truth and the divine
example: In their comparative religion seminar, Zoya explained fitra as the idea that people arrive already tuned towards truth.

hindi: उचित मनोवृत्ति — किसी वस्तु के गुणों के अनुरूप सही ठहरने वाली भावना या दृष्टि
definition: an emotion or evaluative response that suits its object, such as admiration toward something admirable, with some philosophers defining value through such fittingness
example: Laughing at the office printer's jam felt like the fitting attitude until it swallowed Raj's final report.

hindi: पंचतत्त्व-चक्र — काष्ठ, अग्नि, पृथ्वी, धातु और जल के परिवर्तन का सिद्धांत
definition: the Chinese theory that wood, fire, earth, metal and water are phases of change that produce and overcome each other in regular cycles
example: Her acupuncturist explained the five phases so well that Mira began seeing her tea kettle as fire overcoming metal.

hindi: पंचमार्ग — ईश्वर के अस्तित्व हेतु अक्विनास के पाँच तर्क
definition: Aquinas's five short arguments for the existence of the deity, reasoning from motion, causation, contingency, degrees of perfection and apparent purpose in nature
example: Asked to prove the office coffee machine had a maker, Zoya offered five ways, starting with the obvious fact that it moved nothing unless someone pressed the button.

hindi: पाँच-मिनट परिकल्पना — जगत के हाल ही में स्मृतियों सहित बनने की कल्पना
definition: Russell's sceptical proposal that the whole world might have sprung into existence only five minutes before this moment, complete with false memories and apparent records of the past
example: Unable to remember where she parked, Shruti proposed the five-minute hypothesis: the car simply had no past.

hindi: विश्वास का स्थिरीकरण — संदेह मिटाकर स्थिर विश्वास पाने की प्रक्रिया
definition: Peirce's account of how people settle doubt and arrive at stable beliefs, comparing four methods: tenacity, authority, reasoning from preference, and science
example: Their debate class studied the fixation of belief by listing how each student had decided which phone brand was best.

hindi: अदृढ़ निर्देशक — ऐसा पद जो अलग-अलग संभव स्थितियों में अलग वस्तुओं को इंगित करे
definition: a term, usually a description, that could pick out different objects in different possible situations, the opposite of what Kripke called a rigid designator
example: 'Whoever finishes the milk' is a flaccid designator in Neel's house, since the culprit changes every single morning.
