hindi: ध्वजदंड समस्या — यह पहेली कि छाया से दंड की ऊँचाई निकलती है, पर उसकी व्याख्या नहीं होती
definition: Bromberger's counterexample showing that deducing a flagpole's height from its shadow fits Hempel's model, although the shadow clearly does not explain the height
example: In physics class, Jai raised the flagpole problem by insisting his shadow explained why he was tall.

hindi: शब्द-श्वास — सामान्य नाम केवल मुँह से निकली हवा हैं, यह मत
definition: the extreme view, linked with Roscelin, that general words such as humanity are merely a puff of breath from the voice and name nothing real at all
example: When his manager kept praising 'synergy', Karan quietly decided the word was flatus vocis.

hindi: तैरता पुरुष — इंद्रिय-रहित अवस्था में आत्म-बोध पर इब्न सीना की परिकल्पना
definition: Avicenna's thought experiment of a person created suspended in empty space with no sensation of the body, used to argue that the self knows its own existence apart from the body
example: Lying in the dark floatation tank at the spa, Farah felt like Avicenna's floating man, minus the medieval robes.

hindi: प्लवमान पुरुष तर्क — बिना इंद्रिय-अनुभव के भी आत्मबोध होने का विचार-प्रयोग
definition: Avicenna's thought experiment imagining a person created suspended in empty space with no sensation of the body, who would still know that he exists, suggesting the soul is distinct from the body
example: Floating in the sensory deprivation tank, Neha decided the floating man argument was right, because she had lost her toes but not herself.

hindi: तैरता संकेतक — बिना निश्चित अर्थ का, हर अर्थ समा लेने वाला शब्द
definition: a word or symbol with no fixed meaning, so different groups can fill it with whatever meaning suits them, such as 'freedom' in political speeches
example: At the office retreat, 'culture' became a floating signifier meaning free lunch to some and longer hours to others.

hindi: सूत्र-उल्लंघन — संकेत देने हेतु बातचीत के नियम को जान-बूझकर खुलेआम तोड़ना
definition: deliberately and openly breaking one of the unwritten rules of conversation so that the listener notices and works out a hidden meaning, as in irony or understatement
example: Calling a three-hour meeting "brief" was flouting at its finest, and the whole team smirked.

hindi: सतत परिवर्तन — यह मत कि जगत में सब कुछ निरंतर बदलता रहता है
definition: Heraclitus's view that everything in the world is constantly changing, so that nothing stays exactly the same from one moment to the next
example: Karan said his room was not messy but in a state of flux, which his mother did not accept as philosophy.

hindi: केंद्रीय साधना — ऐसी श्रमसाध्य क्रिया जो लोगों को जोड़े और जीवन को अर्थ दे
definition: Borgmann's term for a demanding activity, such as cooking a family meal or playing music, that gathers people together and gives life meaning beyond mere convenience
example: Sunday parathas became the flat's focal practice, since nobody had ever gathered that lovingly around a delivery box.

hindi: लोक मनोविज्ञान — विश्वास और इच्छा से व्यवहार समझाने की रोज़मर्रा की समझ
definition: the everyday, common-sense theory people rely on to explain and predict behaviour by attributing beliefs, desires, hopes and fears to one another
example: Folk psychology told Dev that his flatmate slamming cupboards meant she wanted the dishes done, and no brain scan was needed to confirm it.

hindi: पुल दुविधा — एक व्यक्ति को धक्का देकर पाँच को बचाने की नैतिक पहेली
definition: a variant of the trolley thought experiment where you could save five people only by pushing a large stranger off a bridge into the tram's path, sacrificing one person with your own hands
example: Most of the ethics class happily pulled the lever, but the footbridge problem made everyone suddenly very interested in their shoes.

hindi: बल और सजीवता — ह्यूम के अनुसार संवेदन को प्रत्यय से अलग करने वाली तीव्रता
definition: Hume's phrase for the liveliness and strength of a perception, which distinguishes impressions from fainter ideas and separates belief from mere imagining
example: Rohan said his dread of Monday's meeting had such force and vivacity that it clearly counted as a genuine impression, not idle imagining.

hindi: अनिवार्य विकल्प — ऐसा चुनाव जिससे बचना संभव न हो
definition: William James's term for a choice with no third path, where refusing to decide amounts to picking one side
example: Whether to reply to the wedding invitation was a forced option, since silence would count as a polite refusal.

hindi: उत्पादक शक्तियाँ — उत्पादन में प्रयुक्त श्रम-शक्ति, कौशल, तकनीक और साधन
definition: in Marxist theory, the combination of human labour, skills, technology and tools that a society uses to produce goods
example: The arrival of spreadsheet software transformed the forces of production in the accounts office faster than any memo ever did.

hindi: पूर्व-बोध — व्याख्या से पहले से मौजूद अपेक्षाएँ और धारणाएँ
definition: the expectations and assumptions a reader brings before interpreting anything, which Heidegger and Gadamer held shape every understanding of a text
example: Adil's fore-understanding of the email subject 'quick chat' had already prepared him for bad news.

hindi: परित्यक्तता — बिना किसी दैवी या बाहरी मार्गदर्शन के अकेले चुनने की अवस्था
definition: Sartre's term for the feeling of being abandoned in a world without any deity or fixed values, so that humans must invent their own guidance
example: With no teacher, parent or online forum able to settle her dilemma, Nandini tasted true forlornness.

hindi: जीवन-रूप — भाषा के पीछे की साझा सामाजिक प्रथाओं और व्यवहारों की पृष्ठभूमि
definition: Wittgenstein's term for the shared background of human practices, customs and reactions within which language games make sense
example: Queuing politely for chai at the station is part of a form of life no rulebook fully spells out.

hindi: शुभ का प्रत्यय — सब आदर्श रूपों को प्रकाश और अर्थ देने वाला सर्वोच्च प्रत्यय
definition: in Plato, the highest of all Forms, which gives every other Form its reality and makes true knowledge possible, much as sunlight makes things visible
example: After the meeting went nowhere, Pooja said the team needed to glimpse the Form of the Good, or at least agree on a goal.

hindi: आकारिक कारण — वह रूप या संरचना जो किसी वस्तु को वही बनाती है जो वह है
definition: in Aristotle's scheme of four causes, the form, structure or pattern that makes a thing the kind of thing it is, such as the design turning wood into a table
example: Without its formal cause, Simran pointed out, the flat-pack wardrobe was just a heavy box of boards and screws.

hindi: आकारिक भेद — एक ही वस्तु के पहलुओं में वह भेद जो न पूर्ण वास्तविक न केवल मानसिक
definition: Duns Scotus's middle category between a real and a merely mental difference, holding between aspects of one thing that are inseparable yet not identical in definition
example: Her friends insisted Rhea's patience and stubbornness were one trait, but she claimed a formal distinction between them.

hindi: रूपगत विषय — वह मूल्य-गुण जिसके रूप में कोई भाव अपने विषय को देखता है
definition: the evaluative property that an emotion presents its target as having, such as danger for fear or loss for grief, which fixes what kind of emotion it is
example: Danger is the formal object of fear, Aditi explained, which is why her brother's fear of empty inboxes made no sense.

hindi: रूपवाद — विषयवस्तु से अधिक रूप और संरचना को महत्व देने का मत
definition: the view that form and structure, rather than content or subject matter, are what matter most, especially when judging artworks or mathematics
example: The poetry teacher's formalism meant she graded the sonnet's rhyme scheme first and its heartbreak second.

hindi: अंतःप्रज्ञा के रूप — कांट के अनुसार देश और काल, जिनमें ही हर अनुभव मिलता है
definition: Kant's name for space and time, which he held are frames the mind supplies to arrange everything the senses deliver, intuition here meaning direct sensory awareness
example: Stuck in traffic, Ashok felt both forms of intuition at once: too little space, and far too much time.

hindi: स्वायत्तता सूत्र — ऐसे कर्म करो मानो तुम्हारा संकल्प स्वयं सार्वभौम नैतिक नियम बनाता हो
definition: the version of Kant's categorical imperative that says behave as though your own rational will were making the moral rules that bind everyone
example: Using the formula of autonomy, Zoya asked whether she would write 'ghost your friends' into the rulebook for everyone, and texted back.

hindi: मानवता सूत्र — मनुष्य को सदा साध्य मानो, कभी केवल साधन नहीं
definition: the version of Kant's categorical imperative that says always treat people as ends in themselves, never merely as tools for your own purposes
example: When Kabir befriended the new intern only to borrow her notes, Meera quoted the formula of humanity across the office pantry.

hindi: सार्वभौम नियम सूत्र — वही करो जिसे तुम सबके लिए नियम बना सको
definition: the version of Kant's categorical imperative that says to follow only those personal rules you could consistently want everyone else to follow too
example: Applying the formula of universal law, Sana pictured every commuter cutting the metro queue and decided the shortcut failed the test.

hindi: आधारवाद — ज्ञान को कुछ मूल, स्वतः मान्य विश्वासों पर टिका मानने का मत
definition: the view that justified beliefs rest on a base of basic beliefs, which need no support from other beliefs and support everything built above them
example: Explaining foundationalism to her study group, Ananya compared their notes to a house: without the bottom bricks, every chapter collapses.

hindi: आधार-संगतिवाद — आधारवाद और संगतिवाद को मिलाने वाला औचित्य-सिद्धांत
definition: the theory of justification that blends foundationalism and coherentism, treating experience as input while beliefs support each other like entries in a crossword puzzle
example: Solving the Sunday crossword over chai, Meera explained foundherentism: the clues matter, but so do the letters already filled.

hindi: चतुर्विध कारण — अरस्तू के अनुसार किसी वस्तु की व्याख्या करने वाले चार प्रकार के कारण
definition: Aristotle's four kinds of explanation for anything: its material, formal, efficient and final causes, answering what it is made of, its shape, what produced it and its purpose
example: Asked about the birthday cake, Mira gave all four causes: flour and sugar, a round shape, her aunt's oven skills and Dad turning fifty.

hindi: चार आर्य सत्य — दुःख, उसका कारण, उसका निरोध और उसका मार्ग
definition: the core Buddhist teaching that life involves suffering, that suffering arises from craving, that suffering can cease, and that a practical path leads to that ceasing
example: Their teacher explained the four noble truths as a doctor's visit: diagnosis, cause, cure and prescription.

hindi: चार मूल — पृथ्वी, जल, वायु और अग्नि को सब वस्तुओं का आधार मानना
definition: Empedocles's theory that everything is made by mixing four basic elements, earth, water, atmosphere and fire, in different proportions
example: In chemistry class, Kabir said the four roots were a decent first guess, since his lab experiment had definitely involved water and fire.

hindi: चार अंकुर — मेंशियस के अनुसार मानव-मन में जन्मजात सद्गुणों के बीज
definition: Mencius's teaching that every human heart contains four natural beginnings of virtue, namely compassion, shame, deference and a sense of right and wrong
example: Seeing the toddler wince when her friend fell over, their teacher said the four sprouts were already growing in the sandpit.

hindi: चतुर्विमीयवाद — वस्तुएँ लंबाई-चौड़ाई-ऊँचाई के साथ समय में भी फैली होती हैं, यह मत
definition: the view that objects are extended through time as well as space, so each thing is made of temporal parts, meaning slices or stages, spread across its whole history
example: Pointing at his baby photos, Imran defended four-dimensionalism by calling them the earliest slices of one long, gradually balding person.

hindi: चतुर्-सप्त विवाद — नैतिक और सामान्य भावनाओं के स्रोत पर कोरियाई विमर्श
definition: the Korean Confucian controversy over whether four moral feelings and seven ordinary emotions spring from principle, the moral pattern of things, from material force, the energy making things up, or from both
example: Arguing about whether anger at injustice counts as moral, the philosophy club rebooted the Four-Seven Debate over samosas.

hindi: चतुर्चरण सिद्धांत — समाज के शिकार, पशुपालन, कृषि और वाणिज्य चरणों का सिद्धांत
definition: the Scottish Enlightenment view that societies develop through hunting, herding, farming and commerce, each stage shaping laws and customs
example: In economics class, Rhea mapped her family's history onto the four-stages theory, ending with her uncle's online shop.

hindi: चौदह-दिवसीय नियम — प्रयोगशाला में मानव भ्रूण पर शोध की समय-सीमा
definition: the widely adopted limit forbidding scientists from growing human embryos in the laboratory for research beyond fourteen days after fertilisation
example: Ananya joked that her sourdough starter deserved a fourteen-day rule before it developed opinions.

hindi: संरचना समस्या — बदलती स्थिति में केवल प्रासंगिक बातों को पहचानने की समस्या
definition: the problem, first raised in artificial intelligence research, of how a thinking system can efficiently tell which facts change after an action and which it can safely ignore
example: Their robot vacuum illustrated the frame problem perfectly, pausing at every sock to reconsider its entire map of the living room.

hindi: फ़्रैंकफ़र्ट दृष्टांत — अन्य विकल्प न होने पर भी नैतिक उत्तरदायित्व बना रहने का उदाहरण
definition: Harry Frankfurt's example of a person who freely chooses an action that a hidden controller would have forced anyway, used to argue that moral responsibility does not require the ability to choose otherwise
example: Sonal chose the veg thali herself, not knowing the café had run out of everything else, which her professor would call a Frankfurt case.

hindi: फ्रैंकफर्ट दृष्टांत — विकल्प न होने पर भी उत्तरदायित्व दिखाने वाले काल्पनिक उदाहरण
definition: thought experiments in which a hidden controller would force a choice if needed but never intervenes, suggesting a person can be responsible even without alternative options
example: Arjun explained Frankfurt cases with the group chat: even if the admin would have forced everyone to vote pizza, Kiran picked pizza entirely unprompted.

hindi: फ्रैंकफर्ट चिंतन-धारा — मार्क्सवाद, मनोविश्लेषण और दर्शन को मिलाने वाले आलोचनात्मक सिद्धांतकारों का समूह
definition: the group of critical theorists linked to the Institute for Social Research in Frankfurt, including Adorno, Horkheimer and Marcuse, who combined Marxism, psychoanalysis and philosophy
example: Scrolling through identical streaming thumbnails, Ananya felt she finally understood what worried the Frankfurt School about mass entertainment.

hindi: स्वतंत्र सौंदर्य — बिना किसी प्रयोजन या अवधारणा के सहज रूप से भाने वाला सौंदर्य
definition: Kant's term for beauty judged purely by form, without any concept of what the thing is supposed to be or what purpose it serves, like a flower or a wallpaper pattern
example: Neel said the swirling foam on his coffee showed free beauty, since nobody needs latte swirls to understand what coffee is.

hindi: मुक्त तर्कशास्त्र — जिसमें नाम किसी अस्तित्ववान वस्तु को इंगित करें, यह आवश्यक नहीं
definition: a logic that allows names which refer to nothing, such as 'Sherlock Holmes', without assuming that everything named actually exists
example: In a debate about dragons, Esha reached for free logic so she could discuss their diet without committing to their existence.

hindi: स्वतंत्र चेतना — परंपरा और प्रचलित विश्वासों से मुक्त होकर सोचने वाला व्यक्ति, नीत्शे के अनुसार
definition: Nietzsche's ideal thinker who breaks free from tradition, custom and inherited convictions, testing every belief rather than accepting it
example: Questioning why the family always celebrates birthdays with cake, Rohini was branded the household's free spirit.

hindi: मुक्त चर — ऐसा चर जो किसी परिमाणक से बँधा न हो
definition: a variable in a formula that no quantifier (a phrase such as 'for every' or 'there exists') governs, so the formula makes no complete claim until something fills that variable
example: 'Someone left the milk out' is fine, but Laila's note 'x left the milk out' had a free variable and fooled nobody.

hindi: इच्छा-स्वातंत्र्य — अपने कर्मों को सचमुच स्वयं चुनने की क्षमता
definition: the power a person may have to choose their actions for themselves, so that the choice is genuinely theirs and not simply forced on them by outside causes
example: Standing at the vending machine for five minutes, Aarav insisted that picking the samosa over the chips was a triumph of free will.

hindi: स्वतंत्र-इच्छा प्रतिरक्षा — मनुष्य की स्वतंत्रता को अशुभ का कारण बताकर ईश्वर का बचाव
definition: the argument that a deity permits moral evil because creating beings with genuine free will is valuable, even though such beings can choose wrongly
example: Asked why she didn't just ban junk food at home, Mum gave a free will defence: the kids had to learn to choose for themselves.

hindi: स्वतंत्र इच्छा संशयवाद — स्वतंत्र इच्छा के अस्तित्व पर गहरा संदेह करने का मत
definition: the family of views doubting that people have the kind of free will needed to deserve praise or blame for their choices
example: Meera's free will skepticism made her surprisingly calm when her little brother broke the television remote.

hindi: अधीनता-मुक्त स्वतंत्रता — किसी की मनमानी शक्ति के अधीन न होने के अर्थ में स्वतंत्रता
definition: the republican idea that you are free only when nobody holds arbitrary power over you, even if that power is never actually used
example: Neha explained freedom as non-domination to her flatmate: a kind landlord who could evict you on a whim still leaves you unfree.

hindi: स्वतंत्र चिंतन — परंपरा या सत्ता के बजाय तर्क के आधार पर विश्वास बनाने का मत
definition: the view that beliefs, especially about religion, should be formed by reason and evidence rather than accepted from tradition or authority
example: Kiran's freethinking shows at book club, where she refuses to accept any claim just because a bestseller printed it.

hindi: फ्रेगे की पहेली — समान निर्देश वाले दो नामों से बने कथनों का ज्ञान-मूल्य भिन्न क्यों होता है, इसका प्रश्न
definition: the problem of explaining why a statement joining two names for one object, like 'Hesperus is Phosphorus', can deliver genuine information, while a statement repeating one name tells nobody anything
example: Discovering that the quiet neighbour and the anonymous meme account were the same person gave the whole group chat a lesson in Frege's puzzle.

hindi: फ्रेगे प्रमेय — यह परिणाम कि ह्यूम सिद्धांत से संपूर्ण मूल अंकगणित व्युत्पन्न हो जाता है
definition: the result that the basic axioms of arithmetic can be derived from Hume's principle within second-order logic, meaning logic that can make claims about all or some properties, not just about objects
example: Discovering that her whole tuition worksheet followed from matching pairs of objects, Kavya felt she had rediscovered Frege's theorem during a free period.

hindi: फ्रेगे-गीच समस्या — मिश्रित वाक्यों में नैतिक कथनों के अर्थ को अभिव्यक्तिवाद द्वारा समझाने की कठिनाई
definition: the challenge that expressivism struggles to explain what moral words mean inside larger sentences, such as conditions or questions, where the speaker expresses no attitude at all
example: Ananya raised the Frege-Geach problem in class: in 'if copying homework is wrong, then Ravi is in trouble', nobody is actually booing anything.

hindi: सुख-मैत्री — साथ के आनंद पर टिकी और रुचि बदलते ही बदल जाने वाली मित्रता
definition: Aristotle's term for friendship that rests on mutual enjoyment, such as shared jokes or hobbies, and tends to fade once the pleasure changes
example: The quiz-night gang drifted apart when the pub closed, proving theirs had been a friendship of pleasure all along.

hindi: उपयोग-मैत्री — आपसी लाभ पर टिकी और लाभ घटते ही ढीली पड़ने वाली मित्रता
definition: Aristotle's term for friendship that rests on mutual usefulness, such as shared lifts or work favours, and tends to fade once the benefit ends
example: Sana and her carpool partner stopped texting the week she bought a car, a textbook friendship of utility.

hindi: सद्गुण-मैत्री — एक-दूसरे के चरित्र के कारण टिकी सबसे ऊँची मित्रता
definition: Aristotle's highest kind of friendship, between good people who value each other for their character, rather than for usefulness or pleasure
example: The office friends who only met for free snacks drifted apart, but Tina and Leena's friendship of virtue survived three job changes.

hindi: पूर्ण प्लेटोवाद — हर संगत गणितीय सिद्धांत की वस्तुओं को वास्तविक मानने का मत
definition: the boldest version of mathematical platonism, holding that every consistent mathematical theory, meaning every theory free of contradiction, describes abstract objects that really exist
example: When Kiran invented a board game with strange number rules, his friend invoked full-blooded platonism and declared those numbers had existed all along.

hindi: कार्य-तर्क — मनुष्य के विशिष्ट कार्य से उसके श्रेष्ठ जीवन को निकालने वाला तर्क
definition: Aristotle's argument that human good consists in performing well the function distinctive to humans, which he identified as living according to reason
example: Using the function argument, Riya reasoned that a good phone charges quickly, so a good student must presumably think well.

hindi: फलनात्मक पूर्णता — संयोजकों के समूह का हर संभव सत्य-फलन व्यक्त कर पाने का गुण
definition: the property of a collection of connectives, or joining symbols, that can express every possible pattern of truth and falsity across combined statements
example: Jiya's electronics teacher proved the functional completeness of a single chip type, which is why the lab only stocks those.

hindi: प्रकार्यवाद — मानसिक अवस्था को उसकी कारणात्मक भूमिका से परिभाषित करने का मत
definition: the view that a mental state is defined by its causal role, meaning what typically causes it, what other mental states it produces and what behaviour it leads to, rather than by the stuff it is made of
example: When the office printer started sighing at every paper jam, Priya invoked functionalism and insisted that, if it plays the role of frustration, the printer is frustrated.

hindi: मूलभूत सत्तामीमांसा — मानवीय अस्तित्व के विश्लेषण से सत् के अर्थ की खोज
definition: Heidegger's project of asking about the meaning of being by first analysing human existence, which already understands being implicitly
example: Karan called his Sunday journalling fundamental ontology, though it was mostly about why he never finishes laundry.

hindi: मूल परियोजना — व्यक्ति का वह आधारभूत चुनाव जो उसके समूचे जीवन को दिशा देता है
definition: Sartre's term for the basic, overall choice of who to be that gives shape and direction to all of a person's smaller decisions
example: From his playlists to his career, everything Aman did seemed to serve one fundamental project: never being boring.

hindi: अतिरिक्त तथ्य — शरीर और मन के संबंधों से परे, व्यक्ति की पहचान को तय करने वाला कथित मूल तथ्य
definition: Parfit's term for a supposed extra fact about personal identity lying beyond all bodily and psychological relations, such as a separate soul, which reductionists deny exists
example: Staring at the teleporter in the video game, Rohit asked whether any further fact decided if his character was still really him.

hindi: क्षितिज-संलयन — पाठक और पाठ के दृष्टिकोणों का मिलकर नई समझ बनाना
definition: Gadamer's term for understanding as a meeting where the reader's outlook and the outlook of a text or another person merge into a wider shared view
example: After an hour arguing about the film, Maya and her grandfather reached a fusion of horizons over the ending.

hindi: भावी आकस्मिक कथन — ऐसी भावी घटनाओं के कथन जो अभी न अनिवार्य हैं न असंभव
definition: statements about future events that are neither necessary nor impossible, raising the puzzle, discussed by Aristotle, of whether they are already true or false today
example: Asked whether it would rain during the cricket match, Siddharth declared future contingents neither true nor false yet and packed an umbrella anyway.

hindi: हमारे-जैसे-भविष्य तर्क — भावी मूल्यवान जीवन छीनने के कारण हत्या को गलत मानने वाला तर्क
definition: the argument that killing is wrong because it deprives a being of a valuable future like ours, applied especially to debates about abortion
example: Deleting her half-finished novel, Zoya said a future-like-ours argument could surely be made for chapter four.

hindi: अस्पष्ट तर्कशास्त्र — सत्य को शून्य से एक तक अंशों में मापने वाला तर्क
definition: a many-valued logic in which statements can be true to any degree between completely false and completely true, used for vague ideas like 'tall', 'warm' or 'nearly full'
example: Tara explained that the office thermostat ran on fuzzy logic, which is why 'slightly cold' and 'freezing' produced exactly the same result.

hindi: अस्पष्ट समुच्चय — जिसके सदस्य आंशिक मात्रा में उसमें शामिल हों
definition: a collection whose members can belong partly, each having a degree of membership between none and full, rather than being simply inside or outside
example: Divya placed her uncle in the fuzzy set of 'people who can cook', with a membership of about 0.3 on good days.

hindi: मूर का पलटाव — प्रबल निश्चितता के बल पर संशयवादी तर्क का उलटा निष्कर्ष निकालना
definition: a strategy that turns a sceptical argument around, reasoning that because a conclusion like 'I have hands' is certain, one of the argument's premises must be false
example: When his classmate argued he could not know he was awake, Farhan pulled a G. E. Moore shift and waved both hands at him.

hindi: गैलीलियो विरोधाभास — वर्ग संख्याएँ कम लगकर भी सभी संख्याओं जितनी होने की उलझन
definition: the puzzle that square numbers seem fewer than all whole numbers, yet they can be paired with them exactly, one to one
example: Pairing every classmate with a snack, Chitra explained Galileo's paradox: somehow the smaller pile never ran out.

hindi: जुआरी का दोष — स्वतंत्र घटनाओं में पिछले परिणामों से अगला परिणाम तय मानना
definition: the mistaken belief that past results of a random process change the chances of the next result, even when each result is unaffected by earlier ones, such as expecting heads after many tails
example: After losing the coin toss for washing dishes five nights running, Arnav was sure tonight was his, the gambler's fallacy in full bloom.

hindi: खेल रूपवाद — गणित को शतरंज जैसे अर्थहीन प्रतीकों का नियमबद्ध खेल मानने का मत
definition: the view that mathematics resembles a game like chess, manipulating meaningless symbols according to fixed rules, so its statements concern nothing beyond those moves
example: Watching her nephew shuffle equations around without asking what they meant, Rekha diagnosed a serious case of game formalism.

hindi: परस्पर अनुनाद — चीनी मत कि समान प्रकार की वस्तुएँ दूरी पर भी एक-दूसरे को प्रभावित करती हैं
definition: the classical Chinese idea of resonance, in which things of the same kind stir and respond to each other across distance, as one plucked lute string sets its twin vibrating
example: When both twins texted Mum the same question at the same minute, she called it ganying and answered only once.

hindi: गौनिलो का खोया द्वीप — सत्तामूलक युक्ति के विरुद्ध परिपूर्ण द्वीप का प्रतिवाद
definition: an objection to the ontological argument which imagines the greatest possible island, claiming the same reasoning would wrongly prove that such a perfect island exists
example: When Aarav insisted the ideal office chair must exist somewhere, his manager replied with Gaunilo's lost island and pointed him back to the squeaky one.

hindi: गवागई — क्वाइन का उदाहरण-शब्द, जो अनुवाद और निर्देश की अनिश्चितता दिखाता है
definition: Quine's invented word, spoken by a native speaker as a rabbit runs past, used to show that evidence cannot settle whether the word means rabbit, rabbit part or rabbit stage
example: When the toddler pointed at the dog and shouted 'woof', his father had a gavagai moment: dog, bark, tail or dinner?

hindi: चैतन्य — व्यक्ति, संस्कृति और इतिहास में व्याप्त आत्मा या मन
definition: a German word meaning spirit or mind, used by Hegel for the shared consciousness that unfolds through individuals, cultures and history as it comes to know itself
example: Their history teacher said the Geist of the Renaissance was visible everywhere, from the paintings to the banking ledgers.

hindi: अनासक्त शांति — चीज़ों को होने देने की खुली, शांत मनोवृत्ति
definition: the German term, used by Heidegger, for a calm, open letting-be, releasing the urge to control things while still engaging with them
example: Faced with a delayed train, Aman practised Gelassenheit and read his book instead of refreshing the travel application.

hindi: लैंगिक द्वैत — केवल दो विपरीत लिंगों को मान्यता देने वाली व्यवस्था
definition: the classification of gender into a strict pair of opposite and separate categories, female and male, with no recognized space outside them
example: The gym's locker rooms had just two doors, and Sam joked that the building's architect clearly believed in the gender binary.

hindi: लैंगिक सारवाद — स्त्री-पुरुष में स्थायी जन्मजात स्वभाव मानने का मत
definition: the view that women and males possess fixed, innate natures that determine their traits, abilities and proper social roles
example: When the ad claimed girls are naturally better at folding laundry, Kavya diagnosed gender essentialism with a side of bad marketing.

hindi: लैंगिक प्रदर्शनात्मकता — लिंग को दोहराए गए आचरण से बनने वाली पहचान मानना
definition: Butler's view that gender is created through repeated everyday performances of speech, dress and behaviour, rather than expressing a fixed inner nature
example: Watching his nephew copy the uncles' handshakes at the wedding, Arjun decided gender performativity started earlier than he thought.

hindi: जीन-केंद्रित दृष्टि — विकास को जीनों के अपने प्रतिलिपि-प्रसार के रूप में देखने का मत
definition: the approach that treats evolution as competition among genes to copy themselves, with organisms understood as vehicles that genes build for their own survival
example: From a gene's-eye view, Kavya joked, her grandmother's matchmaking was just genes seeking another vehicle.

hindi: वंशानुक्रम-विश्लेषण — विचारों और संस्थाओं के उद्भव का आलोचनात्मक इतिहास
definition: a method used by Nietzsche and Foucault that traces how values, ideas or institutions arose from accidents, conflicts and power struggles rather than from timeless reason
example: Tracing the genealogy of the office dress code, Vikram found it began with one manager's grudge against sandals.

hindi: सामान्य प्रकाशन — प्रकृति और अंतरात्मा द्वारा सबको उपलब्ध ईश्वरीय ज्ञान
definition: knowledge about the divine believed to be available to everyone through nature, conscience and ordinary human experience
example: On a hiking trip, Leela pointed at the mountains and called them general revelation, while her brother called them a steep climb.

hindi: सामान्य इच्छा — पूरे समुदाय के साझा हित की ओर लक्षित सामूहिक इच्छा
definition: Rousseau's idea of the collective will of a whole community aimed at the common good, which differs from the private wants of each member
example: Everyone privately wanted pizza, but the general will of the study group, aimed at passing tomorrow, ordered salads and coffee.

hindi: सामान्यता समस्या — विश्वास-प्रक्रिया का सही स्तर तय करने की विश्वसनीयतावादी कठिनाई
definition: the difficulty for reliabilism of deciding how broadly to describe the process behind a belief, since different descriptions give different reliability scores
example: Arguing over whether Mira's belief came from 'eyesight' or from 'squinting at dusk through a dirty window', the study group ran headlong into the generality problem.

hindi: सामान्यीकृत निहितार्थ — लगभग हर संदर्भ में स्वतः उत्पन्न होने वाला निहितार्थ
definition: a hinted, unstated meaning that arises by default in almost any setting from the words chosen, without needing special knowledge of the particular conversation
example: "I met a woman yesterday" carries a generalized implicature that she was not your sister, whatever the family group chat says.

hindi: सामान्यीकृत अन्य — समाज की सामूहिक अपेक्षाएँ, जिन्हें व्यक्ति आत्मसात करता है
definition: George Herbert Mead's term for the combined attitudes and expectations of a whole community, which a person absorbs and uses to judge their own conduct
example: Before posting the photo, Ishaan imagined the generalized other of his class group and quietly deleted the caption.

hindi: उत्पत्ति-दोष — किसी विचार को उसके स्रोत के आधार पर ही सही या गलत ठहराना
definition: the fallacy of judging a claim true or false purely because of where it came from, rather than examining the evidence for the claim itself
example: The recipe came from a cereal box, sneered Dev, committing the genetic fallacy right before the cookies turned out perfect.

hindi: उत्पत्तिमूलक संवृतिशास्त्र — अर्थों के समय के साथ बनने की प्रक्रिया का अध्ययन
definition: the later stage of Husserl's phenomenology that studies how meanings and habits of experience develop and build up over time within consciousness
example: Explaining why she hates coriander, Pooja gave a genetic phenomenology stretching back to one terrible school lunch.

hindi: जाति-प्रतिभा — प्रेम के पीछे छिपी प्रजाति की अंधी इच्छा, शोपेनहावर के अनुसार
definition: Schopenhauer's name for the hidden drive of the species working through romantic attraction, steering lovers toward whoever suits future offspring
example: When Tara swooned over a stranger's jawline at the bus stop, her friend blamed the genius of the species.

hindi: प्रत्यक्ष सत्य-प्रकटन — रोज़मर्रा के जीवन में ही परम सत्य के प्रकट होने की शिक्षा
definition: Dogen's teaching that ultimate truth is actualized right here in everyday reality, so ordinary tasks can themselves express awakening
example: Washing dishes after the party, Tara joked about genjokoan, claiming each clean plate was enlightenment manifesting in her sink.

hindi: वास्तविक विकल्प — जीवंत, अनिवार्य और महत्वपूर्ण चुनाव
definition: William James's term for a choice between beliefs that is live, forced and momentous, the only kind where he thought faith may rightly outrun evidence
example: For Rohan, accepting the job abroad was a genuine option: both paths felt real, he had to pick one, and the stakes were huge.

hindi: जाति — वह व्यापक वर्ग जिसमें कई उपजातियाँ सम्मिलित होती हैं
definition: in Aristotelian definition, the broader class a thing belongs to, which contains several narrower species, such as animal being the wider class of human
example: Defining a samosa at the canteen, Mohit began with its genus, fried snack, before the argument about potatoes started.

hindi: ज्यामितीय परिपाटीवाद — दिक् की ज्यामिति को आंशिक रूप से सुविधा के चयन पर आधारित मानने का मत
definition: the view that which geometry describes physical space is partly a matter of convenient choice, since measurement alone cannot settle it
example: Arguing over whether the office floor plan was square, Shreya fell back on geometric conventionalism and said it depended on whose tape measure counted.

hindi: समग्र-दृष्टि परिवर्तन — एक ही तथ्यों को अचानक बिल्कुल भिन्न रूप में देखने लगना
definition: Kuhn's comparison between scientific change and a sudden perceptual flip, as when a drawing of a duck abruptly looks like a rabbit
example: Kabir experienced a Gestalt switch when the company logo he'd stared at for years suddenly revealed a hidden arrow.

hindi: गेटियर दृष्टांत — संयोगवश सत्य और तर्कसंगत विश्वास ज्ञान नहीं होता, यह दर्शाने वाला उदाहरण
definition: an example, following Edmund Gettier, where someone holds a true and well-justified belief that is true only by luck, used to show that justified true belief is not enough for knowledge
example: Reading a stopped clock that happened to show the correct time, Manav was right about lunch by pure accident, a perfect Gettier case.

hindi: गेटियर समस्या — सप्रमाण सत्य विश्वास के ज्ञान न होने के उदाहरणों से उठी चुनौती
definition: the challenge, raised by cases where someone holds a justified true belief only through lucky coincidence, that such belief still falls short of real knowledge
example: Glancing at a stopped kitchen clock that happened to show the right time, Arjun realised breakfast had handed him a Gettier problem.

hindi: गज़ेरा शावा — समान शब्दों के आधार पर दो पाठों में सादृश्य-अनुमान
definition: a rule for interpreting the Talmud, the vast collection of rabbinic legal debate and scripture that links two separate passages because they share the same word, applying the ruling of one to the other
example: Noticing both club rules used the word guest, Jacob applied a gezerah shavah and demanded the same snacks for both events.

hindi: यंत्र में प्रेत — शरीर रूपी यंत्र में अलग से बसे अभौतिक मन की धारणा पर रायल का व्यंग्यात्मक नाम
definition: Ryle's critical label for the Cartesian picture of a non-physical mind living inside the body and steering it like a hidden pilot
example: When Kiran insisted his real self was steering his body from somewhere behind the eyes, his philosophy teacher smiled and wrote 'ghost in the machine' on the board.

hindi: प्रदत्तता — किसी वस्तु का चेतना के समक्ष स्वयं प्रकट होना
definition: the manner in which anything shows or presents itself to consciousness, which phenomenologists treat as the starting point for describing experience
example: In the classroom debate, Leela insisted the givenness of the smell settled it: something in the lunchbox had definitely died.

hindi: वैश्विक न्याय — राष्ट्रीय सीमाओं के पार दुनिया भर के लोगों के प्रति न्याय के दायित्व
definition: the study of what fairness requires between nations and among all people worldwide, including duties across borders on poverty, trade and migration
example: The seminar on global justice ran long when someone asked whether rich countries owe anything for the climate damage they caused.

hindi: सर्वव्यापी संशयवाद — किसी भी ज्ञान को संभव न मानने का मत
definition: the sweeping sceptical position that doubts every kind of knowledge whatsoever, rather than questioning just one particular area of belief
example: Aarav's global scepticism collapsed quickly when someone questioned whether his pizza order had actually arrived.

hindi: वैश्विक कार्यक्षेत्र सिद्धांत — चेतना मस्तिष्क में जानकारी के सर्वत्र प्रसारण से उत्पन्न होती है, ऐसा सिद्धांत
definition: the theory that information becomes conscious when it is broadcast across the brain's shared workspace, making it available to many specialised systems at once
example: Ravi compared global workspace theory to the office announcement speaker: whatever gets broadcast, suddenly every department knows about it.

hindi: ज्ञान — मुक्ति देने वाला प्रत्यक्ष आध्यात्मिक बोध
definition: direct spiritual knowledge of the divine or ultimate reality, gained through inner insight rather than through reasoning or belief
example: Kunal claimed gnosis about the office Wi-Fi password, which turned out to be written on the fridge.

hindi: ज्ञानवाद — गुप्त आध्यात्मिक ज्ञान से मुक्ति मानने वाले प्राचीन मतों का समूह
definition: a group of ancient religious movements holding that salvation comes through secret spiritual knowledge, often teaching that the material world is flawed or a prison
example: Reading about Gnosticism, Pooja joked that her college's secret seating rules felt like knowledge revealed only to the chosen few.

hindi: अंतराल का ईश्वर — विज्ञान की अनसुलझी खाइयों में ईश्वर को रखने की आलोचना
definition: a critical label for using a deity to explain whatever science cannot yet explain, so that the deity's role shrinks as knowledge grows
example: When Karan blamed the vanishing socks on cosmic mystery, his flatmate warned him it was a God of the gaps explanation until someone checked the washing machine.

hindi: स्वर्णिम मध्य — दो अतियों के बीच का उचित संतुलन जिसमें सद्गुण बसता है
definition: the idea that each virtue sits at a balanced middle point between a pair of vices, one of excess and one of deficiency, as courage sits between rashness and cowardice
example: Choosing to reply to the angry email politely but firmly, Isha felt she had found the golden mean between doormat and volcano.

hindi: सदय-पथिक विरोधाभास — सहायता के दायित्व से अपराध का दायित्व निकलने की पहेली
definition: a puzzle in deontic logic in which an obligation to help a robbery victim seems to imply that the robbery ought to happen, since helping requires the robbery
example: Kabir teased the first-aid class with the good Samaritan paradox: if we ought to bandage the injured, then surely somebody ought to trip first.

hindi: सद्संकल्प — कर्तव्य के लिए ही कर्तव्य करने वाला संकल्प, जिसे कांट एकमात्र निरपेक्ष शुभ मानते हैं
definition: in Kant, a will that chooses rightly because duty requires it, the only thing he considered good without qualification
example: The surprise party flopped, but Maya insisted her good will still counted, even if the cake had collapsed.

hindi: शासन-बुद्धि — जनसंख्या और व्यक्तियों को संचालित करने की तकनीकें और सोच
definition: Foucault's term for the techniques, knowledge and habits of thought through which states and institutions steer the conduct of populations and individuals
example: The fitness app nudging everyone toward eight hours of sleep struck Ananya as governmentality with pastel graphics.

hindi: दादा-विरोधाभास — अतीत में जाकर अपने ही अस्तित्व को मिटाने की असंगति
definition: the puzzle that a time traveller who prevents their own grandparent from meeting would never be born, and so could never travel back
example: Planning a family trip, Rhea joked that visiting her grandfather's village might trigger the grandfather paradox if she criticised his cooking.

hindi: दादाजी की कुल्हाड़ी — पुर्ज़े बदलते रहने पर भी वस्तु की पहचान बने रहने की घरेलू पहेली
definition: a homely version of the ship of Theseus puzzle about a woodcutting tool whose handle and blade have both been replaced, asking whether it remains the same tool
example: Dad proudly called the kitchen knife a family heirloom, until Tara pointed out that with a new blade and handle it was really a grandfather's axe.

hindi: अधिकतम सुख का सिद्धांत — अधिकतम लोगों के अधिकतम सुख को नैतिकता की कसौटी मानने का सिद्धांत
definition: the utilitarian principle that actions are right insofar as they promote happiness and wrong insofar as they produce unhappiness, aiming at the greatest happiness overall
example: Choosing the playlist for the road trip, Zoya applied the greatest happiness principle and quietly skipped her favourite sad ballads.

hindi: ग्रेलिंग-नेल्सन विरोधाभास — 'स्वयं पर लागू न होने वाला' शब्द का स्वयं पर लागू होना या न होना
definition: the puzzle of whether the adjective 'heterological', meaning a word that does not describe itself, describes itself, since either answer leads to contradiction
example: In English class, Sahil tried to decide whether 'heterological' was heterological and discovered the Grelling-Nelson paradox by accident.

hindi: ग्राइस का उस्तरा — अर्थ-व्याख्या में न्यूनतम शाब्दिक अर्थ मानकर शेष को संदर्भ से समझना
definition: the principle that you should assume as few separate word meanings as possible, explaining extra hints through context and the expectations of polite conversation instead
example: Using Grice's razor, the linguistics tutor argued that 'some students passed' has one meaning, and the hint that not everyone passed comes from context.

hindi: गृहस्थ — परिवार और समाज के दायित्व निभाने वाली अवस्था
definition: the second stage of life in Hindu thought, the householder, who marries, earns a living, raises a family and supports society
example: Paying rent, fixing the leaking tap and packing school lunches, Anjali felt every inch the grihastha.

hindi: समूह चयन — प्राकृतिक चयन का पूरे समूहों पर कार्य करने का मत
definition: the view that natural selection can favour whole groups whose members cooperate, even when cooperation costs individual members something
example: Neel defended group selection by noting that teams who shared their notes all passed, while lone geniuses scraped through.

hindi: वर्धमान खंड सिद्धांत — भूत और वर्तमान को वास्तविक, पर भविष्य को अभी अस्तित्वहीन मानने का मत
definition: the view that past and present moments exist while future moments remain unreal, so reality grows as each fresh moment gets added
example: Staring at the unfinished spreadsheet, Arjun invoked growing block theory: tomorrow's rows simply did not exist yet, so neither did his deadline.

hindi: हरनीला — गुडमैन का गढ़ा रंग-विशेषण: किसी तय तिथि से पहले जाँचा जाए तो हरा, बाद में नीला
definition: Goodman's invented predicate meaning green if examined before a certain future date and blue otherwise, so every green emerald observed also counts as evidence for grue emeralds
example: Sana's roommate argued that every green kiwi in the fruit bowl was equally good evidence that kiwis are grue, so nobody should be surprised by blue ones next year.

hindi: मार्गदर्शी नियंत्रण — कर्म को अपनी विवेकशील प्रक्रिया से संचालित करने का नियंत्रण
definition: the control a person exercises when their action flows from their own reasons-responsive decision process, even without alternative options
example: Driving a car with dual controls, the learner still had guidance control, because the instructor never touched the second brake.

hindi: संगति-दोषारोप — किसी के साथियों के आधार पर उसे या उसके विचार को गलत ठहराना
definition: the fallacy of judging a person or an idea as wrong simply because disliked people are connected with that person or support that idea
example: Tanvi's cousin refused to try yoga because his annoying neighbour loved it, a clear case of guilt by association.

hindi: गुण — प्रकृति के तीन मूल तत्त्व: सत्त्व, रजस् और तमस्
definition: in Samkhya, the three strands or qualities woven through all of nature, sattva for clarity, rajas for restless energy and tamas for heaviness, whose shifting balance shapes every thing and mood
example: Looking at the office after the Friday lunch, Meenal said the gunas had shifted decisively toward tamas.

hindi: गुणस्थान — आत्मा के आध्यात्मिक विकास की चौदह अवस्थाएँ
definition: in Jain philosophy, one of fourteen stages of spiritual development through which the soul climbs as karmic matter falls away, ending in liberation
example: Seeing the fourteen stages on the whiteboard, Yash asked whether each gunasthana came with a progress bar like his fitness app.

hindi: स्त्रीकेंद्रिकता — स्त्री के अनुभव और दृष्टिकोण को केंद्र में रखना
definition: an approach that places women's experience, values and perspectives at the centre of thought, often as a corrective to male-centred thinking
example: The book club adopted gynocentrism for a year, reading only novels that told events through women's perspectives.

hindi: गोडेल वाक्य — ऐसा वाक्य जो अपने ही बारे में कहता है कि उसे सिद्ध नहीं किया जा सकता
definition: a statement constructed within a formal system that, in effect, says of itself that the system cannot prove it, and which is true provided the system is consistent
example: Aman's sticky note reading 'nobody in this office will ever approve this note' worked like a Gödel sentence and stumped his manager for a week.

hindi: अभ्यास-संस्कार — बार-बार आचरण द्वारा सद्गुण या स्वभाव का विकास
definition: the process of acquiring virtues by repeatedly performing the matching actions, so that you become generous by practising generosity until it feels natural
example: Their mother believed in habituation, so the twins said thank you to the delivery driver until they meant it.

hindi: अभ्यस्त वृत्ति — बार-बार के आचरण से बनी स्थिर प्रवृत्ति, जो सद्गुण या दुर्गुण का आधार है
definition: the Latin term medieval writers such as Aquinas used for a settled disposition of character, formed through repeated practice and inclining a person toward certain actions
example: Tidying her desk every evening had hardened into a habitus, so Nisha felt strange leaving the office with a pen out of place.

hindi: एतत्ता — किसी वस्तु का 'यह-पन', जो उसे हर दूसरी वस्तु से अलग व्यक्ति बनाता है
definition: the thisness of a thing, meaning the property of being this very individual and no other, even if another object matched it in every quality
example: The twins wore matching uniforms to school, but their teacher insisted each still had a haecceity, mostly visible in who had eaten whose lunch.

hindi: हैनलन का उस्तरा — जिसे मूर्खता से समझाया जा सके उसे दुर्भावना न मानना
definition: the principle that you should never assume someone acted from malice when carelessness or foolishness explains their behaviour well enough
example: Before replying angrily to the reply-all email, Kabir remembered Hanlon's razor and assumed his manager simply clicked the wrong button.

hindi: कठिन मुक़दमे — जहाँ स्थापित नियम स्पष्ट उत्तर नहीं देते और न्यायाधीश को विवेक या सिद्धांत से निर्णय करना पड़ता है
definition: legal disputes where the existing written rules and earlier rulings give no clear answer, raising the question of whether judges then create fresh rules or discover principles already present
example: Whether a delivery drone counts as a 'vehicle' in the park ban became one of those hard cases that kept the neighbourhood group chat busy for a week.

hindi: कठोर नियतिवाद — सब कुछ पूर्वनिर्धारित होने से स्वतंत्र इच्छा को नकारने का मत
definition: the view that every event, including every human choice, is fixed by earlier causes and natural laws, and that free will therefore does not exist
example: Rahul blamed hard determinism for his missed deadline, which impressed nobody in the office, least of all his manager.

hindi: कठोर असंगतिवाद — नियति हो या संयोग, दोनों में स्वतंत्र इच्छा को असंभव मानने का मत
definition: the view that free will is impossible whether or not determinism is true, since choices fixed by causes and choices left to chance are both beyond real control
example: Ishaan's hard incompatibilism collapsed the moment his roommate asked who had eaten the last mango.

hindi: कठोर पितृवाद — पूर्ण सूचित इच्छा के विरुद्ध भी भलाई हेतु हस्तक्षेप का मत
definition: the view that interfering with someone's fully informed, voluntary choice can be justified purely to protect that person from harming themselves
example: Confiscating Dad's salt shaker despite his fully informed protest was, the family agreed, hard paternalism at the dinner table.

hindi: चेतना की कठिन समस्या — भौतिक मस्तिष्क से अनुभूति क्यों उपजती है, यह प्रश्न
definition: the question of why physical processes in the brain are accompanied by felt inner experience at all, rather than happening with nobody feeling anything
example: Priya's biology notes explained every neuron firing during a headache, but the hard problem of consciousness remained: why does the headache actually hurt?

hindi: हानि-सिद्धांत — मिल का मत कि समाज केवल दूसरों को हानि से बचाने हेतु स्वतंत्रता रोक सकता है
definition: Mill's principle that society may restrict a person's liberty only to prevent harm to others, never merely for that person's own good
example: Citing the harm principle, Arjun argued that his pineapple pizza hurt nobody, whatever the group chat said.

hindi: गोलकों का संगीत — ग्रहों की गति में गणितीय सुर-संगति का विचार
definition: the Pythagorean idea that the planets and stars move in mathematical ratios that produce a cosmic music, even though human ears cannot hear it
example: Lying on the terrace looking at the stars, Riya claimed she could hear the harmony of the spheres, though it was mostly the neighbours' wedding band.

hindi: हस्कला — अठारहवीं-उन्नीसवीं सदी का यहूदी प्रबोधन आंदोलन
definition: the Jewish Enlightenment of the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries, a movement encouraging secular learning, reason and engagement with wider European culture
example: When Aaron's grandmother signed up for a science podcast, he congratulated her on joining the Haskalah.

hindi: अविचारित सामान्यीकरण — थोड़े उदाहरणों से व्यापक निष्कर्ष निकाल लेना
definition: the fallacy of drawing a broad general conclusion from a handful of examples, or from examples that do not represent the whole group
example: After one rude cab driver, Pooja decided the whole city was hostile, a hasty generalization she later took back.

hindi: प्रेत-सत्तामीमांसा — वर्तमान में अतीत और अधूरे भविष्यों की प्रेत-सी उपस्थिति
definition: Derrida's term, punning on ontology, for the manner in which past ideas and unrealised futures linger in the present like ghosts, neither fully present nor absent
example: The office still ran on a retired manager's spreadsheet formulas, a small daily hauntology nobody dared delete.

hindi: हृदय-मन — भावना और विचार का एक साथ केंद्र
definition: the Chinese concept of xin as a single organ of both feeling and thinking, where emotion, judgement and moral sense are not separated
example: Torn between logic and loyalty over the job offer, Sameer admitted his heart-mind was having a meeting with itself.

hindi: साही की दुविधा — जितना पास आओ उतना चुभो: निकटता और चोट के बीच का तनाव
definition: Schopenhauer's image of creatures who want closeness for warmth but hurt each other when they come near, describing human intimacy and its pains
example: Two roommates sharing one blanket during the power cut lived out the hedgehog's dilemma, trading warmth for elbows.

hindi: सुख-गणना — किसी कर्म से होने वाले सुख और दुःख को मापकर जोड़ने की बेंथम की विधि
definition: Bentham's method for measuring the pleasure and pain an action will cause, weighing features such as intensity, duration, certainty and extent, then adding the totals
example: Before buying the expensive headphones, Isha ran a hedonic calculus in her notes app: intense pleasure, long duration, certain regret at month's end.

hindi: सुखवाद — सुख को ही सर्वोच्च भलाई मानने का मत
definition: the view that pleasure is the highest good, and that seeking pleasure and avoiding pain is the proper goal of human life
example: Ordering dessert before even glancing at the mains was Tanya's small act of hedonism, and the waiter respected it.

hindi: सुखवादी उपयोगितावाद — सुख को ही एकमात्र मूल्य मानकर उसका कुल योग बढ़ाने का मत
definition: the form of utilitarianism holding that pleasure is the only thing valuable in itself, so right actions produce the greatest total pleasure minus pain for everyone
example: Tanvi's hedonistic utilitarianism explained why she ordered dessert for the whole table: more pleasure, shared widely, minus nobody's pain.

hindi: अंतःकरण-शासक — मन का वह अंश जो संवेदन, इच्छा और निर्णय को संचालित करता है
definition: the Stoic name for the ruling part of the soul, which receives sense impressions, gives or withholds agreement to them and directs every action
example: Ishaan's hegemonikon clearly rejected a third samosa, but his hands had apparently not received the memo.

hindi: नियति — कार्य-कारण की अटूट शृंखला के रूप में भाग्य
definition: the Stoic doctrine of fate as an unbreakable chain of causes running through the whole universe, so that everything happens necessarily
example: Missing the bus by three seconds, Aditya blamed heimarmene rather than the fifteen minutes he spent choosing socks.

hindi: हेलेनिस्टिक दर्शन — सिकंदर के बाद के स्टोइक, एपिक्यूरी और संशयवादी दर्शन
definition: the schools of thought flourishing after Alexander the Great, including Stoicism, Epicureanism and Scepticism, which focused on achieving calm and happiness
example: Their philosophy teacher summarised Hellenistic philosophy as three rival therapies for stress, and the whole class took notes.

hindi: एकत्व-मीमांसा — परम एक तत्त्व का दार्शनिक अध्ययन
definition: the study of the One, the single ultimate source of reality in Neoplatonism, which lies beyond being and beyond ordinary description
example: When Shruti tried to explain henology at dinner, her father asked whether the One also paid electricity bills.

hindi: इष्टदेववाद — अनेक देवताओं को मानते हुए भी एक ही देवता को सर्वोपरि मानकर पूजना
definition: the worship of one supreme deity while accepting that other deities also exist and may be worshipped by other people
example: Priya's grandmother practised a kind of henotheism, devoting every morning prayer to one deity while cheerfully wishing the neighbours well with theirs.

hindi: झुंड-नैतिकता — भीड़ के नियमों और सुरक्षा को सर्वोच्च मानने वाली नैतिकता
definition: Nietzsche's term for morality that prizes conformity, safety and sameness within the group, distrusting anyone strong or different who stands apart
example: When the whole class wore identical sneakers, Ishaan muttered that herd morality had reached the shoe rack.

hindi: आनुवंशिकतावाद — बुद्धि और स्वभाव को मुख्यतः वंशानुगत मानने का मत
definition: the view that heredity, the traits passed down through genes, matters more than upbringing or surroundings in shaping intelligence and character
example: Uncle's hereditarianism, 'our family is naturally good at maths', did not survive Ishaan's report card.

hindi: व्याख्या-चक्र — अंश को पूर्ण से और पूर्ण को अंश से समझने की चक्रीय प्रक्रिया
definition: the idea that understanding moves in a circle: you grasp the parts of a text through the whole, and the whole through its parts
example: Reading the group chat thread backwards and forwards, Sameer found himself trapped in the hermeneutic circle of one ambiguous emoji.

hindi: व्याख्यात्मक संवृतिशास्त्र — अनुभव को सदा व्याख्या के रूप में समझने वाला संवृतिशास्त्र
definition: the form of phenomenology, developed by Heidegger and later Gadamer and Ricoeur, holding that describing experience always already involves interpretation
example: Describing his first office party, Harsh found that hermeneutic phenomenology was unavoidable: every awkward handshake already came pre-interpreted.

hindi: व्याख्यात्मक अन्याय — अनुभव को नाम देने वाली अवधारणाओं के अभाव से उपजा अन्याय
definition: a wrong done to people as knowers, where a group lacks shared concepts to name and understand their own experience, because they were excluded from shaping the language everyone speaks
example: Before anyone had a word for workplace harassment, many employees suffered a hermeneutical injustice: they felt something was wrong but could not explain it to anyone.

hindi: व्याख्याशास्त्र — अर्थ और व्याख्या की प्रक्रिया का दार्शनिक अध्ययन
definition: the theory and philosophy of interpretation, studying how people understand the meaning of texts, actions and human experience
example: Decoding her boss's two-word email required serious hermeneutics from Parul and three colleagues.

hindi: संदेह का व्याख्याशास्त्र — स्पष्ट अर्थ के पीछे छिपे हितों को खोजने वाली व्याख्या
definition: Ricoeur's phrase for interpretation that looks beneath obvious meanings for hidden motives, such as economic interests or unconscious desires
example: Applying a hermeneutics of suspicion, Nikhil wondered why his flatmate's sudden offer to cook arrived just before rent was due.

hindi: परतंत्रता — संकल्प का विवेक के बजाय इच्छाओं या बाहरी शक्तियों से नियंत्रित होना
definition: in Kant, the condition of a will ruled by something outside reason, such as desires, fear, rewards or other people's commands
example: Buying the phone only because influencers pushed it was pure heteronomy, Nisha admitted, scrolling through her bank statement.

hindi: विषमलैंगिक मानकता — विषमलैंगिकता को ही सामान्य और स्वाभाविक मानने की धारणा
definition: the assumption that heterosexuality is the normal, default form of human sexuality, built into institutions, customs and everyday expectations
example: When every form at the new school asked for 'mother's name' and 'father's name', Leo's two dads sighed at the heteronormativity.

hindi: हेतु — अनुमान में प्रयुक्त कारण या चिह्न
definition: in Nyaya logic, the reason or sign in an inference, such as smoke, whose presence points through pervasion to the thing being proved
example: In the debate club, Rehan's hetu for the canteen being closed was simple: nobody was carrying samosas.

hindi: हेत्वाभास — दोषपूर्ण हेतु, जो सही कारण जैसा दिखता है पर नहीं है
definition: in Nyaya logic, a fallacious reason, a sign that only looks like a sound ground for inference but fails, for example because it strays or contradicts itself
example: Claiming the new intern was lazy because he wore sneakers, Vikram was gently told his reasoning was a textbook hetvabhasa.

hindi: स्थायी वृत्ति — अभ्यास से बनी चरित्र की स्थिर अवस्था
definition: the Greek term for a stable disposition of character, a settled tendency built by practice that shapes how a person feels and acts
example: After a year of daily running, getting up early had become a hexis for Leela, no longer a heroic struggle.

hindi: हिकम का सूत्र — किसी स्थिति के एक से अधिक स्वतंत्र कारण हो सकते हैं
definition: the principle, often paired against Occam's razor, that a situation may have several separate causes at once rather than one single explanation
example: Applying Hickam's dictum, the mechanic found both a flat battery and a broken starter, much to the driver's dismay.

hindi: प्रच्छन्न पाठ्यक्रम — विद्यालय द्वारा अनजाने में सिखाए जाने वाले मूल्य और आदतें
definition: the values, habits and attitudes that schools teach without stating them, through rules, routines, seating, rewards and the silent example of adults
example: Nobody ever taught obedience in so many words, but the hidden curriculum of bells, queues and raised hands taught it every single morning.

hindi: छिपे चर सिद्धांत — क्वांटम संयोग के पीछे अज्ञात निश्चित कारण होने का मत
definition: any interpretation of quantum physics claiming that apparently random measurement results are fixed by further hidden facts the standard theory leaves out
example: Rahul's hidden variable theory of the office vending machine held that its choices only looked random because nobody knew about the stuck coin.

hindi: उच्चतर सुख — बुद्धि, कला और नैतिक भावना के सुख, जिन्हें मिल शारीरिक सुखों से श्रेष्ठ मानता था
definition: Mill's claim that pleasures of the intellect, feelings and imagination are more valuable than bodily pleasures, judged by those who know both
example: Choosing a poetry reading over a buffet, Asha claimed the higher pleasures, then raided the buffet afterwards.

hindi: उच्च-स्तरीय साक्ष्य — अपनी तर्क-क्षमता की विश्वसनीयता के बारे में प्रमाण
definition: evidence about whether your own reasoning is reliable, such as learning you are exhausted or that a peer disagrees, rather than evidence about the question itself
example: Realising she had been awake for twenty hours was higher-order evidence that made Neha recheck her late-night tax calculation.

hindi: उच्च-क्रम सिद्धांत — किसी मानसिक अवस्था का सचेत होना उसके बारे में दूसरी मानसिक अवस्था पर निर्भर है, ऐसा मत
definition: the view that a mental state becomes conscious only when the mind has a further thought or perception about being in that state
example: Only when her colleague asked why she was humming did Kavya notice it, a small win for the higher-order theory.

hindi: उच्चस्तरीय अस्पष्टता — स्पष्ट और सीमांत उदाहरणों के बीच की सीमा का भी धुंधला होना
definition: the vagueness of the boundaries between clear cases and borderline cases themselves, so there is no sharp point where the borderline cases begin
example: Trying to decide exactly when the evening became 'late enough' to leave the party, Arjun ran into higher-order vagueness and stayed till dawn.

hindi: परम शुभ — सद्गुण और उसके अनुरूप सुख का मेल
definition: Kant's ideal of complete moral goodness combined with happiness exactly proportioned to it, a goal reason hopes for but cannot guarantee in this life
example: Rahul's idea of the highest good was an office where the most honest employee also received the biggest bonus.

hindi: हिकमत — इस्लामी परंपरा में तर्क और आध्यात्मिक अनुभूति को जोड़ने वाला विवेक-दर्शन
definition: wisdom philosophy in the Islamic tradition, a later style of thinking that blends rational philosophy with mystical insight and spiritual practice
example: Ayesha described her yoga-plus-logic reading club as hikma for beginners: half careful argument, half quiet reflection.

hindi: हिल्बर्ट होटल — अनंत कमरों वाले भरे होटल में फिर भी नया अतिथि समा जाना
definition: a thought experiment about a hotel with endlessly many rooms, all full, which can still house new guests by shifting everyone along
example: Hearing that the fully booked wedding venue had squeezed in forty more guests, Gaurav called it Hilbert's hotel.

hindi: हिल्बर्ट कार्यक्रम — संपूर्ण गणित को औपचारिक रूप देकर उसकी संगति सिद्ध करने की योजना
definition: the early twentieth-century project of writing all mathematics as formal axiom systems and proving them consistent using only simple, finite reasoning
example: Trying to reduce the entire family budget to fixed rules that could never contradict each other, Neel launched his own Hilbert's program over dinner.

hindi: आधार-प्रतिज्ञप्ति — जिन पर संदेह-विश्वास का पूरा ढाँचा टिका है
definition: Wittgenstein's idea of a basic certainty, such as having hands, that is never questioned because all ordinary doubting and checking depend on it
example: Checking whether the lift worked, Anjali never doubted the hinge proposition that the building still had floors.

hindi: अचिन्तन — सोचने और न सोचने से परे की ध्यान अवस्था
definition: Dogen's teaching of thinking beyond thinking, a meditative awareness that neither grasps thoughts nor pushes them away but lets them pass freely
example: Arjun claimed his blank stare during the maths lecture was actually hishiryo, though the teacher suspected ordinary daydreaming.

hindi: ऐतिहासिक कला-परिभाषा — पूर्ववर्ती कलाकृतियों से जुड़ाव के आधार पर कलाकृति को पहचानने का मत
definition: the view that something counts as an artwork when its maker intends people to regard it in ways that earlier, accepted artworks have been regarded
example: Using the historical definition of art, Omar argued his cardboard sculpture belonged beside every earlier sculpture made from humble materials.

hindi: ऐतिहासिक भौतिकवाद — इतिहास को उत्पादन की भौतिक परिस्थितियों से संचालित मानने का मार्क्सवादी मत
definition: the Marxist view that history is driven mainly by how societies produce the material goods they need, so that changes in production shape legal systems, politics and ideas
example: Arjun explained the rise of work-from-home through historical materialism: first came fast broadband, and only afterwards did managers discover they believed in trust.

hindi: हिचेन्स का उस्तरा — जो दावा बिना प्रमाण किया गया, उसे बिना प्रमाण ठुकराया जा सकता है
definition: the principle that a claim made without any evidence can be dismissed without any evidence, placing the burden of proof on whoever makes the claim
example: When his cousin insisted the moon landing was staged, Kunal reached for Hitchens's razor and went back to eating his samosa.

hindi: छिद्र तर्क — सामान्य सापेक्षता में दिक्-काल बिंदुओं को स्वतंत्र सत्ता मानने के विरुद्ध तर्क
definition: an argument from general relativity that treating spacetime points as real entities makes physics unable to predict what happens inside an empty region
example: Mira brought up the hole argument at lunch, and her physics friend admitted it bothered him more than the canteen's missing dessert.

hindi: पवित्र संकल्प — ऐसा संकल्प जो स्वभाव से ही सदा नैतिक नियम के अनुरूप चले
definition: in Kant, a perfectly rational will that always agrees with the moral rule by nature, so for it duty never feels like pressure
example: Watching his sister cheerfully return a lost wallet without a second thought, Om wondered whether she had a holy will or just good sleep.

hindi: समस्थितिक गुण-समूह — स्थिर कारणों से साथ रहने वाले गुणों का समूह जो वर्ग बनाता है
definition: a natural kind, such as a biological species, marked out by a cluster of properties that stable causes keep occurring together, rather than by one essence every member shares
example: Nikhil described his friend group as a homeostatic property cluster: nobody shared every trait, but cricket and bad jokes kept them together.

hindi: मानव-मानक सिद्धांत — मनुष्य को सब वस्तुओं का मापदंड मानने वाला प्रोटागोरस का मत
definition: Protagoras's doctrine that each human being is the measure of all things, meaning that how things appear to someone is how they are for that person
example: When his sister said the room was freezing and he said it was perfect, Yash invoked homo mensura and refused to touch the thermostat.

hindi: लघुमानव प्रकार्यवाद — मन को छोटे-छोटे सरल उप-तंत्रों की परतों में बाँटकर समझाने का मत
definition: the form of functionalism that explains a mind as layers of simpler functional subsystems, each doing a smaller, dumber task, until the bottom layers are simple enough for plain machinery
example: Describing his startup's org chart, Vikram accidentally gave a lecture on homuncular functionalism: every manager is just a team of progressively less clever interns.

hindi: लघुमानव दोष — मन को भीतर बैठे एक और छोटे मन से समझाने की भूल
definition: the mistake of explaining some mental capacity, such as vision, by quietly assuming a little person inside the head who already has that very capacity
example: When his friend said the brain shows pictures to the mind, Yash flagged the homunculus fallacy and asked who was watching the tiny screen.

hindi: मूल बोधि — सभी प्राणियों के स्वभावतः पहले से प्रबुद्ध होने का सिद्धांत
definition: the Japanese doctrine of original enlightenment, holding that all beings are already fully awakened by nature and need only realize this
example: When his mother nagged him to study, Vivaan cited hongaku, arguing that since he was already enlightened, revision seemed unnecessary.

hindi: क्षितिज — किसी अनुभव के चारों ओर संभावनाओं और अर्थों का पृष्ठभूमि-क्षेत्र
definition: in phenomenology, the background of further possible experiences and meanings surrounding anything perceived, such as the unseen back side of a teacup
example: Kiran saw only the front of the parcel, but its horizon already included the tape, the bubble wrap and the probable disappointment.

hindi: रिक्तता-भय — प्रकृति के शून्य या रिक्त स्थान से बचने की पुरानी धारणा
definition: the ancient principle that nature abhors a vacuum and always rushes to fill any empty space with matter
example: Every time someone vacated a seat on the metro, a new passenger appeared instantly, which Aarav called horror vacui in action.

hindi: ताओ-विधि समन्वय — ताओवादी और विधिवादी विचारों को मिलाने वाला राजनीतिक मत
definition: the early Chinese school that blended Daoist ideas of effortless action with Legalist methods of running a state, advising rulers to govern lightly through clear standards
example: The manager set firm deadlines and then stayed out of everyone's hair, a style Farah described as office Huang-Lao.

hindi: अवतंसक दर्शन — सब वस्तुओं के परस्पर समाहित होने का चीनी बौद्ध मत
definition: the Chinese Buddhist school, based on the Flower Garland Sutra, which teaches that every thing contains and reflects every other thing in an endless network
example: Looking at mirrors reflecting mirrors in the lift, Ananya finally grasped Huayan.

hindi: मानवीय गरिमा — मनुष्य का वह अमूल्य मूल्य जिसकी तुलना या अदला-बदली संभव नहीं
definition: in Kantian ethics, the unconditional worth every rational person has, which cannot be priced or traded against anything else
example: When the manager joked about ranking staff like groceries, Tanvi reminded him that human dignity doesn't come with a barcode.

hindi: मानव संवर्धन — तकनीक द्वारा मनुष्य की क्षमताओं को सामान्य सीमा से आगे बढ़ाना
definition: applying medicine or technology to improve human abilities beyond normal healthy functioning, rather than merely treating disease
example: When Rohit's exam-week coffee reached six cups, his sister accused him of amateur human enhancement.

hindi: मानवीय उत्कर्ष — मनुष्य के रूप में पूरी तरह फलना-फूलना और अच्छा जीवन जीना
definition: the condition of living a full, thriving human life in which your abilities, character and relationships develop well over the whole of your life
example: The school counsellor said human flourishing needed more than good marks, which Tara took as permission to join the drama club.

hindi: मानवाधिकार — वे मूल अधिकार जो हर मनुष्य को केवल मनुष्य होने के नाते प्राप्त हैं
definition: basic rights and freedoms held by every person simply because they are human, regardless of nationality, gender, religion, ethnicity or status
example: In civics class, Aditi pointed out that human rights apply to everyone, including the classmate who always reclines his chair into her desk.

hindi: मानवतावाद — मानव की गरिमा, बुद्धि और कल्याण को केंद्र में रखने वाला मत
definition: the outlook that places human dignity, reason and welfare at the centre, seeking to live well without relying on supernatural authority
example: Her humanism shows in small things: she learns the name of every security guard and asks how their children are doing.

hindi: लोकहितवाद — दुखी मनुष्यों की भलाई को अपना कर्तव्य मानने का मत
definition: the view that people have a duty to reduce human suffering and improve the welfare of others, whoever and wherever they are
example: Her humanitarianism is practical: she skipped the debate about global poverty and set up a monthly donation before lunch.

hindi: ह्यूम का सूत्र — यह मत कि भिन्न-भिन्न अस्तित्वों के बीच कोई अनिवार्य संबंध नहीं होता
definition: the principle that there are no necessary connections between distinct existences, so any separate things could in principle exist without each other
example: Citing Hume's dictum, Jai argued his socks could exist without their pair, which explained the laundry basket.

hindi: ह्यूम का द्विभाजन — सारे ज्ञान को विचार-संबंध और तथ्य-विषय में बाँटने का सिद्धांत
definition: Hume's claim that every piece of knowledge is either about relations between ideas, known by reasoning, or about matters of fact, known by experience
example: Using Hume's fork on the office rumour, Neel asked whether it was true by definition or whether anyone had actually seen the memo.

hindi: ह्यूम का गिलोटिन — 'है' से 'चाहिए' निकालने पर लगी रोक
definition: the principle that statements about how things ought to be cannot be logically derived from statements only about how things actually are
example: When his roommate said everyone skips the dishes so nobody should mind, Arjun dropped Hume's guillotine on the argument.

hindi: ह्यूम का नियम — तथ्य-कथनों से अकेले कर्तव्य-कथन नहीं निकाले जा सकते, यह सिद्धांत
definition: the principle that no statement about what ought to happen can be validly derived from premises that only describe what is the case
example: Citing Hume's law, Zara told her father that 'the neighbours all have a trampoline' proves nothing about whether the family should.

hindi: ह्यूम सिद्धांत — दो समूहों की संख्या तभी समान है जब उनके सदस्यों की पूरी-पूरी जोड़ियाँ बन सकें
definition: the principle, central to neo-logicism, that two collections have the same number of members exactly when their members can be paired off perfectly, with nothing left over
example: Unable to count the chairs, the teacher applied Hume's principle: every student sat down, nobody stood, so there were as many chairs as students.

hindi: ह्यूमीय अधिनिर्भरता — यह मत कि जगत के सारे तथ्य स्थानीय तथ्यों के वितरण पर ही निर्भर हैं
definition: David Lewis's thesis that every fact about the world, including its causes and laws, depends entirely on the arrangement of local particular facts across space and time
example: Aman defended Humean supervenience in the group chat: fix every pixel of the universe, he said, and the laws come along for free.

hindi: ह्यूमीय प्रेरणा सिद्धांत — कर्म के लिए विश्वास के साथ इच्छा का होना अनिवार्य है, यह मत
definition: the view that beliefs alone never move anyone to action, and that every motivation requires a desire working together with a belief
example: Knowing the gym was open never got Aarav there, which he cited as proof of the Humean theory of motivation.

hindi: ह्यूमवाद — यह मत कि प्रकृति में कोई अनिवार्य संबंध नहीं, और नियम केवल घटनाओं के प्रतिरूपों का सार हैं
definition: in debates about laws and causation, the view that the world contains no necessary connections, only a mosaic of particular facts, and laws merely summarise its patterns
example: Neel's Humeanism made him unbearable at trivia night: gravity, he insisted, was just a very consistent summary.

hindi: शत संप्रदाय — प्राचीन चीन के अनेक दार्शनिक मतों का युग
definition: the period of lively debate in ancient China when many rival schools, including Confucians, Daoists, Mohists and Legalists, competed to advise rulers
example: The family group chat, with its dozen competing theories about the leaking tap, resembled the Hundred Schools.

hindi: हुन्हु — शोना भाषा में दूसरों के प्रति करुणा और सामुदायिक मनुष्यता का आदर्श
definition: the Shona word for the southern African ideal that personhood is realised through caring relationships, respect and responsibility within community
example: Tendai lent his last bus fare to a stranger, and his grandmother said that showed real hunhu.

hindi: निर्णायक प्रश्न-वाक्य — ध्यान में निरंतर संशय के साथ धारण किया जाने वाला सूत्र
definition: the critical phrase in Korean meditation, taken from a koan, which the student holds with doubt and intense focus until thinking breaks open
example: Kabir kept repeating 'what is this?' through his whole commute, treating the question as his hwadu until the bus driver started worrying.

hindi: विवाद-समन्वय — विरोधी मतों में सामंजस्य खोजने की कोरियाई बौद्ध पद्धति
definition: the Korean Buddhist method of harmonizing disputes, showing how rival doctrines each capture partial truths within a single larger vision
example: As class monitor, Jiya practised hwajaeng, persuading both debate teams that each side was half right about the uniform policy.

hindi: संकर अभिव्यक्तिवाद — नैतिक कथनों को एक साथ मान्यता और अभिवृत्ति दोनों व्यक्त करने वाला मानने का मत
definition: the view that moral statements express both a belief about the world and an attitude of approval or disapproval at the same time
example: Hybrid expressivism fit Meena's review of the café perfectly: 'rude staff' both described the service and plainly expressed her disapproval.

hindi: मिश्रित कल्याण सिद्धांत — वस्तुगत रूप से अच्छी वस्तुओं का आनंदपूर्वक अनुभव ही कल्याण है
definition: the theory holding that a person's life goes well for them only when objectively valuable goods, such as friendship or knowledge, are combined with that person's enjoying or wanting them
example: Siddharth defended a hybrid theory of wellbeing: the guitar lessons were valuable, but only because he actually loved them rather than enduring them.

hindi: द्रव्य-रूपवाद — हर भौतिक वस्तु को पदार्थ और रूप का संयोग मानने का मत
definition: Aristotle's view that every physical thing is a combination of matter and form, the stuff it is made of joined with the structure that organises that stuff
example: Explaining hylomorphism in class, Mrs Kapoor held up a lump of clay, then a clay mug, and asked which one could hold coffee.

hindi: जीवद्रव्यवाद — यह मत कि समस्त पदार्थ स्वयं में जीवित है
definition: the view that all matter is itself alive, so that life belongs to the physical stuff of the world rather than being added from outside
example: The way the office printer jammed only before deadlines made Priya half believe in hylozoism.

hindi: अतिशय संदेह — जानबूझकर चरम सीमा तक खींचा गया संदेह
definition: Descartes's deliberately exaggerated doubt that treats any belief with even the slightest possibility of error as though it were false
example: Checking the stove six times before leaving, Varun admitted his hyperbolic doubt had spread from philosophy class into his kitchen.

hindi: अतियथार्थ — वह अवस्था जिसमें नकली छवियाँ असली से अधिक वास्तविक लगें
definition: Baudrillard's term for a condition where media images and simulations seem more real than reality itself, so people can no longer separate the model from the thing
