example: When Ishaan's friends judged the beach trip by how the filtered photos looked rather than how the weekend felt, they were living in hyperreality.

hindi: काल्पनिक सहमति — वह स्वीकृति जो लोग तर्कसंगत होने पर देते, भले वास्तव में न दी हो
definition: the agreement people would give to a government or rule if they were reasoning fairly and sensibly, used to justify authority even when no actual agreement was given
example: Dad justified the new chore chart by hypothetical consent: any reasonable teenager, he claimed, would have agreed to it.

hindi: सापेक्ष आदेश — किसी इच्छित लक्ष्य की शर्त पर ही लागू होने वाला आदेश
definition: in Kant, a command that applies only on condition that you want some particular goal, such as 'study hard if you want good marks'
example: Mum's 'take an umbrella if you want to stay dry' was a hypothetical imperative, which Arjun cheerfully ignored because he enjoyed the rain.

hindi: कल्पित आशयवाद — जानकार पाठक द्वारा अनुमानित आशय को कृति का अर्थ मानने का मत
definition: the view that a work means what an informed, attentive reader would best guess its maker intended, rather than what the maker actually intended
example: Taking hypothetical intentionalism, Sana said the poem's meaning was whatever a careful reader would guess, not whatever the poet muttered later.

hindi: परिकल्पना-निगमन विधि — परिकल्पना से परिणाम निकालकर प्रेक्षण से जाँचने की वैज्ञानिक पद्धति
definition: the scientific method of proposing a hypothesis, deducing observable predictions from it, and then testing whether those predictions come true
example: Using the hypothetico-deductive method, Anika predicted that if the fuse had blown, the kitchen lights would stay dark, and they did.

hindi: परिकल्पना-निगमनवाद — पुष्टि को परिकल्पना से निकले अनुमानों के सफल परीक्षण पर आधारित मानने का मत
definition: the view that a hypothesis is confirmed when observable predictions deduced from it turn out true, making the hypothetico-deductive method the core of scientific reasoning
example: Sameer's hypothetico-deductivism about the wifi meant predicting a router reboot would help, then rebooting it smugly.

hindi: मैं-वह संबंध — दूसरे को वस्तु या साधन मानकर देखने का बूबर का विचार
definition: Martin Buber's term for a relationship in which you treat another being as an object to be measured, used or managed, rather than meeting them as a person
example: Calling the delivery rider only by his order number, Vikram realised the whole exchange had been pure I-It.

hindi: मैं-तुम संबंध — किसी को पूर्ण व्यक्ति के रूप में मिलने का बूबर का विचार
definition: Martin Buber's term for a relationship in which you meet another being as a whole person in genuine mutual presence, not as an object to be used
example: Putting her phone away during coffee with her father, Tara felt the conversation shift into something like I-Thou.

hindi: आदर्श भाषा दर्शन — दार्शनिक समस्याएँ सुलझाने के लिए सटीक तार्किक भाषा गढ़ने का दृष्टिकोण
definition: the approach in analytic philosophy that seeks to build a perfectly precise logical language, free of the vagueness of everyday speech, in which philosophical problems can be settled
example: Frustrated by vague project briefs, Siddharth dreamed of an office run on ideal language philosophy, where every request had exactly one meaning.

hindi: आदर्श द्रष्टा सिद्धांत — किसी कर्म को सही मानना यानी पूर्ण ज्ञानी निष्पक्ष द्रष्टा द्वारा उसे स्वीकार्य पाना
definition: the view that an action is right if a fully informed, impartial and calm observer would approve of it, and wrong if they would disapprove
example: To end the sibling feud over the remote, Asha appealed to ideal observer theory: a calm, all-knowing referee would clearly back her claim.

hindi: आदर्श सिद्धांत — पूर्ण अनुपालन वाले पूर्णतः न्यायपूर्ण समाज के सिद्धांतों पर केंद्रित चिंतन
definition: political philosophy that works out principles for a perfectly just society in which everyone complies, before tackling injustice in the messy real world
example: Ideal theory told the flatmates how chores should be divided; nonideal theory had to deal with Sahil never doing any.

hindi: आदर्श उपयोगितावाद — सुख के साथ ज्ञान, सौंदर्य और मित्रता जैसे मूल्यों को भी बढ़ाने का मत
definition: the form of utilitarianism, linked with G. E. Moore, holding that right actions maximize several goods valuable in themselves, such as knowledge, beauty and friendship, not pleasure alone
example: Nisha's ideal utilitarianism insisted the school trip include the art gallery, since beauty counts even when the arcade would produce more giggles.

hindi: प्रत्ययवाद — यथार्थ को मूलतः मानसिक या विचारमय मानने का मत
definition: the view that reality is fundamentally made of minds and ideas, so that the physical world depends on being thought or perceived
example: On the walk to school Kunal tried out idealism, wondering whether the traffic jam existed only because everyone kept thinking about it.

hindi: आत्मचिंतनजन्य प्रत्यय — मन द्वारा अपनी क्रियाओं के निरीक्षण से प्राप्त विचार
definition: in Locke's theory, ideas the mind gains by noticing its own operations, such as thinking, doubting, believing and willing
example: Journaling about why she kept doubting her decisions, Pooja realised she was collecting ideas of reflection rather than sensation.

hindi: इंद्रियजन्य प्रत्यय — बाहरी इंद्रियों से प्राप्त लॉक के विचार
definition: in Locke's theory, ideas that come into the mind through the outward senses, such as colour, sound, warmth and texture
example: Lying on the beach, Zoya said her brain was running only on ideas of sensation: sunlight, salt spray and gritty sand.

hindi: अविभेद्यों की अभिन्नता — जिन वस्तुओं के सारे गुण एक जैसे हों, वे एक ही वस्तु हैं, यह सिद्धांत
definition: Leibniz's principle that if things share every single property, with nothing whatever to tell them apart, then they are really one and the same thing
example: Staring at two identical phone chargers on the office desk, Sam invoked the identity of indiscernibles and declared that both were therefore his.

hindi: अस्मिता की राजनीति — साझी सामाजिक पहचान के आधार पर संगठित राजनीति
definition: political activity organized around shared social identity, such as race, gender, religion or sexuality, especially by groups seeking recognition and justice
example: The group chat split in half over whether the student union election had become pure identity politics or overdue representation.

hindi: पहचान-पूर्वाग्रह — किसी की सामाजिक पहचान से जुड़ी पूर्वधारणा
definition: a prejudice attached to someone's social identity, such as gender, caste, race or accent, that distorts how much credibility listeners grant their words
example: The call-centre agent's accent triggered identity prejudice in the customer, who demanded a supervisor to repeat the exact same answer.

hindi: तादात्म्य सिद्धांत — मानसिक अवस्थाओं को मस्तिष्क की अवस्थाओं के समान मानने का मत
definition: the view that mental states are literally identical with physical states of the brain, so that a feeling of pain simply is a certain pattern of neural firing
example: When Rahul said his headache was only in his mind, his neuroscience-student roommate replied that, according to identity theory, his mind was only in his brain.

hindi: वैचारिक राज्य-तंत्र — विद्यालय, परिवार, मीडिया जैसे संस्थान जो शासक विचारधारा फैलाते हैं
definition: Althusser's term for institutions such as schools, families, religion and media that spread the ruling ideology without using open force
example: Riya decided her school's morning assembly was an ideological state apparatus, though a surprisingly tuneful one.

hindi: विचारधारा — राजनीति और समाज को समझने वाले विश्वासों और मूल्यों की व्यवस्था
definition: a connected system of beliefs and values about society and politics that shapes how a group sees the world and what it wants
example: Their dinner argument ended when Nisha pointed out that everyone called their own views common sense and everyone else's ideology.

hindi: विचारधारा-आलोचना — प्रचलित विचारों में छिपे शासक-हितों को उजागर करने की पद्धति
definition: the method of examining widely held beliefs to reveal how they quietly serve the interests of powerful groups while presenting themselves as natural or neutral
example: In sociology class, Riya practised ideology critique on a cereal advert and concluded that the happy family was mainly there to sell sugar.

hindi: यदि-तो वाद — गणित को केवल 'यदि ये अभिगृहीत, तो ये निष्कर्ष' जैसे कथनों का संग्रह मानने का मत
definition: the view that mathematical statements do not describe real objects but only claim that certain conclusions follow logically if certain axioms, meaning starting assumptions, are granted
example: When her brother asked whether parallel lines ever meet, Zoya answered with pure if-thenism: that depends entirely on which geometry rules you start with.

hindi: अर्थान्तर दोष — मूल प्रश्न छोड़कर किसी दूसरी बात को सिद्ध कर देना
definition: the fallacy of arguing for a conclusion that differs from the actual point in question, so the argument misses the matter being debated
example: Asked whether the project was late, Suresh proved at length that the team worked hard, a polished ignoratio elenchi.

hindi: अर्थ-संशयवाद — 'ईश्वर' शब्द के स्पष्ट अर्थ के बिना अस्तित्व-प्रश्न को निरर्थक मानने का मत
definition: the view that questions about whether a deity exists are meaningless until the word itself is given a clear, testable definition
example: When asked if the office had a dress code, Leena's ignosticism kicked in: first define 'smart casual', then we'll talk.

hindi: इज्तिहाद — स्वतंत्र विवेक से धार्मिक-कानूनी प्रश्नों पर निर्णय
definition: independent reasoning by a qualified scholar to reach a fresh judgement on a legal or moral question where earlier sources give no clear answer
example: When the club rulebook said nothing about video calls, Zainab used a little ijtihad and decided remote members could still vote.

hindi: सुरुचि — सहज, संयत और परिष्कृत आकर्षण का जापानी सौंदर्य-भाव
definition: the Japanese aesthetic ideal of understated, effortless stylishness, combining urban sophistication, restraint and a hint of playful allure
example: Zara's grandfather showed iki at the wedding, wearing a plain grey kurta with such quiet confidence that everyone else looked overdressed.

hindi: अभिकथन-क्रिया — कहने में ही किया गया कार्य, जैसे वादा या चेतावनी
definition: the action a speaker performs in saying something, such as promising, warning or requesting, judged by the purpose behind the words rather than their effect
example: "The floor is wet" was an illocutionary act of warning, though Dev treated it as a mere report and slid straight into the fridge.

hindi: कथन-बल — किसी कथन का अभिप्राय, कि वह वादा है, आदेश है या प्रश्न
definition: the kind of action a sentence carries in context, such as promise, command, question or warning, which can differ even when the words stay the same
example: "Nice parking" from a stranger in the lot had the illocutionary force of a complaint, not a compliment.

hindi: इशराक़ दर्शन — ज्ञान को प्रकाश और प्रत्यक्ष अनुभूति से समझने वाला मत
definition: the philosophy founded by Suhrawardi which treats reality as degrees of light and holds that the deepest knowledge comes through direct inner vision rather than definition alone
example: When Sana said she understood calculus only after it suddenly clicked, her tutor called it illuminationism with homework.

hindi: भ्रमवाद — अनुभूति-गुणों का आभास एक भ्रम है जो मस्तिष्क स्वयं रचता है, ऐसा मत
definition: the view that phenomenal consciousness, the apparent inner glow of experience, is a kind of illusion the brain creates about its own workings
example: Rubbing his stubbed toe, Siddharth conceded that illusionism might be true, but insisted the illusion was extremely painful.

hindi: कल्पना-प्रतिरोध — कथा में नैतिक रूप से विकृत बात को सच मान लेने में मन की अड़चन
definition: the puzzling reluctance readers feel to imagine certain things a story asks, especially that a plainly cruel action is morally right within the fiction
example: Kiran happily imagined dragons in the novel, but imaginative resistance kicked in when the story insisted stealing lunches was noble.

hindi: अनुकरण सिद्धांत — कला को प्रकृति और जीवन की सच्ची नकल मानने का मत
definition: the theory that paintings, stories and other artworks should faithfully copy nature and the way people really live
example: The director's devotion to imitation meant the actors ate real, cold parathas in every take of the breakfast scene.

hindi: अंतर्वर्ती — जो मन के भीतर ही घटे और बाहर असर न डाले
definition: describing a mental action that takes place wholly within the mind, such as thinking or wishing, without producing effects outside it; more broadly, present within something
example: Silently rehearsing a comeback on the bus is immanent; saying it aloud to the man hogging two seats is another matter entirely.

hindi: अंतर्निहित आलोचना — किसी विचार या समाज को उसके अपने ही मानकों पर परखना
definition: a method of criticism that judges a theory or society by its own stated standards and ideals, showing where it falls short of them
example: Neel's immanent critique of the company handbook simply quoted its promise of work-life balance next to his weekend emails.

hindi: अन्तर्निहित यथार्थवाद — सामान्यों को वास्तविक पर केवल वस्तुओं के भीतर मौजूद मानने का मत
definition: the view, associated with Aristotle, that universals are real but exist only within the particular things that have them, never separately from those things
example: Nandini defended immanent realism at the bakery: roundness was real, but only inside the actual laddoos on the counter.

hindi: अभौतिकवाद — भौतिक पदार्थ के स्वतंत्र अस्तित्व को नकारने वाला मत
definition: Berkeley's view denying that material substance exists, so physical objects are nothing more than collections of ideas perceived by minds
example: Arjun defended immaterialism at breakfast until his brother pointed out that the toast was burning whether anyone perceived it or not.

hindi: अमरत्व — मृत्यु से परे अनंत काल तक अस्तित्व बने रहना
definition: the condition of living forever and never dying, whether as an endless bodily life, a soul surviving death, or a continued existence in some other form
example: After three hours stuck in the bank queue, Arjun decided that immortality would mostly mean more time spent waiting in queues.

hindi: निष्पक्ष दर्शक — एडम स्मिथ का काल्पनिक तटस्थ निर्णायक जो हमारे आचरण को परखता है
definition: Adam Smith's imagined neutral observer whose judgement people consult when assessing their own conduct and feelings fairly
example: Before sending an angry email, Tushar consulted his impartial spectator, who strongly advised deleting the third paragraph.

hindi: अपूर्ण कर्तव्य — ऐसा कर्तव्य जिसे कब और कैसे निभाना है, इसमें छूट हो, जैसे परोपकार
definition: in Kantian ethics, a broad duty such as helping others or developing talents, where each person chooses when and how often to fulfil it
example: Helping strangers is an imperfect duty, Farhan argued, which is why he didn't have to fix every printer in the office.

hindi: निहितार्थ — जो कहा नहीं गया पर कथन से संकेतित या अभिप्रेत है
definition: what a speaker suggests or hints without literally saying it, which a listener works out from the words together with the setting of the conversation
example: When the landlord said the flat had "character", the implicature was that the taps leaked and the stairs creaked.

hindi: असंभवता — जो किसी भी स्थिति में सत्य न हो सके, उसका गुण
definition: the property of a statement or state of affairs that could never be true, holding in no possible world at all, such as a square circle
example: Anjali pointed out that a four-cornered triangle is a true impossibility, whereas her ten-minute commute on the Delhi ring road is merely wildly unlikely.

hindi: असंभव वस्तु — ऐसी वस्तु जिसके गुण परस्पर विरोधी हों
definition: an object with contradictory features, like a round square, which some theories still allow us to think about and describe
example: Their ideal flat, spacious, central and cheap, was an impossible object, the estate agent gently explained.

hindi: असंभव जगत — वे कल्पित स्थितियाँ जिनमें तर्क या गणित के नियम भी टूटते हैं
definition: imagined ways things could not possibly be, where even logical or mathematical truths fail, used to model contradictory beliefs and reasoning about impossibilities
example: Tara joked that her group project schedule belonged to one of the impossible worlds, since it had every member free at the same hour.

hindi: अविधेयता — किसी वस्तु को उसी समूह के सहारे परिभाषित करना जिसमें वह स्वयं शामिल हो
definition: the feature of a definition that specifies an object by referring to a whole collection to which that very object belongs, a circularity some mathematicians reject
example: Defining the tallest student as the tallest person in a class that included him, Rohit learned that impredicativity bothers nobody at basketball trials.

hindi: संवेदन और प्रत्यय — ह्यूम का प्रत्यक्ष अनुभव और उसकी धुँधली प्रतिलिपि का भेद
definition: Hume's distinction between impressions, the lively perceptions of sensation and feeling, and ideas, the fainter copies of them used in memory and thinking
example: Stuck in traffic, Meera compared the sharp smell of diesel with her faint memory of jasmine and explained impressions and ideas to her bored cousin.

hindi: अहस्तांतरणीय अधिकार — वे अधिकार जिन्हें न छीना जा सकता है, न स्वेच्छा से त्यागा जा सकता है
definition: rights so basic that they cannot be taken away by others or even willingly sold, surrendered or transferred by the person who holds them
example: Rohan claimed the window seat was among his inalienable rights, though he did trade it away for a chocolate bar within minutes.

hindi: अप्रामाणिकता — भीड़ और भूमिकाओं के सहारे अपनी स्वतंत्रता से बचकर जीना
definition: a manner of living that avoids your freedom by simply following the crowd, social roles and borrowed values instead of choosing and owning your life
example: Meera realised her whole weekend plan was inauthenticity: every activity had been chosen because the group chat liked it.

hindi: अक्षमीकरण — दंड द्वारा अपराधी की अपराध करने की क्षमता को ही रोक देना
definition: the purpose of punishment that protects society by physically preventing offenders from committing further crimes, for example through prison, rather than by changing their choices or motives
example: Confiscating her brother's phone was pure incapacitation, Ritu admitted, since it did nothing to cure his urge to send memes at midnight.

hindi: प्रवृत्ति — इच्छा, भावना या रुचि से उपजा झुकाव, जिसे कांट कर्तव्य से अलग मानते हैं
definition: in Kantian ethics, a desire, feeling or liking that pushes someone toward an action, contrasted with acting purely from duty
example: Pooja's inclination said stay under the blanket, but her promise to walk the neighbour's anxious beagle said otherwise.

hindi: समावेशी विधिक प्रत्यक्षवाद — नैतिक कसौटियाँ तभी मान्य जब समाज की मान्यता-नियम उन्हें शामिल करे
definition: the version of legal positivism, the view that validity rests on social facts, holding that moral tests can decide legal validity, but only when a society's accepted rules for recognising valid laws happen to include them
example: Because the constitution demands 'fair' treatment, Kabir said, inclusive legal positivism lets judges weigh fairness without admitting that morality always governs validity.

hindi: असंमेयता — प्रतिद्वंद्वी वैज्ञानिक सिद्धांतों के बीच किसी साझा मापदंड के अभाव का मत
definition: the claim that rival scientific theories share no common measure or neutral language, so their concepts and standards cannot be compared point by point
example: Arguing about pizza toppings, Arjun and Divya hit total incommensurability: she ranked by taste, he ranked by how many slices survived till midnight.

hindi: असंगतिवाद — स्वतंत्र इच्छा और नियतिवाद को परस्पर विरोधी मानने का मत
definition: the view that free will and determinism cannot both be true, so that if every event is fixed by earlier causes, nobody chooses freely
example: In the philosophy club, Tanvi defended incompatibilism by pointing out that a choice written in advance by physics looks suspiciously like a script.

hindi: अपूर्णता प्रमेय — गोडेल के वे प्रमेय जिनके अनुसार पर्याप्त समृद्ध संगत प्रणाली अपने सभी सत्य सिद्ध नहीं कर सकती
definition: Gödel's results showing that any consistent formal system, meaning a fixed collection of axioms and proof rules, strong enough for basic arithmetic contains true statements it cannot prove
example: When the school's thick rulebook still could not settle whether hoodies counted as uniform, Pooja blamed the incompleteness theorems.

hindi: असंशोधनीयता — किसी विश्वास का ऐसा होना कि उसमें भूल सुधारी ही न जा सके
definition: the property of a belief that cannot be corrected by anyone else, often claimed for reports about your own present feelings or sensations
example: Nobody could argue with Simran's headache; her report enjoyed full incorrigibility, much to the office manager's dismay.

hindi: अनुवाद की अनिश्चितता — क्वाइन का मत कि एक भाषा के कई समान रूप से सही अनुवाद संभव हैं
definition: Quine's thesis that a language can be translated in several incompatible ways that all match every possible piece of evidence, so there is never one uniquely correct translation
example: Three friends translated the same meme caption three different ways, and each claimed that indeterminacy of translation proved them right.

hindi: अनिश्चित स्थिति — उलझी, अस्पष्ट स्थिति जिससे अन्वेषण आरंभ होता है
definition: Dewey's term for a confused, unsettled situation in which the parts do not hang together, which triggers inquiry aimed at making the situation settled
example: Arriving at the station to find no trains and no announcements, Neel stood in a perfect indeterminate situation.

hindi: अनियतिवाद — कुछ घटनाओं को पूर्व कारणों से पूर्णतः निर्धारित न मानने का मत
definition: the view that some events, possibly including some human choices, are not completely fixed by earlier causes and natural laws
example: Watching the kettle boil at random-seeming moments, Leena joked that her kitchen was proof of indeterminism.

hindi: सांदर्भिक सूचक — मैं, यहाँ, अब जैसे शब्द जिनका निर्देश प्रसंग के साथ बदलता है
definition: a word such as 'I', 'here', 'now' or 'today' whose reference shifts with the context of speaking, depending on the speaker, place or time
example: The sticky note saying 'back in five minutes' was a useless indexical, since nobody knew when the five minutes had started.

hindi: सूचक वास्तविकता सिद्धांत — यह मत कि 'वास्तविक' शब्द 'यहाँ' की भाँति बोलने वाले के जगत को सूचित करता है
definition: David Lewis's view that the word 'actual' works like the word 'here', referring to whichever possible world the speaker happens to inhabit
example: Using the indexical theory of actuality, Varun argued that his counterpart's world felt equally actual to that counterpart, just as 'here' feels like here to anyone.

hindi: परोक्ष संप्रेषण — सीधे बताने की बजाय पाठक को स्वयं सत्य तक पहुँचाने की कीर्केगार्द की शैली
definition: Kierkegaard's method of writing under pseudonyms and irony so readers must reach their own conclusions rather than simply receiving answers
example: Leaving a recycling article on her brother's desk was Neha's indirect communication about the overflowing bin.

hindi: परोक्ष परिणामवाद — कर्मों को नियमों, उद्देश्यों या चरित्र के परिणामों के माध्यम से आँकने का मत
definition: any form of consequentialism that judges actions indirectly, by asking which rules, motives or character traits produce the best consequences, rather than judging each action by its own results
example: Ananya's indirect consequentialism told her to simply be an honest person at the office, instead of calculating the payoff of every small fib.

hindi: अप्रत्यक्ष वाक्-क्रिया — एक प्रकार के कथन के माध्यम से दूसरा कार्य करना
definition: an utterance that performs one action by means of another, such as making a request by asking a question, as in "is there any more coffee?"
example: "It's cold in here, isn't it?" was an indirect speech act, and everyone knew who should close the window.

hindi: अभिन्नों की अविभेद्यता — जो वस्तु एक ही है, उसके सारे गुण भी एक ही होंगे, यह सिद्धांत
definition: the principle that if something and something else are truly one and the same thing, they must share every property, so any difference in properties shows two distinct things
example: Priya used the indiscernibility of identicals in the group chat: the cake in the photo had frosting and the cake on the table did not, so somebody had swapped them.

hindi: अपरिहार्यता तर्क — विज्ञान के लिए अपरिहार्य होने के कारण गणितीय वस्तुओं को वास्तविक मानने का तर्क
definition: the argument that because our best scientific theories cannot work without mentioning numbers and functions, we should believe mathematical objects really exist
example: When her physics teacher said engineers could not build bridges without calculus, Priya muttered the indispensability argument and gave numbers grudging respect.

hindi: व्यक्तिवाद — व्यक्ति की स्वतंत्रता, आत्मनिर्भरता और हितों को प्राथमिकता देने वाला मत
definition: the outlook that gives the goals, freedom and independence of each individual person priority over those of the group or community
example: Kabir's individualism meant he ordered his own pizza while the entire team split one.

hindi: मतारोपण — बिना प्रश्न और प्रमाण के विश्वासों को मन में बैठाना
definition: teaching beliefs so that learners accept them without weighing evidence or reasons, and become unable to question or revise those beliefs later
example: When the coaching centre banned any question about its famous shortcut formula, Arjun began to suspect indoctrination rather than mathematics.

hindi: असंदिग्ध — जिस पर संदेह करना संभव ही न हो
definition: describing a belief that cannot be doubted by anyone who clearly understands it, often sought as a secure foundation for knowledge
example: The only indubitable fact at Monday's standup was that someone would forget to unmute.

hindi: आगमन — अनेक विशेष उदाहरणों से सामान्य निष्कर्ष की ओर जाने वाली तर्क-विधि
definition: reasoning that moves from particular observed cases to a general conclusion that is likely but never guaranteed, because future cases might differ
example: After the metro was late six Mondays running, Neha's induction told her to leave early next Monday, though the trains might finally surprise her.

hindi: आगमनात्मक सामान्यीकरण — किसी नमूने के गुण से पूरे समूह के गुण का अनुमान
definition: an inference from a feature observed in a sample of a group to the conclusion that the whole group probably shares that feature
example: Having tasted three mangoes from the crate, Sana made an inductive generalization that the entire crate was sweet and bought it.

hindi: आगमन-संशयवाद — अनुभव से निकाले गए सामान्य निष्कर्षों को अप्रमाणित मानने का मत
definition: the view that generalizing from observed cases to unobserved ones can never be rationally justified, however many cases support the generalization
example: Aarav's inductive skepticism lasted exactly until lunch, when he assumed the canteen samosas would still be edible.

hindi: आगमन-सांख्यिक प्रतिरूप — सांख्यिक नियमों से घटना को अति संभाव्य दिखाकर व्याख्या करने का मत
definition: Hempel's account of explanation in which general statistical laws make the event being explained highly probable, rather than logically certain
example: Via the inductive-statistical model, Sneha explained her cold: most people sharing a crowded office in flu season catch something.

hindi: अनिर्वचनीयता — अनुभव का शब्दों में बताया न जा सकना
definition: the quality of an experience, especially a mystical experience, that cannot be adequately described in words, even by the person having it
example: Trying to explain a concert to her parents, Isha gave up and blamed ineffability.

hindi: अभ्रांततावाद — ज्ञान के लिए भूल की किसी भी संभावना को बहिष्कृत मानने का मत
definition: the view that knowledge requires justification so strong that it rules out any possibility of being mistaken
example: Mohit's infallibilism meant he never claimed to know his train would arrive, only that it probably would.

hindi: अनुमान करना — प्रमाण या तर्क के आधार पर निष्कर्ष निकालना
definition: to draw a conclusion from evidence or from statements already accepted, by reasoning rather than being told directly
example: From the empty biscuit tin and the crumbs on his shirt, Mum could infer exactly who had been up at midnight.

hindi: अनुमान-भूमिका अर्थविज्ञान — यह मत कि शब्द का अर्थ उससे जुड़े अनुमानों से तय होता है
definition: the view that the meaning of a word or sentence is fixed by the inferences it licenses, meaning which conclusions follow from it and which premises lead to it
example: Under inferential role semantics, 'we should talk' means Vivek should immediately infer that trouble is coming.

hindi: अनवस्था दोष — जहाँ हर व्याख्या या कारण के लिए एक और व्याख्या चाहिए और यह शृंखला कभी समाप्त नहीं होती
definition: a series in which each step depends on a further step of the same kind, so the chain of reasons or causes never reaches a final stopping point
example: Asking who approves the manager's approval, who approves that, and so on, the new intern uncovered an infinite regress in the expense system.

hindi: अनंततावाद — औचित्य को कारणों की अनंत शृंखला पर टिका मानने का मत
definition: the view that a belief is justified by an endless chain of supporting reasons, each backed by another reason, with no final stopping point
example: After the fifth 'but why?' from his nephew, Sameer decided the child was a natural champion of infinitism.

hindi: सूचना-नीतिशास्त्र — सूचना के निर्माण, संग्रह, प्रसार और गोपनीयता से जुड़े नैतिक प्रश्नों का अध्ययन
definition: the branch of ethics studying moral questions about creating, collecting, sharing and protecting information, including privacy, surveillance and misinformation
example: Before forwarding the viral rumour to the family group, Tanvi paused for a quick lesson in information ethics.

hindi: सूचित सहमति — पूरी जानकारी पाकर स्वेच्छा से दी गई चिकित्सकीय अनुमति
definition: the principle that a patient must freely agree to a treatment or study only after being clearly told its purpose, risks, benefits and alternatives
example: Before the dentist touched the drill, Aarav demanded full informed consent, including a written account of exactly how loud it would be.

hindi: सूचना-मंडल — सूचना, साधनों और उनसे जुड़े प्राणियों का समूचा परिवेश
definition: Luciano Floridi's name for the whole environment of information, including data, devices, networks and the people and programs interacting within them, both online and offline
example: The office printer jammed and the shared drive crashed at once, and Ravi declared that the entire infosphere had turned against him.

hindi: समवेत होना — गुण का किसी वस्तु में टिके रहने या उसी में रहने का संबंध
definition: the relation by which a quality exists in a substance and depends upon it, the manner in which colour inheres in a wall rather than floating free
example: Scraping paint off the balcony railing, Nisha decided that inherence was overrated, because the rust clearly inhered far more stubbornly than the paint.

hindi: आरंभिक नामकरण — वह मूल क्षण जब किसी वस्तु को पहली बार नाम दिया जाता है
definition: in the causal theory of reference, the original occasion on which an object first receives its name, starting the chain of communication that later speakers depend upon
example: The initial baptism of the office plant as 'Gerald' happened during a boring meeting, and now the whole building uses the name.

hindi: जन्मजात प्रत्यय — वे विचार या ज्ञान जो मन में जन्म से ही उपस्थित माने जाते हैं
definition: concepts or pieces of knowledge held to be present in the mind from birth, rather than learned later through experience
example: Watching the baby frown at broccoli, Anil wondered whether a dislike of vegetables counted among the innate ideas.

hindi: सहजज्ञानवाद — यह मत कि मन कुछ ज्ञान या प्रत्यय जन्म से लेकर आता है
definition: the view that the mind is born already holding certain ideas or knowledge, which experience merely awakens rather than creates
example: Her innatism slipped out when Sana claimed every toddler is born knowing exactly where the biscuits are hidden.

hindi: अन्वेषण — संदेहपूर्ण स्थिति को सुलझाकर स्थिर विश्वास तक पहुँचने की प्रक्रिया
definition: in pragmatist philosophy, the active process of settling doubt, in which a confused or unsettled situation is turned, through testing and reasoning, into a settled belief
example: The team's inquiry into the broken office printer began with doubt, moved through three theories, and ended with the settled belief that someone had jammed a sticky note inside.

hindi: निर्देश की दुर्ज्ञेयता — यह मत कि शब्द किस वस्तु को इंगित करता है, यह प्रमाण से तय नहीं होता
definition: Quine's thesis that all possible evidence about a speaker's behaviour cannot settle exactly which objects that speaker's words refer to
example: Whether Aditi's 'nice' referred to the food or the host remained a case of inscrutability of reference all evening.

hindi: अघुलनीय कथन — मध्यकालीन तर्कशास्त्र में स्वयं को झूठा बताने वाले वाक्यों का नाम
definition: the medieval name for liar-style sentences whose truth could not be settled, which logicians of that period studied closely in writing and debate
example: Looking at the office rule 'ignore all rules on this board', Meera said the notice belonged among the insolubilia.

hindi: दृष्टान्तीकरण — किसी वस्तु द्वारा किसी सामान्य गुण को धारण करने का संबंध
definition: the relation between a particular thing and a universal quality or kind it has, as when a scarlet apple instantiates redness
example: The new intern, eager and confused, was described by his team as a flawless instantiation of the universal first-week energy.

hindi: संस्थागत कला-सिद्धांत — कलाजगत की मान्यता से किसी वस्तु के कलाकृति बनने का मत
definition: the view that something counts as an artwork because people within the artworld, such as galleries, curators and critics, confer that status on it
example: When the gallery hung a mop bucket on the wall, Sameer muttered that the institutional theory of art had officially reached his cleaning cupboard.

hindi: साधनात्मक अभिसरण — भिन्न लक्ष्यों वाले बुद्धिमान तंत्रों के भी संसाधन, सुरक्षा जैसे समान उप-लक्ष्य अपनाने का मत
definition: the thesis that intelligent agents with very different final goals would still pursue similar intermediate goals, such as gathering resources and avoiding being shut down
example: Instrumental convergence explained, Tara said, why both her study group and her cat always wanted more snacks and fewer interruptions.

hindi: साधनपरक तर्क — केवल लक्ष्य प्राप्ति के कुशल साधन खोजने वाला, लक्ष्यों पर प्रश्न न उठाने वाला तर्क
definition: reasoning concerned only with finding the most efficient means to a given goal, without asking whether the goal itself is worthwhile, a central target of critical theory
example: The meeting optimized the report's font, margins and delivery time with pure instrumental reason, and nobody asked whether anyone would read it.

hindi: साधनवाद — विचारों और सिद्धांतों को कार्य के साधन मानने का मत
definition: the view that ideas and theories are tools for guiding action and predicting results, judged by how well they work rather than whether they are literally true
example: Priya's instrumentalism about maps is total: she doesn't care whether the app is accurate, only whether it gets her to the metro on time.

hindi: समेकित सूचना सिद्धांत — चेतना किसी तंत्र में सूचना के एकीकृत होने की मात्रा से मापी जाती है, ऐसा सिद्धांत
definition: the theory that consciousness corresponds to how much information a system integrates as a unified whole, which can in principle be measured as a number
example: After reading about integrated information theory, Gauri wondered aloud whether her overloaded group chat was secretly more conscious than her cousin.

hindi: सत्यनिष्ठा आपत्ति — यह आपत्ति कि परिणामवाद व्यक्ति को अपने गहरे मूल्यों और प्रतिबद्धताओं से अलग कर देता है
definition: Bernard Williams's objection that consequentialism alienates people from their deepest commitments, treating their personal values as just one input into a total calculation
example: Asked to write ads for a cigarette brand because someone worse would otherwise do it, Nikhil raised the integrity objection and politely refused.

hindi: बौद्धिक अहंकार — अपने ज्ञान और तर्क को बढ़ा-चढ़ाकर आँकने का दोष
definition: the intellectual vice of overrating your own knowledge and reasoning, dismissing others' views and refusing to consider that you might be mistaken
example: His intellectual arrogance peaked when he corrected the pharmacist about a medicine he had first heard of that morning.

hindi: बौद्धिक साहस — विरोध के बावजूद सच्चे विचार रखने और परखने का गुण
definition: the intellectual virtue of voicing, defending or examining ideas despite the risk of embarrassment, disapproval or social cost
example: It took intellectual courage for the junior analyst to tell the whole boardroom that the quarterly forecast rested on a spreadsheet error.

hindi: बौद्धिक ईमानदारी — प्रमाण के प्रति सच्चा रहने और अपनी गलती मानने का गुण
definition: the intellectual virtue of following evidence where it leads, admitting mistakes and not misrepresenting arguments, even when doing so is inconvenient
example: Intellectual honesty made Leela admit, mid-argument, that her own link actually supported her brother's side.

hindi: बौद्धिक विनम्रता — अपनी बौद्धिक सीमाओं को पहचानने और मानने का गुण
definition: the intellectual virtue of noticing and owning the limits of your own knowledge, abilities and beliefs, without either hiding them or exaggerating them
example: Her intellectual humility showed when the chemistry student said, in front of the whole classroom, that she had no idea and would look it up.

hindi: बौद्धिक साक्षात्कार — बुद्धि द्वारा किसी सत्य या वस्तु का सीधा, बिना अनुमान का ज्ञान
definition: a direct grasp of truths or objects by the intellect itself, without reasoning step by step and without relying on the senses
example: Nikhil claimed intellectual intuition told him the meeting was pointless, though the agenda probably helped.

hindi: बौद्धिक दृढ़ता — कठिनाइयों के बावजूद सत्य की खोज में लगे रहने का गुण
definition: the intellectual virtue of continuing to pursue understanding despite difficulty, frustration or setbacks, rather than abandoning inquiry when it gets hard
example: After the tenth failed attempt at the crossword clue, Vikram's intellectual perseverance finally beat the puzzle on the evening train.

hindi: बौद्धिक दासता — अपनी समझ छोड़कर दूसरों के मत के आगे झुक जाने का दोष
definition: the intellectual vice of deferring to others' opinions excessively, abandoning your own well-grounded judgement from timidity or a wish to please
example: Agreeing with every idea the boss floated, even the contradictory ones, Sameer's intellectual servility made the brainstorm pointless.

hindi: बौद्धिक सद्गुण — सत्य तक पहुँचने में सहायक चिंतन का गुण
definition: a trait of mind, such as open-mindedness, patience or careful attention, that helps a person reach truth and avoid error
example: Reading the full article before posting an angry reply showed a rare intellectual virtue in the family group chat.

hindi: बोध-प्रतिरूप — मन में बनी वह प्रतिमा जिसके द्वारा वस्तु का सामान्य ज्ञान होता है
definition: the mental likeness, in scholastic theory of knowledge, through which the mind grasps what a thing is after drawing it out of sensory images
example: Recognising a mango in the dark by smell alone, Neel credited his intelligible species of mango with years of rigorous training.

hindi: अंतर्वस्तु — किसी पद का वह अर्थ-भाग जो बताता है कि वह किन वस्तुओं पर लागू होगा
definition: the meaning or defining content of a term, often treated as the rule that fixes which things the term applies to in every possible situation, as opposed to the things themselves
example: The intension of 'snack' in Riya's flat was hotly disputed once someone claimed that cold pizza counts as breakfast.

hindi: गुणार्थक — शब्द के अर्थ को उसके लक्षणों से जोड़ने वाला
definition: relating to the qualities a word implies, the features something must have to deserve that word, rather than the actual things it names
example: An intensional definition of 'sandwich' lists what makes one, while pointing at the lunch counter merely shows you some.

hindi: साभिप्राय क्रिया — किसी उद्देश्य या इरादे से सोच-समझकर की गई क्रिया
definition: an action done on purpose, guided by the person's intention and aimed at some goal, rather than an accident or reflex
example: Deleting the spam folder was an intentional action, but deleting the boss's email alongside it was, Shreya insisted, not.

hindi: आशय-दोष — रचनाकार के आशय को ही कृति के अर्थ या मूल्य की कसौटी मानने की भूल
definition: the supposed mistake of judging the meaning or value of a poem or artwork by what its maker intended, rather than by what the work itself shows
example: When Kunal said the song meant heartbreak because the singer tweeted so, his English teacher warned him about the intentional fallacy.

hindi: आशयगत अस्तित्व — विचार के विषय का केवल मन में उपस्थित रहना, चाहे वह जगत में हो या न हो
definition: Brentano's phrase for the special manner in which the object of a thought exists within the thinking itself, which is why people can think about unicorns that nowhere exist
example: Explaining intentional inexistence, the teacher said a student's promised homework could be vividly present in his thoughts while existing nowhere in his backpack.

hindi: साभिप्राय विषय — वह वस्तु जिसकी ओर कोई विचार या अनुभव उन्मुख है
definition: whatever a thought, feeling or perception is directed toward or about, considered exactly as consciousness presents it, whether or not that thing actually exists
example: Ishaan's dread before the exam had a perfectly clear intentional object, even though the surprise quiz never actually happened.

hindi: आशयगत दृष्टि — किसी तंत्र के व्यवहार को विश्वास और इच्छा मानकर समझाने की रणनीति
definition: Daniel Dennett's strategy of predicting a system's behaviour by treating it as a rational agent with beliefs and desires, whether it is a person, a chess program or a thermostat
example: Taking the intentional stance toward the office thermostat, Farah announced that it clearly wanted everyone in sweaters by noon.

hindi: आशयवाद — कृति का सही अर्थ रचनाकार के आशय से तय होने का मत
definition: the view that the correct meaning of a poem, novel or artwork is fixed, wholly or partly, by what its maker actually intended it to mean
example: Settling the group chat debate with intentionalism, Aman simply messaged the director of the short film and asked what the ending meant.

hindi: विषयोन्मुखता — मानसिक अवस्थाओं का किसी वस्तु या स्थिति के बारे में होना
definition: the property of mental states, such as beliefs, desires and perceptions, of being about, directed at or representing something beyond themselves
example: Aditi pointed out the intentionality of her brother's longing: it was entirely about the last slice of pizza, which was already in her hand.

hindi: अन्योन्यक्रियावाद — मन और शरीर एक-दूसरे पर कारणात्मक प्रभाव डालते हैं, ऐसा द्वैतवादी मत
definition: the dualist view that a non-physical mind and a physical body causally influence each other, so a decision can move a limb and a stubbed toe can cause pain
example: Watching his worry make his stomach churn before the exam, Aditya decided interactionism felt more convincing than any textbook diagram.

hindi: अंतर्सत्ता — सभी वस्तुओं के परस्पर जुड़े होने का विचार
definition: a modern Buddhist term for the idea that nothing exists separately, since every thing depends on and contains countless other things and conditions
example: Holding up a sheet of paper, the teacher asked the class to find the cloud, the rain and the tree inside it, a lesson in interbeing.

hindi: परस्पर-विनिमेय — अर्थ या सत्य बदले बिना एक-दूसरे की जगह रखे जा सकने वाले
definition: in logic, able to swap places without changing whether a statement is true, as with two names for the same thing
example: In the quiz, 'Mumbai' and 'Bombay' were interchangeable, so Neha scored the point either way.

hindi: हित सिद्धांत — अधिकार का उद्देश्य व्यक्ति के महत्त्वपूर्ण हितों की रक्षा है
definition: the theory that rights exist to protect a person's important interests, so even infants and others unable to make choices can hold them
example: Defending interest theory, Kavya argued that the baby had a right to the quietest room even though she could not ask for it.

hindi: अंतर-पीढ़ी न्याय — वर्तमान और भावी पीढ़ियों के बीच न्यायपूर्ण दायित्व
definition: the question of what fairness requires between people alive today and future generations still unborn, such as duties about public debt, resources and climate
example: Leaving the fridge empty for the next shift, Varun joked that the office had never heard of intergenerational justice.

hindi: आंतरिक यथार्थवाद — सत्य को किसी वैचारिक ढाँचे के भीतर समझने का पटनम का मत
definition: Putnam's view that questions about what exists and what is true make sense only within some conceptual scheme, a particular framework for sorting the world, never from a viewpoint outside every framework
example: Counting the objects on her desk, Lata saw internal realism at work: three pens, or one pen set, depending on how you sort.

hindi: आंतरिकतावाद — औचित्य के आधार को व्यक्ति की अपनी चेतना के भीतर मानने का मत
definition: the view that whatever justifies a belief must be something inside the believer's mind, available to them through careful reflection
example: Defending internalism in class, Neha argued that if you cannot point to your reasons, your homework answer is just a guess.

hindi: कारण-आंतरिकतावाद — कर्म के कारण को व्यक्ति की अपनी इच्छाओं से जुड़ा मानने का मत
definition: the view that a person has a reason for action only when it connects to some desire or motivation they already have or could reach through sound reasoning
example: Under internalism about reasons, Vikram argued, a man who hates music has no reason at all to attend the office choir.

hindi: अंतरराष्ट्रीयतावाद — राष्ट्रों के आपसी सहयोग को सर्वोपरि मानने का मत
definition: the view that nations should work together closely, because their shared interests matter more than their differences
example: The hostel kitchen, with Korean noodles beside Punjabi pickle, ran on a cheerful internationalism nobody had voted for.

hindi: आह्वान — विचारधारा द्वारा व्यक्ति को एक निश्चित पहचान में 'पुकार' कर ढाल देना
definition: Althusser's term for the process by which ideology hails or calls people into particular identities, so that they recognize themselves as the subjects it describes
example: When the advert said smart professionals like you, Karan felt the interpellation and reached for his wallet.

hindi: अंतर्वैयक्तिक तुलना — अलग-अलग लोगों के सुख या कल्याण को एक पैमाने पर तौलने की समस्या
definition: the problem of measuring different people's happiness or wellbeing on one shared scale, which utilitarians need in order to combine and compare them
example: Whether Riya's delight at the window seat outweighed Dev's sulk required an interpersonal comparison nobody in the car could settle.

hindi: व्याख्यावाद — विश्वास रखने को सफल व्याख्या का विषय मानने का मत
definition: the view that having beliefs and desires is a matter of being usefully interpretable as having them, so that mental states are fixed by the best available interpretation of behaviour
example: Arun's interpretivism went too far when he claimed the cat believed in breakfast because that interpretation predicted the yowling at six every morning.

hindi: प्रतिच्छेदिता — जाति, लिंग, वर्ग आदि पहचानों के आपस में गुँथकर उत्पीड़न रचने का विचार
definition: the idea that race, gender, class and other social identities overlap, so that oppression and privilege combine in ways no single category explains
example: Priya explained intersectionality to her study group: a policy helping 'women' and 'minorities' separately can still miss women from minority communities entirely.

hindi: अंतर्व्यक्तिनिष्ठता — अनेक चेतन व्यक्तियों के बीच साझा अनुभव और अर्थ
definition: the shared realm of experience and meaning between several conscious persons, through which each person recognises others as fellow subjects and builds a common world
example: The office's unspoken rule about the last slice of cake was pure intersubjectivity: nobody wrote it down, yet everyone obeyed it.

hindi: अंतर्पाठीयता — हर पाठ का अन्य पाठों से बुना होना
definition: the idea, developed by Kristeva, that every text gains meaning through its references, echoes and borrowings from other texts rather than standing alone
example: The meme only made sense through intertextuality: you needed two films, one advertisement and last week's office email.

hindi: हस्तक्षेपवाद — कारण को वह मानना जिसमें हस्तक्षेप करने से कार्य भी बदल जाए
definition: the view, developed by James Woodward, that one variable causes another when an idealised intervention changing only the first would also change the second
example: Pooja's interventionism about the flickering lamp was simple: change only the bulb, and see whether the flickering changes.

hindi: आंतरिक औचित्य — किसी अभिगृहीत को उसकी अवधारणा में ही निहित होने के कारण स्वीकारना
definition: support for accepting a mathematical axiom because it seems to follow directly from the very concept being described, such as what being a collection means
example: In the debate club, Leela argued for her axiom by intrinsic justification, saying anyone who understood what a group was would already agree.

hindi: आन्तरिक गुण — वह गुण जो वस्तु में अपने आप में है, दूसरों से संबंध पर निर्भर नहीं
definition: a property a thing has purely in itself, independent of anything else around it, such as its mass or shape rather than its distance from others
example: Laila reminded her brother that height was an intrinsic property, so standing next to shorter cousins in the family photo did not actually count.

hindi: प्रवेश सिद्धांत — वस्तु से आने वाले प्रकाश या रूप के आँखों में प्रवेश से देखने का मत
definition: the theory of vision holding that sight works by light, images or forms travelling from objects and entering the eyes, rather than rays leaving the eyes
example: Blinking at her bright phone screen at midnight, Aditi felt that intromission was winning rather aggressively.

hindi: अंतःप्रज्ञावाद — ज्ञान, विशेषकर नैतिक ज्ञान, को सीधी अंतर्दृष्टि से प्राप्त मानने का मत
definition: the view that some basic truths, especially moral ones, are grasped directly by intuition, a kind of immediate insight, rather than proved
example: Asked why cheating was wrong, Mira fell back on intuitionism: she just saw it, the way you see that two plus two makes four.

hindi: अंतःप्रज्ञावादी तर्कशास्त्र — जिसमें सत्य का अर्थ प्रमाण निर्मित कर पाना है
definition: a logic in which a statement counts as true only when a proof of it can actually be constructed, so the principle that every statement is either true or false is not assumed
example: Under intuitionistic logic, Asha refused to accept that her keys were somewhere in the house until someone actually produced them.

hindi: प्रत्यक्ष बोध — किसी मौजूद वस्तु का सीधा ज्ञान, जिससे पता चले कि वह है या नहीं
definition: Scotus's and Ockham's term for directly knowing a present thing in a manner that tells the knower whether it actually exists here and at this moment
example: Hearing footsteps outside, Meera wanted intuitive cognition of the delivery driver, not another app notification promising one.

hindi: अपर्याप्त-अनिवार्य अंश शर्त — मैकी के अनुसार कारण वह अंश है जो कार्य के लिए पर्याप्त शर्तों के एक समूह में आवश्यक हो
definition: Mackie's analysis of a cause as one needed part of a larger package of conditions that together would be enough for the effect, though other packages could also produce it
example: The fire inspector told the office that the frayed kettle cable was an INUS condition: guilty only alongside the paper stacks and the dry air.

hindi: अवैधता — तर्क का वह दोष जिसमें आधार सत्य होते हुए भी निष्कर्ष असत्य हो सकता है
definition: the property of an argument whose premises could all be true while its conclusion is still false, because the conclusion does not follow from them
example: Tanya exposed the invalidity of 'rich people drive cars, I drive a car, so I am rich' by pointing at her scooter loan.

hindi: उलटा वर्णक्रम — दो व्यक्तियों के रंग-अनुभव परस्पर उलटे होने की परिकल्पना
definition: the thought experiment that someone might experience colours swapped, seeing the colour of grass where you see the colour of tomatoes, while naming and sorting everything exactly as you do
example: Arguing about whether the dress was blue or gold, the cousins agreed only that one of them must have an inverted spectrum.

hindi: वस्तु-अन्वेषण — वस्तुओं के मूल सिद्धांत को जानने की साधना
definition: the Neo-Confucian practice of carefully studying things and events to grasp the principle behind them, as a path to moral self-cultivation
example: Taking apart the broken toaster to understand it, Nikhil claimed he was pursuing the investigation of things.

hindi: अदृश्य हाथ व्याख्या — किसी व्यवस्था को बिना योजना के व्यक्तिगत कर्मों का परिणाम बताना
definition: an explanation showing how an orderly social pattern, such as a market price or footpath, arises from many individual choices without anyone planning it
example: The worn shortcut across the campus lawn needed an invisible hand explanation: nobody designed it, yet everyone used it.

hindi: अनैच्छिक इच्छामृत्यु — सक्षम व्यक्ति की इच्छा के विरुद्ध दी गई मृत्यु
definition: the ending of a competent person's life against their expressed wishes or without asking them, which nearly all ethical theories condemn as killing
example: Riya's history essay argued that involuntary euthanasia is less a medical choice than a crime wearing a white coat.

hindi: इरेनियस का ईश्वर-न्याय — दुःख को आत्मिक विकास का साधन मानने वाला समाधान
definition: a theodicy, often called soul-making, claiming that a deity permits suffering because struggling through hardship helps people grow into morally mature persons
example: The coach's Irenaean theodicy for the brutal training camp was that nobody becomes a champion without some character-building misery.

hindi: विडंबनावादी — अपनी ही अंतिम शब्दावली पर सदा संदेह रखने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: Rorty's term for someone who keeps doubting their own final vocabulary, aware that other vocabularies exist and that none can be proven the uniquely correct one
example: A true ironist, Mehak kept rewriting her personal mission statement, suspecting every version was just one description among many.

hindi: संदेह की बेचैनी — वह असुविधा जो मन को विश्वास की ओर धकेलती है
definition: Peirce's description of genuine doubt as an uneasy, unsettled mental state that pushes us to inquire until we reach a stable belief
example: The irritation of doubt about whether she had locked the door kept Sana texting her roommate until someone confirmed it.

hindi: है-चाहिए समस्या — केवल तथ्यात्मक कथनों से कर्तव्य संबंधी निष्कर्ष निकालने की कठिनाई
definition: the puzzle, raised by Hume, of how any conclusion about what ought to happen could follow from premises describing only what is the case
example: Maya pointed out the is-ought problem when her brother argued that since everyone skips the gym in winter, everyone should.

hindi: ईश्वर — सगुण ब्रह्म, जगत का स्वामी और रचयिता
definition: in Vedanta, Brahman viewed as the personal Lord who creates, sustains and governs the world, the supreme deity approached through worship
example: Ananya argued that the building manager behaved like Ishvara, creating, sustaining and occasionally dissolving the parking rules.

hindi: वाद — कोई भी विशिष्ट सिद्धांत या विचारधारा
definition: an informal word for any distinctive doctrine, theory or belief system, borrowed from the ending of names like realism, stoicism and socialism
example: Priya's uncle has an ism for everything, and by dessert he had blamed the traffic on three of them.

hindi: पुनरावर्तनीयता — चिह्न का नए संदर्भों में दोहराए जा सकने का गुण
definition: Derrida's term for the capacity of any sign to be repeated and quoted in fresh contexts, which means its meaning can never be fully controlled
example: Iterability struck when Dev's sarcastic 'love this plan' was screenshotted and quoted in the next meeting as sincere support.

hindi: समुच्चय की पुनरावृत्त अवधारणा — समुच्चयों को चरणबद्ध ढंग से, पहले बने समुच्चयों से निर्मित मानने की धारणा
definition: the picture of sets as formed in stages, where each stage collects only sets already built at earlier stages, which blocks paradoxical sets containing themselves
example: Stacking lunchboxes inside bigger lunchboxes, Aarav explained the iterative conception of set: nothing can hold a container that has not been made yet.

hindi: जबरिया — मनुष्य के कर्मों को पूर्णतः ईश्वरीय विवशता मानने वाला इस्लामी मत
definition: an early Islamic school holding that humans have no real choice, because every action is compelled directly by the divine will
example: Studying Islamic theology, Samir compared jabriyya to a puppet show in which the strings belong entirely to heaven.

hindi: जैन धर्म — अहिंसा, अपरिग्रह और आत्म-संयम पर आधारित भारतीय दर्शन-परंपरा
definition: the ancient Indian religion and philosophy teaching that every living soul can reach liberation through nonviolence, self-discipline and freedom from karmic matter
example: Checking the ingredients on every snack packet, Ritika explained that her diet followed Jainism, so even onions were off the table.

hindi: जल्प — जीतने के लिए छल-युक्त तर्कों वाली बहस
definition: in Nyaya philosophy, wrangling debate, a discussion in which each side aims at victory and will employ tricks and quibbles to triumph
example: By the third meeting on the logo colour, the design review had sunk from honest debate into pure jalpa.

hindi: जेम्स-लैंग सिद्धांत — पहले शारीरिक परिवर्तन, फिर उसका बोध ही भाव है
definition: the view that an emotion is the felt awareness of bodily changes, so that people feel afraid because they tremble rather than trembling because they feel afraid
example: Following the James-Lange theory, Nisha forced a wide smile during her commute and claimed it almost made the delayed train bearable.

hindi: सर्वप्रेम — सभी के प्रति बिना भेदभाव समान स्नेह
definition: the Mohist ideal of impartial caring: concern for everyone equally, treating other families and states with the same care as your own
example: Splitting the pizza evenly between his friends and total strangers, Jai proudly called it jian ai with extra cheese.

hindi: स्वशक्ति — अपने प्रयास और साधना से मुक्ति पाने का मार्ग
definition: self-power, the approach in Japanese Buddhism that seeks liberation through personal effort, discipline and meditation rather than reliance on outside grace
example: Pooja took the jiriki route to learning guitar, practising alone every night instead of waiting for a teacher to save her.

hindi: जीव — शरीर और मन से बँधा हुआ व्यक्तिगत आत्मा
definition: the individual living self, the atman experienced as bound to a particular body and mind and caught in the cycle of birth and death
example: Stuck in traffic on the flyover, Sneha felt like a very tired jiva trapped in a very small car.

hindi: जीवन्मुक्ति — शरीर रहते हुए ही प्राप्त मुक्ति
definition: liberation from the cycle of rebirth attained while still living in the body, so that the freed person continues acting without attachment
example: Her yoga teacher seemed so unbothered by the delayed train that the commuters half suspected jivanmukti.

hindi: उन्मत्त आनंद — सुख की सीमा लाँघता तीव्र आनंद
definition: a French term used by Lacan and Barthes for an intense enjoyment that goes beyond ordinary pleasure, often mixed with excess, loss of control or pain
example: Finishing the spiciest pani puri on the street, Sameer wept with a jouissance only his stomach later regretted.

hindi: रुचि-निर्णय — किसी वस्तु को सुंदर कहने वाला निर्णय जो निजी होकर भी सबकी सहमति चाहता है
definition: Kant's term for a judgment that something is beautiful, which rests on personal feeling rather than concepts yet still claims everyone ought to agree
example: When Maya called the sunset beautiful in the group chat, her judgment of taste clearly expected every member to reply with a heart.

hindi: जूलियस सीज़र समस्या — यह प्रश्न कि संख्या की परिभाषा कैसे तय करे कि सीज़र कोई संख्या नहीं है
definition: Frege's worry that defining numbers through matching principles fails to settle whether an unrelated object, such as Julius Caesar, might itself be a number
example: When the HR policy defined a team member without ruling out the office plant, Naina raised the Julius Caesar problem at the meeting.

hindi: सज्जन — कन्फ़्यूशियस परम्परा में सद्गुणों से परिपूर्ण आदर्श व्यक्ति
definition: the Confucian ideal of the exemplary person, someone who has cultivated humaneness, propriety and wisdom until good conduct flows naturally from character
example: Letting the elderly passenger take his metro seat without making a show of it, Hao behaved like a quiet junzi.

hindi: विधिशास्त्र — कानून के स्वरूप और न्यायिक निर्णयों के आधारों का दर्शन
definition: the philosophy of legal systems, asking what laws are, what gives them authority and what principles guide judges in deciding cases
example: A classroom argument over whether an unfair school rule still counts as a rule turned into a crash course in jurisprudence.

hindi: निष्पक्षता के रूप में न्याय — रॉल्स का मत कि न्यायपूर्ण नियम वही हैं जिन्हें निष्पक्ष स्थिति में सब स्वीकार करें
definition: Rawls's theory that fair principles of justice are those free, equal people would choose together from a neutral starting point where nobody could slant the rules in their favour
example: Anika invoked justice as fairness when she insisted the chore chart be drafted before anyone knew who would move into the room with the balcony.

hindi: सप्रमाण सत्य विश्वास — ज्ञान को उचित आधार वाला सच्चा विश्वास मानने की पारंपरिक परिभाषा
definition: the classic analysis of knowledge, holding that you know something when you believe it, the belief is true, and you have good reasons supporting it
example: Priya had a justified true belief that the office fridge held her lunch, right up until the intern labelled it his.

hindi: यॉर्गेनसेन द्विविधा — आदेश सत्य-असत्य न होने पर उनमें तर्क कैसे हो, यह प्रश्न
definition: the puzzle that commands and norms seem neither true nor false, yet people clearly reason with them, so it is unclear how logic can apply to them at all
example: When his mother said 'eat your vegetables, therefore eat the carrots', Tanay raised Jørgensen's dilemma, since neither order was actually true or false.

hindi: कब्बाला — ईश्वर और सृष्टि के गूढ़ स्वरूप पर यहूदी रहस्यवादी दर्शन
definition: the Jewish mystical tradition that explores the hidden nature of the divine, how creation flows from it, and the spiritual meaning behind scripture
example: Reading hidden patterns into the office seating chart, Noah was told to leave Kabbalah out of facilities planning.

hindi: कैवल्य — पुरुष का प्रकृति से पूर्ण अलगाव, मुक्ति की अवस्था
definition: in Samkhya and Yoga, liberation understood as complete isolation of pure consciousness from nature, when spirit no longer mistakes itself for body or mind
example: Switching off every notification for the weekend, Neha announced she was seeking digital kaivalya.

hindi: कल वा-होमेर — लघु से गुरु की ओर अनुमान का तलमूदी नियम
definition: a rule of reasoning used in the Talmud, the vast collection of rabbinic legal debate, arguing from a lesser case to a greater one, so that a rule holding in the weaker case must hold in the stronger
example: Using kal va-chomer, Mira argued that if her brother could borrow the bicycle, she could certainly borrow the scooter.

hindi: काल — भारतीय दर्शन में समय, जिसे वैशेषिक और जैन मत एक स्वतंत्र द्रव्य मानते हैं
definition: in Indian philosophy, time understood as a real substance; Vaisheshika and Jain thinkers count it among the basic kinds of existing things
example: Late for the exam again, Harsh told his grandmother that kala was a substance, and hers was clearly flowing faster than his.

hindi: कलाम — तर्क के सहारे इस्लामी आस्था की व्याख्या और रक्षा करने वाला धर्म-दर्शन
definition: Islamic rational theology, the discipline that uses argument and debate to explain and defend religious belief about the deity, creation and human freedom
example: In the canteen, Faraz defended his faith with syllogisms instead of slogans, and his friend teased that he had been secretly studying kalam.

hindi: कलाम सृष्टिमूलक युक्ति — आरंभ वाले जगत के कारण के रूप में ईश्वर का तर्क
definition: a version of the cosmological argument, developed by medieval Islamic thinkers, claiming that whatever begins to exist has a cause, the universe began to exist, so the universe has a cause
example: Tanvi used the kalam cosmological argument on her flatmate: the mess began to exist on Tuesday, so something, or someone, caused it.

hindi: आदर्श नगर — प्लेटो का पूर्णतः न्यायपूर्ण, दार्शनिकों द्वारा शासित राज्य
definition: Plato's name for the beautiful, perfectly just city described in the Republic, ruled by philosophers and organised into classes
example: The housing society's new rulebook read like a draft constitution for kallipolis, complete with a committee of wise guardians.

hindi: उदात्त — वह सुंदर और श्रेष्ठ, जिसके लिए सद्गुणी व्यक्ति कर्म करता है
definition: the Greek word for the noble, fine or beautiful, which Aristotle said is the goal a virtuous person aims at when choosing good actions
example: Giving up her window seat to the nervous first-time flyer was, for Nandini, simply the kalon thing to do.

hindi: काम — सुख, प्रेम और इंद्रिय-आनंद का जीवन-लक्ष्य
definition: in Hindu thought, the human goal of pleasure, love and sensory enjoyment, considered healthy when pursued within the bounds of dharma
example: Defending his third mango of the afternoon, Vikram insisted that kama is a recognised aim of life, just like studying.

hindi: कांट की कोटियाँ — कारण, एकता, द्रव्य जैसे बुद्धि के मूल प्रत्यय जिनसे अनुभव संभव होता है
definition: Kant's basic concepts of the understanding, the mind's power of judging, such as cause, unity and substance, which the mind applies to make any experience possible
example: Seeing the spilled juice, Mira's mind applied the Kantian categories instantly: cause, effect, and a guilty-looking toddler.

hindi: कांटीय रचनावाद — नैतिक सिद्धांतों को स्वतंत्र, तर्कशील व्यक्तियों की सहमति से निर्मित मानने का मत
definition: a version of constructivism holding that moral principles are those that free, equal and rational persons would choose or endorse through reasoning
example: The student council used Kantian constructivism to settle phone rules, asking which policy every rational student could accept as fair.

hindi: कांटीय नीतिशास्त्र — बुद्धि से निकले सार्वभौम कर्तव्यों पर आधारित कांट का नैतिक सिद्धांत
definition: Kant's ethical theory, a form of deontology holding that right actions follow duties which reason itself commands, whatever outcomes those actions bring
example: In philosophy class, Riya used Kantian ethics to argue that fibbing about finishing the reading was wrong, even if the teacher never checked.

hindi: कांटवाद — कांट के ज्ञान और नीति संबंधी विचारों पर आधारित दर्शन
definition: the philosophy of Kant and his followers, especially the claims that the mind shapes experience and that morality rests on duties that reason itself discovers
example: Nikhil's Kantianism showed at the office when he refused to fake a sick day, even though the whole team called it a harmless white lie.

hindi: कर्म — किए गए कार्य और उनसे लौटने वाले फल का नियम
definition: the Indian principle that every deliberate action, good or harmful, leaves traces that later return to the doer as matching results, in this life or another
example: Riya called it karma when the classmate who never shared notes found the exam covered the only chapter she had skipped.

hindi: कर्मयोग — निःस्वार्थ कर्म के द्वारा मुक्ति का मार्ग
definition: the path to liberation through selfless action, performing your duties without attachment to their rewards, as taught in the Bhagavad Gita
example: Coaching the under-twelve football team for free every Saturday, Sunita called it her weekly karma yoga.

hindi: कर्मफल — किसी कर्म से उत्पन्न होने वाला फल या परिणाम
definition: the fruit or result that an action brings back to the person who performed it, according to the Indian doctrine of karma
example: When his skipped revision showed up as a failing grade, Aditya had to admit the karmaphala arrived faster than expected.

hindi: करुणा — दूसरों के दुःख दूर करने की इच्छा
definition: the Buddhist virtue of compassion, the wish that others be free from suffering, treated as the necessary partner of wisdom on the path
example: Sharing her umbrella with a stranger at the bus stop, Isha showed karuna without making a speech about it.

hindi: कस्ब — ईश्वर-रचित कर्म को मनुष्य द्वारा अर्जित करने का अशअरी सिद्धांत
definition: the doctrine of the Ash'ari school of Islamic theology that the deity creates every human action while the person acquires it, and so becomes responsible for it
example: Omar explained kasb with a cooking metaphor: the kitchen supplies every ingredient, but whoever plates the dish owns the result.

hindi: कश्फ़ — सूफ़ी साधना में परदा हटकर सत्य का प्रत्यक्ष दर्शन
definition: in Sufi thought, the unveiling of hidden spiritual truth to the heart through direct insight, rather than through argument or study
example: After finally understanding his tax form, Hamid called it kashf, the veil lifting at last from the heart of bureaucracy.

hindi: स्थिर सुख — पीड़ा और व्याकुलता के अभाव से मिलने वाला शांत आनंद
definition: the Epicurean pleasure of a settled state, simply being free from pain and worry, which Epicurus ranked above active excitement
example: Lying on the sofa after finishing his taxes, Gaurav enjoyed the katastematic pleasure of having absolutely nothing left to dread.

hindi: उचित कर्तव्य — अपनी प्रकृति और भूमिका के अनुरूप करणीय कर्म
definition: in Stoic ethics, an appropriate action that fits your nature and social role, like caring for parents, which can be given a sensible justification
example: Calling his grandmother every Sunday was Nikhil's idea of kathekon, even when she spent the whole call reviewing his haircut.

hindi: क्रमिक एकदेववाद — अनेक देवताओं में से बारी-बारी से हर एक को सर्वोच्च मानकर पूजना
definition: the worship of several deities one after another, treating each in turn as supreme while that particular hymn or ritual lasts
example: Reading the hymns for her exam, Sana noticed kathenotheism at work, each deity praised as supreme until the next verse handed that honour along.

hindi: सम्यक कर्म — पूर्ण विवेक से किया गया निर्दोष कर्तव्य
definition: in Stoic ethics, a perfectly right action performed by a wise person from fully virtuous understanding, rather than merely doing the correct thing
example: Priya joked that returning the extra change to the grocer was merely kathekon, and she would reach katorthoma once she stopped telling everyone.

hindi: स्वभाव-दर्शन — अपने असली स्वभाव की झलक पाने का आरंभिक बोध
definition: an initial glimpse of awakening in Japanese Buddhism, literally 'seeing your nature', often treated as the first taste of deeper enlightenment
example: Sahil described quitting social media as a kensho moment, though his friends noted that the awakening lasted until Thursday.

hindi: केवलज्ञान — सर्वज्ञता, वह पूर्ण ज्ञान जो सभी कर्मों के नष्ट होने पर प्रकट होता है
definition: in Jain philosophy, perfect and complete knowledge of everything, which the soul attains once all karmic matter clouding it has been removed
example: Rahul joked that he would need kevala jnana to understand the new tax form without calling his accountant.

hindi: केवली — केवलज्ञान प्राप्त कर चुका सर्वज्ञ पुरुष
definition: in Jainism, a person who has attained perfect, complete knowledge of everything while still living in a body
example: Everyone in the quiz team treated Meenal as a kevalin until she confidently named the wrong capital of Australia.

hindi: आधार-पात्र — वह स्थान जिसमें भौतिक वस्तुएँ आकार लेती हैं
definition: Plato's word in the Timaeus for the receptacle or space in which physical things come into being, neither Form nor physical object
example: The empty studio apartment felt like pure khora to Jai, a space waiting for furniture to come into being.

hindi: ख्यातिवाद — भ्रम या मिथ्या प्रत्यक्ष की व्याख्या करने वाले भारतीय सिद्धांत
definition: the family of Indian theories explaining perceptual error, such as mistaking a rope for a snake, each school offering its own account of what the error really perceives
example: After Tanya screamed at a phone charger she mistook for a spider, her flatmate launched into khyativada and asked what exactly she had seen.

hindi: मारना और मरने देना — सक्रिय हत्या और मृत्यु न रोकने के नैतिक अंतर पर बहस
definition: the debate over whether actively causing someone's death is morally worse than failing to prevent a death that you could have prevented
example: Watching Neel not rescue the drowning houseplant, Sana opened a lecture on killing and letting die.

hindi: गतिशील सुख — किसी इच्छा की पूर्ति के समय होने वाला सक्रिय आनंद
definition: the Epicurean pleasure of activity or change, like eating when hungry, which satisfies a desire but is less valuable than settled calm
example: The first bite of biryani after a long shift gave Sana pure kinetic pleasure, followed swiftly by a nap.

hindi: साध्यों का राज्य — ऐसा आदर्श समुदाय जहाँ हर व्यक्ति साध्य है और सब समान नैतिक नियम बनाते हैं
definition: Kant's ideal community of rational beings who each treat all others as ends in themselves and who together make and obey the same moral rules
example: Their flat's chore chart, Ishaan claimed, was a small kingdom of ends, until someone left the dishes for a week.

hindi: राजधर्म — सद्गुण और करुणा से शासन का मार्ग
definition: the Confucian ideal of ruling through virtue and care for the people, winning loyalty by goodness rather than by military force or fear
example: The captain who carried everyone's bags won more trust than the one who barked orders, proof of the kingly way.

hindi: ज्ञान-ज्ञान सिद्धांत — जानने पर यह भी जान लेने की शर्त कि आप जानते हैं
definition: the principle that whenever a person knows something, that person must also know that they know it, so knowledge always comes with self-awareness of knowing
example: Asked whether she knew that she knew the exam date, Devika tangled herself in the KK principle and reopened the timetable anyway.

hindi: क्लेश — अविद्या, अहंकार, राग, द्वेष और मृत्यु-भय जैसे मन के मूल दोष
definition: in Yoga philosophy, any of the root afflictions of the mind, namely ignorance, egoism, attachment, aversion and clinging to life, which cause suffering
example: Refusing to delete a single old photo, Omar admitted his attachment was a genuine klesha, and his storage was full.

hindi: नोब प्रभाव — दुष्परिणाम को सुपरिणाम से अधिक जानबूझकर किया गया मानने की प्रवृत्ति
definition: the experimental finding that people judge a foreseen harmful side effect as intentional much more readily than a foreseen helpful side effect
example: The Knobe effect struck when the canteen's cost-cutting raised prices: everyone said the manager meant it, though nobody credited him for the shorter queues.

hindi: ज्ञाता विरोधाभास — 'यह वाक्य ज्ञात नहीं है' से उपजा ज्ञान-संबंधी विरोधाभास
definition: a liar-style puzzle about a sentence stating that nobody knows it, which shows that simple rules about knowledge can lead to contradiction
example: When the quiz host asked whether anyone knew the answer that nobody knows, the team captain muttered that this was the knower paradox.

hindi: ज्ञान-तर्क — भौतिक तथ्यों से अनुभव की पूरी व्याख्या न होने का तर्क
definition: the argument, built on the Mary's room thought experiment, that knowing every physical fact about colour vision still leaves out what seeing colour feels like, so physical facts cannot capture everything about the mind
example: Riya used the knowledge argument to explain why reading the menu description was nothing like actually tasting the biryani.

hindi: परिचयजन्य ज्ञान — किसी वस्तु के सीधे प्रत्यक्ष अनुभव से मिला ज्ञान
definition: knowledge gained through direct, immediate experience of something, such as tasting a flavour, without relying on descriptions
example: After one bite of the ghost-pepper chutney, Zoya's knowledge by acquaintance far outran her friends' warnings.

hindi: वर्णनजन्य ज्ञान — किसी वस्तु को केवल वर्णनों और तथ्यों के माध्यम से जानना
definition: knowledge of something gained only through descriptions and facts about it, without direct experience of the thing itself
example: Having only read the menu, Ravi had knowledge by description of the ghost-pepper chutney and planned to keep it that way.

hindi: ज्ञान-प्रधान ज्ञानमीमांसा — ज्ञान को मूल मानकर विश्वास और औचित्य को उससे समझाने का दृष्टिकोण
definition: the approach that treats knowledge as basic, something that cannot be broken down into simpler parts, then explains belief, evidence and justification in terms of knowledge
example: Tired of patching definitions, the seminar tried knowledge-first epistemology and started with what everyone simply knew about the coffee rota.

hindi: क्रियात्मक ज्ञान — कोई कौशल या काम कर पाने की जानकारी
definition: practical knowledge of how to perform a skill or task, such as riding a bicycle, which may resist being stated as facts
example: Grandma's roti-making is pure knowledge-how: she cannot write down the recipe, but her hands never miss.

hindi: प्रतिज्ञप्त्यात्मक ज्ञान — किसी तथ्य या कथन के सत्य होने का ज्ञान
definition: knowledge of facts, expressed by saying someone knows that something is the case, also called propositional knowledge
example: Aryan had plenty of knowledge-that about swimming strokes, which proved useless the moment he jumped into the pool.

hindi: ध्यान-पहेली — तर्क से न सुलझने वाली, बोध जगाने वाली गुरु की पहेली
definition: a puzzling story, question or statement used in meditation training that cannot be solved by ordinary reasoning and aims to break habitual thinking
example: Riya said her landlord's rule that the kitchen must be both spotless and never used was basically a koan.

hindi: कोलबर्ग की अवस्थाएँ — नैतिक तर्कशक्ति के विकास की क्रमिक अवस्थाओं का सिद्धांत
definition: the psychologist Lawrence Kohlberg's theory that moral reasoning develops through six stages, moving from fear of punishment toward universal ethical principles
example: The twins argued about bedtime from opposite ends of Kohlberg's stages: one feared punishment, the other appealed to universal fairness.

hindi: राष्ट्रीय विद्या — प्राचीन जापानी ग्रंथों से मूल जापानी भावना खोजने वाली धारा
definition: the Japanese nativist school that studied ancient Japanese poetry and chronicles to recover an authentic native sensibility free of Chinese influence
example: Her literature professor linked mono no aware to kokugaku, since those scholars prized feeling over borrowed Chinese moralising.

hindi: कोश — आत्मा को ढकने वाले पाँच आवरणों में से एक
definition: any of the five sheaths described in the Taittiriya Upanishad, layers of body, breath, mind, intellect and bliss that cover the true self
example: Peeling off his jacket, sweater and scarf after the cold commute, Ishaan joked that he had shed three koshas already.

hindi: क्रिपके अर्थविज्ञान — संभव लोकों और उनके संबंधों से प्रकारमूलक कथनों का अर्थ देने की पद्धति
definition: a method of giving meaning to modal logic using possible worlds linked by an accessibility relation, where different rules about that relation produce different modal systems
