example: Sahil used Kripke semantics to map every excuse his flatmate had ever given, and found no possible world where the dishes got done.

hindi: क्षमा — दूसरों के अपराध को माफ़ करने का गुण
definition: forgiveness and patient forbearance, releasing anger toward someone who has wronged you
example: When her brother finished the last of the ice cream, Diya practised kshama, though she also hid the next tub.

hindi: कुन-हानि — नए ढाँचे को अपनाते समय पुराने ढाँचे की व्याख्यात्मक क्षमता का खो जाना
definition: the explanatory problems that an older scientific framework could handle but its replacement cannot, so progress also involves real losses
example: Upgrading the office software produced a Kuhn loss: the fancy dashboard could not print the simple table everyone actually needed.

hindi: क्योटो सम्प्रदाय — बौद्ध चिंतन और पश्चिमी दर्शन को जोड़ने वाली जापानी दार्शनिक धारा
definition: the twentieth-century Japanese philosophical movement, begun by Nishida Kitaro, which combined Buddhist insight with Western philosophy around the idea of nothingness
example: In the seminar, Farah explained that the Kyoto School tried to make Hegel and meditation teachers share a single dinner table.

hindi: प्रभुतंत्र — अनेक प्रकार के वर्चस्व की परस्पर जुड़ी पिरामिडी व्यवस्था
definition: a term broadening patriarchy to describe interlocking social systems of domination, where people may be oppressed in some respects and privileged in others
example: Watching the head chef bully the waiters who then snapped at the dishwashers, Rhea called the restaurant a tiny kyriarchy.

hindi: श्रम-स्वामित्व सिद्धांत — श्रम मिलाने से वस्तु पर स्वामित्व बनने का लॉक का मत
definition: Locke's view that people gain ownership of natural resources by mixing their labour with them, such as farming unclaimed land
example: Having assembled the flatpack wardrobe alone, Yash invoked the labour theory of property to claim first choice of shelves.

hindi: श्रम-मूल्य सिद्धांत — वस्तु का मूल्य उसे बनाने में लगे श्रम से तय होने का मत
definition: the theory, held by Smith, Ricardo and Marx, that the value of a commodity depends on the amount of labour socially necessary to produce it
example: Defending her handmade candles' price at the craft fair, Pooja invoked the labour theory of value and three hours of careful pouring.

hindi: अहस्तक्षेपवाद — अर्थव्यवस्था में सरकारी हस्तक्षेप न करने की नीति
definition: the policy that government should leave trade and business alone, allowing markets to operate without regulation, subsidies or controls
example: The new manager's laissez-faire style meant nobody set deadlines, which worked beautifully until the client called.

hindi: भूमि-नीति — मिट्टी, जल, पौधों और पशुओं के पूरे समुदाय तक नैतिकता का विस्तार करने का मत
definition: the view that ethics should extend to the whole community of soils, waters, plants and animals, so that actions are right when they preserve the integrity and stability of that community
example: The farmer's land ethic meant the hedgerows stayed, even when his accountant sent three emails about crop yields.

hindi: भाषा-खेल — भाषा को नियमबद्ध सामाजिक गतिविधियों के रूप में देखने का विट्गेन्स्टाइनी विचार
definition: Wittgenstein's idea that words gain their meaning inside rule-governed social activities, such as ordering, joking or bargaining, much as chess pieces gain meaning inside chess
example: Office jargon is its own language game: "circle back" makes perfect sense in a meeting and none at the dinner table.

hindi: विचार की भाषा — मस्तिष्क में प्रतीकों की आंतरिक भाषा होने की परिकल्पना
definition: Jerry Fodor's hypothesis that thinking takes place in an inner, language-like system of mental symbols with its own grammar, distinct from any spoken language
example: Bilingual Aisha argued that when she dreamed in neither Hindi nor English, she must be dreaming in the language of thought.

hindi: भाषा-व्यवस्था — किसी भाषा के साझा नियमों और संबंधों का पूरा तंत्र
definition: Saussure's term for language as a shared, abstract system of rules and relations that every speaker draws upon, studied apart from individual speech
example: Grandma's slang confused everyone, yet she was still clearly drawing on the same langue as the rest of the dinner table.

hindi: लाप्लास का दानव — संपूर्ण ज्ञान से भविष्य की पूर्ण भविष्यवाणी की परिकल्पना
definition: pierre-Simon Laplace's imagined intellect that knows the exact position and motion of every particle and could therefore predict the entire future, used to picture strict determinism
example: Guessing correctly which colleague would be late to every meeting, Tanya was hailed as the Laplace's demon of the marketing floor.

hindi: बृहत् गणनांक अभिगृहीत — अत्यंत विशाल अनंत संख्याओं के अस्तित्व को मानने वाला अभिगृहीत
definition: an axiom asserting the existence of enormously large infinite numbers, called cardinals, beyond anything standard axioms prove exist, often used to settle otherwise undecidable questions
example: When Ishan's brother bet infinity plus one, Ishan escalated with a large cardinal axiom, and their mother confiscated both phones.

hindi: अंतिम मनुष्य — नीत्शे का वह प्रकार जो केवल आराम और सुरक्षा चाहता है
definition: Nietzsche's picture of a comfortable, timid human who wants only safety, pleasure and sameness, the opposite of the striving, value-creating Übermensch
example: Sprawled on the sofa with snacks and a streaming queue, Rohan proudly declared himself the last man.

hindi: अंतिम मनुष्य तर्क — पृथ्वी के अंतिम मनुष्य द्वारा प्रकृति नष्ट करना भी गलत लगने से प्रकृति का अपना मूल्य सिद्ध करने वाला प्रयोग
definition: the thought experiment asking whether the final surviving human would do wrong by destroying every remaining forest, meant to show that nature has value beyond human usefulness
example: Stuck on the last man argument, the class decided that anyone who torches a forest at the end of the world has bigger problems.

hindi: लैटिन इब्न रुश्दवाद — मध्ययुगीन यूरोप में इब्न रुश्द के विचारों पर आधारित आंदोलन
definition: the movement among medieval European university teachers who followed Averroes in reading Aristotle through reason alone, even where his conclusions clashed with Christian teaching
example: In history class, Priya's teacher called the medieval Paris arts faculty a Latin Averroism fan club, reading Aristotle long after the bishops said stop.

hindi: सत्यनिष्ठ विधि — न्यायाधीश पूरे क़ानूनी इतिहास को सुसंगत नैतिक सिद्धांतों की सर्वश्रेष्ठ व्याख्या में पढ़ें
definition: Dworkin's view that judges should decide cases by interpreting past legal decisions as expressing coherent moral principles, choosing the reading that best justifies the whole legal practice
example: Asked which ruling to follow, Zoya reasoned in the spirit of law as integrity, reading the club's past decisions as one consistent story about fairness to members.

hindi: मध्यम-परिहार नियम — हर कथन या उसका निषेध सत्य होता है, तीसरा विकल्प नहीं
definition: the principle of classical logic that for any statement, either the statement or its negation is true, leaving no third option in between
example: Rhea invoked the law of excluded middle at the canteen: either the biryani is spicy or it isn't, so her friend should stop saying 'kind of'.

hindi: व्याघात-निषेध नियम — कोई कथन एक ही समय और अर्थ में सत्य और असत्य दोनों नहीं हो सकता
definition: the principle, defended by Aristotle, that a statement and its denial cannot both be true at the same time and in the same sense
example: When Dhruv claimed he was both at home and at the cinema, his mother invoked the law of non-contradiction and asked for his location.

hindi: प्रकृति के नियम — जगत की घटनाओं में व्याप्त सार्वभौम और अपरिवर्तनीय नियमितताएँ
definition: the basic universal patterns or principles that govern, or at least describe, how everything in the physical world behaves, such as the conservation of energy
example: Dev insisted the laws of nature forbade his phone from surviving that fall, yet there it lay on the kitchen tiles, uncracked and smug.

hindi: अकर्मण्य तर्क — यदि भाग्य तय है तो प्रयास व्यर्थ है, यह भ्रामक तर्क
definition: the ancient argument that if the future is fated, effort makes no difference, which Stoic thinkers answered by saying outcomes are fated together with the actions leading to them
example: Ananya's lazy argument that her exam result was already fated collapsed when her mother pointed out that revising was fated too.

hindi: करके सीखना — प्रत्यक्ष क्रिया और अनुभव द्वारा ज्ञान प्राप्त करना
definition: Dewey's principle that people learn most deeply through active experience and experiment, thinking about what happens when they attempt something themselves
example: Priya mastered the office spreadsheet through learning by doing, which mostly meant breaking it twice before lunch.

hindi: वाम स्वेच्छातंत्रवाद — आत्म-स्वामित्व के साथ प्राकृतिक संसाधनों पर साझा अधिकार मानने वाला मत
definition: the view that combines strong individual self-ownership with the claim that land and natural resources belong to everyone equally
example: In the ecology seminar, Ritu's left-libertarianism meant she defended people's control over their bodies while insisting the river belonged to everyone.

hindi: विधिक नैतिकतावाद — अनैतिक आचरण को केवल अनैतिक होने के कारण दंडनीय बनाना उचित है
definition: the view that the state may justly criminalise conduct simply because it is immoral, even when that conduct harms nobody else
example: When the housing society proposed fining residents for private card games, Neel called it legal moralism dressed up as a noise complaint.

hindi: विधिक प्रत्यक्षवाद — क़ानून की वैधता सामाजिक तथ्यों से तय होती है, नैतिकता से नहीं
definition: the view that whether a rule counts as a valid legal rule depends only on social facts, such as being passed by a parliament, and not on its moral merit
example: Rohan paid the parking fine in the spirit of legal positivism: the council had properly passed the rule, so it was valid, however unfair it felt.

hindi: विधिक यथार्थवाद — क़ानून वह है जो अदालतें वास्तव में करती हैं, केवल लिखित नियम नहीं
definition: the view that laws are best understood by predicting what judges and courts actually decide, since rulings are shaped by judges' backgrounds, politics and social pressures as much as by written rules
example: Studying past verdicts instead of the statute book, the trainee lawyer embraced legal realism and noted which judge ruled harshly just before lunch.

hindi: विधिक-तार्किक सत्ता — नियमों और पद की वैधता पर टिकी वेबर की सत्ता
definition: Weber's type of legitimate authority that rests on belief in formal rules and procedures, so people obey the office and its written laws rather than the person holding it
example: Nobody liked the new floor manager, but his legal-rational authority came with the job title, so the reports still got filed.

hindi: विधिवाद — कठोर कानून, दण्ड और पुरस्कार से शासन करने का पक्षधर चीनी दर्शन
definition: the Chinese school of political thought that holds a state is best governed through strict written laws, harsh penalties and rewards rather than moral example
example: The new hostel warden practised pure Legalism: a rulebook on every door and fines posted daily on the noticeboard.

hindi: वैधता — किसी सत्ता के शासन करने के अधिकार का उचित और मान्य होना
definition: the quality a government or authority has when its right to rule and give commands is rightful and justified, rather than resting on force alone
example: The new class monitor had the badge, but after winning a vote nobody attended, her legitimacy was shaky at best.

hindi: वैधता संकट — जनता का शासन-व्यवस्था पर विश्वास और स्वीकृति खो देना
definition: Habermas's term for a situation where citizens stop believing a political system deserves loyalty, so the state loses the support it needs to govern
example: After the third unexplained fee hike, the residents' association faced a legitimation crisis, and nobody attended its meetings.

hindi: लाइब्निट्ज़ विस्थापन तर्क — पूरे जगत को खिसकाने से कोई भेद न होने के आधार पर निरपेक्ष दिक् का खंडन
definition: Leibniz's argument against absolute space: shifting the entire universe three metres east would make no detectable difference, so absolute positions are meaningless
example: When the landlord claimed the whole building had moved, Arjun replied with the Leibniz shift argument: nothing inside could possibly tell.

hindi: लाइबनिट्ज़ का नियम — अभिन्न वस्तुओं के सभी गुण समान होने का सिद्धांत
definition: the principle that if two named things are identical, then every property of the first is also a property of the second, and vice versa
example: Invoking Leibniz's law, Zoya proved the 'other' charger was hers: same scratch, same frayed cable, same missing sticker.

hindi: लाइबनिट्ज़ की चक्की — यांत्रिक पुर्ज़ों में चेतना न मिल पाने का दृष्टांत
definition: Leibniz's thought experiment of walking inside a thinking machine enlarged to the size of a mill, where you would find only moving parts and never anything like perception or thought
example: Opening up his laptop to clean the fan, Aryan found only dust and wires, which he announced was proof of Leibniz's mill.

hindi: वाच्यार्थ — किसी कथन द्वारा कहा गया अभौतिक अर्थ
definition: in Stoic logic, the meaning or content of a spoken sentence, treated as something real yet not physical, distinct from both words and objects
example: When his sister twisted his text message, Rohit insisted the lekton was innocent even if the emojis were suspicious.

hindi: उपप्रमेय — बड़े प्रमेय को सिद्ध करने हेतु पहले सिद्ध किया गया सहायक कथन
definition: a smaller statement proved first as a stepping stone, so that it can be used as a premise in the proof of a larger theorem
example: Before proving he deserved the window seat, Varun established a lemma: whoever booked the tickets gets first choice.

hindi: लेश्या — कर्मों से रंगे आत्मा के भावों का रंग-आधारित वर्गीकरण
definition: in Jain philosophy, the subtle colouring of the soul caused by karma, ranked from dark to bright shades that reflect a person's moral character
example: After his outburst at the cricket match, Neel's friends teased that his leshya had turned the darkest possible shade.

hindi: समतलीकरण आपत्ति — यदि बराबरी स्वयं में अच्छी है तो अमीरों को गरीब बनाना भी अच्छा मानना पड़ेगा
definition: the objection that pure egalitarianism would approve of making better-off people worse off even when doing so helps nobody at all
example: When Mum proposed banning dessert because only one child finished dinner, the kids raised the leveling down objection in unison.

hindi: अन्यायपूर्ण विधि विधि नहीं — घोर अन्यायी नियम को सच्चे क़ानून का दर्जा नहीं मिलता
definition: a principle from natural law thinking, which grounds legal authority in morality, meaning roughly 'an unjust statute is no statute at all' and holding that a gravely unjust statute creates no genuine duty to obey
example: Priya quoted lex iniusta non est lex at the staff meeting when the canteen banned eating lunch at your desk, which some colleagues felt was overstating things.

hindi: क्रमिक प्राथमिकता — एक सिद्धांत को पूरी तरह संतुष्ट करने के बाद ही अगले पर विचार करने का नियम
definition: a strict ordering of principles in which a higher principle must be fully satisfied before any lower principle may even be considered
example: The team gave deadlines lexical priority over tidiness, which explained why nobody had seen the meeting table since Tuesday.

hindi: आचार — संस्कार, शिष्टाचार और मर्यादा का पालन
definition: the Confucian idea of ritual propriety: the customs, ceremonies and good manners that shape respectful conduct and hold a community together
example: Standing when the grandparents entered the room, Neha explained to her Canadian friend, was simply li in everyday clothes.

hindi: सहज नैतिक बोध — वांग यांगमिंग का मत कि हर मन में सही-गलत का जन्मजात ज्ञान है
definition: in Wang Yangming's Neo-Confucian thought, the innate knowing of good present in every mind, which needs clearing rather than teaching
example: When Mohan returned the extra change the shopkeeper gave him, his sister credited liangzhi rather than his maths.

hindi: असत्यवादी विरोधाभास — 'यह वाक्य झूठा है' जैसे कथन का सत्य-असत्य दोनों न ठहर पाना
definition: the puzzle of a sentence that says of itself that it is false, so that if the sentence is true then it must be false, and if false then true
example: When Tanya's sticky note on the fridge read 'this note is false', her flatmate spent breakfast stuck inside the liar paradox.

hindi: उदार शिक्षा — व्यवसाय के बजाय मुक्त और विचारशील मनुष्य बनाने वाली व्यापक शिक्षा
definition: an education in broad subjects such as literature, history, science and philosophy, aimed at forming free and thoughtful persons rather than training for a single trade
example: Her engineering friends mocked her poetry elective until Tara used her liberal education to write the best cover letter in the flat.

hindi: उदार सुजननिकी — माता-पिता की स्वतंत्र पसंद से संतान के गुण चुनने का मत
definition: the view that parents, rather than governments, should be free to choose genetic traits for their children using reproductive technologies
example: When cousins debated choosing a baby's eye colour, Divya warned they had drifted into liberal eugenics before dessert.

hindi: उदार नारीवाद — समान अधिकार और अवसर द्वारा स्त्री-समानता का मत
definition: the form of feminism that seeks equality for women mainly through equal legal rights, equal opportunities and reform of existing institutions
example: Pushing for equal parental leave in the office handbook, Meena called her strategy liberal feminism, one policy clause at a time.

hindi: उदार तटस्थता — राज्य को जीवन के किसी एक आदर्श का पक्ष न लेने का सिद्धांत
definition: the principle that government should stay neutral between rival ideas of the good life and should never favour one religion, lifestyle or ideal
example: The principal cited liberal neutrality when she refused to pick between the cricket club and the chess club for the assembly slot.

hindi: उदारवाद — व्यक्ति की स्वतंत्रता, अधिकारों और सीमित शासन को केंद्र में रखने वाली विचारधारा
definition: the political outlook that places individual liberty, equal rights and limits on government power at the centre of a fair society
example: When the housing society tried to ban balcony plants, Aarav's liberalism kicked in and he drafted a petition about individual rights.

hindi: इच्छा-स्वातंत्र्यवाद — मनुष्य के चुनाव को पूर्व कारणों से अनिर्धारित और सचमुच स्वतंत्र मानने का मत
definition: the view that people really do choose freely, and that this is possible only because some human choices are not fixed in advance by earlier causes
example: Siya claimed libertarian free will over dinner: no chain of causes, she said, could have predicted her ordering pineapple pizza.

hindi: स्वतंत्रतावादी पितृवाद — विकल्प छीने बिना लोगों को बेहतर चुनाव की ओर धीरे से मोड़ना
definition: the approach of nudging people toward better choices, for example through default settings, while still leaving them fully free to choose otherwise
example: The canteen's libertarian paternalism put fruit at eye level and hid the chips on the bottom shelf, where everyone still found them.

hindi: स्वेच्छातंत्रवाद — व्यक्तिगत स्वतंत्रता को सर्वोच्च मानकर राज्य को न्यूनतम रखने का मत
definition: the political view that individual liberty and property rights come first, so government should shrink to the smallest possible role
example: Karan's libertarianism lasted until the flatmates proposed that everyone simply keep their own dishes, forever, unwashed if they liked.

hindi: उदासीनता की स्वतंत्रता — बिना किसी निर्धारक कारण के चुनने की स्वतंत्रता
definition: the supposed freedom to choose without any prior cause settling the choice, as if the person stood evenly balanced between options
example: Staring at two identical phone cases, Akash wished for liberty of indifference so his thumb would simply decide.

hindi: स्वेच्छा की स्वतंत्रता — बाहरी बल के बिना अपनी इच्छा से कर्म करने की स्वतंत्रता
definition: the freedom to behave as you wish without outside force or restraint, even if your wishes themselves have causes
example: Leaving the office early with permission, Ritika enjoyed liberty of spontaneity, though her schedule had been fixed since Monday.

hindi: लिबेट प्रयोग — सचेत निर्णय से पहले मस्तिष्क-गतिविधि दिखाने वाला प्रयोग
definition: the brain study showing electrical activity starting before people report consciously deciding to move, often cited in debates about free will
example: Citing the Libet experiment, Pranav claimed his brain had ordered the second samosa before he even noticed.

hindi: जीवन-संतोष सिद्धांत — कल्याण व्यक्ति के अपने जीवन से समग्र संतोष में है
definition: the theory of wellbeing holding that a person's life goes well for them when they themselves judge and feel their life as a whole to be satisfying
example: Under life satisfaction theory, Lata's cramped flat still counts as a good life, because she beams about it at every family dinner.

hindi: जीवन-नौका नीति — सीमित संसाधनों में किसे बचाया जाए, इस पर नैतिक चिंतन
definition: the view, framed through the image of a crowded lifeboat with limited room, that wealthy nations must sometimes refuse help to others so that shared resources are not exhausted
example: When the last slice of pizza met six hungry flatmates, Arjun invoked lifeboat ethics and was promptly voted off the sofa.

hindi: जीवन-जगत — रोज़मर्रा के अनुभव का वह संसार जिसे हम बिना प्रश्न जीते हैं
definition: the everyday world of shared, lived experience that people simply take for granted, which comes before and underlies every scientific or theoretical account
example: The physics teacher explained sunsets as scattered light, but in the lifeworld of the class group chat they were simply beautiful.

hindi: सादृश्य सिद्धांत — विचार केवल विचार जैसा ही हो सकता है, यह बर्कले का मत
definition: Berkeley's principle that an idea can resemble nothing except another idea, so ideas cannot copy unthinking material things
example: Riya invoked the likeness principle to argue that her mental picture of pizza resembled other pizza thoughts far more than the soggy slice on her plate.

hindi: सीमांत स्थिति — मृत्यु, पीड़ा या अपराध जैसी अपरिहार्य परिस्थितियाँ
definition: Jaspers's term for unavoidable situations such as death, suffering, struggle and guilt, which shatter everyday security and force a person to face their existence
example: Sitting in the hospital corridor overnight, Divya faced what Jaspers called a limit situation.

hindi: पलायन-रेखा — स्थापित ढाँचों से निकलकर नई संभावनाओं की ओर गति
definition: deleuze and Guattari's term for a path of escape by which desire or thought breaks free from fixed structures, habits and identities toward unexpected possibilities
example: Quitting the accounting course to open a bakery was, Mira insisted, a line of flight and not merely a sugar craving.

hindi: रैखिक तर्कशास्त्र — जिसमें हर आधार ठीक एक बार उपयोग होता है
definition: a substructural logic, one that limits the usual proof rules, in which each premise must be used exactly once, treating statements like resources that are consumed rather than truths that stay available
example: Explaining linear logic to his flatmate, Siddharth pointed out that the last packet of noodles, once cooked, cannot also be cooked tomorrow.

hindi: भाषिक विश्लेषण — शब्दों और वाक्यों के प्रयोग की बारीक जाँच द्वारा अवधारणाओं को स्पष्ट करना
definition: the method of clarifying concepts by closely examining how words and sentences are used, taken by many analytic philosophers as the main tool of philosophy
example: A bit of linguistic analysis revealed that when Karan said 'I'll be there in five minutes' he meant something closer to half an hour.

hindi: भाषिक ढाँचा — किसी विषय पर बोलने के लिए चुने गए शब्दों और नियमों की पूरी व्यवस्था
definition: in Carnap's philosophy, a chosen system of words and rules for talking about some subject, such as numbers or physical objects, where questions asked inside the system have answers
example: Asking whether numbers really exist, Ishaan's tutor said that inside the linguistic framework of arithmetic the answer is simply yes, and outside it the question is unclear.

hindi: भाषिक परिघटनाविज्ञान — शब्दों की बारीकियों से स्वयं अनुभव और स्थितियों को समझने की विधि
definition: Austin's name for studying everyday words closely in order to sharpen our awareness of the situations and experiences those words describe
example: Through a little linguistic phenomenology, Riya noticed that 'accidentally' and 'by mistake' describe two quite different kitchen disasters.

hindi: भाषिक दर्शन — दार्शनिक समस्याओं को भाषा के विश्लेषण से सुलझाने का दृष्टिकोण
definition: the broad approach within analytic philosophy holding that philosophical problems are best tackled by examining the language used to state them
example: Linguistic philosophy came in handy at the family lunch when Divya showed that her uncle and cousin were using the word 'freedom' in different senses.

hindi: भाषिक मोड़ — बीसवीं सदी में दर्शन का ध्यान भाषा के अध्ययन की ओर मुड़ना
definition: the twentieth-century shift in philosophy toward treating the study of language as the central route to answering questions about thought, knowledge and reality
example: Their philosophy class took its own linguistic turn when every argument about fairness became an argument about what the word 'fair' means.

hindi: शाब्दिकतावाद — शब्दों या चित्रण को ज्यों-का-त्यों लेने का आग्रह
definition: the practice of taking words at their exact surface meaning, or, in artwork and literature, of portraying things exactly as they appear
example: Told to 'break a leg' before the school play, Ishan's literalism had him double-checking the stage for loose planks.

hindi: लघु आख्यान — स्थानीय, सीमित और विशिष्ट कथा
definition: Lyotard's term for a small, local story tied to a particular community or situation, offered in place of grand, universal explanations of history
example: Instead of a history of the whole city, Sana collected little narratives from each shopkeeper on her street.

hindi: जीवंत परिकल्पना — जो संभावना व्यक्ति को सचमुच विश्वसनीय लगे
definition: William James's term for a possibility that appeals to someone as a real candidate for belief, as opposed to a dead hypothesis that holds no pull
example: Becoming a dentist was never a live hypothesis for Aditi, though her parents kept raising it at dinner.

hindi: जीवित शरीर — भीतर से अनुभव किया जाने वाला शरीर, केवल भौतिक वस्तु नहीं
definition: the body as experienced from within, as your living means of perceiving and acting in the world, rather than as a physical object studied from outside
example: After ten hours at the desk, Ananya's lived body announced itself loudly through her neck, shoulders and wrists.

hindi: जीवित वसीयत — भविष्य में असमर्थ होने पर उपचार संबंधी इच्छाओं का लिखित दस्तावेज़
definition: a written document in which a person states in advance which medical treatments they would accept or refuse if they later become unable to decide
example: After binge-watching a hospital drama, Kiran drafted a living will that also banned anyone from playing sad violin music.

hindi: गर्भित प्रश्न — ऐसा प्रश्न जिसमें अप्रमाणित दावा पहले से छिपा हो
definition: a question that contains a hidden, unproven assumption, so that any direct answer seems to accept that assumption as true
example: Have you stopped stealing my charger, asked Kavya, and her brother realised the loaded question had no safe answer.

hindi: आंशिक संशयवाद — किसी एक क्षेत्र के ज्ञान पर संदेह
definition: scepticism limited to one particular area of belief, such as memory, other minds or morality, while accepting knowledge elsewhere
example: Priya's local scepticism applied only to her uncle's fishing stories, which grew longer every family wedding.

hindi: लॉक का बंद कक्ष — स्वेच्छा से रुकने और स्वतंत्रता के भेद पर दृष्टांत
definition: John Locke's example of a person who happily chooses to stay in a room without knowing the door is locked, used to separate acting willingly from being genuinely free
example: Enjoying the conference until he learned the exits were sealed for security, Yash realised he had been in Locke's locked room all along.

hindi: लॉक की शर्त — दूसरों के लिए पर्याप्त और उतना ही अच्छा छोड़ने की शर्त
definition: Locke's condition that someone may claim natural resources as property only if enough and as good remains for others
example: When Reza took the last three chairs in the meeting room, Leela reminded him of the Lockean proviso.

hindi: उच्चारण-क्रिया — अर्थपूर्ण शब्दों को बोलने की मूल क्रिया
definition: the basic action of uttering meaningful words with a definite literal meaning and a definite subject, before asking what the speaker intended or achieved by them
example: Reading the menu aloud in a flat voice, Sameer performed a flawless locutionary act and ordered absolutely nothing.

hindi: तर्कशास्त्र — सही अनुमान और प्रमाण के नियमों का अध्ययन
definition: the branch of philosophy that studies reasoning itself, working out which arguments have conclusions that genuinely follow from their starting claims
example: The group chat's logic collapsed when someone argued that since pizza is food and salad is food, salad is basically pizza.

hindi: तार्किक विश्लेषण — किसी वाक्य की सच्ची तार्किक संरचना को उसके व्याकरणिक रूप के पीछे से उजागर करना
definition: the method of revealing the true logical structure hidden behind a sentence's grammar, often by translating it into the symbols of formal logic
example: Logical analysis showed Nikhil that 'nobody finished the pizza' does not mention a person called Nobody who ate slowly.

hindi: तार्किक परमाणुवाद — संसार को सरल, स्वतंत्र तथ्यों से बना मानने का मत, जिन्हें भाषा के सरलतम वाक्य दर्शाते हैं
definition: the view, developed by Russell and early Wittgenstein, that reality consists of simple, independent facts, and that complex statements can be analysed into simple ones mirroring those facts
example: Sorting his messy notes into single, separate claims, Yash joked that he had become a logical atomist for exam week.

hindi: तार्किक व्यवहारवाद — मानसिक कथन वास्तव में व्यवहार और व्यवहार-प्रवृत्तियों के कथन हैं, ऐसा मत
definition: the view that statements about mental states are really statements about behaviour or tendencies to behave in certain ways under certain conditions
example: Citing logical behaviorism, Kunal said his sister clearly wanted the remote, since she kept reaching for it whenever he looked away.

hindi: तार्किक संयोजक — 'और', 'या', 'नहीं', 'यदि-तो' जैसे कथनों को जोड़ने वाले शब्द या चिह्न
definition: a word or symbol such as 'and', 'or', 'not' or 'if-then' that builds a compound statement from simpler statements
example: Rhea's lawyer friend circled every logical connective in the rental agreement, suspecting the landlord's 'and/or' was hiding something.

hindi: तार्किक परिणाम — वह कथन जो दिए गए कथनों से केवल तार्किक रूप के कारण अनिवार्यतः निकलता है
definition: a statement that follows necessarily from other statements purely because of their logical form, so it must be true whenever those statements are true
example: Meera showed that 'the café is shut' was a logical consequence of 'every shop on this street is shut', so nobody needed to walk over and check.

hindi: तार्किक रचना — किसी वस्तु को सरल तत्वों से तार्किक रूप से गढ़ी गई संरचना मानना
definition: an entity treated as built by logic out of simpler, more basic items, such as a table understood as a pattern of sense experiences rather than a separate hidden thing
example: Kunal claimed that 'the average student' was a logical construction, since no actual student in the classroom had exactly 2.4 siblings.

hindi: तार्किक अनुभववाद — आधुनिक तर्कशास्त्र और अनुभव को मिलाकर ज्ञान की नींव रखने का मत
definition: the later, milder name for logical positivism: the movement combining modern logic with experience, holding that meaningful claims must be checkable by observation or true by logic
example: Priya's physics teacher sounded like a logical empiricist, insisting that every claim on the board needed either a proof or a measurement behind it.

hindi: तार्किक समतुल्यता — दो कथनों का हर स्थिति में समान सत्य-मान होना
definition: the relation between a pair of statements that have the same truth value in every possible case, so each statement guarantees the other
example: Vivaan tried to prove a logical equivalence between 'I'll do it later' and 'I'll do it', but his mother had years of counterexamples.

hindi: तार्किक रूप — किसी कथन या तर्क का वह ढाँचा जो उसकी वैधता तय करता है
definition: the underlying structure of a statement or argument, stripped of its particular subject matter, which determines what follows from it validly
example: Once Asha wrote out the logical form, her flatmate's rent argument turned out to have the same shape as a well-known fallacy.

hindi: तार्किक अनिवार्यता — जो केवल तर्क के नियमों से ही सत्य सिद्ध हो
definition: necessity that follows from the laws of logic alone, so that denying the statement would produce an outright contradiction
example: Aditya explained that it is a logical necessity that either the meeting happens or it does not, which somehow still did not settle the calendar.

hindi: तार्किक बहुलवाद — एक से अधिक तर्क-प्रणालियों के समान रूप से मान्य होने का मत
definition: the view that there is more than one correct logic, so different logics such as classical, intuitionistic or paraconsistent can each be legitimate for different purposes
example: Refusing to pick a side in the classroom logic argument, Farhan announced his logical pluralism and went back to his sandwich.

hindi: तार्किक प्रत्यक्षवाद — केवल अनुभव से जाँचे जा सकने वाले या तार्किक रूप से सत्य कथनों को ही सार्थक मानने का मत
definition: the early twentieth-century movement holding that a statement is meaningful only if experience could check it or logic alone makes it true, so most traditional metaphysics counts as meaningless
example: When Dev asked whether the universe has a purpose, his roommate, a fan of logical positivism, replied that the question could not survive a single experiment and went back to his noodles.

hindi: अशुभ की तार्किक समस्या — ईश्वर और अशुभ के सह-अस्तित्व को तार्किक रूप से असंभव बताने वाला तर्क
definition: the version of the problem of evil claiming that the existence of any evil at all is logically inconsistent with an all-powerful, perfectly good deity
example: In class, Farah pitched the logical problem of evil as a contradiction so tight that one spilled drink should be enough to break it.

hindi: तर्कमूलवाद — गणित को शुद्ध तर्कशास्त्र पर टिका मानने का मत
definition: the view that all of mathematics can be built up from pure logic, so that numbers and sums rest on logical rules alone
example: Watching his sister prove that one plus one equals two in forty lines, Aman finally understood what logicism was asking.

hindi: शब्द-केंद्रवाद — सत्य को वाणी या तर्क में सीधे उपस्थित मानने की प्रवृत्ति
definition: Derrida's term for the Western habit of treating speech, reason or some central word as a direct, stable source of truth and meaning
example: Priya accused the philosophy syllabus of logocentrism after it assumed every essay question had one correct meaning waiting to be found.

hindi: विश्व-विधान — जगत के समस्त परिवर्तन को व्यवस्थित रखने वाला सार्वभौमिक तर्क-नियम
definition: in Heraclitus, the rational principle or universal order that governs all change in the world and that human reason can partly grasp
example: The group project descended into chaos until Aarav drew a timeline, and suddenly everyone could see the logos behind the madness.

hindi: अर्थ-चिकित्सा — जीवन में अर्थ खोजने पर आधारित मनोचिकित्सा
definition: Frankl's form of psychotherapy built on the belief that the search for meaning in life is the strongest human motivation and a path through suffering
example: After a tough semester, Kiran's counsellor used logotherapy, asking what made her mornings worth waking for.

hindi: लोकसंग्रह — समाज के कल्याण और एकता के लिए कर्म
definition: in the Bhagavad Gita, action performed for the welfare and holding together of the whole world, setting an example others can follow
example: Aarav cleaned the shared stairwell himself, calling it lokasamgraha, and within a week two neighbours were doing it too.

hindi: लोकायत — इसी लोक को ही वास्तविक मानने वाला भौतिकवादी मत
definition: another name for the ancient Indian materialist school, meaning what is spread among ordinary people, which accepts only this perceived world and denies any afterlife
example: In the ethics seminar, Kavya summed up lokayata as the philosophy of trusting only what you can taste, touch and photograph.

hindi: दीर्घकालवाद — दूर भविष्य के लोगों के कल्याण को आज के नैतिक निर्णयों में प्रमुख प्राथमिकता देने का मत
definition: the view that positively influencing the long-term future, affecting billions of people still unborn, is a central moral priority of the present
example: Nisha's longtermism made her plant an oak tree, although her roommate pointed out that the dishes were a more immediate emergency.

hindi: लॉटरी विरोधाभास — हर टिकट हारने का विश्वास और किसी के जीतने का ज्ञान
definition: the puzzle that it seems rational to believe each single lottery ticket will lose, yet irrational to believe that every ticket will lose
example: Buying a ticket at the petrol station, Gurpreet shrugged off the lottery paradox, confident only that his own ticket was special.

hindi: प्रेम और कलह — तत्त्वों को जोड़ने और तोड़ने वाली दो ब्रह्मांडीय शक्तियाँ
definition: Empedocles's names for the forces that blend the elements together and pull them apart, whose endless contest drives all change in the cosmos
example: The family WhatsApp group ran on Love and Strife: birthday wishes bound everyone together until someone posted about politics.

hindi: लवलेस आपत्ति — मशीन के केवल आदेश-पालन कर पाने और मौलिक कुछ न रच पाने की आपत्ति
definition: the objection, drawn from Ada Lovelace's famous notes, that a machine can only perform what programmers instruct and therefore can never originate anything genuinely creative
example: When the music app produced a surprisingly catchy tune, Divya raised the Lovelace objection: somewhere, a programmer deserved the royalties.

hindi: संयोग तर्क — अनिर्धारित चुनाव को मात्र संयोग बताने वाला तर्क
definition: the argument that if a choice is not fixed by earlier causes, then which option happens is simply chance, and chance is not real control
example: Tara used the luck argument against her friend: if nothing settled his choice of film, then the popcorn machine basically chose it.

hindi: भाग्य-समतावाद — संयोग से मिली असमानता को मिटाने और चुनाव से बनी असमानता को स्वीकारने का मत
definition: the view that inequalities caused by unchosen luck, such as birth or illness, should be corrected, while inequalities flowing from free choices may stand
example: True to her luck egalitarianism, Tara paid her brother back for the phone she knocked over but not for the concert tickets he chose to lose.

hindi: निम्नतम सर्वहारा — स्थायी रोज़गार और वर्ग-चेतना से बाहर का निर्धनतम तबका
definition: in Marxist theory, the lowest layer of society outside regular employment, which Marx doubted would develop revolutionary class consciousness
example: In the political theory seminar, students debated whether Marx was unfair to the lumpenproletariat or simply describing a grim reality.

hindi: ल्वोव–वारसा संप्रदाय — पोलैंड का तर्कशास्त्रियों और दार्शनिकों का प्रभावशाली संप्रदाय
definition: the influential Polish school of logicians and philosophers, active between the world wars, known for rigorous logic, precise language and careful analysis of truth
example: Rahul's logic professor spoke about the Lwów–Warsaw school with such reverence that the class assumed it must have invented clear thinking itself.

hindi: अंतराल — वस्तुओं और क्षणों के बीच के सार्थक रिक्त स्थान का भाव
definition: the Japanese aesthetic idea of meaningful interval, the pause or empty space between things that gives shape and significance to what surrounds it
example: Her music teacher explained ma by making the class count the silence between notes, which turned out to be the hardest part of the piece.

hindi: माख का सिद्धांत — जड़त्व को सुदूर समस्त पदार्थ के प्रभाव से उत्पन्न मानने की धारणा
definition: the idea that inertia, the resistance of matter to changes in motion, arises from the influence of all distant matter in the universe
example: Spinning on his office chair, Ravi invoked Mach's principle and blamed the distant galaxies for his dizziness.

hindi: यंत्र-नीतिशास्त्र — मशीनों और कृत्रिम बुद्धि को स्वयं नैतिक निर्णय लेने योग्य बनाने का अध्ययन
definition: the field that studies how to build machines and artificial intelligence systems that can themselves make ethically acceptable decisions
example: The machine ethics class spent an hour deciding whether a self-driving taxi should ever break a traffic rule to avoid a pothole.

hindi: यंत्र प्रकार्यवाद — मन को गणन-यंत्र की अवस्थाओं के रूप में समझने वाला प्रकार्यवाद
definition: the early form of functionalism holding that mental states are like the internal states of a computing machine, each defined by the rules linking inputs, other internal states and outputs
example: Watching his calculator app, Arjun explained machine functionalism to his sister: feed in inputs, shift internal states, spit out answers, and that is roughly a mind.

hindi: माध्यमिक — नागार्जुन द्वारा स्थापित शून्यतावादी बौद्ध दर्शन
definition: the Buddhist school of the Middle Way, founded by Nagarjuna, which argues that all things are empty of fixed essence and steers between claiming things truly exist and claiming nothing exists
example: In debate club, Shreya used Madhyamaka arguments to show that every position her opponent held quietly depended on another.

hindi: महत् — प्रकृति से उत्पन्न पहला तत्त्व, विश्व-बुद्धि
definition: in Samkhya, the great principle, the first product to emerge from nature, a cosmic intellect from which individual thought, selfhood and the senses later unfold
example: When the teacher drew prakriti's family tree on the whiteboard, Sana noted that mahat sat right at the top, like the eldest cousin.

hindi: महावाक्य — उपनिषदों के वे महान वाक्य जो आत्मा और ब्रह्म की एकता बताते हैं
definition: any of the great sayings of the Upanishads that declare the individual self to be identical with Brahman, the ultimate reality
example: Aditi wrote a mahavakya on a sticky note above her desk, hoping it would outlast her usual motivational quotes.

hindi: महाव्रत — मुनियों द्वारा पूर्ण रूप से पाले जाने वाले पाँच महान जैन व्रत
definition: in Jainism, the five great vows of nonviolence, truthfulness, not stealing, chastity and non-possession, kept completely and strictly by monks and nuns
example: Hearing that mahavrata forbids even owning a phone, the teenagers in the class decided they would admire it strictly from a distance.

hindi: महायान — बोधिसत्व आदर्श पर आधारित बौद्ध परंपरा
definition: the broad Buddhist tradition, the Great Vehicle, which stresses compassion for all beings and the ideal of the bodhisattva who seeks awakening for everyone
example: Nikhil explained Mahayana to his roommates as refusing to leave the party until everybody has a lift home.

hindi: धात्री-विधि — प्रश्नों द्वारा दूसरे के मन से ज्ञान को बाहर लाने की कला
definition: Socrates's comparison of his questioning to midwifery, helping another person bring to birth ideas they already carry but cannot yet express
example: Rather than giving answers, the new manager practised maieutics, asking questions until the interns proposed the plan themselves.

hindi: मैमोनिडीज़ विवाद — यहूदी धर्म में दर्शन के स्थान पर मध्ययुगीन बहस
definition: the long medieval dispute within Jewish communities over whether Maimonides' reliance on Aristotelian philosophy strengthened religious faith or endangered it
example: The family group chat reached Maimonidean controversy levels when Grandpa learned his grandson was studying philosophy instead of scripture.

hindi: मुख्य आधार-वाक्य — न्यायवाक्य का वह आधार-वाक्य जिसमें निष्कर्ष का विधेय-पद आता है
definition: the premise of a syllogism that contains the major term, which is the term appearing as the predicate, or described property, of the conclusion
example: Sameer's major premise, that every Friday deserves takeaway, did most of the work in convincing his family to order dinner.

hindi: कल्पना-क्रीड़ा सिद्धांत — कथा और चित्र को बच्चों के खेल जैसी कल्पना की क्रीड़ा मानने का मत
definition: the view that engaging with fiction and pictures is a game of pretending, like children's games, in which the work acts as a prop that prompts people to imagine
example: Explaining the make-believe theory, the teacher held up a banana as a telephone, and the whole classroom instantly played along.

hindi: मक्रोपुलोस दृष्टांत — अंतहीन जीवन अंततः ऊब से असह्य हो जाएगा, यह विचार
definition: Bernard Williams's thought experiment about a woman living for centuries who grows utterly bored, used to argue that an endless immortal life would eventually become unbearable tedium
example: Having rewatched the same sitcom seven times, Tara cited the Makropulos case as proof she would make a terrible immortal.

hindi: पुरुष दृष्टि — स्त्री को पुरुष दर्शक की नज़र से वस्तु की तरह दिखाने की प्रवृत्ति
definition: the tendency of films, adverts and artworks to present women as objects for a presumed male viewer's pleasure rather than as people with their own perspective
example: Scrolling past the perfume advert on the metro, Tara muttered that the male gaze had clearly directed the camera angle.

hindi: मनन — सुने हुए उपदेश पर तर्कपूर्वक विचार करना
definition: the second stage of Vedantic study, reflecting on the teaching already heard and using reasoning to remove every doubt about it
example: On the long bus ride home, Yash practised manana, turning over the lecture until his doubts ran out.

hindi: मनस् — इंद्रियों से आने वाली सूचना को जोड़ने वाला आंतरिक मन
definition: in Indian philosophy, the inner mind or sense organ that gathers and coordinates information from the other senses, attending to one thing at a time
example: Trying to text, cook and listen to a podcast together, Isha concluded her manas really could handle only one channel at a time.

hindi: स्वर्गादेश — चीनी मत कि शासक का अधिकार स्वर्ग से मिलता है और अन्यायी होने पर छिन जाता है
definition: the Chinese doctrine that heaven grants a ruler the right to govern only while he rules justly, and withdraws it when he becomes cruel or careless
example: After the captain lost three matches and blamed everyone else, the team felt he had clearly lost the mandate of heaven.

hindi: प्रकट प्रतिमा — दैनिक अनुभव में दिखने वाला व्यक्तियों और वस्तुओं का जगत
definition: Wilfrid Sellars's term for the everyday picture of the world as people, objects, colours and intentions, as we ordinarily experience it
example: In the manifest image, Ravi's coffee mug was simply blue and warm, whatever the physics textbook said.

hindi: अंतःप्रज्ञा की विविधता — संवेदनाओं का बिखरा हुआ कच्चा समूह
definition: Kant's term for the scattered, unorganised variety of sensations the senses receive, which the mind must gather and combine before anything becomes an object
example: Stepping into the crowded market, Farhan felt the full manifold of intuition hit him at once before his mind sorted it into stalls and vendors.

hindi: बहुगुणित द्रव्यवाद — दिक्-काल बिंदुओं के गणितीय समुच्चय को वास्तविक सत्ता मानने का मत
definition: the view that the bare collection of spacetime points, the mathematical manifold physicists employ, exists as a real entity apart from any fields or matter
example: Manifold substantivalism kept Omkar awake, wondering whether the empty seats in the stadium had points of spacetime waiting patiently in them.

hindi: परिचालनीयता सिद्धांत — कारण को वह मानना जिसे बदलकर हम कार्य को बदल सकें
definition: the family of views holding that causes are handles for control: something counts as a cause when manipulating or changing it would be a means of changing the effect
example: By the manipulability theory, the office thermostat was clearly a cause of the temperature, whatever facilities kept claiming.

hindi: हेरफेर तर्क — गुप्त नियंत्रण से किए गए कर्म को नियतिवाद जैसा बताने वाला तर्क
definition: the argument that a person secretly programmed by scientists is not responsible, and that ordinary determined people are in no relevantly different position
example: The manipulation argument came up when Vikram joked that his mother had engineered his love of cricket since birth.

hindi: अनेक-देव आपत्ति — पास्कल के दाँव के विरुद्ध अनेक संभावित देवताओं की आपत्ति
definition: an objection to Pascal's wager pointing out that there are many possible deities to believe in, so the wager cannot tell anyone which deity deserves their belief
example: When Rahul said he'd back every team to be safe, his friend raised a many gods objection: you can't wear all the jerseys at once.

hindi: बहुमूल्य तर्कशास्त्र — दो से अधिक सत्य-मूल्यों वाला तर्क
definition: any logic that allows more truth values than simply true and false, adding further values such as 'unknown', 'indeterminate' or degrees in between
example: Leena said her exam results called for many-valued logic, since 'passed', 'failed' and 'awaiting revaluation' were all very different moods.

hindi: अनेक-जगत व्याख्या — हर क्वांटम मापन पर सभी संभावित परिणामों का अलग-अलग शाखाओं में घटित होना
definition: the reading of quantum physics on which measurement never collapses anything; instead every possible outcome happens, each in its own branching world
example: Having missed the train by one second, Arnav took comfort in the many-worlds interpretation, where some other Arnav was already sitting at his desk.

hindi: धर्म-क्षय काल — बुद्ध-शिक्षा के पतन का अंतिम युग
definition: the Buddhist belief in a final degenerate period when the teachings decline and ordinary practice can no longer bring awakening without special help
example: Seeing the state of the shared fridge, Ritu declared that the flat had entered mappo and only divine intervention could restore order.

hindi: चिह्न संचरण — यह मत कि वास्तविक कारण-प्रक्रिया अपने ऊपर लगे चिह्न को आगे ले जाती है
definition: Wesley Salmon's test for a genuine causal process: something counts only if a mark or change made to it at one point is carried along to later points
example: Using the mark transmission test, Ayaan showed that a chalk-marked cricket ball keeps its smudge in flight, while its shadow keeps nothing.

hindi: विचारों का बाज़ार — खुली बहस में सच्चे विचार अंततः झूठे पर भारी पड़ते हैं, यह मत
definition: the view, drawn largely from Mill's defence of free speech, that truth emerges best when opinions compete openly and freely
example: The debate club's motto was the marketplace of ideas, though snacks usually won the argument.

hindi: मार्क्सवाद — इतिहास को वर्ग-संघर्ष और आर्थिक संरचना से समझने वाला सिद्धांत
definition: the body of theory, following Karl Marx, that explains history through class struggle and economic structures and predicts capitalism's replacement by communism
example: Applying Marxism to the office, Jatin decided the real struggle was between the people who booked meeting rooms and those who needed them.

hindi: मैरी का कक्ष — रंग-अनुभव से नया ज्ञान मिलता है या नहीं, इस पर जैक्सन की परिकल्पना
definition: Frank Jackson's thought experiment about Mary, a scientist raised in a black-and-white room who knows every physical fact about colour vision, asking whether she learns something new when she first sees colour
example: Seeing mangoes after years of reading about them in textbooks, Ishaan joked he had finally walked out of Mary's room.

hindi: प्रधान तर्क — दियोदोरस का तर्क कि जो कभी घटित न होगा वह संभव ही नहीं
definition: the ancient Greek argument of Diodorus Cronus concluding that nothing is possible which neither is nor ever will be true
example: When Aman said he could have gone to the gym, his sister ran the master argument: if he never goes, it was never possible.

hindi: स्वामी-नैतिकता — शक्तिशालियों की नैतिकता जो बल और गौरव को अच्छा मानती है
definition: Nietzsche's name for the morality of noble, strong people, who call their own pride, strength and confidence good and weakness merely inferior
example: Rahul's master morality lasted until his mother asked who had left dishes in the sink.

hindi: स्वामी-दास द्वंद्व — मान्यता के संघर्ष से आत्मचेतना का विकास
definition: Hegel's story of two consciousnesses struggling for recognition, where the master wins dominance but the slave, through labour, gains deeper self-awareness
example: Watching the senior manager struggle with the new software his intern mastered, Leena saw the master-slave dialectic playing out in real time.

hindi: उपादान कारण — वह पदार्थ जिससे कोई वस्तु बनी होती है
definition: in Aristotle's scheme of four causes, the matter or stuff that a thing is made from, such as the wood of a table or the bronze of a statue
example: The material cause of Arnav's science-fair volcano was mostly baking soda, vinegar and his sister's craft glue.

hindi: वस्तुगत सोपाधिक — 'यदि क तो ख' कथन, जो केवल तब असत्य है जब क सत्य और ख असत्य हो
definition: the logical reading of an 'if-then' statement that counts it false only when the first part is true and the second part false, and true in every other case
example: Kabir argued that 'if pigs fly, I'll wash the dishes' was a true material conditional, which conveniently meant he never had to wash anything.

hindi: भौतिक संघटन — एक ही पदार्थ से बनी दो वस्तुओं, जैसे मूर्ति और मिट्टी, के संबंध की समस्या
definition: the relation between an object and the matter making it up, and the puzzle of whether a statue and its lump of clay are one thing or two
example: Sculpting clay in art class, Naina worried about material constitution: if she squashed her pot, had she destroyed an object or merely changed its shape?

hindi: वस्तुगत आपादन — 'यदि क तो ख' का वह अर्थ जो केवल सत्य-मानों पर टिका हो
definition: the relation expressed by the material conditional, under which a statement implies another unless the first is true and the second false, whatever either statement is about
example: Under material implication, Riya noted, 'if the moon is cheese then Monday is a holiday' comes out true, which her boss refused to accept.

hindi: गणितीय अयथार्थवाद — गणितीय वस्तुओं के मन-निरपेक्ष अस्तित्व को नकारने वाले मतों का समूह
definition: any view that denies numbers and other mathematical objects exist independently of minds, treating mathematics instead as invention, fiction, rules or mental construction
example: Stuck on homework at midnight, Arjun embraced mathematical anti-realism, reasoning that if humans invented algebra they could surely uninvent it.

hindi: गणितीय रचनावाद — किसी गणितीय वस्तु को उसकी रचना-विधि दिखाने पर ही अस्तित्वमान मानने का मत
definition: the view that a mathematical object should count as existing only when a method for actually constructing or finding it has been given, not merely when denying it leads to contradiction
example: Told that a free parking spot surely existed somewhere, Maya replied with mathematical constructivism: show her the spot or it did not count.

hindi: गणितीय अनुभववाद — गणितीय ज्ञान को अनुभव से प्राप्त सामान्यीकरण मानने का मत
definition: the view that mathematical knowledge rests on experience, so arithmetic truths are highly confirmed generalisations from observing and counting physical things
example: Having counted exactly four samosas every time she added a couple to a couple, Diya declared her mathematical empiricism settled.

hindi: गणितीय आगमन — पहले मान और हर अगले चरण के लिए सिद्ध करके सभी संख्याओं हेतु कथन सिद्ध करने की विधि
definition: a deductive method of proof that shows a claim holds for the first number and that whenever it holds for one number it holds for the next
example: Aarav explained mathematical induction with dominoes on the dinner table: knock the first, make sure each hits the next, and they all fall.

hindi: गणितीय अंतर्ज्ञान — अमूर्त गणितीय वस्तुओं को सीधे समझ लेने की मानी गई बौद्धिक क्षमता
definition: a proposed intellectual faculty, sometimes compared to perception, through which mathematicians might directly grasp abstract objects and recognise basic axioms as true
example: Asked how he solved the puzzle without writing anything down, Kabir shrugged and credited mathematical intuition, which his teacher did not accept as working.

hindi: गणितीय प्रकृतिवाद — गणित के प्रश्नों को गणित की अपनी पद्धतियों से ही सुलझाने का मत
definition: the view that questions in mathematics should be answered by mathematics' own methods and standards, without philosophy imposing external demands on working mathematicians
example: When his uncle asked whether numbers really existed, the maths student adopted mathematical naturalism and said that question could wait until after the exam.

hindi: गणितीय प्लेटोवाद — गणितीय वस्तुओं को मन से स्वतंत्र, अमूर्त और वास्तविक मानने का मत
definition: the view that numbers, sets and other mathematical objects really exist as abstract things, outside space and time and independent of every human mind
example: During the maths test, Anaya's mathematical platonism was oddly comforting: the answer to question six existed somewhere, even if she could not find it.

hindi: गणितीय यथार्थवाद — गणितीय कथनों को मन से स्वतंत्र तथ्यों के बारे में सच मानने का मत
definition: the view that mathematical statements are objectively true or false, describing facts about numbers and structures that hold whether or not anyone ever proves them
example: Arguing over an unsolved puzzle in the group chat, Dev defended mathematical realism by insisting the answer was already settled, just rudely hidden from them.

hindi: गणितीय संरचनावाद — गणित को अलग-अलग वस्तुओं के बजाय संरचनाओं और संबंधों का अध्ययन मानने का मत
definition: the view that mathematics studies structures, meaning patterns of relations, rather than individual objects, so a number is simply a position within a structure
example: Explaining that 'second in the queue' means the same thing whoever stands there, Nikhil gave the canteen line a crash course in mathematical structuralism.

hindi: गणितीय उदात्त — असीम विशालता के सामने कल्पना के हार जाने का अनुभव
definition: Kant's term for the overwhelming feeling produced by something so vast, like the starry night, that imagination fails to grasp it while reason still thinks of infinity
example: Reading that the galaxy holds billions of stars, Kavya felt the mathematical sublime and then felt oddly calm about her unanswered emails.

hindi: वर्चस्व का जाल — जाति, लिंग, वर्ग आदि उत्पीड़नों की गुंथी व्यवस्था
definition: Collins's term for the interlocking system in which race, gender, class and other forms of oppression are organized together across institutions and daily life
example: Sketching arrows between school, workplace and police on the whiteboard, the teacher mapped a small matrix of domination for the class.

hindi: मात्स्यन्याय — राजा के बिना बड़ी मछली द्वारा छोटी को निगलने जैसी अराजक दशा
definition: the Indian 'law of the fishes', describing a condition without rulers where the strong devour the weak as large fish swallow small ones
example: With no teacher on duty, the canteen queue descended into matsya nyaya, and the seniors swallowed every last samosa.

hindi: तथ्य-विषय — ऐसे सत्य जो केवल अनुभव और निरीक्षण से जाने जाते हैं
definition: in Hume's account, truths about the actual world, known only through experience, whose denial would be false but still perfectly thinkable
example: Whether the landlord fixed the geyser was one of the matters of fact, Riya said, and the cold shower was her evidence.

hindi: मातुरीदी मत — बुद्धि और शास्त्र के बीच मध्यमार्ग अपनाने वाला कलाम संप्रदाय
definition: a school of Islamic theology that takes a middle path, giving human reason more power to know moral truths than Asharism does while still treating revelation as supreme
example: In the debate club, Rehan kept splitting the difference between both teams, so the moderator labelled his position Maturidism.

hindi: सूत्र-नियम — कर्म के पीछे व्यक्ति का निजी सिद्धांत या इरादा
definition: in Kantian ethics, the personal principle or rule behind an action, stating what you intend to do and your reason for doing it
example: Priya admitted her maxim was 'promise to help move house, then invent a fever', which did not survive the kitchen debate.

hindi: शैली सूत्र — स्पष्ट, संक्षिप्त और सुव्यवस्थित ढंग से बोलने का नियम
definition: Grice's conversational rule that a speaker should be clear, brief and orderly, avoiding obscure or ambiguous phrasing
example: Dad's forty-minute route directions, complete with detours, violated the maxim of manner at every roundabout.

hindi: गुणवत्ता सूत्र — केवल वही कहने का नियम जिसे सत्य माना जाए और जिसका प्रमाण हो
definition: Grice's conversational rule that a speaker should state only what they believe true and have adequate evidence for
example: "This traffic is moving at lightspeed" plainly breaks the maxim of quality, which is how everyone in the car knew it was sarcasm.

hindi: परिमाण सूत्र — न आवश्यकता से कम, न अधिक जानकारी देने का नियम
definition: Grice's conversational rule that a speaker should give as much information as needed for the purpose, but no more than needed
example: Asked if he had finished his homework, Arjun broke the maxim of quantity by saying only "the maths part".

hindi: प्रासंगिकता सूत्र — बातचीत के विषय से संबंधित बात ही कहने का नियम
definition: Grice's conversational rule that a speaker should keep contributions relevant to the topic and purpose of the current exchange
example: When asked about the broken vase, the cat-owner's talk of the weather strained the maxim of relation.

hindi: अधिकतम-न्यूनतम नियम — वह विकल्प चुनना जिसका सबसे बुरा परिणाम बाकी विकल्पों के सबसे बुरे परिणाम से बेहतर हो
definition: a decision rule that tells you to choose the option whose worst possible outcome is better than the worst outcome of every other option
example: Applying the maximin rule to dinner, Kiran picked the dhaba that had never been great but had never once made anyone sick.

hindi: माया — वह शक्ति जिससे एक ब्रह्म अनेक रूपों वाला जगत दिखता है
definition: in Advaita Vedanta, the power of illusion through which the single Brahman appears as a world of many separate, changing things
example: The glossy food photo on the delivery app turned out to be pure maya once the soggy noodles arrived.

hindi: मैक्टैगार्ट का विरोधाभास — समय की वास्तविकता को असिद्ध करने वाला तर्क
definition: McTaggart's argument that time cannot be real, because every event would have to be past, present and future, which are incompatible properties
example: After a meeting that felt past, present and future all at once, Ishaan said the office had finally solved McTaggart's paradox by abolishing time.

hindi: अर्थ-समग्रतावाद — यह मत कि किसी शब्द का अर्थ पूरी भाषा के संबंधों पर निर्भर है
definition: the view that the meaning of any single word or sentence depends on its connections to many other words and beliefs in the whole language, so none has meaning in isolation
example: Explaining 'offside' to his aunt, Rohit discovered meaning holism, since he had to explain the entire game first.

hindi: अर्थ ही प्रयोग है — शब्द का अर्थ उसके व्यवहार में होने वाले प्रयोग से तय होता है, यह सूत्र
definition: the slogan, drawn from Wittgenstein's later work, stating that a word's meaning is found in the ways people actually employ it in their shared activities, rather than in some object it names
example: Hearing her grandfather say 'cool' about the weather and her friends say it about sneakers, Sneha concluded that meaning is use.

hindi: जीवन का अर्थ — जीवन को सार्थक और मूल्यवान बनाने वाली बात का प्रश्न
definition: the question of what, if anything, makes a human life significant, worthwhile or purposeful, beyond merely being pleasant or morally decent
example: The meaning of life came up at the office party somewhere between the cake and the printer jam, and neither was resolved.

hindi: अर्थ अभिधारणा — शब्दों के अर्थ-संबंध तय करने के लिए भाषा में जोड़ा गया नियम
definition: a rule added to a formal language to settle how the meanings of its words connect, such as stating that anything called a bachelor is also unmarried
example: The team's style guide worked like a meaning postulate: anything labelled 'urgent' was automatically also 'due today'.

hindi: अर्थ-परिवर्तिता — सिद्धांत बदलने पर वैज्ञानिक शब्दों के अर्थ बदल जाने का मत
definition: the thesis that scientific terms change meaning when theories change, so words like 'mass' mean something different in different theories
example: Neha blamed meaning variance when her grandfather's idea of a 'quick call' lasted forty minutes and hers lasted four.

hindi: उत्पादन के साधन — भूमि, कारखाने, मशीनें और कच्चा माल जिनसे वस्तुएँ बनती हैं
definition: the land, factories, machines, tools and materials used to produce goods, whose ownership Marxists treat as the basis of class division
example: When the startup founder kept the laptops but let everyone go, Nikhil noted who had really owned the means of production.

hindi: साधन-साध्य सातत्य — साधन और लक्ष्य एक-दूसरे को आकार देते हैं यह मत
definition: Dewey's view that means and goals cannot be sharply separated, since the methods we choose shape the goals we reach and goals are revised as we pursue them
example: Discovering that cramming ruined her love of history, Tanvi grasped the means-ends continuum the hard way.

hindi: मापन समस्या — क्वांटम भौतिकी में यह प्रश्न कि मापने पर अनेक संभावनाएँ एक परिणाम कैसे बनती हैं
definition: the puzzle in quantum physics of why measuring a system yields one definite result, when the theory's equations describe many possible outcomes existing together
example: Checking the fridge to see if leftovers remained, Isha joked about the measurement problem: until she opened it, the biryani both existed and didn't.

hindi: चिकित्सकीय निरर्थकता — ऐसा उपचार जिससे रोगी को वास्तविक लाभ की आशा न हो
definition: the judgement that a treatment has no reasonable chance of benefiting the patient, which may justify doctors declining to provide it
example: The doctor declared medical futility on reviving the hospital's broken vending machine and ordered samosas instead.

hindi: चिकित्सकीय पितृवाद — रोगी की भलाई के नाम पर उसकी इच्छा को दरकिनार कर निर्णय लेना
definition: the practice of doctors overriding or bypassing a patient's own choices for the patient's supposed good, much like a parent deciding for a child
example: When the family doctor decided Uncle Ravi shouldn't see his own test results, his daughter called it medical paternalism and asked for the file.

hindi: महानात्मता — अपनी वास्तविक योग्यता के अनुरूप उच्च सम्मान का उचित दावा
definition: the Greek virtue often translated as greatness of soul, belonging to a person who deserves great honour and rightly claims it, without vanity or false modesty
example: Accepting the award with a simple thank you, neither boasting nor fishing for compliments, Farah showed a touch of megalopsychia.

hindi: माइनॉन्गवाद — अस्तित्वहीन वस्तुओं को भी विचार का वास्तविक विषय मानने का मत
definition: the view, from Alexius Meinong, that we can think and speak truly about objects that do not exist, such as golden mountains or round squares
example: Priya defended her meinongianism in class: the perfect exam she never wrote still had properties, mostly being perfect.

hindi: सुधारवाद — यह मत कि मानवीय प्रयास से संसार बेहतर बनाया जा सकता है
definition: the view, championed by William James and Dewey, that the world is neither doomed nor guaranteed to improve, but can be made better through human effort
example: Siddharth's meliorism kicked in at the messy hostel kitchen: not hopeless, just waiting for a cleaning rota.

hindi: स्मृति-कसौटी — लॉक का मत कि अपने पिछले अनुभवों को भीतर से याद रखना ही व्यक्ति के बने रहने का आधार है
definition: Locke's view that a person at a later time is the same person as someone earlier exactly when they can remember that earlier person's experiences from the inside
example: Kiran used the memory criterion to argue that whoever sang karaoke at the party last night was, legally speaking, a stranger.

hindi: मेनो का विरोधाभास — जो ज्ञात है उसे खोजना व्यर्थ, और अज्ञात को पहचानना असंभव
definition: the puzzle that inquiry seems impossible: if you already know something you need not search, and if you do not, you cannot recognise it when found
example: Scrolling for a song she half remembered, Diya found herself living inside Meno's paradox.

hindi: मानसिक कारणता — मन की अवस्थाओं का शारीरिक घटनाओं को उत्पन्न करना
definition: the idea that mental states such as decisions and desires can cause physical events, such as raising your hand, and the puzzle of how this could work
example: Deciding to hit snooze and watching his thumb obey, Kartik marvelled that mental causation worked perfectly whenever sleep was involved.

hindi: मानसिक विषयवस्तु — किसी विचार या विश्वास में जो प्रस्तुत है, उसका सार
definition: what a thought, belief or perception represents or says about the world, such as the content that the train is late in the belief that the train is late
example: Both friends were anxious, but the mental content differed: one feared the exam, and the other feared the canteen closing early.

hindi: मानसिक भाषा — शब्दों से पहले विचारों की अपनी भीतरी भाषा, ऑकम का मत
definition: Ockham's view that thought itself runs in an inner language of concepts, shared by all people, which spoken languages only express
example: Switching between Hindi and English mid-sentence, Aarav argued his mental language was clearly neither.

hindi: मनोदशा सिद्धांत — कल्याण केवल व्यक्ति के अनुभवों की गुणवत्ता पर निर्भर है
definition: the theory of wellbeing holding that only a person's inner experiences, such as pleasure and enjoyment, make their life better or worse for them
example: If the mental state theory is right, Neel said on the commute, a perfect dream about holidays counts just as much as the actual holiday.

hindi: मानसभाषा — मस्तिष्क की उस काल्पनिक आंतरिक भाषा का नाम जिसमें सोच होती है
definition: the name for the hypothesised inner language of thought, a system of mental symbols in which thinking is carried out before being turned into spoken words
example: Staring blankly at his exam paper, Varun insisted the answer was perfectly clear in mentalese and only the English translation was failing.

hindi: मनोवाद — मन को ही असली यथार्थ मानने का मत
definition: the view that mind is the true reality and that objects exist only as contents of someone's awareness
example: Staring at the unwashed dishes, Kiran wished his mentalism were strong enough to make them vanish by simply ignoring them.

hindi: मात्र-योग विरोधाभास — कम सुखी लोग जोड़ते जाने से अंततः घृणित निष्कर्ष तक पहुँचने का तर्क
definition: Derek Parfit's argument that adding extra people with lives worth living, step by plausible step, seems to lead to the repugnant conclusion
example: Each new cousin invited to the trip seemed harmless, but by the tenth, Karan recognised the mere addition paradox in the cramped minivan.

hindi: मात्र-संरक्षणवाद — यह मत कि ईश्वर केवल वस्तुओं को अस्तित्व में बनाए रखता है और प्रभाव वे स्वयं उत्पन्न करती हैं
definition: the view that the deity merely keeps created things in existence, while those things produce natural effects entirely through causal powers belonging to themselves
example: In the religious studies seminar, Joel compared mere conservationism to a landlord who keeps the lights on but never touches the tenants' cooking.

hindi: केवल साधन — किसी व्यक्ति को उसकी सहमति और लक्ष्यों की उपेक्षा कर मात्र औज़ार बनाना
definition: the Kantian wrong of treating a person merely as a tool for your purposes, ignoring their consent and their own goals as a rational being
example: Using his cousin as a free taxi without asking was, Aditi explained, treating her as a mere means with better air conditioning.

hindi: अंशांशी-सारवाद — किसी वस्तु के अंश उसके लिए अनिवार्य हैं, एक भी बदले तो वस्तु बदल जाती है, यह मत
definition: the view, defended by Chisholm, that every object has its parts essentially, so losing or replacing any single part makes it a different object
example: After a single crumb fell off, Aryan used mereological essentialism to claim the birthday cake was now a different cake, and so technically fair game.

hindi: अंशांशी-शून्यवाद — मूल कणों से बनी कोई संयुक्त वस्तु वास्तव में नहीं होती, यह मत
definition: the view that composite objects, meaning things made of parts, never exist, and that there are only simple particles without parts arranged in various shapes, such as chair-shaped
example: Accused of breaking the chair, Karan pleaded mereological nihilism, since strictly there were only particles arranged chairwise, and now particles arranged otherwise.

hindi: अंशांशी-सर्ववाद — किन्हीं भी वस्तुओं का संग्रह मिलकर एक वस्तु बनाता है, यह मत
definition: the view that any collection of things whatever, however scattered, composes a further single object made of exactly those parts
example: By mereological universalism, Pooja argued, her left shoe and the office printer formed one object, which explained why both were always jammed.

hindi: अंशांशी-मीमांसा — अंश और पूर्ण के संबंधों का दार्शनिक अध्ययन
definition: the philosophical study of parts and wholes, including how parts combine into wholes and when a collection of parts makes up a single object
example: Assembling flat-pack furniture, Ritika discovered practical mereology: seven leftover screws meant the wardrobe was not quite a whole.

hindi: योग्यतातंत्र — पद और पुरस्कार योग्यता और प्रयास के आधार पर देने की व्यवस्था
definition: a social system in which positions, power and rewards are given to people according to talent and effort rather than birth, wealth or connections
example: The office called itself a meritocracy, until the manager's nephew was promoted after a single week.

hindi: मिश्र चेतना — अनेक संस्कृतियों की सीमाओं पर जीने से उपजी चेतना
definition: anzaldúa's term for the flexible, plural awareness developed by people living between cultures, who learn to tolerate contradiction and ambiguity
example: Switching between Spanish at home and English at school, Lucia said mestiza consciousness felt like running three group chats at once.

hindi: अधिनीतिशास्त्र — नैतिक कथनों के अर्थ, सत्यता और आधार की पड़ताल करने वाली शाखा
definition: the branch of philosophy that asks what moral claims mean, whether they can be true, and where moral facts, if there are any, come from
example: Instead of deciding who should wash the dishes, the flatmates drifted into metaethics and started asking what 'should' even means.

hindi: अधिभाषा — वह भाषा जिसमें किसी दूसरी भाषा के बारे में बात की जाती है
definition: a language used to describe, analyse or discuss another language, called the object language, which is needed to state theories of truth and meaning without paradox
example: Explaining French grammar in English, the tutor reminded Aisha that English was serving as the metalanguage for the lesson.

hindi: अधिगणित — स्वयं गणितीय सिद्धांतों और प्रमाणों का गणितीय अध्ययन
definition: the mathematical study of mathematical theories themselves, examining their proofs, consistency and limits by treating formal systems as objects of investigation
example: Instead of solving the homework, Tanya did metamathematics, proving to her tutor that the worksheet's questions contradicted each other.

hindi: परम-आख्यान — अन्य सभी कथाओं को वैध ठहराने वाली सर्वोपरि कथा
definition: an overarching story used to explain and justify all other stories and knowledge, such as history as steady progress, which postmodern thinkers treat with suspicion
example: The startup's pitch deck told a metanarrative in which every problem in human history was waiting for its app.

hindi: पश्चात्ताप-दर्शन — आत्म-समर्पण और पश्चात्ताप से ही दर्शन को नवजीवन देने का मार्ग
definition: Tanabe Hajime's philosophy of repentance, holding that reason must confess its limits and surrender to other-power, a saving force beyond oneself, before real renewal becomes possible
example: After his startup failed, Rohit read about metanoetics and admitted that his plan had needed less confidence and more humility.

hindi: परासत्तामीमांसा — सत्तामीमांसीय प्रश्नों के स्वरूप और अर्थ का अध्ययन
definition: the study of ontology itself, asking what existence questions mean and whether disputes about what exists are genuine
example: Asked whether the sandwich debate was real, Vikram retreated into metaontology and questioned the question.

hindi: तत्त्वमीमांसीय अनिवार्यता — वस्तुओं के स्वरूप से उपजी अनिवार्यता
definition: necessity grounded in the nature of things themselves, covering truths such as water being made of hydrogen and oxygen that hold in every possible world
example: Farah insisted that her cat's hatred of Mondays was not a metaphysical necessity, merely a very stubborn habit.

hindi: तात्त्विक विद्रोह — अन्यायपूर्ण और अर्थहीन मानवीय दशा के विरुद्ध विद्रोह
definition: Camus's term for a person's protest against the whole human condition, rejecting the suffering and meaninglessness of existence while refusing to abandon life
example: Refusing to accept that Mondays exist at all, Pooja declared her snooze button an act of metaphysical rebellion.

hindi: तत्त्वमीमांसा — अस्तित्व और यथार्थ के मूल स्वरूप का अध्ययन
definition: the branch of philosophy that asks what reality is fundamentally like, covering existence, time, cause, identity and mind
example: A late-night argument about whether a rebuilt bicycle is still the same bicycle wandered straight into metaphysics.

hindi: उपस्थिति की तत्त्वमीमांसा — सत्य को पूर्णतः उपस्थित सत्ता मानने की परंपरा
definition: Derrida's term for the long Western tendency to treat reality and meaning as fully present, immediate and self-contained, rather than shaped by absence and difference
example: Insisting he knew exactly what he meant in the moment he said it, Uncle Mohan offered a textbook metaphysics of presence.

hindi: पुनर्जन्म — मृत्यु के बाद आत्मा का नए शरीर में प्रवेश
definition: the doctrine, held by Pythagoras and Plato among others, that after death the soul passes into another body, human or animal
example: Seeing the cat stare judgementally at his cooking, Aman wondered whether metempsychosis had brought back his strict grandmother.

hindi: भागीदारी — वस्तुओं का आदर्श रूपों में सहभाग करना
definition: Plato's idea of participation, the relation by which ordinary physical things share in a Form and so take on its qualities
example: The kids' paper crowns had a touch of methexis about them: each was a little bit royal by sharing in royalty itself.

hindi: साम्य-विधि — अनेक मामलों में साझा एकमात्र परिस्थिति से कारण पहचानने का मिल का नियम
definition: Mill's rule that if several cases of an effect share only one circumstance in common, that circumstance is probably the cause of the effect
example: Applying the method of agreement, Ritu noticed every office headache followed the same stuffy afternoon meeting room.

hindi: प्रामाण्य की विधि — संस्था या शासन द्वारा विश्वास तय करवाने का तरीका
definition: Peirce's name for settling belief by accepting whatever an institution, ruler or powerful group declares, often enforced upon everyone
example: The office used the method of authority on the thermostat debate: the manager said twenty-two degrees, and belief was settled.

hindi: भेद-विधि — एक ही अंतर वाले दो मामलों से कारण पहचानने का मिल का नियम
definition: Mill's rule that if a case where an effect occurs and a case where it does not differ in only one circumstance, that circumstance is part of the cause
example: By the method of difference, Gauri proved the extra chilli was why tonight's curry made everyone cry.

hindi: अवशेष-विधि — ज्ञात कारणों का प्रभाव घटाकर बचे प्रभाव को बची परिस्थिति से जोड़ने का नियम
definition: Mill's method of subtracting the effects already explained by known causes and assigning whatever effect remains to the remaining circumstance
