example: After accounting for rent and groceries, the method of residues pinned the missing money squarely on late-night food deliveries.

hindi: विज्ञान की विधि — बाहरी यथार्थ की जाँच से विश्वास तय करने का तरीका
definition: Peirce's preferred route to settling belief, in which claims are tested against an external reality that anyone investigating carefully would eventually agree upon
example: Instead of arguing about which charger was faster, Leela chose the method of science and timed both with a stopwatch.

hindi: हठ की विधि — विरोधी प्रमाणों से बचकर अपने विश्वास से चिपके रहने का तरीका
definition: Peirce's name for settling belief by stubbornly clinging to whatever you already think and avoiding any evidence or people that might challenge it
example: Muting every group member who disagreed, Vikram practised the method of tenacity on his claim that pineapple belongs on pizza.

hindi: पद्धतिगत समष्टिवाद — सामाजिक घटनाओं को पूरे समाज की संरचनाओं से समझाने का सिद्धांत
definition: the principle that social events should be explained through whole social structures, institutions and forces, rather than through individual people and their intentions
example: Meera took methodological holism to the team meeting, blaming the missed deadline on company structure rather than on anybody's actual laziness.

hindi: पद्धतिगत व्यक्तिवाद — सामाजिक घटनाओं को व्यक्तियों के कर्मों और इरादों से समझाने का सिद्धांत
definition: the principle that social events, such as markets, revolutions or traditions, should be explained through the actions, beliefs and intentions of individual people
example: Asked why the office canteen ran out of chai, Ishaan applied methodological individualism and simply named every colleague who had taken three cups.

hindi: पद्धतिगत संशयवाद — सत्य की खोज के साधन के रूप में व्यवस्थित संदेह
definition: the approach of doubting beliefs systematically, not because knowledge is impossible, but as a method for separating certain beliefs from doubtful ones
example: The science teacher called it methodological skepticism when the class tested whether the 'viral' hack for peeling garlic actually worked.

hindi: पद्धतिशास्त्र — किसी विषय में ज्ञान खोजने की विधियों और नियमों का अध्ययन
definition: the study of the methods and principles used to investigate questions within a subject, asking which ways of finding things out are reliable
example: The class survey only asked her friends, and the teacher's red ink said one word beside it: methodology.

hindi: मध्यमार्ग दोष — दो दावों के बीच का बिंदु ही सत्य मान लेना
definition: the fallacy of assuming that a compromise halfway between two opposing claims must be correct, simply because it sits in the middle
example: One flatmate said the milk was fresh, another said it was spoiled, and the middle ground fallacy produced a very bad chai.

hindi: मध्य प्लेटोवाद — प्लेटो के विचारों का स्टोइक और अरस्तू-विचारों से मिश्रित रूप
definition: the phase of Platonic thought between the doubting later Academy and Plotinus, blending Plato's ideas with those of Aristotle and the Stoics
example: In her essay, Bhavna described Middle Platonism as Plato's ideas after a long group project with every rival school.

hindi: मध्यपद — न्यायवाक्य का वह पद जो दोनों आधार-वाक्यों में आता है पर निष्कर्ष में नहीं
definition: the term that appears in both premises of a syllogism but not in its conclusion, linking the other two terms together
example: In 'all buses are slow, the number nine is a bus, so it is slow', Pooja underlined 'bus' as the middle term doing the linking.

hindi: मध्यम मार्ग — भोगविलास और कठोर तपस्या के बीच का बौद्ध मार्ग
definition: the Buddhist ideal of a path between extremes, avoiding both indulgent pleasure and harsh self-denial, and in philosophy between claiming things exist permanently and claiming nothing exists
example: Choosing one slice of cake instead of none or the whole thing, Anjali called it the middle way.

hindi: मिलेटस संप्रदाय — जगत के एक मूल भौतिक तत्त्व की खोज करने वाले प्रारंभिक यूनानी चिंतक
definition: the earliest Greek philosophers, from the city of Miletus, who searched for a single natural first principle behind everything instead of explaining the world through myths
example: When the science teacher asked what the whole universe was made of, Tanvi answered like the Milesian school: water, obviously, judging by the monsoon.

hindi: मिल की विधियाँ — कारण-संबंध खोजने के लिए जॉन स्टुअर्ट मिल के पाँच आगमनात्मक नियम
definition: five rules of inductive reasoning described by John Stuart Mill for discovering causes by comparing cases where an effect occurs with cases where it does not
example: Using Mill's methods, the hostel wing traced its stomach trouble to the one chutney everyone sick had shared.

hindi: मिलवाद — यह मत कि नाम का पूरा अर्थ केवल उसका धारक है
definition: the view, named after John Stuart Mill, that the entire meaning of a proper name is simply the object it names, with no further descriptive content attached
example: A strict believer in Millianism, Dev insisted his cafe's name meant nothing beyond the cafe, whatever the reviews implied.

hindi: मीमांसा — वेद-वाक्यों और कर्मकांड की व्याख्या करने वाला भारतीय दर्शन
definition: the classical Indian school devoted to interpreting Vedic scripture and ritual duty, which developed careful rules for reading texts and a theory of knowledge
example: Poring over the society rulebook to settle a parking dispute, Arvind approached it with the rigour of Mimamsa.

hindi: अनुकृति — कला और साहित्य में प्रकृति और जीवन का अनुकरण
definition: the imitation or representation of nature and human life in painting, theatre and literature, an idea central to Plato and Aristotle
example: The street play's mimesis was so sharp that the audience recognised their own landlord within seconds.

hindi: न्यूनतम-राज्यवाद — राज्य को केवल सुरक्षा, न्यायालय और पुलिस तक सीमित रखने का मत
definition: the libertarian view that government should exist but be limited to police, courts and national defence, doing nothing beyond protecting rights
example: Dev's minarchism for the hostel committee was simple: the committee guards the gate and settles fights, and stays away from the menu.

hindi: मन-देह समस्या — चेतन मन और भौतिक शरीर के आपसी संबंध का प्रश्न
definition: the puzzle of how the conscious mind, with its thoughts and feelings, relates to the physical body and brain, and whether they are different things
example: Stuck in traffic, Aarav wondered whether his rising anger was just brain chemistry, and realised he had wandered straight into the mind-body problem.

hindi: मन-निरपेक्षता — किसी तथ्य का किसी के सोचने या मानने पर निर्भर न होना
definition: the property of a fact existing or holding true whether or not any mind believes it, feels about it or thinks about it
example: In the philosophy seminar, the class debated the mind-independence of kindness while the heating quietly failed, which was definitely real.

hindi: चित्तसंतान — क्षण-क्षण बदलती चेतना की अटूट धारा जो बौद्ध मत में जीवन को जोड़ती है
definition: the Buddhist idea of a continuous stream of momentary mental events, each causing the next, which links a life together without needing any permanent self
example: Watching thoughts drift past during a long bus ride, Harsh decided his mindstream mostly carried worries about whether he'd locked the door.

hindi: न्यूनतम आत्म — अनुभव के क्षण में स्वतः उपस्थित 'यह मेरा अनुभव है' का मूल बोध
definition: the most basic sense of self, present in each moment of experience as the feeling that this experience is mine, without needing memories or a life story
example: Waking from a nap with no idea what day it was, Gautam still had his minimal self, knowing only that someone here was very hungry.

hindi: न्यूनतम राज्य — केवल अधिकारों की रक्षा तक सीमित, सबसे छोटा उचित राज्य
definition: Nozick's idea of the smallest justified state, limited to protecting people against force, theft and fraud and enforcing their contracts
example: Arguing for a minimal state at dinner, Veer said the family should only guard the fridge, not decide who eats what.

hindi: गौण आधार-वाक्य — न्यायवाक्य का वह आधार-वाक्य जिसमें निष्कर्ष का उद्देश्य-पद आता है
definition: the premise of a syllogism that contains the minor term, which is the term appearing as the subject, or thing described, of the conclusion
example: Everyone agreed tired people make typos; the fight was over Anil's minor premise that the manager was tired after a single coffee.

hindi: प्रकृति का दर्पण — मन को बाहरी यथार्थ का प्रतिबिंब मानने वाला चित्र, जिसकी रॉर्टी ने आलोचना की
definition: Rorty's name for the picture, which he criticised, of the mind or language as a mirror whose knowledge consists in accurately reflecting an outside reality
example: Aryan dropped the mirror of nature when mapping the office: his floor plan needed to help people find desks, not copy every wall.

hindi: दर्पण अवस्था — बालक का अपनी छवि से स्वयं की पहचान बनाना
definition: Lacan's term for the early moment when an infant recognises its reflection and forms a sense of self based on an outside image
example: Watching his toddler niece wave at the mirror, Nikhil explained the mirror stage while she ignored him completely.

hindi: स्त्रीद्वेष — स्त्रियों के प्रति घृणा या उन्हें दंडित करने वाली प्रवृत्ति
definition: hatred or contempt for women, or, on some recent accounts, the social enforcement that punishes women who challenge expected gender roles
example: The comments section under the female referee's video filled with such misogyny that the club disabled replies.

hindi: ईश्वर-द्वेष — ईश्वर के अस्तित्व को मानते हुए उससे घृणा या उसके प्रति गहरा रोष रखना
definition: hatred of a deity, usually a deity believed to exist, often arising from anger about suffering allowed in the world
example: In the novel her book club read, the heroine's misotheism grew with each loss, as she blamed the deity she believed in for every funeral.

hindi: विकृत मान्यता — किसी पहचान को तुच्छ या विकृत रूप में देखा जाना
definition: the harm suffered when a person or group is denied proper recognition, being seen through demeaning images that damage their identity and self-respect
example: Every time the office party skipped her festival but celebrated everyone else's, Farah felt the quiet sting of misrecognition.

hindi: लुप्त नीला रंग — ह्यूम का उदाहरण जहाँ बिना अनुभव के भी एक रंग की कल्पना संभव लगती है
definition: Hume's thought experiment about a person who pictures a shade of blue never actually seen, seeming to break his own copy principle
example: Staring at forty paint samples, Aditi realised she could imagine the missing shade of blue better than choose between those she had.

hindi: सीमित संशयवाद — संशय मानते हुए भी व्यावहारिक विश्वास रखना
definition: Hume's moderate scepticism, which admits that certainty is impossible yet accepts that everyday beliefs guided by habit remain sensible for ordinary living
example: Mitigated scepticism let Rohan doubt the bus timetable in theory while still sprinting to catch the eight fifteen.

hindi: सह-अस्तित्व — दूसरों के साथ होना, मानवीय अस्तित्व का मूल पक्ष
definition: Heidegger's German term for being-with, the feature of human existence by which people always exist alongside and involved with others
example: Even eating alone at his desk, Tushar felt Mitsein in the shared sighs drifting over the cubicle walls.

hindi: मिश्रित दंड-सिद्धांत — दंड का सामान्य उद्देश्य निवारण, पर किसे और कितना दंड मिले यह पात्रता तय करे
definition: the view, defended by Hart, that the general purpose justifying punishment is deterring future crime, while desert, meaning what offenders deserve, decides who may be punished and how severely
example: The school's mixed theory of punishment made detention exist to discourage lateness, yet only the students who were actually late could be given it.

hindi: प्रकारता पतन — वह स्थिति जिसमें सभी सत्य अनिवार्य बन जाते हैं और आकस्मिकता मिट जाती है
definition: an objection that a theory accidentally implies every truth is necessary, erasing the difference between what is contingent and what is necessary
example: When Pallavi's theory implied her burnt toast was necessary, her tutor warned her it had suffered a modal collapse.

hindi: संभाव्यता कल्पनावाद — संभाव्य जगतों को उपयोगी कथा मात्र मानने का मत
definition: the view that talk of possible worlds is a useful fiction, so that claims about possibility are true according to the story rather than true of real worlds
example: Aryan adopted modal fictionalism in the debate, treating possible worlds the way he treated his fantasy football league: useful, not real.

hindi: प्रकारता तर्कशास्त्र — अनिवार्यता और संभावना वाले कथनों का तर्क
definition: the branch of logic that studies reasoning about what is necessary, what is possible and what merely happens to be true, adding special symbols, called operators, for 'necessarily' and 'possibly'
example: When Dev insisted the Wi-Fi could possibly work but necessarily wouldn't during his meeting, his sister called it modal logic with a grudge.

hindi: प्रकार-संकारक — 'अनिवार्यतः' या 'संभवतः' जैसा कथन-परिवर्तक चिह्न
definition: a logical symbol, such as a small square for 'necessarily' or a diamond for 'possibly', placed before a statement to express necessity or possibility
example: Tanvi drew a little square before 'Monday exists' on the whiteboard and told the office that the modal operator meant no weekend would ever last.

hindi: संभाव्यता यथार्थवाद — यह मत कि सभी संभाव्य जगत हमारे जगत जितने ही वास्तविक हैं
definition: the view, defended by David Lewis, that every possible world is a concrete universe just as real as ours, merely located elsewhere and causally isolated from us
example: When Priya lost the lottery again, her brother cited modal realism and assured her that some other version of her was, right now, buying a yacht.

hindi: संभाव्यता संशयवाद — संभावना और अनिवार्यता के ज्ञान पर संदेह करने वाला मत
definition: the view that our knowledge of what is possible or necessary is limited or unreliable, especially for situations distant from everyday experience
example: Faced with claims that he could have become an astronaut, Omar's modal skepticism surfaced: nobody really knows what distant possibilities hold.

hindi: संभाव्यतामूलक संरचनावाद — गणित को संभव संरचनाओं के बारे में कथन मानने का मत
definition: the version of mathematical structuralism holding that mathematics describes what would hold in any possible system with a given pattern, avoiding commitment to structures that actually exist
example: Rahul's modal structuralism let him discuss an infinitely long queue at the ticket counter without claiming such a queue existed, which the cashier appreciated.

hindi: पर्याय — किसी मूल द्रव्य की विशेष, बदलती हुई अवस्था या ढंग
definition: in Descartes and Spinoza, a particular state or modification of a substance that cannot exist on its own, such as a specific thought or a specific shape
example: Explaining Spinoza before an exam, Zoya said her panic was just a mode of her mind, which somehow made the panic worse.

hindi: प्रस्तुति-प्रकार — किसी वस्तु को मन के सामने लाने का विशेष ढंग
definition: in Frege's theory, the particular manner in which a word or phrase presents its object to the mind, which explains how two expressions can pick out one object while presenting it quite differently
example: Karan knew 'Mum' and 'the woman calling seven times' named one person, but the second mode of presentation made him answer much faster.

hindi: उत्पादन-पद्धति — उत्पादक शक्तियों और उत्पादन-संबंधों का ऐतिहासिक रूप से विशिष्ट संयोजन
definition: in Marxist theory, the overall manner in which a society organizes production, combining its forces and relations of production, such as feudalism or capitalism
example: Grandfather's farm ran on a mode of production where payment came in grain, while Aditi's gig work paid by the minute through an application.

hindi: मध्यम समुदायवाद — समुदाय के साथ व्यक्ति के अधिकारों को भी मान्यता देने का मत
definition: Kwame Gyekye's view that community shapes who a person is, while each individual still keeps rights and the capacity to question communal values
example: Abena stayed for every family festival but refused the arranged match, which her professor called moderate communitarianism.

hindi: मध्यम नैतिकतावाद — कुछ कलाकृतियों के नैतिक दोष उनके कलात्मक मूल्य को भी घटाते हैं, यह मत
definition: the view that in some cases a moral flaw in an artwork is also an artistic flaw, because it stops audiences from responding in the manner the work intends
example: Taking moderate moralism, Rhea said the comedy failed as comedy because its cruel jokes left the whole audience wincing instead of laughing.

hindi: मध्यम बुद्धिवाद — यह मत कि बौद्धिक अंतःप्रज्ञा से ज्ञान मिलता है पर वह भूल-रहित नहीं
definition: the view that reason alone can justify some beliefs about the world, while admitting that such rational insight can still sometimes be mistaken
example: Moderate rationalism suited Omkar: he trusted his reasoning, yet still double-checked the train timings.

hindi: मध्यम यथार्थवाद — सामान्य गुण वस्तुओं में वास्तविक हैं पर उनसे अलग नहीं, यह मत
definition: the view, associated with Aquinas, that universals are real features within particular things, which the mind draws out and grasps as general concepts
example: Kavya's moderate realism survived the bakery: every croissant really was flaky, but she never met flakiness floating around by itself.

hindi: ऐनेसिडेमस की दस विधियाँ — सापेक्षता दिखाकर निर्णय-स्थगन की युक्तियाँ
definition: ten ancient sceptical arguments showing that how things appear varies between creatures, people, senses and circumstances, so judgement should be suspended
example: When the office thermostat felt freezing to Sana and stuffy to Vikram, she cited the modes of Aenesidemus and wore a jacket anyway.

hindi: अग्रिप्पा के प्रकार — हर प्रमाण को अनंत, चक्रीय या मनमाना दिखाने वाले पाँच संशयवादी तर्क
definition: five sceptical argument patterns showing that any attempt at proof ends in disagreement, dependence on point of view, an endless chain of reasons, circular reasoning or an arbitrary starting assumption
example: Every time Neha justified her bedtime, her younger brother deployed the modes of Agrippa by asking why, why and why again.

hindi: उदार आधारवाद — मूल विश्वासों को निश्चित नहीं, केवल प्रारंभिक रूप से उचित मानने वाला आधारवाद
definition: the milder form of foundationalism holding that basic beliefs need only some initial justification, not complete certainty, and may later be overturned
example: Trusting the platform display until the announcer said otherwise, Aditya practised modest foundationalism on his morning train.

hindi: विधायक अनुमान — 'यदि क तो ख' और 'क' से 'ख' निकालने का नियम
definition: the inference rule that, given a conditional (an 'if-then' statement) and given that its first part holds, you may validly conclude its second part
example: Priya used modus ponens on her flatmate: if the sink is full you owe me chai, the sink is full, so the kettle is now his problem.

hindi: निषेधक अनुमान — 'यदि क तो ख' और 'ख नहीं' से 'क नहीं' निकालने का नियम
definition: the inference rule that, given a conditional (an 'if-then' statement) and given that its second part is false, you may validly conclude that its first part is false as well
example: If the delivery had arrived the doorbell would have rung, and it never rang, so by modus tollens Aarav stopped refreshing the tracking page.

hindi: मातृ-रक्त — अकान परंपरा में माता से मिला रक्त, जो व्यक्ति को मातृवंश और कुल से जोड़ता है
definition: in Akan thought, the blood a person inherits from their mother, which fixes their clan membership and lineage
example: Explaining mogya to her flatmates, Efua said her clan came through her mother's blood, which is why her aunts had opinions about everything.

hindi: मोहीवाद — सार्वभौमिक समान स्नेह और उपयोगिता पर आधारित चीनी मत
definition: the ancient Chinese school that taught impartial caring for everyone, judged practices by their benefit to people, and opposed costly rituals and aggressive warfare
example: When Rohan proposed cancelling the lavish office party and giving the budget to everyone equally, his manager accused him of Mohism.

hindi: मोज़ी-पंथी परिणामवाद — प्राचीन चीनी चिंतक मोज़ी के अनुयायियों का मत कि आचरण को जनहित पर उसके प्रभाव से आँका जाए
definition: the ancient Chinese ethics of Mozi and his followers, judging practices by whether they benefit the people through order, wealth and population, and urging impartial care for everyone
example: Scrapping the expensive farewell banquet to fund new classroom fans was, the principal said, Mohist consequentialism in action.

hindi: मोक्ष — जन्म-मृत्यु के चक्र से पूर्ण मुक्ति
definition: liberation from the cycle of birth, death and rebirth, reached in Vedanta through knowing the true self and its relation to Brahman
example: Submitting the final assignment of the semester, Kunal announced he had achieved moksha, at least until next term.

hindi: मोलिनावाद — ईश्वर के 'मध्य ज्ञान' से पूर्वज्ञान और स्वतंत्रता को जोड़ने का मत
definition: the theological view that a deity knows what every free person would choose in any possible situation, reconciling divine foreknowledge with human freedom
example: Nisha described Molinism as a heavenly spreadsheet listing what everyone would freely choose under every possible menu.

hindi: मोलिन्यू की समस्या — क्या दृष्टि पाने वाला जन्मांध स्पर्श से जानी आकृतियाँ देखकर पहचान लेगा
definition: the puzzle of whether a person born blind, suddenly given sight, could recognise by looking alone the shapes they knew only by touch
example: Fumbling for the light switch in a dark hotel, Karan found himself thinking about Molyneux's problem in reverse.

hindi: क्षणिकवाद — बौद्ध मत कि हर वस्तु केवल एक क्षण रहती है और तुरंत नष्ट होकर नए क्षण को जन्म देती है
definition: the Buddhist doctrine that every existing thing lasts only a single moment, perishing instantly and being replaced by a similar successor
example: When his phone battery dropped two percent in a minute, Tenzin said it was a lesson in momentariness.

hindi: महत्वपूर्ण विकल्प — अनोखा, भारी और अपरिवर्तनीय चुनाव
definition: William James's term for a choice that is unique, significant and hard to reverse, as opposed to a trivial decision that can easily be retried
example: Picking a lunch spot was hardly a momentous option, though the office treated it like a national election.

hindi: चिदणु — लाइबनिज़ के अनुसार जगत की सरल, अविभाज्य, अनुभव करने वाली मूल इकाई
definition: in Leibniz's philosophy, a simple, indivisible, mind-like unit that perceives the world from its unique viewpoint, and from which all reality is built
example: Every student in the silent exam hall sat like a separate monad, each perceiving the same ticking clock from a private, windowless little world.

hindi: एकत्ववाद — समस्त यथार्थ को एक ही मूल तत्त्व से बना मानने का मत
definition: the view that reality is made of a single basic substance or kind of thing, rather than a pair or many
example: Sunita argued for monism over chai, insisting that her thoughts and the biscuit in her hand were ultimately made of the same stuff.

hindi: भावबोध — क्षणभंगुर वस्तुओं के प्रति कोमल, उदास संवेदना
definition: the Japanese aesthetic feeling of gentle sadness and tenderness toward beautiful things precisely because they pass away and cannot last
example: Scrolling through photos from the last school trip, the whole group chat fell into mono no aware and sent nothing but crying emojis.

hindi: एकदेवपूजा — अन्य देवताओं का अस्तित्व मानते हुए केवल एक देवता की ही उपासना करना
definition: the worship of only one deity while believing that other deities exist, though treating their worship as forbidden or improper
example: Discussing monolatry in class, Dev compared it to loyalty to one cricket team: you admit the other teams exist, you just refuse to cheer for them.

hindi: बल-प्रयोग पर एकाधिकार — वैध हिंसा का अधिकार केवल राज्य के पास होने की वेबर की धारणा
definition: Weber's definition of the state as the body that successfully claims the sole rightful power to use physical force within a territory
example: Mum reminded the squabbling twins that in this house she held the monopoly on violence, and the pillow fight ended at once.

hindi: एकचित्तवाद — सभी मनुष्यों की एक ही साझा बुद्धि है, यह मत
definition: the view, associated with Averroes, that all human beings share one single intellect rather than each person having an intellect of their own
example: When the whole class wrote the same wrong answer, the teacher wondered aloud whether monopsychism had finally been proven.

hindi: एकेश्वरवाद — यह मान्यता कि केवल एक ही ईश्वर है और दूसरा कोई नहीं
definition: the view that exactly one deity exists, a single personal creator, and that no other divine beings are real
example: In the religion class, Meera explained that monotheism allows exactly one deity, which Aarav said sounded like his mother's rule about television remotes.

hindi: दैत्य-निषेध — प्रतिउदाहरण को विकृत कहकर, परिभाषा बदलकर बाहर कर देने की युक्ति
definition: the strategy of protecting a mathematical claim from a counterexample by redefining terms so the troublesome case, dismissed as a monster, no longer counts
example: When a slice of cake broke his rule that dessert is healthy, Nakul practised monster-barring and declared cheesecake technically not a dessert.

hindi: मॉन्टी हॉल समस्या — तीन दरवाज़ों में से चुनाव बदलने से जीत की संभावना बढ़ने की पहेली
definition: a probability puzzle where, after a host opens one losing door of three, switching your choice doubles your chance of winning, which surprises most people
example: Siddharth refused to switch lunch orders until his colleague sketched the Monty Hall problem on a napkin.

hindi: मूर का विरोधाभास — किसी बात को सत्य कहते हुए उस पर अविश्वास जताने की असंगति
definition: the puzzle that sentences like "it is raining but I don't believe it" sound absurd to assert, although both parts could be true together
example: "The exam is tomorrow, but I don't believe it is" was Moore's paradox in its purest student form.

hindi: मूर का प्रमाण — अपने हाथों से बाह्य जगत सिद्ध करने का तर्क
definition: Moore's argument that an external world must exist because he plainly knows he possesses two hands, reversing the sceptic's reasoning by trusting ordinary knowledge instead
example: When his cousin claimed nothing was real, Bhavesh waved both hands in Moore's proof and asked him to pass the chutney.

hindi: मूरीय तथ्य — किसी भी दार्शनिक तर्क से अधिक विश्वसनीय सामान्य तथ्य
definition: an ordinary belief, such as having hands, that seems more certain than any clever philosophical argument claiming to show it false
example: However elegant the argument against motion, Sahil treated catching his bus as a Moorean fact.

hindi: नैतिक निरपेक्षतावाद — यह मत कि कुछ कर्म हर परिस्थिति में अनिवार्य रूप से गलत हैं
definition: the view that some actions are always wrong in every circumstance, whatever the consequences of refusing to perform them
example: Kavya's moral absolutism about spoilers meant nobody in the group chat was allowed to mention the finale, ever.

hindi: नैतिक अयथार्थवाद — मन से स्वतंत्र वस्तुनिष्ठ नैतिक तथ्यों के अस्तित्व को नकारने का मत
definition: the family of views denying that moral facts exist independently of what minds think or feel, treating morality instead as attitudes, conventions or error
example: Arjun's moral anti-realism wobbled the moment his sister ate the last samosa, which suddenly felt objectively wrong.

hindi: नैतिक युक्ति — वस्तुनिष्ठ नैतिकता के आधार के रूप में ईश्वर का तर्क
definition: the argument that objective moral duties and values need a foundation beyond human opinion, and that a deity best provides that foundation
example: In the staffroom, Mr Iyer ran a moral argument over the stolen yoghurt: if stealing is truly wrong, something deeper than the fridge rules must make it so.

hindi: व्यावहारिक निश्चितता — आचरण के लिए पर्याप्त, पर पूर्ण नहीं
definition: a degree of confidence strong enough to guide practical action, although falling short of absolute, logically guaranteed certainty
example: Aisha had moral certainty that her flatmate ate the last samosa, even without the crumbs on his keyboard as proof.

hindi: नैतिक विचारणीयता — किसी प्राणी का ऐसा होना कि उसके हितों पर नैतिक रूप से ध्यान देना आवश्यक हो
definition: the property of being a thing whose interests or welfare must be taken into account when deciding what is morally right, as debated for animals, plants and ecosystems
example: Halfway through weeding the garden, Neel started wondering aloud about the moral considerability of dandelions.

hindi: नैतिक रचनावाद — नैतिक सत्यों को तर्कसंगत प्रक्रिया या सहमति से निर्मित मानने का मत
definition: the view that moral truths are not discovered but constructed, being whatever principles would result from an ideal procedure of rational agreement
example: Moral constructivism shaped the flat meeting: the chore rules were fair because everyone would sign them after calm, informed discussion.

hindi: नैतिक पात्रता — कर्मों या गुणों के आधार पर किसी का उचित पुरस्कार या दंड का अधिकारी होना
definition: the idea that people can deserve particular rewards or penalties because of their actions, effort or character, and that justice should track this
example: The whole class agreed on moral desert: whoever stayed late to finish the project slides deserved the front seat on the trip.

hindi: नैतिक निरुत्तरता — कारण न दे पाने पर भी नैतिक निर्णय पर अडिग रहना
definition: the state of firmly holding a moral judgement while being unable to give any reasons that support it
example: Asked why eating the office goldfish would be wrong if nobody minded, Tara stammered in pure moral dumbfounding.

hindi: नैतिक शिक्षा — चरित्र, विवेक और सही-गलत की समझ विकसित करने वाली शिक्षा
definition: the teaching that aims to develop children's sense of right and wrong, their moral reasoning, and the settled habits that make good conduct likely
example: Sorting out who had eaten the last samosa in the staffroom turned into an impromptu lesson in moral education for the new interns.

hindi: नैतिक संवर्धन — दवा या तकनीक से मनुष्यों की नैतिक प्रवृत्तियाँ सुधारने का प्रस्ताव
definition: the proposal to improve human moral motives, such as empathy and fairness, through drugs, genetic methods or other technology rather than only through education
example: Stuck behind a honking driver, Farah wished moral enhancement came as a nasal spray.

hindi: नैतिक ज्ञानमीमांसा — नैतिक ज्ञान की संभावना, स्रोत और औचित्य का अध्ययन
definition: the study of whether and how people can know moral truths, and what justifies moral beliefs, such as intuition, reasoning or experience
example: Moral epistemology crept into the office debate when Sara asked how anyone could actually know that splitting the bill evenly was fair.

hindi: नैतिक अशुभ — मनुष्य के स्वतंत्र, जान-बूझकर किए गए गलत कर्मों से उपजा दुःख
definition: suffering caused by the deliberate wrongful choices of free persons, such as cruelty, theft and violence
example: Finishing the last slice of cake without asking, Neil committed what his sister called a textbook case of moral evil.

hindi: नैतिक आदर्श-पुरुष — वह व्यक्ति जिसका चरित्र दूसरों के लिए अनुकरणीय उदाहरण हो
definition: a person whose admirable character and conduct serve as a model that others can study, admire and imitate in their own moral lives
example: When the class debated honesty, Kabir nominated his grandmother as a moral exemplar because she once returned a found wallet on foot, three kilometres away.

hindi: नैतिक कल्पनावाद — नैतिक भाषा को उपयोगी कल्पना मानकर उसे जारी रखने का मत
definition: the view that moral claims are strictly false or unfounded, yet worth continuing to speak and think in, like a useful shared story
example: Moral fictionalism suited Ria's household: nobody believed the chore chart was cosmically binding, but pretending kept the kitchen clean.

hindi: नैतिक आधार सिद्धांत — नैतिकता को कई जन्मजात मनोवैज्ञानिक आधारों पर टिका मानने का सिद्धांत
definition: the psychological theory that human morality rests on several inborn intuitive foundations, such as care, fairness, loyalty, authority and purity, weighted differently across cultures
example: Moral foundations theory helped Simran see why her uncle stressed loyalty while her cousin stressed fairness at every family dinner.

hindi: नैतिक प्रकार्यवाद — नैतिक शब्दों का अर्थ सामान्य नैतिक सोच में उनकी भूमिका से तय करने का मत
definition: the view that moral words pick out whatever natural, scientifically studiable properties play the roles assigned to them by the shared, matured principles of everyday moral thinking
example: Explaining moral functionalism to his study group, Neel said 'fair' just names whatever plays the fairness role in everyone's settled rules for splitting pizza.

hindi: नैतिक नियम — विवेक से प्राप्त वह सार्वभौम नियम जो हर विवेकी प्राणी को बाध्य करता है
definition: in Kant, the universal principle of morality that reason gives to every rational being and which binds them whatever their desires
example: Kunal felt the moral law tugging at him when the vending machine dropped two chocolate bars for the price of one.

hindi: नैतिक संयोग — संयोग के कारण किसी के नैतिक मूल्यांकन के बदल जाने की समस्या
definition: the puzzle that people are often praised or blamed for outcomes shaped by chance factors lying beyond their control, even though fairness seems to demand judging only what they control
example: Two friends drove home equally tipsy, but only the one whose route had a jaywalker became the villain of the group chat, a textbook case of moral luck.

hindi: नैतिक प्रकृतिवाद — नैतिक गुणों को प्राकृतिक, विज्ञान-सम्मत गुणों के रूप में समझने का मत
definition: the view that moral properties such as goodness are natural properties, the kind of features that science could in principle study and explain
example: Kavya's moral naturalism made her insist that 'good' for the team simply meant whatever reduced stress and boosted wellbeing on the office survey.

hindi: नैतिक शून्यवाद — किसी भी वस्तुनिष्ठ नैतिक सत्य या कर्तव्य के अस्तित्व को नकारने का मत
definition: the view that nothing is objectively morally right or wrong, because there are no moral facts or genuine moral obligations at all
example: Aditya's moral nihilism lasted until someone jumped the queue at the coffee shop and he found himself outraged.

hindi: नैतिक वस्तुनिष्ठतावाद — सही-गलत को व्यक्ति या समाज की मान्यता से स्वतंत्र मानने का मत
definition: the view that moral truths hold objectively, meaning their truth does not depend on any person's or culture's beliefs, feelings or approval
example: Dev defended moral objectivism at the office canteen, arguing that stealing a colleague's labelled yoghurt stays wrong whatever the break-room culture says.

hindi: नैतिक पात्र — ऐसा प्राणी जिसके साथ सही-गलत व्यवहार हो सकता है, भले वह स्वयं नैतिक निर्णय न ले सके
definition: a being that can be wronged or treated well, and so deserves moral concern, even though it cannot itself make moral choices or bear responsibility
example: Their toddler, Aunt Meena pointed out, is a moral patient rather than a moral agent, so blaming him for the crayon mural makes little sense.

hindi: नैतिक प्रत्यक्ष — परिस्थिति के नैतिक रूप से महत्त्वपूर्ण पहलुओं को सहज रूप से देख पाना
definition: the capacity to notice directly what is morally important in a situation, such as someone's distress, which virtue ethicists treat as part of good character
example: Spotting that the new intern was eating lunch alone, Pooja showed the moral perception her busier colleagues had missed.

hindi: नैतिक बुद्धिवाद — नैतिकता का आधार तर्कबुद्धि में मानने का मत
definition: the view that moral truths are known, and moral motivation is produced, chiefly through reasoning rather than through feelings such as sympathy
example: Invoking moral rationalism, Leela insisted she could prove sharing chores was fair with a spreadsheet, no feelings required.

hindi: नैतिक यथार्थवाद — नैतिक तथ्यों को मनुष्य की राय से स्वतंत्र रूप से वास्तविक मानने का मत
definition: the view that there are real moral facts, and that moral claims are true or false regardless of what anyone happens to believe or feel
example: Aisha's moral realism came out in the group chat: cheating at quiz night was wrong, she insisted, even if every single player voted it fine.

hindi: नैतिक सापेक्षवाद — नैतिक सही-गलत को किसी संस्कृति या समूह के मानदंडों पर निर्भर मानने का मत
definition: the view that moral rightness and wrongness depend on the standards of a particular culture or group, so no single morality holds for everyone
example: Moral relativism came up on the exchange trip when Aryan wondered whether eating with your left hand was wrong everywhere or only at his host's table.

hindi: नैतिक उत्तरदायित्व — अपने कर्मों के लिए प्रशंसा या निंदा का पात्र होने की स्थिति
definition: the condition of being a fitting target of praise, blame, gratitude or resentment for your actions, usually thought to require some control and awareness
example: Priya argued the toddler lacked moral responsibility for the spilled juice, though the family dog seemed less sure.

hindi: नैतिक संत — ऐसा व्यक्ति जिसका हर कर्म अधिकतम नैतिक भलाई की ओर हो
definition: a person whose every action aims to be as morally good as possible, a figure some philosophers argue would be admirable but not an attractive ideal
example: Volunteering every weekend and never watching films, Rahul worried he was becoming a moral saint with nothing to talk about at parties.

hindi: नैतिक इंद्रिय सिद्धांत — सही-गलत को एक आंतरिक नैतिक अनुभूति से पहचानने का मत
definition: the view, held by Shaftesbury and Hutcheson, that humans perceive right and wrong through an inner moral feeling, much like taste perceives flavour
example: Watching a stranger return a lost wallet, Mansi felt an instant glow of approval and credited moral sense theory.

hindi: नैतिक भावुकतावाद — नैतिकता का आधार तर्क नहीं, मनुष्य की भावनाओं और सहानुभूति में मानने का मत
definition: the view that morality is grounded in human feelings such as sympathy and approval, rather than in pure reason alone
example: Moral sentimentalism explained why Dhruv's whole family forgave his little brother the moment he started crying over the broken vase.

hindi: नैतिक स्थिति — किसी प्राणी का ऐसा दर्जा जिससे उसके हितों का नैतिक महत्त्व हो
definition: the standing of a being whose interests matter morally for their own sake, so that others have duties towards it
example: When the class hamster escaped, the search party debated its moral status versus the value of finishing lunch.

hindi: नैतिक अधिसंबद्धता — प्राकृतिक तथ्यों में अंतर के बिना नैतिक अंतर संभव न होने का सिद्धांत
definition: the principle that situations alike in every natural, non-moral feature must also be alike in their moral features, so moral differences always rest on factual differences
example: Leena appealed to moral supervenience when her teacher praised one essay and scolded an identical one: same words, same facts, so same verdict.

hindi: नैतिक जुड़वाँ पृथ्वी — नैतिक प्रकृतिवाद को चुनौती देने वाला एक विचार-प्रयोग
definition: a thought experiment imagining a planet whose people apply moral words to different natural properties, yet seem to genuinely disagree with us, challenging moral naturalism
example: The Moral Twin Earth example gripped the class: if another planet's 'fair' tracked different features, would their quarrels with us still be real disagreements?

hindi: नैतिक सद्गुण — भावनाओं और आचरण की वह उत्कृष्टता जो अभ्यास से बनती है
definition: in Aristotle's ethics, an excellence of character, such as courage or generosity, that concerns feelings and actions and grows through practice and habit
example: Returning extra change had become so natural for Varun that his friends called it a moral virtue rather than a rule he remembered to follow.

hindi: नैतिक मूल्य — सही-गलत के वे सिद्धांत जिनसे व्यक्ति का आचरण चलता है
definition: a person's principles about right and wrong, the standards that guide their choices and their sense of what they owe others
example: Her morals were tested when the vending machine dropped two snacks for the price of one.

hindi: ज्यामितीय पद्धति से — परिभाषाओं और स्वयंसिद्धों से प्रमेय निकालने की शैली
definition: a Latin phrase meaning 'in the geometrical manner', naming the method, used by Spinoza, of setting out philosophy through definitions, axioms and proofs like a geometry textbook
example: Ayaan argued for a later curfew more geometrico, with numbered definitions and proofs, and his parents still said no.

hindi: मॉर्गन का नियम — पशु-व्यवहार की सबसे सरल मानसिक व्याख्या चुनने का सिद्धांत
definition: the principle that animal behaviour should be explained by the simplest mental ability that could produce it, never assuming higher reasoning without need
example: Invoking Morgan's canon, the biology teacher said the dog fetching its leash wanted a walk, not a lecture on freedom.

hindi: प्रेरक कारण — वह कारण जिससे प्रेरित होकर व्यक्ति वास्तव में कर्म करता है
definition: the consideration that actually moves a person to action, as seen from their own viewpoint, whether or not it is a good reason
example: His stated reason for leaving early was a dentist visit, but his motivating reason was clearly the cricket final.

hindi: प्रेरणात्मक बाह्यतावाद — नैतिक निर्णय और कर्म की प्रेरणा के बीच कोई अनिवार्य संबंध नहीं, यह मत
definition: the view that a person can sincerely judge an action right yet feel no motivation to perform it, since motivation comes from separate desires
example: Motivational externalism explained Vivek perfectly: he sincerely believed he should answer emails promptly and felt absolutely no pull to do so.

hindi: प्रेरणात्मक आंतरिकतावाद — सच्चा नैतिक निर्णय अपने साथ कर्म की प्रेरणा भी लाता है, यह मत
definition: the view that sincerely judging an action right necessarily brings at least some motivation to perform it
example: Motivational internalism made Ritu doubt her flatmate's claim that recycling mattered, given the pizza boxes still stacked by the bin.

hindi: गतिक साभिप्रायता — शरीर की बिना सोचे लक्ष्य की ओर उन्मुख गतिविधि
definition: Merleau-Ponty's term for the body's skilled, unreflective directedness toward things, like reaching for a light switch without thinking about where it is
example: In the dark kitchen, Vikram's motor intentionality found the kettle perfectly while his conscious brain was still asleep.

hindi: चल-प्रकाश सिद्धांत — सभी क्षणों को वास्तविक, पर वर्तमान को उन पर सरकती रोशनी मानने का मत
definition: the view that all moments exist, as eternalism holds, but only one moment at a time is illuminated as present, with the spotlight sliding steadily toward the future
example: During the slow queue at the passport office, Meera pictured the moving spotlight theory and wished the beam would hurry past her turn.

hindi: अभाव — 'नहीं' या 'कुछ नहीं', प्रसिद्ध ध्यान-पहेली का उत्तर
definition: the Japanese word meaning 'nothing' or 'without', famous as a teacher's answer to whether a puppy has Buddha-nature, the capacity for awakening, used to shatter either-or thinking
example: When his sister asked whether he had finished or even started his homework, Dev replied only 'mu', which ended the conversation but not the homework.

hindi: अनित्यता — सब वस्तुओं के क्षणभंगुर और परिवर्तनशील होने का बोध
definition: the Japanese Buddhist sense of impermanence, the recognition that all things change and pass away, often colouring poetry with gentle sadness
example: Watching the last samosa vanish from the office pantry, Karan sighed about mujo and the passing nature of all snacks.

hindi: बहुसंस्कृतिवाद — एक देश में अनेक संस्कृतियों के समान और शांतिपूर्ण सहअस्तित्व का मत
definition: the view that many different cultures can live together peacefully and on equal terms within a single country, each keeping its own traditions
example: The office potluck, with biryani beside sushi beside pierogi, was multiculturalism served on paper plates.

hindi: बहु-साकारता — एक ही मानसिक अवस्था के अनेक भौतिक आधारों में संभव होने का सिद्धांत
definition: the thesis that one and the same mental state, such as pain, could be produced by very different physical systems, like human brains, octopus nervous systems or silicon circuits
example: Pointing at the octopus video in the group chat, Sana argued that multiple realizability means it can feel pain without owning a single human neuron.

hindi: बहुस्थिरता — एक ही तकनीक के भिन्न संदर्भों में अनेक अर्थ और प्रयोग
definition: Ihde's term for the idea that a single technology can take on several different meanings and functions, depending on the culture and context adopting it
example: The office stapler served as paperweight, doorstop and lunch-queue weapon, a fine demonstration of multistability.

hindi: मुमुक्षुत्व — मोक्ष पाने की तीव्र इच्छा
definition: an intense longing for liberation, the burning desire to be freed from the cycle of rebirth through knowledge of the self
example: By the fourth hour of the meeting, the whole team was showing clear signs of mumukshutva.

hindi: द्वार पर हत्यारा — झूठ बोलने की नैतिकता पर कांट से जुड़ी परिकल्पना
definition: a thought experiment, linked to Kant's ethics, asking whether you may deceive a killer who knocks and asks where your friend is hiding, testing whether the duty of honesty admits exceptions
example: Nisha said she would happily lie to a murderer at the door, but still refused to tell her mother who ate the last laddoo.

hindi: अचित्तता — विचारों में उलझे बिना सहज, मुक्त मन की अवस्था
definition: the state of no-mind, where awareness acts freely and spontaneously without being blocked by fear, planning or self-conscious thinking
example: In the final over, Rohan batted in pure mushin, hitting sixes without thinking, and then could not explain a single shot afterwards.

hindi: मूसार — आत्मसंयम और चरित्र-निर्माण पर केंद्रित यहूदी नैतिक आंदोलन
definition: a Jewish ethical movement focused on the careful daily practice of improving character traits such as patience, humility and honesty
example: Keeping a journal of every time she lost her temper in traffic, Ruth said her commute had become a Mussar exercise.

hindi: मुतज़िला — ईश्वरीय न्याय और मानवीय स्वतंत्र इच्छा पर बल देने वाला बुद्धिवादी कलाम संप्रदाय
definition: an early school of Islamic rational theology which held that reason can know right from wrong, that the deity is perfectly just, and that humans freely choose their actions
example: When Samir insisted that cheating is wrong whether or not any rulebook forbids it, his teacher said he sounded like a member of the Mutazila.

hindi: पारस्परिकतावाद — स्वैच्छिक आदान-प्रदान और सहकारी बैंकिंग पर आधारित अराजकतावादी मत
definition: the anarchist theory that society should operate through fair voluntary exchange between workers, cooperatives and mutual banks without government
example: Swapping tutoring for home-cooked meals, Asha and her neighbour were practising mutualism without ever reading about it.

hindi: चेतना-अज्ञेयवाद — मानव बुद्धि चेतना की गुत्थी कभी नहीं सुलझा सकती, ऐसा मत
definition: the view that the human mind may simply lack the mental equipment ever to understand how consciousness arises from the brain
example: After a two-hour seminar ended with more questions than answers, Harsh announced his conversion to mysterianism and went for samosas.

hindi: भयावह रहस्य — पवित्र के सामने काँपा देने वाली विस्मय-भावना
definition: a Latin phrase meaning 'awe-inspiring mystery', naming the overwhelming feeling of reverent wonder and trembling a person may feel before the holy
example: Standing before the towering temple gates, Neel felt a small mysterium tremendum, then remembered he had left his shoes outside.

hindi: रहस्यवाद — परम सत्य या ईश्वर का सीधा आंतरिक अनुभव पाने की साधना और मत
definition: the practice or belief that ultimate reality or the divine can be known through direct inner experience, beyond ordinary thought and senses
example: After ten minutes of meditation on the metro, Aarav claimed a brush with mysticism, though it may have been the air conditioning.

hindi: प्रदत्त का मिथक — बिना अवधारणा के प्राप्त अनुभव को ज्ञान की नींव मानने की आलोचना
definition: Wilfrid Sellars's criticism of the idea that unprocessed sensory experience, received without any concepts, could by itself justify beliefs and serve as the foundation of knowledge
example: When Karthik claimed he just knew the milk was sour from pure experience, his sister cited the myth of the given and asked how he knew what sour meant.

hindi: म्युनख़हाउज़न त्रिविकल्प — हर औचित्य के तीन असंतोषजनक अंत
definition: the sceptical argument that every attempt to justify a belief finishes in an endless chain of reasons, circular reasoning, or a dogmatic halt at some unproven starting belief
example: Debating homework rules, Kabir invoked the Münchhausen trilemma, arguing his teacher's reasons would eventually circle back to because school says so.

hindi: नागेल का चमगादड़ — दूसरे प्राणी के अनुभव को भीतर से न जान पाने पर परिकल्पना
definition: Thomas Nagel's example asking what it is like to be a flying mammal that senses the world through echoes, used to argue that science cannot capture a creature's inner point of view
example: Watching her cat stare at an empty wall for ten minutes, Sana decided pets were her personal version of Nagel's bat.

hindi: सरल मिथ्याकरणवाद — एक विरोधी प्रेक्षण से ही सिद्धांत को त्याग देने का मत
definition: Lakatos's label for the simple view that a theory must be abandoned outright the moment a single observation conflicts with it
example: Rohan's naive falsificationism made him quit the running plan after one slow Tuesday, which even his coach found hasty.

hindi: सरल यथार्थवाद — वस्तुएँ ठीक वैसी ही हैं जैसी दिखती हैं, यह मानने वाला मत
definition: the everyday view that perception shows us physical objects directly and just as they really are, with their colours, sounds and textures belonging to the objects themselves
example: Kiran's naive realism survived until the dress in the group chat looked blue to her and gold to everyone else.

hindi: कथात्मक पहचान — अपनी जीवन-कथा के माध्यम से बनने वाली व्यक्तिगत पहचान
definition: the view, developed by Ricoeur, that a person's identity is formed through the stories they tell about their life, linking past, present and future
example: At the reunion, Swati noticed her narrative identity had quietly edited out the entire embarrassing college band phase.

hindi: आख्यानात्मक आत्म — अपनी जीवन-कथा कहने और समझने से गढ़ा गया स्व
definition: Dennett's view that the self is the central character in the stories a person's mind keeps telling, useful for making sense of behaviour, much like a centre of gravity, though not a physical thing inside the head
example: Updating her college application essay, Riya realised her narrative self had quietly edited out every failed baking experiment.

hindi: आख्यानात्मकता सिद्धांत — यह दावा कि मनुष्य अपने जीवन को कथा के रूप में जीता है या उसे ऐसे जीना चाहिए
definition: the claim that people do, or ought to, experience and understand their lives as a story, which critics reject because many people live well without any life story
example: Scrolling through her chaotic photo gallery, Sara concluded that the narrativity thesis had never met her camera roll.

hindi: संकीर्ण विषयवस्तु — केवल व्यक्ति के भीतरी तत्त्वों से तय होने वाली मानसिक विषयवस्तु
definition: the part of a thought's content fixed entirely by what is inside the thinker's head, so that two internally identical people share it regardless of their surroundings
example: Rashmi and her doppelganger in the thought experiment shared narrow content, she decided, since both of them silently resented the office playlist.

hindi: नास्तिक — वेदों की प्रामाणिकता न मानने वाले भारतीय दर्शन
definition: a label for Indian philosophical schools, such as Jainism, Buddhism and Charvaka, that reject the authority of the Vedas, the ancient sacred Hindu scriptures
example: In the textbook chart, Jainism and Charvaka sat together under nastika, which Pallavi noted made them unlikely study partners.

hindi: राष्ट्रवाद — राष्ट्र के प्रति निष्ठा और उसके स्वशासन को सर्वोच्च मानने वाली विचारधारा
definition: the political outlook that a nation, a people sharing culture, history or language, should govern itself and deserves special loyalty
example: During the cricket final, even Aditi, who ignored sports, got swept up in nationalism and painted a flag on her cheek.

hindi: सहजवाद — यह मत कि मन की कुछ क्षमताएँ या ज्ञान जन्मजात होते हैं
definition: the view that certain mental abilities, concepts or knowledge are inborn and built into the mind, rather than learned from experience
example: In psychology class, Vikram defended nativism by noting that nobody teaches babies to panic at loud noises.

hindi: सृजनशील प्रकृति — प्रकृति का वह पक्ष जो स्वयं से सब कुछ उत्पन्न करता है
definition: a Latin phrase meaning 'nature naturing', used by Spinoza for nature considered as the active, self-causing source that produces everything
example: Seeing seedlings burst through the balcony pot overnight, Aditi pointed and announced natura naturans hard at work.

hindi: सृजित प्रकृति — प्रकृति का वह पक्ष जो उत्पन्न वस्तुओं के रूप में दिखता है
definition: a Latin phrase meaning 'nature natured', used by Spinoza for nature considered as the collection of produced things that follow from the active source
example: Looking at the finished vegetable garden, Nikhil said the seedlings were natura naturata now, and weeding was his problem.

hindi: स्वाभाविक दृष्टि — संसार को बिना प्रश्न किए वास्तविक मान लेने की रोज़मर्रा की मनोवृत्ति
definition: the everyday outlook, in Husserl's phenomenology, that simply takes the world and its objects for granted as real, without questioning or examining that assumption
example: In the natural attitude, Rohan never doubted his fridge existed; he only doubted whether his roommate had left any milk inside.

hindi: प्राकृतिक निगमन — सरल अनुमान-नियमों से चरणबद्ध उपपत्ति रचने की तर्क-पद्धति
definition: a system of formal proof that derives conclusions step by step using simple rules of inference, each matching an ordinary pattern of reasoning
example: Their logic tutor made natural deduction feel like cooking: follow each rule of inference in order and the conclusion comes out of the oven.

hindi: न्याय का स्वाभाविक कर्तव्य — न्यायपूर्ण संस्थाओं का समर्थन करने का बिना सहमति वाला कर्तव्य
definition: Rawls's idea that everyone has a duty, without any promise or consent, to support and comply with fair and just institutions that apply to them
example: Nobody asked Omar to recycle, but he sorted the bins anyway, citing a natural duty of justice toward the building's rota.

hindi: प्राकृतिक अशुभ — भूकंप, रोग आदि प्राकृतिक कारणों से होने वाला दुःख
definition: suffering caused by natural processes such as earthquakes, floods and disease rather than by anyone's deliberate choices
example: Discussing the cyclone in class, Aditi pointed out that natural evil is harder to explain away, since nobody chose to cause it.

hindi: प्राकृतिक शुभता — यह मत कि मानवीय सद्गुण जीवों की स्वाभाविक श्रेष्ठता जैसा ही है
definition: the view, defended by Philippa Foot, that human virtue is a kind of natural excellence, judged much like a healthy plant or animal is judged against its species
example: Comparing her sulky teenage son to a wilting houseplant, Kavita invoked natural goodness and threatened more sunlight.

hindi: प्राकृतिक वर्ग — ऐसा वर्गीकरण जो प्रकृति की वास्तविक बनावट से मेल खाता है
definition: a grouping of things, such as gold, water or tigers, that reflects real divisions in nature rather than merely human interests or conventions
example: Pooja argued that 'weeds' could never be a natural kind, since it just meant plants her father disliked in his garden.

hindi: प्राकृतिक वर्ग-पद — जल, सोना जैसे प्रकृति-निर्धारित वर्गों के नाम
definition: a word such as 'water', 'gold' or 'tiger' that names a kind of thing found in nature, whose membership many philosophers think depends on hidden structure rather than appearance
example: Mira argued that 'jam' is no natural kind term, since the stuff in her fridge was clearly whatever her flatmate felt like making.

hindi: प्राकृतिक विधि — नैतिकता और तर्क पर आधारित ऊँचा नियम जिससे मानवीय क़ानून की वैधता परखी जाती है
definition: the view that there are moral principles built into human nature and knowable by reason, and that human laws gain their authority from agreeing with these deeper principles
example: Arguing over the landlord's eviction notice, Ishaan appealed to natural law, saying that a rule leaving a family homeless in winter could not bind anyone in conscience.

hindi: सहज प्रकाश — देकार्त के अनुसार बुद्धि की वह क्षमता जिससे सत्य स्पष्ट दिखता है
definition: in Descartes' thought, the mind's inborn power of reason that reveals certain truths as plainly and reliably as daylight reveals objects
example: Stuck on a sudoku, Farhan waited for the natural light of reason; the actual lamp would also have helped.

hindi: प्राकृतिक अर्थ — कारण-कार्य संबंध से उत्पन्न संकेत, जैसे धुआँ आग का
definition: Grice's term for the kind of meaning a sign has through a causal link, without anyone intending it, as smoke means fire
example: Those spots have natural meaning, the doctor told Kabir: chickenpox, not a fashion statement.

hindi: प्राकृतिक अनिवार्यता — प्राकृतिक जगत की प्रकृति और नियमों से उत्पन्न अनिवार्यता
definition: the necessity with which things must happen given the natures and laws of the natural world, stronger than chance but weaker than the necessity of logic
example: Leela told her impatient brother that water boiling at sea level was natural necessity, and staring at the pot would not speed it.

hindi: स्वाभाविक सत्तामीमांसीय दृष्टि — विज्ञान के परिणामों को बिना दार्शनिक व्याख्या के स्वीकारना
definition: Arthur Fine's stance of accepting scientific results at face value, while declining both the realist reading that they describe hidden reality and the antirealist reading that they are merely useful tools
example: Arjun adopted the natural ontological attitude toward vaccines: trust the results, skip the philosophy seminar, book the appointment.

hindi: प्राकृतिक स्थान — वह स्थान जिसकी ओर हर तत्व स्वभावतः गति करता है
definition: in Aristotle's physics, the proper location each element naturally moves toward, with earth sinking downward and fire rising upward
example: Watching every dropped spoon slide under the fridge, Asha decided its natural place was clearly among the dust.

hindi: प्राकृतिक अधिकार — वे अधिकार जो मनुष्य को जन्म से ही प्राप्त माने जाते हैं, किसी सरकार की देन नहीं
definition: rights that people are thought to possess simply by being human, before and independent of any government, statute or custom that might grant them
example: Arjun argued that sleeping in on Sunday was among his natural rights, a claim his mother's vacuum cleaner firmly rejected.

hindi: प्राकृतिक दासता — कुछ लोगों को स्वभाव से दास मानने वाला अरस्तू का विवादित सिद्धांत
definition: Aristotle's much-criticised view that some people are by nature suited to be ruled as slaves, a claim today widely rejected as a justification of injustice
example: In history class, the students traced how the doctrine of natural slavery was used to defend cruelty, and why later thinkers tore it apart.

hindi: प्रकृतिवाद — जगत को अलौकिक शक्तियों के बिना, प्राकृतिक कारणों से समझने का मत
definition: the view that everything can be explained by natural causes and scientific study, without appeal to spirits or supernatural powers
example: When the lights flickered, Aisha's naturalism sent her straight to the fuse box while her cousin was still listening for footsteps.

hindi: प्रकृतिवादी दोष — 'शुभ' को किसी प्राकृतिक गुण के समान परिभाषित करने की कथित भूल
definition: the alleged mistake, named by Moore, of defining goodness as identical to some natural property such as pleasure, usefulness or being desired
example: When Omar said good simply meant whatever gave him pleasure, his flatmate accused him of the naturalistic fallacy and hid the chocolate.

hindi: प्रकृति-दर्शन — प्रकृति को सजीव, विकसित होती चेतना मानने वाला दर्शन
definition: the German Romantic philosophy of nature, especially Schelling's, which treated nature as a living, developing whole in which spirit gradually awakens
example: Hiking past the waterfall, Ira joked that Naturphilosophie made sense, since the river seemed to have more spirit than most Monday meetings.

hindi: नय — किसी वस्तु को एक विशेष दृष्टिकोण से देखने का ढंग
definition: in Jain philosophy, a single partial viewpoint or standpoint from which something is judged, true within its limits but never the complete truth
example: From the naya of the person paying the bill, Aman argued, the restaurant was clearly overpriced.

hindi: नयवाद — वस्तु को आंशिक दृष्टिकोणों से जानने का जैन सिद्धांत
definition: the Jain doctrine of viewpoints: the view that every judgement about reality is made from a partial standpoint and captures only one aspect of the whole truth
example: Settling the office dispute over the thermostat, the manager applied nayavada and admitted that the window desk and the server corner simply lived in different climates.

hindi: अनुभवसिद्ध अनिवार्य सत्य — ऐसा अनिवार्य सत्य जिसे केवल अनुभव से जाना जा सके
definition: a truth that holds necessarily yet can only be discovered through experience or investigation, such as water being hydrogen and oxygen, a category Kripke defended
example: The chemistry teacher called water's formula a necessary a posteriori truth, which did not stop half the class guessing it wrong.

hindi: अनिवार्य सत्ता — ऐसी सत्ता जिसका न होना असंभव हो
definition: a being whose existence does not depend on anything else and which could not possibly have failed to exist, often identified with a deity in arguments about existence
example: In the philosophy club, Zoya joked that coffee was her necessary being, since a morning without it seemed simply impossible.

hindi: अनिवार्य संबंध — कारण और कार्य को बाँधने वाली वह कथित अनिवार्यता जिसे ह्यूम ने अनुभव में अदृश्य माना
definition: the supposed binding force by which a cause must produce its effect, which Hume argued we never actually observe and only project onto events from habit
example: Tanvi stared at the vending machine for the necessary connection between her coin and the chips, but saw only a coin drop and chips fall.

hindi: वाजिबुल-वुजूद — वह सत्ता जिसका न होना असंभव है
definition: in Avicenna's philosophy, a being whose existence cannot fail because it depends on nothing else, and on which every contingent thing, one that merely happens to exist, ultimately rests
example: When the coffee machine broke, the whole office stalled, and Dev declared it their necessary existent: everything else depended on it.

hindi: अनिवार्य सत्य — वह कथन जो किसी भी संभाव्य स्थिति में असत्य न हो सके
definition: a statement that is true and could not possibly have been false, holding in every possible world, such as the truths of mathematics and logic
example: Riya announced that 'all bachelors are unmarried' is a necessary truth, then admitted her cousin's wedding plans had no bearing on it.

hindi: आवश्यकतावाद — यह मत कि प्रकृति के नियम सार्वभौम गुणों के बीच वास्तविक अनिवार्य संबंध हैं
definition: the view that laws of nature are real necessitating relations between universals, meaning features shared by many things, which force regular patterns rather than summarising them
example: Kabir's necessitarianism annoyed his flatmates, who wanted to hear that the dishes piled up by accident, not by necessity.

hindi: परिणाम-संबंध की अनिवार्यता — निष्कर्ष के अनुसरण की अनिवार्यता, स्वयं निष्कर्ष की नहीं
definition: 'necessity of the consequence': the medieval distinction that a conclusion necessarily follows from premises without the conclusion itself being necessary
example: Ritu explained necessitas consequentiae to her flatmate: if he ate the last samosa it necessarily follows the plate is empty, yet his eating it was never necessary.

hindi: अनिवार्यीकरण नियम — सिद्ध प्रमेय को अनिवार्य सत्य घोषित करने का नियम
definition: a rule of modal logic stating that whatever can be proved as a theorem of the system, with no extra assumptions, may also be declared necessarily true
example: After proving in class that every triangle has three sides, Aarav invoked the necessitation rule and declared it true in every possible universe.

hindi: अनिवार्यता — जो किसी भी स्थिति में अन्यथा न हो सके, उसका गुण
definition: the property of a statement or state of affairs that could not have been otherwise, holding true in every possible world without exception
example: In maths class, Isha argued that two plus two making four was a necessity, while the teacher assigning homework on Friday merely felt like one.

hindi: निषेध — किसी कथन को उलटकर उसका सत्य-मान बदल देने वाली क्रिया
definition: the logical operation that reverses a statement, producing a statement that is true exactly when the original statement is false
example: Ishaan's mother pointed out that the negation of 'I cleaned my room' is not 'I cleaned half my room'.

hindi: अभावात्मक अनीश्वरवाद — ईश्वर में विश्वास का अभाव, बिना यह दावा किए कि ईश्वर नहीं है
definition: the position of simply lacking belief in any deity, without also asserting the claim that no deity exists
example: Asked in the group chat whether she believed in a deity, Kavya described her negative atheism: no belief either way, and no claim to settle the question.

hindi: निषेधात्मक गुण — ईश्वर को 'क्या नहीं है' के द्वारा ही वर्णित करने का सिद्धांत
definition: Maimonides' doctrine that humans can only describe the deity by saying what it is not, since any positive description would wrongly limit the divine
example: Unable to explain her new job, Rachel used negative attributes: not sales, not coding, not quite management.

hindi: नकारात्मक द्वंद्वात्मकता — किसी अंतिम समन्वय तक न पहुँचने वाला, सदा आलोचनात्मक चिंतन
definition: Adorno's form of dialectical thinking that refuses a final reconciliation, stressing what concepts leave out rather than resolving tensions into a neat whole
example: Asked to sum up the debate in one line, Leela practised negative dialectics and explained why no single line would ever do.

hindi: निषेधात्मक शिक्षा — बाल्यावस्था में उपदेश के बजाय बच्चे को बुराई और भ्रम से बचाए रखना
definition: Rousseau's view that early education should mainly protect children from vice and error, letting their nature develop freely rather than filling them with lessons
example: Letting her toddler discover mud, puddles and gravity alone, Sana claimed she was practising negative education, not simply finishing her coffee.

hindi: नकारात्मक स्वतंत्रता — दूसरों के हस्तक्षेप से मुक्त रहने के अर्थ में स्वतंत्रता
definition: freedom understood as the absence of interference, meaning nobody, including government, stops you from doing what you choose
example: Riya claimed negative liberty over her bedroom: nobody could stop her from leaving the laundry on the chair.

hindi: नकारात्मक उत्तरदायित्व — जो होने दिया गया, उसके लिए भी उतना ही उत्तरदायी होने का विचार
definition: the consequentialist idea, named by Bernard Williams, that people are just as responsible for outcomes they fail to prevent as for outcomes they directly cause
example: Watching his flatmate leave the stove burning, Siddharth felt the full weight of negative responsibility and turned off the knob.

hindi: नकारात्मक प्रतिकारवाद — दोषी न होने पर दंड कभी नहीं, पर दोषी को दंड देना अनिवार्य नहीं
definition: the view that desert, meaning what someone deserves, limits punishment rather than demanding it, so the innocent must never be punished and the guilty may receive no more than they deserve, though punishing them is optional
example: The teacher practised negative retributivism, refusing to punish the whole class for one student's prank while happily letting the culprit off with a warning.

hindi: नकारात्मक अधिकार — दूसरों के हस्तक्षेप से बचे रहने के अधिकार, जैसे हिंसा से मुक्ति
definition: rights that require others only to refrain from interfering, such as rights not to be harmed, silenced, robbed or imprisoned without reason
example: Nikhil explained that negative rights meant his roommate did not have to cook for him, merely stop eating his leftovers.

hindi: निषेधात्मक धर्मशास्त्र — ईश्वर का वर्णन केवल निषेधों से करने की पद्धति
definition: the approach that speaks about the deity only by denying qualities of it, holding that positive human words always fall short of the divine
example: Describing the new café by listing everything it lacked, Mira admitted her review read like negative theology.

hindi: नकारात्मक उपयोगितावाद — सुख बढ़ाने से अधिक दुःख घटाने को प्राथमिकता देने का मत
definition: the form of utilitarianism holding that reducing suffering matters more than increasing happiness, so right actions minimize total pain and misery
example: Rohan's negative utilitarianism made him skip the party and drive his sick flatmate to the clinic instead.

hindi: नेग्रीट्यूड — अश्वेत अस्मिता और अफ़्रीकी संस्कृति के आत्मगौरव का दार्शनिक-साहित्यिक आंदोलन
definition: the movement, led by thinkers such as Senghor and Cesaire, that affirmed the value of Black identity and African culture against colonial contempt
example: Reading her essays on African heritage aloud, Awa told the class that Negritude was pride written down.

hindi: बुद्धानुस्मृति — अमिदा बुद्ध के नाम का श्रद्धापूर्वक स्मरण और जप
definition: the practice of reciting Amida Buddha's name with trust and gratitude, central to Pure Land devotion as a path toward rebirth and awakening
example: Stuck in the exam hall, Sneha whispered her formulas like a nembutsu, trusting that sincere repetition would somehow carry her through.

hindi: नव-अरस्तूवाद — आधुनिक नीतिशास्त्र में अरस्तू के सद्गुण-विचार का पुनरुद्धार
definition: the modern revival of Aristotle's ethical ideas, especially virtue, practical wisdom and flourishing, as an alternative to rule-based and outcome-based moral theories
example: Their philosophy lecturer's neo-Aristotelianism showed whenever she answered a question about exams by asking what a flourishing student would do.

hindi: नव-कन्फ्यूशियसवाद — तत्त्वमीमांसा से समृद्ध परवर्ती कन्फ्यूशियस दर्शन
definition: the later revival of Confucian thought that added a detailed theory of reality, built on principle and vital energy, partly in response to Buddhist and Daoist ideas
example: In philosophy club, Anika summarised Neo-Confucianism as Confucius getting a serious upgrade on metaphysics.

hindi: नव-कांटवाद — उन्नीसवीं सदी में कांट के विचारों का पुनरुद्धार
definition: a movement in German universities during the later nineteenth century that revived Kant's ideas to explain the foundations of science, knowledge and values
example: Their philosophy lecturer described neo-Kantianism as the nineteenth century hitting refresh on Kant to see if physics still loaded properly.

hindi: नव-तर्कवाद — अंकगणित को तर्क और परिभाषाओं से व्युत्पन्न करने के फ्रेगे-प्रयास का आधुनिक रूप
definition: the modern revival of Frege's project, holding that arithmetic can be derived from logic together with abstraction principles, meaning definitions of numbers through matching collections
example: Pairing every guest with a chair before counting anyone, the wedding planner practised neo-logicism without ever opening a philosophy book.

hindi: नवउदारवाद — बाज़ार, निजीकरण और कम सरकारी नियंत्रण को बढ़ावा देने वाली नीति-दृष्टि
definition: the late twentieth-century policy outlook favouring free markets, privatisation, lower public spending and less government regulation of business
example: When the office replaced its free canteen with a vending machine and called it efficiency, Sana muttered that neoliberalism had reached the third floor.

hindi: नव-प्लेटोवाद — एक परम सत्ता से सब कुछ उत्पन्न मानने वाला प्लोटिनस का दर्शन
definition: the late ancient school founded by Plotinus, teaching that all reality flows from a single, perfect source beyond thought and that the soul seeks to return to it
example: Staring at the family tree covering the whole living-room wall, Harsh joked it looked like Neoplatonism with more cousins.

hindi: नव-व्यवहारवाद — भाषा और संवाद पर केंद्रित आधुनिक व्यवहारवादी दर्शन
definition: a late twentieth-century revival of pragmatism, linked with Rorty and Putnam, that treats truth and knowledge as matters of language, social practice and useful conversation rather than mirroring reality
example: In seminar, Dev summed up neopragmatism by saying the question was never whether the theory copied reality, only whether it helped the class keep talking productively.

hindi: नेति नेति — 'यह नहीं, यह नहीं', निषेध द्वारा ब्रह्म तक पहुँचने की विधि
definition: the Upanishadic method of describing Brahman by denial, meaning not this, not this, rejecting every limited description until only the indescribable remains
example: Choosing a restaurant with friends became neti neti: not pizza, not sushi, not burgers, until only the canteen remained.

hindi: न्यूरथ की नाव — ज्ञान को समुद्र में ही मरम्मत की जाती नाव मानने का रूपक
definition: the image of knowledge as a boat that sailors must rebuild plank by plank while still afloat, since there is no solid ground outside our beliefs from which to start again
example: Fixing the team's broken spreadsheet while the quarterly report still depended on it, Vikram muttered that this was Neurath's boat with formulas.

hindi: तंत्रिकानीतिशास्त्र — मस्तिष्क-विज्ञान से उठे नैतिक प्रश्नों का अध्ययन
definition: the study of moral questions raised by brain science and brain treatments, such as reading thoughts, boosting memory or altering personality
example: When a startup promised a headband that sharpens focus by zapping your brain, the class debate turned into neuroethics.

hindi: तटस्थ एकतत्ववाद — मन और पदार्थ दोनों किसी एक तटस्थ मूल तत्त्व के रूप हैं, ऐसा मत
definition: the view that mind and matter are both built from one more basic kind of stuff that is itself neither mental nor physical
example: Rahul compared neutral monism to dough that becomes either roti or paratha, depending on what the cook decides to make of it.

hindi: नवीन छल-दानव समस्या — विश्वसनीयतावाद के विरुद्ध भ्रमित पर विवेकी व्यक्ति का विचार-प्रयोग
definition: the objection to reliabilism imagining people fooled by a deceiving demon: they reason just as carefully as we do, so their beliefs seem justified, yet the processes forming those beliefs are unreliable
example: Watching a simulation film, Yash raised the new evil demon problem: the fooled hero reasoned perfectly and still got everything wrong.

hindi: नव यथार्थवाद — बीसवीं सदी का मत कि मन बाहरी वस्तुओं को सीधे ग्रहण करता है
definition: an early twentieth-century American movement holding that the mind perceives physical objects directly, and that objects exist independently of being known, against idealists who held that objects depend on minds
example: In the seminar room, Priya's new realism met its test when the professor asked whether the projector still existed during the power cut.

hindi: आगमन की नई पहेली — यह प्रश्न कि किन गुणों से सामान्यीकरण उचित है और किनसे नहीं
definition: Goodman's puzzle showing that the same evidence supports rival generalizations equally, so we must explain which predicates are suitable for induction and which are not
example: Arjun's teacher used the new riddle of induction to show why 'every emerald seen so far is green' does not settle the matter.

hindi: न्यूकॉम्ब की समस्या — भविष्यवक्ता की उपस्थिति में तर्कसंगत चुनाव पर पहेली
definition: a decision puzzle in which you may take a closed container alone or take it together with a smaller open prize, and a near-perfect predictor has already filled the closed container with a fortune only if it forecast that you would take it alone, testing what rational choice means
example: The family argued over Newcomb's problem at dinner until the aunt who always predicts everything simply took both desserts.

hindi: न्यूटन की बाल्टी — घूमते पानी की वक्र सतह से निरपेक्ष गति सिद्ध करने का तर्क
definition: Newton's argument that the curved surface of water spinning in a bucket reveals real rotation relative to absolute space, not merely relative to nearby objects
example: Stirring her lassi, Kavya noticed the curved surface and announced she had reproduced Newton's bucket in a steel tumbler.

hindi: निचिरेन बौद्ध मत — कमल सूत्र को सर्वोच्च मानने वाली जापानी परंपरा
definition: the Japanese tradition founded by the monk Nichiren, holding the Lotus Sutra, a revered Buddhist scripture, as the supreme teaching and chanting its title as the path to awakening
example: His neighbour's Nichiren Buddhism group chanted every morning, which Aman found more pleasant than his alarm clock.

hindi: निकोद-कसौटी — यह नियम कि किसी सामान्य कथन का प्रत्येक उदाहरण उसकी पुष्टि करता है
definition: the rule that a generalization such as 'every raven is black' is confirmed by each black raven observed and disconfirmed by each non-black raven
example: By Nicod's criterion, every late train Aditi rode confirmed her theory that the railway company runs entirely on hope.

hindi: निदिध्यासन — उपदेश पर गहरा, निरंतर ध्यान
definition: the third stage of Vedantic study, deep and sustained meditation on the teaching until knowledge of the self becomes direct experience
example: Before the final exam, Sara moved from cramming to nididhyasana, sitting quietly with one formula until it felt obvious.

hindi: नीत्शेवादी — नीत्शे के विचारों जैसे मूल्य-सृजन, शक्ति-संकल्प या आत्म-विजय से जुड़ा
definition: relating to Nietzsche's thought, especially its themes of self-creation, will to power, questioning morality and affirming life in spite of suffering
example: Karan gave a Nietzschean speech about embracing hardship, then asked someone else to carry his gym bag.

hindi: रात्रि-प्रहरी राज्य — केवल सुरक्षा, न्याय और अनुबंध-रक्षा तक सीमित राज्य
definition: a state whose only proper jobs are protecting citizens from force, theft and fraud and enforcing contracts, leaving everything else to private life
example: The society's committee acted like a night-watchman state, fixing the gate lock but ignoring every complaint about the lift music.

hindi: निषेधन — चेतना द्वारा किसी स्थिति को नकारकर उससे परे जाने की क्रिया
definition: Sartre's term for the activity by which consciousness pulls back from things and mentally cancels them, noticing what is absent and imagining what could be otherwise
example: Looking at the crowded cafe and seeing only that her friend was missing, Simran gave a textbook example of nihilation.

hindi: शून्यवाद — जीवन, नैतिकता या मूल्यों के किसी वास्तविक आधार को नकारने का मत
definition: the view that life has no built-in meaning or value and that moral rules have no real foundation; historically, also a movement urging the destruction of the existing social order
example: After his third rejected internship application, Varun flirted with nihilism until his mother placed a plate of hot parathas in front of him.

hindi: शून्यवाद-अनुभव — सारे अर्थों के खोखले प्रतीत होने की गहरी अनुभूति
definition: Nishitani Keiji's term for the abyss of meaninglessness beneath ordinary life, which must be passed through toward emptiness, the insight that nothing exists with a fixed separate self
example: After three rejected applications, Tanya stared into nihility for an evening, then made pasta and started a fourth.

hindi: निराकारवाद — ज्ञान स्वयं आकाररहित है और विषय को सीधे ग्रहण करता है, यह मत
definition: the Indian and Buddhist view that cognition itself has no form or image of its object, but simply reveals the object, which alone carries the form
example: Against her brother's sakaravada, Pallavi defended nirakaravada: her awareness of the cake was formless, while the cake was very much round.

hindi: निर्गुण ब्रह्म — सभी गुणों और रूपों से परे ब्रह्म
