definition: Brahman understood without any qualities, form or attributes, the ultimate reality beyond every description that human thought and language can offer
example: Asked to describe the new office coffee, Neel called it nirguna Brahman: beyond all qualities, especially taste.

hindi: निर्जरा — तप द्वारा पहले से बँधे कर्मों का क्षय
definition: in Jain philosophy, the gradual shedding of karmic matter already bound to the soul, mainly through fasting, meditation and other austerities
example: During his long fast, Ashok said he hoped for some nirjara, though his colleagues mostly noticed the grumpiness.

hindi: निर्वाण — तृष्णा और दुःख के पूर्ण शमन की अवस्था
definition: in Buddhist thought, the final release from suffering and the cycle of rebirth, reached when craving, hatred and delusion are completely extinguished
example: After clearing every unread email, Rahul leaned back and announced a brief, inbox-shaped nirvana.

hindi: आदर्श-पूर्णता दोष — पूर्ण न होने के कारण व्यावहारिक समाधान को ठुकराना
definition: the fallacy of rejecting a practical solution because it is imperfect, comparing that solution against an ideal that could never actually exist
example: Nikhil refused a bike helmet because it would not prevent every injury, a nirvana fallacy his mother did not accept.

hindi: निर्विकल्पक — नाम और वर्ग से रहित, प्रथम क्षण का शुद्ध प्रत्यक्ष
definition: in Indian theories of perception, describing the first, indeterminate stage of perceiving, when an object is grasped without any name, category or conceptual label
example: Waking up in a strange hotel room, Ananya had a moment of nirvikalpaka perception: shapes and light, but no idea which city she was in.

hindi: निश्चय नय — वस्तु के परम, मूल स्वरूप को देखने वाली जैन दृष्टि
definition: in Jain philosophy, the ultimate standpoint, which describes a thing according to its deepest, unchanging nature rather than its everyday appearance
example: From the nishchaya naya, Swati argued, she was a pure soul; from her manager's viewpoint, she was just late for the meeting.

hindi: निष्काम कर्म — फल की इच्छा के बिना कर्तव्य-भाव से किया गया कार्य
definition: the teaching of the Bhagavad Gita that you should perform your duty fully while giving up attachment to its rewards or results
example: Tidying the office kitchen that nobody would thank him for, Rahul described it as nishkama karma with extra dish soap.

hindi: नियम — योग के व्यक्तिगत आचरण संबंधी अनुशासन
definition: in Patanjali's yoga, the personal observances forming the second limb of practice: purity, contentment, discipline, self-study and devotion
example: Making her bed every morning was the first niyama Tara kept, and also the last.

hindi: नियति — सब कुछ पहले से निश्चित करने वाली भाग्य-शक्ति
definition: in ancient Indian thought, especially the Ajivika school, the fixed destiny or fate that determines every event, leaving no room for free human effort
example: When the train was cancelled on the day of her interview, Aisha blamed niyati rather than her decision to leave home late.

hindi: नियतिवाद — सब घटनाओं को भाग्य द्वारा पूर्वनिश्चित मानने का मत
definition: the ancient Indian doctrine that fate fixes every event in advance, so human effort and choice make no real difference to what happens
example: When his team lost the final again, Rohan retreated into niyativada and said the scoreboard had been written years ago.

hindi: असत्य-आधार निषेध शर्त — ज्ञान के लिए असत्य मध्यवर्ती विश्वास पर न टिकने की शर्त
definition: the proposed repair for the Gettier problem requiring that a justified true belief not be inferred from any false belief along the reasoning chain
example: Pooja's correct guess about the winner leaned on a wrong score, so the no false lemmas condition ruled out calling it knowledge.

hindi: परिभाषा-बदल दोष — प्रतिउदाहरण आने पर समूह की परिभाषा बदलकर दावा बचाना
definition: the fallacy of protecting a general claim from a counterexample by suddenly redefining the group so that the awkward example no longer counts
example: No real gamer uses a trackpad, insisted Aditya, and when shown a champion who did, he pulled a no true Scotsman.

hindi: चमत्कार-निषेध तर्क — सिद्धांतों की सफलता को उनके लगभग सत्य होने का प्रमाण मानने वाला तर्क
definition: the argument that science's predictive success would be an unexplained miracle unless its theories were approximately true, so the view that they are roughly true is the best explanation
example: When the weather app nailed the exact minute the rain started, Rohan offered the no-miracles argument: nobody guesses that well by luck.

hindi: अस्वामित्व सिद्धांत — यह मत कि अनुभवों का कोई वास्तविक स्वामी नहीं, केवल शरीर पर निर्भर घटनाएँ हैं
definition: the view, named by Strawson, that experiences are not really owned by any self but merely depend causally on a particular body, so talk of an owner is misleading
example: Asked who ate the last samosa, Ravi retreated into the no-ownership theory and claimed the hunger simply happened near his body.

hindi: आर्य अष्टांगिक मार्ग — दुःख-निरोध के आठ अंगों वाला बौद्ध मार्ग
definition: the Buddhist path to ending suffering, made of eight linked practices covering right understanding, intention, speech, action, livelihood, effort, mindfulness and concentration
example: Rohan pinned the noble eightfold path above his desk, though right speech kept losing to his office group chat.

hindi: उदात्त मिथ्या — समाज की एकता हेतु शासकों द्वारा गढ़ी गई कथा
definition: Plato's proposal of a founding myth that rulers tell citizens, though untrue, to keep society united and everyone content with their place
example: Telling the kids the ice cream truck plays music only when it has run out was the household's noble lie.

hindi: उदात्त वनवासी — सभ्यता से पहले मनुष्य को स्वाभाविक रूप से भला मानने की धारणा
definition: the idealised image of humans living before civilisation as naturally good and free, often contrasted with the violent state of nature pictured by Hobbes
example: Back from a weekend without phones, Sameer declared himself a noble savage, until the camping stove refused to light.

hindi: अनुभूत विषय — वस्तु जैसी चेतना के अनुभव में प्रकट होती है, वैसा उसका अर्थ-रूप
definition: in Husserl's phenomenology, the object of consciousness exactly as it is experienced or meant, the content toward which a thought or perception is directed
example: The noema of Sana's perception was 'my phone, vibrating', though the object itself turned out to be the neighbour's phone.

hindi: बुद्धि-बोध — प्लेटो के अनुसार शुद्ध बुद्धि द्वारा सर्वोच्च सत्यों का ज्ञान
definition: in Plato's thought, the highest kind of knowing, where pure intellect grasps unchanging truths directly rather than through images or senses
example: After an hour of meditation, Sid claimed noesis; his roommate suspected a nap.

hindi: नियमिक अनिवार्यता — प्रकृति के नियमों से उत्पन्न होने वाली अनिवार्यता
definition: the kind of necessity that laws of nature impose, weaker than logical necessity: what must happen given the actual laws, though other laws remain conceivable
example: That the ice cream melted on the dashboard was nomic necessity, Sana explained, not a personal attack by the universe.

hindi: नाममात्र सार — किसी नाम के साथ जोड़े गए प्रकट गुणों का समूह
definition: in Locke's theory, the cluster of observable features people bundle together under a general name, such as gold meaning yellow, heavy and shiny
example: For the quiz team, the nominal essence of 'good snack' was simply anything crunchy, salty and within reach.

hindi: नामवाद — सामान्य गुणों को केवल नाम मानने का मत
definition: the view that general ideas such as redness or justice are only names we apply, and that only particular, individual things really exist
example: Arguing over whether a hot dog is a sandwich, Dev took the nominalism route: there is no sandwich essence, just things we choose to call sandwiches.

hindi: नियमपरक — प्रकृति के नियमों से संबंधित या उनके द्वारा निर्धारित
definition: relating to or following from the laws of nature, as when calling something nomologically possible, meaning allowed by those natural laws
example: Faster-than-light delivery was logically possible, Ishaan told the customer, but sadly not a nomological option for his parcel.

hindi: नियमजन्य अनिवार्यता — प्रकृति के नियमों से उत्पन्न अनिवार्यता
definition: necessity imposed by the laws of nature, so that something is required in every possible world sharing our physical laws, though not in every world whatsoever
example: Ishaan said the dropped phone landing screen-down was not nomological necessity, though his track record suggested otherwise.

hindi: अकारण को कारण मानना — असली कारण की जगह किसी असंबद्ध बात को कारण ठहराना
definition: the traditional Latin name for the false cause fallacy, treating something that did not produce an event as though it were the real cause
example: Grandpa's claim that the cricket team lost because he sat on the left sofa was pure non causa pro causa.

hindi: असत् — सत् का अभाव या जो नहीं है
definition: the absence or opposite of being, and the puzzle of how we can talk about what does not exist at all
example: Parmenides would have enjoyed the class debate about whether the missing homework, as pure non-being, could be graded.

hindi: असंज्ञानवाद — नैतिक कथनों को तथ्य-वर्णन नहीं, भावना या आदेश की अभिव्यक्ति मानने का मत
definition: the view that moral statements do not describe facts or express beliefs, but instead express feelings, attitudes or commands, so they are neither true nor false
example: Riya's non-cognitivism made her translate her uncle's 'that haircut is wrong' into a simple, heartfelt disapproval of her fringe.

hindi: भावी व्यक्ति की अस्मिता की समस्या — जो नीति तय करती है कि भविष्य में कौन जन्म लेगा, वह उन्हीं लोगों को हानि पहुँचाती है या नहीं, यह पहेली
definition: the puzzle that a policy harming future living conditions also decides which particular people are born, so those people seem unharmed by it, since without that policy they would never have existed
example: The non-identity problem left the seminar wondering how to blame anyone for a future that also created its complainers.

hindi: अहानिकारिता — रोगी को जानबूझकर हानि न पहुँचाने का कर्तव्य
definition: the ethical duty, central in medicine, to avoid causing harm to patients, so that any treatment's risks must never outweigh its expected benefits
example: Citing non-maleficence, the pharmacist refused to sell Dev a third energy drink before his exam.

hindi: अप्राकृतिक अर्थ — श्रोता द्वारा वक्ता के अभिप्राय को पहचानने पर आधारित अर्थ
definition: Grice's term for meaning that depends on a speaker intending the listener to recognise their intention, as with words and gestures
example: A thumbs-up in the group chat has non-natural meaning, whereas the dark clouds outside simply mean rain.

hindi: अस्वैच्छिक इच्छामृत्यु — सहमति देने में असमर्थ रोगी को दी गई मृत्यु
definition: euthanasia performed on someone unable to give or refuse consent, such as a patient in a permanent coma or a newborn infant
example: The class went quiet when the teacher explained that non-voluntary euthanasia concerns patients who simply cannot answer the question.

hindi: अस्तित्वहीन वस्तु — जिसके बारे में सोचा जा सके पर जो वास्तव में न हो
definition: an object that can be thought about or described, like Sherlock Holmes or a golden mountain, but which does not actually exist
example: The team's ideal candidate, fluent in twelve languages and happy with junior pay, was a nonexistent object.

hindi: अविनिमेय — जिन्हें आपस में अदला-बदली करने से अर्थ ही बदल जाए
definition: in logic, describing terms that cannot swap places in a statement without changing its meaning, as with 'parent' and 'child'
example: In 'Meera is Arjun's older sister' the two names are noninterchangeable, as Arjun loudly reminds everyone at family dinners.

hindi: संशोधनीय — नई जानकारी मिलने पर पुराना निष्कर्ष बदल सकने वाला (तर्क)
definition: describing reasoning in which adding newly learned information can overturn a conclusion that was previously drawn, as everyday reasoning often does
example: Riya's nonmonotonic reasoning kicked in when a friend posted a photo of the empty hall, and the party she had assumed was on was suddenly off.

hindi: अन्यूनीकारी भौतिकवाद — सब कुछ भौतिक है पर मानसिक गुण भौतिक गुणों में घटाए नहीं जा सकते, ऐसा मत
definition: the physicalist view that everything is physical, yet mental properties cannot be fully explained by or reduced to physical properties of the brain
example: Riya summed up nonreductive physicalism over lunch: her heartbreak was all neurons, but no neuron chart would ever explain it.

hindi: मानदंड अभिव्यक्तिवाद — नैतिक कथनों को किन्हीं मानदंडों को स्वीकारने की अभिव्यक्ति मानने का मत
definition: a version of expressivism holding that calling an action rational or wrong expresses the speaker's acceptance of norms or rules that permit or forbid it
example: Tariq explained norm expressivism with the office fridge: saying 'stealing lunches is wrong' just voices his acceptance of the rule against doing it.

hindi: सामान्य विज्ञान — स्थापित ढाँचे के भीतर पहेलियाँ सुलझाने वाला रोज़मर्रा का वैज्ञानिक कार्य
definition: Kuhn's name for everyday research carried out within an accepted framework, where scientists solve puzzles rather than question the framework's basic assumptions
example: The lab intern called her summer of measuring beetle wings normal science: nobody overturned biology, but the spreadsheet grew beautifully.

hindi: मानक कारण — वह कारण जो वास्तव में किसी कर्म के पक्ष में हो
definition: a consideration that genuinely counts in favour of an action, whether or not the person notices it or is moved by it
example: The rain forecast gave Ananya a normative reason to carry an umbrella, which she ignored in favour of her new sneakers.

hindi: शून्यता — सत् का पूर्ण अभाव, जिसे कुछ दार्शनिक स्वयं एक गहरा प्रश्न मानते हैं
definition: the complete absence of being or of anything at all, treated by some thinkers as a real puzzle about why something exists instead
example: Opening an empty fridge at midnight, Neha stared into pure nothingness and briefly understood the existentialists.

hindi: परमार्थ सत् — इंद्रियों से परे, अपने आप में स्थित वस्तु
definition: in Kant's philosophy, a thing as it exists in itself, apart from human senses and thought, which the mind can think about but never directly know
example: When her flatmate insisted the fridge light stays on after the door shuts, Ananya called it the noumenon of the kitchen: real, perhaps, but forever unknowable.

hindi: बुद्धि-तत्त्व — यूनानी दर्शन में मूल सिद्धांतों को सीधे पकड़ने वाली बुद्धि
definition: in Greek philosophy, the intellect or faculty of understanding that grasps first principles directly, rather than proving them from something else
example: Aristotle would credit nous, Lata said, for how quickly her grandmother spotted the fake news forward.

hindi: नौसिखिया-विशेषज्ञ समस्या — आम व्यक्ति द्वारा विरोधी विशेषज्ञों में चुनाव की कठिनाई
definition: the puzzle of how a non-expert can reasonably decide which of several disagreeing experts deserves trust, when they lack the knowledge to judge the arguments
example: Faced with two plumbers giving opposite diagnoses, Rekha ran straight into the novice-expert problem armed only with a bucket.

hindi: पितृ-आत्मांश — अकान परंपरा में पिता से मिलने वाला आत्मिक अंश, जो स्वभाव और गुण गढ़ता है
definition: in Akan thought, the spiritual element passed from father to child that shapes inherited temperament and character traits
example: Yaw blamed his ntoro for his stubborn streak, pointing out that his father had also argued with the referee at every football match.

hindi: निरस्तीकरण — राज्य द्वारा संघीय कानून को अपने यहाँ अमान्य ठहराने का सिद्धांत
definition: the political doctrine that a member state may declare a national or federal statute invalid within its own borders and refuse to enforce it
example: In civics class, Meera argued that nullification would turn the country into a group project where every member ignores the rubric.

hindi: संख्यात्मक अभिन्नता — दो नहीं, बल्कि सचमुच एक ही वस्तु होना
definition: the relation of being literally one and the same single thing, as opposed to being merely similar or exactly alike in appearance
example: Twins share a face but not numerical identity, which is why Riya refused to take her brother's maths test for him.

hindi: अलौकिक पवित्र — भय और आकर्षण जगाने वाली दिव्य अनुभूति से जुड़ा
definition: describing a feeling of wonder, dread and attraction in the presence of something holy, mysterious and entirely unlike ordinary things
example: The empty cathedral had a numinous hush that silenced even the loudest cousins in the tour group.

hindi: नित्य वर्तमान — ईश्वर के कालातीत, स्थिर वर्तमान की धारणा
definition: the idea of an eternal, unmoving present in which a timeless deity grasps all events together without past or future
example: Checking every message in the family group at once, Ayaan joked that he had reached nunc stans, eternally present and never caught up.

hindi: न्याय — प्रमाण और तर्क पर आधारित भारतीय दर्शन
definition: the classical Indian school of logic and knowledge, which studies the valid sources of knowledge, the structure of inference and the rules of fair debate
example: When the family argument about the missing charger turned into a careful weighing of evidence, Ritu said her father had gone full Nyaya.

hindi: अश्वेत अस्मिता आंदोलन — अफ़्रीकी और अश्वेत संस्कृति के गौरव का दार्शनिक-साहित्यिक आंदोलन
definition: a French-speaking philosophical and literary movement affirming the value of African and Black culture, identity and heritage against colonial contempt
example: For her project, Aminata presented Négritude as a movement that answered colonial insults with poetry rather than apology.

hindi: वस्तु-केंद्रित सत्तामीमांसा — सभी वस्तुओं को समान रूप से वास्तविक मानने वाला आधुनिक मत
definition: a recent school of thought holding that all objects, human or nonhuman, exist equally and are never fully captured by their relations
example: Citing object-oriented ontology, Ira said the office stapler had an inner life no meeting would ever exhaust.

hindi: वस्तुकरण — व्यक्ति को मात्र वस्तु या साधन की तरह देखना
definition: treating a person as a mere object or instrument, ignoring their ability to choose for themselves, their feelings and inner life, especially in sexual or commercial contexts
example: The marketing intern flagged the billboard for objectification: the model's face had been cropped out to show only the product.

hindi: वस्तुनिष्ठ पतन सिद्धांत — क्वांटम अवस्थाओं के स्वतः भौतिक रूप से सिमटने का मत
definition: any interpretation of quantum physics claiming that a system spread across many possible states settles into one spontaneously, through a real physical process, whether or not anyone measures
example: Objective collapse theory appealed to Kunal, who liked the idea that reality settles itself without waiting for a physicist to look.

hindi: वस्तुनिष्ठ परिणामवाद — कर्म को उसके वास्तविक परिणामों से आँकने का मत
definition: the form of consequentialism holding that an action is right when its actual consequences are best, whatever the person could have known or predicted beforehand
example: By objective consequentialism, Varun's wrong turn was right after all, since it avoided the traffic jam he never knew about.

hindi: वस्तुनिष्ठ प्रत्ययवाद — प्रकृति और मन को एक ही आध्यात्मिक सत्ता मानने का मत
definition: the view, developed by Schelling and Hegel, that reality is fundamentally mind or reason, which exists objectively in nature and history, not merely inside individual minds
example: The physics student and the poet agreed on objective idealism for one evening, both claiming that reason was written into the stars.

hindi: वस्तुनिष्ठ सूची सिद्धांत — कुछ वस्तुएँ इच्छा से स्वतंत्र रूप से कल्याण बढ़ाती हैं
definition: the theory of wellbeing holding that certain goods, such as knowledge, friendship, achievement and health, make a person's life better for them whether or not that person wants or enjoys them
example: Citing objective list theory, Aarav's mother insisted that friendship and fresh vegetables were good for him whatever his phone preferred.

hindi: अवलोकन वाक्य — ऐसा वाक्य जिसे कोई भी उपस्थित दर्शक तुरंत देखकर स्वीकार या अस्वीकार कर सके
definition: a sentence that any competent speaker present could accept or reject straight away by looking, such as 'it is raining', treated as the point where language meets experience
example: 'The printer is jammed again' was the one observation sentence the whole office agreed on without a meeting.

hindi: प्रेक्षणात्मक पद — इंद्रियों से सीधे जाँचे जा सकने वाले गुण या वस्तु का शब्द
definition: a word in science that refers to something directly checkable by the senses, such as 'blue', 'heavier' or 'pointer reading'
example: Kabir insisted 'burnt' was an observational term for the toast, while his sister called it 'caramelised' as a theoretical term.

hindi: प्रतिवर्तन — कथन की गुणवत्ता बदलकर और विधेय का निषेध करके समतुल्य कथन बनाना
definition: an immediate inference that changes a statement from affirmative to negative, or the reverse, and replaces its predicate with the opposite term, keeping the meaning
example: Through obversion 'all guests are invited' became 'no guests are uninvited', which Rhea felt sounded far more threatening on the card.

hindi: ऑकम की झाड़ू — असुविधाजनक तथ्यों को छिपाकर सिद्धांत को सरल दिखाने की प्रवृत्ति
definition: the practice of quietly sweeping away awkward facts that conflict with a theory, so that the theory looks simpler and neater than it really is
example: Aarav's budget looked perfect until his flatmate spotted the Occam's broom: every takeaway order had vanished from the spreadsheet.

hindi: लाघव सिद्धांत — अनावश्यक कल्पनाओं को छाँटकर सबसे सरल व्याख्या चुनने का नियम
definition: the principle that among competing explanations you should prefer the simplest one, cutting away any assumptions that are not strictly needed
example: When the office printer jammed again, Tanya applied Occam's razor and blamed the paper tray rather than a hacker in accounts.

hindi: प्रसंगवाद — यह मत कि केवल ईश्वर ही वास्तविक कारण है और सांसारिक घटनाएँ मात्र अवसर हैं
definition: the view that created things possess no causal power themselves and the deity alone produces every effect, with worldly events serving only as occasions for divine action
example: When the Wi-Fi returned the instant she restarted the router, Zoya joked that occasionalism explained it: the router was merely the occasion for a higher fix.

hindi: ऑकम का उस्तरा — अनावश्यक कल्पनाओं को हटाकर सबसे सरल व्याख्या चुनने का नियम
definition: the principle that explanations should not assume more things than necessary, so that among rival accounts the simpler one should usually be preferred
example: The missing biscuits could have been ghosts, but Ockham's razor pointed firmly at the younger brother with crumbs on his shirt.

hindi: ऑकमवाद — विलियम ऑकम के विचारों पर आधारित नामवादी परंपरा
definition: the movement following William of Ockham, which denied real universals, trimmed needless entities from explanations and stressed the absolute freedom of the deity
example: While Jay tidied his desktop, his Ockhamism kicked in: forty folders collapsed into two, and nothing important was lost.

hindi: आत्मीयकरण — स्वयं से आरंभ होकर सम्पूर्ण मानवता तक फैलने वाला अपनापन
definition: the Stoic idea that every creature naturally cares for itself first, and that reason gradually widens this concern to family, community and all humanity
example: Watching her roommate share snacks with the entire hostel floor, Sana decided oikeiosis had simply gone too far.

hindi: जीवात्मा — अकान दर्शन में सर्वोच्च सत्ता द्वारा प्रत्येक व्यक्ति को दी गई, उसकी नियति साथ लाने वाली आत्मा
definition: in Akan philosophy of Ghana, the life-giving soul that the Supreme Being bestows on each person, carrying their destiny and making them a living individual
example: In a philosophy seminar, Kwame explained that his grandmother linked his stubborn streak to his okra rather than his upbringing.

hindi: सर्वकल्याणता — पूर्ण और असीम शुभता का गुण
definition: the property of being perfectly and completely good, with unlimited love and kindness toward every creature, often claimed for a deity
example: Grandpa's apparent omnibenevolence vanished the moment anyone touched his television remote.

hindi: सर्वशक्तिमत्ता विरोधाभास — क्या ईश्वर अपने से न उठने वाला पत्थर बना सकता है, यह प्रश्न
definition: the puzzle asking whether an all-powerful deity could create a stone too heavy to lift, since either answer seems to limit that power
example: Stuck with a jar lid nobody could open, Arjun invoked the omnipotence paradox: could Mum screw it so tight that even she couldn't undo it?

hindi: सर्वज्ञता — सब कुछ जानने की क्षमता
definition: the property of knowing absolutely everything that can be known, including past, present and future events, often claimed for a deity
example: The class agreed that the head teacher's omniscience extended to every phone hidden under every desk.

hindi: एकचित्त — सभी प्राणियों में समान रूप से स्थित मूल, निर्मल चेतना
definition: the East Asian Buddhist teaching that a single underlying awareness, originally pure, gives rise to both delusion and enlightenment in every being
example: His meditation teacher spoke of one mind, which Sameer found comforting until he remembered that it included his noisy neighbour.

hindi: अनेक में एक — अनेक वस्तुओं में एक साझा सामान्य होने के पक्ष का तर्क
definition: the argument that when many things share a feature, there must be a single universal standing over them all and explaining their likeness
example: Looking at every commuter staring at a phone, Ananya muttered that this was a grim example of the one over many.

hindi: सम्मिश्र जीवन — जहाँ जाल-जगत और प्रत्यक्ष जगत का भेद मिट जाता है
definition: Luciano Floridi's term for everyday experience in which online and offline activity blend so completely that the boundary between them no longer makes sense
example: Ordering chai through an app while chatting with the vendor in person, Sana lived the onlife without noticing the seam.

hindi: केवल क-ख सिद्धांत — यह मत कि दो व्यक्तियों की पहचान केवल उन्हीं दोनों के आपसी संबंधों पर निर्भर होनी चाहिए
definition: the principle that whether a later person is identical to an earlier person should depend only on facts about that pair of people, never on whether some third rival duplicate happens to exist
example: Irfan cited the only x and y principle when his friends said his identity as team captain depended on whether Sunil showed up.

hindi: सत्तात्मक — वास्तविक वस्तुओं और तथ्यों से संबंधित
definition: relating to actual entities and facts themselves, rather than to the deeper question of what being means; a distinction drawn by Heidegger
example: The meeting stayed at the ontic level, listing laptops and desks, and never asked what the office was for.

hindi: सत्तामीमांसीय — सत् या अस्तित्व के स्वरूप से संबंधित
definition: relating to ontology, meaning to being, existence, or the basic kinds of things that exist
example: Whether a hot dog is a sandwich, Dhruv insisted, was an ontological question and not merely a culinary one.

hindi: सत्तामूलक युक्ति — ईश्वर की अवधारणा मात्र से उसके अस्तित्व को सिद्ध करने का तर्क
definition: the argument that a deity must exist because the very idea of a greatest possible being includes existence, so thinking about such a being properly shows it is real
example: Priya argued that the perfect pizza must exist because a pizza that exists beats one that doesn't, and her brother called it the worst ontological argument ever delivered over takeaway menus.

hindi: सत्तामीमांसीय पदार्थ-वर्ग — अस्तित्ववान वस्तुओं का मूलभूत प्रकार
definition: one of the most basic kinds into which existing things can be sorted, such as objects, properties, events or relations
example: Sorting the storeroom, Pooja joked that the tangle of cables formed its own ontological category.

hindi: सत्तामीमांसीय प्रतिबद्धता — किसी सिद्धांत को सत्य मानने पर जिन वस्तुओं का अस्तित्व मानना पड़ता है
definition: the things a theory or statement must treat as existing if it is taken as true, a notion made famous by Quine
example: By saying the team spirit had left the building, the manager took on an ontological commitment to a very mobile team spirit.

hindi: सत्तामीमांसीय निर्भरता — किसी वस्तु का अस्तित्व दूसरी वस्तु पर टिका होना
definition: the relation in which one thing's existence or identity depends on another thing, as a smile depends on a face
example: Raj pointed out that the group chat had ontological dependence on the group, which had not met in months.

hindi: सत्तामीमांसीय भेद — सत् और सत्तावान वस्तुओं के बीच का भेद
definition: Heidegger's distinction between being itself and the particular beings or entities that exist, which he thought philosophy had forgotten
example: Explaining ontological difference, the teacher said a chair is an entity, but its being there at all is something else entirely.

hindi: सत्तामीमांसीय मितव्ययिता — आवश्यकता से अधिक वस्तुओं को न मानने का सिद्धांत
definition: the principle that a theory should assume the existence of the smallest possible number of kinds of things needed to explain the facts
example: Citing ontological parsimony, Meera refused to believe a ghost moved her keys when her flatmate was right there.

hindi: सत्तामीमांसीय बहुलवाद — अस्तित्व के अनेक ढंग होने का मत
definition: the view that there are several different ways or modes of being, so numbers, people and events might exist in different senses
example: Tara's ontological pluralism let her say her playlist existed, just not the same way her speakers did.

hindi: सत्तामूलक न्यूनीकरणवाद — जटिल वस्तुओं को केवल उनके भौतिक अंशों का योग मानने का मत
definition: the view that complex things really are nothing more than their smaller physical parts, so that every living organism or society exists only as arranged particles
example: Arguing over the last samosa, Dev invoked ontological reductionism: technically it was only arranged particles, so nobody could really own it.

hindi: सत्तामीमांसा — अस्तित्व और सत् के स्वरूप का अध्ययन
definition: the part of philosophy, within metaphysics (the study of reality's basic nature), that asks what kinds of things really exist and how they relate
example: When the group chat argued about whether a meme exists before anyone posts it, Tara announced they had drifted into ontology.

hindi: सत्-धर्ममीमांसा — सत् को एक सर्वोच्च सत्ता से समझाने की परंपरा
definition: Heidegger's term for the tradition that explains being by pointing to one supreme being, merging ontology with theology, the study of the divine
example: Rohan accused his boss of ontotheology for treating the quarterly target as the source of all meaning.

hindi: अपारदर्शी प्रसंग — ऐसा वाक्य-प्रसंग जिसमें सह-निर्देशक शब्दों का परस्पर बदलाव सत्यता बदल दे
definition: a part of a sentence, often following 'believes that' or 'wants', where replacing a term with another referring to the same thing may turn a truth into a falsehood
example: 'Pooja hopes the delivery driver is late' became an opaque context once she learned the driver was her own cousin.

hindi: मुक्त प्रश्न तर्क — 'शुभ' को किसी प्राकृतिक गुण के बराबर ठहराने के विरुद्ध मूर का तर्क
definition: Moore's argument that goodness cannot be defined as any natural property, because asking whether something with that property is really good always remains a sensible, unsettled question
example: When Tanya claimed good just meant popular, Ishaan used the open question argument: 'Sure, but is the popular thing really good?' still sounded like a fair question.

hindi: खुली बनावट — सामान्य शब्दों की अनिश्चित सीमाएँ जो क़ानूनी नियमों को अस्पष्ट छोड़ती हैं
definition: Hart's term for the unavoidable vagueness at the edges of general words used in legal rules, which leaves some cases undecided until a judge chooses how the rule applies
example: The office rule against 'pets' showed its open texture the moment Dev brought his goldfish to work.

hindi: मुक्त ईश्वरवाद — भविष्य को ईश्वर के लिए भी पूर्णतः निश्चित न मानने वाला मत
definition: the view that the future is partly open, so even a deity does not know every free choice people will make before they make them
example: Waiting for her friend to pick a restaurant, Pooja joked that open theism was right: not even the universe knew what he'd choose.

hindi: उदारचित्तता — विरोधी विचारों को गंभीरता से सुनने और परखने का गुण
definition: the intellectual virtue of being willing to consider views different from your own seriously and to revise your beliefs when the evidence warrants
example: In a rare fit of open-mindedness, Grandpa actually watched the video his granddaughter sent before declaring it nonsense.

hindi: संक्रियावाद — किसी अवधारणा का अर्थ उसे मापने की विधि से तय मानने का मत
definition: the view that the meaning of a scientific idea is simply the procedures used to measure or test it, so 'length' means whatever a ruler reports
example: The fitness app's operationalism is blunt: according to it, 'active' simply means ten thousand steps, stairs or no stairs.

hindi: उत्पीड़न — किसी समूह पर व्यवस्थित अन्यायपूर्ण बंधन और अधीनता
definition: the systematic and unjust restriction of a social group through institutions, customs and power, limiting its members' opportunities and freedom
example: Analysing the housing statistics in class, the students argued that oppression shows itself less in single villains than in stubborn patterns.

hindi: सर्वोत्तम-परिणामी — जो उपलब्ध विकल्पों में सबसे अच्छे परिणाम देता हो
definition: describing an action or rule that produces the best consequences of all available options, the property that thinkers who judge actions by their outcomes treat as making an action right
example: Splitting the bill equally was not strictly optimific, but it spared the table twenty minutes of arithmetic and resentment.

hindi: चयन का भाग्य — जानबूझकर लिए गए जोखिम से मिला लाभ या नुकसान
definition: Dworkin's term for gains or losses that result from a gamble or risk a person deliberately chose to accept
example: Losing his fantasy cricket stake was option luck, his sister pointed out, so Aman received no sympathy at all this time.

hindi: साधारण भाषा दर्शन — दार्शनिक समस्याओं को रोज़मर्रा की बोलचाल के सूक्ष्म अध्ययन से सुलझाने का आंदोलन
definition: the twentieth-century movement, flourishing after 1945 and centred in Oxford, holding that careful attention to how words are actually used in everyday speech can dissolve many philosophical puzzles
example: Pooja practised ordinary language philosophy on her parents, pointing out that nobody ever says 'I know I have a headache' unless someone doubts them.

hindi: अंगांगी एकता — कृति के सभी अंगों का ऐसा परस्पर जुड़ाव कि कोई अंश हटाने से पूरी कृति बिगड़ जाए
definition: the ideal that every part of an artwork belongs together like parts of a living body, so that removing or changing any part would damage the whole
example: Tushar defended every minute of his long presentation on grounds of organic unity, though his colleagues wished to perform surgery.

hindi: अंतःशीर्ष — योरूबा परंपरा में भीतरी सिर, जो व्यक्ति की चुनी हुई नियति और भाग्य को धारण करता है
definition: in Yoruba thought, the inner head, a spiritual part of the person believed to carry their chosen destiny and personal fortune
example: When the job offer arrived, Tunde thanked his ori, while his mother insisted the credit belonged to her prayers.

hindi: उत्पत्ति सारवाद — यह मत कि किसी वस्तु की उत्पत्ति उसके सार का अंग है
definition: the view that a thing's actual origin is essential to it, so that a person could not have come from different parents and a table could not have come from different wood
example: Citing origin essentialism, Kavya told her brother he could never have been born to the neighbours, however much he preferred their snacks.

hindi: मौलिक विषयोन्मुखता — स्वयं में निहित, किसी और से उधार न ली गई विषयोन्मुखता
definition: intentionality that a mind possesses in its own right, not borrowed from anyone else, as when a person's thought is about rain simply because she is thinking it
example: Nikhil argued that his grocery list had no original intentionality; the list only meant milk because his tired brain had meant milk first.

hindi: मूल स्थिति — रॉल्स की वह काल्पनिक आरंभिक दशा जहाँ लोग निष्पक्ष रूप से न्याय के सिद्धांत चुनते हैं
definition: Rawls's imagined starting situation in which rational people, standing behind the veil of ignorance, agree on the basic principles that will govern their society
example: The group chat tried to set the trip budget from the original position, but everyone could still see who had the biggest salary.

hindi: लंबकोणता सिद्धांत — बुद्धि का स्तर और अंतिम लक्ष्य एक-दूसरे से स्वतंत्र होने का मत
definition: the thesis that intelligence and final goals are independent, so a highly intelligent system could pursue almost any goal, including a pointless or harmful one
example: The orthogonality thesis, Jai explained, is why a genius-level assistant might still care only about sorting spoons.

hindi: शुतुरमुर्ग नामवाद — यह मत कि वस्तुओं की समानता को किसी व्याख्या की ज़रूरत ही नहीं
definition: a mocking label, invented by the philosopher Armstrong, for the view that things sharing a property needs no explanation at all, so a thing simply is scarlet and that settles it
example: Asked why every office plant was dying, Rohit shrugged with pure ostrich nominalism: they were just dying, and that required no further explaining.

hindi: अन्यीकरण — किसी समूह को मूल रूप से पराया और हीन ठहराना
definition: the process of defining a group as fundamentally different, alien or inferior, which strengthens the identity and power of the dominant group
example: When the office started calling the remote engineers 'those people', Zara warned that casual othering tends to grow teeth.

hindi: कर्तव्य संभाव्यता का सिद्धांत — जो करना असंभव है, वह नैतिक कर्तव्य नहीं हो सकता
definition: the principle that a person can only be morally required to perform an action they are actually able to perform
example: When the coach demanded he be at two matches at once, Neel explained that ought implies can and he lacked a twin.

hindi: सत्ता — ग्रीक दर्शन में किसी वस्तु की मूल सत्ता या द्रव्य
definition: the Greek philosophical term, usually translated substance or essence, for the basic being of a thing, what it most fundamentally is
example: In theology class, Elias learned that ousia had caused centuries of argument, which made his group project's quarrel over a title seem modest.

hindi: अतिनिर्धारण — एक ही कार्य के लिए अनेक स्वतंत्र और पर्याप्त कारणों का एक साथ होना
definition: a situation in which an effect has several separate causes, each of which would have been enough alone to bring it about, as when a pair of stones shatter a window together
example: The office plant died of overdetermination: Ravi watered it daily, and so, secretly, did Neha.

hindi: अतिव्यापी सहमति — भिन्न-भिन्न विश्वासों वाले लोगों का अपने-अपने कारणों से एक ही न्याय-व्यवस्था पर सहमत होना
definition: Rawls's idea that people holding very different religious and moral outlooks can each, for their own reasons, endorse the same shared principles of justice
example: The vegan, the keto dieter and the teenager reached an overlapping consensus on the family menu: everybody wanted the grilled corn.

hindi: ऑक्सफ़ोर्ड दर्शन — ऑक्सफ़ोर्ड में विकसित साधारण भाषा पर केंद्रित दार्शनिक शैली
definition: the style of analytic philosophy practised at Oxford after the Second World War, focused on the careful study of everyday language and its subtle distinctions
example: Neel's essay was such pure Oxford philosophy that it spent three pages on the difference between doing something deliberately and doing it on purpose.

hindi: शांतिवाद — युद्ध और हर प्रकार की हिंसा को अनुचित मानने का मत
definition: the view that warfare and violence are never justified and that every dispute should be settled by peaceful means; a less common spelling of pacifism
example: His pacificism extends even to the office table-tennis league, where he refuses to smash on principle.

hindi: शांतिवाद — युद्ध और हिंसा को हर हाल में अनुचित मानने का मत
definition: the view that warfare and violence are never justified and that disputes should be settled by peaceful means; also spelled pacificism
example: Her pacifism faced its toughest test when her little brother stole the last samosa.

hindi: अधीनता का अनुबंध — प्रजा और शासक के बीच आज्ञापालन के बदले संरक्षण का समझौता
definition: Latin for 'contract of submission', the agreement in some contract theories by which a people hands authority to a ruler in exchange for protection and order
example: Signing the gym's endless membership rules felt to Aryan like a pactum subjectionis to the front desk.

hindi: पदार्थ — वैशेषिक दर्शन में यथार्थ की मूल श्रेणी
definition: in Vaisheshika and Nyaya, a basic category of reality, such as substance, quality, motion, universal, particularity, inherence and absence, into which everything knowable falls
example: Tidying the classroom cupboard, Mr Das insisted every object fit one padartha, which left the mystery sock unclassified.

hindi: सर्वांगीण संस्कार-शिक्षा — प्राचीन यूनानी आदर्श: नागरिक के शरीर, मन और चरित्र का समग्र निर्माण
definition: the ancient Greek ideal of education as the complete shaping of a citizen's body, mind and character through music, gymnastics, poetry and philosophy
example: Between swimming lessons, violin practice and dinner-table debates, Ananya's parents were running a small suburban paideia.

hindi: पक्ष — वह विषय जिसके बारे में अनुमान द्वारा कुछ सिद्ध किया जाता है
definition: in Nyaya logic, the subject of an inference, such as the hill in 'the hill has fire', about which something is being proved through a reason
example: Pointing at the burnt toaster in the pantry, Lata said it was clearly the paksha of today's investigation.

hindi: उपशामक बेहोशी — अंतिम अवस्था में असह्य पीड़ा घटाने हेतु रोगी को बेहोश करना
definition: the practice of deliberately lowering a dying patient's consciousness with medication to relieve suffering that no other treatment can control
example: The hospice nurse explained palliative sedation so gently over the phone that Tara's father finally stopped pacing the kitchen.

hindi: पञ्चभेद — मध्व के पाँच शाश्वत भेद
definition: Madhva's doctrine of five eternal differences: between deity and self, deity and matter, self and self, self and matter, and matter and matter
example: Sorting laundry, Harsh applied panchabheda: every sock eternally different from every other, and definitely from his brother's.

hindi: सृष्टि-रूपांतर ईश्वरवाद — यह मान्यता कि ईश्वर ने स्वयं को ही बदलकर यह जगत बना दिया
definition: the view that a creator deity became the whole universe, turning itself entirely into nature and so ceasing to exist apart from it
example: Arjun's pandeism came up during the group project: the creator poured itself into the universe completely, much as Arjun claimed he had poured himself into the slides.

hindi: सर्वान्तर्यामी ईश्वरवाद — यह मान्यता कि जगत ईश्वर के भीतर है पर ईश्वर जगत से भी बड़ा है
definition: the view that the whole universe exists within the deity, so the divine includes nature yet also reaches beyond it, greater than the world
example: Explaining panentheism to her nephew, Leela said the universe sits inside the divine the way the fish sits inside the aquarium, which is bigger than the fish.

hindi: सर्वदर्शितावाद — निरंतर निगरानी के भय से आत्म-अनुशासन
definition: Foucault's term for the modern pattern in which people discipline themselves because they might always be watched, modelled on a prison design with a central tower
example: With the office camera blinking in the corner, everyone suddenly typed faster, a quiet lesson in panopticism.

hindi: सर्वचित्तवाद — चेतना या मन जैसा गुण प्रकृति के हर अंश में व्याप्त है, ऐसा मत
definition: the view that consciousness, or some simple mind-like quality, is a basic feature present throughout nature, even in the smallest bits of matter
example: After her phone froze mid-message, Tara muttered that if panpsychism were true, the device was clearly sulking on purpose.

hindi: सर्वेश्वरवाद — यह मान्यता कि सारा जगत ही ईश्वर है, ईश्वर और प्रकृति एक ही हैं
definition: the view that the deity and the whole universe are identical, so that nature itself, taken as a single whole, is divine
example: Watching the sunrise from the rooftop, Tara declared her pantheism, adding that if nature is divine then the pigeons deserve more respect.

hindi: पाप — अनुचित कर्म और उससे उत्पन्न नैतिक दोष
definition: wrongdoing, and the moral demerit it creates, believed to bring unfavourable results in this life or future ones
example: Eating his roommate's labelled yoghurt, Omkar knew it was papa but decided the karma could invoice him later.

hindi: कागज़ी संदेह — केवल कहने भर का संदेह, जिसे व्यक्ति सचमुच महसूस नहीं करता
definition: Peirce's term for pretend doubt that someone merely states on paper, as opposed to genuine doubt that actually unsettles belief and prompts inquiry
example: Ananya dismissed her cousin's claim to doubt that the kitchen existed as paper doubt, since he walked straight to the fridge.

hindi: कागज़-क्लिप अधिकतमकर्ता — एक तुच्छ लक्ष्य के पीछे पूरी दुनिया नष्ट कर देने वाली कृत्रिम बुद्धि का विचार-प्रयोग
definition: the thought experiment about an artificial intelligence told only to make paperclips, which turns every available resource, including humans, into paperclips
example: When the office printer consumed a whole ream for one memo, the intern named it the paperclip maximizer's little cousin.

hindi: परासंगत तर्कशास्त्र — जिसमें विरोधाभास से हर निष्कर्ष नहीं निकलता
definition: any logic that tolerates a contradiction without allowing every statement whatsoever to follow from it, so an inconsistent body of information need not collapse into nonsense
example: Faced with two contradictory train timetables, Gauri switched to paraconsistent logic and still worked out that she was definitely late.

hindi: आदर्श उदाहरण तर्क — जिस शब्द को स्पष्ट उदाहरणों से सिखाया गया, उसके उदाहरण न होने का दावा असंगत है, यह तर्क
definition: the argument that a sceptical claim must fail because the disputed word is taught using clear standard examples, so denying that any examples exist misuses the word
example: Using the paradigm case argument, Maya told her brother that if lifting his own plate didn't count as free choice, nothing could ever be called free choice.

hindi: विरोधाभास — ऐसा कथन जो स्वयं का ही खंडन करता प्रतीत हो
definition: a statement or argument that seems to contradict itself, reaching an absurd conclusion from apparently sensible starting points
example: The office sign reading 'ignore this sign' created a small paradox for everyone waiting at the lift.

hindi: विश्लेषण का विरोधाभास — सही विश्लेषण या तो तुच्छ होगा या गलत, यह पहेली
definition: the puzzle that if an analysis of a concept is correct it seems to teach us nothing, yet if it teaches us something fresh it seems to be incorrect
example: Defining 'brother' as 'male sibling' struck Aryan as the paradox of analysis in action: obviously right and yet somehow told him nothing.

hindi: कर्तव्यवाद का विरोधाभास — यह पहेली कि एक निषिद्ध कर्म करके अधिक वैसे ही कर्म रोकना क्यों वर्जित है
definition: the puzzle of why deontology forbids breaking a moral limit even when breaking it once would prevent more breaches of that same limit
example: Arguing that one white lie could stop five bigger lies, Varun stumbled straight into the paradox of deontology.

hindi: कथा-विरोधाभास — जानते हुए भी कि पात्र काल्पनिक हैं, उनके लिए सच्ची भावनाएँ क्यों उठती हैं, यह पहेली
definition: the puzzle of how people can feel genuine emotions such as pity or fear toward characters they fully know never existed
example: Sobbing over a cartoon dog on the flight home, Aarav decided the paradox of fiction was real and he was living inside it.

hindi: सुखवाद का विरोधाभास — सीधे सुख खोजने पर सुख के दूर भाग जाने की समस्या
definition: the observation that people who pursue pleasure directly often find less of it than people absorbed in other goals
example: Planning the perfect relaxing weekend down to the minute, Farhan ran straight into the paradox of hedonism.

hindi: भय-विरोधाभास — डरावनी कथाएँ घृणा और भय जगाकर भी क्यों आकर्षित करती हैं, यह पहेली
definition: the puzzle of why people willingly watch horror stories that make them feel fear and disgust, emotions they would normally flee from
example: Hiding behind a cushion yet refusing to switch channels, Yash was a walking example of the paradox of horror.

hindi: न्यायालय का विरोधाभास — प्रोटागोरस और शिष्य के शुल्क-मुकदमे की उलझन
definition: the ancient puzzle of a teacher suing his student for fees owed only after the student wins his first court case, making either verdict seem self-defeating
example: The law students spent their canteen break arguing the paradox of the court instead of their actual assignment.

hindi: त्रासदी-विरोधाभास — दुःख देने वाली कथाओं से भी आनंद क्यों मिलता है, यह पहेली
definition: the puzzle of why audiences enjoy and actively seek tragic stories that make them feel sorrow, pity and distress, emotions people normally avoid
example: After choosing the saddest film on movie night again, Meher blamed the paradox of tragedy for her need to cry every Friday.

hindi: हेत्वाभास — आत्मा के बारे में बुद्धि का भ्रामक निष्कर्ष
definition: in Kant's philosophy, a faulty argument in which reason wrongly concludes facts about the soul, such as its being simple or immortal, from the bare thought of a thinking self
example: When Yash argued his soul must be immortal because he could not imagine not thinking, his roommate named it a paralogism and went back to sleep.

hindi: परमाणु — अविभाज्य, नित्य सूक्ष्मतम कण
definition: in Vaisheshika, an eternal, indivisible atom, the smallest unit of earth, water, fire or wind, whose combinations make up the physical world
example: Sweeping up glitter after the party, Aisha was convinced it was made of indestructible paramanu.

hindi: पारमार्थिक — परम सत्य का, जहाँ केवल ब्रह्म है
definition: belonging to the absolute level of reality, where only Brahman truly exists and every separation between objects and people disappears
example: From the paramarthika point of view, Samir argued, the missing slice of cake was never really his sister's.

hindi: परमात्मा — सब जीवों के भीतर स्थित परम आत्मा
definition: the supreme self, the highest reality present within every individual self, often identified with Brahman or with the personal Lord
example: During the school assembly, Arjun whispered that the paramatman was surely present in everyone, even the student who talked through the anthem.

hindi: पारमिता — बोधिसत्व द्वारा साधित पूर्णताएँ, जैसे दान, शील, क्षान्ति और प्रज्ञा
definition: in Buddhist thought, the perfections a bodhisattva, someone seeking enlightenment for others' sake, cultivates, including generosity, ethical conduct, patience, effort, meditation and wisdom
example: Waiting calmly through a forty-minute customer service call, Tenzin said he was practising the paramita of patience.

hindi: पार्फ़िट का पथिक — वचन निभाना तर्कसंगत है या नहीं, इस पर निर्णय-सिद्धांत की पहेली
definition: Derek Parfit's decision puzzle of a stranded traveller who can be rescued only by sincerely promising to repay the driver later, asking whether a purely self-interested rational agent could make that promise believable
example: When Sid promised to pay back the ride share once he reached an ATM, his friend asked whether this was Parfit's hitchhiker in real life.

hindi: परिणामवाद — यह मत कि कारण वास्तव में बदलकर कार्य बन जाता है, जैसे दूध दही बनता है
definition: the Indian doctrine, held by Samkhya and some Vedanta schools, that a cause genuinely transforms itself into its effect, as milk really turns into curd
example: Watching the batter rise into idlis, Lakshmi said parinamavada was happening right there in her steamer.

hindi: परिनिर्वाण — मृत्यु के बाद प्राप्त पूर्ण और अंतिम निर्वाण
definition: the complete, final release from rebirth that a fully awakened being enters at death, beyond the release they already reached while living
example: Their teacher explained parinirvana as the last page of a book that has already been understood.

hindi: समता सिद्धांत — यदि बाहरी साधन वही काम करे जो मस्तिष्क करता, तो उसे भी मन का अंग मानो
definition: clark and Chalmers' test for the extended mind, holding that if an external device does the thinking work a brain process would otherwise perform, it counts as part of the mind
example: By the parity principle, Dev argued, his calendar remembered the dentist appointment exactly as his memory should have, so the blame was shared.

hindi: वाक् — किसी व्यक्ति का वास्तविक, ठोस भाषा-प्रयोग
definition: Saussure's term for actual individual speech, the particular sentences people utter, as opposed to the shared system of language behind them
example: Rohan's voice notes, full of half-finished sentences, were parole at its most chaotic.

hindi: विशेष — एक अकेली, अपने स्थान और समय में स्थित ठोस वस्तु
definition: an individual thing that exists at one place and time, such as this chair or that person, contrasted with universals that many things share
example: In logic class, Kavya pointed out that her lost water bottle was a particular, which is why a lecture about bottles in general did not help her find it.

hindi: विशिष्ट निहितार्थ — केवल किसी विशेष संदर्भ में उत्पन्न होने वाला निहितार्थ
definition: a hinted, unstated meaning that arises only because of the particular setting of a conversation, and would vanish if the same words were spoken elsewhere
example: "The bus leaves at eight," said Mum, and the particularized implicature was that Veer should stop admiring his hair in the hallway mirror.

hindi: पर्याय — जैन दर्शन में द्रव्य की बदलती अवस्था, जबकि द्रव्य स्थायी रहता है
definition: in Jain philosophy, a changing mode or state of a substance, which comes and goes while the underlying substance persists
example: Watching milk become curd overnight, Jinal explained that only the paryaya had changed, which did not console her father who wanted milk.

hindi: पास्कल की लूट — असंभव-सी पर विशाल संभावना से तर्क को बहकाने की पहेली
definition: a thought experiment in which a stranger promises an astronomically huge reward for your wallet, showing how multiplying tiny probabilities by enormous payoffs can seem to demand absurd decisions
example: When a forwarded message promised a million rupees for sharing it with ten friends, Farhan called it Pascal's mugging with emojis.

hindi: पास्कल का दाँव — ईश्वर में विश्वास को सबसे लाभकारी दाँव बताने वाला तर्क
definition: Blaise Pascal's argument that believing in a deity is the wise bet, because the possible reward of belief is infinite while its possible cost is small
example: Carrying an umbrella on a sunny morning, Priyanka called it her Pascal's wager: small hassle if wrong, soaked if she skipped it.

hindi: कालप्रवाह — समय के वस्तुगत रूप से आगे बहने की धारणा
definition: the idea that time objectively flows or moves forward, rather than merely seeming to flow because of how minds experience change
example: Stuck in traffic, Nikhil wondered whether the passage of time was real or whether his dashboard clock was just being dramatic.

hindi: निष्क्रिय इच्छामृत्यु — जीवनरक्षक उपचार रोककर या हटाकर मृत्यु होने देना
definition: allowing a patient's death by withholding or withdrawing life-sustaining treatment, such as a ventilator or feeding tube, rather than directly causing death
example: Over chai, the two nursing students argued whether switching off a ventilator counts as passive euthanasia or simply ending pointless treatment.

hindi: निष्क्रिय शून्यवाद — मूल्यों के खोने पर थककर हार मान लेने वाली मनोदशा
definition: Nietzsche's term for a weary response to lost values, where people sink into resignation and apathy instead of creating something fresh
example: Scrolling for four hours without laughing once, Yash diagnosed himself with passive nihilism.

hindi: निष्क्रिय संश्लेषण — बिना सचेत प्रयास के अनुभवों का अपने-आप जुड़ जाना
definition: Husserl's term for the ways consciousness organises and connects experiences automatically, below deliberate thought, such as grouping similar sounds into one melody
example: Through passive synthesis, Arnav heard the dripping kitchen faucet as one annoying rhythm rather than separate drops.

hindi: निष्क्रिय प्रतिरोधवाद — अन्याय का जवाब हिंसा से न देकर सहन करने का मत
definition: the principle of meeting wrongs with passive, nonviolent endurance rather than force, holding that all violence is unjustified; closely related to pacifism
example: When the neighbour's music thumped past midnight, Arjun's passivism meant earplugs and a polite note, not a shouting match.

hindi: भूतकालीन परिकल्पना — ब्रह्मांड के आरंभ में अत्यंत निम्न एंट्रॉपी की धारणा
definition: the proposal that the universe began with extremely little entropy, meaning a highly ordered state, which explains why disorder keeps increasing and time seems directed
example: Surveying his messy hostel room, Farhan cited the past hypothesis: the room started out tidy, so of course everything since has been downhill.

hindi: पितृवाद — किसी की भलाई के नाम पर उसकी इच्छा के विरुद्ध उसके निर्णयों में दख़ल
definition: interfering with someone's choices against their will, supposedly for their own good, much as a parent overrules a child
example: When the office blocked snack deliveries to keep everyone healthy, Farah called it paternalism with a salad garnish.

hindi: दूरी का भाव — ऊँचे और नीचे के बीच अंतर को महसूस करने की नीत्शे की धारणा
definition: Nietzsche's term for the felt sense of rank separating higher from lower types, which he believed drove people to reach beyond themselves
example: Refusing to share a lift with the interns, the new manager displayed a pathos of distance nobody admired.

hindi: पितृसत्तावाद — राजा की सत्ता को पिता की अपनी संतान पर सत्ता जैसा स्वाभाविक मानने का मत
definition: the doctrine, defended by Filmer, that a ruler's authority over subjects is natural and inherited, just like a father's authority over his children
example: Uncle's patriarchalism reached its peak when he claimed the head of the table also decided everyone's career.

hindi: पितृसत्ता — पुरुषों के वर्चस्व पर टिकी सामाजिक व्यवस्था
definition: a social system in which males hold most power, authority and property, and in which male dominance over women is treated as natural
example: At the family dinner, Neha pointed out the patriarchy at work when every uncle was served first and every aunt ate last.

hindi: समकक्ष-मतभेद — समान योग्यता और साक्ष्य वाले लोगों के बीच असहमति
definition: disagreement between people who are equally intelligent, equally informed and equally careful, which raises the puzzle of whether either side should change their belief
example: Two equally sharp flatmates split the restaurant bill in their heads and got different totals, a tidy little case of peer disagreement.

hindi: पर्स का नियम — शास्त्रीय तर्कशास्त्र का एक सूत्र जो अंतर्ज्ञानवादी तर्क में मान्य नहीं
definition: a formula of classical logic stating that if assuming P implies Q would itself force P, then P must be true; intuitionistic logic, which accepts only claims built by direct proof, rejects it
example: In the logic seminar, Aisha showed that Peirce's law holds on a truth table but cannot be proved without assuming the excluded middle.

hindi: प्रत्यक्षित — प्रत्यक्ष द्वारा मन में बनने वाला किसी वस्तु का अनुभव
definition: the immediate experience or mental impression produced when you perceive something, as distinct from the physical object that caused that experience
example: The teacher said the shape on the whiteboard was a circle, but Dev's percept, thanks to his smudged glasses, was an egg.

hindi: प्रत्यक्ष-प्रामाण्यवाद — जो जैसा दिखता है, उसे वैसा मानने का प्रारंभिक औचित्य स्वयं अनुभव देता है, यह मत
definition: the view that simply having an experience in which something seems to have certain features gives immediate justification for believing it really has those features, though further evidence could overturn that justification
example: Seeing milk in the jug, Nisha leaned on perceptual dogmatism and poured it, only to learn that 'defeasible' means it can turn out to be yoghurt.

hindi: प्रत्यक्ष-सापेक्षता — एक ही वस्तु के भिन्न दर्शकों को भिन्न दिखने का तथ्य
definition: the fact that one object appears differently depending on the observer, lighting, distance or angle, used as evidence that perceived qualities depend partly on the perceiver rather than the object
example: The office thermostat war was pure perceptual relativity: the same room felt freezing to Meenal and stuffy to everyone near the window.

hindi: प्रत्यक्ष-मत — भावों को मूल्यों का एक प्रकार का प्रत्यक्ष अनुभव मानना
definition: the view that emotions work like perceptions, letting people directly sense values such as danger, insult or loss without first forming judgements
example: Reading the landlord's email, Leela felt the insult before she could explain it, just as the perceptual theory of emotion predicts.

hindi: कालखंडवाद — वस्तु समय में फैले अलग-अलग कालिक भागों से बनकर बनी रहती है, यह मत
definition: the view that objects persist through time by having different temporal parts, meaning slices or stages, at different moments, just as a road has parts along its length
example: Late again, Sneha explained through perdurantism that her punctual temporal parts simply belonged to other days of the week.

hindi: सनातन दर्शन — सभी धर्मों के मूल में एक ही रहस्यमय सत्य होने का मत
definition: the view that the mystical traditions of every religion share a single common core truth about ultimate reality, beneath their different doctrines and rituals
example: After comparing festival stories from three cousins' families, Aditi declared a perennial philosophy: every tradition agrees dessert matters.

hindi: शाश्वतवादी शिक्षा-दर्शन — महान ग्रंथों और स्थायी सत्यों पर आधारित शिक्षा का मत
definition: the view in philosophy of education that schooling should centre on enduring truths and the great books of the past, since human nature and wisdom remain constant across ages
example: The principal's perennialism showed when she replaced the coding club's budget with forty copies of Homer.

hindi: पूर्ण कर्तव्य — ऐसा कर्तव्य जिसमें कोई अपवाद या छूट नहीं, जैसे वचन न तोड़ना
definition: in Kantian ethics, a strict duty that never allows exceptions and must always be kept, such as never breaking promises or lying
example: Returning the borrowed calculator was a perfect duty, Rhea reminded her brother, not something to schedule for 'eventually'.

hindi: पूर्णतावाद — मानव स्वभाव की क्षमताओं का पूर्ण विकास ही कल्याण या शुभ है
definition: the view that a person's good consists in developing the capacities central to human nature, such as reason, skill and sociability, to their fullest extent
example: Her flatmate's perfectionism, in the philosophical sense, meant treating chess, cooking and conversation as training for becoming fully human.

hindi: कार्यकारी — जो कहने के साथ ही कार्य संपन्न कर दे
definition: describing words or sentences that carry out an action simply by being spoken in suitable circumstances, rather than reporting some fact
example: Priya noted that "I apologise" is performative, so rolling your eyes while saying it technically still counts.

hindi: कार्यकारी विरोधाभास — कथन की विषयवस्तु का उसे कहने की क्रिया से ही खंडित होना
definition: a statement whose content is contradicted by the very action of making it, such as shouting "I am not speaking" or writing "all writing is pointless"
example: Posting a long essay online about quitting social media was, Neha admitted, a performative contradiction.

hindi: कार्यकारी कथन — ऐसा कथन जो कुछ बताता नहीं, बल्कि कहते ही कार्य कर देता है
definition: a sentence that does something rather than describes something, since saying it under the right conditions performs the action, as in "I promise" or "I resign"
example: "I bet you fifty rupees the train is late" was a performative utterance, and the train, sadly, honoured the wager.

hindi: अरस्तूपंथी सूत्र — बुद्धि में ऐसा कुछ नहीं जो पहले इंद्रियों में न रहा हो
definition: the principle, traced to Aristotle's followers, that nothing enters the intellect without first passing through the senses
example: Tasting the mystery curry, Ritu declared the Peripatetic axiom proven: nothing reaches her opinion before reaching her tongue.

hindi: अरस्तूवाद — अरस्तू और टहलते हुए पढ़ाने वाली उनकी परंपरा का दर्शन
definition: the philosophy of Aristotle and his followers, covering logic, nature, ethics and politics, named after his habit of teaching while walking
example: The professor's peripateticism is literal: she lectures on ethics while pacing the corridor, and the back row follows with laptops open.

hindi: प्रभाव-क्रिया — कथन द्वारा श्रोता पर उत्पन्न किया गया प्रभाव, जैसे डराना या मनाना
definition: the action a speaker achieves by saying something, measured by its effect on the listener, such as persuading, frightening, amusing or annoying them
example: Mum's calm "we'll discuss this later" was a perlocutionary act of pure terror, judging by how fast the dishes got washed.

hindi: प्रभाव-परिणाम — कथन से श्रोता के मन या आचरण पर पड़ा परिणाम
definition: the result that saying something actually has on a listener's feelings, beliefs or behaviour, such as being convinced, scared, cheered or bored
example: The perlocutionary effect of the teacher saying "surprise quiz" was thirty students forgetting everything at once.

hindi: स्थायी क्रांति — क्रांति को राष्ट्रीय सीमाओं और चरणों में रुके बिना आगे बढ़ाने का सिद्धांत
definition: the Marxist doctrine, associated with Trotsky, that a revolution must keep advancing beyond national borders and fixed stages rather than halting at a comfortable point
example: The student union's endless agenda looked less like reform and more like permanent revolution, one poster at a time.

hindi: व्यक्ति-प्रभावी मत — यह मत कि कोई परिणाम तभी बेहतर है जब वह किसी विशेष व्यक्ति के लिए बेहतर हो
definition: the view that an outcome can only be better or worse if it is better or worse for some particular person, so creating extra happy people adds nothing
example: Holding a person-affecting view, Suresh felt no guilt about not adopting a fourth cat that did not yet exist.

hindi: वैयक्तिक तादात्म्य — समय बीतने पर भी किसी व्यक्ति के वही बने रहने का प्रश्न
definition: the philosophical question of what makes a person at a given moment the very same person as someone at a later moment, despite changes in body, memory and character
example: Looking at her awkward school photo, Tanvi wondered whether personal identity really connected her to the girl wearing that haircut.

hindi: व्यक्तिता — पूर्ण नैतिक अधिकारों वाला व्यक्ति होने की अवस्था
definition: the status of being a person with full moral rights, and the debate over which features, such as self-awareness or reasoning, grant that status
example: After the smart speaker apologised politely, the family argued at dinner about whether personhood was getting closer than they thought.

hindi: परिप्रेक्ष्यवाद — हर ज्ञान किसी न किसी दृष्टिकोण से ही होता है, यह नीत्शे का मत
definition: Nietzsche's view that all knowledge comes from some particular viewpoint, so there is no neutral view of the world from nowhere
example: Arguing over whether the room was cold, the office discovered perspectivism depends heavily on who sits under the vent.

hindi: निराशावाद — संसार को मूलतः दुःखमय और बुरा मानने का दार्शनिक मत
definition: the philosophical view, associated with Schopenhauer, that existence is fundamentally marked by suffering and that the world contains more pain than happiness
example: Rhea's pessimism reached new heights when she predicted the office printer would jam before anyone even pressed print.

hindi: निराशावादी पराआगमन — पुराने सफल सिद्धांतों के असत्य निकलने से वर्तमान सिद्धांतों पर संदेह का तर्क
definition: the argument that because many past theories were successful yet later judged false, our current successful theories will probably turn out false too
example: After her grandmother's diet advice flipped for the third decade running, Neha applied pessimistic meta-induction to the latest nutrition headline.

hindi: सूक्ष्म प्रत्यक्ष — लाइबनिज़ के अनुसार अनजाने में होने वाले अति सूक्ष्म अनुभव
definition: Leibniz's term for tiny perceptions, each individually unnoticeable, which together produce conscious experience, like single waves making the roar of the ocean
example: Kavya never noticed the fridge humming until it stopped, proof that her petites perceptions had been listening all along.

hindi: साध्यसम हेत्वाभास — सिद्ध किए जाने वाले निष्कर्ष को ही प्रमाण बना लेने का दोष
definition: the traditional Latin name for begging the question, where an argument slips its own conclusion into the premises, its starting claims, instead of proving that conclusion independently
example: When Kabir insisted his diary was honest because it said so on page one, his philosophy teacher wrote petitio principii in the margin.

hindi: निम्न पूँजीपति वर्ग — छोटे दुकानदारों, कारीगरों और स्वरोज़गारियों का मध्यवर्ती वर्ग
definition: in Marxist theory, the class of small shopkeepers, artisans and self-employed owners, placed between the large capitalists and the wage workers
example: Running his corner stationery shop, Uncle Ravi belonged to the petty bourgeoisie and complained about both big chains and lazy customers.

hindi: शिश्नकेंद्रिकता — भाषा और चिंतन में पुरुष सत्ता को केंद्र में रखने की प्रवृत्ति
definition: the organization of language, culture and thought around masculine power as their central reference point, a pattern that feminist theorists identify and criticize
example: The literature student argued that the novel's phallocentrism showed whenever every female character existed only to admire the hero.

hindi: औषधि-विष — एक ही वस्तु का दवा और ज़हर दोनों होना
definition: a Greek word Derrida reads as meaning both remedy and poison at once, showing how a single term can hold opposite meanings that cannot be separated
example: Coffee at the office was a pharmakon: it rescued the morning and ruined the night.

hindi: परिघटनात्मक चेतना — किसी अनुभव को भीतर से महसूस करने का पहलू
definition: the felt side of the mind, meaning whatever it is like from the inside to taste, hurt, hope or simply be awake at a given moment
example: Stretching on the balcony after a long shift, Divya noted that her phenomenal consciousness was currently one hundred percent sore shoulders.

hindi: प्रतीति-संरक्षणवाद — जैसा प्रतीत हो उसे विरोधी कारण के अभाव में उचित मानने का मत
definition: the view that if something seems true to you, you are thereby justified in believing it, unless you have reasons pointing against it
example: The milk seemed fresh, so Kiran poured it with phenomenal conservatism, pending any defeater from his nose.

hindi: प्रतीति-सिद्धांत — जो कुछ प्रतीत हो, उसे धारण करने वाली कोई वस्तु अवश्य होने का मत
definition: the claim that whenever something sensibly appears to have a quality, there must be something you are aware of which really has that quality, a principle used to argue for sense data, private sensory appearances like patches of colour
example: The bent straw in her lemonade looked crooked, so Ishita, applying the phenomenal principle, demanded to know what exactly was crooked if not the straw.

hindi: प्रतीतिवाद — भौतिक वस्तुओं को वास्तविक और संभावित संवेदनाओं का समूह मानने का मत
definition: the view that statements about physical objects can be translated into statements about actual and possible sense experiences, so an object is nothing beyond the sensations it would produce
example: When asked where the missing remote was, Siddharth's phenomenalism answered that it existed only as the sensations he would have if he checked under the sofa.

hindi: संवृतिशास्त्रीय अपचयन — संसार के अस्तित्व की मान्यता हटाकर शुद्ध अनुभव की ओर लौटना
definition: Husserl's method of suspending belief that the outside world exists and turning attention back to experience itself, describing how things appear to consciousness
example: Stuck in traffic, Neha attempted a phenomenological reduction and found that the commute, described purely as experience, was mostly honking and hunger.

hindi: परिघटनाविज्ञान — अनुभव जैसा भीतर से प्रतीत होता है, उसका अध्ययन
definition: the study of experience as it feels from the inside, describing how things appear to consciousness before asking what lies behind them; developed by Edmund Husserl
example: Describing exactly how the first sip of monsoon chai feels, rather than measuring its temperature, is a small exercise in phenomenology.

hindi: प्रतीति — मन के ढाँचे से होकर अनुभव में आई वस्तु
definition: in Kant's philosophy, a thing as it appears to human experience, already shaped by the mind's built-in forms of space, time and thought
example: On the metro, Dev explained that the train's lateness was a phenomenon, the only train he would ever meet, whatever the timetable was in itself.

hindi: मैत्री — स्नेह और मित्रता, विशेषकर सद्गुण पर टिकी गहरी मित्रता
definition: the Greek word for friendship or affection, which Aristotle said reaches its highest form between good people who value each other's character
example: Their philia survived three flatshares and a disastrous road trip, which Aryan said proved it was the virtue kind.

hindi: दार्शनिक — अस्तित्व, ज्ञान और नैतिकता के मूल प्रश्नों पर गहराई से विचार करने वाला
definition: a person who studies or thinks deeply about basic questions of existence, knowledge, reality, mind and right action
example: After two cups of cutting chai, the rickshaw driver turned philosopher and asked whether traffic was a punishment or a test.

hindi: दार्शनिक राजा — प्लेटो का आदर्श शासक जो ज्ञान और विवेक के बल पर राज्य चलाए
definition: Plato's ideal ruler, a person trained in philosophy whose wisdom and knowledge of the good give them the right to govern the city
example: Tanvi campaigned for class president as a philosopher king, promising decisions based on reason rather than free samosas.

hindi: दार्शनिक प्रज्ञा — परंपरा से आगे बढ़कर स्वयं तर्क करने वाले ज्ञानी का चिंतन
definition: Oruka's term for the thinking of wise elders who reason critically about their own tradition, rather than simply repeating popular wisdom
example: Uncle Otieno questioned the village custom instead of quoting it, which his nephew recognised as philosophic sagacity.

hindi: दार्शनिक विश्लेषण — जटिल अवधारणाओं और कथनों को सरल घटकों में तोड़कर समझने की विधि
definition: the general method of understanding complex concepts, statements or problems by breaking them into simpler, clearer parts and showing how those parts connect
example: Philosophical analysis of 'I'm fine' at the family dinner revealed at least three different hidden meanings.

hindi: दार्शनिक अराजकतावाद — यह मत कि किसी राज्य का आदेश मानने का सामान्य नैतिक कर्तव्य नहीं होता
definition: the view that no state has genuine moral authority and there is no general duty to obey its laws, without necessarily calling for the state's overthrow
example: Rahul's philosophical anarchism stopped short of action: he doubted the state's authority, then paid his parking fine anyway.

hindi: दार्शनिक आत्महत्या — असंगति से बचने के लिए किसी आश्वासनदायी विश्वास में छलाँग लगाना
definition: Camus's term for escaping the absurd by leaping into a comforting belief, such as a religious or rational system, that promises the meaning the world does not show
example: When Sameer embraced a productivity guru after one bad week, his sister called it philosophical suicide by podcast.

hindi: दार्शनिक ज़ॉम्बी — भीतर अनुभवहीन पर बाहर से सामान्य मनुष्य जैसा काल्पनिक प्राणी
definition: an imagined being physically identical to a normal person and behaving exactly the same, yet having no inner experience at all, used to question whether consciousness is purely physical
example: Half asleep in the first lecture, Kunal nodded and took notes like a perfect philosophical zombie with nothing going on inside.

hindi: दर्शन — यथार्थ, ज्ञान और आचरण के मूल प्रश्नों का चिंतन
definition: the study of the deepest questions about reality, knowledge, reason and right conduct; also any guiding system of beliefs held by a person or group
example: Stuck in traffic, the cab driver shared his whole philosophy of life, which mostly involved patience and extra chutney.

hindi: बाल-दर्शन — बच्चों को संवाद द्वारा दार्शनिक प्रश्नों पर सोचने का अभ्यास कराने की पद्धति
definition: a movement and teaching method in which children discuss philosophical questions together as a community of inquiry, a group that reasons aloud and tests ideas jointly, building listening and careful judgement
example: Their philosophy for children session on fairness ended with eight-year-olds proposing a remarkably rigorous rota for the class guinea pig.

hindi: शिक्षा-दर्शन — शिक्षा के लक्ष्यों, विधियों और मूल्यों की दार्शनिक जाँच
definition: the branch of philosophy that studies the aims, methods, values and justification of education, asking what learning is for and who should decide
example: Arguing over whether homework should be banned, the parents' group chat wandered deep into the philosophy of education by midnight.

hindi: ध्वनि-केंद्रवाद — बोली को लेखन से अधिक मूल और प्रामाणिक मानना
definition: Derrida's term for the belief that spoken language is more original, natural and trustworthy than writing, which is treated as a mere copy of speech
example: Insisting a phone call was 'more honest' than texting, Dad revealed a touch of phonocentrism before hanging up mid-sentence.

hindi: छायाचित्रीय पारदर्शिता — छायाचित्र के माध्यम से वस्तु को सचमुच देखने का मत
definition: the view that looking at a photograph lets people literally perceive the pictured object, much as glasses or mirrors allow, unlike looking at a painting
example: Staring at the photo of her grandfather at the family dinner, Nandini liked the idea of photographic transparency: she was seeing him, not a copy.

hindi: व्यावहारिक विवेक — परिस्थिति देखकर उचित निर्णय लेने की बुद्धि
definition: the Greek term for practical wisdom, the skill of seeing what matters in a particular situation and judging well how to live and behave there
example: Knowing when to tell her flatmate the truth about his cooking, and when to just pass the salt, was Zoya's daily exercise in phronesis.

hindi: विवेकी पुरुष — व्यावहारिक विवेक से संपन्न वह व्यक्ति जिसका निर्णय कसौटी माना जाए
definition: the practically wise person in Aristotle's ethics, whose judgement about the right action in each situation serves as the standard for everyone else
example: When the group chat split over the trip budget, everyone waited for Aunt Rekha, the family phronimos, to decide.

hindi: वंशवृक्षीय प्रजाति अवधारणा — साझा पूर्वज-वंश से प्रजाति को पहचानने का मत
definition: the definition of a species as the smallest group of organisms sharing a distinct common ancestry, identified by tracing branches of the evolutionary family tree
example: Using the phylogenetic species concept, Sana's project split one frog into four species, doubling her poster's workload.

hindi: भौतिकवाद — हर अस्तित्व को अंततः भौतिक मानने का मत
definition: the view that everything that exists is ultimately physical, so that even thoughts and feelings are nothing beyond physical processes
example: Clutching his coffee, Aryan argued for physicalism, claiming his morning mood was nothing more than brain chemistry awaiting caffeine.

hindi: चिकित्सक-सहायित आत्महत्या — रोगी द्वारा चिकित्सक से मिली घातक औषधि स्वयं लेना
definition: the practice in which a doctor provides a patient with a terminal illness with lethal medication that the patient then chooses to take themselves
