example: Their podcast episode on physician-assisted suicide ran two hours over because every caller had a different grandparent's story.

hindi: चित्र-सिद्धांत — विटगेंस्टाइन का आरंभिक मत कि वाक्य तथ्यों का तार्किक चित्र होते हैं
definition: the early Wittgenstein's view that a meaningful sentence works like a picture of a possible fact, sharing a logical structure with the situation it represents
example: Sketching the seating plan on a napkin, Yash claimed the picture theory of meaning: the napkin was true only if Aunt Lata sat far from Uncle Mohan.

hindi: चित्रोपम — ऊबड़-खाबड़, अनियमित दृश्य का वह आकर्षण जो सौंदर्य और उदात्त के बीच ठहरता है
definition: an eighteenth-century aesthetic category for scenery that pleases through roughness, irregularity and variety, sitting between calm beauty and the overwhelming sublime
example: Arjun defended his messy balcony garden as a lesson in the picturesque: the crooked pots and wild creepers were entirely deliberate.

hindi: मार्गदर्शक-तरंग सिद्धांत — कणों को तरंग द्वारा निश्चित पथ पर ले जाए जाने का मत
definition: an interpretation of quantum physics on which particles always have definite positions and are steered along exact paths by an accompanying guiding wave
example: Pilot-wave theory, Zoya explained in the lab, is like every electron having a very bossy satnav.

hindi: पिलपुल — तलमूद के अध्ययन में सूक्ष्म भेदों पर आधारित तीक्ष्ण तर्क-पद्धति
definition: a method of intense argument over the Talmud, the vast collection of rabbinic legal debate, drawing very fine distinctions between passages to reconcile or sharpen them, sometimes criticised as hairsplitting
example: Arguing over whether a sandwich counts as a snack, the office slipped into pilpul so fine that lunch went cold.

hindi: पिनोकियो विरोधाभास — 'मेरी नाक अब बढ़ेगी' कहने से उपजा असत्यवादी जैसा उलझाव
definition: a playful liar-style puzzle in which Pinocchio, whose nose grows only when he says something false, announces that his nose is about to grow
example: Ishaan tried the Pinocchio paradox on his little sister's talking toy, which simply played its jingle and refused to engage.

hindi: संभाव्य — जो प्रामाणिक न होकर भी विश्वसनीय प्रतीत हो
definition: the persuasive or plausible impression, which the sceptic Carneades said could guide practical action even when certain knowledge stays impossible
example: Without proof the shortcut was faster, Arnav followed the pithanon of the map app and hoped for the best.

hindi: प्लेटो की दाढ़ी — अस्तित्वहीन वस्तुओं के बारे में बोलने की उलझन
definition: Quine's name for the tangled puzzle of how we can truly say that something does not exist without seeming to refer to it
example: Saying the office unicorn employee does not exist, Sana admitted she had tripped over Plato's beard again.

hindi: प्लेटोनिक प्रेम — शारीरिक सौंदर्य से ऊपर उठकर सौंदर्य के प्रत्यय तक पहुँचने वाला प्रेम
definition: originally, Plato's idea of love that rises from attraction to one beautiful person towards love of Beauty itself, today also meaning deep affection without romance
example: Everyone at the hostel assumed Kunal and Aisha were dating, but their Platonic love mostly consisted of splitting pizza and proofreading each other's essays.

hindi: प्लेटोवादी यथार्थवाद — सामान्यों को वस्तुओं से अलग, स्वतंत्र और शाश्वत सत्ता मानने का मत
definition: the view, drawn from Plato, that universals exist independently of the physical things that have them, outside space and time
example: Gazing at a flawless triangle drawn by the geometry software, Reyansh said Platonic realism finally made sense, unlike his own hand-drawn triangles.

hindi: प्लेटोवाद — प्लेटो के प्रत्यय सिद्धांत पर आधारित दार्शनिक परंपरा
definition: any philosophy following Plato in holding that abstract objects, such as numbers and Forms, exist independently of minds and of the physical world
example: The maths teacher's Platonism came out when she insisted the number seven would exist even if everyone forgot how to count.

hindi: पूर्ण दिक् — ऐसा दिक् जो पूरी तरह पदार्थ से भरा हो और जिसमें कोई रिक्तता न हो
definition: space conceived as completely filled with matter, leaving no empty region anywhere, as Descartes and many ancient thinkers held
example: Opening her overstuffed wardrobe, Tanya declared it a true plenum: not one empty region anywhere, and certainly no room for new shoes.

hindi: लोभ — अपने उचित भाग से अधिक पाने की लालसा का दुर्गुण
definition: the Greek term for grasping greed, the vice of always wanting more than your fair share of goods, honour or advantage
example: Taking the last three parathas before anyone else sat down, Vikram displayed pleonexia worthy of a textbook.

hindi: प्राण-वायु — अग्नि और वायु से बना, जगत में व्याप्त सक्रिय तत्त्व
definition: in Stoic physics, the fiery, breath-like active force that runs through all matter, holding objects together and giving living beings their life
example: During the power cut, Zara joked that the ceiling fan had finally lost its pneuma.

hindi: पूर्व-लांछन दोष — बोलने से पहले ही वक्ता को बदनाम कर उसकी बात को कमज़ोर करना
definition: the fallacy of attacking someone's character or motives in advance, so that listeners distrust anything that person later says
example: Before Ananya even presented her budget, Raj was poisoning the well by reminding everyone she once lost the office stapler.

hindi: नगर-राज्य — प्राचीन यूनान का स्वशासित नगर, जिसे अरस्तू मानव जीवन का स्वाभाविक समुदाय मानते थे
definition: the ancient Greek city-state, seen by Aristotle as the natural political community in which human beings can live a complete and good life
example: Their apartment complex, with its own market, temple and gossip network, felt to Meenal like a small modern polis.

hindi: सामाजिक-राजनीतिक प्राणी — मनुष्य का स्वभावतः समुदाय और नगर-राज्य में रहने वाला होना
definition: Aristotle's description of human beings as creatures whose nature is fulfilled only by living together in communities and sharing in public life
example: Unable to last one evening without checking the housing society WhatsApp group, Gopal admitted he was a political animal.

hindi: राजनीतिक सत्ता — राज्य का आदेश देने और आज्ञापालन की अपेक्षा रखने का अधिकार
definition: the right of a government or state to issue commands and make laws that its subjects have a real duty to obey, not merely a power to force them
example: The hostel warden had a whistle and a clipboard, but the students debated whether he had any actual political authority.

hindi: राजनीतिक दायित्व — नागरिक का राज्य के कानून मानने का नैतिक कर्तव्य
definition: the moral duty, if there is one, that citizens have to obey the laws of their state simply because those laws come from their state
example: Stopping at a red light on an empty street at 2 a.m., Nikhil wondered whether this was political obligation or just habit.

hindi: मान्यता की राजनीति — पहचान और गरिमा की सार्वजनिक स्वीकृति के लिए संघर्ष
definition: the view, developed by Taylor and Honneth, that social justice requires not only fair distribution of goods but respectful public acknowledgement of people's identities and dignity
example: The staff petition to pronounce everyone's names correctly was, Rehan argued, the politics of recognition on a small scale.

hindi: न्यायवाक्य-श्रृंखला — कई न्यायवाक्यों को जोड़कर बना लंबा तर्क
definition: a chain of syllogisms linked together so that the conclusion of one syllogism serves as a premise of the next, building a longer argument
example: Karan's polysyllogism about why the team needed a new coffee machine had four steps and ended, somehow, with a pay rise.

hindi: बहुदेववाद — अनेक देवी-देवताओं के अस्तित्व और उनकी उपासना की मान्यता
definition: the view that many distinct deities exist, each usually with its own powers, character and area of the world, and that several deserve worship
example: Planning the festival calendar in the office, Nisha explained that the polytheism of her family's tradition meant several deities, each with its own feast day to mark.

hindi: लोक संप्रभुता — सर्वोच्च सत्ता का अंतिम स्रोत जनता को मानने का सिद्धांत
definition: the principle that supreme political authority belongs to the people as a whole, who are the final source of every government's power
example: When the class voted to move the picnic, the teacher bowed to popular sovereignty and quietly cancelled the museum trip.

hindi: जनसंख्या नीतिशास्त्र — भविष्य में कितने और कैसे लोग हों, इस पर नैतिक विचार
definition: the branch of ethics that asks how to value outcomes containing different numbers of people, including whether adding more happy people makes the world better
example: A dinner debate about having kids drifted into population ethics, until someone asked whether future people also have to do the dishes.

hindi: जनसंख्या-दृष्टि — प्रजाति को विविध व्यक्तियों की आबादी के रूप में समझना
definition: the approach in biology that treats a species as a varied population of individuals, where variation itself matters, rather than as copies of an ideal type
example: Farah used population thinking at the bakery, noticing that no single samosa was the 'true' samosa, only a varied batch.

hindi: लोकवाद — आम जनता को अभिजात वर्ग के विरुद्ध खड़ा करने वाली राजनीति
definition: in political theory, the outlook that pits ordinary people, seen as honest and united, against a corrupt or privileged elite who hold power
example: The class president candidate's populism peaked when he promised to abolish homework on behalf of 'the real students'.

hindi: आधार-कल्पना — तर्क आगे बढ़ाने के लिए सत्य मान लिया गया कथन
definition: in logic, a claim assumed to be true without proof so that an argument or theory can be built on top of it
example: The whole plan for the road trip rested on one posit: that the car would start.

hindi: दृढ़ अनीश्वरवाद — यह स्पष्ट दावा कि कोई ईश्वर नहीं है
definition: the view that firmly asserts that no deity exists, going beyond simply lacking belief in any deity
example: At the dinner table, Ishaan stated his positive atheism outright, insisting he did not merely lack belief in a deity but held there definitely was none.

hindi: सकारात्मक स्वतंत्रता — अपने जीवन को स्वयं दिशा देने की वास्तविक क्षमता के अर्थ में स्वतंत्रता
definition: freedom understood as the real ability to control your life and pursue your goals, rather than merely lacking outside interference
example: Signing up for coding lessons, Imran said he wanted positive liberty: nobody was stopping him from building apps, but now he could actually do it.

hindi: सकारात्मक अधिकार — दूसरों से किसी वस्तु या सेवा को पाने के अधिकार, जैसे शिक्षा या चिकित्सा
definition: rights that entitle a person to receive something from others, such as schooling or healthcare, placing duties on others to provide it
example: Explaining positive rights, Pooja said free school lunches are not charity but something the state owes every child.

hindi: प्रत्यक्षवाद — केवल अवलोकन और विज्ञान से सिद्ध ज्ञान को मान्य मानने का मत
definition: the view that genuine knowledge comes only from what can be observed and tested scientifically, rejecting intuition, revelation and speculation as sources
example: Anil's positivism shows at dinner, where he refuses to believe the new diet works until someone shows him an actual study.

hindi: संभाव्यवाद — यह मत कि केवल संभव वस्तुएँ भी किसी अर्थ में होती हैं
definition: the view that there are merely possible objects, things that could have existed but do not actually exist, and that these belong among what there is
example: Meera's possibilism let her count the unbaked cakes she could have made this weekend as part of her baking portfolio.

hindi: संभावना — जो किसी स्थिति में सत्य हो सकता है, उसका गुण
definition: the property of a statement or state of affairs that could be true, holding in at least one possible world even when false in the actual world
example: Karan insisted that winning the chess tournament remained a genuine possibility, even after losing his queen on move nine.

hindi: ग्राही बुद्धि — वह बौद्धिक क्षमता जो सामान्य धारणाओं को ग्रहण करती है
definition: the receptive power of the mind that takes in and holds general concepts once the active intellect has drawn them out of experience
example: Cramming for the exam, Rohan felt his possible intellect was a sponge already full of the syllabus.

hindi: संभाव्य जगत — वे पूर्ण वैकल्पिक स्थितियाँ जिनमें संसार अन्यथा हो सकता था
definition: complete alternative ways the whole universe could have been, used by philosophers to explain what is possible, what is necessary and what might have happened instead
example: Stuck in traffic, Aarav comforted himself that in several possible worlds he had left home ten minutes earlier and was already eating breakfast.

hindi: संभव-जगत अर्थविज्ञान — अर्थ को विभिन्न संभव स्थितियों में सत्यता से समझाने की पद्धति
definition: an approach that explains the meaning of words and sentences, especially about possibility and necessity, by describing their truth or reference across many alternative ways the world could have been
example: Using possible worlds semantics, Omar argued there was at least one world where his team met the deadline, sadly not this one.

hindi: कालानुक्रम-कारण दोष — केवल बाद में घटने से पहली घटना को कारण मान लेना
definition: the fallacy of assuming that because one event followed another, the earlier event must have caused the later one
example: Ishaan wore his lucky socks and passed the exam, and now nothing will convince him it was post hoc ergo propter hoc.

hindi: उत्तर-विश्लेषणात्मक दर्शन — विश्लेषणात्मक परंपरा से निकलकर उसकी सीमाओं पर सवाल उठाने वाला दर्शन
definition: philosophy that grew out of the analytic tradition but questions its hopes for final analysis and strict method, often drawing on pragmatism and other traditions
example: Ira described her professor as a post-analytic philosopher: trained to define every term, now suspicious that definitions ever settle anything.

hindi: पश्च प्रायिकता — प्रमाण देखने के बाद किसी परिकल्पना पर संशोधित विश्वास की मात्रा
definition: the revised probability of a hypothesis after taking evidence into account, calculated from the prior probability and the evidence using Bayes' theorem
example: After spotting the delivery bike outside, Pooja's posterior probability that dinner was arriving shot upward.

hindi: उत्तरमानववाद — मनुष्य को विशेष और केंद्र मानने की परंपरागत मानवतावादी धारणा पर प्रश्न उठाने वाला दर्शन
definition: a philosophy that questions the traditional humanist picture of humans as unique, separate and central, stressing human entanglement with animals, machines and the environment
example: In the seminar on posthumanism, Aditi argued that her phone was already part of her mind, and nobody could quite disagree.

hindi: मरणोत्तर हानि — मृत्यु के बाद की घटनाओं से मृत व्यक्ति के हितों को पहुँचने वाली क्षति
definition: harm that events after a person's death, such as broken promises or a ruined reputation, are said to cause that person, by defeating interests they held while alive
example: When the group chat mocked Grandpa's secret recipe the week after his funeral, Nisha insisted the jokes still counted as posthumous harm to him.

hindi: उत्तर-आधुनिक दशा — महाआख्यानों में विश्वास खो चुकी समाज की अवस्था
definition: Lyotard's phrase for the state of advanced societies in which people have lost faith in grand, universal stories that once justified knowledge and progress
example: Scrolling through twelve competing explanations of the same news, Tara felt the postmodern condition settle in before breakfast.

hindi: उत्तर-आधुनिकतावाद — सार्वभौम सत्य, प्रगति और महाआख्यानों पर संदेह करने वाली प्रवृत्ति
definition: a broad late twentieth-century outlook marked by suspicion of universal truths, objective knowledge and stories of progress, favouring irony, plurality and local perspectives
example: The restaurant's menu mixed fusion tacos, ironic retro posters and three competing origin stories, which Meera called postmodernism with extra cheese.

hindi: उत्तर-परिघटनाविज्ञान — तकनीक के माध्यम से मनुष्य और संसार के संबंध का अध्ययन
definition: a philosophy of technology, grown from phenomenology (the study of lived experience), that studies how devices shape human perception, action and meaning
example: Noticing that her glasses changed how she read faces across a room, Aditi gave the book club a short lesson in postphenomenology.

hindi: उत्तर-संरचनावाद — संरचनाओं की स्थिरता और अर्थ की निश्चितता पर संदेह करने वाली विचारधारा
definition: a movement that grew from structuralism but denies that language and culture form stable, closed systems, stressing instead that meaning is unstable, shifting and shaped by power
example: Arjun's poststructuralism survived the whole seminar until the teacher asked whether the exam instructions had a stable meaning too.

hindi: अभिगृहीत — तर्क की नींव के रूप में बिना प्रमाण स्वीकारा गया कथन
definition: in logic and mathematics, a statement accepted as true without proof so that further reasoning can be built upon it
example: The group project began from one shaky postulate: that someone else had already made the slides.

hindi: व्यावहारिक बुद्धि की मान्यताएँ — ईश्वर, स्वतंत्रता और अमरत्व की नैतिक पूर्वधारणाएँ
definition: Kant's claim that moral life requires believing in freedom, the soul's immortality and a deity, though none of these can be proved by theoretical reasoning
example: Their ethics teacher described the postulates of practical reason as the beliefs you need to keep trying to be good even when nobody is watching.

hindi: अभिधारणा — बिना प्रमाण के तर्क का आधार मान ली गई बात
definition: the action of assuming something as true without proof, so that it can serve as a starting point for an argument or theory
example: Every board game night begins with the same postulation: nobody flips the table, however badly Monopoly goes.

hindi: निरपेक्ष सामर्थ्य — ईश्वर की वह शक्ति जो तर्कसंगत रूप से संभव सब कुछ कर सकती है
definition: the scholastic idea of the deity's absolute power, meaning everything it could do without contradiction, as opposed to what it has actually chosen to ordain
example: Siddharth said the landlord's potentia absoluta included raising the rent, but his chosen order, thankfully, did not.

hindi: संभाव्य अनंत — ऐसा अनंत जो कभी पूरा न होकर बस आगे बढ़ता रहता है
definition: infinity understood as an endless process that can always continue further, such as counting, without ever forming a completed infinite whole
example: Scrolling through her feed after midnight, Sana realised the timeline was a potential infinity: always another post, never a final one.

hindi: संभाव्यता — किसी वस्तु की कुछ और बन सकने या कुछ कर सकने की क्षमता
definition: Aristotle's term for the capacity a thing has to become something else or to perform some activity, like an acorn's capacity to grow into a tree
example: Looking at the pile of unwashed dishes, Priya said they had great potentiality for becoming clean, if only someone would help.

hindi: संभाव्यता तर्क — भ्रूण के भावी व्यक्ति बनने की क्षमता से उसके अधिकार सिद्ध करना
definition: the argument that an embryo or foetus deserves protection because it has the natural potential to develop into a person with full moral rights
example: Holding an acorn in biology class, Omar cheekily applied the potentiality argument and demanded it be treated as a forest.

hindi: उद्दीपन-अभाव तर्क — सीमित अनुभव से समृद्ध ज्ञान बनने के आधार पर जन्मजात क्षमता का तर्क
definition: the argument that children learn language and concepts far richer than the thin evidence they hear, so some knowledge must be inborn
example: Hearing her nephew invent perfect grammar he had never heard, Kavya muttered something about the poverty of the stimulus.

hindi: सत्ता-ज्ञान — सत्ता और ज्ञान के अविभाज्य संबंध का सिद्धांत
definition: Foucault's idea that power and knowledge are bound together, since knowledge creates power over people and power decides which knowledge counts
example: The doctor's chart and the nurse's schedule showed power-knowledge at work: whoever wrote the records also decided the patient's day.

hindi: व्यावहारिक बुद्धि — कर्म का निर्णय करने और नैतिक नियम देने वाली बुद्धि
definition: reason used to decide what to do rather than what is true, which Kant believed could itself supply moral rules
example: Practical reason told Divya to start the assignment tonight, while every other part of her mind voted for another episode.

hindi: व्यावहारिक प्रज्ञा — ठोस परिस्थितियों में उचित कर्म पहचानने की विवेक-क्षमता
definition: the practical skill of judging well which action suits a particular situation, weighing what matters and choosing the fitting response, which Aristotle called phronesis
example: Their manager showed practical wisdom by moving the meeting when she saw half the team yawning into their coffee.

hindi: आस्था की भूमिका — वे सत्य जो केवल तर्क से सिद्ध होकर आस्था की नींव बनते हैं
definition: the preambles of faith, meaning truths such as the existence of the deity that scholastic thinkers held reason alone can prove before faith builds on them
example: Before joining the cricket club, Nikhil demanded the praeambula fidei: proof that the pitch actually existed and the tea was free.

hindi: व्यावहारिक सूत्र — किसी विचार का अर्थ उसके व्यावहारिक परिणामों से स्पष्ट करने का नियम
definition: Peirce's rule that the meaning of any concept is fully captured by the practical effects we would expect if the concept were true
example: When the group chat argued about whether the phone was waterproof, Kiran applied the pragmatic maxim and asked what would actually happen if they dropped it in the sink.

hindi: सत्य का व्यवहारवादी सिद्धांत — जो विचार व्यवहार में सफल हो, वही सत्य है यह मत
definition: the view that a belief is true when it works: when acting on it succeeds, when it survives testing, or when inquiry would finally settle upon it
example: By the pragmatic theory of truth, Arjun said, his belief that the shortcut saved time was true, since he had reached school early every morning this week.

hindi: व्यावहारिक समर्थन — आगमन को यह दिखाकर उचित ठहराना कि यदि कोई विधि सफल होगी तो वही होगी
definition: Reichenbach's defence of induction: even without proving that induction works, we can show that if any method of predicting succeeds, induction will succeed too
example: Kabir offered a pragmatic vindication of checking the weather apps: if anything predicts the monsoon, surely those forecasts will.

hindi: पर्स का व्यवहारवाद — पर्स द्वारा अपने व्यवहारवाद को लोकप्रिय रूपों से अलग करने हेतु दिया गया नया नाम
definition: the name Peirce gave his own version of pragmatism, chosen to separate it from looser popular versions and described by him as ugly enough to stay safe from kidnappers
example: Arnav insisted his essay was about pragmaticism, not pragmatism, and the teacher had to admire the precision.

hindi: प्रयोगार्थविज्ञान — संदर्भ में भाषा के प्रयोग और अर्थ का अध्ययन
definition: the study of how context shapes meaning, covering what speakers imply, assume and accomplish beyond the literal content of their words
example: Pragmatics is why "do you know what time it is?" from your mother is not really asking about the clock.

hindi: व्यवहारवाद — विचारों के अर्थ और सत्य को उनके व्यावहारिक परिणामों से आँकने का मत
definition: the philosophical view that the meaning and truth of an idea lie in its practical consequences, in what difference believing it makes
example: In a spirit of pragmatism, the flatmates stopped debating who was right about the dishwasher and asked which method left fewer greasy plates.

hindi: प्रशंसनीयता — किसी कर्म के कारण सराहना के योग्य होने का गुण
definition: the property of deserving praise for an action, which depends on whether the person acted with enough control, knowledge and genuine regard for others
example: Rahul questioned the praiseworthiness of donating the office's leftover pizza, since he only did it to clear the fridge.

hindi: प्रज्ञा — वस्तुओं के वास्तविक स्वरूप की अंतर्दृष्टि
definition: the Buddhist term for wisdom or insight, the direct understanding of impermanence, suffering, emptiness and the absence of self
example: Reading the fine print before signing up, Omar showed a rare moment of prajna.

hindi: प्रकृति — मूल जड़ प्रकृति, जिससे मन, इंद्रियाँ और समस्त भौतिक जगत विकसित होते हैं
definition: in Samkhya and Yoga, primal nature or matter, the single unconscious source from which body, mind, senses and the whole physical world unfold
example: Staring at the overflowing laundry basket, Priya decided that prakriti was clearly evolving faster than she could fold it.

hindi: प्रमाण — यथार्थ ज्ञान प्राप्त करने का वैध साधन
definition: in Indian philosophy, a valid source or means of knowledge, such as perception, inference, comparison or reliable testimony, that yields true knowledge
example: Asked how she knew the cake was gone, Maya listed her pramana: she saw the empty plate and her brother had crumbs on his shirt.

hindi: प्रमेय — वह विषय जो प्रमाण द्वारा जाना जाता है
definition: in Nyaya philosophy, an object of valid knowledge, anything that can be known through the proper sources such as perception or inference
example: Whether the leftover pizza still existed was a prameya that Ayaan resolved by opening the fridge.

hindi: प्रपत्ति — ईश्वर के प्रति पूर्ण शरणागति
definition: complete surrender to the deity Vishnu, taught in Vishishtadvaita as a path to liberation open to everyone regardless of learning
example: After three failed attempts at the tax form, Dhruv practised prapatti and handed everything to his accountant.

hindi: प्रारब्ध कर्म — वर्तमान जीवन में फल देने लगा हुआ कर्म
definition: the portion of stored karma that has already begun to bear results in the present life and must simply be lived through
example: Stuck behind every slow walker on the commute, Aisha blamed her prarabdha karma and plugged in her headphones.

hindi: प्रासंगिक — केवल विरोधी मतों के दोष दिखाने वाली माध्यमिक शाखा
definition: a branch of Madhyamaka Buddhism that refuses to defend positive claims of its own, and instead shows that every opposing view leads to absurd consequences
example: Karan argued like a Prasangika at dinner, never stating his own opinion, only dismantling everyone else's.

hindi: प्रस्थानत्रयी — उपनिषद्, भगवद्गीता और ब्रह्मसूत्र, वेदान्त के तीन मूल ग्रंथ
definition: the three foundational texts of Vedanta, namely the Upanishads, the Bhagavad Gita and the Brahma Sutras, which every major school must interpret
example: Rohan called his three favourite cookbooks his kitchen prasthanatrayi, since every family recipe dispute ended with one of them.

hindi: प्रतिभा — भर्तृहरि के दर्शन में अर्थ का अचानक, सहज और पूर्ण बोध
definition: in the Indian philosopher Bhartrhari's thought, a sudden intuitive flash in which the whole meaning of something is grasped at once
example: The punchline landed a beat late, but when the pratibha struck, Gauri laughed louder than anyone.

hindi: प्रातिभासिक — केवल आभास का, स्वप्न या भ्रम जैसा सत्य
definition: belonging to the merely apparent level of reality, like dreams or illusions, which seem real only while they last and vanish on waking
example: Vikram's midnight plan to become a millionaire turned out to be purely pratibhasika by breakfast.

hindi: प्रतिबिम्बवाद — जीव को अविद्या में ब्रह्म का प्रतिबिम्ब मानने का मत
definition: the Advaita theory that the individual self is a reflection of Brahman in ignorance or mind, like the moon reflected in many water pots
example: Looking at her face in five shop windows on the walk home, Ira finally understood pratibimbavada.

hindi: प्रतिक्रमण — भूलों पर विचार कर पश्चाताप करने की जैन साधना
definition: the Jain ritual of reflecting on one's faults and expressing regret for harm caused, performed regularly to turn the mind back toward right conduct
example: After snapping at his mother on the phone, Karan did a quiet pratikramana on the metro and called her back to apologise.

hindi: प्रतीत्यसमुत्पाद — बौद्ध सिद्धांत कि प्रत्येक वस्तु अन्य कारणों और परिस्थितियों पर निर्भर होकर उत्पन्न होती है
definition: the Buddhist doctrine of dependent origination: nothing exists independently, and every thing or mental state arises only in dependence on other causes and conditions
example: Watching the queue at the canteen collapse because one person paused, Tenzin called it pratityasamutpada in miniature.

hindi: प्रत्याहार — इंद्रियों को बाहरी विषयों से हटाकर भीतर लाना
definition: in Yoga philosophy, the fifth limb of the eight-limbed path, withdrawing the senses from outside objects so that attention turns inward toward meditation
example: Wearing noise-cancelling headphones on the crowded metro, Sameer called it pratyahara, though his neighbour called it ignoring her.

hindi: प्रत्यक्ष — इंद्रियों और विषय के संपर्क से होने वाला सीधा ज्ञान
definition: in Indian philosophy, perception, the source of valid knowledge that comes from direct contact between the senses and their objects
example: Rahul doubted the forecast until pratyaksha settled it: he stepped outside and got soaked.

hindi: सिद्धांत-निष्ठ कर्म — विचार और परिवर्तनकारी व्यवहार की एकता
definition: in Marxist and critical thought, practical activity guided by theory that aims to change the world, uniting thinking and doing
example: After a semester of reading about waste, the hostel students turned to praxis and finally built the compost bin.

hindi: प्रायश्चित्त — किए गए दोष के निवारण हेतु किया गया कर्म
definition: an action of atonement or penance performed to cancel out the moral harm of a wrongdoing
example: After forgetting his sister's birthday, Varun's prayashchitta was a very large cake and a very long apology.

hindi: पूर्वस्थापित सामंजस्य — ईश्वर द्वारा आरंभ से ही मन और शरीर का तालमेल बिठा देने का लाइबनिज़ीय सिद्धांत
definition: Leibniz's theory that minds and bodies never truly affect each other, but were arranged by the deity at creation to unfold in perfect step, like clocks keeping identical time
example: Riya and her twin always ordered the same pizza from different cities, which their mother called pre-established harmony and their father called a shared app.

hindi: एहतियाती सिद्धांत — गंभीर हानि की आशंका हो तो पूर्ण प्रमाण से पहले ही बचाव करने का नियम
definition: the principle that when an action threatens serious or irreversible harm, protective measures should be taken even before the danger is fully proven by science
example: Invoking the precautionary principle, Dad refused to eat the leftover biryani of unknown age, however fragrant it smelled.

hindi: पूर्वनियति — ईश्वर द्वारा प्रत्येक आत्मा की नियति पहले से तय होने का सिद्धांत
definition: the religious doctrine that a deity has decided in advance the eternal destiny of every soul, including who will be saved
example: In a heated study group, Leah argued predestination was different from fatalism, because it concerned souls rather than bus timetables.

hindi: विधेय — वाक्य में उद्देश्य के बारे में कही गई बात
definition: in logic, the part of a statement that says something about its subject, such as 'is mortal' in 'Socrates is mortal'
example: In 'the chai is too sweet', the predicate is 'too sweet', and it is also Nani's entire review.

hindi: विधेय तर्कशास्त्र — कथनों के भीतर वस्तुओं, गुणों और परिमाणकों का तर्कशास्त्र
definition: the branch of formal logic that looks inside statements at objects, their properties and relations, and uses quantifiers like 'every' and 'some'
example: Only predicate logic, Ananya argued, could capture her claim that every flatmate owes someone at least one bottle of milk.

hindi: विधेय-नामवाद — वस्तुओं के समान गुण को केवल एक ही शब्द के लागू होने से समझाने का मत
definition: the view that there are no universals, and that things share a property only in the sense that the same predicate, a describing word, applies truly to them
example: According to Samar's predicate nominalism, all his friends were cool only because the word applied to them, which he admitted was a generous use of the word.

hindi: विधेयन — किसी विषय पर कोई गुण आरोपित करने की क्रिया
definition: in logic, the action of saying that some quality or property belongs to a subject, as when a sentence calls the soup cold
example: 'Monday is exhausting' is a predication the whole office would sign without reading.

hindi: विधेयवाद — ऐसी परिभाषाओं को नकारने का मत जो परिभाषित वस्तु वाले पूरे समूह पर ही टिकी हों
definition: the view that mathematics should employ only definitions that avoid circularity, never defining an object by referring to a whole collection that already includes that object
example: When the club defined its best player as whoever the best players voted for, Esha's predicativism kicked in and she demanded a less circular rule.

hindi: अग्रक्रमण — एक कारण द्वारा दूसरे संभावित कारण को प्रभाव डालने से पहले ही रोक देना
definition: a case where one cause brings about an effect and thereby stops a backup cause that would otherwise have produced the same effect, troubling counterfactual theories
example: Meher's reply-all apology was pure preemption: the boss had been drafting a scolding that never needed sending.

hindi: प्रस्तावना विरोधाभास — हर कथन पर विश्वास पर पूरी पुस्तक में भूल की स्वीकृति
definition: the puzzle of an author who rationally believes every claim in their book yet also rationally believes that somewhere the book contains a mistake
example: Submitting her thesis, Radhika faced the preface paradox: she stood behind every sentence but was certain a typo lurked somewhere.

hindi: इच्छा-उपयोगितावाद — लोगों की इच्छाओं और पसंदों की अधिकतम पूर्ति को सही मानने का मत
definition: the form of utilitarianism holding that right actions satisfy the preferences and desires of everyone affected as fully as possible, rather than maximizing pleasure itself
example: Choosing the team lunch spot by poll was pure preference utilitarianism, even if the winning pizza place made nobody especially happy.

hindi: वांछनीय उदासीन — स्वास्थ्य, धन आदि जो चुनने योग्य हैं पर सद्गुण नहीं
definition: in Stoic ethics, things like health, wealth and reputation that are reasonable to choose but make no difference to whether a life is truly good
example: Rahul filed his salary hike under preferred indifferents, then immediately upgraded his headphones.

hindi: विपत्ति-पूर्वचिंतन — संभावित कष्टों की पहले से कल्पना कर मन को तैयार करना
definition: the Stoic exercise of calmly imagining misfortunes in advance, such as loss or failure, so that they cause less shock and distress when they arrive
example: Before the client presentation, Mira practised premeditatio malorum: projector failure, frozen laptop, and a surprise question about last year's figures.

hindi: आधार-वाक्य — वह कथन जिसे तर्क में निष्कर्ष के समर्थन हेतु स्वीकार किया जाता है
definition: a statement offered within an argument as a reason or support for accepting its conclusion, taken as given for the purpose of that argument
example: Kavya accepted the conclusion that pizza was cheaper but challenged the premise that anyone would actually cook the vegetables they had bought.

hindi: आदेशवाद — नैतिक कथनों को तथ्य नहीं, आचरण के निर्देश मानने का मत
definition: the view in ethics that moral statements work like instructions, telling people what to do rather than describing facts about the world
example: Anika's prescriptivism shows in the flat group chat, where 'stealing yogurt is wrong' really just means 'hands off my yogurt'.

hindi: विद्यमानता — किसी वस्तु को उपयोग से हटाकर केवल देखी जाने वाली चीज़ मानना
definition: Heidegger's term for the manner in which things appear when detached from practical usage and simply observed or studied, as a broken hammer suddenly does
example: Once the stapler jammed, it shifted into presence-at-hand, and the whole office gathered to stare at it.

hindi: प्रस्तुतिपरक — मन के सामने सीधे उपस्थित अनुभव से संबंधित
definition: in philosophy and psychology, relating to what is directly present to the mind in experience, such as colours and sounds, before any interpretation
example: Before she recognised it as her ringtone, the sound was just a presentational blur of chirps in a noisy train carriage.

hindi: वर्तमानवाद — केवल वर्तमान को ही वास्तविक मानने का मत
definition: the view in philosophy of time that only present things truly exist, while the past no longer exists and the future does not exist yet
example: Stuck in traffic, Vikram adopted presentism: yesterday's plans were gone, tomorrow's meeting wasn't real, and only this red light existed.

hindi: अनुमानित सहमति — स्पष्ट इनकार न होने पर सहमति मान लेने की नीति
definition: the policy of treating a person as agreeing to something, such as organ donation after death, unless they have explicitly opted out
example: When the office assumed everyone wanted the birthday cake fund, Ishaan grumbled that presumed consent had reached the break room.

hindi: पूर्वमान्यता — कथन में पहले से मानकर चली गई बात
definition: background information a sentence takes for granted in order to make sense, such as "the king of France is bald" assuming France has a king
example: "Have you stopped hogging the remote?" carried a presupposition that Rohan refused to accept either way.

hindi: पूर्वमान्यता-विफलता — कथन की आधारभूत मान्यता का असत्य निकलना
definition: the situation in which the background assumption a sentence depends upon is false, leaving the sentence neither clearly true nor clearly false
example: "Your reply to my email was rude" ended in presupposition failure, since Meena had never replied at all.

hindi: प्रथमदृष्ट्या कर्तव्य — ऐसा कर्तव्य जो तब तक बाध्यकारी है जब तक कोई प्रबल कर्तव्य उसे न हटाए
definition: Ross's term for a genuine duty that binds unless a stronger competing duty outweighs it in the particular situation
example: Keeping her lunch plans was a prima facie duty for Anjali, until her flatmate's emergency took priority.

hindi: अस्तित्व की प्राथमिकता — सार के बजाय अस्तित्व को मूल वास्तविकता मानने का मत
definition: Mulla Sadra's doctrine that existence, not essence, is what is fundamentally real, while essences are only mental outlines drawn around existing things
example: Hana argued for the primacy of existence during dinner: the idea of dessert was nice, but the actual cake was what mattered.

hindi: मूल प्रभाव — वर्तमान क्षण की सीधी, ताज़ी अनुभूति
definition: Husserl's term for the fresh, present-moment phase of experience in time-consciousness, held between the fading just-past and the anticipated about-to-come
example: The primal impression of the first sip of chai was perfect; everything afterwards was merely memory and hope.

hindi: प्राथमिक वस्तुएँ — अधिकार, स्वतंत्रता, अवसर, आय और आत्मसम्मान जैसे साधन जो हर जीवन-योजना में काम आते हैं
definition: Rawls's term for things every rational person wants whatever their plans, such as rights, liberties, opportunities, income, wealth and the basis of self-respect
example: Moving into the hostel, Ishaan listed his primary goods: a working plug point, reliable Wi-Fi and the right to close his door.

hindi: प्राथमिक गुण — आकार, विस्तार, गति जैसे वस्तु में स्वयं निहित गुण
definition: properties such as shape, size, motion and solidity, which Locke held really belong to objects themselves, whoever perceives them
example: Packing the moving van, Tara noted that the sofa's primary qualities, its size and solidity, mattered far more than its colour.

hindi: प्राथमिक द्रव्य — कोई एक विशिष्ट, स्वतंत्र रूप से विद्यमान वस्तु
definition: in Aristotle's categories, an individual, particular thing that exists independently, such as this specific person or this specific horse
example: The class could debate cats in general forever, but the primary substance knocking pens off Kavya's desk was very much her cat Biscuit.

hindi: आद्य पदार्थ — सभी रूपों के नीचे स्थित रूपहीन मूल पदार्थ
definition: in Aristotelian thought, the completely formless basic stuff that underlies all physical change and can take on any form, but never exists without some form
example: Stirring the grey sludge in the blender, Kiran said his smoothie had reached prime matter: no form, only potential.

hindi: आदि प्रवर्तक — समस्त गति और परिवर्तन का प्रथम कारण
definition: the first cause of all motion and change in the universe, another name for Aristotle's eternal unmoved being that sets everything else moving
example: Tracing the office rumour back through five group chats, Leela found its prime mover was the intern who misread one email.

hindi: आदिम संचय — बलपूर्वक बेदखली से पूँजीवाद के आरंभिक संचय की प्रक्रिया
definition: Marx's term for the early, often violent process, such as enclosing common land, by which producers were separated from their means of living and capital first gathered
example: Reading about village commons fenced off for private estates, Dhruv finally understood why Marx called primitive accumulation anything but gentle.

hindi: सर्वप्रथम हानि न करो — चिकित्सक का पहला कर्तव्य हानि से बचना है
definition: Latin for 'first, harm nothing', the medical maxim that a doctor's first duty is avoiding harm to patients before attempting any treatment
example: Asked whether to microwave the leftover biryani a third time, Priya muttered primum non nocere and ordered fresh.

hindi: राजकुमार और मोची — स्मृति ही व्यक्तिगत पहचान है, इस पर लॉक का दृष्टांत
definition: John Locke's thought experiment of a prince's memories and character moving into a cobbler's body, used to argue that personal identity follows memory and consciousness rather than the body
example: When his twin sister answered his phone and remembered all his plans, Rudra said it was the prince and the cobbler all over again.

hindi: प्रधान सिद्धांत — वस्तुगत संयोग को जानकर उसी अनुपात में विश्वास रखने का नियम
definition: David Lewis's principle that if you know the objective chance of an outcome, your degree of belief in it should match that chance exactly
example: Following the principal principle, Harsh believed the coin would land heads exactly as strongly as the physics said, no more, no less.

hindi: व्यष्टिकरण का सिद्धांत — वह आधार जो किसी वस्तु को अलग व्यक्ति बनाता है
definition: Latin for principle of individuation, whatever makes a thing the distinct individual it is, separating it from others of the same kind
example: With thirty identical grey laptops in the office, the only working principium individuationis turned out to be the stickers.

hindi: परिचय सिद्धांत — हर समझा गया कथन प्रत्यक्ष परिचित वस्तुओं से ही बना होना चाहिए, यह सिद्धांत
definition: Russell's principle that every statement we understand must be made up entirely of parts standing for things we are directly aware of in experience
example: By the principle of acquaintance, Omar argued, his aunt could not really understand 'good coffee' until she tried the café downstairs.

hindi: स्वायत्तता का सिद्धांत — अपने शरीर और जीवन के निर्णय स्वयं लेने के अधिकार का आदर
definition: the bioethics principle that competent patients have the right to make their own decisions about their bodies and medical treatment, free from pressure
example: When her parents pushed for surgery, Nisha calmly cited the principle of autonomy and reminded them whose knee it actually was.

hindi: उदारता का सिद्धांत — दूसरों के कथनों की व्याख्या यथासंभव सत्य और तर्कसंगत मानकर करना
definition: the principle of interpreting another speaker's words so that as many of their beliefs as possible come out true and reasonable, since otherwise interpretation cannot begin
example: Applying the principle of charity, Farhan assumed his manager's email saying 'urgent, whenever' meant something sensible.

hindi: विश्वसनीयता सिद्धांत — जैसा अनुभव दिखे वैसा मानने का सिद्धांत, जब तक खंडन न हो
definition: the principle that if something seems to be present in experience, it probably is present, unless there are special reasons for doubt, sometimes applied to religious experience
example: Using the principle of credulity, Mira trusted that the smell of samosas meant someone had brought samosas, until she found only an empty box.

hindi: न्यायोचित सहभागिता का सिद्धांत — साझा व्यवस्था का लाभ लेने वाले पर उसके नियम मानने का दायित्व
definition: the view that anyone who accepts the benefits of a shared, rule-governed scheme has a duty to follow its rules and carry their share of the burden
example: Having eaten from the office snack fund all month, Leela felt the principle of fair play demanded she finally chip in.

hindi: व्यष्टिकरण का सिद्धांत — किसी वस्तु को अन्य सभी से अलग एक विशिष्ट वस्तु बनाने वाला आधार
definition: whatever makes a particular thing the single individual that it is, marking it apart from every other thing of the same kind
example: Holding two identical school uniforms, Aman searched for a principle of individuation and settled on the ketchup stain.

hindi: पूर्णता सिद्धांत — यह मत कि प्रत्येक वास्तविक संभावना कभी न कभी साकार होती है
definition: the principle that every genuine possibility is realised at some time or place, so nothing possible stays forever unrealised
example: Invoking the principle of plenitude, Dhruv assured his flatmates that someday, somehow, the dishes would get washed.

hindi: पुनर्संयोजन सिद्धांत — यह नियम कि संभव वस्तुओं के अंशों को जोड़कर नई संभावनाएँ बनती हैं
definition: David Lewis's principle that any parts of possible things can be patched together to form another possible thing, used to decide which possible worlds exist
example: Using the principle of recombination, Gauri concluded that a unicorn is possible, since horses and horns both exist.

hindi: पर्याप्त कारण का सिद्धांत — प्रत्येक तथ्य के होने का कोई पर्याप्त कारण अवश्य होता है
definition: the principle, central to Leibniz, that nothing exists or happens without a reason sufficient to explain why it happens exactly as it does rather than otherwise
example: Invoking the principle of sufficient reason, Dev demanded to know why the office printer jammed only on Mondays.

hindi: साक्ष्य सिद्धांत — दूसरों के बताए अनुभवों पर सामान्यतः भरोसा करने का सिद्धांत
definition: the principle that people should generally believe what others report about their experiences, unless there are special reasons for doubt, applied to reports of religious experience
example: Relying on the principle of testimony, Anil believed his colleague's story about the haunted lift, at least until lunchtime.

hindi: सहिष्णुता सिद्धांत — कोई भी भाषा या तर्क-प्रणाली चुनने की स्वतंत्रता, बशर्ते उसके नियम स्पष्ट हों
definition: Carnap's principle that philosophers may freely choose any language or logical system they like, provided they state its rules clearly, since there is no single correct logic
example: Invoking the principle of tolerance, Aditi let her study partner use his own weird notation, as long as he explained every symbol first.

hindi: उपयोगिता का सिद्धांत — किसी कर्म को उससे बढ़ने या घटने वाले सुख से आँकने का सिद्धांत
definition: Bentham's principle that every action should be approved or disapproved according to whether it increases or decreases the happiness of everyone affected
example: Under the principle of utility, the class agreed that moving the test to Friday was right, since only the teacher seemed happier on Monday.

hindi: सिद्धांतवाद (जैवनैतिक) — स्वायत्तता, परोपकार, अहानि और न्याय के चार सिद्धांतों पर आधारित दृष्टिकोण
definition: the approach to bioethics that weighs four principles, namely patient autonomy, beneficence, avoiding harm and justice, against each other in each medical case
example: The ethics committee's whiteboard showed pure principlism: four columns, one hard case, and a great deal of erasing.

hindi: पूर्व प्रायिकता — नया प्रमाण देखने से पहले किसी परिकल्पना पर विश्वास की मात्रा
definition: the probability assigned to a hypothesis before taking particular evidence into account, which Bayesian reasoning then adjusts in light of that evidence
example: Given the prior probability of Karan being late, nobody at the office panicked when his seat stayed empty.

hindi: प्राथमिकतावाद — जो जितना वंचित है, उसके लाभ को उतना अधिक महत्त्व देने का मत
definition: the view that benefits matter more the worse off the person receiving them is, so helping the least advantaged should take priority
example: Following prioritarianism, the family gave the last blanket to Grandpa, who had been shivering since the power failed.

hindi: निजी भाषा युक्ति — केवल एक व्यक्ति को समझ आने वाली भाषा की असंभवता का तर्क
definition: Wittgenstein's argument that a language whose words refer only to one person's inner sensations, understood by nobody else, could never really work, since meaning needs shared public rules
example: Aarav's diary code, with symbols for feelings only he could check, collapsed exactly as the private language argument predicts.

hindi: शुभ का अभाव — अशुभ को स्वतंत्र वस्तु नहीं, शुभ की कमी मानने का मत
definition: the view, from Augustine, that evil is not a thing in its own right but an absence or lack of goodness, the way darkness is an absence of light
example: Staring at the empty biscuit tin, Kiran explained privatio boni to his flatmate: the evil here was simply the absence of biscuits.

hindi: अभाव — किसी ऐसे गुण की अनुपस्थिति जो स्वभावतः होना चाहिए था
definition: in Aristotle's account of change, the absence of a form or quality that a thing could naturally have, such as darkness being the lack of light
example: Staring at the empty fridge, Rohit declared that dinner tonight would be a study in privation.

hindi: संभाव्यतावाद — निश्चितता के अभाव में संभावना को आचरण का आधार मानने का मत
definition: the view that certainty is rarely possible, so reasonable belief and action should follow what is probable; in Catholic ethics, the rule that one may follow any well-supported opinion
example: Her probabilism settles most debates: she cannot prove the train will be late, but she packs a snack anyway.

hindi: संभाव्य कारणता — कारण को वह मानना जो कार्य के घटित होने की संभावना बढ़ाता है
definition: the view that a cause is something that raises the probability, meaning the chance, of its effect rather than guaranteeing it, as smoking raises the chance of lung disease
example: Skipping revision does not guarantee failure, Tara told her study group, but probabilistic causation was not on their side.

hindi: अशुभ की समस्या — सर्वशक्तिमान, सर्वशुभ ईश्वर और जगत के दुःख में विरोध का प्रश्न
definition: the challenge of explaining why suffering and evil exist if a deity is all-powerful, all-knowing and perfectly good
example: After the flood wrecked their neighbour's shop, the kitchen conversation turned into a quiet, serious talk about the problem of evil.

hindi: आगमन-समस्या — अतीत के अनुभव से भविष्य के बारे में निष्कर्ष को उचित ठहराने की कठिनाई
definition: the puzzle, made famous by Hume, of whether anything justifies expecting the future to resemble the past, since every such justification seems to assume that very expectation
example: When the office coffee machine finally broke after a thousand good mornings, Tanvi blamed the problem of induction for her misplaced trust.

hindi: पुराने प्रमाण की समस्या — पहले से ज्ञात तथ्य बेज़वाद में पुष्टि क्यों नहीं दे पाता, यह समस्या
definition: the difficulty for Bayesian confirmation that evidence already known cannot raise a hypothesis's probability, yet such evidence often seems to confirm theories strongly
example: Tanya's detective theory explained the missing earring she had noticed weeks ago, raising the problem of old evidence at family dinner.

hindi: अन्य मनों की समस्या — दूसरों के मन के अस्तित्व का ज्ञान
definition: the sceptical puzzle of how we can know that other people have thoughts and feelings, since we only ever observe their behaviour from outside
example: When his friend replied to a long heartfelt message with a single thumbs up, Harsh wrestled with the problem of other minds.

hindi: कसौटी की समस्या — ज्ञान और उसकी कसौटी में पहले कौन
definition: the sceptical puzzle that recognising true knowledge needs a reliable standard, yet choosing that standard already requires knowing which beliefs are true
example: Choosing which review site to trust about review sites, Arjun hit the problem of the criterion and ordered the cheapest headphones instead.

hindi: बाह्य जगत की समस्या — अनुभव से परे जगत के ज्ञान का प्रश्न
definition: the question of how we can know that a world outside our minds exists, when all our evidence comes through experiences that could be misleading
example: Staring at a frozen video call, Divya pondered the problem of the external world and whether her colleagues still existed.

hindi: अनेक का प्रश्न — धुंधली सीमाओं वाली वस्तु के अनेक समान उम्मीदवार होने की पहेली
definition: Unger's puzzle that an object with fuzzy edges, such as a cloud, has countless almost identical candidates for being it, so there seem to be many objects
example: Asked to point at the cloud shaped like a whale, Gauri raised the problem of the many, since countless whale-candidates overlapped in that patch of vapour.

hindi: सामान्य-विवाद — 'लालपन' जैसे सामान्य गुण वास्तव में अस्तित्व रखते हैं या केवल नाम हैं, यह प्रश्न
definition: the question of whether general qualities shared by many things, such as redness or humanity, exist in reality, only in minds, or only as words
example: When the group chat argued whether 'vibe' was a real shared thing or just a word, Meera announced they had reinvented the problem of universals.

hindi: समस्या-प्रस्तावक शिक्षा — संवाद से विद्यार्थियों के अपने जीवन की समस्याओं पर विचार कराने वाली शिक्षा
definition: Freire's alternative to the banking model, in which teacher and students question real problems from their lives together through dialogue, so both learn and teach
example: Instead of a lecture on budgets, the teacher asked why the canteen prices kept rising, and problem-posing education filled the whole period with arguments.

hindi: समस्यामूलक स्थिति — जब अनिश्चितता पहचानकर समस्या के रूप में स्पष्ट की जाती है
definition: Dewey's term for an unsettled situation once it has been recognised and framed as a definite problem, the point where inquiry properly begins
example: The flat's leaking tap became a problematic situation only when Farah wrote down exactly when and where it dripped.

hindi: प्रक्रियात्मक न्याय — परिणाम से अधिक निर्णय की प्रक्रिया की निष्पक्षता पर ध्यान
definition: the fairness of the methods and procedures used to reach a decision, judged separately from whether the final outcome seems fair
example: Nobody loved the new shift roster, but the office accepted it on grounds of procedural justice, since everyone had drawn names from the same mug.

hindi: प्रक्रिया विश्वसनीयतावाद — विश्वास बनाने की प्रक्रिया की विश्वसनीयता से औचित्य तय करने का मत
definition: the standard form of reliabilism holding that a belief is justified when the psychological process producing that belief reliably yields truths
example: By process reliabilism, Gauri's belief from checking two newspapers beat her cousin's belief from a forwarded meme.

hindi: प्रक्रिया धर्मशास्त्र — ईश्वर को परिवर्तनशील और जगत के साथ विकसित होता मानने वाला मत
definition: the view, inspired by Whitehead, that the deity is not unchanging but develops alongside the world, persuading rather than forcing events
example: Naina said her book club worked like process theology: the organiser nudged everyone gently and changed with the group.

hindi: प्रजनन-विषमता — यह मत कि दुःखी जीवन रचना गलत है, पर सुखी जीवन रचना अनिवार्य कर्तव्य नहीं
definition: the view that creating a person whose life would be miserable is wrong, while there is no matching duty to create a person whose life would be happy
example: Dev cited the procreative asymmetry when his aunt insisted that a happy couple owed the family more grandchildren.

hindi: प्रजनन परोपकारिता — संभावित संतानों में सबसे अच्छे जीवन वाली को चुनने का सिद्धांत
definition: the contested principle that parents selecting between possible children should choose the child expected to have the best life
example: Planning a puppy adoption spreadsheet, Nikhil claimed to be practising procreative beneficence, which his wife found alarming.

hindi: प्रगतिशील शिक्षा — अनुभव, रुचि और क्रिया से सीखने पर बल देने वाला आंदोलन
definition: an educational movement, linked with Dewey, holding that children learn best through experience, inquiry and shared projects that connect with their interests and community life
example: The class built a working rain gauge instead of copying notes about weather, which is progressive education with wet shoes.

hindi: प्रगतिशील समस्या-परिवर्तन — संशोधनों से नए और पुष्ट तथ्यों की भविष्यवाणी होना
definition: Lakatos's term for changes within a research programme that predict novel facts which are later confirmed, marking the programme as healthy
example: Each tweak to the delivery app predicted busier routes that proved real, a textbook progressive problemshift for the logistics team.

hindi: सुविचारित चयन — सोच-विचार के बाद किया गया चुनाव, जो चरित्र का संकेत है
definition: the Greek term for deliberate choice, a decision reached through reasoning about means, which Aristotle treated as the clearest sign of character
example: Picking the harder internship after a week of weighing options was, Manav said, genuine prohairesis rather than panic.

hindi: प्रक्षेपणीयता — किसी गुण का ऐसा होना कि उसे नए उदाहरणों तक वैध रूप से फैलाया जा सके
definition: the quality of a predicate or hypothesis that makes it legitimate to extend from observed cases to unobserved ones, as green seems to have and grue seems to lack
example: Debating the office snack rota, Rohan questioned the projectibility of 'Fridays bring cake' after one lucky birthday.

hindi: प्रक्षेपणवाद — मनुष्य द्वारा अपनी भावनाओं को संसार पर आरोपित कर उन्हें नैतिक गुण समझने का मत
definition: the view that people project their own feelings and attitudes onto the world, then speak as though moral qualities belonged to things themselves
example: Projectivism, Sahil joked, explains why his cousin calls the traffic jam 'cruel': the frustration lives in him, not in the cars.

hindi: सर्वहारा — उत्पादन के साधनों से वंचित और मजदूरी पर निर्भर श्रमिक वर्ग
definition: in Marxist theory, the class of workers who lack any means of production and must sell their labour for wages to survive
example: With rent due and no savings, Kunal announced he had officially joined the proletariat, laptop included.

hindi: उपपत्ति — स्वीकृत आधारों से किसी कथन की सत्यता को चरणबद्ध रूप से स्थापित करने वाला तर्क
definition: a sequence of valid reasoning steps that establishes a statement as true, starting from premises or axioms already accepted
example: Meenal demanded proof that her brother had fed the fish, and he produced a photo, a timestamp and an unusually smug fish.

hindi: विरोध द्वारा उपपत्ति — किसी कथन का निषेध मानकर विरोधाभास दिखाते हुए उसे सिद्ध करने की विधि
definition: a method of proof that assumes the opposite of the claim to be proved and shows that this assumption leads to a contradiction, so the claim must hold
example: In maths class Rohan enjoyed proof by contradiction most, since it let him pretend to be wrong until the numbers forced him right.

hindi: सम्यक्-कार्यवाद — ठीक से काम करती मानसिक क्षमताओं से बने विश्वास को ज्ञान मानने का मत
definition: the view that knowledge is true belief produced by mental abilities, or faculties, working properly according to a design aimed at truth, in the environment suited to them
example: After a sleepless night, Omkar cited proper functionalism to explain why he trusted nothing he believed before his second coffee.

hindi: विशिष्ट संवेद्य — केवल एक इंद्रिय द्वारा ग्रहण होने वाले गुण, जैसे रंग या ध्वनि
definition: in Aristotle's theory, qualities perceived by only one sense, such as colour by sight and sound by hearing, about which that sense is rarely mistaken
example: His earbuds dead, Aditya discovered that music was one of the proper sensibles: staring at the playlist hard did nothing.

hindi: मूलभूत उचित विश्वास — जो विश्वास किसी दूसरे विश्वास पर टिके बिना उचित हो
definition: a belief that is rationally justified without being inferred from other beliefs, such as trusting memory or perception, which some thinkers extend to belief in a deity
example: Priya insisted that her certainty the office printer hates her is a properly basic belief, needing no further evidence beyond every Monday.

hindi: गुण-द्वैतवाद — एक ही भौतिक पदार्थ में भौतिक और मानसिक, दो तरह के गुण होते हैं, ऐसा मत
definition: the view that there is only one kind of physical stuff, but the brain has two kinds of properties, physical ones and mental ones that cannot be reduced to them
example: In the group chat, Kabir explained property dualism as one phone with two features: the circuitry and the feeling of being ignored.

hindi: भविष्यवक्ता व्यवहारवाद — सामाजिक न्याय और नैतिक आलोचना से जुड़ा व्यवहारवाद
definition: Cornel West's version of pragmatism, joining Deweyan problem-solving with moral criticism of injustice, drawn from Black Christian and democratic traditions
example: Their civics teacher described prophetic pragmatism as asking both what works and whom the current system leaves behind.

hindi: प्रतिज्ञप्ति — ऐसा कथन जो या तो सच हो या झूठ
definition: in logic, a statement that asserts or denies something and must be either true or false, whatever language it is expressed in
example: 'The milk has gone off' is a proposition, and one sniff at the fridge settled whether it was true.

hindi: प्रतिज्ञप्ति-अभिवृत्ति — किसी कथन के प्रति विश्वास, इच्छा या आशा जैसी मानसिक अवस्था
definition: a mental state, such as believing, hoping, fearing or wanting, that relates a person to a proposition, a statement that could be true or false
example: Mohit's propositional attitude toward the claim that the meeting could have been an email was not mere belief but burning certainty.

hindi: प्रतिज्ञप्ति कलन — संयोजकों से बने कथनों का औपचारिक नियम-तंत्र
definition: a formal system of symbols and rules for reasoning about whole statements joined by connectives, the calculating side of propositional logic
example: Siddharth ran the house rules through the propositional calculus and proved that the dishes were, in fact, his job.

hindi: प्रतिज्ञप्तिगत औचित्य — किसी कथन पर विश्वास करने के लिए पर्याप्त कारण उपलब्ध होना
definition: the justification a person has for a claim when their evidence supports it, whether or not they actually believe it for those reasons
example: With crumbs on the sofa and an empty tin, Kunal had propositional justification for accusing his flatmate, even before he had made up his mind.

hindi: प्रतिज्ञप्ति तर्कशास्त्र — पूरे कथनों और उन्हें जोड़ने वाले संयोजकों का तर्कशास्त्र
definition: the branch of formal logic that studies whole statements and the connectives joining them, without looking inside statements at their subjects
example: Propositional logic could handle 'if it rains the match is off', Pooja noticed, but not her claim that some umpire always loses the ball.

hindi: पूर्वन्यायवाक्य — वह न्यायवाक्य जिसका निष्कर्ष अगले न्यायवाक्य का आधार-वाक्य बने
definition: a syllogism whose conclusion serves as a premise of a following syllogism, forming the earlier link in a chain of reasoning
example: Sahil's prosyllogism proved the printer was broken, which then became the premise for why his report was late.

hindi: रक्षक पट्टी — मूल सिद्धांतों को खंडन से बचाने वाली संशोधनीय सहायक परिकल्पनाएँ
definition: Lakatos's term for the adjustable supporting assumptions surrounding a research programme's core, which take the blame for failed predictions so the core itself survives
example: When the diet failed, Rohan revised the protective belt, blaming weekend parties rather than the diet's central promise.

hindi: पूर्वधारण — अगले क्षण की अनुभव में निहित अपेक्षा
definition: Husserl's term for consciousness reaching forward toward the moment just about to come, as when you anticipate the final notes of a familiar song
example: When the microwave hit three seconds, Zoya's protention was already braced for the beep before it sounded.

hindi: प्रोटोकॉल वाक्य — प्रत्यक्ष अवलोकन को दर्ज करने वाला मूल वाक्य जिस पर ज्ञान टिका माना गया
definition: in logical positivism, a basic sentence recording a direct observation, such as a reading on a dial, meant to serve as the foundation on which scientific knowledge is built
example: Sana's lab notebook read like a list of protocol sentences: 'Beaker warm, liquid blue, smell questionable.'

hindi: सिद्धि-तर्कशास्त्र — 'सिद्ध किया जा सकता है' को प्रकार-संकारक मानने वाला तर्क
definition: a modal logic that reads its necessity operator as 'it is provable that', used to study what formal mathematical systems can prove about their own proofs
example: Ira joked that provability logic would never help her essay, since nothing her teacher liked was provable within her system.

hindi: अस्थायी नैतिकता — निश्चित ज्ञान मिलने तक अपनाए गए व्यावहारिक आचार-नियम
definition: Descartes's temporary rules for living, such as obeying local customs and acting firmly, adopted while his doubt about knowledge remained unresolved
example: New to the hostel, Arnav followed a provisional morality: queue politely, share snacks, and question nothing until exams were over.

hindi: निकटतम कारण — किसी परिणाम से ठीक पहले का सबसे सीधा कारण
definition: the cause nearest in time and sequence to an effect, as opposed to distant background causes further back along the causal chain
example: The proximate cause of the spilled coffee was Harsh's elbow, though he blamed the cramped desk layout for everything else.

hindi: प्रतिनिधि सहमति — असमर्थ रोगी की ओर से किसी अन्य द्वारा दी गई अनुमति
definition: permission for a medical treatment given by a substitute, such as a parent or guardian, on behalf of someone who cannot consent themselves
example: Signing the form for her little brother's school trip, Aisha realised proxy consent comes with a surprising amount of paperwork.

hindi: स्वहित-मूल्य — वह मूल्य जो किसी वस्तु का स्वयं व्यक्ति के कल्याण के लिए होता है
definition: the value something has because it makes a person's life better for that person, as opposed to moral, aesthetic or other kinds of value
example: Vikram's morning walk has plenty of prudential value, although his neighbours insist his loud singing along the way has no aesthetic value at all.

hindi: आभासी समस्या — वास्तविक लगने वाली पर भाषा की उलझन से उपजी निरर्थक समस्या
definition: a question that looks deep but, according to logical positivists and later analytic philosophers, arises only from confused language and vanishes once the words are made clear
example: After twenty minutes arguing whether a hot dog counts as a sandwich, the flatmates agreed it was a pseudo-problem about labels, then kept arguing anyway.

hindi: छद्मविज्ञान — विज्ञान का रूप धरे किंतु वैज्ञानिक पद्धति से रहित मान्यताएँ
definition: a body of claims presented as scientific that lacks genuine testing, dodges refutation and does not follow the careful methods of real science
example: The wellness influencer's crystal chart looked like a periodic table, but Arjun still filed it under pseudoscience.

hindi: मानसिक दूरी — कलाकृति का आनंद लेने के लिए निजी चिंता और व्यावहारिक सरोकार से अलग हटना
definition: the idea that appreciating something aesthetically requires stepping back from personal worries and practical concerns, so that even danger can be enjoyed as spectacle
example: Nisha lost all psychical distance during the horror film because the haunted house looked exactly like her uncle's flat.

hindi: मनोप्रकार्यवाद — मानसिक अवस्थाओं की भूमिका वैज्ञानिक मनोविज्ञान से तय करने वाला प्रकार्यवाद
definition: the form of functionalism holding that the causal roles defining mental states should be discovered by scientific psychology, rather than taken from everyday common-sense talk about minds
example: Neha's psychofunctionalism meant she refused to define stress at the dinner table until someone brought her a peer-reviewed study of cortisol.

hindi: मनोवैज्ञानिक परहितवाद — कुछ कर्मों को वास्तव में दूसरों के हित से प्रेरित मानने का मत
definition: the descriptive view that people sometimes behave from genuine concern for the welfare of others, and not only from self-interest
example: Seeing a stranger chase a bus to return a lost wallet, Pooja declared psychological altruism the winner of their argument.

hindi: मनोवैज्ञानिक निश्चितता — व्यक्ति का दृढ़ आत्मविश्वास, प्रमाण से स्वतंत्र
definition: a person's feeling of complete confidence in a belief, which may exist even when the supporting evidence is weak or mistaken
example: Kiran's psychological certainty about the shortcut lasted right until the road ended at a locked factory gate.

hindi: मनोवैज्ञानिक संबद्धता — स्मृति, इरादे और विश्वास की सीधी कड़ियाँ जो दो क्षणों के मन को जोड़ती हैं
definition: the direct links between mental states at different times, such as remembering an earlier experience or fulfilling an earlier intention, which can weaken gradually even while psychological continuity holds
example: Neha admitted her psychological connectedness to her twelve-year-old self was thin, since she remembered nothing from that year except one bad haircut.

hindi: मनोवैज्ञानिक सातत्य — स्मृतियों, इच्छाओं और चरित्र की अटूट कड़ी से व्यक्ति के बने रहने का मत
definition: the view that a person survives over time when overlapping chains of memories, beliefs, desires and character traits link each earlier stage of their mental life to each later stage
example: Arjun defended psychological continuity at the dinner table, insisting he was still the same person who once hated okra, just with better memories and worse knees.

hindi: मनोवैज्ञानिक कसौटी — स्मृति और चरित्र की निरंतरता को व्यक्ति के बने रहने की शर्त मानने का मत
definition: the view that what keeps a person the same over time is continuity of memories, beliefs, desires and character, rather than sameness of body or brain matter
example: When the office laptop was wiped and restored from backup, Dev joked that by the psychological criterion it was still the same laptop, only happier.

hindi: मनोवैज्ञानिक अहंवाद — हर कर्म को अंततः स्वार्थ से प्रेरित मानने का मत
definition: the descriptive view that every human action is ultimately driven by self-interest, even actions that look generous or selfless
example: After Riya carried everyone's bags, her cousin invoked psychological egoism, claiming she only wanted the front seat.

hindi: मनोवैज्ञानिक सुखवाद — हर कर्म को सुख की चाह या दुख से बचाव से प्रेरित मानने का मत
definition: the descriptive view that every human action is ultimately driven by the desire to gain pleasure or avoid pain for oneself
example: Watching his roommate queue an hour for bubble tea, Aman found psychological hedonism entirely convincing.

hindi: मनोदैहिक समानांतरवाद — मानसिक और शारीरिक घटनाएँ बिना परस्पर क्रिया के साथ-साथ चलती हैं
definition: the view that mental events and bodily events unfold alongside each other in perfect correspondence without either causing the other, found in Spinoza and Leibniz
example: Every time Omar felt nervous his knee started bouncing, which he defended as psychophysical parallelism rather than admitting to stage fright.

hindi: अनगढ़ काष्ठ — सहज, अकृत्रिम मूल अवस्था का प्रतीक
definition: the Daoist image of the uncarved block: a simple, natural state before learning, desire and social conventions shape a person
example: Watching the baby laugh at a cardboard box, Dev said she was pure pu, untouched by brand names.

hindi: सार्वजनिक क्षेत्र — वह साझा स्थान जहाँ नागरिक सार्वजनिक विषयों पर खुलकर तर्क करते हैं
definition: Habermas's term for the shared space, from coffee houses to newspapers, where private citizens gather to discuss public matters and form opinion through reasoned argument
example: Divya worried the public sphere had shrunk to a comment section where arguments lasted exactly one scroll.

hindi: पुद्गल — जैन दर्शन में रूप, रस, गंध और स्पर्श वाला भौतिक पदार्थ
definition: in Jain philosophy, physical matter, made of tiny atoms that can be seen, tasted, smelled or touched and that combine into everything material, including karma
example: Sweeping up the glitter after the party, Omkar said that no amount of pudgala had ever been harder to remove.

hindi: पुद्गलवाद — व्यक्ति को स्कन्धों से न अलग, न एक मानने वाला बौद्ध संप्रदाय
definition: an early Buddhist school holding that a person exists as something neither identical to nor separate from the changing groups of bodily and mental processes, a view other schools rejected as smuggling back a self
example: In the seminar, Nisha said her Pudgalavada instincts kicked in whenever someone claimed her playlist was not really hers.

hindi: पुनर्जन्म — मृत्यु के बाद फिर से जन्म लेना
definition: rebirth: the view that after death a being is born again into another body according to its karma
example: Watching the cat nap all afternoon, Radhika hoped punarjanma would bring her back with exactly that schedule.

hindi: अभिव्यंजक दंड-सिद्धांत — दंड समाज की निंदा और अस्वीकृति को प्रकट करने का माध्यम है
definition: the view that punishment is justified mainly because it expresses the community's condemnation of wrongdoing and communicates to offenders that their conduct was seriously wrong
example: Suspending the striker for one match barely changed the scoreboard, but for a fan of punitive expressivism it told every player that the club condemned the racist chant.

hindi: पुण्य — शुभ कर्मों से अर्जित नैतिक योग्यता
definition: moral merit earned through good actions, believed to bring favourable results in this life or future ones
example: Driving the whole team to the airport at dawn, Rekha was sure she had stored enough punya for a year.

hindi: शुद्ध चेतना अनुभव — बिना किसी विषय या विचार के केवल जागरूक रहने का अनुभव
definition: a mystical experience, reported across traditions, of being awake and aware without any thoughts, images or objects filling that awareness
example: Tara claimed a pure consciousness event during yoga class, though her friend suspected she had simply dozed off.

hindi: शुद्ध अनुभव — मन और वस्तु में बँटने से पहले का मूल अनुभव
definition: William James's name for the basic stuff of reality, experience before it is sorted into mind and matter, from which both are built
example: Lost in the smell of chai before thinking anything, Meenal said she had touched pure experience.

hindi: शुद्ध अंतःप्रज्ञा — कांट के अनुसार देश और काल का अनुभव-रहित, मन से दिया गया बोध
definition: in Kant's thought, the mind's awareness of space and time themselves, prior to any particular content supplied by the senses
example: Drawing a triangle in the air, the tutor claimed pure intuition was enough to show its angles, chalk being optional.

hindi: सुखावती मार्ग — अमिताभ बुद्ध की शरण द्वारा शुद्ध भूमि में जन्म की आस्था
definition: the East Asian Buddhist tradition centred on devotion to Amida, the Buddha of boundless light, trusting that sincere faith brings rebirth in a blissful realm where awakening becomes easy
example: Her grandmother explained Pure Land Buddhism over chai as the gentle path for people too busy to meditate all day.

hindi: शुद्ध बुद्धि — अनुभव से स्वतंत्र होकर कार्य करने वाली तर्क-शक्ति
definition: reason working by itself, independently of experience, especially as Kant examined its powers and limits for gaining knowledge
example: Pure reason could not tell Gautam where he parked; that took walking every floor of the mall garage.

hindi: प्रयोजनहीन प्रयोजनशीलता — किसी लक्ष्य के बिना सुगठित प्रतीत होना
definition: Kant's phrase for the beautiful object's quality of seeming perfectly designed, as though made for some goal, without serving any actual goal at all
example: Staring at a perfectly symmetrical leaf in the park, Arnav called it purposiveness without purpose: it looked designed, but for nothing he could name.

hindi: पुरुष — शुद्ध चेतना, जो केवल साक्षी है और प्रकृति से अलग है
definition: in Samkhya and Yoga, pure consciousness, the silent witnessing spirit that never acts or changes and remains entirely separate from nature and matter
example: Stuck in traffic, Nikhil tried to be pure purusha, calmly witnessing the honking without letting it touch him, and lasted four minutes.

hindi: पुरुषार्थ — मानव जीवन के चार लक्ष्य: धर्म, अर्थ, काम और मोक्ष
definition: the four proper aims of human life in Hindu thought: dharma (right conduct), artha (wealth), kama (pleasure) and moksha (liberation)
example: Planning her gap year, Nisha tried to balance every purushartha, which is how a volunteering trip ended up including a beach week.

hindi: पिर्होवाद — निर्णय स्थगित कर मानसिक शांति पाने का प्राचीन संशयवाद
definition: the ancient Greek sceptical school that balanced opposing arguments on every question, suspended judgement, and sought calm freedom from worry
example: Asked whether pineapple belongs on pizza, Sameer practised Pyrrhonism, weighed both camps equally, and serenely ate whatever arrived.

hindi: पाइथागोरसवाद — संख्या को समस्त वास्तविकता का मूल मानने वाला संप्रदाय
definition: the school of Pythagoras and his followers, who held that numbers and mathematical ratios form the deepest structure of reality and also practised a strict spiritual lifestyle
example: Meher's Pythagoreanism showed when she insisted the playlist needed exactly twelve songs because twelve was a harmonious number.

hindi: क़दरिया — मनुष्य को अपने कर्मों का स्वतंत्र रचयिता मानने वाला इस्लामी मत
definition: an early Islamic school holding that humans freely create their own actions and are therefore justly responsible for them before the divine judge
example: In the seminar, Aisha contrasted Qadariyya with Jabriyya, noting that only one school hands humans the steering wheel.

hindi: क्वांटम बेयसवाद — क्वांटम संभावनाओं को प्रेक्षक की व्यक्तिगत आस्थाएँ मानने का मत
definition: an interpretation of quantum physics treating quantum probabilities as a person's own degrees of belief about their future experiences, rather than facts about the world itself
example: Following QBism, Tara decided her ninety percent confidence in the bus arriving described her hopes, not the bus.

hindi: प्राणशक्ति — सब वस्तुओं में बहने वाली जीवन-ऊर्जा
definition: in Chinese thought, the vital energy or breath that flows through all things, forming both living bodies and the physical world
example: After a sleepless night, Arjun blamed his sluggish qi and ordered a second cup of chai.

hindi: अनुभूति-गुण — किसी अनुभव का निजी, भीतर से महसूस होने वाला स्वरूप
definition: the private felt qualities of experience, such as the particular taste of coffee or the redness of a sunset as it feels from the inside
example: Arguing about whether the office coffee tasted burnt, Neha insisted that her qualia were simply more refined than everyone else's.

hindi: गुणात्मक समानता — दो अलग वस्तुओं का गुणों में बिलकुल एक जैसा होना
definition: the relation between separate things that share exactly the same qualities, such as colour, shape and size, while still being distinct things
example: The two mugs in the office kitchen had perfect qualitative identity, which explained the weekly argument over whose coffee was whose.

hindi: जीवन-गुणवत्ता — जीवन के अनुभव और सुख-सुविधा के आधार पर उसका मूल्यांकन
definition: the view in bioethics that medical decisions should weigh how good a patient's experienced life is, rather than simply how long it lasts
example: Choosing between two treatments, Mum asked the doctor about quality of life first and survival statistics second.

hindi: इच्छा-गुण — किसी कर्म में झलकती सद्भावना या दुर्भावना
definition: the goodwill, hostility or indifference toward others that an action expresses, which many theorists treat as what praise and blame really respond to
example: Stepping on a foot in a crowded metro is forgivable; stomping on it on purpose shows a very different quality of will.

hindi: गुणवत्ता-समायोजित जीवन-वर्ष — स्वास्थ्य-लाभ को जीवन की अवधि और गुणवत्ता से मापने की इकाई
definition: a measure used to allocate healthcare, counting each year of life gained by treatment and weighting it by how healthy that year is
example: Budget meetings at the hospital sounded cold until the manager explained how a quality-adjusted life year actually decides which treatments get funded.
