hindi: परिमाणक — 'सब', 'कुछ', 'कोई नहीं' जैसे मात्रा बताने वाले तार्किक शब्द
definition: in logic, a word such as 'every', 'some' or 'none' that tells how many members of a group a statement makes its claim about
example: 'Everyone liked the movie' collapsed the moment Kabir challenged its quantifier, since he had walked out at the interval.

hindi: परिमाणक भिन्नता — 'अस्तित्व है' के कई समान रूप से वैध अर्थ होने का मत
definition: the view that phrases like there exists can carry several equally correct meanings, so some disputes about existence are merely verbal
example: When two roommates argued whether the pile of laundry was one thing or many, Omar cited quantifier variance and declared a draw.

hindi: परिमाणित करना — किसी पद पर 'सभी' या 'कुछ' लगाकर उसका दायरा तय करना
definition: in logic, to mark how much of a group a statement covers by attaching a word like 'every' or 'some' to a term
example: Before the debate on whether teenagers are lazy, the teacher asked us to quantify the claim: all teenagers, or just some?

hindi: क्वांटम तर्कशास्त्र — क्वांटम भौतिकी से प्रेरित अशास्त्रीय तर्क
definition: an alternative to classical logic, modelled on quantum physics, in which the classical rule distributing 'and' over 'or' fails for statements about measurements
example: Ritika claimed her sock drawer obeyed quantum logic: a pair was surely there, but no particular sock ever was.

hindi: क्वांटम अस्थानिकता — दूर स्थित कणों के मापन-परिणामों का असाधारण सहसंबंध
definition: the feature of quantum physics where measurements on widely separated particles, once linked together or entangled, show correlations that no signal travelling between them could explain
example: Quantum nonlocality, Varun claimed, was the only explanation for his mother knowing instantly whenever he skipped lunch across the city.

hindi: आभासी भाव — कल्पित वस्तु के प्रति उठने वाली भावना जैसी, पर वास्तविक भावना न होने वाली अवस्था
definition: a feeling that resembles genuine emotion, such as fear during a monster film, but which some philosophers argue is not real emotion because no belief in danger is present
example: Gripping the armrest during the zombie scene, Reva insisted it was only quasi-emotion, then refused to walk to the parking lot alone.

hindi: अर्ध-अनुभववाद — गणित को प्रायोगिक विज्ञान की भाँति अनुमान और खंडन से बढ़ता हुआ मानने का मत
definition: the view that mathematics grows somewhat like experimental science, through conjectures, counterexamples and revisions, rather than through certain deductions from fixed axioms
example: After three failed attempts at the geometry proof, each rescued by a friend's counterexample, Ayaan decided quasi-empiricism described his homework perfectly.

hindi: आभासी स्मृति — ऐसी स्मृति-जैसी अवस्था जो किसी के अनुभव से उपजी हो, पर जरूरी नहीं कि अपने ही अनुभव से
definition: a memory-like mental state that is caused in the right manner by a past experience but, unlike ordinary memory, does not assume that the experience belonged to the person currently remembering it
example: After hearing her brother tell the story fifty times, Ishita felt she had a quasi-memory of falling into the village pond herself.

hindi: आभासी यथार्थवाद — अभिव्यक्तिवादी होते हुए भी नैतिक सत्य की सामान्य भाषा को उचित ठहराने का प्रयास
definition: the project, within expressivism, of explaining why people may properly speak of moral truth, facts and mistakes, even though moral statements express attitudes rather than describing facts
example: Thanks to quasi-realism, Vikram could keep calling his expressivist attitudes 'true' in the staff meeting without contradicting his philosophy lectures.

hindi: लैंगिक मानकों का आलोचनात्मक सिद्धांत — लैंगिकता और पहचान की स्थिर श्रेणियों पर प्रश्न उठाने वाला चिंतन
definition: a field of scholarship that questions fixed categories of sexuality and gender, examining which identities get labelled normal or deviant and why
example: After a semester of queer theory, Mira refused to fill in any survey box without first asking who designed the categories.

hindi: स्वरूपता — किसी वस्तु का वह सार जो बताता है कि वह क्या है
definition: the essence of a thing, meaning whatever makes something the kind of thing it is, as named when answering the question of what that thing really is
example: After an hour of debate, the office decided the quiddity of a sandwich was two slices of bread, which left the hot dog in serious trouble.

hindi: क्वाइन विरोधाभास — उद्धरण द्वारा आत्मसंदर्भ बनाकर गढ़ा गया असत्यवादी रूप
definition: a version of the liar paradox that builds self-reference by quoting a phrase and then describing that quotation, avoiding words like 'this sentence'
example: Aditi's poster of Quine's paradox confused every visitor to her dorm room, which she considered the entire point.

hindi: यथेच्छ प्रश्न — मध्ययुगीन विश्वविद्यालयों की खुली बहस जिसमें कोई भी कुछ भी पूछ सकता था
definition: a formal medieval university debate in which a master answered questions on any subject whatsoever, put by anyone in the audience
example: The team's Friday stand-up turned into a quodlibet, with questions ranging from sprint deadlines to whether cereal counts as soup.

hindi: नस्ली अनुबंध — समाज-अनुबंध को श्वेत वर्चस्व का समझौता मानने का मत
definition: Mills's argument that social contract theory, the idea that society rests on an agreement among its members, hides an unspoken agreement among white people to exclude and exploit people of colour
example: After reading about the racial contract, Arun reread his political theory notes and noticed who had never been invited to sign anything.

hindi: नस्ल-निषेधवाद — नस्ल की अवधारणा को त्याग देने का मत
definition: the view that races do not really exist as biological kinds, and that the concept of race should therefore be abandoned in thought and speech
example: During lunch, Lena defended racial eliminativism, while her friend replied that racism clearly had not received the memo.

hindi: नस्लीकरण — किसी समूह को नस्ली श्रेणी में बाँधने की सामाजिक प्रक्रिया
definition: the social process by which groups, practices or traits come to be classified and treated in racial terms, often for political reasons
example: In history class, the teacher traced the racialization of Irish migrants, who were once described as a separate race.

hindi: नस्लवाद — नस्ल के आधार पर श्रेष्ठता या हीनता मानने वाला मत और व्यवहार
definition: the belief that some racial groups are superior to others, together with the prejudice, discrimination and social structures that follow from it
example: When the landlord's flat was suddenly 'taken' after hearing Kwame's accent, his flatmates recognized racism wearing a polite smile.

hindi: रैडब्रुख सूत्र — असहनीय अन्याय तक पहुँचा हुआ क़ानून अपनी वैधता खो देता है
definition: Radbruch's principle that a statute normally stays valid even when unjust, but loses its legal validity once its injustice becomes so extreme that it is intolerable
example: The debate club agreed a clumsy tax statute survives the Radbruch formula, while a statute stripping citizenship from a whole minority plainly does not.

hindi: आमूल चुनाव — बिना किसी पूर्व-निर्धारित कसौटी के अपने मूल्यों का चुनाव
definition: the idea that a person's deepest values are chosen freely without any prior standard or reason to decide between them, since every standard would itself need choosing
example: Asked why she valued honesty over loyalty, Leela shrugged and called it radical choice, not a spreadsheet.

hindi: उग्र समुदायवाद — व्यक्ति की पहचान और अधिकार पूरी तरह समुदाय से ही बनते हैं, यह मत
definition: the view, found in some African philosophy, that personhood is wholly conferred by the community, so the community's claims come before individual rights
example: In the group chat debate, Chidi's radical communitarianism meant he thought the family should decide who got the last samosa.

hindi: मूलगामी अनुभववाद — विलियम जेम्स का मत कि संबंधों सहित सब कुछ प्रत्यक्ष अनुभव में है
definition: William James's view that philosophy should rely only on direct experience, and that relations between things are themselves experienced
example: Arguing that he could feel the tension in the meeting, Varun gave his team a crash course in radical empiricism.

hindi: मूलगत अशुभ — नैतिक नियम से ऊपर स्वार्थ रखने की मानवीय प्रवृत्ति
definition: Kant's term for a deep human tendency to place self-interest above the moral rule, a choice rooted in freedom rather than in nature or ignorance
example: Watching his flatmate eat the last samosa while claiming to have saved it for everyone, Tanvi muttered something about radical evil.

hindi: आमूल नारीवाद — पितृसत्ता को उत्पीड़न की जड़ मानकर उसके मूलोच्छेद का मत
definition: the form of feminism holding that patriarchy is the root form of oppression, embedded in family, sexuality and culture, and must be fundamentally dismantled
example: In the kitchen argument about wedding customs, Leela took the radical feminism line: the whole ritual needed rethinking, not just the menu.

hindi: आमूल स्वतंत्रता — व्यक्ति के हर चुनाव में पूर्ण स्वतंत्रता और उत्तरदायित्व का सिद्धांत
definition: the existentialist view that a person is completely free in every choice and therefore fully responsible for what they become, with no nature or deity to blame
example: Arguing for radical freedom at dinner, Ishaan claimed nobody forced him to finish the whole pizza, which was sadly true.

hindi: मौलिक व्याख्या — बिना किसी पूर्व जानकारी के किसी की भाषा का अर्थ समझने का प्रयास
definition: Davidson's imagined situation in which someone must work out the meaning of a stranger's words entirely from scratch, using only observed behaviour and surrounding circumstances
example: Decoding her toddler's word 'bababa' at dinner, Anjali felt she was attempting radical interpretation with a spoon in hand.

hindi: आमूल संशयवाद — बाह्य जगत के ज्ञान को पूरी तरह नकारने वाला मत
definition: the extreme sceptical position that we cannot know anything about the external world, because our experiences might all be produced by deception
example: Radical scepticism hit Kunal during a power cut, when he briefly wondered whether his flat had ever existed at all.

hindi: राज्य हित — राज्य की सुरक्षा के लिए सामान्य नैतिकता से हटकर किए गए कार्य का औचित्य
definition: French for 'reason of state', the doctrine that a government may break ordinary moral rules when the survival or security of the state demands it
example: Mum read her son's diary and defended it as raison d'état, since the household's safety was apparently at stake.

hindi: राजधर्म — प्रजा की रक्षा और न्यायपूर्ण शासन का राजा का नैतिक कर्तव्य
definition: the Indian doctrine of the king's sacred duty to protect subjects, uphold justice and govern according to dharma, meaning moral and cosmic order
example: The class monitor took rajadharma seriously, guarding the lunch queue so the youngest students were never pushed aside.

hindi: रजस् — प्रकृति का गति, इच्छा और बेचैनी वाला गुण
definition: in Samkhya, the strand of nature marked by restless energy, passion, desire and constant motion, one of the three qualities woven through everything
example: Three espressos into the deadline, Kiran was so full of rajas that she reorganised the whole shared drive instead of writing the report.

hindi: रैमसे वाक्य — किसी सिद्धांत के सैद्धांतिक पदों को चर से बदलकर बना वाक्य
definition: a sentence formed by replacing a theory's technical terms with blank placeholders, stating only that some things exist which play the roles the theory describes
example: The physics tutor rewrote the theory as a Ramsey sentence, saying only that something exists which behaves exactly as 'electron' promises.

hindi: रैमसे परीक्षण — 'यदि' वाले कथन को परिकल्पना जोड़कर परखने की विधि
definition: a method for judging a conditional statement by temporarily adding its 'if' part to your beliefs and asking whether the 'then' part follows
example: Using the Ramsey test, Jai imagined the train running late and decided that yes, he would then miss the opening slides.

hindi: रस — काव्य, नाटक या संगीत के अनुभव से सहृदय में जागने वाला आस्वाद्य भाव
definition: the Indian aesthetic concept of the refined emotional flavour, such as love, heroism or sorrow, that a drama, poem or music awakens in a sensitive audience
example: After the dance recital, Meenakshi said the rasa of longing was so strong that she immediately texted her faraway cousin.

hindi: तर्कसंगत चयन सिद्धांत — व्यवहार को लाभ-हानि तौलकर किए गए चुनाव के रूप में समझाने वाला मत
definition: the theory that social behaviour can be explained by assuming people choose whichever available option best serves their own preferences after weighing costs and benefits
example: Rational choice theory predicted Vikram would take the cheaper train, but it had not accounted for the cafe beside the bus stop.

hindi: बौद्धिक अंतर्दृष्टि — किसी कथन की अनिवार्यता को बुद्धि से सीधे पहचानना
definition: a direct seeing, by reason alone, that some statement must be true, used by some rationalists to explain knowledge independent of experience
example: In the exam hall, a flash of rational insight told Megha that the answer could not be both odd and even.

hindi: बौद्धिक अंतःप्रज्ञा — किसी सत्य को केवल विचार करके सीधे समझ लेने की क्षमता
definition: the ability to grasp that something must be true simply by understanding it, directly through reason rather than through the senses
example: Tanvi needed no calculator for 'if taller than me, then not shorter than me'; rational intuition handled it before the kettle boiled.

hindi: तार्किक पुनर्रचना — किसी सिद्धांत या तर्क को स्पष्ट तार्किक क्रम में फिर से गढ़ना
definition: the method of restating a theory, argument or body of knowledge in a clear logical order showing how its parts justify one another, whatever the messy route by which it was actually discovered
example: Tara's rational reconstruction of how the class trip got cancelled sounded tidy and logical, which the actual chaos of emails never was.

hindi: बुद्धिवाद — ज्ञान का मुख्य स्रोत तर्कबुद्धि को मानने का मत
definition: the view that reason, rather than sensory experience, is the main source of knowledge, and that some truths can be known by thinking alone
example: Her rationalism kicked in during the quiz: she had never seen a square circle, yet knew without looking that none could exist.

hindi: रत्नत्रय — सम्यक् दर्शन, सम्यक् ज्ञान और सम्यक् चारित्र, जैन मोक्षमार्ग के तीन रत्न
definition: the three jewels of Jainism, right faith, right knowledge and right conduct, which together form the path toward liberation of the soul
example: Planning her new study routine, Pooja joked that ratnatraya meant trusting the syllabus, reading the syllabus and actually doing the syllabus.

hindi: कौआ-विरोधाभास — यह पहेली कि हरा सेब भी 'सब कौए काले हैं' की पुष्टि करता प्रतीत होता है
definition: Hempel's puzzle: since 'every raven is black' means the same as 'every non-black thing is non-raven', observing a green apple seems to confirm that ravens are black
example: Staring at her yellow highlighter during revision, Ishita invoked the raven paradox to claim she was technically studying ornithology.

hindi: प्रतिक्रियात्मक मनोभाव — दूसरों की नीयत पर होने वाली क्रोध, कृतज्ञता जैसी भावनाएँ
definition: feelings such as resentment, gratitude, indignation and forgiveness that people have toward each other, which some thinkers treat as the foundation of holding someone responsible
example: When a colleague took credit for her slides, Meera's reactive attitudes arrived before any theory of blame could.

hindi: उपलब्धता — किसी औज़ार का बिना ध्यान दिए सहज उपयोग में आना
definition: Heidegger's term for the manner in which tools show up in everyday practical activity, used smoothly and unnoticed rather than examined as objects
example: The keyboard enjoyed perfect readiness-to-hand until the letter 'e' stopped working and Ritika suddenly noticed it.

hindi: वास्तविक भेद — सार और अस्तित्व का वस्तुतः अलग-अलग होना, यह मत
definition: the view, associated with Aquinas, that in every creature its essence, meaning what it is, and its existence, meaning that it is, are genuinely different principles
example: Knowing exactly what a unicorn is without owning one, Ishan decided the real distinction between essence and existence was painfully clear.

hindi: वास्तविक सार — किसी वस्तु की छिपी आंतरिक संरचना जो उसके गुणों का कारण है
definition: in Locke's theory, the hidden inner structure of a thing that causes all its observable properties, often unknown to ordinary observers
example: Staring into the broken laptop, Sneha admitted she understood its nominal features but had no clue about its real essence.

hindi: सामान्य-यथार्थवाद — साझा गुणों और प्रकारों को वास्तविक सत्ता मानने का मत
definition: the view that universals, meaning qualities or kinds shared by many things, genuinely exist rather than being mere names or ideas inside human minds
example: Pointing at twelve identical rotis on the plate, Aarav argued that realism about universals was the only honest explanation for his grandmother's perfect consistency.

hindi: युक्तिसंगत मतभेद — दोनों पक्षों के विवेकपूर्ण रहते हुए भी बनी रहने वाली असहमति
definition: disagreement in which both sides are thinking carefully and responding sensibly to evidence, yet still reach different conclusions
example: After an hour on whether pineapple belongs on pizza, the family settled into reasonable disagreement and ordered two separate pizzas.

hindi: कारण बाह्यतावाद — किसी के पास कर्म का कारण उसकी इच्छाओं से स्वतंत्र भी हो सकता है, यह मत
definition: the view that people can have genuine reasons for action that do not depend on any desire or motive they currently have
example: Reasons externalism was Neha's reply to her brother: he had a reason to wear a helmet whether or not he cared about his skull.

hindi: कारण आंतरिकतावाद — किसी के पास कर्म का कारण तभी है जब वह उसकी इच्छाओं से जुड़ा हो, यह मत
definition: the view that a person has a reason to perform an action only if it connects, through sound reasoning, to some desire or motive they already have
example: Citing reasons internalism, Kunal argued he had no reason to learn chess, since nothing he cared about would ever lead him there.

hindi: कारण-संवेदनशीलता — उचित कारणों के अनुसार निर्णय बदलने की क्षमता
definition: the capacity of a decision process to notice good reasons and change course in response, which some theories treat as the core of responsible control
example: Karan's reasons-responsiveness was proven when he cancelled the road trip the moment the storm warning appeared on his phone.

hindi: प्रतिखंडक निरसक — विश्वास के विपरीत निष्कर्ष का सीधा साक्ष्य देने वाला निरसक
definition: a defeater that directly supports the opposite conclusion, giving positive evidence that the original belief is false
example: Swati thought the train was late until a rebutting defeater arrived: its doors closing right in front of her.

hindi: हठी भाव — अपने ही विवेकपूर्ण निर्णय के विपरीत बना रहने वाला भाव
definition: an emotion that persists even though the person sincerely believes it unwarranted, such as fearing flying while knowing flights are extremely safe
example: Vikram knows the lift is inspected monthly, yet his recalcitrant emotion still sends him panting up six flights of stairs.

hindi: प्रचलित दृष्टिकोण — सिद्धांतों को प्रेक्षणीय पदों से जुड़ी तार्किक स्वयंसिद्ध-प्रणाली मानने वाला प्रत्यक्षवादी मत
definition: the logical positivists' account of a scientific theory as a tidy system of axioms, meaning starting assumptions, written in formal logic and linked to observation by translation rules
example: The seminar tested the received view against real lab notebooks, and not one of them looked like a neat system of logical axioms.

hindi: मान्यता — दूसरों द्वारा व्यक्ति या समूह की पहचान और मूल्य को स्वीकार करना
definition: the acknowledgement of a person or group as a full equal whose identity, worth and perspective deserve respect, which some thinkers regard as a basic human need
example: When the manager finally credited the night-shift team by name in the company email, they felt a rare moment of recognition.

hindi: नाम-शोधन — शब्दों और पदों को उनके वास्तविक अर्थ के अनुरूप करना
definition: the Confucian teaching that social order requires words and titles to match reality, so that a ruler truly rules and a parent truly acts like a parent
example: When the 'team lead' did none of the leading, Vikram muttered that the office needed a rectification of names.

hindi: पुनर्वर्णन — किसी वस्तु या व्यक्ति को नई शब्दावली में फिर से कहना
definition: in Rorty's philosophy, describing something in fresh vocabulary so that it looks different, seen as a central tool of intellectual and moral change
example: Calling her failed bake an 'experimental crumble' was a masterful piece of redescription by Gauri.

hindi: विपरीत-प्रसंग — किसी मान्यता से असंगत परिणाम दिखाकर उसे खंडित करने की विधि
definition: a method of argument that refutes a claim by showing that accepting it leads to a contradiction or to a plainly absurd consequence
example: Aditi used a reductio ad absurdum on her brother: if nobody needs to wash dishes, then soon every plate in the house would be dirty.

hindi: न्यूनीकरणवाद — जटिल को उसके सरल घटकों से पूरी तरह समझाने का मत
definition: the view that complex things, such as living organisms or societies, can be fully explained by describing their smaller parts and the physical rules governing those parts
example: When Tara said her mood swings were just chemistry, her roommate accused her of reductionism before breakfast was even over.

hindi: अपचयी विश्लेषण — किसी अवधारणा को पूरी तरह सरल, अधिक मूल अवधारणाओं के रूप में परिभाषित करना
definition: an analysis that defines a concept entirely in terms of simpler, more basic concepts, so that the original concept could in principle be replaced by them
example: Leela tried a reductive analysis of 'weekend' as 'days without alarms', until her brother pointed out that holidays fit too.

hindi: न्यूनीकारी भौतिकवाद — मानसिक गुणों को पूरी तरह भौतिक गुणों में समझाया जा सकता है, ऐसा मत
definition: the physicalist view that mental properties can be fully explained in terms of physical brain properties, so psychology could in the end be rewritten entirely as brain science
example: Holding up his fitness tracker, Varun claimed reductive physicalism meant the device knew his stress better than his therapist did.

hindi: अतिरिक्त कारणता — एक ही कार्य के लिए एक से अधिक पर्याप्त कारणों का उपस्थित होना
definition: the general situation in which more than one cause is present that could each produce the same effect, covering both overdetermination and preemption
example: Three alarms, two parents and one dog all tried to wake Yash, a textbook case of redundant causation that still failed.

hindi: द्विगुणन तर्क — विलियम्स का तर्क कि स्मृति की नकल दो व्यक्तियों में हो सकती है, अतः वह पहचान की कसौटी नहीं
definition: Williams's argument that because a pair of people could both have duplicate memories of a single earlier person, memory continuity cannot by itself settle which duplicate is identical to the original
example: Two cousins both claimed to be the real author of the family recipe, and Aditi called it a kitchen reduplication argument.

hindi: निर्देश — शब्द और उस वस्तु का संबंध जिसकी ओर वह संकेत करता है
definition: the relation between a word or phrase and the particular object in the world that it stands for or picks out, such as the relation between a name and its bearer
example: The reference of 'the boss' shifted every Friday afternoon, when the office cat claimed the manager's chair.

hindi: निर्देश-उधार — दूसरों से नाम सीखकर उसी वस्तु की ओर संकेत कर पाना
definition: the process, central to the causal theory of reference, by which speakers pick up a name from others and thereby refer to the same object without knowing much about it
example: Thanks to reference borrowing, Aarav could complain about 'the landlord' for months without ever having seen the man.

hindi: निर्देश-विफलता — किसी नाम या वर्णन का किसी वस्तु को न चुन पाना
definition: the situation in which a name or description fails to pick out any object, leaving philosophers to debate whether sentences containing it are false, meaningless or neither
example: Asking the waiter for 'the vegetarian option' produced total reference failure, as the menu had none.

hindi: निर्देश-अपारदर्शिता — ऐसी स्थिति जहाँ समान निर्देश वाले शब्द बदलने से सत्यता बदल सकती है
definition: the feature of certain contexts, such as reports of belief, where swapping a word for another with the same reference can change whether the whole sentence is true
example: Nikhil believed the new hire was brilliant but not that his old rival was, and the discovery that they were one person was pure referential opacity.

hindi: निर्देशात्मक प्रयोग — वर्णन से किसी पहले से चुने व्यक्ति की ओर इशारा करना
definition: Donnellan's term for employing a definite description to point out a particular person the speaker already has in mind, even if the description does not strictly match that person
example: At the party, 'the man drinking champagne' was a referential use by Anu, though the drink turned out to be apple juice.

hindi: चिंतनशील संतुलन — सामान्य सिद्धांतों और ठोस नैतिक निर्णयों को आपस में तालमेल तक परखते रहना
definition: a method of adjusting general moral principles and particular moral judgements against each other, back and forth, until they cohere and support each other
example: After three rounds of revising the house rules on guests, the flatmates reached something close to reflective equilibrium, or at least exhaustion.

hindi: चिंतनशील विचार — प्रमाणों की सावधान जाँच कर किसी विश्वास तक पहुँचना
definition: Dewey's term for careful, active thinking that examines a belief and the grounds supporting it, prompted by doubt and aimed at resolving a problem
example: Instead of forwarding the viral health tip, Pooja paused for some reflective thinking and checked where it came from.

hindi: सुधारवादी ज्ञानमीमांसा — ईश्वर-विश्वास को बिना तर्क के भी उचित मानने वाला मत
definition: the view that belief in a deity can be rational and justified without argument or evidence, because such belief may be properly basic, like trusting memory
example: Arjun used reformed epistemology in class to argue that his belief in the divine needs no proof, just as his memory of breakfast needs none.

hindi: सुधारवाद — क्रांति के बजाय धीरे-धीरे सुधार से समाज बदलने का मत
definition: the political view that society should be improved through gradual changes within existing institutions rather than by revolution
example: Her reformism showed at the residents' meeting, where she proposed fixing the lift schedule instead of firing the whole committee.

hindi: सत्य-शासन — किसी समाज में सत्य गढ़ने और मान्य करने की व्यवस्था
definition: Foucault's term for the rules, institutions and experts through which a society decides which statements are accepted as true and who gets to declare them
example: In the school staffroom, the regime of truth was simple: whatever the timetable spreadsheet said was reality.

hindi: अनवस्था तर्क — हर प्रमाण को आगे प्रमाण चाहिए, यह तर्क
definition: the sceptical argument that every belief needs another belief to justify it, producing an endless chain of reasons that never reaches solid ground
example: Every approval form at Meera's office needed another signed form, which she called the regress argument turned into paperwork.

hindi: अनवस्था समस्या — हर कारण के लिए नए कारण की माँग से उठी अंतहीन शृंखला की कठिनाई
definition: the puzzle that if every belief needs another belief supporting it, the chain of reasons seems endless, circular, or stopping at something unsupported
example: When every answer in the group chat triggered another 'source?', Tanvi declared they had hit the regress problem.

hindi: नियमितता सिद्धांत — कारणता को केवल घटनाओं के नियमित क्रम के रूप में समझने का मत
definition: the view that causation is nothing more than events of one kind being regularly followed by events of another kind, with no hidden power or necessity linking them
example: Under the regularity theory, Kiran said, the alarm clock does not wake her up; waking up just reliably follows the ringing.

hindi: नियमितता कारणता-सिद्धांत — कारणता को घटनाओं के नियमित क्रम मात्र मानने का मत
definition: the view that causation is nothing more than regular succession, where events of one kind reliably follow events of another kind
example: Reviewing sales data, Mehul took the regularity theory of causation seriously: discount emails were always followed by orders, and nothing more was claimed.

hindi: नियामक नियंत्रण — अनेक संभव विकल्पों में से चुनने का नियंत्रण
definition: the kind of control that requires genuinely open alternatives, the power to choose between several different actions
example: Zara had regulative control over the dinner plan until her friends voted and left just one restaurant standing.

hindi: नियामक प्रत्यय — खोज को दिशा देने वाला पर ज्ञान न देने वाला विचार
definition: Kant's term for an idea of reason, such as a complete system of nature, that guides inquiry as a useful goal without giving knowledge of any actual object
example: The manager treated zero bugs as a regulative idea: nobody expected to reach it, but it kept the whole team testing.

hindi: वस्तुकरण — मानवीय संबंधों और प्रक्रियाओं को जड़ वस्तुओं जैसा मान लेना
definition: the process by which human relationships, choices and social arrangements come to be treated as fixed, natural things beyond human control
example: Calling the market angry is reification, Meera told her father, since the market is just millions of people clicking buttons.

hindi: पुनर्जन्मवाद — आत्मा के नए शरीर में लौट आने का मत
definition: the belief that after the body dies, the soul or inner self is born again into a fresh body, human or otherwise
example: Grandma's reincarnationism came up at dinner when she insisted the stray dog that visits every Tuesday has her late husband's stubborn streak.

hindi: R-संबंध — पारफ़िट के अनुसार मनोवैज्ञानिक सातत्य और संबद्धता का वह संबंध जो जीवित रहने में वास्तव में मायने रखता है
definition: Parfit's name for psychological continuity and connectedness taken together, which he argued is what really matters when we care about surviving, whether or not strict identity holds
example: Rahul said he didn't care if the upgraded phone was technically his, so long as relation R held between it and his old photo gallery.

hindi: सम्बन्धपरक स्वायत्तता — संबंधों और परिवेश के भीतर ही आकार लेने वाली स्वायत्तता
definition: the view, prominent in feminist bioethics, that personal autonomy is shaped through relationships, family and social conditions rather than exercised by isolated individuals
example: Grandpa chose his treatment after a two-hour family call, which Meera described as relational autonomy with extra shouting.

hindi: संबंधपरक समतावाद — न्याय का लक्ष्य वस्तुओं की बराबरी नहीं, बल्कि बराबरी के सामाजिक रिश्ते हैं
definition: the view that equality means people relating to one another as social equals, free from domination and humiliation, rather than holding equal goods
example: Pointing to relational egalitarianism, Sana argued the real problem was not the intern's salary but that nobody ever learned her name.

hindi: सापेक्ष क्वांटम यांत्रिकी — क्वांटम गुणों को केवल अन्य प्रणालियों के सापेक्ष मानने का मत
definition: an interpretation of quantum physics on which a system's properties exist only relative to other systems interacting with it, never absolutely
example: Relational quantum mechanics suited the group chat perfectly: whether the party was cancelled depended on who you had talked to.

hindi: संबंधात्मक आत्म — यह मत कि व्यक्ति का स्व मूलतः दूसरों से उसके संबंधों से बनता है
definition: the view, prominent in Confucian and feminist thought, that a self is largely composed of its relationships and roles, such as child, friend or teacher, rather than existing first as an isolated individual
example: Introducing herself as daughter, sister, class monitor and chief group-chat admin, Lin described a perfect relational self.

hindi: संबंधवाद — दिक् और काल को वस्तुओं व घटनाओं के परस्पर संबंधों के सिवा कुछ न मानने का मत
definition: the view that space and time are nothing over and above the relations of distance and order between physical objects and events
example: When the office emptied for Diwali, Neha's relationalism kicked in: with nothing left in the room, she wondered whether there was any space left either.

hindi: विचार-संबंध — ऐसे सत्य जो केवल प्रत्ययों की तुलना और तर्क से जाने जाते हैं
definition: in Hume's account, truths known by reasoning about concepts alone, such as geometry and arithmetic, whose denial would contradict itself
example: Ishaan told the tutor that his maths homework was pure relations of ideas, so surely it could finish itself.

hindi: उत्पादन-संबंध — उत्पादन में लोगों के बीच स्वामित्व और नियंत्रण के सामाजिक संबंध
definition: in Marxist theory, the social relationships of ownership and control between people in production, such as those between employer and employee
example: The office said everyone was family, but the relations of production became clear when only one family member signed the salary slips.

hindi: सापेक्ष अभिन्नता — दो वस्तुएँ किसी एक वर्ग के रूप में एक, पर दूसरे रूप में भिन्न हो सकती हैं, यह मत
definition: the view, defended by Geach, that things can be the same under one kind of description yet different under another, so identity always depends on which kind of thing, such as 'book' or 'copy', is being counted
example: Maya insisted on relative identity: the library book was the same title she had lent out, but certainly not the same copy that came back stained.

hindi: सापेक्षवाद — सत्य और नैतिकता को व्यक्ति, संस्कृति या परिस्थिति के सापेक्ष मानने का मत
definition: the view that truth, knowledge or morality are not absolute but depend on the person, culture or situation making the judgment
example: Invoking relativism to defend pineapple on pizza did not help Sameer, since the whole table shared one very firm standard.

hindi: युगपत्ता की सापेक्षता — दो घटनाओं के एक-साथ होने को प्रेक्षक पर निर्भर मानने का सिद्धांत
definition: the finding from special relativity that whether two distant events happen at the same moment depends on the motion of the observer
example: When two friends texted 'on my way' at the same moment, Nakul cited the relativity of simultaneity to avoid deciding who replied first.

hindi: प्रासंगिकता तर्कशास्त्र — जिसमें आधार और निष्कर्ष विषय में जुड़े हों
definition: a family of logics requiring that the premises, the starting claims of a valid argument, actually share subject matter with the conclusion, blocking inferences from unrelated or contradictory statements
example: Relevance logic would have rescued the book club when Harsh argued that because the moon is round, he should choose the next novel.

hindi: प्रासंगिकता सिद्धांत — संप्रेषण को प्रासंगिकता की खोज से समझाने का सिद्धांत
definition: the theory, from Sperber and Wilson, that listeners interpret utterances by seeking the most relevant meaning for the least mental effort
example: Relevance theory explains why "the bus is here" makes a teenager grab their shoes rather than admire the vehicle.

hindi: प्रासंगिक विकल्प सिद्धांत — केवल उचित विकल्पों को नकारना ज्ञान के लिए पर्याप्त
definition: the view that knowing something only requires ruling out realistic alternatives, not remote sceptical possibilities like dreaming or deception
example: By relevant alternatives theory, Naina knew her parcel had arrived without first disproving that aliens swapped it for an identical box.

hindi: विश्वसनीयतावाद — विश्वसनीय प्रक्रिया से बने विश्वास को उचित मानने का मत
definition: the view that a belief is justified when it comes from a reliable process, meaning a method of forming beliefs that usually produces truths
example: Vikram's reliabilism about the weather app lasted until it promised sunshine during his soggy cycle commute.

hindi: धार्मिक अनन्यवाद — केवल एक धर्म को सत्य या मुक्ति का मार्ग मानने का मत
definition: the view that only a single religion is true or offers salvation, so that the teachings of other religions are mistaken where they differ
example: Arguing in the canteen, Ritu compared religious exclusivism to her uncle, who believes only one brand of pickle is truly pickle.

hindi: धार्मिक अनुभव — ईश्वर या पवित्र सत्ता की उपस्थिति का प्रत्यक्ष अनुभव
definition: an experience that the person takes to be an awareness of the divine or sacred, often treated in philosophy as possible evidence for religious belief
example: In seminar, Rahul argued that a religious experience counts as evidence only if the person was not also sleep-deprived after exams.

hindi: धार्मिक समावेशवाद — एक धर्म को पूर्ण सत्य मानते हुए अन्य धर्मों में आंशिक सत्य स्वीकारने का मत
definition: the view that a single religion holds the fullest truth, while other religions contain partial truth and their followers may still reach salvation
example: Rohit's religious inclusivism resembled his playlist: his favourite band sits on top, but other bands still get a place.

hindi: मानवता — दूसरों के प्रति करुणा और सच्चा मनुष्यपन
definition: the central Confucian virtue of humaneness: genuine kindness, care and goodness shown toward other people, starting with family and spreading outward
example: Offering the last samosa to the new intern was, Aarav insisted, pure ren and not at all because he was full.

hindi: प्रतिस्थापनीयता तर्क — एक सुखी पशु को मारकर उतना ही सुखी दूसरा पैदा करने से कुल हानि न होने का तर्क
definition: the utilitarian argument that killing a contented animal causes no overall loss if it is replaced by another equally contented animal
example: Kabir tried the replaceability argument on his sister after losing her goldfish, and it went about as well as expected.

hindi: प्रतिनिधानवाद — अनुभव का स्वरूप उसके द्वारा प्रस्तुत विषय से तय होने का मत
definition: the view that perceptual experience works by representing the world as being some particular way, so what an experience feels like is fixed by what it represents
example: Defending representationalism in class, Maya said her headache-blurred vision represented the whiteboard as fuzzy, even though the whiteboard stayed perfectly sharp.

hindi: प्रतिनिधि यथार्थवाद — बाहरी वस्तुएँ मन में प्रत्ययों के माध्यम से ही जानी जाती हैं
definition: the view that external objects really exist but are perceived only indirectly, through mental ideas or images that represent them to the mind
example: Adjusting the video call, Nikhil joked that representative realism fitted remote work perfectly: he only ever met colleagues through their pixelated representations.

hindi: दमनकारी सहिष्णुता — ऐसी सहिष्णुता जो असमानता बनाए रखकर परिवर्तन को निष्प्रभावी कर देती है
definition: Marcuse's argument that tolerance applied equally to all views can, in an unequal society, protect existing power and quietly neutralize demands for change
example: In the debate club, Sana argued that giving every opinion two minutes regardless of evidence looked like repressive tolerance.

hindi: गणतंत्रवाद — नागरिक सहभागिता, नागरिक सद्गुण और मनमानी सत्ता से मुक्ति पर आधारित राजनीतिक परंपरा
definition: the political tradition holding that freedom means living under laws citizens share in making, with active participation, civic virtue and nobody ruling arbitrarily
example: Pooja's republicanism showed at the society meeting: she wanted every resident voting on the rules, not just the secretary deciding.

hindi: घृणित निष्कर्ष — जनसंख्या-नीति में कुल सुख बढ़ाने के असहज परिणाम की समस्या
definition: Derek Parfit's troubling result that, if we only maximise total wellbeing, a vast population of people whose lives are barely worth living would count as better than a smaller, flourishing population
example: The group chat about future cities reached the repugnant conclusion when someone proposed ten billion people sharing one lukewarm shower.

hindi: चिंतनशील द्रव्य — देकार्त के अनुसार मन, जिसका सार सोचना है
definition: Descartes's Latin phrase meaning 'thinking thing', naming the mind as a substance whose whole nature is thinking and which occupies no space
example: Slumped over the laptop at midnight, Ananya described herself as pure res cogitans, the body having clocked out hours earlier.

hindi: विस्तारयुक्त द्रव्य — देकार्त के अनुसार भौतिक पदार्थ, जिसका सार लंबाई-चौड़ाई में फैलाव है
definition: Descartes's Latin phrase meaning 'extended thing', naming physical matter as a substance whose whole nature is taking up space in length, breadth and depth
example: Moving house, Rahul realised his grandmother's steel almirah was res extensa of the most stubborn kind.

hindi: शोध कार्यक्रम — अटल मूल सिद्धांतों और उनकी रक्षक परिकल्पनाओं का विकासशील समूह
definition: Lakatos's term for a series of theories sharing an untouchable core of assumptions, guarded by adjustable supporting hypotheses that absorb failed predictions
example: Tanya's fitness plan had become a research programme, with a fixed core of 'no sugar' and endlessly revised excuses around it.

hindi: सादृश्य-नामवाद — वस्तुओं की समानता को साझा सामान्य नहीं, केवल आपसी सादृश्य से समझाने का मत
definition: the view that there are no universals, and that things count as having the same property simply because they resemble one another
example: The twins' matching laughs, according to their resemblance nominalism loving uncle, required no shared universal, just a family that resembled itself too much.

hindi: श्रम की आरक्षित सेना — बेरोज़गारों का वह समूह जो मज़दूरी को नीचे रखता है
definition: the Marxist term for the unemployed and underemployed, whose readiness to take jobs keeps wages depressed and workers anxious
example: When fifty applicants queued for one internship, Aisha felt the reserve army of labour breathing down her neck.

hindi: आरक्षित शर्त — हर संकल्प के साथ 'यदि परिस्थितियाँ अनुमति दें' जोड़ना
definition: the Stoic habit of pursuing every plan with the silent condition that fate may block it, so disappointment does not overturn your calm
example: Aisha planned the picnic with a reserve clause, which proved useful when the monsoon arrived precisely at lunchtime.

hindi: व्यक्ति-सम्मान — हर मनुष्य को स्वयं निर्णय लेने वाला प्राणी मानने का सिद्धांत
definition: the research-ethics principle that people must be treated as capable of deciding for themselves, while those with reduced decision capacity receive extra protection
example: Out of respect for persons, the psychology student asked each classmate before adding them to her survey rather than just sending a link.

hindi: प्रतिक्रिया-आश्रितता — किसी गुण को उपयुक्त परिस्थितियों में मनुष्यों की प्रतिक्रियाओं से परिभाषित करने का मत
definition: the view that some properties, such as colours or moral qualities, consist in a tendency to produce certain responses in suitable observers under suitable conditions
example: Response-dependence came up when Divya argued that the office joke was offensive because reasonable colleagues would respond with discomfort.

hindi: उत्तरदायित्व-रिक्तता — स्वायत्त यंत्र की हानि के लिए किसी मनुष्य का पूरा उत्तरदायी न ठहर पाना
definition: the problem that when autonomous machines, meaning systems acting without human control such as self-learning software or driverless vehicles, cause harm, no person seems fully responsible
example: When the delivery robot flattened the neighbour's tulips, the building group chat spent an hour arguing over the responsibility gap.

hindi: प्रतिशोधी द्वेष — दुर्बल का शक्तिशाली के प्रति दबा हुआ बैर जो मूल्य बदल देता है
definition: Nietzsche's term for the buried resentment of the weak toward the strong, which takes revenge by redefining the strong's qualities as moral failings
example: Simran admitted her rants about people who wake early were probably ressentiment rather than principle.

hindi: पुनर्स्थापनात्मक न्याय — दंड से अधिक हुई क्षति की भरपाई और संबंधों की मरम्मत पर बल
definition: an approach to wrongdoing that focuses on repairing harm through dialogue between offender, victim and community, rather than mainly on punishment
example: The teacher chose restorative justice, so the boys who broke the window spent Saturday helping fix it alongside the caretaker.

hindi: परिणामगत संयोग — कर्म के अनियंत्रित परिणामों से जुड़ा नैतिक भाग्य
definition: the kind of moral luck in which chance decides how an action turns out, so that identical choices earn different blame depending on their results
example: Both interns forgot to save the file, but resultant luck meant only Aarav's laptop crashed before the client meeting.

hindi: प्रतिकारी न्याय — अपराधी को उसके अपराध के अनुपात में दंड देने का मत
definition: the view that wrongdoers deserve punishment in proportion to their wrongdoing, and that this deserved punishment is justified in itself
example: Retributive justice ruled the flat that week: whoever ate the last mango had to scrub every pan in the sink.

hindi: प्रतिकारवाद — अपराधी दंड का पात्र है क्योंकि उसने अपराध किया, भविष्य के लाभ के कारण नहीं
definition: the view that punishment is justified because offenders deserve suffering in proportion to their wrongdoing, and not because punishing them produces good future consequences
example: Kavya's retributivism showed when she insisted her flatmate replace the exact yoghurt he stole, no more and no less.

hindi: प्रतिगामी अनुमान — परिणाम से पीछे जाकर संभावित कारण की परिकल्पना बनाना
definition: Peirce's name, also called abduction, for reasoning backwards from a surprising observation to a hypothesis, a testable guess, that would explain it
example: Retroduction from the empty milk carton and the wet counter led Zoya to a single suspect: her flatmate's midnight cereal habit.

hindi: प्रकाशन — ईश्वर द्वारा मनुष्य को सत्य प्रकट करना; श्रुति
definition: the disclosure of truth by the divine to human beings, through scripture, prophets or experience, which reason alone could not discover
example: Finding the missing charger behind the sofa felt like revelation to Ananya, though no prophet was involved.

hindi: जीवन के प्रति श्रद्धा — हर जीवित प्राणी के प्रति आदर को नैतिकता की नींव मानने का सिद्धांत
definition: the ethical principle that every living being deserves wonder and respect, so that preserving and helping life is good and destroying it is wrong
example: Carrying the spider outside in a mug, Leela explained that reverence for life applied even to housemates with eight legs.

hindi: संशोधनवादी तत्त्वमीमांसा — संसार के बारे में हमारी सोच की संरचना को बदलने का प्रयास
definition: Strawson's term for metaphysics that tries to replace or correct the basic structure of our everyday thinking about the world with a supposedly better scheme
example: Rewriting the whole filing system instead of learning the old one, the new manager was practising revisionary metaphysics on the office.

hindi: क्रांतिकारी विज्ञान — स्थापित ढाँचे को उखाड़कर नया ढाँचा रचने वाला वैज्ञानिक कार्य
definition: Kuhn's term for research during a crisis that overturns an accepted framework, in contrast with normal science that works within one
example: The professor warned her graduate students that revolutionary science is thrilling in textbooks but terrible for grant renewals.

hindi: प्रकंद — बिना केंद्र या पदानुक्रम के फैलने वाला जाल
definition: deleuze and Guattari's image of thought or culture as a spreading network without centre, beginning or hierarchy, like underground roots, rather than a single branching tree
example: The group chat spun off side threads, memes and private messages until it became a rhizome nobody could summarise.

hindi: रिचर्ड विरोधाभास — शब्दों से परिभाषित संख्याओं की सूची से उपजा विरोधाभास
definition: a puzzle showing that listing every decimal number definable in English words lets you define a new number missing from that list, contradicting the list's completeness
example: The coding bootcamp instructor used Richard's paradox to explain why no single list could capture every describable number.

hindi: क्रांति का अधिकार — अत्याचारी शासन को हटाने का जनता का अधिकार
definition: the doctrine, associated with Locke, that a people may rightfully overthrow a government that breaks its trust and violates their basic rights
example: When the family council banned dessert forever, the youngest invoked the right of revolution and hid the fridge key.

hindi: सम्यक् बुद्धि — वह सही विवेक जो सद्गुणी व्यक्ति के चुनाव का मार्गदर्शन करता है
definition: the correct reasoning, called orthos logos in Greek, that guides a virtuous person's choices and fixes where the right balance lies in each situation
example: Dev insisted that right reason, not hunger, had guided him to order exactly one samosa instead of four.

hindi: मृत्यु का अधिकार — अपनी मृत्यु के समय और ढंग को स्वयं चुनने का दावा
definition: the claimed moral or legal entitlement of a person, especially someone with a terminal illness, to choose the timing and manner of their own death
example: The civics teacher wrote right to die on the board and watched the whole class suddenly find their pens fascinating.

hindi: तुरुप के रूप में अधिकार — अधिकार सामूहिक लाभ के तर्कों पर भारी पड़ते हैं
definition: Dworkin's idea that individual rights override ordinary arguments about general welfare, much as a trump card beats cards of every other suit
example: The class voted to read Tanvi's diary aloud, but she played rights as trumps and the teacher agreed.

hindi: दृढ़ निर्देशक — वह नाम जो हर संभाव्य जगत में उसी वस्तु को इंगित करे
definition: Kripke's term for a name or expression that picks out the very same object in every possible world where that object exists, unlike a description that could pick out different things
example: Kabir explained that 'Mumbai' is a rigid designator, whereas 'the city with the worst commute' might describe somewhere else in another possible world.

hindi: कठोरतावाद — नैतिक नियमों को बिना किसी अपवाद के पालन करने का आग्रह
definition: the view that moral rules must be followed strictly without exceptions, a charge often made against Kant's refusal to allow lying
example: Gauri's rigorism meant she wouldn't even tell her grandmother the dry cake was delicious, which made family dinners tense.

hindi: ऋण — हर व्यक्ति पर देवताओं, ऋषियों और पितरों के तीन ऋण
definition: the moral debts every person is born owing in Hindu thought: to the deities, to the sages who taught, and to ancestors
example: Calling her grandmother every Sunday, Pallavi said she was paying off her rina one phone call at a time.

hindi: गाइजीज़ की अँगूठी — अदृश्य होने पर भी न्यायी रहने की परीक्षा करने वाला विचार-प्रयोग
definition: Plato's thought experiment about a ring that makes its wearer invisible, asking whether anyone would stay just if they could never be caught
example: Noticing the office camera was broken, Sahil faced his own ring of Gyges over the unlabelled cake in the fridge.

hindi: सहसा-बोध ध्यान शाखा — पहेलीनुमा प्रश्नों से अचानक बोध जगाने वाली जापानी परंपरा
definition: the Japanese branch of meditation Buddhism that trains students with koans, baffling riddles, and sharp teacher encounters to provoke sudden awakening
example: Aarav said his debate coach ran practice like a Rinzai master, firing impossible questions until somebody's brain simply gave up and saw clearly.

hindi: यंत्रमानव उत्तर — संवेदन और गति जोड़ने से समझ आ सकने वाला प्रत्युत्तर
definition: the reply to the Chinese room argument claiming that a program placed inside a robot with cameras and limbs, linking symbols to the world, would genuinely understand
example: Watching the delivery robot bump into the office door, Maya decided the robot reply had a long way to go before anyone called it understanding.

hindi: यंत्रमानव-अधिकार — पर्याप्त उन्नत यंत्रमानवों और कृत्रिम बुद्धि के भी नैतिक अधिकार होने का मत
definition: the view that sufficiently advanced robots or artificial intelligence systems might deserve moral rights, such as protection from abuse or deletion
example: After her brother kicked the robot vacuum, Diya launched a heartfelt campaign for robot rights at the breakfast table.

hindi: सुदृढ़ चिंता-मत — प्रेम को प्रिय के भले की उसके अपने लिए परवाह मानना
definition: the view that love consists mainly in caring about the beloved's wellbeing for that person's own sake, rather than in forming a shared identity
example: Ishaan backed his partner's move abroad despite missing her terribly, which his philosophy tutor called the robust concern view in action.

hindi: दृढ़ नैतिक यथार्थवाद — नैतिक तथ्यों को प्राकृतिक तथ्यों से भिन्न, स्वतंत्र और वास्तविक मानने का मत
definition: a strong form of moral realism holding that moral facts are objective, exist whatever anyone thinks, and cannot be boiled down to natural facts studied by science
example: Priya's robust realism meant she thought the wrongness of ghosting a friend was as real as gravity, just not something a physicist could measure.

hindi: भूमिका नीतिशास्त्र — संबंधों और सामाजिक भूमिकाओं के निर्वाह को नैतिकता का केंद्र मानने का मत
definition: an interpretation of Confucian thought holding that moral life consists in performing your family and social roles well, as child, parent, friend or colleague
example: Juggling duties as daughter, sister and team lead in one evening, Anika joked that role ethics required a shared calendar.

hindi: रोमन स्टोइकवाद — सेनेका, एपिक्टेटस और मार्कस ऑरेलियस का व्यावहारिक स्टोइक दर्शन
definition: the later, practical form of Stoicism developed by Seneca, Epictetus and Marcus Aurelius, focused on daily discipline, duty and handling hardship
example: Nidhi's journaling habit began as Roman Stoicism and ended as a list of snacks she regretted eating.

hindi: प्रणय-प्रेम — किसी एक व्यक्ति के प्रति गहरी, चुनी हुई और आत्मीय प्रीति
definition: the intense, exclusive love between partners that combines desire, deep affection and wanting to share a life, often seen as chosen rather than given
example: In the group chat, Kabir declared romantic love dead until someone pointed out he had just spent forty minutes choosing an anniversary gift.

hindi: रज्जु-सर्प दृष्टान्त — अँधेरे में रस्सी को साँप समझने का उदाहरण
definition: the Advaita illustration of a rope mistaken for a snake in faint light, showing how ignorance superimposes a false world onto the real Brahman
example: When a charging cable in the dark hallway made Amit leap, his sister calmly explained the rope-snake analogy.

hindi: रॉस विरोधाभास — दायित्व से अनचाहे वैकल्पिक दायित्व निकलने की पहेली
definition: the puzzle in deontic logic that from an obligation to post a letter it seems to follow an obligation to post it or burn it, which sounds absurd
example: When told he must return the book, Yash cited Ross's paradox and asked whether returning it or losing it would therefore also satisfy the duty.

hindi: ऋत — ब्रह्मांड की नैतिक और प्राकृतिक व्यवस्था
definition: in the Vedas, the cosmic order that keeps nature regular, rituals effective and human conduct right, an early forerunner of dharma
example: When the monsoon arrived exactly on schedule, Grandmother nodded as if rta were still keeping its appointments.

hindi: नियम-परिणामवाद — उन नियमों के पालन का मत जिनका सामान्य पालन सबसे अच्छे परिणाम देता है
definition: the form of consequentialism holding that an action is right when it follows a rule whose general acceptance would produce the best consequences, rather than judging each action alone
example: The flatmates settled on rule consequentialism for the dishes: everyone washes their own plate, because the kitchen works best when nobody makes exceptions.

hindi: अनुमान-नियम — वह नियम जो बताता है कि किन आधारों से कौन-सा निष्कर्ष वैध रूप से निकलता है
definition: a formal rule stating which conclusions may validly be drawn from premises of a given form, such as modus ponens
example: Kunal insisted that 'mum said maybe' was not a rule of inference that licensed buying the new console.

hindi: विधि का शासन — सभी पर, शासकों समेत, समान रूप से कानून लागू होने का सिद्धांत
definition: the principle that everyone, including rulers and officials, is bound by clear, public laws applied equally, rather than by the private wishes of powerful people
example: When the principal also got a detention slip for using his phone in assembly, the students cheered for the rule of law.

hindi: मान्यता-नियम — वह मूल सामाजिक नियम जिससे पहचाना जाता है कि कौन-सा नियम वैध क़ानून है
definition: Hart's term for the basic social rule, accepted mainly by officials such as judges, that sets out which sources and procedures make other rules count as valid laws
example: The group chat's rule of recognition was simple: a plan counted as official only once Nisha pinned the message.

hindi: बचाव का नियम — संकट में दिखते किसी व्यक्ति को हर कीमत पर बचाने की प्रवृत्ति
definition: the strong human impulse to save an identifiable person in immediate danger whatever the cost, even when resources could save more lives elsewhere
example: The whole office donated to rescue one stranded kitten, and Priyanka blamed the rule of rescue for the empty snack fund.

hindi: नियम-उपयोगितावाद — उन नियमों के पालन का मत जिनका सामान्य पालन सबसे अधिक सुख देता है
definition: the form of utilitarianism holding that an action is right when it follows a rule whose general acceptance would produce the greatest total happiness or wellbeing
example: Meera invoked rule utilitarianism in the group chat: if everyone replied late whenever it suited them, nobody's weekend plans would ever happen.

hindi: नियम-पूजा — किसी नियम का पालन तब भी करना जब उसके टूटने से अधिक भलाई हो
definition: J. J. C. Smart's charge against rule utilitarianism, that following a beneficial rule even when breaking it would produce more happiness turns the rule into an idol
example: Refusing to jaywalk across an empty village street at midnight, Gaurav was teased for rule worship by his cousins.

hindi: नियम-पालन विरोधाभास — किसी नियम के सही पालन के निर्धारण की समस्या
definition: the puzzle, from Wittgenstein and Kripke, that no past behaviour or inner thought fixes which rule someone is following, since any action could match some rule
example: When the new flatmate "followed" the cleaning rota by rearranging the dust, the rule-following paradox came home.

hindi: रसेल विरोधाभास — स्वयं को सदस्य न रखने वाले सभी समुच्चयों के समुच्चय का विरोधाभास
definition: the puzzle about the collection of all collections that are not members of themselves, which is a member of itself exactly when it is not, exposing a flaw in early theories of collections
example: Ananya's club for people who never join clubs fell apart the moment someone pointed out Russell's paradox.

hindi: रसेल की केतली — अप्रमाण्य दावे का भार दावा करने वाले पर होने का दृष्टांत
definition: an analogy showing that the burden of proof lies with the person making an unfalsifiable claim, not with those who doubt it
example: Asked to disprove that his sister's lucky socks won the match, Rohan cited Russell's teapot and demanded she prove it first.

hindi: एस5 प्रणाली — वह प्रकारमूलक तंत्र जिसमें हर संभव लोक हर दूसरे से सुगम्य हो
definition: the strongest standard system of modal logic, in which whatever is possible is necessarily possible, because every possible world counts as accessible from every other
example: Meera claimed her diet plan ran on S5, since it was necessarily possible that she would start it tomorrow.

hindi: साधन चतुष्टय — वेदान्त के अध्ययन हेतु चार आवश्यक योग्यताएँ
definition: the four qualifications a student needs before studying Vedanta: discrimination, detachment, inner disciplines such as calm and self-control, and longing for liberation
example: The gym coach listed his own sadhana chatushtaya: discrimination, detachment from snacks, discipline and a burning longing for abs.

hindi: साधारण धर्म — सभी मनुष्यों पर समान रूप से लागू होने वाले कर्तव्य
definition: the duties shared by all human beings regardless of caste or stage of life, such as truthfulness, nonviolence and self-control
example: Whatever their role in the group project, the teacher reminded everyone that honesty was sadharana dharma and not optional.

hindi: साध्य — अनुमान द्वारा सिद्ध किया जाने वाला धर्म
definition: in Nyaya logic, the property to be proved in an inference, such as fire on the hill, which the reason must be shown to carry with it
example: Once Ishaan named the sadhya as 'someone ate my lunch', the rest of the office inquiry followed quickly.

hindi: सुरक्षा शर्त — निकट संभावित स्थितियों में भी विश्वास के सत्य रहने की शर्त
definition: the requirement that a belief counts as knowledge only if, in similar nearby situations, you would not easily have believed it falsely
example: Aman's claim that the coffee machine worked failed the safety condition, since it broke every second morning.

hindi: सेगन मानक — असाधारण दावों के लिए असाधारण प्रमाण आवश्यक होने का सिद्धांत
definition: the principle that extraordinary claims require extraordinary evidence, so the more surprising an assertion is, the stronger its support must be
example: Meera applied the Sagan standard to her friend's story about a ghost in the staff room and asked for more than one blurry photo.

hindi: प्रज्ञा दर्शन — परंपरागत ज्ञानी व्यक्तियों के चिंतन पर आधारित अफ़्रीकी दर्शन
definition: Henry Odera Oruka's approach that finds African philosophy in the critical reasoning of individual wise elders, recorded through interviews, rather than in anonymous tradition
example: Recording his grandmother's arguments about fairness for a class project, Juma realised he was doing sage philosophy.

hindi: ऋषि-राजा — प्रज्ञा और सद्गुण से शासन करने वाला आदर्श राजा
definition: the Chinese ideal of a ruler of perfect wisdom and virtue, such as the legendary early kings, whose goodness alone brings peace and order
example: The residents' association wanted a sage-king but settled for a retired accountant with a spreadsheet.

hindi: सगुण ब्रह्म — गुणों सहित ब्रह्म, जिसे ईश्वर रूप में पूजा जाता है
definition: Brahman understood with qualities, such as mercy, power and personal form, which makes the ultimate reality approachable through worship and devotion
example: Grandma preferred saguna Brahman, explaining that she could not light a lamp for something with no qualities at all.

hindi: सहृदय — काव्य और कला के रस को ग्रहण करने में सक्षम संवेदनशील रसिक
definition: the Indian aesthetic ideal of a sensitive, cultivated audience member whose heart is attuned enough to savour the emotional flavour of poetry and drama
example: Shreya proved herself a true sahridaya when she teared up at the classical recital while her brother checked cricket scores.

hindi: साकारवाद — ज्ञान में विषय का आकार उपस्थित होने का मत
definition: the Indian and Buddhist view that cognition carries the form or image of its object within itself, so awareness of an object means awareness of that inner form
example: Rewatching the match highlights, Ashwin argued for sakaravada: the goal was replaying inside his cognition, form and all.

hindi: साक्षी — सब अनुभवों को निष्पक्ष देखने वाली शुद्ध चेतना
definition: witness consciousness, the pure awareness in Vedanta that observes every thought, feeling and experience without being changed or touched by them
example: While her siblings argued over the remote, Diya sat back as the sakshi, silently witnessing and eating popcorn.

hindi: सल्लेखना — जीवन के अंत में धीरे-धीरे आहार त्याग कर शांत मृत्यु स्वीकारने का जैन व्रत
definition: the Jain solemn promise to face death peacefully by gradually giving away food and drink, undertaken near the natural close of life with calm acceptance and religious guidance
example: In the bioethics debate, Farah explained that sallekhana is understood by Jains as a calm spiritual discipline, which is why the court case about it drew such careful arguments.

hindi: जनकल्याण ही सर्वोच्च विधि — प्रजा की भलाई को हर कानून से ऊपर रखने का सूत्र
definition: Latin for 'the welfare of the people is the supreme law', the principle that government exists above all to protect the safety and wellbeing of its people
example: Cancelling the school trip because of the storm, the principal simply wrote salus populi suprema lex on the whiteboard.

hindi: सत्य-रक्षण सहित — ऐसा प्रतिस्थापन जिससे वाक्य की सत्यता न बदले
definition: a Latin expression meaning 'saving the truth', used when one term can replace another within a sentence without changing whether that sentence is true or false
example: In the office rota, 'Monday' and 'the worst morning' could be swapped salva veritate, according to everyone except the manager.

hindi: समाधि — ध्यान की वह अवस्था जिसमें ध्याता और ध्येय एक हो जाते हैं
definition: in Yoga philosophy, the eighth and final limb of the eight-limbed path, meditative absorption so complete that the sense of a separate meditator disappears
example: Watching her grandmother shell peas in perfect silence, Kavya wondered whether this was what samadhi looked like in a kitchen.

hindi: सामान्य — वैशेषिक दर्शन में अनेक वस्तुओं में रहने वाला नित्य सामान्य धर्म
definition: in Vaisheshika and Nyaya philosophy, the universal, an eternal shared nature such as cowness that resides in every individual of a kind
example: Seeing a dozen stray cows blocking the lane, Gaurav said at least their samanya was stable, even if the traffic was not.

hindi: समवाय — वैशेषिक-न्याय में गुण, कर्म और द्रव्य के बीच का नित्य अविभाज्य संबंध
definition: in Vaisheshika and Nyaya philosophy, inherence, the inseparable relation binding a quality to its substance or a whole to its parts
example: Kiran said the relation between his mother and her morning chai was pure samavaya, since nobody had ever seen the pair apart.

hindi: सामायिक — समता भाव से किया जाने वाला जैन ध्यान-व्रत
definition: the Jain practice of setting aside a fixed period for calm meditation, during which a person tries to treat all beings and events with equal composure
example: Before opening her work email each morning, Deepa spends forty minutes on samayika so the inbox cannot upset her equanimity.

hindi: सांख्य — पुरुष और प्रकृति के द्वैत पर आधारित भारतीय दर्शन
definition: the classical Indian school holding that reality rests on a pair of independent principles, conscious spirit called purusha and unconscious nature called prakriti, and that liberation comes from knowing them apart
example: Sorting her notes into 'the watcher' and 'everything watched', Aditi realised she had drawn a Samkhya chart for her philosophy exam.

hindi: संसार — जन्म, मृत्यु और पुनर्जन्म का अनवरत चक्र
definition: the endless cycle of birth, death and rebirth that Indian traditions describe, driven by karma and escaped only through liberation
example: Stuck in his fourth weekly status meeting about the same delayed project, Arjun felt he finally understood samsara.

hindi: संस्कार — पिछले कर्मों से मन पर पड़ी छाप
definition: a deep mental impression left by past actions and experiences, which shapes habits, character and future actions
example: Pranav's habit of switching off every light was a samskara from childhood, where electricity bills were a family crisis.

hindi: संवर — संयम द्वारा आत्मा में नए कर्मों के प्रवेश को रोकना
definition: in Jain philosophy, the stopping of fresh karmic matter from flowing into the soul, achieved through self-control, careful conduct and vows
example: Muting every work group after seven in the evening was, Priya claimed, her personal practice of samvara.

hindi: संचित कर्म — पिछले जन्मों में संचित समस्त कर्मों का भंडार
definition: the entire stored balance of karma gathered from all past lives, which has not yet begun to bear its results
example: Dropping his phone for the third time that week, Nikhil wondered how much sanchita karma was still waiting in storage.

hindi: जीवन की पवित्रता — मानव जीवन को स्वभावतः पवित्र और अनुल्लंघनीय मानने का मत
definition: the view that human life is sacred or intrinsically valuable, so that deliberately ending an innocent human life is always wrong
example: Grandma invoked the sanctity of life to stop anyone swatting the spider, which then lived rent-free behind the fridge.

hindi: सन्निकर्ष — इंद्रिय और विषय का संपर्क जिससे प्रत्यक्ष ज्ञान उत्पन्न होता है
definition: in Nyaya, the classical Indian school of logic, the contact or connection between a sense organ and its object, which the school holds must occur for perception to arise
example: Mumbling that sannikarsha had failed, Gaurav explained why he never noticed the ringing phone buried under his laundry.

hindi: संन्यास — सब सांसारिक बंधनों के त्याग की अवस्था
definition: the fourth and final stage of life in Hindu thought, renouncing possessions and social ties to seek liberation
example: After deleting every social media account, Vivek joked that he had taken digital sannyasa.

hindi: संथारा — सल्लेखना का प्रचलित नाम, आहार त्याग द्वारा शांत देह-त्याग
definition: another name for the Jain solemn promise to face death peacefully by gradually giving away food and drink near the natural close of life
example: Reading the newspaper over breakfast, Ananya explained to her cousin that santhara is the everyday Jain name for what textbooks call sallekhana.

hindi: संतोष — जो है उसमें प्रसन्न रहने का गुण
definition: contentment, being at peace with what you have rather than restlessly craving more, one of the personal observances in yoga
example: When the café ran out of croissants, Abhay chose santosha and a slightly stale muffin.

hindi: सप्तभंगी — किसी वस्तु के विषय में सात प्रकार के सापेक्ष कथनों की जैन पद्धति
definition: the Jain method of sevenfold predication, which describes anything through seven qualified statements, such as perhaps it is, perhaps it is not, and perhaps it cannot be described
example: Asked whether the exam was hard, Simran gave a full saptabhangi answer until her friends begged her to pick one of the seven.

hindi: सर्वास्तिवाद — भूत, वर्तमान और भविष्य तीनों के अस्तित्व का बौद्ध मत
definition: an early Buddhist school holding that the basic elements of existence are real in past, present and future alike, which explains how past actions still produce effects
example: Arguing that his embarrassing school photos still counted, Mohit sounded like a Sarvastivada monk.

hindi: सर्वोदय — सबके उदय और कल्याण का गांधीवादी आदर्श
definition: the Gandhian ideal of the welfare and uplift of everyone, especially the poorest, through village cooperation and nonviolent social change
example: The colony's sarvodaya spirit showed when residents pooled funds so the night guard's daughter could finish school.

hindi: सासा — म्बीती के अनुसार वर्तमान और निकट अतीत-भविष्य का जीवंत समय
definition: in John Mbiti's account of African concepts of time, the lived present together with the recent past and immediate future that people actually experience
example: Planning only for next week, never next year, Wanjiru said she lived entirely in the Sasa.

hindi: सत् — वेदांत और उपनिषदों में शुद्ध अस्तित्व या परम सत्य
definition: the Sanskrit term for being, existence or reality, used in the Upanishads and Vedanta, ancient Indian scriptures and the school built upon them, for ultimate unchanging reality
example: In the reading circle, Ishaan argued that sat means more than things existing; it names the reality underneath all of them.

hindi: सच्चिदानन्द — सत्, चित् और आनन्द, ब्रह्म का स्वरूप
definition: the Vedantic description of Brahman as being, consciousness and bliss, three words pointing to the single nature of ultimate reality
example: Lying in a hammock after exams, Aarav claimed he had finally tasted satchidananda, or at least a long nap.

hindi: पर्याप्ततावादी परिणामवाद — सर्वोत्तम नहीं, पर्याप्त अच्छे परिणाम देने वाले कर्म को सही मानने का मत
definition: the form of consequentialism holding that an action is right when its consequences are good enough, rather than requiring the very best possible outcome
example: Sneha's satisficing consequentialism approved the takeaway dinner: not the healthiest meal possible, but good enough for a Tuesday.

hindi: सत्कार्यवाद — सांख्य मत कि कार्य अपनी उत्पत्ति से पहले ही अपने कारण में विद्यमान रहता है
definition: the Samkhya doctrine that an effect already exists, in hidden form, inside its material cause before it appears, as curd is present potentially in milk
example: Setting the milk to curdle overnight, Nani explained satkaryavada: the curd was already there, just waiting for morning.

hindi: बोधि — अचानक प्रकट होने वाला आत्मज्ञान का गहरा अनुभव
definition: the Japanese Buddhist term for sudden awakening, a direct experience of seeing things as they truly are, beyond words and concepts
example: After weeks of struggling with fractions, Anaya had a small satori in the kitchen when she finally cut a pizza into eighths.

hindi: सत्त्व — प्रकृति का प्रकाश, स्पष्टता और संतुलन वाला गुण
definition: in Samkhya, the strand of nature marked by clarity, lightness, balance and calm understanding, one of the three qualities woven through everything
example: After a quiet walk and a light breakfast, Arjun claimed his brain was running on pure sattva, until the group chat woke up.

hindi: संतृप्त परिघटना — ऐसा अनुभव जो हमारी समझ की क्षमता से अधिक भरा हो
definition: jean-Luc Marion's term for an experience so overflowing with meaning, like wonder before a vast artwork, that no concept can fully contain it
example: Standing before the giant cinema screen, Omkar called the film a saturated phenomenon, then admitted he had also eaten too much popcorn.

hindi: सत्य — मन, वचन और कर्म में सच्चाई
definition: truthfulness in thought, speech and action, counted among the basic ethical restraints in Indian traditions
example: Asked whether she liked the haircut, Zoya weighed satya against kindness and settled on 'it's very brave'.

hindi: सौत्रान्तिक — केवल वर्तमान क्षण को वास्तविक मानने वाला बौद्ध मत
definition: an early Buddhist school that relied on the sutras and held that only the present moment is real, with past and future elements not truly existing
example: Refusing to discuss last week's argument, Gauri took a firmly Sautrantika line: only the present counts.

hindi: सविकल्पक — नाम, जाति और गुण सहित निश्चित प्रत्यक्ष
definition: in Indian theories of perception, describing determinate perception, where an object is grasped together with its name, kind and qualities, as in recognising 'this is a mango'
example: The blur at the bus stop became savikalpaka the moment Ritvik recognised it as his tutor, and he hid behind a newspaper.

hindi: क्रमिक परिणामवाद — कर्मों को सही-गलत में नहीं, कम-ज़्यादा अच्छे के पैमाने पर आँकने का मत
definition: the form of consequentialism holding that actions are only better or worse by degrees according to their consequences, with no sharp line between right and wrong
example: Under scalar consequentialism, texting back after three days was simply worse than texting back after one, not a moral crime.

hindi: क्रमिक निहितार्थ — कमज़ोर शब्द चुनने से प्रबल विकल्प के निषेध का संकेत
definition: an inference that a stronger statement is false because the speaker chose a weaker word on a scale, so "some" suggests "not all"
example: "I ate some of the cake" triggered a scalar implicature that the empty plate flatly contradicted.

hindi: संशयवादी परिकल्पना — अनुभव को भ्रम सिद्ध करने वाली कल्पना
definition: any imagined scenario, such as dreaming or deception by a computer, in which your experiences would feel exactly the same yet your beliefs would be false
example: Mahira's favourite sceptical hypothesis was that her whole commute was a dream, which explained why the train was on time.

hindi: संशयवाद — निश्चित ज्ञान की संभावना पर प्रश्न उठाने वाला मत
definition: the philosophical attitude that questions whether we can have certain knowledge, or any knowledge at all, about ourselves and the world
example: When the weather app promised sunshine for the fifth day running, Tanvi packed an umbrella out of pure scepticism.

hindi: रूपरेखा-विधान — अमूर्त श्रेणियों को काल के माध्यम से अनुभव पर लागू करने की प्रक्रिया
definition: Kant's account of how abstract concepts such as cause become connected to sensory experience, through time-based rules that tell the mind how each concept looks in practice
example: Explaining schematism to her cousin, Leela said the concept of a dog needs a rough mental template before it can recognise the neighbour's poodle.

hindi: विद्वत्परंपरावाद — मध्ययुगीन विद्यापीठों में तर्क से आस्था के प्रश्न सुलझाने की पद्धति
definition: the method of medieval European universities that used careful logic, close reading of authorities and formal debate to explain and defend religious faith
example: Priya answered her flatmate's question about the dishes with three objections, two replies and a final ruling, which everyone agreed was pure scholasticism.

hindi: नामवाद संप्रदाय — भाषा और तर्क के विरोधाभासों पर विचार करने वाला चीनी संप्रदाय
definition: the ancient Chinese group of thinkers who studied language, logic and naming, famous for puzzling paradoxes about how words relate to things
example: Arguing that a hot dog is not a dog, Yash sounded like a founding member of the School of Names.

hindi: शोपेनहावरवादी — संसार को अंधी इच्छा और दुःख से भरा मानने वाले दृष्टिकोण से जुड़ा
definition: relating to Schopenhauer's thought, especially its gloomy view that blind will drives every living thing and that life brings more suffering than happiness
example: After losing his third phone charger this month, Manav took a thoroughly Schopenhauerian view of household electronics.

hindi: श्रोडिंगर की बिल्ली — अवलोकन से पहले दोहरी अवस्था की विरोधाभासी परिकल्पना
definition: Erwin Schrödinger's thought experiment of a sealed chamber holding a living animal whose survival depends on a random atomic event, used to question whether it could be both alive and dead until observed
example: Until the exam results were posted, Rohit insisted he was Schrödinger's cat, both passing and failing chemistry at once.

hindi: अंतःप्रज्ञात्मक ज्ञान — स्पिनोज़ा के अनुसार ज्ञान का सर्वोच्च प्रकार
definition: Spinoza's Latin phrase for intuitive knowledge, the highest kind of knowing, which grasps a particular thing directly through its relation to the whole of nature
example: After months of practice, Sneha solved the puzzle in a flash and called it scientia intuitiva, while her brother called it luck.

hindi: वैज्ञानिक अयथार्थवाद — सफल सिद्धांतों के अदृश्य तत्त्वों पर विश्वास को अनावश्यक मानने का मत
definition: the view that scientific success does not require believing that theories' claims about unobservable entities are true, only that theories work
example: Rohan's scientific antirealism toward his car's software was relaxed: he never believed its diagrams, only that the dashboard lights behaved.

hindi: वैज्ञानिक प्रतिमा — विज्ञान द्वारा वर्णित कणों और नियमों का जगत
definition: Wilfrid Sellars's term for the picture of the world offered by theoretical science, as particles, fields and laws, which competes with our everyday picture
example: In the scientific image, Ravi's warm mug was a crowd of jittering molecules, which did nothing to improve the coffee.

hindi: वैज्ञानिक प्रगति — समय के साथ विज्ञान का बेहतर होते जाना और उस सुधार की कसौटी का विचार
definition: the improvement of science over time, and the philosophical debate over whether it consists in reaching truth, solving more problems or gaining knowledge
example: Scrolling past a fifty-year-old medical ad, Divya decided scientific progress was real, since doctors no longer recommend cigarettes.

hindi: वैज्ञानिक यथार्थवाद — सफल सिद्धांतों को अदृश्य जगत का लगभग सच्चा चित्र मानने का मत
definition: the view that our most successful scientific theories are approximately true, and that the unseen entities they describe, such as electrons and genes, really exist
example: Watching the phone charge, Kabir defended scientific realism: if electrons were fiction, his battery would not be climbing to eighty percent.

hindi: वैज्ञानिक क्रांति — किसी विज्ञान के मूल ढाँचे का पूर्ण रूप से बदल जाना
definition: Kuhn's name for an episode in which a scientific community abandons its accepted framework and adopts a fundamentally different one
