example: Divya told her physics class that switching from paper notes to tablets was no scientific revolution, however loudly the boys cheered.

hindi: वैज्ञानिक समाजवाद — इतिहास के भौतिक नियमों पर आधारित होने का दावा करने वाला मार्क्सवादी समाजवाद
definition: the name Marx and Engels gave their socialism to claim it rested on analysis of historical and economic laws rather than on moral wishes
example: Vikram insisted his chore chart was scientific socialism because he had tracked six weeks of dish-washing data.

hindi: व्याप्ति-संबंधी — किसी तार्किक शब्द के प्रभाव-क्षेत्र से जुड़ा
definition: relating to scope, meaning how much of a sentence a word like 'every' or 'never' controls, which can change the whole meaning
example: 'Every student didn't pass' has a scopal ambiguity that sent the class group chat into a panic until the teacher clarified.

hindi: स्कॉटसवाद — डन्स स्कॉटस के दर्शन पर आधारित परंपरा
definition: the philosophical school following Duns Scotus, known for thisness, the univocity of being, the formal distinction and the priority of will over intellect
example: In the seminar, Ananya's Scotism made her split every hair into formal distinctions, which delighted exactly one professor.

hindi: स्कॉटिश प्रबोधन — अठारहवीं सदी के स्कॉटलैंड का बौद्धिक आंदोलन
definition: the eighteenth century flowering of Scottish thought, including Hume, Smith, Reid and Hutcheson, stressing human nature, sentiment, commerce and society
example: Over chai, Kartik claimed Edinburgh's Scottish Enlightenment ran on the same fuel as his study group: arguments, pastries and endless talk.

hindi: नैतिक संकोच — अंतरात्मा की वह झिझक जो गलत काम से रोके
definition: moral hesitations drawn from one's principles that make a person uneasy about doing something they think may be wrong
example: His scruples kicked in halfway through copying the answers, so he left the group chat and did the homework himself.

hindi: नौ-युद्ध तर्क — भविष्य के कथनों की सत्यता और नियतिवाद पर अरस्तू की पहेली
definition: Aristotle's puzzle asking whether the statement that a naval battle will happen tomorrow is already true or false today, and whether that would make the future fixed
example: Before the cricket final, Yash used the sea battle argument to claim his prediction was neither right nor wrong yet, which annoyed the group chat.

hindi: पृथकतावाद — किसी क्षेत्र या समूह के राज्य से अलग होने के अधिकार का समर्थन
definition: in political theory, the view that a region or group has the right to break away from a larger state and govern itself
example: When the top floor of the hostel threatened to run its own Wi-Fi network, the warden sensed a whiff of secessionism.

hindi: द्वितीय दर्शन — किसी बाहरी दार्शनिक आधार के बिना विज्ञान और गणित के भीतर से ही जाँच करने का दृष्टिकोण
definition: an approach to philosophy that begins inside science and mathematics, using their ordinary methods to investigate, rather than first seeking foundations from outside them
example: Instead of debating whether the recipe was justified, Hema practised second philosophy and simply tasted the curry to find out.

hindi: द्वितीय-स्तरीय इच्छा — अपनी ही किसी इच्छा के बारे में रखी गई इच्छा
definition: a desire about your desires, such as wanting to stop wanting sugar, used to explain what makes a choice truly your own
example: Pooja's second-order desire was simple: she wanted to want the salad as much as she wanted the fries.

hindi: द्वितीय-क्रम तर्कशास्त्र — ऐसा तर्कशास्त्र जिसके परिमाणक गुणों और संबंधों पर भी लागू हों
definition: a stronger form of predicate logic, the logic of objects and their properties, whose quantifiers range over properties and relations as well as individual objects
example: 'There's some quality every good barista shares' needs second-order logic, Maya claimed, while waiting twenty minutes for her flat white.

hindi: द्वितीयक गुण — रंग, स्वाद, गंध जैसे गुण जो देखने वाले के मन पर निर्भर हैं
definition: properties such as colour, taste, smell and warmth, which Locke held exist in perceivers' minds, produced by powers within the objects
example: When the sisters argued whether the dress was blue or gold, their father calmly blamed secondary qualities and left the room.

hindi: गौण द्रव्य — वह जाति या वर्ग जिसमें कोई विशिष्ट वस्तु आती है
definition: in Aristotle's categories, the species or general kind to which an individual thing belongs, such as human being or horse
example: Biscuit was the primary substance, Kavya explained, while cat was merely the secondary substance that kept getting blamed on social media.

hindi: द्वितीयता — प्रतिरोध और टकराव का अनुभव, पर्स की दूसरी श्रेणी
definition: Peirce's second category of reality: brute fact, resistance and reaction, such as the shock of bumping into a door you thought was open
example: Walking into the glass office door gave Sameer a sharp lesson in secondness.

hindi: धर्मनिरपेक्षता — शासन और सार्वजनिक जीवन को धर्म से अलग रखने का सिद्धांत
definition: the principle that government, courts and public institutions should stay separate from religion, neither backing nor controlling any faith
example: The school's secularism meant the assembly included songs from every festival, and nobody's holiday got skipped.

hindi: सेफ़िरोत — कब्बाला में ईश्वरीय गुणों के दस प्रकटीकरण
definition: in Kabbalah, the emanations or channels through which the infinite divine reveals itself, each expressing a quality such as wisdom, mercy or judgement
example: Ethan's teacher drew the sefirot on the whiteboard like a flowchart, and the class finally saw how the attributes connected.

hindi: चयनात्मक यथार्थवाद — सिद्धांत के केवल सफलता देने वाले अंशों को सत्य मानने का मत
definition: the view that we should believe only those parts of a successful theory that actually produced its successes, not every claim it makes
example: Divya took selective realism toward her aunt's cooking tips, trusting the spice ratios but quietly ignoring the lucky spoon.

hindi: आत्म-परिष्कार — अध्ययन, अभ्यास और चिंतन से अपने चरित्र को निखारना
definition: especially in Confucian thought, the lifelong work of shaping your own character through study, reflection, ritual practice and careful attention to relationships
example: Keeping a gratitude journal and apologising faster during family arguments were part of Mei's project of self-cultivation.

hindi: आत्मप्रवंचना — स्वयं को ही किसी असत्य पर विश्वास दिला लेना
definition: the puzzling state of believing something while having evidence against it, usually because the truth is unwelcome, which seems to require fooling yourself
example: Calling his fourth coffee purely medicinal, Nikhil showed a talent for self-deception that his cardiologist would dispute.

hindi: आत्म-विलोपी सिद्धांत — ऐसा नैतिक सिद्धांत जो स्वयं कहे कि लोग उस पर सीधे विश्वास न करें
definition: Derek Parfit's term for a moral theory which recommends that people believe and follow some different theory, because believing the original would produce worse results
example: When Shreya said her study method worked best if she forgot about it entirely, her tutor called it a self-effacing theory of revision.

hindi: स्वतःसिद्धता — किसी सत्य का बिना प्रमाण, केवल समझ लेने से स्पष्ट हो जाना
definition: the property some truths have of being clearly true to anyone who fully understands them, without needing proof or further evidence
example: Rahul pleaded self-evidence for his claim that the last samosa was his, but the table demanded proof.

hindi: स्वतःसिद्ध — जिसे समझते ही सत्य दिख जाए
definition: describing a truth that anyone who properly understands it can recognise as true directly, without needing further argument or evidence
example: To Mehul it seemed self-evident that whoever finishes the milk should buy more, yet his flatmates demanded a formal debate.

hindi: आत्म-निर्माणकारी कर्म — कठिन दुविधा में लिया गया चरित्र गढ़ने वाला निर्णय
definition: a hard choice made under inner conflict, not fixed in advance, through which a person shapes their character and becomes responsible for it
example: Choosing to return the extra change at the grocery store felt to Mira like a self-forming action, not just arithmetic.

hindi: आत्म-प्रतिरूप सिद्धांत — 'मैं' का अनुभव मस्तिष्क द्वारा बनाए गए भीतरी प्रतिरूप से उपजता है, यह मत
definition: the view that a lasting inner self is merely an illusion: the brain builds a model of itself as a person and then mistakes that model for a real owner of experience
example: Frustrated by his own procrastination, Dev blamed the self-model theory and argued that his brain's model of him was the lazy one.

hindi: आत्म-विजय — अपनी पुरानी सीमाओं और आदतों को लगातार पार करते जाना
definition: Nietzsche's idea that life and character grow by constantly surpassing their own earlier forms, limits and habits, rather than settling into comfort
example: Giving up his snooze button for a whole week was, Arjun insisted, a genuine act of self-overcoming.

hindi: स्व-संबंधी कर्म — ऐसा कार्य जो मुख्यतः करने वाले को ही प्रभावित करे, मिल के अनुसार
definition: Mill's term for conduct that mainly affects only the person doing it, which he held society should leave free from interference
example: Dyeing his hair green was, Sameer insisted, a purely self-regarding action and none of the aunties' business.

hindi: अर्थगत बाह्यवाद — शब्दों का अर्थ बोलने वाले के बाहर के तथ्यों से तय होने का मत
definition: the view that the meaning of words, and what they refer to, depends partly on facts outside the speaker's head, such as the environment and expert usage
example: When Tanvi used the word elm without knowing a single thing about trees, her botanist aunt cited semantic externalism to prove she still meant elm.

hindi: अर्थगत विरोधाभास — सत्य, अर्थ या नामकरण जैसी धारणाओं से उपजा विरोधाभास
definition: any paradox arising from ideas about truth, meaning or naming, such as the liar paradox, rather than from mathematics itself
example: Noticing the classroom poster about a sentence that denies its own truth, Rhea filed it under semantic paradox.

hindi: अर्थ-मूल्य — किसी भाषिक अंश को अर्थ-सिद्धांत में सौंपा गया योगदान
definition: whatever a theory of meaning assigns to a word or phrase as its contribution to the truth or falsity of the sentences containing it, such as an object for a name
example: Arguing over whether 'soon' has any semantic value at all, the project team agreed the deadline certainly did not.

hindi: सिद्धांतों का अर्थगत दृष्टिकोण — सिद्धांतों को वाक्यों के बजाय प्रतिरूपों का परिवार मानना
definition: the view that a scientific theory is best understood as a family of models representing parts of the world, rather than a list of sentences
example: Tanya favoured the semantic view of theories when explaining traffic: the model mattered more than any sentence describing it.

hindi: अर्ध-संगतिवाद — नियतिवाद के साथ नैतिक उत्तरदायित्व को संभव मानने का मत
definition: the view that moral responsibility fits with determinism even if the freedom to choose otherwise does not, so people deserve praise or blame regardless
example: Kabir used semicompatibilism to argue he deserved credit for the dinner, even if the universe had always planned the paneer.

hindi: संकेतविज्ञान — संकेतों द्वारा अर्थ-निर्माण का अध्ययन
definition: the study of signs and how they create meaning in language, fashion, advertising and everyday life; another name for semiotics
example: Her semiology essay argued that a café's handwritten menu board signals 'authentic' far more than it signals 'lunch'.

hindi: संकेतविज्ञान — चिह्नों और प्रतीकों से अर्थ बनने का अध्ययन
definition: the study of signs and symbols, such as words, gestures, images and emojis, and how they come to carry meaning; also called semiology
example: A lecture on semiotics finally explained why a single thumbs-up emoji from her boss felt quietly terrifying.

hindi: संवेदनवाद — यह मत कि सारा ज्ञान और सारे विचार केवल संवेदनाओं से बनते हैं
definition: the view that all knowledge and every idea are built entirely from sensations, the raw feelings delivered by the senses
example: Yash's sensationalism met its limits when he tried to explain the square root of minus one through smell.

hindi: अर्थ और निर्देश — शब्द के प्रस्तुति-भाव और उसके वास्तविक निर्दिष्ट विषय का भेद
definition: Frege's distinction between the sense of an expression, the particular manner in which it presents something to the mind, and its reference, the actual object the expression picks out in the world
example: When Tara realised that 'the office printer' and 'the machine that eats paper' were the same device, her colleague explained sense and reference with a sigh.

hindi: इंद्रिय-प्रदत्त — इंद्रियों को सीधे मिलने वाले रंग, ध्वनि और आकार के अनुभव
definition: the colours, sounds, shapes and textures that are directly present in your sensory experience, which some philosophers say are what you really perceive rather than physical objects themselves
example: Staring at the blurry office projector, Nikhil insisted he could vouch only for his sense data: a grey smudge that might once have been a spreadsheet.

hindi: संवेद्य — वे इंद्रिय-गुण जो अनुभव न किए जाने पर भी रह सकते हैं
definition: items of the same kind as sense data, such as colours and sounds, which some philosophers claim could exist even when nobody is actually perceiving them
example: When the flatmates argued whether the fridge light stays shining after the door shuts, Tara said it was really a question about unsensed sensibilia.

hindi: संवेदनशीलता सिद्धांत — नैतिक गुणों को उपयुक्त संवेदनशीलता वाले व्यक्ति द्वारा पहचाने जाने योग्य मानने का मत
definition: the view that moral qualities are real but depend on human sensibility, being features that merit the responses a well-trained moral sensibility would have
example: Defending sensibility theory, Leo said cruelty in the playground video was real, but only someone with a caring outlook would fully notice it.

hindi: संवेद्य रूप — वस्तु से इंद्रियों तक पहुँचने वाले रूप या प्रतिबिंब का मध्ययुगीन सिद्धांत
definition: in medieval Christian and Islamic philosophy, likenesses or forms that travel from an object through the surrounding medium to the sense organs, carrying the object's qualities into perception
example: Waiting for his phone to connect to the smart speaker, Imran compared the loading bar to sensible species slowly drifting through the living room.

hindi: संवेदनशीलता शर्त — तथ्य असत्य होने पर विश्वास भी न रहने की शर्त
definition: the requirement that a belief counts as knowledge only if you would not hold that belief were it false
example: Because Jaya's phone showed 'delivered' even when messages failed, her belief that Mum got the text flunked the sensitivity condition.

hindi: संवेदी-गतिक सिद्धांत — देखना यह जानना है कि हमारी गतिविधि के साथ संवेदनाएँ कैसे बदलेंगी
definition: the view that perceiving is knowing how sensations would change as the body moves, such as turning the head or reaching toward something
example: Tilting his phone to check whether the table was really round, Arjun gave a live demonstration of the sensorimotor theory.

hindi: संवेदित — अनुभव में सीधे उपस्थित एक इकाई संवेदना
definition: a single item of sense data, such as one patch of colour or one sound, directly present in sensory experience and treated as the basic object of perception
example: Pointing at the orange blur on his screen, Arjun announced that one sensum, at least, proved the pizza tracker was real.

hindi: सामान्य बोध — सब मनुष्यों में साझा वह भावना जिस पर सौंदर्य-निर्णय सबकी सहमति माँगता है
definition: Kant's name for a shared human sense of feeling that allows judgments of beauty to claim agreement from everyone, even though they rest on personal pleasure
example: Appealing to sensus communis, Tara argued that anyone who dislikes monsoon rain on a tin roof simply has not listened properly.

hindi: दिव्य बोध — मनुष्य में ईश्वर को पहचानने की जन्मजात क्षमता
definition: a Latin phrase meaning 'sense of the divine', naming an inborn human capacity, proposed by some theologians, to become aware of a deity directly
example: Watching the sunrise from the train, Neha felt her sensus divinitatis stir, until the announcement about delays drowned it out.

hindi: वाक्य-अर्थ — शब्दों और व्याकरण से निर्धारित वाक्य का शाब्दिक अर्थ
definition: the literal meaning a sentence carries because of its words and grammar alone, independent of what any particular speaker intends to communicate with it
example: The sentence meaning of 'nice haircut' is a compliment, but Rehan's tone suggested something else entirely.

hindi: संवेदनवाद — सुख-दुःख अनुभव करने की क्षमता वाले हर प्राणी को नैतिक महत्त्व देने का मत
definition: the view that every being capable of feeling pleasure and pain, whatever its species, deserves moral concern because its experiences matter to it
example: Priya's sentientism reached its limit at the mosquito buzzing around her bedroom at two in the morning.

hindi: कोरियाई ध्यान सम्प्रदाय — एक निर्णायक प्रश्न पर एकाग्र होकर बोध खोजने वाली बौद्ध परंपरा
definition: the Korean school of meditation Buddhism, sharing roots with Chinese Chan, known for its practice of focusing intensely on a single critical phrase
example: During the exchange trip to Seoul, the class visited a Seon temple where monks had meditated through the winter retreat without once checking their phones.

hindi: पृथक्करण सिद्धांत — क़ानून और नैतिकता के बीच कोई अनिवार्य संबंध नहीं
definition: the central claim of legal positivism that there is no necessary connection between legal validity and morality, so even an unjust rule can still be a valid legal rule
example: In civics class Meera defended the separability thesis, arguing that the old curfew rule was genuinely valid even though everyone agreed it was morally rotten.

hindi: व्यक्तियों की पृथकता — यह विचार कि हर व्यक्ति का जीवन अलग है और उनके सुख-दुःख को एक में नहीं जोड़ा जा सकता
definition: the objection, stated by John Rawls, that utilitarianism wrongly treats many separate lives like one single person, letting one individual's loss be cancelled by others' gains
example: Told his lost weekend was fine because the team gained overall, Imran appealed to the separateness of persons: the team did not have his hangover.

hindi: शक्ति पृथक्करण — विधायी, कार्यकारी और न्यायिक शक्तियों को अलग अंगों में बाँटने का सिद्धांत
definition: the principle that the powers to make laws, carry them out and judge disputes should belong to separate bodies, so no single group holds them all
example: The flat introduced separation of powers: Anu writes the chore rules, Dev enforces them, and the landlord settles appeals.

hindi: समुच्चय-सैद्धांतिक बहुविश्व — अनेक समान रूप से वैध समुच्चय-जगतों को मानने का मत
definition: the view that many different universes of sets exist equally, so questions like the continuum hypothesis receive different answers in different universes rather than a single correct answer
example: Tired of the argument about the best biryani, Farah proposed a set-theoretic multiverse where every family's recipe was equally correct.

hindi: सेवा — निःस्वार्थ भाव से दूसरों की सहायता
definition: selfless service to others, offered freely as a spiritual and ethical practice rather than for payment or praise
example: Every Sunday Harpreet did seva at the community kitchen, rolling rotis faster than anyone could count.

hindi: कठोर परीक्षण — ऐसा परीक्षण जो परिकल्पना गलत होने पर उसे लगभग निश्चित रूप से पकड़ ले
definition: the idea, developed by Deborah Mayo, that evidence supports a hypothesis only if the test would very probably have exposed the hypothesis were it false
example: Before trusting the cheap charger, Tara subjected it to severe testing by leaving her phone plugged in overnight on a metal tray.

hindi: जैविक लिंग और सामाजिक लिंग का भेद — शरीर की बनावट और समाज-प्रदत्त लैंगिक भूमिका का अंतर
definition: the distinction between biological features of bodies and gender, understood as the social roles, norms and identities that cultures attach to those features
example: In biology class, Ishaan used the sex-gender distinction to argue that chromosomes decide nothing about who should wash the dishes.

hindi: लिंगभेद — लिंग के आधार पर पूर्वाग्रह और भेदभाव
definition: prejudice or discrimination against people because of their gender, together with the beliefs and practices that treat one gender as superior
example: When the robotics coach handed every girl the decoration tasks, Simran called out the sexism before the glue guns came out.

hindi: शब्द प्रमाण — विश्वसनीय व्यक्ति या शास्त्र के वचन से प्राप्त ज्ञान
definition: in Indian philosophy, verbal testimony, the source of valid knowledge gained from the words of a reliable speaker or trusted scripture
example: Tanya had never visited the new café herself, but her best friend's review counted as shabda enough to book a table.

hindi: सतही पारिस्थितिकी — प्रदूषण और संसाधन-क्षय से केवल मानव हित के लिए लड़ने वाला पर्यावरणवाद
definition: a critical label for environmental concern that fights pollution and resource loss mainly to protect human health and wealth, without questioning human-centred values
example: Swapping plastic straws for paper ones while ordering three delivery meals a day struck Mira as shallow ecology at its finest.

hindi: ऊर्ध्व अनुरूपता — ऊपर वाले के मानदंड से सहमत होने का मोही सिद्धांत
definition: the Mohist doctrine of identifying upward: people should adopt the moral standards of their superiors, so that the whole state shares a single notion of right
example: When every department copied the chief executive's slogan, Varun said the company had achieved shangtong.

hindi: साझा निर्णय — चिकित्सक और रोगी द्वारा मिलकर उपचार चुनने की पद्धति
definition: the medical practice in which doctor and patient decide on treatment together, combining clinical evidence with the patient's own values and preferences
example: Their family doctor practised shared decision-making so thoroughly that choosing an antibiotic felt like planning a group holiday.

hindi: शेफ़र संयोजक — 'दोनों नहीं' अर्थ वाला संयोजक, जिससे अकेले ही बाकी सभी संयोजक बनाए जा सकते हैं
definition: the connective (joining symbol) meaning 'not both', which is true unless both joined statements are true, and from which every other connective can be built
example: Rudra's rule for his twin sisters, 'not both of you on my laptop', was a Sheffer stroke they tested every single evening.

hindi: प्रभुता — पद और स्थिति से मिलने वाली शक्ति
definition: the Legalist concept of positional power: the authority that comes from holding a high office, rather than from the ruler's personal talent or virtue
example: The intern's ideas were better, but the director had shi, so the director's slide stayed in the deck.

hindi: केवल-आसन — बिना किसी विषय के केवल बैठे रहने का ध्यान
definition: the meditation practice of simply sitting, with no object, counting or question to hold, letting awareness remain open and alert
example: Maya tried shikantaza on the metro, just sitting with no podcast and no goal, and felt oddly rested by the time she reached work.

hindi: शिन बौद्ध मत — केवल अमिदा बुद्ध की कृपा पर पूर्ण भरोसे का मार्ग
definition: the Japanese school of Pure Land Buddhism founded by Shinran, teaching that liberation comes entirely through Amida Buddha's compassion, received through faith
example: Rahul admired Shin Buddhism for admitting what every student knows: some problems are solved only by grace from somewhere else.

hindi: मंत्रयान — मंत्र, मुद्रा और मंडल वाली जापानी गूढ़ बौद्ध परंपरा
definition: the Japanese school of esoteric Buddhism, meaning teachings passed secretly from teacher to student, which uses sacred chants, hand gestures and mandalas, circular sacred diagrams, to realize awakening in this very body
example: Studying Shingon for her project, Isha was surprised to find hand gestures more meaningful than anything in the class group chat.

hindi: श्रद्धा-चित्त — अमिदा बुद्ध की करुणा पर अटल, प्रदत्त आस्था
definition: the settled, trusting heart in Shin Buddhism, understood as faith given by Amida Buddha rather than produced through personal striving
example: Dhruv's shinjin in the canteen cook was absolute: he ordered without looking at the menu and was never disappointed.

hindi: देह-चित्त मोचन — शरीर और मन के छूट जाने का बोध
definition: Dogen's phrase for the dropping away of body and mind, the release from clinging to a separate self that marks genuine awakening
example: Twenty minutes into the silent retreat, Mira felt something like shinjin datsuraku, then her stomach growled and the self came rushing back.

hindi: थीसियस का जहाज़ — धीरे-धीरे हर हिस्सा बदल जाने पर भी वस्तु के वही बने रहने की पहेली
definition: the ancient puzzle about a wooden ship whose planks are replaced one by one, asking whether the rebuilt ship is still the same ship and which vessel keeps its identity
example: After replacing the screen, battery and keyboard, Anya asked whether her laptop was now a ship of Theseus and whether the warranty still counted.

hindi: नवशिष्य-चित्त — हर विषय को नए विद्यार्थी की खुली जिज्ञासा से देखने का भाव
definition: beginner's mind, the attitude of approaching any subject with openness, eagerness and freedom from assumptions, even when already skilled
example: The senior engineer brought shoshin to the code review, asking basic questions that exposed a bug everyone else had stopped seeing.

hindi: श्रवण — गुरु से वेदान्त के उपदेश को सुनना
definition: the first stage of Vedantic study, listening carefully to the teaching of the Upanishads from a qualified teacher
example: Nandini called the first lecture of term shravana, since all she could do was listen and take notes.

hindi: संकुचित खंड सिद्धांत — भविष्य और वर्तमान को वास्तविक, पर भूत को मिटता हुआ मानने का मत
definition: the view that present and future moments exist but past moments drop out of reality, so the block of existing time keeps shrinking
example: Karan liked the shrinking block theory because it meant last week's awkward presentation had literally ceased to exist.

hindi: परस्परता — जो अपने लिए न चाहो, वह दूसरों के साथ न करो
definition: the Confucian principle of reciprocity: treating others as you would wish to be treated, and never doing to them what you would dislike yourself
example: Before posting the embarrassing photo, Riya remembered shu and imagined her own school picture going viral.

hindi: शुद्धाद्वैत — वल्लभ का मत कि जगत ब्रह्म का ही वास्तविक रूप है, माया नहीं
definition: Vallabha's school of Vedanta holding that Brahman is pure and single, and that the world is its real expression rather than an illusion created by ignorance
example: Against his roommate's gloomy talk of illusion, Rahul cited shuddhadvaita and declared the pizza on the table perfectly real.

hindi: मृत्युपर्यंत रोग — कीर्केगार्द के अनुसार निराशा, यानी सच्चा स्वयं न बन पाने की पीड़ा
definition: Kierkegaard's name for despair, understood as the spiritual condition of failing or refusing to become your true self before the divine
example: Stuck in a job he hated, Vivek joked that his sickness unto death came with a monthly salary slip.

hindi: सिद्ध — सभी कर्मों से मुक्त होकर लोक के शिखर पर स्थित आत्मा
definition: in Jainism, a fully liberated soul, free from all karma and all bodies, dwelling forever in perfect knowledge and bliss at the summit of the universe
example: Finishing the last of the wedding paperwork, Shruti said she finally understood how a siddha must feel.

hindi: पार्श्व मर्यादा — वे नैतिक सीमाएँ जिन्हें किसी भी लक्ष्य के लिए नहीं लांघा जा सकता
definition: Nozick's term for moral limits on action that may never be crossed, even to achieve a good outcome or prevent a greater number of violations
example: Rahul treated honesty as a side constraint on his sales pitch, which is why his quarterly numbers were modest but his reviews were glowing.

hindi: सार्थक रूप — रेखाओं और रंगों का वह विन्यास जो विशिष्ट सौंदर्य-भाव जगाता है
definition: the view that what all genuine artworks share is a particular arrangement of lines, colours and shapes that stirs a special aesthetic emotion
example: Admiring the tiled kitchen floor, Lavanya swore it had significant form, while her mother insisted it simply needed mopping.

hindi: संकेतित — चिह्न द्वारा व्यक्त मानसिक अवधारणा
definition: in Saussure's theory of signs, the mental concept that a word or image evokes, as opposed to the sound or written form that carries it
example: The word 'deadline' reached the whole team, but the signified clearly differed between the manager and the interns.

hindi: संकेतक — चिह्न का ध्वनि या लिखित रूप वाला पक्ष
definition: in Saussure's theory of signs, the physical form of a sign, such as a spoken sound or written word, as opposed to the concept it stands for
example: Kabir pointed out that the signifier 'chai' did nothing for him until somebody actually boiled the water.

hindi: व्यावहारिक विद्या — जनहित और यथार्थ समस्याओं पर केंद्रित कोरियाई चिंतन-धारा
definition: the Korean practical learning movement that turned Confucian scholarship toward farming, economics, technology and the real needs of ordinary people
example: The student council leaned toward Silhak, spending its budget on fixing the water coolers rather than debating the school motto.

hindi: सरल प्रत्यय — लॉक के अनुसार अविभाज्य मूल विचार, जैसे किसी रंग या स्वाद का
definition: in Locke's theory, the basic building blocks of thought, such as single colours or tastes, which cannot be broken into smaller ideas
example: Explaining mango to a friend abroad, Anika gave up, since the taste was among the simple ideas that only experience could supply.

hindi: सरल व्यक्तिनिष्ठावाद — नैतिक कथनों को वक्ता की अपनी स्वीकृति या अस्वीकृति का वर्णन मानने का मत
definition: the view that a moral statement simply reports the speaker's own approval or disapproval, so 'lying is wrong' just means the speaker personally dislikes lying
example: Under simple subjectivism, when Mira and Sam argued about tipping, they were both right: each was just reporting their own feelings.

hindi: सरल मत — व्यक्ति की पहचान को स्मृति या शरीर के संबंधों में न घटाकर एक मूल, अविभाज्य तथ्य मानने का मत
definition: the view that personal identity is a basic, indivisible fact that cannot be analysed into bodily or psychological relations, so a person either survives entirely or not at all
example: Ananya took the simple view during the argument, insisting she was entirely herself no matter how many embarrassing phases she had lived through.

hindi: सिम्पसन विरोधाभास — समूहों में दिखी प्रवृत्ति का मिलाने पर उलट जाना
definition: the statistical puzzle where a trend appearing within every separate group reverses or disappears when the groups are combined
example: The marketing team celebrated each region's growth until the analyst showed Simpson's paradox wrecking the combined total.

hindi: छद्म-प्रतिरूप — ऐसी नकल जिसका कोई मूल ही न हो
definition: Baudrillard's term for a copy or image that no longer imitates any original reality, standing instead as a copy of other copies
example: The mall's 'authentic Italian village' food court, built from photos of other theme parks, was a perfect simulacrum with free refills.

hindi: अनुकरण तर्क — हमारा संसार किसी कंप्यूटर-अनुकरण का भाग होने की संभावना पर तर्क
definition: Nick Bostrom's argument that, if advanced civilisations create many detailed computer simulations of minds, most beings with experiences like ours might be living inside such a simulation
example: When the lift stopped at every floor in the same order twice, Dhruv muttered that the simulation argument was looking stronger by the minute.

hindi: अनुकरण परिकल्पना — जगत के कंप्यूटर-निर्मित होने की संभावना
definition: the proposal that our entire experienced reality might be a computer simulation running on some advanced civilisation's machines
example: When the same stranger appeared at three different cafés, Tara joked that the simulation hypothesis was running out of background characters.

hindi: अनुकरण सिद्धांत — स्वयं को दूसरे की स्थिति में रखकर उसके मन को समझने का मत
definition: the view that people understand other minds mainly by imagining themselves in the other person's situation and running their own mental processes as a model
example: Before replying to her boss's terse email, Shreya used simulation theory, pictured herself buried under forty unread messages, and decided the tone was not personal.

hindi: निष्कपटता शर्त — वक्ता के मन में कथन के अनुरूप भाव या इच्छा होने की शर्त
definition: the requirement that a speaker genuinely holds the belief, feeling or intention their utterance expresses, so a promise needs a real intention to keep it
example: His "I'll definitely come to your recital" broke the sincerity condition the moment he checked the cricket schedule.

hindi: एकलवाद — यह मत कि एक विशेष घटना दूसरी का कारण हो सकती है, चाहे कोई सामान्य नियमितता न हो
definition: the view that a single event can cause another without any general regularity or pattern backing it, so causation belongs first to particular cases
example: Her singularism settled it for Ananya: this particular sneeze woke the baby, regardless of what sneezes usually do.

hindi: नैतिक जीवन — परिवार, समाज और राज्य की साझा रीतियों में बसी नैतिकता
definition: Hegel's term for ethical life, the morality lived through shared customs and institutions such as family, civil society and state, rather than private conscience alone
example: Rhea argued that the neighbourhood's habit of checking on elderly residents was Sittlichkeit in action, a morality nobody needed to write down.

hindi: परिस्थितिजन्य स्वतंत्रता — सदा किसी ठोस परिस्थिति के भीतर ही संभव स्वतंत्रता
definition: the view, found in Beauvoir and Merleau-Ponty, that human freedom always operates within a concrete situation of body, history and society rather than in a vacuum
example: Stuck in traffic but choosing a podcast over road rage, Anjali called it situated freedom in its purest form.

hindi: परिस्थितिवाद — यह मत कि व्यवहार चरित्र से अधिक परिस्थितियों पर निर्भर करता है
definition: the view, drawn from psychology experiments, that people's behaviour depends far more on their immediate situation than on stable, lasting character traits
example: Noting that everyone got kinder after the free doughnuts arrived, the office psychologist declared situationism vindicated.

hindi: स्कन्ध — व्यक्ति को बनाने वाले पाँच बदलते समूह
definition: in Buddhist thought, the five changing groups of processes (bodily form, feeling, perception, mental habits and consciousness) that together compose a person, without any separate self standing behind them
example: Asked in the group chat who he really was, Vikram listed his five skandhas, which mostly turned out to be hunger and sleepiness.

hindi: संशयवादी ईश्वरवाद — ईश्वर के कारणों को मनुष्य की समझ से परे मानने वाला उत्तर
definition: the view that humans should not expect to understand a deity's reasons for permitting suffering, so apparently pointless evil is not strong evidence against that deity
example: The intern took a skeptical theism approach to the manager's decisions: surely there were reasons, just far above her pay grade.

hindi: स्कोलेम का विरोधाभास — गिने न जा सकने वाले समुच्चयों को सिद्ध करने वाले सिद्धांत के गणनीय प्रतिरूप की विचित्रता
definition: the puzzling result that the theory of sets, which proves some sets are too large to list even in an endless sequence, can itself be interpreted within a domain whose members could all be listed
example: Ravi felt Skolem's paradox at the airport, where a lounge advertising unlimited seating turned out, when someone counted, to have exactly forty chairs.

hindi: दास-नैतिकता — दुर्बलों की वह नैतिकता जो शक्तिशालियों को बुरा और विनम्रता को अच्छा कहती है
definition: Nietzsche's name for a morality born among the powerless, which labels strength and pride evil and praises meekness, humility and pity as good
example: Kunal accused his teammates of slave morality when they voted to ban the office's best player from the carrom league.

hindi: सुप्त सुंदरी समस्या — स्मृति-लोप के बाद संभावना-अनुमान पर पहेली
definition: a probability puzzle about a person woken once or twice depending on a coin toss, with memories erased between wakings, asking how confident she should be that the coin landed heads
example: After three alarms and three snoozes, Mira woke with no idea which alarm this was, a very personal Sleeping Beauty problem.

hindi: क्रमिक पतन दोष — एक छोटे कदम से अनिवार्य विनाश-श्रृंखला मान लेने की भूल
definition: the fallacy of claiming that one small first step will inevitably trigger a long chain of worse events, without showing why each link must follow
example: Dad's slippery slope ran from one late-night snack to Arjun dropping out of college and living on biscuits in a garage.

hindi: सामाजिक निर्मिति — किसी श्रेणी का प्रकृति के बजाय समाज द्वारा गढ़ा जाना
definition: the view that certain categories, such as gender, race or money, exist because of shared human practices and agreements rather than natural facts alone
example: Arguing over whether 'breakfast foods' exist, Karan insisted cereal at dinner proved breakfast was a social construction.

hindi: सामाजिक अनुबंध — लोगों के आपसी समझौते से राज्य और उसकी सत्ता के बनने का सिद्धांत
definition: the theory that political authority and the state arise from an agreement among people, who give up some freedoms in exchange for protection and order
example: When the flatmates finally agreed that whoever cooks never washes up, Arjun called it the social contract of flat 4B.

hindi: सामाजिक लोकतंत्र — बाज़ार अर्थव्यवस्था के साथ व्यापक कल्याणकारी राज्य की विचारधारा
definition: the political outlook that keeps a market economy but adds strong welfare services, public healthcare, education and worker protections funded through taxation
example: Returning from Denmark, Shreya praised social democracy mainly because the trains were on time and the healthcare was free.

hindi: सामाजिक पारिस्थितिकी — पर्यावरण-संकट को सामाजिक पदानुक्रम और प्रभुत्व से उपजा मानने का मत
definition: the view that ecological problems grow out of social hierarchies and domination among humans, so healing nature requires more equal, local communities
example: Sana traced the neighbourhood's missing trees back to the landlord, which her friends agreed was social ecology in miniature.

hindi: सामाजिक अंतर्बोधवाद — नैतिक निर्णय को तत्काल भावानुभूति से उपजा मानने का मत
definition: the psychological theory that moral judgements come from quick instinctive intuitions, with reasoning usually arriving afterwards to justify them to others
example: Watching his friends condemn the new rule first and search for arguments later, Omar saw social intuitionism unfold in the group chat.

hindi: सामाजिक न्याय — समाज में अधिकारों, अवसरों और संसाधनों की न्यायसंगत व्यवस्था
definition: the ideal of a society whose institutions share rights, opportunities, wealth and respect fairly among all groups, especially those historically excluded
example: The debate club spent the entire session on social justice and still ran over time arguing about who got the microphone.

hindi: सामाजिक उदारवाद — स्वतंत्रता के लिए कल्याणकारी राज्य को आवश्यक मानने वाला उदारवाद
definition: the form of liberalism that holds individual liberty needs public support such as schooling, healthcare and welfare, so government should actively help people
example: Priya defended social liberalism in the group chat, arguing that freedom means little if you cannot afford the bus fare to college.

hindi: सामाजिक सत्तामीमांसा — धन, विवाह, सरकार जैसी सामाजिक वस्तुओं के अस्तित्व का अध्ययन
definition: the study of what social things, such as money, marriages, companies and governments, really are and how they exist through shared human agreement
example: Arguing over whether their friendship streak on the messaging app truly existed, Tanvi and Jai stumbled into social ontology.

hindi: समाजवाद — उत्पादन के साधनों पर सामूहिक स्वामित्व और समान वितरण की विचारधारा
definition: the political outlook that factories, land and other means of producing wealth should be owned collectively and managed for the whole community
example: The hostel floor ran on socialism: whoever's mother sent snacks, the snacks belonged to everyone.

hindi: समाजवादी नारीवाद — स्त्री उत्पीड़न को पूँजीवाद और पितृसत्ता से जोड़ने वाला मत
definition: the form of feminism holding that women's oppression arises from both capitalism and patriarchy, especially through unpaid household labour and poorly paid work
example: Tallying hours of unpaid cooking and cleaning on a spreadsheet, Ritu made a very practical case for socialist feminism.

hindi: सुकराती बुद्धिवाद — यह मत कि ग़लत कर्म केवल अज्ञान से ही होता है
definition: the view attributed to Socrates that virtue is entirely a matter of knowledge, so wrongdoing always comes from ignorance and nobody does wrong knowingly
example: Defending Socratic intellectualism, Tara argued that her brother only ate her yoghurt because he truly did not understand ownership.

hindi: सुकराती व्यंग्य — जानबूझकर अज्ञान का दिखावा कर दूसरे की धारणा परखना
definition: the strategy of pretending ignorance and asking innocent questions so that a confident speaker exposes the weaknesses of their confident claims
example: With perfect Socratic irony, Grandma asked the salesman to explain how a free phone could cost so much each month.

hindi: सुकराती पद्धति — प्रश्नोत्तर द्वारा विचारों की परख करने की विधि
definition: a method of teaching and inquiry through repeated questioning, which exposes hidden assumptions and contradictions and pushes people to think more clearly
example: Using the Socratic method, the tutor kept asking why until Rohan admitted he had no idea what photosynthesis really meant.

hindi: सुकराती विरोधाभास — यह मत कि कोई भी जानबूझकर गलत नहीं करता
definition: the claim, associated with Socrates, that nobody does wrong willingly, because anyone who truly knew what was good would choose it
example: Caught eating the last samosa, Vivek pleaded the Socratic paradox: he had simply not known it was reserved.

hindi: मृदु नियतिवाद — नियतिवाद को मानते हुए भी स्वतंत्र इच्छा को स्वीकारने का मत
definition: an older name for the view that every event is fixed by earlier causes yet people still choose freely when nothing outside them forces their actions
example: Dev's soft determinism meant he admitted his coffee habit was caused by genetics but still took full credit for choosing oat milk.

hindi: मृदु पितृवाद — केवल अधूरी समझ या अनैच्छिक निर्णय में ही हस्तक्षेप का मत
definition: the view that interfering with someone's choice for their own good is justified only when that choice is uninformed, pressured or otherwise not truly voluntary
example: Stopping Kabir mid-stride because he hadn't noticed the wet floor sign was, Tanya insisted, soft paternalism and not bossiness.

hindi: मृदु प्रौद्योगिकीय नियतिवाद — तकनीक समाज को गढ़ती है, पर मनुष्य के चुनाव भी उसकी दिशा मोड़ते हैं
definition: a milder form of technological determinism holding that technology strongly shapes society while human choices, markets and politics still steer which technology develops
example: Meera argued for soft technological determinism in the staff meeting: the new scheduling software would change the office, but the team could still decide how.

hindi: अहंमात्रवाद — केवल अपने मन को ही निश्चित रूप से वास्तविक मानने का मत
definition: the view that only your own mind is certainly real, and that everything else might exist only inside your experience
example: After three hours of gaming alone, Rohan joked that his solipsism was confirmed: nobody had texted, so maybe nobody else existed.

hindi: परिष्कृत परिणामवाद — सदा गणना न करके ऐसा जीवन जीने का मत जो वास्तव में सर्वोत्तम परिणाम दे
definition: Peter Railton's view that a consequentialist should not constantly calculate outcomes, but should develop loyal relationships and habits that actually produce the best consequences
example: Mohit's sophisticated consequentialism meant he visited his grandmother because he loved her, not because a spreadsheet said so.

hindi: परिष्कृत मिथ्याकरणवाद — सिद्धांत को तभी त्यागना जब बेहतर प्रतिद्वंद्वी उपलब्ध हो
definition: Lakatos's refined version of Popper's testing approach, which abandons a theory only when a rival explains everything it explained and also predicts novel, confirmed facts
example: Tanya practised sophisticated falsificationism with laptops: she kept the creaky one until a rival did everything it did and more.

hindi: संयम — इच्छाओं और सुखों के प्रति संतुलित, शांत और आत्म-ज्ञानी वृत्ति
definition: the Greek virtue of temperance or moderation, meaning a calm, balanced relationship with pleasures and desires, together with sound self-knowledge
example: Taking a single slice of cake at the office party and actually enjoying it, Anjali displayed effortless sophrosyne.

hindi: राशि विरोधाभास — एक-एक दाना हटाते जाने पर ढेर कब ढेर नहीं रहता, यह पहेली
definition: the ancient paradox that removing a single grain never turns a heap into a non-heap, yet removing grains repeatedly eventually leaves nothing, exposing vague words
example: Eating crisps one at a time from the shared packet, Neha invoked the sorites paradox: no single crisp ever made it 'most of the packet'.

hindi: वर्गवाचक पद — वस्तुओं को गिनने और पहचानने योग्य श्रेणी बताने वाला शब्द
definition: a general term, such as 'horse' or 'chair', that supplies a principle for counting things and for telling when something remains the same thing
example: Asked how many things were in the fridge, Kiran demanded a sortal first, since the answer changed completely between 'items' and 'molecules'.

hindi: स्वरूप-सत् — किसी वस्तु का 'ऐसा होना', यानी उसके गुणों का समूह
definition: Meinong's term for the so-being of an object, its character or collection of properties, which he held it possesses whether or not it exists
example: The novel's villain has a vivid Sosein, Arjun said, cruel and clever, despite lacking existence entirely.

hindi: सोतो ध्यान शाखा — बिना लक्ष्य के शांत बैठने को ही बोध मानने वाली परंपरा
definition: the Japanese branch of meditation Buddhism, shaped by Dogen, which stresses quiet sitting without goals as itself the expression of awakening
example: Priya's yoga-loving aunt preferred Soto Zen, explaining that she liked a practice where just sitting still counted as doing everything right.

hindi: सुदृढ़ता — ऐसा वैध तर्क जिसके सभी आधार-वाक्य सचमुच सत्य हों
definition: the property of an argument that is valid and whose premises are also actually true, so its conclusion is guaranteed to be true as well
example: The debate coach circled the essay and wrote that its logic held but its soundness collapsed, since nobody in class believed the opening premise.

hindi: विलोपन-अधीन — शब्द को काटकर भी उसे बनाए रखने की युक्ति
definition: a device used by Heidegger and Derrida of writing a word and crossing it out, keeping both visible, because the word is inadequate yet still necessary
example: Aditya's essay put 'objective' sous rature, which his teacher found either brilliant or a problem with his eraser.

hindi: संप्रभुता — किसी राज्य या सत्ता की सर्वोच्च और स्वतंत्र शासन-शक्ति
definition: supreme and final authority to make and enforce laws within a territory, answerable to no higher power inside or outside it
example: Riya declared full sovereignty over the top bunk, backed by a hand-drawn flag taped to the ladder.

hindi: वक्ता-अर्थ — वक्ता किसी कथन से वास्तव में क्या कहना चाहता है
definition: what a particular person intends to communicate by an utterance on a given occasion, which can differ sharply from the literal meaning of the words used
example: The literal words were 'the bin is full', but the speaker meaning, as every flatmate knew, was 'it is your turn'.

hindi: विशिष्ट संघटन प्रश्न — कब अनेक वस्तुएँ मिलकर एक नई वस्तु बनाती हैं, यह प्रश्न
definition: van Inwagen's question of exactly when several things come together to compose a single further object, rather than remaining merely many things
example: Staring at the pile of laundry on the chair, Harsh posed the special composition question: was it a heap, a sculpture, or simply many socks?

hindi: विशेष छूट दोष — अपने पक्ष के लिए नियम से बिना कारण अपवाद माँगना
definition: the fallacy of applying a rule to others while exempting yourself or a favoured case, without giving a good reason for that exception
example: Everyone must wash their own mugs, except me because I am busy, announced the team lead, in shameless special pleading.

hindi: विशेष प्रकाशन — विशिष्ट लोगों या ग्रंथों द्वारा दिया गया ईश्वरीय ज्ञान
definition: knowledge about the divine given to particular people at particular times, such as through prophets, miracles or scripture
example: Dhruv joked that the leaked exam timetable was special revelation, granted only to students in the right group chat.

hindi: जाति सारवाद — हर प्रजाति का कोई स्थायी सार होने का मत
definition: the view that every biological species is defined by a fixed essence, some property all members share that makes them belong to that species
example: Species essentialism took a knock in Riya's biology class when the teacher showed wolves and chihuahuas sharing a species.

hindi: प्रजाति समस्या — यह प्रश्न कि जैविक प्रजाति को ठीक-ठीक कैसे परिभाषित करें
definition: the unresolved question in biology of how exactly to define a species, since different definitions based on breeding, ancestry or appearance give conflicting answers
example: Debating whether a mule counts as anything, the biology club hit the species problem and ordered snacks instead.

hindi: प्रजाति-सत्ता — मनुष्य का रचनात्मक, सामूहिक श्रम से परिभाषित स्वभाव
definition: the young Marx's term for human nature as creative, freely chosen labour shared with others, which alienation under capitalism cuts people away from
example: Painting the class mural together, the students seemed to rediscover their species-being, until the bell rang and they became exam-takers again.

hindi: प्रजातिवाद — केवल प्रजाति के आधार पर अन्य जीवों के हितों को कम आँकने का पक्षपात
definition: the practice of giving the interests of other animals less moral weight simply because they belong to another species, a label coined by critics who liken it to racism
example: When the family agreed the dog deserved a birthday cake but the chickens deserved nothing, Tara accused the whole dinner table of casual speciesism.

hindi: आभासी वर्तमान — वह छोटी अवधि जिसे मन एक साथ वर्तमान के रूप में अनुभव करता है
definition: the short stretch of time, lasting several seconds, that the mind experiences as happening presently rather than as a single instant
example: Listening to a song, Maya realised the whole melody seemed present at once, which her teacher said was the specious present at work.

hindi: वाक्-क्रिया — बोलकर कोई कार्य संपन्न करना, जैसे वादा, आदेश या क्षमा
definition: an action performed by saying something, such as promising, warning, ordering, apologising or asking, where speaking itself does the deed
example: When Tanvi typed "I quit" into the office group chat, her manager realised it was a speech act, not a weather update.

hindi: वाक्-क्रिया सिद्धांत — बोलने को कार्य करने का एक रूप मानने वाला सिद्धांत
definition: the theory, developed by Austin and Searle, that speaking is a form of action, and that utterances should be studied by what they do as well as what they state
example: Speech act theory explains why "can you pass the salt?" is never answered with a simple "yes" at dinner.

hindi: स्पिनोज़ावाद — ईश्वर और प्रकृति को एक ही अनंत द्रव्य मानने वाला दर्शन
definition: the philosophy of Spinoza, holding that there is only one infinite substance, identical with deity and nature, of which minds and bodies are passing features
example: After a long hike, Leela said she was having a Spinozism moment: the river, the trees and her aching feet all seemed part of one thing.

hindi: गंभीरता का भाव — मूल्यों को मानव-चुनाव नहीं, जगत के अटल तथ्य मान लेना
definition: Sartre's term for treating values, rules and social roles as fixed facts of the world rather than as things people freely choose and could choose differently
example: The manager defended the dress code with such a spirit of seriousness that the interns assumed it had been carved into stone.

hindi: विभक्त-मस्तिष्क प्रसंग — मस्तिष्क के दो भागों के अलग किए जाने पर चेतना के बँटने का प्रसंग
definition: a real medical situation in which the link between the brain's hemispheres is surgically severed, which philosophers employ to question whether a single person can contain separate streams of consciousness
example: Watching her left hand reach for cake while she promised to diet, Pooja joked that she was a split-brain case.

hindi: सत्पुरुष — श्रेष्ठ चरित्र वाला गंभीर, सद्गुणी व्यक्ति जिसका निर्णय आदर्श माना जाए
definition: the Greek term for the excellent or serious person in Aristotle's ethics, whose well-formed character makes their judgements and pleasures the proper standard
example: Their coach, who never lost his temper even when the minibus broke down, was the team's resident spoudaios.

hindi: विरोध-चतुष्कोण — चार प्रकार के कथनों के तार्किक संबंध दिखाने वाला आरेख
definition: a diagram from Aristotelian logic showing how four kinds of statements, beginning all, none, some and some not, relate: which pairs can never both be true, and which pairs must always disagree
example: Mr Iyer drew the square of opposition on the whiteboard to show that 'some students did the homework' and 'no students did the homework' cannot both be true.

hindi: सेंट पीटर्सबर्ग विरोधाभास — अनंत अपेक्षित लाभ वाले खेल पर थोड़ा ही दाँव लगाने की उलझन
definition: a puzzle about a coin-tossing game whose average payout is endlessly large, though almost nobody would sensibly price entry above a modest amount
example: When the fairground game promised doubling prizes forever, Akash explained the St. Petersburg paradox and still paid only twenty rupees.

hindi: धावनपथ विरोधाभास — विपरीत दिशा में चलती पंक्तियों से गति को विरोधी बताने वाला तर्क
definition: Zeno's paradox about rows of bodies passing each other in opposite directions, meant to show that ideas of motion and time lead to contradiction
example: Watching two metro trains pass each other, Dev tried explaining the stadium paradox and lost his entire carriage's attention.

hindi: अवस्था सिद्धांत — प्रत्येक क्षण की वस्तु-अवस्था ही वस्तु है, जो पूर्व-पर अवस्थाओं से जुड़ी है, यह मत
definition: the view that ordinary objects are momentary stages, and that each stage persists only by being linked through similarity and causation to closely matching earlier and later stages
example: By stage theory, Kunal argued, the stage who agreed to help move house last week was merely a counterpart of the stage now switching off his phone.

hindi: रुचि का मानदंड — अनुभवी, निष्पक्ष पारखियों की सहमति से तय होने वाला सौंदर्य-मापदंड
definition: Hume's idea that although beauty rests on feeling, a reliable standard emerges from the shared verdicts of experienced, practised and unprejudiced critics
example: The office biryani contest turned into a debate about the standard of taste when the judges turned out to include the cook's cousin.

hindi: दृष्टिकोण सिद्धांत — यह मत कि समाज में स्थिति ज्ञान को आकार देती है
definition: the view that knowledge is shaped by social position, and that marginalized groups may notice features of power and oppression that privileged groups overlook
example: In the staff meeting, Anjali invoked standpoint theory: the interns who actually book the rooms clearly understood the booking system better than the directors.

hindi: प्राकृतिक अवस्था — राज्य और कानून के बनने से पहले मनुष्यों की कल्पित दशा
definition: the imagined condition of human life before any government, laws or state exist, used by contract theorists to show why people would agree to political authority
example: With the teacher out of the room for ten minutes, the classroom slid straight into a state of nature over the last working marker.

hindi: राज्यवाद — आर्थिक और सामाजिक जीवन में राज्य के व्यापक नियंत्रण का समर्थन
definition: the view that the state should hold wide control over economic and social life, and that many problems are best solved by central government action
example: Kavya's statism showed at the housing society meeting when she proposed a committee to regulate everyone's balcony plants.

hindi: सांख्यिक प्रासंगिकता प्रतिरूप — व्याख्या को उन कारकों से करना जो घटना की संभावना बदलते हैं
definition: Wesley Salmon's account of explanation, which cites factors that change the probability of an event, even when that probability stays quite small
example: Under the statistical relevance model, the lab partner's shaky hands counted as explaining the spilled beaker, even without guaranteeing it.

hindi: सांख्यिकीय न्यायवाक्य — किसी समूह के अधिकांश सदस्यों के गुण से किसी एक सदस्य के गुण का अनुमान
definition: an inductive argument that moves from a claim about most members of a group to a probable conclusion about one particular member
example: Most delivery riders know the shortcut, and Ravi is a rider, so Tina's statistical syllogism told her dinner would arrive quickly.

hindi: दृढ़तावाद — समकक्ष की असहमति के बाद भी अपना विश्वास बनाए रखने का मत
definition: the view that you may sometimes keep your belief unchanged even after learning that someone equally informed and equally capable disagrees, especially when your original reasoning was sound
example: Priya defended the steadfast view at dinner, insisting that her calculation was right regardless of what her equally clever brother said.

hindi: संरक्षकत्व — मनुष्य को प्रकृति का स्वामी नहीं, उसकी देखभाल करने वाला न्यासी मानने का मत
definition: the view that humans are caretakers or trustees of the natural world rather than its owners, and are responsible for passing it on in good condition
example: The housing society's stewardship of the park amounted to one volunteer and a very tired rake.

hindi: स्थितप्रज्ञ — जिसकी बुद्धि सुख-दुख में स्थिर रहती है
definition: in the Bhagavad Gita, a person of steady wisdom who stays calm and unshaken by pleasure, pain, praise or blame
example: When the train was cancelled and Dev simply opened his book, his friends named him the sthitaprajna of platform six.

hindi: स्टोइक प्रज्ञ — पूर्ण विवेकी और सद्गुणी आदर्श ज्ञानी
definition: the ideal wise person of Stoic ethics, whose judgements are always correct and whose virtue is complete, a model that ordinary people strive toward
example: Watching his father stay calm while assembling flat-pack furniture without instructions, Yash wondered if he was living with a Stoic sage.

hindi: स्टोइकवाद — विवेक और सद्गुण को ही सुख मानने वाला यूनानी-रोमन दर्शन
definition: the ancient Greek and Roman school holding that virtue alone brings happiness, and that wise people accept calmly whatever lies beyond their control
example: When the metro stalled for forty minutes, Tanvi opened her book and practised Stoicism while the carriage around her composed furious tweets.

hindi: वात्सल्य-स्नेह — परिवार और अपनेपन से पनपने वाला सहज, पुराना लगाव
definition: the fond, familiar love that grows naturally between family members or people who have long shared daily life, such as parents and children
example: Arjun and his sister bicker over the remote every evening, yet their storge shows the moment anyone else criticises either of them.

hindi: रणनीतिक सारवाद — राजनीतिक एकता हेतु साझी पहचान को अस्थायी रूप से अपनाना
definition: Spivak's term for a marginalized group temporarily presenting a shared, unified identity to achieve political goals, while knowing the group is internally diverse
example: The tenants' association practised strategic essentialism, speaking as 'the residents' at the hearing despite fierce internal quarrels about parking.

hindi: संकल्प-शक्ति — प्रलोभन के बीच भी अपने निर्णय पर टिके रहने का सामर्थ्य
definition: the capacity to keep acting on your considered resolutions despite contrary temptations, often treated as the opposite of weakness of will
example: Keeping the phone locked in a drawer during exam week took more strength of will than Aryan expected.

hindi: सुदृढ़ असत्यवादी — 'यह वाक्य सत्य नहीं है' वाला कठिन रूप
definition: a harder version of the liar paradox using a sentence that says of itself that it is not true, built to defeat solutions that call the liar sentence neither true nor false
example: Every time Arjun proposed a clever escape during logic class, his teacher calmly wrote the strengthened liar on the whiteboard and watched the escape collapse.

hindi: कठोर आपादन — ऐसा 'यदि-तो' जिसमें परिणाम अनिवार्यतः अनुसरण करे
definition: a stronger version of 'if ... then' in which it is necessarily impossible for the first statement to be true while the second is false, rather than merely false in fact
example: Anika told her father that 'if you finish the chores, you get pocket money' should be a strict implication, not a promise that depends on his mood.

hindi: सशक्त कृत्रिम बुद्धि — उचित प्रोग्राम को ही वास्तविक मन मानने का मत
definition: the thesis that a suitably programmed computer would not merely imitate a mind but would literally have one, with genuine understanding and mental states
example: When the chatbot apologised for the late refund, Rohit wondered aloud whether strong AI was true and it actually felt sorry.

hindi: प्रबल उद्भव — ऐसे गुण जो अंशों के ज्ञान से सिद्धांततः भी नहीं निकाले जा सकते
definition: the view that some properties of whole systems are genuinely novel and could never be predicted or derived, even in principle, from complete knowledge of their parts
example: Kiran insisted his toddler's bedtime tantrums were strong emergence, since no amount of knowledge about sugar, naps and neurons could ever have predicted them.

hindi: संरचनात्मक नृविज्ञान — संस्कृतियों में छिपी सार्वभौम संरचनाओं की खोज
definition: lévi-Strauss's approach that studies myths, kinship and customs as systems of relations, searching for deep structures shared by every human culture
example: Comparing wedding rituals across three family branches, Aisha felt like she was doing structural anthropology between servings of biryani.

hindi: संरचनात्मक प्रकार्यवाद — समाज की संस्थाओं को पूरे समाज की स्थिरता में उनके योगदान से समझाने का मत
definition: the social theory that explains institutions, such as family or religion, by the functions they perform in keeping a whole society stable and working
example: Anika's structural functionalism explained the office birthday cake as a ritual keeping the whole department stable and working.

hindi: संरचनात्मक नस्लवाद — संस्थाओं और नीतियों में निहित नस्ली असमानता
definition: the idea that racial inequality can be produced by the ordinary workings of institutions, policies and economic systems, even where no individual intends discrimination
example: Mapping which neighbourhoods got new buses, the city council intern found structural racism hiding inside a routine budget spreadsheet.

hindi: संरचनात्मक यथार्थवाद — सिद्धांतों की गणितीय संरचना को वास्तविक मानने का मत
definition: the view that science captures the real mathematical structure of the world, even when its claims about the underlying entities later change
example: Kabir defended structural realism about his playlist: the song titles kept changing, but the pattern of fast then slow survived every edit.

hindi: संरचनावाद — अर्थ को तत्त्वों के आपसी संबंधों की व्यवस्था से समझने का मत
definition: the view that language, culture and thought are best understood as systems of relations between elements, where each part gains meaning from its place in the whole structure
example: Mapping the family WhatsApp group through structuralism, Riya showed that each uncle's role made sense only against every other uncle.

hindi: शाश्वतता की दृष्टि से — वस्तुओं को कालातीत, सार्वभौमिक दृष्टि से देखना
definition: a Latin phrase meaning 'under the aspect of eternity', used by Spinoza for seeing things as timelessly necessary rather than from a passing, personal viewpoint
example: Viewed sub specie aeternitatis, Rhea decided, losing the office quiz by one point barely mattered, though she still demanded a recount.

hindi: सहसा-बोधवाद — बोध के एकाएक, एक ही क्षण में होने का मत
definition: the doctrine that enlightenment happens suddenly and completely in a single moment of insight, rather than through gradual stages of practice
example: Neha's piano teacher rejected subitism entirely, insisting that nobody wakes up suddenly able to play Chopin.

hindi: जीवन-कर्ता — ऐसा प्राणी जिसकी अपनी इच्छाएँ, स्मृति और भविष्य हो, और इसलिए जिसका अपना अंतर्निहित मूल्य हो
definition: a being with beliefs, desires, memory and a sense of its own future, which on this view gives it inherent value and a right to respectful treatment
example: Watching the cat sulk after missing breakfast, Rhea declared it clearly a subject-of-a-life with grudges to prove it.

hindi: आत्मनिष्ठ परिणामवाद — कर्म को उन परिणामों से आँकने का मत जिनकी व्यक्ति उचित रूप से अपेक्षा कर सकता था
definition: the form of consequentialism holding that an action is right when its expected or reasonably foreseeable consequences are best, given the information the person actually had
example: Subjective consequentialism cleared Anjali of blame: the milk seemed fresh when she made everyone chai, whatever happened afterwards.

hindi: व्यक्तिनिष्ठतावाद — ज्ञान और मूल्य को व्यक्ति के अपने अनुभव पर आश्रित मानने का मत
definition: the view that knowledge and values depend on, and are limited by, each person's own experience, feelings and point of view
example: When Neha said the movie was great 'for me', her brother accused her of subjectivism, then admitted he had cried at the end.

hindi: उदात्त — विराट या भयावह वस्तु से जगने वाला विस्मय और श्रद्धा से भरा सौंदर्य-भाव
definition: the overwhelming feeling of wonder, mixed with a thrill of fear, that people experience before something vast or powerful, such as a storm, an ocean or a mountain range
example: Stuck in traffic on the sea link during a thunderstorm, Anya decided the lightning over the water was a brush with the sublime, even if the honking was not.

hindi: अवस्थिति — वास्तविक अस्तित्व से भिन्न, विचार-वस्तुओं के होने का ढंग
definition: a mode of being said to belong to things like numbers, relations or imagined objects that are real in some sense without existing in space and time
example: Rhea argued that her weekend plans had subsistence, since they were perfectly definite even if they never happened.

hindi: द्रव्य — वह मूल सत्ता जो स्वयं टिकी रहती है और जिसमें गुण रहते हैं
definition: in metaphysics, a thing that exists in its own right and underlies its qualities, staying the same thing while those qualities change
example: Arguing over whether the flat's battered kettle was still the same kettle after its third new handle, Anika insisted the substance had survived even if the handle had not.

hindi: पदार्थ-द्वैतवाद — मन और भौतिक शरीर दो मूलतः भिन्न पदार्थ हैं, ऐसा मत
definition: the view that reality contains two fundamentally different kinds of substance, a non-physical mind and a physical body, each able to exist on its own
example: Rohan cited substance dualism to argue that his mind had finished the homework and only his physical body had failed to write it down.

hindi: द्रव्यगत परिवर्तन — किसी वस्तु का बनना या नष्ट होना, जिसमें वह वस्तु ही बदल जाए
definition: Aristotelian term for change in which a thing comes into being or ceases to exist, rather than merely gaining or losing some quality
example: When the firewood turned to ash, Divya noted it was substantial change, not a makeover, and the fireplace would need more logs.

hindi: सारभूत रूप — वह रूप जो पदार्थ को एक विशेष प्रकार की सत्ता बनाता है
definition: in Aristotelian and medieval thought, the form that organises matter into a particular kind of substance, making a thing a horse or a human rather than loose stuff
example: When the flat-pack wardrobe finally stood upright, Priya declared it had received its substantial form, although three screws remained mysteriously spare.

hindi: जौहरी गति — वस्तुओं के मूल सार में निरंतर परिवर्तन का सिद्धांत
definition: Mulla Sadra's doctrine that change happens in the very substance of things, so that a thing's inner being is constantly moving and becoming, not only its surface qualities
example: Looking at his old school photos, Kunal decided substantial motion explained everything: he was not the same person, all the way down.

hindi: द्रव्यवाद — दिक् और काल को वस्तुओं से स्वतंत्र, अपने आप में विद्यमान सत्ता मानने का मत
definition: the view that space and time, or spacetime, exist as real entities in their own right, independent of the objects and events they contain
example: Clearing out the storeroom, Varun claimed substantivalism was proven: the empty space was still there, stubbornly taking up the whole room.

hindi: प्रतिस्थापित निर्णय — असमर्थ रोगी की ओर से वही चुनना जो वह स्वयं चुनता
definition: the standard for proxy decisions requiring a substitute decider to choose what the incapacitated patient would have chosen, based on their known values
example: Using substituted judgment, Ammi ordered Abbu's hospital meal exactly as he would have: extra chillies, no salad.

hindi: अधिष्ठान — वह अदृश्य आधार जिस पर किसी वस्तु के सभी गुण टिके माने जाते हैं
definition: the hidden underlying support that is supposed to hold a thing's qualities together, something that remains once every quality is stripped away
example: After the phone lost its case, its stickers and finally its cracked screen, Riya asked whether any substratum remained or whether the repair shop now owned a ghost.

hindi: उपसंरचनात्मक तर्कशास्त्र — जो आधारों के प्रयोग के मूल नियम सीमित करे
definition: any logic that restricts the basic structural rules of classical proof, such as freely reusing a premise or adding irrelevant premises, which includes relevance logic and linear logic
example: Namrata said her monthly budget followed substructural logic: each rupee could be used once, and nobody could conjure extra premises.

hindi: पर्याप्ततावाद — न्याय के लिए सबको 'पर्याप्त' मिलना ज़रूरी है, बराबर मिलना नहीं
definition: the view that justice requires everyone to have enough to live a decent life, and that inequalities above that threshold matter little
example: Explaining sufficientarianism, Vikram said he did not need the biggest samosa, only a samosa large enough to survive the meeting.

hindi: डूबी लागत दोष — पहले लगाए गए खर्च के कारण घाटे वाला काम जारी रखना
definition: the error of continuing something because of time, money or effort already spent, even when stopping would clearly serve you better
example: Aditi sat through the dreadful three-hour film because the ticket was expensive, a sunk cost fallacy with popcorn.

hindi: व्यक्तित्व-आत्मा — अकान परंपरा में व्यक्ति का चरित्र-बल और स्वभाव गढ़ने वाली आत्मिक शक्ति
definition: in Akan thought, the personality spirit that gives each person their individual character, courage and strength of presence
example: Kwame said his grandmother's sunsum was so strong that the whole family went quiet whenever she entered the kitchen.

hindi: शून्यता — वस्तुओं में स्वतंत्र, स्थायी स्वभाव के अभाव का सिद्धांत
definition: the Buddhist teaching of emptiness, the view that nothing has a fixed, independent essence of its own, because everything exists only through relations and causes
example: Staring at a fridge full of condiments and no actual food, Aditi said the kitchen had achieved sunyata.

hindi: कर्तव्यातिरेक — कर्तव्य से बढ़कर किया गया प्रशंसनीय कर्म
definition: the doing of good actions that exceed what duty requires, praiseworthy to perform yet not wrong to omit
example: Staying late to redo a colleague's slides was supererogation, Lina said, and she expected an unofficial medal.

hindi: अतिबुद्धि — लगभग हर क्षेत्र में सर्वश्रेष्ठ मानव मस्तिष्क से कहीं आगे की बौद्धिक क्षमता
definition: an intellect, usually imagined as artificial, that greatly exceeds the best human minds in nearly every field, including science, strategy and social skill
example: The quiz team's captain claimed superintelligence until the question about cricket rules came up.

hindi: अतिद्रव्यवाद — भौतिक वस्तुओं को दिक्-काल के ही भाग मानने का मत
definition: the view that physical objects are nothing but regions of spacetime itself, so matter is simply spacetime with certain properties
example: Leaning on the classroom wall, Ishita argued from supersubstantivalism that she and the wall were both merely busy patches of spacetime.

hindi: अधिमूल्यनवाद — अस्पष्ट कथन तभी सत्य है जब हर स्वीकार्य स्पष्ट सीमा पर वह सत्य हो, यह मत
definition: the view that a vague sentence is true if it comes out true under every acceptable way of drawing a sharp boundary, and false if false under every such way
example: Using supervaluationism, Kabir concluded that 'the meeting was long' was simply true, since every reasonable cutoff for 'long' had passed an hour earlier.

hindi: अधिनिर्भरता — एक स्तर के गुणों का दूसरे स्तर के गुणों पर पूरी तरह निर्भर होना
definition: a dependence relation where properties of higher-level things cannot differ unless their underlying physical properties also differ, as a picture cannot change without its pixels changing
example: Explaining supervenience, the teacher noted that Arjun's selfie could not look different unless some pixels had changed, filter or not.

hindi: प्रतिनिधान सिद्धांत — वाक्य में शब्द किस वस्तु के लिए खड़ा है, इसका मध्ययुगीन सिद्धांत
definition: the medieval theory of how a word stands for things within a particular sentence, explaining why 'human' can refer to people, the concept or the word
example: When 'teacher has seven letters' confused the class, Divya explained it with supposition theory: the word stood for itself, not for Mrs Sharma.

hindi: अतिरिक्त मूल्य — श्रमिक द्वारा उत्पन्न वह मूल्य जो उसकी मजदूरी से अधिक होता है और मालिक रखता है
definition: in Marxist economics, the value workers produce beyond what they are paid in wages, which the owner of the business keeps as profit
example: Rohan worked out that he earned back his monthly salary by the tenth, so the surplus value from the other twenty days went straight to the owners.

hindi: आकस्मिक परीक्षा विरोधाभास — घोषित अचानक परीक्षा को तर्क से असंभव ठहराने की उलझन
definition: the puzzle of a teacher announcing a test next week that students will not expect, whose students then reason that no such test can happen, and are surprised anyway
example: The class reasoned their way out of any quiz this week, and the surprise examination paradox arrived on Wednesday morning.

hindi: निगरानी पूँजीवाद — लोगों के व्यवहार के आँकड़े जुटाकर उनसे मुनाफ़ा कमाने वाली अर्थव्यवस्था
definition: Shoshana Zuboff's term for an economic order that profits by collecting personal data about online behaviour and selling predictions of what people will do next
example: Minutes after Ishaan mentioned hiking boots at lunch, his feed filled with boot adverts, and he muttered darkly about surveillance capitalism.

hindi: प्रत्येक को उसका प्राप्य — हर व्यक्ति को वही देना जिसका वह उचित रूप से अधिकारी है, न्याय की प्राचीन रोमन परिभाषा
definition: the ancient Roman definition of justice as giving each person what is rightly theirs or what they are properly owed
example: Dividing the birthday cake by age, height and good behaviour, Dad announced suum cuique and immediately started three arguments.

hindi: स्वभाव — किसी व्यक्ति या वस्तु की अंतर्निहित प्रकृति
definition: a person's inborn nature or temperament, which in the Bhagavad Gita helps determine which duties naturally suit them
example: Rohit's svabhava was clearly suited to debating, since he argued even with the parking machine.

hindi: स्वभाववाद — जगत की घटनाओं को वस्तुओं के अपने स्वभाव से समझाने का मत
definition: the Indian view, linked to the Charvaka school, that events happen through the inherent nature of things themselves, without any creator deity or moral force behind them
example: When asked why the milk boiled over, Tanvi invoked svabhavavada: milk simply does that, with no cosmic plan involved.

hindi: स्वधर्म — अपने स्वभाव और जीवन-स्थिति के अनुसार व्यक्ति का निजी कर्तव्य
definition: the duty that belongs to a particular person, fitting their nature, abilities and station in life, rather than duties that belong to someone else
example: Told to design the poster instead of doing the maths, Kavya said art was her svadharma and the numbers could find their own hero.

hindi: स्वतः प्रामाण्य — ज्ञान स्वयं ही प्रामाणिक होता है, यह सिद्धांत
definition: the Mimamsa doctrine of intrinsic validity, which holds that knowledge is valid by itself and should be trusted unless some specific reason shows it false
example: Believing the bus timetable until the bus failed to show, Pranav was living by svatah pramanya without knowing it.

hindi: स्वातन्त्रिक — स्वतंत्र तर्कों से शून्यता सिद्ध करने वाली माध्यमिक शाखा
definition: a branch of Madhyamaka Buddhism holding that emptiness can be proved through independent, positive arguments that both sides of a debate would accept
example: Unlike her brother, Pooja took the Svatantrika route and built her case with a neat, agreed-upon slide deck.

hindi: श्वेताम्बर — श्वेत वस्त्र धारण करने वाली जैन संप्रदाय-परंपरा
definition: one of the two main branches of Jainism, whose monks and nuns wear simple white robes and which holds that women can also attain liberation
example: Seeing the nuns in white robes outside the temple, Kunal's friend explained that they belonged to the Svetambara tradition.

hindi: आप्लावन समस्या — सत्य विश्वास के मूल्य में विश्वसनीय स्रोत का मूल्य डूब जाने की समस्या
definition: the objection that if a reliable source only matters for producing true belief, reliability adds no extra value once the belief is already true
example: Both espressos tasted identical, so Aarav argued the swamping problem made the reliable machine's reputation irrelevant this morning.

hindi: दलदल-मानव — बिजली से संयोगवश बने हूबहू प्रतिरूप वाला डेविडसन का विचार-प्रयोग
definition: Donald Davidson's thought experiment in which lightning accidentally creates an exact physical duplicate of a person, raising whether a being lacking any history can have meaningful thoughts
example: After a weekend of forgetting everyone's names, Esha said she felt like Swampman: identical on the outside, but with none of the history that made her memories mean anything.

hindi: स्वराज — व्यक्ति और राष्ट्र दोनों का आत्म-शासन और आत्म-संयम
definition: the Indian ideal of self-rule, which Gandhi extended from national independence to each person's self-discipline and village self-government
example: Deciding to cook instead of ordering takeout for a month, Rohan called it his personal swaraj from the delivery apps.

hindi: स्याद्वाद — हर कथन को 'किसी अपेक्षा से' सत्य मानने का जैन मत
definition: the Jain doctrine of qualified assertion: the view that every statement about reality holds true only from some particular viewpoint, marked by the word syat, meaning perhaps or in some respect
example: Practising syadvada in the group chat, Ishaan wrote that the pizza was perhaps cold, from the viewpoint of whoever collected it last.

hindi: स्यात् — 'किसी अपेक्षा से' अर्थ वाला जैन तर्क का सूचक शब्द
definition: the Sanskrit word meaning perhaps or in some respect, which Jain logic attaches to every statement to show that it holds only from a particular viewpoint
example: Kiran now begins every restaurant review with syat, so the biryani is excellent only from the viewpoint of someone who skipped lunch.

hindi: न्यायवाक्य — दो आधार-वाक्यों से एक निष्कर्ष निकालने वाला तर्क-रूप
definition: a deductive argument with exactly two premises and one conclusion, where the premises share a middle term that links the other two terms
example: In the office chat Dev built a syllogism: all Monday meetings run late, today's standup is a Monday meeting, so lunch will clearly be late.

hindi: प्रतीक-आधार समस्या — प्रतीकों को जगत से अर्थ कैसे मिलता है, यह प्रश्न
definition: the problem of explaining how symbols inside a computer or mind acquire their meaning from the world, rather than only being defined by more meaningless symbols
