example: Looking up a word, then every word in its definition, Megha hit the symbol grounding problem and closed the dictionary app in despair.

hindi: प्रतीकात्मक व्यवस्था — भाषा, नियमों और सामाजिक अर्थों का साझा तंत्र
definition: Lacan's term for the shared world of language, rules and social roles that people enter as children and through which they understand themselves
example: Learning to call her teacher 'Ma'am' instead of 'Aunty', little Pihu stepped further into the symbolic order.

hindi: समरूपता तर्क — जन्म से पहले की अनस्तित्व की तरह मृत्यु के बाद से भी न डरना
definition: the Epicurean argument, pressed by Lucretius, that nonexistence after death should frighten us no more than the nonexistence before birth
example: When her nephew panicked about mortality after a science documentary, Uma calmly walked him through the symmetry argument over ice cream.

hindi: सर्वसंबंध — ब्रह्मांड के सभी अंगों का परस्पर जुड़ाव
definition: the Stoic idea that every part of the universe is bound together into one living whole, so that events anywhere affect things everywhere
example: When one colleague's cold spread through the entire office within days, Meher called it sympatheia with extra sneezing.

hindi: आश्रित पद — अकेले अर्थ न रखकर दूसरे शब्दों के सहारे अर्थ देने वाला
definition: describing a word, like 'every', 'never' or 'and', that has no meaning standing alone and works only when joined with other words
example: The group chat reply 'and?' fell flat, because a syncategorematic word cannot carry a whole conversation by itself.

hindi: समकालिक अभिन्नता — एक ही क्षण में किसी वस्तु की पहचान का प्रश्न
definition: identity considered at a single moment, asking what makes something count as one thing, rather than several, at that present instant
example: Looking at the tangle of cables behind the television, Nikhil raised a question of synchronic identity: was this one cable or five that had merged?

hindi: सदसद्विवेक-बीज — भलाई करने और बुराई से बचने का जन्मजात नैतिक बोध
definition: the inborn grasp of the most basic moral principles, such as doing good and avoiding evil, which scholastic thinkers held can never be wholly lost
example: Kabir's synderesis nagged him when he eyed his flatmate's labelled yoghurt at midnight.

hindi: श्रमिक संघवाद — मज़दूर संघों द्वारा उद्योग और समाज चलाने की विचारधारा
definition: the radical movement holding that workers' trade unions should take control of industries, through general strikes, and replace government entirely
example: When the delivery riders took over scheduling from the manager, Rehan said their syndicalism beat the app's algorithm.

hindi: सातत्यवाद — जगत में सब कुछ निरंतर और अविभाज्य रूप से जुड़ा है यह मत
definition: Peirce's doctrine that continuity is fundamental to reality, so that things, minds and ideas shade into each other rather than being sharply separated
example: Watching dusk fade into night on his commute, Aman decided synechism was right: there was no single minute when evening ended.

hindi: संश्लेषणात्मक — जिसका सत्य शब्दों के अर्थ से आगे जगत के तथ्यों पर निर्भर हो
definition: describes a statement whose truth depends on how the world actually is, rather than on the meanings of its words alone
example: 'The metro is late again' is synthetic, Priya sighed on the platform, which is exactly why she checked the app.

hindi: संश्लेषणात्मक प्रागनुभविक — ऐसा ज्ञान जो जगत के बारे में नया बताए, फिर भी अनुभव से स्वतंत्र हो
definition: Kant's category of statements that tell us something genuinely about the world yet can be known without relying on experience, such as truths of arithmetic
example: Rohan claimed that 'every event has a cause' was synthetic a priori, then blamed the cat for the broken mug without any evidence.

hindi: संश्लेषणात्मक निर्णय — उद्देश्य में नई जानकारी जोड़ने वाला निर्णय
definition: Kant's term for a statement whose predicate, the thing said about the subject, adds information not already contained in the subject's meaning, like saying this coffee is cold
example: Checking the weather app on her commute, Isha noted that "this morning is rainy" was a synthetic judgment she deeply wished were false.

hindi: तंत्र उत्तर — चीनी कक्ष में समझ को पूरे तंत्र में मानने वाला प्रत्युत्तर
definition: the reply to the Chinese room argument claiming that, although the person inside understands nothing, the whole system of person, rulebook and papers does understand Chinese
example: Their group project earned an A though nobody grasped thermodynamics, so Kabir gave the systems reply: the team as a whole understood it.

hindi: मौन सहमति — बिना कहे, आचरण से दी गई मानी जाने वाली स्वीकृति
definition: agreement to a government's authority that is given silently through conduct, such as living in a country and using its roads, rather than through words
example: Priya never signed the group chat's rules, but by staying in it for three years she had given tacit consent to the meme ban.

hindi: जोड़-विरोधाभास — असंबद्ध परिकल्पना जोड़ने पर भी पुष्टि बने रहने की समस्या
definition: the problem that if evidence confirms a hypothesis, it seems also to confirm that hypothesis with any irrelevant claim tacked onto it, such as a claim about unicorns
example: Riya exploited the tacking paradox by claiming her good exam marks confirmed both her study plan and her theory that Tuesdays are lucky.

hindi: परम मूल — यिन और यांग का आदि स्रोत
definition: the Supreme Ultimate: in Chinese cosmology, the highest source from which yin and yang and then all things emerge
example: Staring at the swirling logo on his martial arts uniform, Kunal finally asked his coach what taiji meant.

hindi: तमस् — प्रकृति का जड़ता, भारीपन और अंधकार वाला गुण
definition: in Samkhya, the strand of nature marked by heaviness, inertia, dullness and darkness, one of the three qualities woven through everything
example: Sunday afternoon on the sofa, Rahul blamed tamas for the fact that the remote was two metres away and staying there.

hindi: तृष्णा — दुःख का मूल कारण मानी जाने वाली लालसा
definition: the Buddhist term for craving or thirst, the restless desire for pleasure, existence or escape that the teaching names as the root cause of suffering
example: Refreshing the delivery tracker for the ninth time, Meera admitted her tanha for new sneakers was getting out of hand.

hindi: तन्मात्रा — शब्द, स्पर्श, रूप, रस और गंध के सूक्ष्म मूल तत्त्व
definition: in Samkhya, any of the five subtle elements of sound, touch, form, taste and smell, from which the gross physical elements later arise
example: Sniffing the biryani before it reached the table, Farhan claimed he was enjoying the tanmatra of smell ahead of the actual rice.

hindi: तप — आत्म-अनुशासन और कठोर साधना
definition: disciplined effort and austerity, enduring hardship willingly to purify yourself and build inner strength
example: Waking at five to practise the violin, Irfan described his routine as tapas and his neighbours described it otherwise.

hindi: तक़लीद — किसी प्रामाणिक विद्वान के मत का बिना स्वयं जाँचे अनुसरण
definition: following the rulings of an established authority or school without independently examining the reasons, often contrasted with independent reasoning
example: Asked why he picked that phone, Rohan admitted it was pure taqlid: his tech-savvy uncle said so.

hindi: परशक्ति — मुक्ति के लिए बुद्ध की करुणा-शक्ति पर निर्भरता
definition: other-power, the Pure Land teaching that liberation depends on Amida Buddha's compassionate power rather than on personal effort or merit
example: After failing to fix the wifi himself, Varun embraced tariki and simply waited for his tech-savvy younger sister to come home.

hindi: तर्क — किसी मत के असंगत परिणाम दिखाकर उसकी परीक्षा करने की विधि
definition: in Nyaya philosophy, hypothetical or counterfactual reasoning that tests a claim by showing the unwelcome consequences that would follow if it were true
example: Using tarka, Simran pointed out that if the office printer were truly fixed, there would not be a queue of five people swearing at it.

hindi: तत्त्वमसि — 'वह तू है', आत्मा और ब्रह्म की एकता का महावाक्य
definition: the great saying of the Chandogya Upanishad, usually translated as you are that, which teaches that the individual self is identical with Brahman, the ultimate reality
example: When her brother pointed at the mess in the living room, Isha replied with tat tvam asi, suggesting that the mess and he were one.

hindi: तत्त्व — जैन दर्शन में मोक्षमार्ग समझाने वाले सात मूल सत्य
definition: in Jain philosophy, one of the seven basic realities, soul, non-soul, inflow, bondage, stopping, shedding of karma and liberation, which explain the path to freedom
example: Revising for the religion exam, Jaya drew each tattva as a stage in a flowchart that ended, happily, in liberation.

hindi: पुनरुक्ति — अपनी बनावट के कारण ही सदा सत्य रहने वाला कथन
definition: a statement that is true in every possible case purely because of its logical form, such as 'either it will rain or it will not'
example: The weather app's forecast, 'it may or may not rain today', is a tautology dressed up as useful information.

hindi: तौहीद — ईश्वर की पूर्ण एकता और अद्वितीयता का सिद्धांत
definition: the doctrine of the absolute oneness and uniqueness of the deity, which Islamic philosophy treats as the foundation for thinking about being, knowledge and ethics
example: In class, Mariam explained tawhid by pointing out that her whole essay kept returning to the single idea that the divine cannot be divided.

hindi: प्रौद्योगिकीय नियतिवाद — यह मत कि तकनीक ही समाज और संस्कृति की दिशा तय करती है
definition: the view that technology develops by its own internal logic and in turn shapes society, culture and human values, rather than being steered by them
example: At dinner Rohan blamed smartphones for killing conversation, a neat piece of technological determinism delivered while he scrolled his own feed.

hindi: तकनीकी तटस्थता — यह मत कि तकनीक स्वयं न अच्छी है न बुरी, सब उसके प्रयोग पर निर्भर है
definition: the view that technology is a neutral instrument, neither good nor evil in itself, whose moral worth depends entirely on how people choose to employ it
example: Invoking technological neutrality, Kabir insisted the family group chat was innocent and only his cousins had turned it into a battlefield.

hindi: तकनीकी विलक्षणता — वह काल्पनिक बिंदु जब तकनीकी प्रगति इतनी तीव्र हो जाए कि मानव भविष्य अपूर्वानुमेय हो जाए
definition: the hypothetical future point at which machine intelligence improves itself so rapidly that technological change becomes uncontrollable and human history impossible to predict
example: Every time his phone updated overnight, Grandpa asked whether the technological singularity had finally arrived.

hindi: तकनीकी निद्राभ्रमण — बिना सोचे-समझे नई तकनीक अपनाते जाना, मानो नींद में चल रहे हों
definition: Langdon Winner's term for sleepwalking through technical change, adopting unfamiliar devices and systems without asking how they reshape daily life, power and politics
example: Signing up for a fifth smart gadget without reading a single setting, Tanvi admitted her kitchen now ran on technological somnambulism.

hindi: आत्म-तकनीकें — स्वयं को गढ़ने और रूपांतरित करने की प्रथाएँ
definition: Foucault's term for practices through which people work on their own bodies, thoughts and conduct to transform themselves, such as journaling, confession or diet
example: Between her gratitude journal, meditation app and habit tracker, Simran had assembled quite a toolkit of technologies of the self.

hindi: प्रयोजनमूलक युक्ति — जगत की व्यवस्था और प्रयोजन से ईश्वर को सिद्ध करने का तर्क
definition: the argument that the order and apparent purpose found in nature point to an intelligent designer, usually understood as a deity
example: Watching the bees fill their honeycomb in perfect hexagons, Nisha felt the pull of the teleological argument, then remembered her own lopsided cake.

hindi: प्रयोजनवाद — वस्तुओं और घटनाओं को उनके उद्देश्य या लक्ष्य से समझाने का मत
definition: the practice of explaining things by the goals or purposes they serve, as in saying that eyes exist for seeing
example: Claiming that the office coffee machine exists purely to test his patience, Farhan slipped into grumpy teleology.

hindi: प्रयोजन-अर्थविज्ञान — मानसिक निरूपण को जैविक प्रयोजन से समझाने वाला सिद्धांत
definition: the family of theories explaining how inner mental states come to stand for things through biological function, holding that a state represents what it was selected, by evolution or learning, to indicate
example: Using teleosemantics, Omkar argued that his stomach's rumble represented lunch because that was the signal evolution designed it to send.

hindi: दूरप्रेषण की समस्या — नष्ट होकर कहीं और हूबहू बना दिए जाने पर व्यक्ति के वही रहने का प्रश्न
definition: a thought experiment asking whether a person survives if a machine scans and destroys their body and then builds an exact duplicate elsewhere, or whether the duplicate is merely a copy
example: Stuck in traffic on the morning commute, Farhan decided the teleporter problem was a small price to pay for a two-second ride to work.

hindi: दूरसंचरण विरोधाभास — स्वयं की प्रतिलिपि बनने पर पहचान बनी रहती है या नहीं, इस पर पार्फ़िट की परिकल्पना
definition: Derek Parfit's thought experiment of a teleporter that scans and destroys your body and builds an exact copy elsewhere, asking whether the person who arrives is really you
example: Stuck in rush-hour traffic, Anaya said she would accept the teletransportation paradox and its risks for a shorter commute.

hindi: परम लक्ष्य — किसी वस्तु या क्रिया का अंतर्निहित उद्देश्य या पूर्णता
definition: the Greek word for the built-in purpose, goal or completion that a thing or activity naturally aims toward, central to Aristotle's thinking about nature
example: Watching the seedling lean toward the kitchen window, Aarav said its telos was clearly sunlight, much like his own on a Sunday morning.

hindi: कालिक असममिति — भूत और भविष्य के बीच मूलभूत भेद
definition: the ways in which past and future differ, such as remembering the past but not the future and causes coming before effects
example: Temporal asymmetry explained why Riddhi could recall last night's argument perfectly but had no memory of tomorrow's apology.

hindi: कालिक भवन — घटनाओं का भविष्य से वर्तमान और फिर भूत बनते जाना
definition: the supposed process by which events come into existence or become present, shifting from future to present to past as time really passes
example: Waiting for the kettle, Zoya felt the full weight of temporal becoming as each second slowly turned into the present.

hindi: काल-तर्कशास्त्र — 'सदा', 'कभी' और 'फिर' जैसे कालसूचक कथनों का तर्क
definition: a modal logic that treats time as its subject, adding operators for 'always', 'sometime', 'previously' and 'eventually' to reason about statements whose truth changes over time
example: Deepa used temporal logic on her brother's promise: he would always eventually reply, which in practice meant never before dinner.

hindi: कालिक अंश — किसी वस्तु का एक निश्चित समयावधि तक सीमित भाग
definition: a part of an object that exists only during some stretch of time, just as a spatial part exists only in some region of space
example: Yash insisted that only the Monday-morning temporal part of him was grumpy, and that later parts deserved no blame.

hindi: कालिक अंश — किसी वस्तु के अलग-अलग समयों पर विद्यमान खंड
definition: the slices or stages of an object that exist at particular moments or periods, which together make up the whole object across time
example: Ananya blamed the burnt toast on one of her temporal parts, specifically the sleepy seven o'clock stage who never reads timers.

hindi: अस्थायी आंतरिक गुण — एक ही वस्तु के अलग समयों पर विरोधी गुण रखने की पहेली
definition: Lewis's puzzle about how one persisting object can have incompatible inner properties, such as being bent and being straight, at different times
example: Watching her friend sit down and stand up, Rhea raised the puzzle of temporary intrinsics: how could one person be both bent and straight?

hindi: कमलसूत्र सम्प्रदाय — ध्यान, सिद्धांत और भक्ति को जोड़ने वाली जापानी बौद्ध परंपरा
definition: the Japanese school of Buddhism brought from China by Saicho, based on the Lotus Sutra, whose mountain monastery trained the founders of most later Japanese schools
example: The history teacher called Tendai the parent campus of Japanese Buddhism, since so many later founders first trained there before starting their own schools.

hindi: कोमल-चित्त — सिद्धांतप्रिय, आदर्शवादी और आशावादी स्वभाव वाला
definition: in William James's sorting of philosophical temperaments, describing someone drawn to grand principles, idealism (the view that mind is basic to reality), optimism, religious faith and belief in free will
example: Asha, tender-minded to the core, insisted that the group project would succeed because everyone surely meant well.

hindi: मूल सिद्धांत — किसी मत या समूह द्वारा सत्य माना गया बुनियादी विश्वास
definition: a principle or belief held as true by a group, school of thought or movement, often forming part of its core teachings
example: A central tenet of our study group is that nobody opens social media until the first chapter is done.

hindi: पद रूपवाद — गणितीय पदों को केवल अपने लिखित प्रतीकों का ही संकेत मानने का मत
definition: the view that mathematical terms refer to nothing beyond the written symbols themselves, so numerals denote only the marks written on paper
example: When Jay insisted the seven on the whiteboard was the only seven there was, his classmates accused him of term formalism.

hindi: पद-तर्कशास्त्र — पदों और उनके संबंधों पर आधारित अरस्तू की पारंपरिक तर्क-पद्धति
definition: the traditional system of logic from Aristotle that studies reasoning built from terms naming a subject and what is said about that subject, such as the syllogism, before modern symbolic logic
example: The debate club preferred term logic because 'all cats are mammals' was easier to shout than a string of symbols.

hindi: उच्छेद-पक्ष — मृत्यु के साथ व्यक्ति का पूर्ण रूप से अस्तित्व समाप्त हो जाता है
definition: the view that when a person dies, that person ceases to exist altogether, rather than surviving as a soul, a corpse or in some other form
example: Arguing for the termination thesis on the bus, Dev said the body in the coffin is no more him than his old school bag is.

hindi: तृतीयक गुण — वस्तु की अन्य वस्तुओं को प्रभावित करने की शक्ति या मूल्य-गुण
definition: properties such as a power to affect other objects, or on some accounts beauty and value, which go beyond both primary qualities like shape and size and secondary qualities like colour and taste
example: Admiring the office's pricey coffee machine, Varun praised its tertiary qualities: chiefly, its power to make Monday mornings survivable.

hindi: आस्था-घोषणा — अपने विश्वासों और सिद्धांतों का औपचारिक कथन
definition: a formal statement of what a person believes or stands for, setting out their core principles, as in a political testament
example: Her farewell email to the team read like a testament: honest feedback, long lunches, and never a meeting on Friday afternoon.

hindi: साक्ष्य-अन्याय — पूर्वाग्रह के कारण किसी की बात पर कम विश्वास करना
definition: a wrong done to someone as a knower, where a listener gives a speaker less credibility than they deserve because of prejudice about the speaker's identity, such as gender, accent or race
example: The mechanic trusted the husband's description of the rattling noise over the wife's, even though she drove the car daily, a textbook case of testimonial injustice.

hindi: साक्ष्य-न्याय — पूर्वाग्रह को सुधारकर वक्ता को उचित विश्वसनीयता देने का गुण
definition: the virtue of a listener who notices when prejudice may be distorting their judgement of a speaker and corrects for it, giving fair credibility
example: Realising she had doubted the quiet student only because he rarely spoke, the teacher practised testimonial justice and asked him to explain his answer.

hindi: शब्द-जन्य ज्ञान — दूसरों के कथन पर भरोसे से मिला ज्ञान
definition: knowledge a person gains by believing what a reliable speaker or writer tells them, rather than by checking the matter themselves
example: Her testimonial knowledge that the office printer was broken came from a sticky note, which turned out to be perfectly reliable.

hindi: साक्ष्य-मौनीकरण — वक्ता को ज्ञाता के रूप में पहचाने ही न जाना
definition: the silencing that happens when an audience fails to recognise a speaker as a knower at all, so their spoken reports are never properly heard
example: Every time the cleaner reported the leaking pipe and nobody even looked up, the office practised testimonial quieting without noticing.

hindi: साक्ष्य-दमन — श्रोता की अक्षमता के डर से अपनी बात को स्वयं काट-छाँट देना
definition: the self-silencing a speaker performs when they shorten or withhold what they would tell others, because they expect the listener will misunderstand it or turn it against them
example: Anjali trimmed her story about the landlord to a single vague sentence in the group chat, a quiet case of testimonial smothering.

hindi: शब्द प्रमाण — दूसरों के कथन से प्राप्त ज्ञान का स्रोत
definition: the process of forming beliefs and gaining knowledge from what other people tell us, through speech or writing, rather than from our own observation
example: Almost everything Aarav knew about the moon landing reached him through testimony, mostly from textbooks and one enthusiastic uncle.

hindi: चतुर्औषधि — ईश्वर, मृत्यु, सुख और दुःख पर एपिक्यूरस के चार उपचार
definition: the Epicurean four-part remedy: fear no deity, do not worry about death, what is good is easy to obtain, and what is terrible is easy to endure
example: Before her driving test, Shreya recited the tetrapharmakos, then added a fifth remedy of her own: do not stall on the hill.

hindi: पश्चात्-लक्ष्य दोष — बिखरे आँकड़ों में बाद में मनचाहा पैटर्न खोजकर उसे प्रमाण मान लेना
definition: the fallacy of finding a pattern in random data after the fact, by focusing on clusters that happen to match while ignoring everything else
example: Ritu's horoscope matched three things that week, and her Texas sharpshooter fallacy quietly ignored the nine it missed.

hindi: ईश्वरवाद — यह मान्यता कि एक व्यक्तित्ववान ईश्वर है जो सृष्टि रचता और उसकी परवाह करता है
definition: the view that at least one deity exists, most often a personal creator who knows, cares about and still acts within the world
example: Over chai in the office kitchen, Rohan defended theism while his colleague kept asking why a caring creator would allow Monday morning meetings.

hindi: ईश्वर-न्याय — अशुभ के रहते हुए भी ईश्वर को न्यायी सिद्ध करने का प्रयास
definition: an attempt to explain why an all-powerful, perfectly good deity would permit evil and suffering in the world
example: Zara joked that her mother's theodicy for rainy holidays was that the sunshine would feel better next time.

hindi: ईश्वरीय भाग्यवाद — ईश्वर के पूर्वज्ञान से मानव स्वतंत्रता को असंभव मानने का मत
definition: the view that if a deity already knows everything we will choose, then our future choices are fixed and we cannot choose otherwise
example: Anaya raised theological fatalism during chai break, asking whether heaven already knew she would skip the gym.

hindi: धार्मिक असंज्ञानवाद — ईश्वर-संबंधी वाक्यों को सत्य-असत्य से परे, केवल भाव या प्रतिबद्धता मानने का मत
definition: the view that religious statements about a deity do not state facts that could be true or false, but express attitudes, commitments or feelings
example: When her roommate asked whether 'the divine is love' was true or false, Maya offered theological noncognitivism: it was less a fact than a commitment, like her loyalty to the college football team.

hindi: धार्मिक सद्गुण — आस्था, आशा और प्रेम, जिन्हें ईश्वरीय कृपा से प्राप्त माना गया
definition: in Christian ethics, the three virtues of faith, hope and charity, believed to come from divine grace rather than from human habit and training
example: In religious studies class, Sara explained that the theological virtues differ from the cardinal ones because believers hold that grace, not practice, supplies them.

hindi: प्रमेय — वह कथन जिसे स्वीकृत स्वयंसिद्धों और नियमों से उपपत्ति द्वारा सिद्ध किया गया हो
definition: a statement that has been proved true by a chain of valid reasoning starting from accepted axioms and previously established results
example: Ishaan called it a theorem that the group chat would cancel the trip, but without a proof from agreed premises it was really just a gloomy prediction.

hindi: सैद्धांतिक पद — सीधे प्रेक्षित न हो सकने वाली सत्ता को सूचित करने वाला शब्द
definition: a word in a scientific theory that refers to something not directly observable, such as 'electron', 'gene' or 'gravitational field'
example: In biology class, Meera noticed that 'gene' was a theoretical term, though her textbook drew them like tiny coloured sausages.

hindi: मनन — सत्य और शाश्वत वस्तुओं का शुद्ध बौद्धिक चिंतन
definition: the Greek term for contemplation, the purely intellectual activity of reflecting on truth and unchanging things for their own sake
example: Lying on the terrace watching stars, Pooja told her brother she was engaged in theoria, not skipping homework.

hindi: वर्णन-सिद्धांत — रसेल का मत कि निश्चित वर्णन छिपे हुए परिमाणक कथन हैं
definition: Russell's analysis of phrases like 'the present king of France' as hidden claims that exactly one such thing exists and has the stated property, rather than as names
example: Using the theory of descriptions, Meera proved that 'the tidy flatmate' was false, since no such person existed in their flat.

hindi: प्रत्यय सिद्धांत — इंद्रियजगत से परे शाश्वत, पूर्ण आदर्श रूपों का प्लेटोनिक मत
definition: Plato's theory that beyond the changing physical world there exist perfect, eternal and unchanging Forms, such as Beauty itself, which ordinary things only imperfectly copy
example: Comparing every pizza to one perfect slice she had in Naples, Kavya was basically living by the theory of Forms.

hindi: सिद्धांत-भारितता — प्रत्येक प्रेक्षण का पहले से धारित सिद्धांतों से प्रभावित होना
definition: the claim that observation is never neutral, because what scientists notice and report is shaped by the theories they already accept
example: The theory-ladenness of the match replay was obvious: each fan saw a clear foul or a brilliant tackle, depending on the jersey.

hindi: सिद्धांत-सिद्धांत — दूसरों के मन को एक अंतर्निहित सिद्धांत के सहारे समझने का मत
definition: the view that people understand other minds by using an implicit theory of how beliefs, desires and behaviour connect, much like a scientist applying laws
example: Watching her toddler hide behind a curtain with his feet showing, Anjali decided theory-theory was right and his theory of other minds simply needed revising.

hindi: चिकित्सकीय भ्रांति — शोध-प्रयोग को अपने निजी उपचार की तरह समझ लेना
definition: the mistaken belief of research participants that a clinical trial is designed mainly to treat them personally, rather than to produce general knowledge
example: Joining the sleep study, Varun suffered from therapeutic misconception and fully expected to come out rested and cured of Mondays.

hindi: चिकित्सात्मक दर्शन — दार्शनिक उलझनों को भाषा के भ्रम मानकर उन्हें सुलझाने की अपेक्षा मिटाने का दृष्टिकोण
definition: the approach, inspired by Wittgenstein, that treats philosophical puzzles as confusions caused by language, aiming to dissolve them rather than solve them
example: In the spirit of therapeutic philosophy, Farhan did not answer his friend's worry about whether anyone can truly know anything; he calmly showed how the worry misused the word 'know'.

hindi: चिकित्सकीय विशेषाधिकार — रोगी की भलाई हेतु कुछ जानकारी रोक लेने की छूट
definition: the contested exception allowing doctors to withhold certain medical information from a patient if disclosing it would seriously harm that patient
example: When the mechanic declined to tell Papa the full repair bill before lunch, Maya called it therapeutic privilege.

hindi: थेरवाद — पालि ग्रंथों पर आधारित प्राचीन बौद्ध परंपरा
definition: the oldest surviving school of Buddhism, based on the early Pali scriptures, which emphasises personal discipline, meditation and the path of the fully liberated arhat
example: In history class, Sanya learned that Theravada Buddhism still shapes daily life across Sri Lanka and Thailand.

hindi: दैवी कर्मकांड — आत्मा को परम से जोड़ने वाले अनुष्ठान
definition: the ritual practice, defended by later Neoplatonists such as Iamblichus, of using sacred rites to unite the soul with divine powers
example: In the philosophy seminar, Esha explained that Iamblichus valued theurgy because he believed clever thinking alone could never lift the soul to the divine.

hindi: सघन अवधारणा — वर्णन और मूल्यांकन दोनों को एक साथ समेटने वाली नैतिक अवधारणा
definition: a moral concept, such as cruel, generous or rude, that both describes what someone did and evaluates it as good or poor at the same time
example: Calling the manager's email 'tactless' used a thick concept: the single word both described the blunt wording and condemned it.

hindi: विरल अवधारणा — 'शुभ', 'सही' जैसी सामान्य मूल्यांकनात्मक अवधारणा जिसमें वर्णन बहुत कम हो
definition: a very general concept of value, such as good, right or ought, that judges something without describing much about what it is like
example: Her teacher circled 'good' on the essay feedback and noted that a thin concept told Maya nothing about what actually worked.

hindi: स्वयं में वस्तु — अनुभव से स्वतंत्र, अपने आप में स्थित वस्तु
definition: Kant's name for reality as it exists independently of human senses and thought, which lies behind every appearance but can never itself be known
example: Staring at the blurry photo in the group chat, Kabir admitted the cake as a thing-in-itself might be delicious, but the cake as it appeared was a crime.

hindi: तृतीय मनुष्य तर्क — प्लेटो के प्रत्ययों को अनन्त श्रृंखला में ले जाने वाला आपत्ति-तर्क
definition: an objection to Plato's theory of Forms, the perfect patterns behind ordinary things, claiming that if tall things share Tallness, then tall things and Tallness together need a further Form, starting an endless regress
example: When the committee formed a subcommittee to review the subcommittee, Dhruv whispered that the office had discovered the third man argument.

hindi: तृतीयता — नियम, आदत और मध्यस्थता की श्रेणी, पर्स की तीसरी श्रेणी
definition: Peirce's third category of reality: rules, habits and meaning, whatever connects and mediates between other things, such as a traffic rule or a word standing for an object
example: The traffic signal, Nisha explained, was thirdness in action: a rule linking a colour to a crowd's behaviour.

hindi: एतत्ता — किसी एक विशेष वस्तु का अपना अनूठा 'यह-पन'
definition: an English rendering of haecceity: the individual feature that makes this particular thing itself, distinct from every other thing of the same kind
example: The twins wore matching uniforms to school, yet their teacher said each one's thisness was obvious within about four seconds.

hindi: थॉमसवाद — अक्विनास के दर्शन पर आधारित परंपरा, जो तर्क और आस्था का मेल करती है
definition: the philosophical school following Aquinas, which combines Aristotle's reasoning with Christian faith and holds that reason and revelation cannot truly conflict
example: Rahul's Thomism came through at the dinner table: he insisted his science homework and his grandmother's prayers were friends, not rivals.

hindi: थॉमसन का वायलिन-वादक — शारीरिक सहायता की नैतिक बाध्यता पर एक विचार-प्रयोग
definition: a thought experiment in which you wake up medically connected to an unconscious violinist, used to question whether anyone must sustain another person using their body
example: When his roommate plugged a phone charger into Karan's laptop overnight, he angrily compared himself to Thomson's violinist.

hindi: त्रिलक्षण — अनित्य, दुःख और अनात्म, अस्तित्व के तीन लक्षण
definition: the Buddhist teaching that every conditioned thing shares three features: impermanence, suffering or unsatisfactoriness, and the absence of a permanent self
example: In class, Ishaan applied the three marks of existence to his old laptop: it was dying, it was painful, and it had no soul.

hindi: त्रिमानक — किसी मत को परखने की मोही कसौटियाँ
definition: the Mohist test for judging any doctrine: check its roots in the example of ancient sages, its agreement with ordinary people's experience, and its benefit when applied
example: Before trusting the viral diet, Sneha put it through the three standards and it failed every single one.

hindi: त्रिमूल्य तर्कशास्त्र — सत्य, असत्य और अनिश्चित, तीन मूल्यों वाला तर्क
definition: a many-valued logic with three truth values instead of a pair, usually true, false and a third value such as 'unknown', 'indeterminate' or 'neither'
example: Asked whether dinner was ready, Vikram answered in three-valued logic: true, false, or 'depends on when your father gets home'.

hindi: सीमा-कर्तव्यवाद — यह मत कि नैतिक नियम तभी टूट सकते हैं जब परिणाम अत्यंत भयावह हों
definition: the view that moral rules should normally be followed regardless of outcomes, but may be broken once the stakes pass some catastrophic level
example: Aditya's threshold deontology meant no lying to his manager, unless the office were literally on fire.

hindi: प्रक्षिप्तता — बिना चुने किसी परिस्थिति में फेंक दिए जाने का अस्तित्वगत तथ्य
definition: Heidegger's term for the condition of finding yourself already placed in a world, family, language and history that you never chose
example: Born into a family of loud cricket fans, Kavya accepted her thrownness every time the living room erupted.

hindi: स्वर्ग — ब्रह्मांड की नैतिक और प्राकृतिक व्यवस्था
definition: the Chinese concept of Heaven: the heavens above and the higher moral order of the universe, sometimes pictured as a deity and sometimes as impersonal nature
example: Looking at the monsoon clouds, Nani said tian clearly disapproved of their picnic plans.

hindi: तियानताई — सभी शिक्षाओं को एक व्यवस्था में जोड़ने वाला चीनी बौद्ध संप्रदाय
definition: the Chinese Buddhist school, founded on the Lotus Sutra, which arranges the many Buddhist teachings into one system and holds that each moment of thought contains all realms of reality
example: Sorting her messy notes into one master document, Rhea joked she was doing Tiantai with folders.

hindi: टिकटिकाता बम परिदृश्य — बड़ी आपदा रोकने के लिए कठोर उपायों के औचित्य की परिकल्पना
definition: a thought experiment imagining a captured suspect who knows where a hidden bomb will soon explode, used to test whether torturing that suspect could ever be justified to save many lives
example: In the debate club, the ticking time bomb scenario turned a polite discussion into twenty minutes of raised voices and frantic note-passing.

hindi: तिक्कुन ओलाम — संसार के सुधार और मरम्मत का नैतिक दायित्व
definition: repairing the world, the Jewish idea that humans share responsibility for healing what is broken in society and creation through ethical action
example: Picking litter off the beach before the picnic, Leah said tikkun olam starts with the crisp packet nearest your feet.

hindi: काल-विलंब तर्क — प्रकाश की देरी से परोक्ष प्रत्यक्ष सिद्ध करने का तर्क
definition: the argument that because light and signals take time to travel, what we perceive has already changed or vanished, so we directly perceive only a present sensory image rather than the object
example: Looking at a distant star from the terrace, Riya used the time-lag argument to claim she was admiring something that might have quit existing long ago.

hindi: काल-समस्या — मृत्यु की हानि किस समय होती है, इसका प्रश्न
definition: the puzzle for anyone holding that death harms a person of saying exactly when that harm happens, since before death the person is unharmed and after death no person remains
example: Asked in the staffroom when exactly the harm of death lands, the biology teacher admitted the timing problem had stumped her too.

hindi: तीर्थंकर — संसार-सागर पार करने का मार्ग दिखाने वाले जैन आचार्य
definition: in Jainism, a fully enlightened teacher who has crossed beyond rebirth and shows others the path across, twenty-four of whom are recognised in the present cosmic cycle
example: In the school project on world religions, Aditi explained that a tirthankara is less a creator deity and more a guide who builds the bridge and then walks across it first.

hindi: दृष्टांत तादात्म्य सिद्धांत — हर एक मानसिक घटना को किसी एक भौतिक घटना मानने का मत
definition: the weaker version of identity theory holding that every individual mental event is identical with some physical event, while allowing that similar mental events may match different brain states
example: On the commute, Imran defended token identity theory: his Monday gloom and his brother's were each some brain event, just probably not the same kind.

hindi: दृष्टांत-भौतिकवाद — हर एक मानसिक घटना किसी न किसी भौतिक घटना से अभिन्न है, ऐसा मत
definition: the weaker physicalist view that each single mental event is identical to some physical event, though one kind of mental state, like hunger, may take quite different physical forms in different brains
example: Anika used token physicalism to explain why her craving for pizza and her brother's could be the same wish yet differ inside their brains.

hindi: सहिष्णुता — असहमत विश्वासों और जीवन-शैलियों को दबाए बिना रहने देने का सिद्धांत
definition: the principle of permitting beliefs, religions and lifestyles you disapprove of rather than suppressing them by force or punishment
example: The flat practised toleration: Anjali disliked her flatmate's heavy metal, but she bought earplugs instead of cutting the wires.

hindi: समग्र-साक्ष्य मत — असहमति और मूल प्रमाण दोनों को साथ तौलने का मत
definition: the view that after discovering an equally informed person disagrees, you should weigh both the original evidence and the disagreement itself, so the better-supported side may shift less
example: Under the total evidence view, Arjun kept most of his confidence because the receipt in his hand still counted for more than his friend's memory.

hindi: कुल-उपयोगितावाद — सब लोगों के कुल कल्याण के योग को अधिकतम करने का मत
definition: the form of utilitarianism holding that the best outcome contains the largest total amount of wellbeing, added across every person, so more happy people makes things better
example: Arguing for a bigger wedding guest list, Aunt Leela was accidentally defending total utilitarianism: more guests, more total happiness.

hindi: सर्वसत्तावाद — जीवन के हर पक्ष पर राज्य के पूर्ण नियंत्रण वाली शासन-व्यवस्था
definition: a form of government that seeks total control over every part of public and private life, including beliefs, education, media and family
example: Mansi said her mother's revision timetable bordered on totalitarianism: it scheduled even her thinking time.

hindi: कठोर-चित्त — तथ्यप्रिय, भौतिकवादी और संशयी स्वभाव वाला
definition: in William James's sorting of philosophical temperaments, describing someone drawn to hard facts, the belief that only matter exists, pessimism, doubt, and the view that every event is fixed by earlier causes
example: Tough-minded Kunal wanted spreadsheets, not speeches, before agreeing the office party would fit the budget.

hindi: टूलमिन प्रतिमान — दावा, आधार, औचित्य और प्रतिबंध में तर्क को बाँटने की पद्धति
definition: a method for analysing everyday arguments into a claim, the data supporting it, the warrant linking them, and any qualifications or rebuttals
example: The debate club used the Toulmin model to dissect the canteen petition, and discovered that its warrant was simply 'because chips'.

hindi: विष पहेली — भविष्य में करने का इरादा बनाने की तर्कसंगतता पर कावका की पहेली
definition: Gregory Kavka's decision puzzle offering a fortune for merely intending tonight to drink a mild poison tomorrow, asking whether you can rationally intend something you will have no reason to carry out
example: Promising himself tonight to jog at dawn, and knowing he would never want to, Neel had built his own toxin puzzle.

hindi: अनुसरण सिद्धांत — ज्ञान को सत्य का सतत अनुसरण करने वाला विश्वास मानने का मत
definition: the theory that knowledge is true belief that tracks truth, meaning you would believe it if it were true and would drop it if it were false
example: Their cricket-mad uncle illustrated tracking theory perfectly: his belief about the score changed ball by ball with the live commentary.

hindi: ट्रैक्टेटस-संबंधी — विट्गेंस्टाइन के आरंभिक ग्रंथ 'ट्रैक्टेटस' के विचारों से जुड़ा
definition: relating to Wittgenstein's early book, the Tractatus, and its views that language pictures facts and that whatever cannot be stated clearly should be passed over in silence
example: Aman's Tractarian note to his roommates simply listed facts about the dishes and left the obvious conclusion unspoken.

hindi: छाप तर्क — मन में अनंत पूर्णता के विचार से ईश्वर के अस्तित्व का तर्क
definition: Descartes's argument that our idea of an infinite, perfect being could only have been placed in finite minds by such a being, like a maker's mark stamped on a product
example: In philosophy class, Kabir compared the trademark argument to finding a logo inside his brain and inferring the company exists.

hindi: पारंपरिक सत्ता — प्राचीन रीति और परंपरा की पवित्रता पर टिकी सत्ता
definition: Weber's type of legitimate authority that rests on respect for long-standing custom, so people obey because things have always been done this way
example: Grandma's traditional authority over the Diwali menu has never been written down, yet nobody dares question it.

hindi: परंपरावाद — प्राचीन परंपराओं और रीतियों को ज्ञान और अधिकार का स्रोत मानने का मत
definition: the view that inherited customs, religious practice and long tradition carry wisdom and authority that reason alone cannot replace
example: Rahul's traditionalism about Diwali meant real clay lamps only, and he treated the string lights as a personal insult.

hindi: साझा संसाधन की त्रासदी — स्वार्थवश हर व्यक्ति द्वारा साझी संपदा का अति-उपयोग कर उसे नष्ट कर देने की स्थिति
definition: the situation in which people sharing a common resource each take slightly more for themselves, until together they exhaust or destroy the resource for everyone
example: The office biscuit tin was a tragedy of the commons: everyone took two, and by Tuesday afternoon nobody had any.

hindi: अनुभवातीत तर्क — अनुभव की पूर्वशर्तों से निष्कर्ष निकालने वाला तर्क
definition: an argument that starts from some undeniable feature of experience and shows what must already be true for that experience to be possible at all
example: Karan offered a transcendental argument in the group chat: if anyone could read his message doubting language, language clearly worked.

hindi: अनुभवातीत निगमन — कांट का तर्क कि बुद्धि के प्रत्यय अनुभव पर वैध रूप से लागू होते हैं
definition: Kant's transcendental argument, meaning one about the conditions that make experience possible, showing why the mind's basic concepts, such as cause, must apply to every object we could experience
example: Nandini's transcendental deduction of her curfew went nowhere; her father simply cited experience.

hindi: अतीन्द्रिय अहं — वह शुद्ध चेतन स्व जो सारे अनुभवों का आधार है
definition: in Husserl's phenomenology, the pure conscious self that remains once you suspend belief in the outside world, the source that gives every experience its meaning
example: Lying awake at night, Siddharth wondered whether his transcendental ego also felt guilty about the unanswered emails.

hindi: अनुभवातीत प्रत्ययवाद — देश, काल और श्रेणियों को मन की देन मानने वाला कांट का मत
definition: Kant's view that space, time and the basic concepts of thought come from the mind itself, so humans know things only as they appear, never as they exist in themselves
example: After trying on blue-light glasses, Arjun announced that transcendental idealism was right: the mind always wears lenses you cannot take off.

hindi: अतीन्द्रिय विषय — प्रतीतियों के पीछे सोचा गया अज्ञात आधार
definition: Kant's term for the unknown something that the mind thinks of as lying behind appearances, the reality as it exists in itself, which it can never directly know
example: In the seminar, Priya compared the transcendental object to a delivery package: you know something is inside, but the tracking app only ever shows you updates.

hindi: पारलौकिक संकेतित — सभी अर्थों को स्थिर करने वाला अंतिम आधार
definition: Derrida's term for an imagined ultimate meaning, such as deity, reason or truth, that would anchor all other signs while needing no further explanation itself
example: In the staff meeting, 'customer value' was treated as the transcendental signified that ended every argument.

hindi: अतीन्द्रियवाद — इन्द्रिय-अनुभव से परे अंतर्ज्ञान और आत्मा को प्रधान मानने वाला दर्शन
definition: any philosophy that places intuition and the spiritual above sensory experience and material things, notably a nineteenth-century American movement that prized nature and self-reliance
example: Leaving her phone at home for a weekend of forest walks, Neha joked that she was trying out transcendentalism.

hindi: सर्वव्यापी गुण — सत्, एकता, सत्य और शुभ जैसे गुण जो हर सत्ता पर लागू होते हैं
definition: the properties that scholastic thinkers held belong to every being whatsoever, such as being, oneness, truth and goodness, cutting across every category
example: Aditya argued his lunch box shared the transcendentals with the stars, since it was real, single, genuine and, with paneer inside, extremely good.

hindi: बहिर्गामी — मन की ऐसी क्रिया जिसका असर मन से बाहर पड़े
definition: describing a mental action whose effects pass beyond the mind into the outside world, as opposed to one that stays within it
example: Deciding to text back was immanent, but actually hitting send made it transeunt, and now the whole group knows.

hindi: पारमानववाद — तकनीक द्वारा मानव शरीर और बुद्धि की सीमाओं को पार करने का समर्थन करने वाला मत
definition: the movement and philosophy that supports using technology to overcome human limits on intelligence, health and lifespan, and to improve human nature itself
example: Kiran's transhumanism so far amounted to a fitness tracker, two supplements and a very optimistic sleep app.

hindi: संक्रामकता — अ-ब और ब-स के संबंध से अ-स का संबंध निकलने का गुण
definition: in logic and mathematics, the property of a relation such that if it links the first thing to the second, and the second to the third, it also links the first to the third
example: Transitivity tells us that if Priya is taller than Sam and Sam is taller than Leo, then Priya is taller than Leo, no measuring tape needed.

hindi: अनुभव की पारदर्शिता — अनुभव पर ध्यान देने पर केवल वस्तुएँ ही दिखने का मत
definition: the claim that when you attend closely to your perceptual experience, you notice only the qualities of outside objects, never any separate inner qualities of the experience itself
example: Trying to describe the sunset for the group chat, Harsh found the transparency of experience annoying: every word was about the clouds, none about his seeing.

hindi: प्रत्यारोपण दुविधा — एक स्वस्थ व्यक्ति के अंगों से पाँच रोगियों को बचाने की नैतिक पहेली
definition: a thought experiment asking whether a surgeon should sacrifice one healthy visitor and use their organs to save five dying patients, testing whether saving more people always justifies killing
example: Dev defended pure number-counting until someone raised the transplant problem, and then he quietly decided to skip his next hospital check-up.

hindi: मूल्यों का पुनर्मूल्यांकन — पुराने नैतिक मूल्यों को उलटकर नए मूल्य रचने की नीत्शे की परियोजना
definition: Nietzsche's project of questioning and overturning inherited moral values, especially Christian ones, and creating fresh values that affirm life
example: Declaring naps a virtue and hustle a vice, Neel called his weekend plan a transvaluation of values.

hindi: अंतर्जगत अभेद — एक ही व्यक्ति का अनेक संभाव्य जगतों में विद्यमान होना
definition: the relation of one and the same individual existing in more than one possible world, which some philosophers accept and counterpart theorists reject
example: Ayaan asked whether the version of him who became a pilot shares transworld identity with him or is just a better-dressed stranger.

hindi: त्रिकाय — बुद्ध के तीन शरीरों का महायान सिद्धांत
definition: the Mahayana Buddhist doctrine that a Buddha has three bodies: the ultimate truth body, a radiant bliss body seen in visions, and the physical body that appears in history
example: Explaining trikaya to her cousin, Zara compared it to a musician who exists as a song, a live concert and a poster.

hindi: त्रिभागी आत्मा — आत्मा को बुद्धि, उत्साह और इच्छा में बाँटने वाला प्लेटो का मत
definition: Plato's theory that the soul has three parts, reason, spirit and appetite, and that a person is just when reason rules the other parts
example: Standing at the dessert counter while on a diet, Ananya felt every part of her tripartite soul arguing at once.

hindi: त्रिवर्ग — धर्म, अर्थ और काम, जीवन के तीन सांसारिक लक्ष्य
definition: the three worldly aims of human life in Hindu thought, namely dharma (right conduct), artha (wealth) and kama (pleasure), pursued in proper balance
example: Kabir's budget spreadsheet was a modern trivarga: one column for charity, one for savings and one, suspiciously large, for biryani.

hindi: सर्वसत्यवाद — हर कथन के सत्य होने का चरम मत
definition: the extreme view that every statement whatsoever is true, including every contradiction, usually discussed as the position that paraconsistent logic, which tolerates contradictions, tries to avoid
example: When her brother agreed with every side of the family argument at once, Anu accused him of trivialism.

hindi: ट्रॉली दुविधा — पाँच को बचाने के लिए एक की बलि देने के औचित्य पर नैतिक प्रश्न
definition: a thought experiment asking whether you should pull a lever to divert a runaway tram, sacrificing one person on a side track to save five people ahead
example: When the office printer could jam either the intern's single page or the manager's five-page report, Tanvi called it the trolley problem of Monday mornings.

hindi: विशिष्ट गुण — किसी एक वस्तु में स्थित गुण का अनोखा, दोहराया न जा सकने वाला उदाहरण
definition: a particular instance of a quality found in exactly one thing, like the specific roundness of this coin, which no other object can share
example: Mira told the group chat that her cat's softness was a trope all its own, and that the neighbour's cat merely had a different, inferior softness.

hindi: विशिष्ट-गुणवाद — गुणों को साझा सामान्य नहीं, हर वस्तु के अपने अलग गुण-उदाहरण मानने का मत
definition: the view that properties are particular instances belonging to single things, so the whiteness of this teacup is distinct from the whiteness of that teacup, rather than shared universals
example: Defending trope theory over office chai, Nikhil claimed the whiteness of his mug and the whiteness of his manager's mug were separate items, and so was the credit for the report.

hindi: सत्य-शर्तें — वे परिस्थितियाँ जिनमें कोई वाक्य सत्य होगा
definition: the circumstances in the world that would have to hold for a particular sentence to be true, which many theories treat as the core of that sentence's meaning
example: The truth conditions for 'the kitchen is clean' were fiercely contested between the flatmate who wiped the counter and the flatmate who looked in the sink.

hindi: अर्थ-आश्रित सत्य — ऐसा सत्य जो केवल शब्दों के अर्थ के कारण सत्य हो
definition: the idea that some statements are true purely because of what their words mean, so their truth needs no evidence from the world
example: Asked to justify 'squares have four sides', Arjun called it truth in virtue of meaning and returned to his chai.

hindi: सत्य-सारणी — किसी यौगिक कथन के सभी संभव सत्य-मानों को दिखाने वाली तालिका
definition: a grid that lists every possible combination of true and false for the simple statements in a formula and shows the resulting value of the whole
example: Before agreeing to the chore rota, Nikhil drew a truth table on the fridge whiteboard to check every loophole.

hindi: सत्य-मान — किसी कथन का 'सत्य' या 'असत्य' होना
definition: the status a statement has of being true or being false, which classical logic treats as the only possible values a statement can take
example: Aryan's claim that he had 'basically finished' the essay had a truth value his teacher could settle in seconds.

hindi: सत्य-शर्त अर्थविज्ञान — यह मत कि वाक्य का अर्थ उसकी सत्यता की शर्तें जानना है
definition: the approach to meaning that explains what a sentence means by stating the conditions under which it would be true, so understanding a sentence means knowing how the world must be
example: Applying truth-conditional semantics, Leena noted that 'I'll be ready in two minutes' had never once been true in her brother's history.

hindi: सत्य-फलनात्मक — जिसका सत्य-मान केवल घटक कथनों के सत्य-मानों से तय हो
definition: describing a connective (a joining word like 'and' or 'or') or compound statement whose truth value depends entirely on the truth values of its component statements
example: Sana explained that 'because' is not truth-functional: 'I'm late because of traffic' can be false even when both halves are true.

hindi: सत्य-मूल्य रिक्ति — किसी कथन का न सत्य, न असत्य होना
definition: the situation in which a statement has no truth value at all, being neither true nor false, as some claim for vague statements or statements about nonexistent things
example: Asked whether her imaginary pet was friendly, Sia explained it was a truth-value gap and changed the subject.

hindi: सत्य-मूल्य अतिरेक — किसी कथन का सत्य और असत्य दोनों होना
definition: the situation in which a statement is held to be both true and false at once, a possibility accepted by some paraconsistent logics, which are logics built to tolerate contradictions
example: Arnav's team labelled the project status a truth-value glut, since the boss swore it was finished while the client swore it had barely started.

hindi: तथ्य-सत्य — आकस्मिक सत्य जिनका निषेध संभव और विरोध-रहित हो
definition: in Leibniz's account, contingent truths, which happen to hold but could have been otherwise, whose denial involves no contradiction and which are known through experience
example: That the canteen serves rajma on Mondays is one of the truths of fact, and Pooja confirms it every week.

hindi: बुद्धि-सत्य — अनिवार्य सत्य जिनका निषेध स्व-विरोधी हो
definition: in Leibniz's account, necessary truths, which could not possibly have been otherwise, whose denial involves a contradiction and which are knowable by reasoning without any appeal to experience
example: Sameer filed 'two plus two makes four' under truths of reason and 'the printer works' under wishful thinking.

hindi: प्रत्यारोप दोष — आलोचना का उत्तर देने के बजाय आलोचक पर वही आरोप लौटा देना
definition: the fallacy of rejecting a criticism by pointing out that the critic behaves the same way, rather than answering whether the criticism itself is correct
example: When his sister told him to stop scrolling at dinner, Rohan tried a tu quoque: you checked your phone twice during the soup.

hindi: ट्यूरिंग परीक्षण — बातचीत में मनुष्य से अलग न पहचाने जाने को बुद्धि की कसौटी मानने वाला परीक्षण
definition: Alan Turing's proposed test for machine intelligence, in which a judge chats by text with a hidden human and a hidden machine and tries to tell which is which
example: After a customer-service chat full of cheerful non-answers, Pooja said the bot had failed the Turing test, though so had several of her colleagues.

hindi: तुरीय — जाग्रत, स्वप्न और सुषुप्ति से परे चौथी अवस्था
definition: the fourth state of consciousness described in the Mandukya Upanishad, pure awareness underlying and beyond waking, dreaming and dreamless sleep
example: Staring blankly during the budget meeting, Farah insisted she was not asleep but resting in turiya.

hindi: द्वादश निदान — जन्म-मरण के चक्र को चलाने वाली बारह कड़ियाँ
definition: the Buddhist chain of twelve linked causes, from ignorance through craving to birth, ageing and death, that explains how suffering and rebirth keep arising
example: Sketching the twelve nidanas on the whiteboard, Tara noticed the chain looked a lot like her procrastination routine.

hindi: जुड़वाँ पृथ्वी — बाहरी जगत के अर्थ पर प्रभाव को दिखाने वाला पुटनम का विचार-प्रयोग
definition: Hilary Putnam's thought experiment imagining a planet identical to ours except that its watery liquid has a different chemical makeup, used to argue that meaning depends on the environment
example: In the canteen, Hamid invoked Twin Earth to argue that the chai on a copy of Earth might taste identical and still not be chai.

hindi: दो लिफ़ाफ़ों की समस्या — लिफ़ाफ़ा बदलना सदा लाभदायक लगने की उलझन
definition: a puzzle in which one envelope holds twice the money of another, and simple reasoning wrongly suggests you should always switch whichever envelope you hold
example: Given two gift cards at the office party, Rahul kept swapping them, trapped inside the two envelopes problem.

hindi: दो हत्थे — पुरस्कार और दंड से नियंत्रण की नीति
definition: the Legalist teaching that a ruler controls subjects through a pair of tools, reward and punishment, and must never allow officials to take hold of either
example: With a gold star chart and a no-screen threat, Mrs Kapoor ran her classroom by the two handles.

hindi: सत्यद्वय — संवृति सत्य और परमार्थ सत्य का बौद्ध सिद्धांत
definition: the Buddhist teaching that reality can be described at two levels: a conventional truth for everyday talk about persons and things, and an ultimate truth about how things really are
example: Using the two truths doctrine, Varun explained that the table was real for dinner but empty for metaphysics.

hindi: द्विस्तरीय उपयोगितावाद — रोज़मर्रा में सरल नियम और कठिन प्रसंगों में सुख की गणना का मत
definition: the utilitarian view that people should follow simple, trusted moral rules in everyday life, and calculate total happiness directly only in rare, unusual or conflicting situations
example: Kabir practises two-level utilitarianism: he never lies to his friends, except the time he calculated that a fake emergency would save the surprise party.

hindi: यदृच्छावाद — प्रकृति में वास्तविक संयोग के अस्तित्व का मत
definition: Peirce's doctrine that genuine chance is a real feature of the universe, so that natural laws are not perfectly exact and themselves evolve
example: When his experiment gave a slightly different reading every single time, Kabir half-seriously blamed tychism rather than his wobbly lab bench.

hindi: प्रकार तादात्म्य सिद्धांत — हर प्रकार की मानसिक अवस्था को एक प्रकार की मस्तिष्क-अवस्था मानने का मत
definition: the version of identity theory holding that each kind of mental state, such as pain in general, is identical with one particular kind of brain state, wherever it occurs
example: Kavya said type identity theory would make her dog's hunger and her own hunger the same brain state, which explained why they both stared at the fridge.

hindi: प्रकार-भौतिकवाद — हर प्रकार की मानसिक अवस्था एक विशेष प्रकार की मस्तिष्क-अवस्था है, ऐसा मत
definition: the physicalist view that every type of mental state, such as pain in general, is identical to one specific type of physical brain state
example: In the staff room, the science teacher defended type physicalism: every Monday dread, she said, would show the same pattern on a brain scan.

hindi: बहुमत का अत्याचार — बहुसंख्या द्वारा अल्पसंख्यकों और व्यक्ति की स्वतंत्रता का दमन
definition: the danger, stressed by Mill and Tocqueville, that majority opinion and social pressure crush individual liberty and minority views
example: When eleven flatmates outvoted the one vegetarian on the dinner menu, she protested the tyranny of the majority.

hindi: सदक़ा — यहूदी परंपरा में ज़रूरतमंद को देना, जिसे दया नहीं बल्कि न्याय का कर्तव्य माना जाता है
definition: the Jewish obligation to give to people in need, understood not as optional kindness but as a duty of righteousness and justice
example: Every Friday, Noa's family filled a small tin for tzedakah, and her little brother kept asking whether coins found under the sofa counted.

hindi: त्सिम्त्सुम — सृष्टि हेतु ईश्वर का स्वयं को संकुचित करना
definition: the Kabbalistic doctrine that the infinite divine contracted or withdrew itself to make space in which a finite world could exist
example: When his mother cleared half the wardrobe so he could move back home, Daniel called it an act of tzimtzum.

hindi: उबुन्तु — दूसरों के साथ संबंधों से ही मनुष्यता बनने का अफ़्रीकी दर्शन
definition: the southern African ethical idea that a person becomes a person through other people, so that humanity is found in compassion, sharing and community
example: When the whole class stayed late to help Thabo finish his project, their teacher said that was ubuntu in action.

hindi: उजामा — परिवार जैसे सामूहिक जीवन पर आधारित न्येरेरे का अफ़्रीकी समाजवाद
definition: Julius Nyerere's idea of African socialism, modelled on the extended family, in which villagers share work and resources for the common good
example: When the flatmates pooled money for groceries and rotated cooking, Baraka declared the kitchen an Ujamaa village.

hindi: सत्ता-काल — दोगेन की ज़ेन धारणा कि अस्तित्व और समय अभिन्न हैं
definition: the Japanese Buddhist teaching of Dogen that being and time are inseparable, so every existing thing simply is its moment of time
example: Sitting quietly through a delayed flight, Mariko said uji meant she was not waiting for time; she was the time.

hindi: परम उत्तरदायित्व — कर्म के मूल स्रोत का स्वयं व्यक्ति होने की शर्त
definition: the demanding condition that a person is fully responsible for a choice only if they are themselves the original source of the character behind it
example: Yash argued nobody has ultimate responsibility for liking spicy food, since his grandmother shaped his palate long before he could choose.

hindi: परमार्थ सत्य — वस्तुओं की वास्तविक, अंतिम प्रकृति
definition: in Buddhist philosophy, truth about how things really are beneath everyday labels, often described as their emptiness of any fixed, independent essence
example: During the late-night study session, Aarav swore he had reached ultimate truth, though it looked a lot like exhaustion.

hindi: अति-सान्तवाद — अत्यंत बड़ी, व्यवहार में अप्राप्य संख्याओं के अस्तित्व पर भी संदेह करने का मत
definition: an extreme form of finitism doubting that even very large finite numbers, such as those too large to write down or compute, genuinely exist
example: Seeing the price of a Mumbai flat, Aditi flirted with ultrafinitism, suspecting that numbers so large could not really exist.

hindi: सर्वसम्मतिवाद — किसी समूह के सभी सदस्यों को एक ही दर्शन का मानने की भ्रांति
definition: Paulin Hountondji's critical term for the assumption that everyone in a culture shares one single philosophy, which he saw as the central flaw of ethnophilosophy
example: When the survey claimed that all teenagers think alike, Amara objected that it was unanimism with a pie chart.

hindi: अनिर्णेयता — अर्थ का दो विरोधी पाठों के बीच झूलते रहना
definition: Derrida's term for the condition of a text or concept that cannot be settled into one meaning, since it supports opposing readings equally
example: The manager's email ending 'great work, as always' hovered in undecidability between praise and sarcasm.

hindi: आधार-खंडक निरसक — विश्वास के कारण की विश्वसनीयता पर प्रश्न उठाने वाला निरसक
definition: a defeater that attacks the connection between your reason and your belief, showing the reason is unreliable without proving the belief false
example: Learning the shop's scale was broken served as an undercutting defeater for Rohit's pride in losing two kilos.

hindi: अल्पनिर्धारण — उपलब्ध प्रमाण का प्रतिद्वंद्वी सिद्धांतों में निर्णय न कर पाना
definition: the view that available evidence can fail to settle which of several rival theories is correct, because each theory fits that evidence equally well
example: The missing charger was a case of underdetermination: the evidence fitted the cat theory and the brother theory equally well.

hindi: अमिथ्याकरणीय — जिसे किसी भी संभव प्रेक्षण से गलत सिद्ध न किया जा सके
definition: describing a claim framed so loosely that no possible observation or experiment could ever show it to be false
example: Whenever the team lost, Kabir said the jersey's luck was merely resting, which made his superstition perfectly unfalsifiable.

hindi: दुःखी चेतना — स्वयं को नश्वर और अनंत के बीच बँटा पाने वाली चेतना
definition: Hegel's term for a divided mind that feels itself torn between its changeable earthly self and an unreachable, unchanging ideal it places beyond itself
example: Scrolling through fitness influencers at midnight while eating chips, Ronit recognised his unhappy consciousness in full.

hindi: प्रकृति-एकरूपता — यह मान्यता कि प्रकृति के नियम समय और स्थान में एक-से रहते हैं
definition: the assumption that nature follows the same regularities everywhere and always, so that unobserved cases will resemble observed ones; inductive reasoning seems to depend upon it
example: Boiling water for chai each morning, Priya quietly bets on the uniformity of nature and has never once lost.

hindi: एकपक्षवाद — दूसरे देशों से सलाह लिए बिना विदेश नीति चलाने का मत
definition: the political stance that a nation should handle its foreign affairs alone, without consulting or relying on other countries
example: The flatmate who repainted the kitchen orange without asking anyone was practising pure unilateralism.

hindi: रहस्यमय एकता — आत्मा और ईश्वर के एक होने का अनुभव
definition: a Latin phrase meaning 'mystical union', naming the experience in which the soul feels joined or merged with the divine
example: Their teacher explained unio mystica using a drop of milk vanishing into chai, which made everyone thirsty.

hindi: एकत्व-मत — प्रेम को दो व्यक्तियों के एक साझा 'हम' में घुल जाने के रूप में देखना
definition: the view that love consists in lovers forming a shared identity, a single 'we' whose interests, choices and wellbeing each partner treats as their own
example: After Tara started saying 'we hate coriander' on her partner's behalf, her friend teased that she had fully signed up to the union view.

hindi: अद्वितीयता-सिद्धांत — एक साक्ष्य-समूह से केवल एक ही उचित निष्कर्ष निकलने का मत
definition: the view that any given body of evidence supports exactly a single rational attitude toward a claim, so people sharing identical evidence cannot both be reasonable while disagreeing
example: Accepting the uniqueness thesis, the quiz team concluded that one of them had to be misreading the clue, since both had identical information.

hindi: चयन की इकाइयाँ — यह प्रश्न कि प्राकृतिक चयन जीन, जीव या समूह किस पर कार्य करता है
definition: the debate over what natural selection actually acts upon, whether genes, individual organisms, groups or whole species
example: The biology tutorial on units of selection ended with everyone asking whether the class, or just its best student, would survive exams.

hindi: विविधता में एकता — अनेक भिन्न अंशों के बीच सामंजस्य को सौंदर्य का आधार मानने का सिद्धांत
definition: the classic principle that beauty arises when many different parts or elements are held together in a single harmonious order
example: Surveying the potluck table of mismatched dishes, Ananya declared it a triumph of unity in variety, united mainly by extra chillies.

hindi: आत्मबोध की अनुभवातीत एकता — सब अनुभवों को एक चेतना में बाँधने वाला 'मैं सोचता हूँ'
definition: Kant's idea that every experience must belong to a single self-aware subject, the thinking self that ties separate perceptions together into one consciousness
example: After a sleepless night, Neel doubted his unity of apperception, because the person who started the essay and the person finishing it felt like strangers.

hindi: चेतना की एकता — अनेक अनुभव एक ही चेतन विषय में एक साथ जुड़े हुए प्रकट होते हैं
definition: the feature of experience by which sights, sounds, thoughts and feelings present themselves together as belonging to a single conscious subject
example: Hearing the kettle, smelling toast and reading messages all at once, Ria felt the unity of consciousness hold her chaotic morning together.

hindi: स्वर्ग-मानव एकता — मनुष्य और ब्रह्मांड की मूल एकता का मत
definition: the Chinese view that human beings and Heaven, meaning nature and the cosmic moral order, form a single whole, so that living well means living in harmony with it
example: Timing her morning walk to the sunrise, Gauri felt a small taste of the unity of heaven and humanity.

hindi: ज्ञान-कर्म एकता — सच्चा ज्ञान वही जो कर्म में उतरे
definition: the Neo-Confucian teaching that true moral knowledge and action cannot be separated: if you really know what is good, you will actually carry it out
example: Her flatmate knew recycling mattered yet binned the bottles, so Ananya lectured her on the unity of knowledge and action.

hindi: विरोधी-एकता — परस्पर विरोधी वस्तुओं के एक ही सत्य के अंग होने का सिद्धांत
definition: Heraclitus's idea that opposites such as night and daylight, hunger and fullness, depend on each other and together form a single whole
example: After sweating through the gym only to sleep better, Zoya finally understood the unity of opposites: exhaustion was how she got her energy back.

hindi: विज्ञान की एकता — सभी विज्ञानों को एक साझा भाषा और पद्धति में जोड़ने का आदर्श
definition: the ideal, promoted by the Vienna Circle, that all the sciences share one common language and method, so that biology, psychology and economics could ultimately connect with physics
example: Ananya argued for the unity of science at dinner, claiming her chemistry homework and her brother's economics essay were secretly the same subject.

hindi: सद्गुणों की एकता — यह मत कि किसी एक सद्गुण के लिए सभी सद्गुण आवश्यक हैं
definition: the view that the virtues are linked so closely that you cannot fully possess any single virtue without possessing all of them together
example: Kiran tested the unity of the virtues by asking whether his brave but rude cousin could really count as courageous.

hindi: सार्वभौमिक सामान्यीकरण — मनमानी वस्तु के लिए सिद्ध बात को सभी वस्तुओं पर लागू करना
definition: the inference rule that a claim proved about an arbitrary object, chosen with no special features, may be concluded about every object
example: Maths class accepted universal generalization for Tanya's proof about any triangle, but not her conclusion that every Monday is cursed.

hindi: सार्वभौमिक दृष्टांतीकरण — 'सभी के लिए सत्य' से किसी विशेष वस्तु के लिए सत्य निकालना
definition: the inference rule that from a claim about every object in the range being discussed you may conclude the same claim about any particular object
example: 'Every employee gets a birthday cake,' read the policy, and by universal instantiation Vikram marched to reception demanding his.

hindi: सार्वभौम आदेशवाद — नैतिक कथनों को सभी समान स्थितियों पर लागू होने वाले आदेश मानने का मत
definition: Hare's view that moral judgements are commands or recommendations that the speaker must be willing to apply to every relevantly similar situation, including their own
example: Universal prescriptivism caught Aman out: if nobody should borrow his charger without asking, then neither should he borrow his roommate's.

hindi: सार्वभौमिक परिमाणक — 'सभी' या 'प्रत्येक' का तर्कशास्त्रीय चिह्न
definition: the logical symbol, usually written as an upside-down capital letter, that claims something holds for every single object in the range being discussed
example: When Sameer texted 'everyone loves my playlist', his sister replied that one skipped track was enough to sink his universal quantifier.

hindi: वस्तुपूर्व सामान्य — सामान्यों को वस्तुओं से पहले और स्वतंत्र मानने का मत
definition: Latin for universals before the thing, the medieval label for the view that universals exist prior to and independently of particular things
example: Kabir claimed the idea of the perfect weekend existed universalia ante rem, since no actual weekend had ever lived up to it.

hindi: वस्तुगत सामान्य — सामान्यों को केवल वस्तुओं के भीतर विद्यमान मानने का मत
definition: Latin for universals in the thing, the medieval label for the view that universals exist only within the particular things that have them
example: Biting into every mango in the crate, Saira insisted sweetness existed universalia in re, and she was simply collecting evidence.

hindi: वस्तु-पश्चात सामान्य — सामान्यों को वस्तुओं को देखकर बनाई गई मन की धारणा मानने का मत
definition: Latin for universals after the thing, the medieval label for the view that universals are concepts the mind forms after observing particular things
example: After meeting five strict landlords, Harsh formed his notion of landlordhood universalia post rem, and no amount of evidence would change it.

hindi: सार्वभौम सुखवाद — केवल अपना नहीं, सबका सुख अधिकतम करने का सिजविक का मत
definition: Sidgwick's name for the view that each person should strive toward the greatest pleasure of everyone, rather than only their own personal pleasure
example: When Arjun shared his umbrella with three strangers at the bus stop, his sister called it universalistic hedonism with wet shoulders.

hindi: सार्वभौमीकरणीयता — किसी नैतिक नियम को बिना विरोधाभास सब पर लागू कर सकने का गुण
definition: the feature a moral rule has when it could consistently apply to everyone in similar circumstances, a central test in Kantian ethics
example: Rahul's plan to borrow chargers and never return them collapsed on universalizability: if everyone did it, nobody would lend a charger again.

hindi: सामान्य — अनेक वस्तुओं में एक साथ विद्यमान साझा गुण या प्रकार
definition: qualities or kinds, such as redness or being a triangle, that many separate things can share at once, wholly present in each
example: In the art room, Tara wondered whether universals were real, since every scarlet marker on the table seemed to share exactly the same redness.

hindi: सत् की एकार्थता — 'है' शब्द का सब वस्तुओं के लिए एक ही अर्थ होना
definition: the view, defended by Duns Scotus, that the word being has exactly the same meaning whether applied to the divine, humans or pebbles
example: Invoking the univocity of being, Naina said her cat and her professor existed in precisely the same sense.

hindi: अचल प्रवर्तक — स्वयं अचल रहकर समस्त गति का मूल कारण बनने वाली सत्ता
definition: Aristotle's idea of an eternal, unchanging being that causes all motion in the universe without itself being moved, drawing things toward it as a goal
example: Sitting perfectly still on the sofa while everyone else cleaned, Grandpa called himself the household's unmoved mover.

hindi: उपाधि — वह सीमित करने वाली शर्त जो असीम को सीमित दिखाती है
definition: a limiting adjunct, a condition like a body or mind that makes the unlimited self seem limited, as a clay vessel seems to enclose open space
example: Tara joked that her tiny cubicle was just an upadhi, and that her creative spirit remained as vast as ever.

hindi: उपमान — समानता या तुलना के आधार पर प्राप्त ज्ञान
definition: in Indian philosophy, comparison or analogy, the source of valid knowledge by which you recognise something unfamiliar through its likeness to something described
example: Told that a kumquat looks like a tiny orange, Jay spotted one at the market by upamana alone.

hindi: उपनिषद् — वेदों के अंतिम दार्शनिक ग्रंथ जिनमें आत्मा और ब्रह्म का विचार है
definition: any of the ancient Sanskrit texts forming the final part of the Vedas, which explore Brahman, the self and liberation through dialogue and teaching
example: Meera's book club finished an Upanishad in one evening and then argued until midnight about a single verse.

hindi: उपाय-कौशल — श्रोता के अनुरूप शिक्षा देने की कुशल विधि
definition: the Mahayana Buddhist idea of skilful means, teaching the same truth in different ways depending on what each listener can understand
example: Explaining fractions with pizza slices to her little brother, Mansi was practising upaya.

hindi: ग्रहण — श्रोता द्वारा कथन के अभिप्राय को समझ लेना
definition: the listener's recognition of what kind of utterance a speaker intended, whether warning, promise or request, which many theorists treat as needed for that utterance to succeed
example: Rhea's sarcastic "great idea" got no uptake, and her team cheerfully booked the karaoke night.

hindi: प्रयोग-सिद्धांत — यह मत कि शब्द का अर्थ भाषा में उसके प्रयोग से बनता है
definition: the view, associated with the later Wittgenstein, that the meaning of a word lies in the ways speakers actually employ it within shared social activities, rather than in objects or mental images
example: By the use theory of meaning, 'literally' in Kiara's group chat now means 'extremely', whatever the dictionary claims.

hindi: उपयोग-मूल्य — किसी वस्तु की वह उपयोगिता जो मानवीय आवश्यकता पूरी करती है
definition: the usefulness of a thing in meeting a human need, as distinct from the price it can fetch when exchanged on a market
example: The broken umbrella had zero exchange value, but its use value returned every time the monsoon caught Sameer without another.

hindi: प्रयोग-उल्लेख भेद — शब्द से किसी वस्तु की बात करने और स्वयं शब्द की बात करने का भेद
definition: the distinction between employing a word to talk about something, as in 'cats purr', and talking about the word itself, as in 'cats has four letters', usually marked with quotation marks
example: When the teacher wrote 'bored' has five letters on the board, the class learned the use-mention distinction and felt both at once.

hindi: उपयोगितावाद — अधिकतम लोगों के अधिकतम सुख को नैतिक कसौटी मानने का मत
definition: the view that the right action is whichever choice produces the greatest total happiness for the greatest number of people
example: Ordering the pizza everyone could tolerate instead of the one Arjun loved was pure utilitarianism, and Arjun sulked all evening.

hindi: उपयोगिता — किसी वस्तु या कर्म से मिलने वाला सुख, कल्याण या इच्छा-पूर्ति
definition: in utilitarian ethics, the happiness, wellbeing or preference satisfaction that an action or outcome produces, treated as the quantity morality should increase
example: Kiran measured the utility of the new coffee machine by how many colleagues stopped complaining before ten o'clock.

hindi: उपयोगिता-दानव — अपार सुख भोगने वाले काल्पनिक प्राणी द्वारा उपयोगितावाद की आलोचना
definition: Robert Nozick's imagined creature that gains vastly more pleasure from every resource than anyone else, used to show that maximising total happiness could demand giving everything to one being
example: Zara's little brother claimed every biscuit in the house because he enjoyed them most, a textbook utility monster in school shorts.

hindi: कल्पनालोकी समाजवाद — नैतिक आदर्शों के आधार पर आदर्श समुदाय रचने वाला प्रारंभिक समाजवाद
definition: the early socialism of thinkers such as Owen and Fourier, who designed ideal cooperative communities from moral principles, a label later used critically by Marx and Engels
example: Their plan for a shared flat with a rota for everything was utopian socialism, Simran warned, until someone left dishes.

hindi: उत्तर मीमांसा — वेदान्त का दूसरा नाम, वेदों के ज्ञान-भाग की विवेचना
definition: another name for Vedanta, meaning later inquiry, because it studies the final, knowledge-focused portions of the Vedas rather than their ritual portions
example: Dev explained that Uttara Mimamsa was the later inquiry, which he felt described his habit of studying only the night before exams.

hindi: वाद — सत्य जानने के लिए की जाने वाली निष्पक्ष चर्चा
definition: in Nyaya philosophy, honest debate, a discussion between partners who share the goal of finding truth rather than of winning
example: The family's dinner discussion about moving cities stayed a proper vada until someone brought up who never washes dishes.

hindi: अस्पष्ट अभिन्नता — दो वस्तुओं के एक होने या न होने का अनिश्चित रहना
