definition: the idea that it might be genuinely indefinite whether something is identical to something else, a possibility argued against by Gareth Evans
example: Whether the rewritten essay was still her original draft seemed a matter of vague identity, Ruhi told her teacher, hoping for an extension.

hindi: अस्पष्टता — शब्दों की ऐसी स्थिति जिसमें उनके लागू होने की सीमा धुंधली हो
definition: the feature of words such as 'tall', 'heap' or 'bald' whose boundaries are blurry, leaving borderline cases where they neither clearly apply nor clearly fail
example: When the recipe said 'a pinch of salt', Arnav blamed vagueness for the soup that tasted like seawater.

hindi: वैभाषिक — बाह्य वस्तुओं के सीधे प्रत्यक्ष को मानने वाला बौद्ध संप्रदाय
definition: a Buddhist school holding that outside objects are real and are perceived directly by the senses, without an intermediate mental image standing between perceiver and object
example: Refusing to believe the photo filter, Tenzin took a Vaibhashika line and insisted on meeting the new puppy in person.

hindi: वैराग्य — विषयों के प्रति आसक्ति का त्याग, अनासक्ति
definition: in Yoga philosophy, dispassion or detachment, the steady release of craving for pleasures, which together with regular practice calms the mind
example: Walking past the dessert counter without stopping, Leela congratulated herself on her vairagya, then went back for one gulab jamun.

hindi: वैशेषिक — पदार्थों और परमाणुओं पर आधारित भारतीय दर्शन
definition: the classical Indian school of natural philosophy that sorts reality into basic categories and explains physical things as combinations of eternal atoms
example: Labelling every jar in the kitchen by kind and quality, Shreya joked that her spice rack had become Vaisheshika in miniature.

hindi: वज्रयान — मंत्र, ध्यान और गुरु-दीक्षा वाली बौद्ध परंपरा
definition: the Buddhist tradition, strongest in Tibet and the Himalayas, that adds ritual, mantra, visualisation and teacher-guided practice to the Mahayana path as a faster route to awakening
example: After a documentary on Tibetan monasteries, Aisha spent the evening reading about Vajrayana ritual.

hindi: वैधता — तर्क का वह गुण जिसमें आधार-वाक्य सत्य हों तो निष्कर्ष भी अनिवार्यतः सत्य हो
definition: the property of an argument whose conclusion must be true whenever its premises are true, because the conclusion follows from them by logical form alone
example: Priya pointed out that her brother's argument had perfect validity; the trouble was that his premise about owning the remote was pure fiction.

hindi: मूल्य-संवेदी अभिकल्पना — तकनीक की रचना में शुरू से ही निजता, न्याय जैसे मानवीय मूल्य गढ़ना
definition: an approach to engineering that deliberately builds human values such as privacy, fairness and autonomy, meaning self-direction, into technology from the earliest design stage
example: Practising value-sensitive design, the startup team asked on day one whether their fitness tracker should share location data at all.

hindi: वानप्रस्थ — गृहस्थ जीवन से धीरे-धीरे अलग होने की अवस्था
definition: the third stage of life in Hindu thought, when a person gradually withdraws from household duties toward reflection and spiritual practice
example: Grandpa handed over the family accounts and took up morning walks, calling it vanaprastha with a pension.

hindi: अग्रदलवाद — एक अनुशासित क्रांतिकारी दल द्वारा श्रमिक वर्ग का नेतृत्व करने का सिद्धांत
definition: the doctrine, associated with Lenin, that a disciplined party of committed revolutionaries must lead the working class, which cannot reach revolutionary awareness by itself
example: When three friends decided alone where the whole group would holiday, Nisha accused them of vanguardism.

hindi: वर्णाश्रम धर्म — वर्ण और आश्रम के अनुसार निर्धारित कर्तव्य
definition: the classical Hindu scheme assigning duties according to social class (varna) and stage of life (ashrama), much debated and criticised by later reformers
example: In history class, the students compared varnashrama dharma with modern job descriptions and argued about which one was fairer.

hindi: वासना — पुराने अनुभवों से बनी सूक्ष्म प्रवृत्तियाँ
definition: a lingering tendency or desire left in the mind by past experiences and actions, shaping future choices and cravings
example: Every time he passed the bakery, Aman felt an old vasana steering his feet toward the samosas.

hindi: वेदान्त — उपनिषदों पर आधारित ब्रह्म-विचार का दर्शन
definition: the family of Indian philosophical schools that interpret the Upanishads to understand Brahman, the ultimate reality, and its relation to the individual self
example: Their philosophy teacher introduced Vedanta by asking the class who, exactly, was doing the yawning.

hindi: अज्ञान का पर्दा — अपनी सामाजिक स्थिति जाने बिना न्याय के नियम चुनने की कल्पना
definition: Rawls's thought experiment of choosing society's rules while ignorant of your own class, talents, gender, religion or future place, so personal bias cannot shape your choice
example: Before splitting the inheritance, Dev asked his siblings to decide the rules behind a veil of ignorance, which lasted until someone remembered who wanted the piano.

hindi: माया का आवरण — शोपेनहावर द्वारा उपनिषदों से लिया गया, अलग-अलग चीज़ों के भ्रम का रूपक
definition: Schopenhauer's phrase, borrowed from Indian thought, for the illusion that the world consists of separate individuals, hiding the single will beneath them all
example: Seeing a stranger cry on the metro and feeling the pain himself, Kabir sensed the veil of Maya slipping for a moment.

hindi: प्रत्यक्ष का परदा — मानसिक प्रत्यय हमें बाहरी जगत से अलग करते हैं, यह आपत्ति
definition: the worry that if perceivers only access mental ideas, those ideas form a screen hiding the external world, making knowledge of it doubtful
example: Staring at the fogged bathroom mirror, Omar announced that he now truly understood the veil of perception.

hindi: सत्य-अनुरूप विभ्रम — ऐसा विभ्रम जो संयोगवश वास्तविक स्थिति से मेल खाए
definition: a hallucination that happens to match how the world really is, as when you hallucinate a clock on the wall where there actually is such a clock, used to test theories of perception
example: Half asleep, Pooja imagined the doorbell ringing just as the courier pressed it, a veridical hallucination that still got her parcel delivered.

hindi: सत्यवत विरोधाभास — विचित्र लगकर भी सत्य निकलने वाला निष्कर्ष
definition: a paradox whose strange-sounding conclusion turns out to be genuinely true once the reasoning is carefully checked
example: Learning that a twenty-three-person classroom likely shares a birthday, Omkar called it a veridical paradox.

hindi: सत्यापन सिद्धांत — जो कथन अनुभव से जाँचा न जा सके वह अर्थहीन है, यह नियम
definition: the central rule of logical positivism: a statement that is neither true by definition nor checkable through observation or experience is literally meaningless
example: Applying the verification principle to her horoscope, Nisha decided that 'a mysterious energy surrounds you' could never be checked, and therefore said nothing at all.

hindi: सत्यापनवाद — किसी कथन का अर्थ उसके सत्यापन की विधि में ही मानने का मत
definition: the view that a statement is meaningful only if some observation or experience could, at least in principle, check whether it is true, and that its meaning lies in that method of checking
example: Arjun used verificationism to shut down the group chat debate about whether his cat secretly judges him: no possible observation could settle it.

hindi: सत्यसमीपता — किसी सिद्धांत का सत्य के कितना निकट होना
definition: the degree to which a theory approaches the truth, a notion Popper used to explain how one false theory can still be better than another
example: Parth defended his wrong quiz answer on grounds of verisimilitude: it was at least closer than everyone else's.

hindi: बोध — मानवीय कार्यों को भीतर से, उनके अर्थ के माध्यम से समझना
definition: the German term, used by Dilthey and Weber, for understanding human actions from within by grasping their meaning, rather than explaining them like natural events
example: To grasp why her colleague hoarded pens, Bina tried Verstehen instead of simply calling it weird.

hindi: उत्कर्ष-मार्ग — ईश्वर में अच्छे गुणों को सर्वोच्च रूप में मानने का रास्ता
definition: a Latin phrase meaning 'the path of eminence', the method of describing the divine by taking good human qualities and raising them beyond every limit
example: Using via eminentiae, Ishaan described his grandmother's cooking as his mother's cooking raised to infinity.

hindi: नवीन मार्ग — ऑकम से प्रेरित उत्तर-मध्ययुगीन नामवादी पद्धति
definition: the modern path of late medieval universities, following Ockham's nominalism, meaning the denial of real universals, in contrast to the older path of Aquinas and Scotus
example: When the teachers split over new grading software, Sameer called the younger faction the via moderna of the staff room.

hindi: नेति मार्ग — ईश्वर को यह बताकर समझना कि वह क्या नहीं है
definition: the approach to understanding the deity by saying only what it is not, denying every limited human description rather than making positive claims
example: Unable to describe the perfect weekend, Farhan used the via negativa: no emails, no alarms and absolutely no meetings.

hindi: दोषपूर्ण अनवस्था — ऐसी अनंत शृंखला जिसके कारण व्याख्या कभी पूरी ही नहीं हो पाती
definition: an endless chain of reasons or conditions that is objectionable because the thing needing explanation is never actually explained or secured
example: Kiran pointed out that needing a password to reset the password to open the password manager was a vicious regress, not good security.

hindi: विदेहमुक्ति — शरीर छूटने के बाद प्राप्त पूर्ण मुक्ति
definition: liberation from the cycle of rebirth completed at the death of the body, when the freed self never takes another birth
example: In the debate class, Arnav argued that videhamukti sounded restful but asked whether the canteen would still be open.

hindi: वियना मंडल — बीसवीं सदी के आरंभ में वियना के दार्शनिकों और वैज्ञानिकों का समूह जिसने तार्किक प्रत्यक्षवाद गढ़ा
definition: the group of philosophers, scientists and mathematicians meeting in Vienna during the 1920s and 1930s who founded logical positivism and campaigned to make philosophy scientific
example: Their weekly study group took itself so seriously, banning any claim nobody could test, that the rest of the hostel nicknamed it the Vienna Circle.

hindi: ऊर्ध्व दृष्टि — जीवन को ब्रह्मांडीय ऊँचाई से देखकर उसे छोटा समझना
definition: the Stoic exercise of imagining yourself looking down on the earth from great height, so that personal worries shrink to their proper size
example: Stuck in a queue at the passport office, Karan tried the view from above and felt briefly better, until the token machine broke.

hindi: सद्गुण परिणामवाद — सद्गुण को उसके अच्छे परिणामों के आधार पर परिभाषित करने का मत
definition: the view that a character trait counts as a virtue because it tends to produce good results, combining attention to character with judging by outcomes
example: Arguing for virtue consequentialism, Ishaan said punctuality was a virtue mainly because it stopped the whole team waiting outside the cinema.

hindi: सद्गुण ज्ञानमीमांसा — ज्ञान को ज्ञाता के बौद्धिक सद्गुणों से समझने वाला दृष्टिकोण
definition: the approach that explains knowledge and justification through the intellectual virtues of the knower, meaning reliable abilities or admirable thinking habits
example: Their teacher graded the science project with virtue epistemology in mind, praising the careful checking more than the lucky result.

hindi: सद्गुण नीतिशास्त्र — कर्म के नियमों से अधिक चरित्र और सद्गुणों पर टिका नैतिक दृष्टिकोण
definition: the approach to ethics that judges actions by asking what a person of good character would choose, focusing on virtues and character rather than rules or outcomes
example: Instead of checking the office handbook, Priya used virtue ethics and asked what an honest, generous colleague would say about the missing biscuits.

hindi: सद्गुण ही ज्ञान है — यह सुकराती मत कि जो सही जानता है वह सही ही करेगा
definition: the Socratic claim that being virtuous simply consists in knowing what is good, so anyone who truly understood the good would always choose it
example: After ordering fries despite reading the nutrition label, Omar concluded that virtue is knowledge might need a second draft.

hindi: सद्गुण विश्वसनीयतावाद — ज्ञान को विश्वसनीय बौद्धिक क्षमताओं से जोड़ने वाला मत
definition: the form of virtue epistemology holding that knowledge comes from reliable mental abilities, such as sharp perception, good memory and sound reasoning
example: Nikhil's flawless memory for phone numbers made him the office's walking argument for virtue reliabilism.

hindi: सद्गुण उत्तरदायित्ववाद — ज्ञान को बौद्धिक चरित्र-गुणों से जोड़ने वाला मत
definition: the form of virtue epistemology stressing intellectual character traits, such as open-mindedness, curiosity and carefulness, that a responsible thinker cultivates
example: Admitting she might be wrong about the pineapple pizza debate, Diya claimed a small victory for virtue responsibilism.

hindi: सद्गुणी नगर — दार्शनिक-शासक के अधीन सुख की ओर उन्मुख आदर्श समाज
definition: Al-Farabi's ideal political community, ruled by a wise philosopher-leader, in which citizens cooperate to reach true happiness and moral excellence
example: After the hostel voted to share chores fairly, Ishaan announced they were one clean kitchen away from the virtuous city.

hindi: जीवंत बल — गतिमान पिंड की शक्ति का लाइबनिज़ीय माप
definition: a Latin phrase meaning 'living force', Leibniz's measure of the active power of a moving body, which he used against the purely geometric physics of Descartes
example: Seeing her cousin sprint down the corridor after a sugary drink, Ritu said the child was pure vis viva.

hindi: विशेष — वैशेषिक दर्शन में नित्य द्रव्यों को एक-दूसरे से अलग करने वाला अंतिम भेदक
definition: in Vaisheshika philosophy, the ultimate particularity that distinguishes eternal things, such as atoms, which otherwise look perfectly alike
example: Two identical grains of rice on the plate prompted Aditi to explain vishesha, though her brother only wanted to know which grain he could keep.

hindi: विशिष्टाद्वैत — रामानुज का मत कि जीव और जगत ब्रह्म के वास्तविक अंग हैं
definition: Ramanuja's school of Vedanta holding that Brahman is the single ultimate reality, yet individual selves and the world are real, distinct parts of Brahman, like a body belonging to its soul
example: Priya described the office team through vishishtadvaita: everyone keeps a real identity, but all of them live inside one company.

hindi: ईश्वर में दर्शन — मैलब्रांश का मत कि हम सभी विचारों को ईश्वर में देखते हैं
definition: Malebranche's doctrine that humans perceive the ideas of things not within their minds but within the divine intellect, where every idea truly resides
example: When everyone in the book club reached the same interpretation independently, Tara half-seriously credited vision in God rather than the blurb on the cover.

hindi: प्राणशक्ति — बंटू दर्शन में सत्ता को ही जीवंत शक्ति मानने का विचार
definition: in Bantu philosophy as described by Tempels, the idea that being itself is a living force, which can grow stronger or weaker through relationships and actions
example: After three cups of chai and a pep talk, Zanele said her vital force was fully restored for exam week.

hindi: प्राणवाद — जीवन को भौतिकी-रसायन से परे किसी विशेष प्राण-शक्ति से चलता मानने का मत
definition: the view that living things are driven by a special life force that cannot be fully explained by physics and chemistry
example: Watching the wilted basil perk up an hour after watering, Pooja joked that her windowsill was making the case for vitalism.

hindi: वितण्डा — बिना अपना मत रखे केवल दूसरे का खंडन करने वाली बहस
definition: in Nyaya philosophy, destructive debate, a discussion in which one side only attacks the opponent's position and never defends any view of its own
example: Every suggestion for the trip got shot down, and Kunal finally asked his cousin to stop the vitanda and propose a destination.

hindi: विवर्तवाद — अद्वैत मत कि जगत ब्रह्म का वास्तविक नहीं, केवल आभासी रूपांतरण है
definition: the Advaita Vedanta doctrine that the world is only an apparent transformation of Brahman, the single ultimate reality, much as a rope in faint light appears to be a snake
example: When the coat on the chair looked like a burglar at midnight, Aditya remembered vivartavada and switched on the light.

hindi: विवेक — नित्य और अनित्य, सत्य और असत्य में भेद करने की शक्ति
definition: discrimination, the ability to distinguish the eternal from the temporary and the real self from everything that merely appears
example: Choosing to sleep instead of doom-scrolling at midnight, Aisha felt her viveka finally getting stronger.

hindi: शून्य आकाश — वह रिक्त स्थान जिसमें परमाणु गति करते हैं
definition: in Greek atomism, the completely empty space that separates atoms and allows them to move, which the atomists claimed exists just as really as matter
example: Opening his wallet at the end of the month, Arjun found only the void, a region the atomists had assured him was perfectly real.

hindi: संकल्प — किसी कर्म को करने का सचेत निर्णय या इच्छा-क्रिया
definition: the mental action of deciding or willing something, the step by which a person turns wanting into actually doing
example: It took real volition for Sameer to leave his warm blanket and face the Monday alarm.

hindi: संकल्पगत अनिवार्यता — ऐसी प्रतिबद्धता जिसके विरुद्ध व्यक्ति कर्म कर ही न सके
definition: the condition of being unable to bring yourself to choose otherwise because of what you deeply care about, which feels binding yet expresses your own will
example: Asked to skip her sister's wedding for a client meeting, Rhea felt a volitional necessity: there was simply no version of her that would go.

hindi: स्वैच्छिक इच्छामृत्यु — रोगी के स्पष्ट अनुरोध पर दी गई मृत्यु
definition: euthanasia carried out at the clear and competent request of the person who is suffering and wishes their life to be ended
example: In the ethics seminar, Farah pointed out that voluntary euthanasia hinges entirely on whether the request itself is genuinely free.

hindi: वृत्ति — चित्त में उठने वाली विचार-तरंग या हलचल
definition: in Yoga philosophy, any fluctuation or wave in the mind, such as perception, error, imagination, sleep or memory, which classical Yoga aims to still
example: Every buzz of her phone set off another vritti, and Riya's plan to meditate for ten minutes became a plan to meditate eventually.

hindi: व्याप्ति — हेतु और साध्य के बीच अनिवार्य, नियत संबंध
definition: in Nyaya logic, invariable concomitance or pervasion, the fixed relation between a reason and what it proves, such as wherever there is smoke there is fire, on which every sound inference rests
example: Arguing that every late-night message from her boss means trouble, Mira admitted her vyapti rested on only three examples.

hindi: व्यवहार नय — वस्तु को लोक-व्यवहार के अनुसार देखने वाली जैन दृष्टि
definition: in Jain philosophy, the conventional standpoint, which describes a thing according to everyday language and ordinary appearance rather than its ultimate nature
example: Speaking from the vyavahara naya, Anil admitted that the sun rises every morning, even though the planet is doing the actual turning.

hindi: व्यावहारिक — दैनिक व्यवहार का, परंपरागत सत्य का स्तर
definition: belonging to the practical level of reality, the everyday world of separate objects and people that is real for ordinary life but not ultimately
example: Her father conceded that money was merely vyavaharika, but still wanted the electricity bill paid on time.

hindi: अपूर्ण-सौंदर्य — अपूर्ण, सादे और क्षणिक में सौंदर्य देखने का जापानी दृष्टिकोण
definition: the Japanese aesthetic that finds beauty in things that are imperfect, simple, aging and incomplete, accepting transience rather than polishing it away
example: Ananya defended her chipped coffee mug as wabi-sabi, though her flatmate insisted it was simply a hazard.

hindi: वहदत-उल-वुजूद — सारा अस्तित्व एक ही परम सत्ता है, यह सूफ़ी मत
definition: the Islamic mystical doctrine of the unity of being, linked to Ibn Arabi, holding that all existence is ultimately one divine reality
example: Listening to qawwali on the drive home, Zain said wahdat al-wujud made even the traffic feel like part of something single.

hindi: वांग विरोधाभास — 'छोटी संख्या' जैसे अस्पष्ट शब्द पर लागू सोराइटीज़ रूप
definition: a puzzle about vague words applied to numbers, reasoning in tiny steps: zero is small, and adding one to a small number keeps it small, so every number seems small
example: When his manager called a budget increase small, Hemant invoked Wang's paradox and asked for every increase after that.

hindi: विवेकहीन इच्छाचारी — अपनी इच्छाओं पर विचार किए बिना उनके पीछे चलने वाला
definition: a being that follows whatever desire is strongest without caring which desires it would prefer to have, and so lacks free will in the full sense
example: Watching his flatmate reach for a fourth cookie without a flicker of second thought, Farhan declared him a wanton.

hindi: प्रामाण्य — वह गुण जो सत्य विश्वास को ज्ञान में बदल देता है
definition: whatever quality turns true belief into knowledge, sometimes explained as belief produced by properly working mental faculties in a suitable environment
example: Reading the bus timetable on the official app gave Isha warrant for her plan, unlike her friend's hunch.

hindi: प्रमाणित कथनीयता — जाँच से पर्याप्त समर्थन पाए कथन की स्थिति, जिसे डेवी ने 'सत्य' के स्थान पर रखा
definition: Dewey's term for the status of a belief that careful inquiry has supported well enough to be stated with confidence, offered as a replacement for the older notion of truth
example: Meera told her brother his claim about the cricket score lacked warranted assertibility until he actually checked the live feed.

hindi: तरंग-फलन पतन — मापन पर क्वांटम संभावनाओं का एक निश्चित परिणाम में सिमटना
definition: the proposed process in quantum physics where a system spread across many possible states suddenly settles into one definite state when measured
example: The moment the teacher called his name, Sid's excuses underwent wave function collapse into one very weak story.

hindi: मोम तर्क — पदार्थ का ज्ञान इंद्रियों से नहीं, बुद्धि से होता है, इस पर देकार्त का तर्क
definition: Descartes's argument that a piece of beeswax keeps its identity after melting changes its colour, smell and shape, so we know physical things through the intellect rather than the senses
example: Watching her candle collapse into a puddle, Isha realised she still recognised it, and remembered the wax argument from her philosophy notes.

hindi: प्रत्यय-पद्धति — मन केवल अपने विचारों को सीधे जानता है, इस मान्यता का रीड द्वारा दिया नाम
definition: Reid's critical name for the doctrine, shared by Descartes, Locke and Hume, that the mind directly perceives only its ideas, never external objects
example: When Kunal claimed he only ever saw his mental image of the bus, his teacher said he had joined the way of ideas and missed the actual bus.

hindi: दुर्बल कृत्रिम बुद्धि — कंप्यूटर को मन के अध्ययन का उपयोगी साधन भर मानने का मत
definition: the more modest thesis that computers are powerful tools for studying and simulating minds, without claiming that any program actually thinks or understands
example: Sunita settled for weak AI at the lunch table: the software modelled her shopping habits brilliantly without having a single opinion about avocados.

hindi: दुर्बल उद्भव — ऐसे गुण जो अंशों से निकलते तो हैं पर केवल अनुकरण से ही जाने जाते हैं
definition: the view that novel properties of whole systems follow from their parts, but are surprising and can only be discovered by simulating or watching the system operate
example: The traffic jam on the ring road was weak emergence at work: every driver's choices explained it, yet nobody could have predicted it without watching.

hindi: संकल्प-दुर्बलता — अपने ही बेहतर निर्णय के विरुद्ध आचरण कर लेना
definition: the condition of freely acting against what you yourself judge to be the better option, because desire or feeling overpowers your judgement
example: Staring at the empty biscuit packet, Meera admitted that weakness of will had beaten her resolution by lunchtime.

hindi: विश्वास-जाल — क्वाइन का मत कि हमारे सभी विश्वास एक जुड़े जाल की तरह परखे जाते हैं
definition: Quine's picture of knowledge as a connected network in which any belief, even logic, could be revised to fit new experience
example: When the bus timetable proved wrong, Kunal adjusted his whole web of belief, starting with trust in the council website.

hindi: कल्याणवाद — परिणामों का मूल्य केवल व्यक्तियों के कल्याण से आँकने का मत
definition: the view that the value of an outcome depends only on the wellbeing of the individuals in it, so nothing else, such as equality or beauty, matters in itself
example: Pooja's welfarism made her unmoved by the neat new office layout until she learned it actually made people happier.

hindi: सुगठित सूत्र — तर्क-भाषा के व्याकरण-नियमों के अनुसार सही बना हुआ चिह्न-क्रम
definition: a string of symbols built correctly according to the grammar rules of a formal logical language, so that it counts as meaningful there
example: Half of Zoya's logic homework got marked wrong before it was even judged true or false, because it wasn't a well-formed formula.

hindi: कल्याण — किसी व्यक्ति के लिए उसका जीवन वास्तव में कितना अच्छा चल रहा है
definition: how well a person's life is going for that person themselves, which theories of wellbeing explain through pleasure, satisfied desires or objectively valuable goods
example: Anjali's manager asked about her wellbeing in the weekly meeting, then assigned her four new projects before she could answer.

hindi: विश्वात्मा — इतिहास में प्रकट होती सार्वभौमिक चेतना
definition: Hegel's term for the world spirit, the universal mind that expresses itself through history, moving whole nations and eras toward greater freedom and self-awareness
example: When his startup finally launched, Aditya announced that the Weltgeist was on his side, a claim his investors found charming but unhelpful.

hindi: संस्कृति — विद्या, कला और परिष्कृत आचरण
definition: the Confucian ideal of cultural refinement: learning, literature, music and graceful conduct that polish a person's natural character
example: Signing up for classical music lessons at forty, Rakesh said he was finally working on his wen.

hindi: सार-दर्शन — किसी वस्तु के सार को सीधे अंतर्दृष्टि से पकड़ना
definition: Husserl's German term for directly grasping the essence of something, the essential features any example of that kind must share, through careful reflective insight
example: After forty group chats, Priya claimed a Wesensschau of the reply-all message: pointless, urgent and always sent at midnight.

hindi: पश्चिमी मार्क्सवाद — संस्कृति, चेतना और दर्शन पर केंद्रित यूरोपीय मार्क्सवादी परंपरा
definition: the tradition of European Marxist thought, including Lukacs, Gramsci and the Frankfurt School, that focused on culture, consciousness and philosophy rather than economics alone
example: Their reading group began with economic charts but drifted into Western Marxism once someone brought up film and advertising.

hindi: वेस्टफेलियाई संप्रभुता — हर राज्य के अपने भीतरी मामलों में बाहरी हस्तक्षेप से मुक्त होने का सिद्धांत
definition: the principle that each state has exclusive authority over its own territory and internal affairs, and outside powers should not interfere
example: Neha's bedroom door sign declared Westphalian sovereignty: no siblings, no inspections, and absolutely no borrowing chargers.

hindi: ध्यान-भटकाऊ प्रत्यारोप — अपने ऊपर लगे आरोप के जवाब में दूसरों की गलतियाँ गिनाना
definition: the tactic of answering a criticism by pointing to some other wrongdoing elsewhere, turning attention away instead of responding to the original charge
example: Asked why the dishes were still in the sink, Aman launched into whataboutism about the laundry pile his roommate had ignored.

hindi: स्वरूपता — किसी वस्तु का 'क्या-पन', यानी वह सार जिससे वह वही बनती है
definition: an English rendering of quiddity: the essence that makes a thing the kind of thing it is, answering what that thing really is
example: Staring at the plant-based burger, Dev wondered aloud whether it shared the whatness of a burger or merely its shape.

hindi: श्वेत अश्व विरोधाभास — 'सफेद घोड़ा घोड़ा नहीं है' का तर्क
definition: the Chinese argument that 'a white horse is not a horse', which plays on the difference between a general category and a specific kind within it
example: When the canteen refused his 'cold coffee is not coffee' coupon trick, Aman blamed their ignorance of the white horse paradox.

hindi: श्वेत विशेषाधिकार — गोरी त्वचा से मिलने वाले अनर्जित सामाजिक लाभ
definition: the idea that people perceived as white receive unearned advantages in racially unequal societies, often without noticing them
example: Hearing that his friend was always stopped at airport security while he breezed through, Tom finally understood white privilege.

hindi: व्यापक विषयवस्तु — बाहरी परिवेश से भी तय होने वाली मानसिक विषयवस्तु
definition: the part of a thought's content that depends on the thinker's environment and social setting, so that internally identical people can still think different things
example: Wide content, the teacher explained, means your thought about the local river depends on which river you actually grew up beside.

hindi: विग्नर का मित्र — दो प्रेक्षकों के बीच मापन-परिणाम की असहमति वाला विचार-प्रयोग
definition: the thought experiment where someone measures a quantum system inside a sealed laboratory while an outside observer treats friend and system together as still undecided
example: Waiting outside while her flatmate read the landlord's letter, Juhi felt like the observer in Wigner's friend.

hindi: सबकी इच्छा — व्यक्तिगत इच्छाओं का जोड़, जिसे रूसो सामान्य इच्छा से अलग मानते हैं
definition: Rousseau's term for the mere total of everyone's private wants added together, which he contrasts with the general will aimed at the common good
example: The office poll produced the will of all, forty separate lunch orders, instead of one sensible catering plan.

hindi: इच्छा सिद्धांत — अधिकार का सार व्यक्ति को मिला चुनाव और नियंत्रण है
definition: the theory that having a right means having control or choice over another person's duty, including the power to waive or enforce it
example: Under will theory, Meenal pointed out, she could forgive her brother's debt, since the right to be repaid was hers to waive.

hindi: विश्वास का संकल्प — प्रमाण अपर्याप्त होने पर भी कुछ प्रश्नों में विश्वास चुनने का अधिकार
definition: William James's argument that, when evidence cannot decide a genuine and pressing question, we are entitled to let our passions and needs choose which belief to hold
example: Joining the startup without guarantees, Kavya called it her will to believe: waiting for proof meant missing the chance entirely.

hindi: जीवित रहने का संकल्प — शोपेनहावर के अनुसार हर प्राणी में बैठी अंधी, कभी न थमने वाली इच्छा
definition: Schopenhauer's idea that a blind, endless striving drives every living thing to survive and reproduce, producing desire and suffering that never fully ends
example: Watching ants rebuild their nest for the third time after the mop went through, Priya saw Schopenhauer's will to live in miniature.

hindi: अर्थ की इच्छा — जीवन में उद्देश्य खोजने की मूल मानवीय प्रेरणा
definition: Frankl's term for the basic human drive to find purpose and meaning in life, which he placed above pleasure or power as our deepest motivation
example: Volunteering at the shelter every Sunday, Harsh said his will to meaning outweighed his will to sleep in.

hindi: शक्ति-संकल्प — नीत्शे के अनुसार जीवन की मूल प्रेरणा: बढ़ने, जीतने और स्वयं को प्रकट करने की इच्छा
definition: Nietzsche's idea that the deepest drive in living things is a striving to grow, overcome resistance and express their strength, more basic than the wish to survive
example: Aarav claimed his will to power explained why he refused to lose at carrom, even to his seven-year-old cousin.

hindi: विल्ट चेम्बरलेन तर्क — नोज़िक का तर्क कि स्वैच्छिक लेन-देन किसी भी निर्धारित समान वितरण को भंग कर देते हैं
definition: Nozick's argument that voluntary payments to a popular performer will upset any fixed pattern of fair distribution, so preserving patterns requires constant interference
example: Watching fans throw money at a street drummer, Farhan explained the Wilt Chamberlain argument to his girlfriend, who wanted to hear the drumming.

hindi: राज्य का लोप — वर्गहीन समाज में राज्य के अनावश्यक होकर मिट जाने का मार्क्सवादी मत
definition: the Marxist prediction that once class divisions disappear, the state, seen as a tool of class rule, will gradually become unnecessary and fade out
example: Watching the society committee fail to agree on anything, Rahul hoped for the withering away of the state, or at least of the committee.

hindi: विट्गेंस्टाइन की सीढ़ी — ऐसे विचार जिनका उपयोग समझ तक पहुँचकर त्याग देना होता है
definition: the image of philosophical statements as a ladder you climb to reach clear understanding and then throw away, because the statements themselves turn out to be nonsense
example: Her maths tutor's rough analogies were Wittgenstein's ladder: useful for reaching the idea, then quietly dropped once Zoya understood it.

hindi: विट्गेन्स्टाइनी आस्थावाद — धार्मिक भाषा को केवल अपने जीवन-रूप के भीतर समझे जाने का मत
definition: the view, drawn from Wittgenstein's later writing, that religious belief forms a distinct practice with separate rules, so outsiders cannot judge religious faith by scientific standards
example: In the staff room, Meera defended a colleague's prayer before exams with Wittgensteinian fideism, saying it follows the rules of faith, not of chemistry.

hindi: स्त्रीत्ववाद — अश्वेत स्त्रियों के अनुभव पर आधारित नारीवादी चिंतन
definition: a strand of feminist thought rooted in the experiences, culture and spirituality of Black women, attentive to race, class and community
example: In her essay, Imani explained that womanism spoke to her grandmother's church and kitchen far better than her textbook's feminism chapter did.

hindi: वॉन बौद्ध मत — दैनिक जीवन में धर्म को उतारने वाली आधुनिक कोरियाई परंपरा
definition: a modern Korean Buddhist movement, founded in 1916, that seeks awakening within everyday work and family life and symbolises truth with a simple circle
example: Minji's uncle followed Won Buddhism, treating his accounting office as a place of practice as sacred as any temple.

hindi: विश्वात्मा — संपूर्ण जगत को जीवित और व्यवस्थित रखने वाली आत्मा
definition: the idea, found in Plato's Timaeus, that the whole universe is a single living being possessing a soul giving it order and motion
example: Watching thousands of commuters move in rhythm at the station, Leela half believed in a world soul directing the rush hour.

hindi: जगतबद्ध व्यक्ति — वह व्यक्ति जो केवल एक ही संभाव्य जगत में विद्यमान हो
definition: an individual that exists in exactly one possible world and nowhere else, as counterpart theory holds of every ordinary person and object
example: Realising that he might be a world-bound individual, Yash decided he had better make this particular version of Saturday count.

hindi: लोक-यात्रा — दूसरों के सामाजिक संसार में प्रेमपूर्वक प्रवेश करने का अभ्यास
definition: Lugones's term for moving between the different social worlds people inhabit, and lovingly trying to understand the ways others experience their world
example: Spending a weekend helping at her friend's family shop, Anya practised a little world-traveling and stopped judging their hectic mornings.

hindi: ग़लत प्रकार के कारण — जो किसी भावना को लाभदायक तो बनाते हैं पर उचित नहीं
definition: reasons that make holding an attitude useful without making it fitting, such as a reward for admiring something plainly unworthy of admiration
example: The manager's bonus offer for loving the new software gave staff only the wrong kind of reasons to adore it.

hindi: अनुचित जीवन — यह दावा कि जन्म लेना ही किसी के लिए हानि था
definition: a legal and moral claim that a person was harmed by being born with severe suffering, raising puzzles about comparing existence with nonexistence
example: Their philosophy club argued about wrongful life so intensely that someone had to bring out emergency samosas.

hindi: अभाव — दाओवादी दर्शन में वह रिक्तता जिससे सब वस्तुएँ प्रकट होती हैं
definition: the Daoist notion of nonbeing or absence, the empty openness from which existing things emerge and which makes them useful
example: Pouring tea, Wei pointed out that the cup works because of its wu, the empty space inside, not the clay around it.

hindi: अकर्म — बिना ज़ोर-ज़बरदस्ती के, सहज भाव से किया गया कर्म
definition: the Daoist ideal of effortless action: acting naturally and without strain, forcing nothing, so that things unfold smoothly of their own accord
example: Instead of nagging her toddler to sleep, Priya dimmed the lights and waited, and her husband called it wu wei parenting.

hindi: अनंत शून्य — सृष्टि से पहले की निराकार अवस्था
definition: in Chinese cosmology, the limitless or formless state of nothingness that comes before the Supreme Ultimate and before yin and yang divide
example: Opening her empty fridge on Sunday night, Pooja announced that her kitchen had returned to wuji.

hindi: पितृभक्ति — माता-पिता और पूर्वजों के प्रति श्रद्धा और सेवा
definition: the Confucian virtue of filial piety: respect, obedience and loving care that children should show their parents and ancestors, seen as the root of all goodness
example: Calling his mother every evening from the commuter train was Aditya's modest daily practice of xiao.

hindi: क्षुद्रजन — स्वार्थ में डूबा हुआ ओछा व्यक्ति
definition: the Confucian term for the petty person, someone driven by selfish profit and narrow interests, the opposite of the exemplary junzi
example: When a colleague took credit for the whole project, Nisha quietly labelled him a xiaoren in her diary.

hindi: विश्वसनीयता — वचन निभाने और सच्चा रहने का गुण
definition: the Confucian virtue of trustworthiness: keeping your word and being reliable, so that your speech and actions match
example: Ishaan showed up at six sharp as promised, and his friends agreed his xin was stronger than his coffee.

hindi: गूढ़ विद्या — नवताओवादी दार्शनिक चिंतन
definition: the later Chinese movement often called Neo-Daoism or Dark Learning, which explored nonbeing (pure nothingness), nature and hidden meaning in Daoist and Confucian texts
example: Late-night debates about whether nothingness comes before everything left the hostel feeling like a xuanxue seminar.

hindi: याब्लो विरोधाभास — अनंत वाक्य-श्रृंखला से बिना आत्मसंदर्भ के उपजा असत्यवादी जैसा विरोधाभास
definition: an endless list of sentences, each saying that every later sentence is false, which creates a liar-style contradiction without any sentence referring to itself
example: Rohan claimed his inbox resembled Yablo's paradox: every email insisted all the following emails were outdated.

hindi: यदृच्छावाद — घटनाओं को संयोग या आकस्मिकता से होने वाला मानने का मत
definition: the ancient Indian view that events happen by chance or accident, without any fixed cause, divine purpose or moral order behind them
example: When the shuffled playlist played three sad songs in a row, Manav refused to see a message in it and defended plain yadrcchavada.

hindi: यम — योग के आरंभिक नैतिक संयम
definition: in Patanjali's yoga, the ethical restraints forming the first limb of practice: nonviolence, truthfulness, refraining from theft, sexual restraint and freedom from greed
example: The yoga teacher said yama came before any stretching, which disappointed the students who had come only for the headstands.

hindi: यांगवाद — अपने जीवन और स्वास्थ्य की रक्षा को प्रधान मानने वाला चीनी मत
definition: the early Chinese school that valued preserving your own life, health and natural nature above serving the state or chasing possessions
example: Skipping the unpaid weekend meeting to sleep and cook, Rhea called it a small act of Yangism.

hindi: धर्मनिष्ठा — उचित और न्यायपूर्ण कर्म करने का भाव
definition: the Confucian virtue of rightness or righteousness: doing what is morally fitting in each situation, even when personal profit points elsewhere
example: Refusing to copy the leaked answer key, Sana told her group chat that yi mattered more than her grade.

hindi: द्वंद्व-संतुलन — परस्पर पूरक विरोधी शक्तियों का सिद्धांत
definition: the Chinese idea that reality is shaped by a pair of complementary forces, dark and light, passive and active, which depend on each other and constantly change places
example: Her flatmate cooks and she washes up, so Meera calls their kitchen routine a small daily yin and yang.

hindi: योगाचार — अनुभव को चेतना की ही रचना मानने वाला बौद्ध दर्शन
definition: the Buddhist school, founded by Asanga and Vasubandhu, which teaches that the world people experience is constructed by consciousness, and studies how the mind builds that experience
example: After a dream about exams felt completely real, Diya started reading Yogacara on the train home.

hindi: गूढ़ सौंदर्य — संकेत मात्र से झलकने वाली गहरी, रहस्यमय सुंदरता
definition: the Japanese aesthetic ideal of profound, mysterious beauty that is suggested rather than shown, stirring feelings deeper than words can reach
example: The foggy morning over the flyover had a certain yugen, until the horns started and the mystery dissolved.

hindi: ज़मानी — म्बीती के अनुसार पूर्वजों से जुड़ा गहरा, विस्तृत अतीत
definition: in John Mbiti's account of African concepts of time, the deep past into which events and ancestors gradually move, forming the foundation of the present
example: Flipping through her great-grandparents' photographs, Achieng felt the Zamani quietly holding up the present.

hindi: ध्यानासन — बौद्ध ध्यान में सीधी मुद्रा में शांत बैठने का अभ्यास
definition: seated meditation in Japanese Buddhism, keeping an upright posture while calmly watching breath and thoughts without chasing them
example: Ishaan tried twenty minutes of zazen before his exam, and discovered that his mind contained roughly four hundred unfinished group chats.

hindi: युगचेतना — किसी काल की प्रचलित सोच और मनोभाव
definition: the spirit of a particular historical period, the shared outlook, mood and ideas that shape how people living through that period think, create and behave
example: Scrolling past endless productivity videos, Nisha decided the Zeitgeist was mostly people apologising for resting.

hindi: ध्यान सम्प्रदाय — ध्यान और प्रत्यक्ष अनुभूति से बोध पाने वाली जापानी बौद्ध परंपरा
definition: a Japanese school of Buddhism, grown from the Chinese meditation school Chan, that seeks awakening through seated meditation and direct insight rather than scripture study
example: When the office printer jammed for the fourth time, Tanvi closed her eyes, breathed slowly and announced she was approaching the whole thing with Zen patience.

hindi: ज़ेनो के विरोधाभास — गति और बहुलता को असंभव सिद्ध करने वाले तर्क
definition: a series of puzzling arguments by Zeno of Elea that attempt to show that motion, change and plurality lead to contradictions and therefore cannot be real
example: Whenever Dad says the download is almost finished, Ishaan reminds him of Zeno's paradoxes, since the last percent never seems to arrive.

hindi: अन्वेषणशील — निष्कर्ष के बजाय निरंतर खोज में लगा
definition: describing a sceptical attitude of continual inquiry that keeps searching and questioning rather than settling on fixed conclusions
example: Kavya's zetetic approach to online shopping meant forty open tabs and still no decision about the kettle.

hindi: प्रज्ञा — भले-बुरे को पहचानने की नैतिक बुद्धि
definition: the Confucian virtue of moral wisdom: the ability to recognise what is right and wrong and to judge people and situations well
example: Knowing which cousin to seat far from which uncle at the wedding required real zhi, said the planner.

hindi: निष्ठा — अपने कर्तव्य और दूसरों के प्रति पूरी लगन
definition: the Confucian virtue of loyalty or dutifulness: doing your best wholeheartedly for others and faithfully fulfilling the duties of your role
example: Staying late to help a teammate finish the report was, Farhan joked, zhong with overtime.

hindi: स्वभाव — अपने-आप होने वाली सहज प्राकृतिक अवस्था
definition: the Daoist ideal of spontaneity or being 'so of itself': letting things follow their own nature without artificial control or interference
example: Kiran let the balcony plants grow wild and called her gardening style ziran rather than laziness.

hindi: ज़ॉम्बी तर्क — अनुभवहीन प्रतिरूप की कल्पना से चेतना के अभौतिक होने का तर्क
definition: the argument that, since a physically identical person with no inner experience seems conceivable, consciousness must be something more than physical facts about the brain
example: Tara tried the zombie argument on her roommate, who replied that she looked exactly like one before her morning coffee.

hindi: स्त्री लेखन — स्त्री देह और अनुभव से उपजी लेखन-शैली का विचार
definition: a French feminist idea of writing that expresses women's bodies and experience, breaking free of rigid, male-structured language and logic
example: Her poetry teacher called the looping, unpunctuated journal entries écriture féminine, which sounded far better than 'forgot full stops'.

hindi: अतिमानव — नीत्शे का आदर्श मनुष्य, जो अपने मूल्य स्वयं रचता है
definition: Nietzsche's ideal of a future human who overcomes ordinary values and creates fresh values of their own, affirming life without leaning on inherited morality
example: After running a marathon and filing his taxes on the same day, Vikram announced he had become the Übermensch.

hindi: वुकासिएविच तर्कशास्त्र — भविष्य के अनिश्चित कथनों हेतु बना बहुमूल्य तर्क
definition: a many-valued logic, first built with three truth values and later extended to infinitely many, designed partly for statements about the undecided future
example: Karan said his exam results existed only in Łukasiewicz logic, neither true nor false until the website finally loaded.
